title_en: Processing method and system for path selection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a processing method and system for path selection. The processing method comprises the steps that a path optimization model is established, wherein the path optimization model comprises objective functions of journey time, objective functions of transportation cost and objective functions of safe-passing probabilities of all road segments; effectiveness conversion is performed on all the objective functions according to the multi-attribute decision theory, and the maximum values and minimum values of the journey time, the transportation cost and the safe-passing probability of all the road segments are respectively figured out; time utility values, transportation cost utility values and safe-passing probability utility values of all the road segments are determined through linear transformation; the time utility value, the transportation cost utility value and the safe-passing probability utility value are respectively converted into corresponding dimensionless values through dimensionless processing; path optimization is converted into a single-attribute decision by performing weighting on all the dimensionless values; a passing path with the maximum decision utility value is found by the adoption of the shortest-path optimization algorithm. According to the processing method and system for the path selection, the process of the path selection is simplified, and the transportation requirement of emergency relief supplies can be fully met.

title_en: Clinical care Performance Evaluation System and method based on data mining analysis platform
abstract_en: The invention belongs to medical nursing assessment technique fields, disclose a kind of clinical care Performance Evaluation System and method based on data mining analysis platform, application decision tree analysis method carries out classification analysis to nursing unit nursery work quantity, quality, efficiency, achievement, nurses performance appraisal for hospital care unit and lump sum bonus distribution provides the classification foundation and evaluation method of science.The satisfaction that the present invention is applied in terms of objectivity, applicability, fairness, acceptance, efficiency, the total satisfaction 6 of nursing performance decision tree analysis is investigated and analysed, and satisfaction rate steps up, and total satisfaction is promoted by 72.41% to 98.28%；The decision tree analysis method of nursing performance provided by the invention can effectively improve satisfaction rate of the nurse to nursing performance appraisal, be the evaluation method that nursing unit nursing performance management distributes effective science with lump sum bonus.
assignees: THE THIRD PEOPLES HOSPITAL OF HUBEI PROVINCE

title_en: Intelligent scheduling and attendance management method for hospital departments
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of internal management of hospital departments, and discloses an intelligent scheduling and attendance management method for hospital departments, which solves the problem that the traditional manual scheduling management mode and the traditional attendance mode no longer meet the management requirements of modern large enterprises. The invention can automatically generate a fair and fair scheduling list which meets the requirements of staff, reduces the complexity of manual scheduling and the situations of insufficient and excessive personnel allocation, avoids the phenomenon of vacant posts caused by disordered allocation, introduces face recognition attendance and avoids the defects of 'no identity of recognized cards' of substitute card punching and traditional attendance; the condition that 'must be pressed by hand' of fingerprint attendance is eliminated, the table is directly perceived and friendly, and the multi-dimensional table of checking up is promoted to the cognitive degree and the degree of obedience to the table, makes the scheduling more humanized, avoids manpower repetition and waste to a great extent, has improved the fairness and the exactness of scheduling, has reduced the loaded down with trivial details nature of scheduling, makes intelligent scheduling system obtain extensive application gradually.
assignees: SHANGHAI REDNOBLE INFORMATION TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Resource distribution method, device, storage medium and computer equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a resource issuing method, a resource issuing device, a storage medium and computer equipment. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a resource verification user and a preset resource; comparing the user characteristics of the resource verification user and the target user, and determining a first similarity between the resource verification user and the target user; comparing the resource characteristics of the preset resource with the resource characteristics of the history resource corresponding to the first user, and determining a second similarity between the preset resource and the history resource; determining the verification probability of the target user relative to the preset resource according to the first similarity and the second similarity; and distributing the preset resources to a target user according to the resource verification probability. According to the method, automatic dynamic resource allocation can be realized without training of a network model, objective and fairness of resource allocation are guaranteed, a target user can obtain resources which meet requirements of the target user, the use effect of the resources and shopping experience of the user are improved, and the loyalty of the user is enhanced.

title_en: College scientific and technological achievement equity distribution method and intelligent management system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of college intellectual property management, in particular to a college scientific and technological achievement equity distribution method and an intelligent management system.
assignees: UNIV NANJING SCIENCE & TECH;JIANGSU SHEHUITONG INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Bearing capacity improvement-oriented water resource optimal allocation method
abstract_en: The invention provides a water resource optimal allocation method for bearing capacity improvement, which belongs to the technical field of watershed water and soil resource risk assessment and comprises the following steps: determining water resource data of an area to be configured; respectively determining a social benefit optimization target with the minimum water deficiency of the area to be configured, an economic benefit optimization target with the minimum water consumption of the ten thousand-element GDP, an environmental benefit optimization target with the maximum carbon sink capacity and an ecological benefit optimization target with the maximum satisfaction degree of the ecological base flow; respectively determining a water quantity balance constraint condition, a pollutant discharge quantity constraint condition of an area to be configured and a water supply fairness constraint condition that the water resource bearing capacity of the area to be configured is not higher than a critical overload level; and optimally configuring regional water resources through a hunger game search algorithm. The invention solves the problem of lower accuracy of water resource allocation based on the existing method.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Surgical grade grading incentive issuing method for performance assessment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a surgical grade grading incentive issuing method for performance assessment, which belongs to the technical field of medical management and comprises the following steps of 1) constructing a dynamic operation grading weight model based on operation risks, technical difficulties, resource consumption and ethical risks, adjusting the performance score of each operation in real time, 2) integrating technical dimension indexes and quality dimension indexes, weighting each index through a machine learning model, and realizing personalized assessment, and 3) blocking chain driven incentive issuing, namely recording operation data and assessment results through a blocking chain technology, and improving enthusiasm of high-difficulty operation development, optimizing medical resource allocation, reducing weight and quality risks and enhancing data credibility and incentive fairness through the dynamic operation grading weight model, the multi-dimensional performance assessment index system and a blocking chain driven incentive issuing and cross-hospital collaborative incentive pool.
assignees: GUANGXI HOSPITAL AFFILIATED TO SUN YAT SEN UNIV

title_en: Internal span type tire crane instruction scheduling method based on multidimensional dynamic priority and predictive scheduling
abstract_en: The invention discloses an internal cross tire crane instruction scheduling method based on multidimensional dynamic priority and predictive scheduling, which comprises the following steps of S1, S2, opportunistic overtaking window evaluation, S3, nonlinear dynamic sequencing of conventional instructions, and S4, instruction issuing and rescheduling. The invention quantifies and decides whether to execute the overtaking instruction with higher net benefit through the opportunistic overtaking window evaluation so as to improve the operation efficiency, ensures that the priority of the instruction waiting for a long time can be systematically improved by introducing the instruction waiting time length factor with exponential growth characteristic and the maximum tolerance threshold so as to ensure the dispatching fairness, and reduces the instruction priority of the congestion area through the local congestion factor so as to achieve the effect of relieving the traffic bottleneck.
assignees: NANJING PORT LONGTAN CONTAINER CO LTD

title_en: Apparatus and method for predicting score for question and answer content, and storage medium
abstract_en: An apparatus and a method for predicting a score for question and answer content, and a storage medium, the method comprising: collecting historical question and answer content of a written exam stage and a corresponding actual score for each question and answer content (S1); on the basis of the answer content, constructing a term segmentation library, a text corpus, a term frequency-inverse document frequency indicator model, and a latent Dirichlet allocation model, and storing same in a database (S2); importing the term segmentation library, the text corpus, the term frequency-inverse document frequency indicator model, and the latent Dirichlet allocation model in the database, performing term segmentation and term frequency calculation, and then inputting a result into the term frequency-inverse document frequency indicator model and the latent Dirichlet allocation model, and acquiring an outputted maximum likelihood array of historical question and answer content of a same topic as question and answer content to be scored; and on the basis of actual scores corresponding to the maximum likelihood array, calculating a predicted score for the question and answer content to be scored. The method is able to ensure objectivity and fairness in scoring.
assignees: PING AN TECH SHENZHEN CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network electric power big data transaction management system based on artificial intelligence and block chain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network electric power big data transaction management system based on artificial intelligence and a block chain, wherein an electric quantity intelligent optimization module counts the lack of electric quantity of a power utilization side and the residual electric quantity of the power generation side and generates bilateral transaction, a transaction monitoring module generates a code number for the transaction, a compression storage module packs and processes the transaction amount, the information of the power utilization side, the information of the power generation side and the transaction electric quantity of the bilateral transaction and transmits the transaction amount and the code number generated by a spontaneous transaction monitoring module to the block chain, and a money amount control module searches for the corresponding bilateral transaction in the block chain according to the code number and transmits the transaction amount of the bilateral transaction to a butt joint arrangement module. The invention combines the block chain technology, realizes the storage and the non-falsification of the electric power transaction data, ensures the fairness of the transaction, intelligently optimizes and considers the generation transaction of the power consumption side and the power distribution side in a differentiated matching way, and achieves the maximum benefit.

title_en: Optimized scheduling method and system for source network load generalized energy storage system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of peak regulation of power systems and discloses a source network load generalized energy storage system optimization scheduling method which comprises the following steps of S1, establishing a source-load double-layer optimization scheduling model, wherein an upper layer model aims at maximizing net benefit of source-side leased energy storage operation, and a lower layer model aims at minimizing net load variance, S2, generating an energy storage configuration result according to the upper layer model and transmitting the energy storage configuration result to the lower layer, and the source network load generalized energy storage system optimization scheduling system comprises a source-load double-layer optimization scheduling model which is used for maximizing net benefit of source-side leased energy storage operation and minimizing net load variance of the system. The peak shaving demand is determined through the optimized net load, peak shaving and clearing are carried out with the aim of minimizing the peak shaving cost of the system, the fairness and the effectiveness of peak shaving transaction are ensured, and each market body can participate in the peak shaving transaction in a fair competition environment, so that the economical efficiency is improved.

title_en: Automatic client resource allocation system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a system and a method for automatically distributing customer resources, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1: the client information acquisition module acquires client reservation information, classifies the client reservation information according to regions through the first data management module, and counts the number of clients corresponding to different regions to form primary information; s2: storing and backing up the primary information to a total database, and distributing the primary information to each local database through a primary information distribution module; s3: the processing capacity of each team in each region is analyzed through the first analysis module, the first-level information in the database of each region is classified according to the region by the second data management module according to the analysis result of the first analysis module, and the number of clients corresponding to different regions is counted to form second-level information; s4: and the secondary information distribution module distributes the secondary information to each team database according to the analysis result of the first analysis module. The technical scheme provided by the application improves the efficiency and fairness of customer resource allocation.
assignees: BEIJING DIANQU EDUCATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Water resource distribution method and system
abstract_en: The application provides a water resource allocation method and system. The method comprises the steps of firstly obtaining predicted water resource distribution amount of each industry in a region, and then obtaining weight index composition and weight index relation of water resource distribution of each industry in each region in the region based on a fair principle according to conditions such as population, land and economic and social development. And finally, acquiring the planned water resource allocation amount of each industry in each region again according to the predicted water resource allocation amount and the weight index of each industry in the region. When the method and the device are used for distributing the water resources in the region, social attributes such as population, land and economic social development conditions can be embodied, time attributes are considered, the difference of water resource distribution in time can be reflected, and new ideas and bases are provided for water resource management. The water resource distribution method and the water resource distribution system avoid the situation that multiple water resources are constantly and much in water resource distribution, the fairness of development opportunities in all regions is reflected, and the situation that the development of local economy and society is restricted due to unfair water resource distribution is reduced.
assignees: SHANGHAI INVESTIGATION DESIGN & RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Urban earthquake disaster risk and loss big data evaluation platform
abstract_en: The urban earthquake disaster risk and loss big data evaluation platform disclosed by the application is used for modeling from three aspects of earthquake disaster factor risk, disaster-bearing body vulnerability and urban earthquake disaster response capability, evaluating the earthquake risk of the earthquake-prone city by adopting a big data analysis method based on multi-index decision, integrating a GIS technology with an earthquake disaster loss matrix evaluation method based on historical big data, establishing an earthquake disaster loss evaluation system, and evaluating and calculating the earthquake disaster loss condition in an area. Before an earthquake occurs, the method analyzes and predicts the risk degree or probability that the area is likely to suffer from the earthquake, helps government to scientifically and effectively carry out urban development planning and disaster prevention and reduction decision, improves regional disaster prevention capacity construction, reduces earthquake disaster condition loss, improves emergency rescue and response capacity after the earthquake occurs, facilitates the distribution and scheduling of disaster relief materials, and has practical significance and effect on regional earthquake risk degree and loss assessment.

title_en: Community education resource scheduling system based on multidimensional demand matching
abstract_en: The invention discloses a community education resource scheduling system based on multidimensional demand matching, which particularly relates to the field of education resource management, and comprises a disturbance construction module, an acquisition module, an extraction module, an evaluation module and a scheduling module; the disturbance construction module is used for constructing a disturbance task sequence of the target course, wherein the disturbance task sequence is composed of a plurality of disturbance tasks, and each disturbance task comprises task content, random excitation parameters and task trigger time of the target course. By constructing disturbance task induced behavior reaction, extracting behavior characteristics and combining with a motivation offset evaluation function, the recognition of pseudo learning behaviors and the dynamic adjustment of scheduling priority are realized, so that the long-term occupation of high-value education resources by non-real demand users is restrained, and the authenticity of the education resource allocation and the fairness of system operation are improved.

title_en: Regional water resource allocation dynamic modeling method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water resource balance, in particular to a regional water resource allocation dynamic modeling method and system. The invention discloses a dynamic modeling method for regional water resource allocation, which comprises the following steps of obtaining regional hydrological historical data, dividing water resource partitions according to the regional hydrological historical data, extracting hydrological conditions of the water resource partitions to obtain regional water resource characteristic data, obtaining regional water demand data, constructing a system dynamics model according to the regional water resource characteristic data and the regional water demand data, simulating inter-industry water interactive relations of the system dynamics model to obtain system dynamic balance data of regional water resources, and establishing a water flow network topological structure according to the system dynamic balance data. According to the invention, by considering the water demand, the supply capacity and the mutual influence of different industries, the water resource demand among the industries can be reasonably balanced, the resource allocation is optimized, the water contradiction is reduced, and the fairness and the efficiency of the water resource allocation are improved.
assignees: PEARL RIVER HYDRAULIC COMPREHENSIVE TECH CENTER PEARL RIVER WATER RESOURCES COMMISSION OF MINISTRY O

title_en: Computer implemented blockchain-based system for agricultural products
abstract_en: This specification discloses a platform built on blockchain that is designed to help increase traceability, efficiency and fairness in agricultural supply chains, such as the coffee, cocoa, tea, sugar, grains and fruit supply chains. The platform includes a Self-Sovereign Identity solution, a new form of digital identity built on distributed ledger technology. Farmers, wholesalers, traders and retailers can interact more efficiently using comprehensive, near real-time access to this data, and consumers can have new insights about the origins of the products they consume. The platform includes a consumer-facing application that pulls information directly from the blockchain and connects the final consumer, e.g. a coffee drinker, to farmers, traders, roasters and brands. The information is presented on an interactive map, allowing each product to tell a story in a simple and scalable way. The app also presents sustainability projects in coffee communities and an opportunity for consumers to directly support them. Consumers now can play an active role in sustainability governance by directly supporting coffee farmers in developing nations.

title_en: Virtual power plant-oriented demand response resource dynamic allocation method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a dynamic demand response resource allocation method and device for a virtual power plant, wherein the method comprises the following steps of collecting load adjustment characteristic parameters of various users in the virtual power plant, establishing an objective function of comprehensive user adjustment cost and corresponding constraint conditions according to the load adjustment characteristic parameters, constructing a mixed integer linear programming problem according to the objective function and the constraint conditions, and solving by adopting a branch and bound algorithm to obtain a dynamic demand response resource allocation scheme. According to the dynamic allocation method of the demand response resources facing the virtual power plants, which is disclosed by the invention, not only can the fairness and economy of an allocation scheme be improved, but also the implementation effect of demand response can be effectively improved.

title_en: Multi-station collaborative pipelined capability verification sample online distribution method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-station collaborative pipelined capacity verification sample online distribution method and system, which specifically comprises the steps of 1, manufacturing a preparation mark for each sample, 2, evaluating the samples, 3, setting laboratory marks and associating laboratories, 4, setting sample combination and associating distribution numbers in the laboratories, 5, distributing the samples for the laboratories and associating the distributed samples with each other, and 6, packaging and express delivering the distributed and associated samples. The invention avoids the situation of capability verification sample false sending or false identification, provides solid data support for sample tracing, and ensures confidentiality and fairness.

title_en: Dynamic collaborative ordering method for incoming flights
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic collaborative ordering method for incoming flights, which specifically comprises the following steps: step 1: respectively establishing an inbound flight collaborative sequencing model aiming at different air traffic densities; step 2: acquiring incoming flight ADS-B data and incoming flight plan data by a dynamic method; and judging real-time air traffic density; and step 3: and (3) inputting the incoming flight ADS-B data and the incoming flight plan data acquired in the step (2) into an incoming flight collaborative ordering model corresponding to the real-time air traffic density, and solving the incoming flight collaborative ordering model to obtain flight ordering. The invention provides a method for realizing the dynamic collaborative ordering of the incoming flights, which is in accordance with the collaborative decision concept, comprehensively considers the benefit requirements of a control unit, an airline company and an airport, can optimize the ordering of the incoming flights, ensures the instantaneity and the dynamics of the flight ordering, obviously improves the runway capacity, and effectively improves the flight delay balance and the flight delay fairness.

title_en: Virtual power plant frequency modulation income distribution method and device considering DLMP
abstract_en: The method and the device for distributing the frequency modulation benefits of the virtual power plant considering the DLMP are used for establishing an economic dispatch model of the power distribution network, and an objective function of the economic dispatch model of the power distribution network is constructed into a Lagrange function form; calculating the frequency modulation cost price of the aggregation main body by considering the marginal electricity price of the nodes of the power distribution network, and calculating the income of the virtual power plant in the frequency modulation auxiliary service market; performing type division on game participants according to a game price strategy distribution interval, calculating benefit expectations of a k-th round game virtual power plant and an aggregation main body, and judging balance point conditions of a virtual power plant internal benefit distribution strategy based on Bayesian game; under the condition that the first round of games are not matched, estimating the quotation mean value and the transaction achievement probability of the opposite game party by adopting the prior probability; and adjusting the quotations of the two game parties through a linear relaxation algorithm until the Bayesian-Nash equilibrium is achieved, so as to achieve the transaction of the two game parties. The invention improves the fairness of the benefit distribution process; and the cooperation stability of the virtual power plant and each aggregation main body is ensured.

title_en: Dynamic optimization comprehensive evaluation method, device, equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a dynamic optimized comprehensive evaluation method, a device, equipment and a readable storage medium, which relate to the technical field of comprehensive evaluation and comprise the steps of obtaining the grading value of each evaluator on each object and the initial weight of each grading value; constructing a first fairness index of all evaluators to any one object and a second fairness index of any one evaluators to different evaluation objects; calculating the average value of all the grading values, and constructing the stability index of any one evaluation object by using the average value and the initial weight; the method comprises the steps of establishing a multi-objective function for representing comprehensive scoring fairness, dynamically correcting initial weights of all scoring values by using a weight optimization algorithm, taking the weight corresponding to the minimum value of the multi-objective function as an optimal weight, and calculating to obtain the comprehensive score of each object by using the optimal weight and the corresponding scoring value.
assignees: INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECH INFORMATION CHINA ACADEMY OF RAILWAY SCIENCES CORPORATION LIMITED;CHINA ACADEMY RAILWAY SCIENCES CORP LTD

title_en: Water right transaction method based on cooperative transaction alliance and storable medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water right trading method and a storable medium based on a cooperative trading alliance, and relates to the technical field of water resource allocation. Aiming at the problem that the opposites of the conventional water right trading buyers and sellers and the distribution of the benefits lack scientific basis, the invention establishes a cooperative trading alliance by determining trading participants and registering trading information, adopts a shape value method to calculate objective contribution degree, adopts a Delphi method to obtain subjective contribution degree, combines subjective and objective weights to form a benefit distribution proportion, preferentially compensates the water saving cost of sellers, distributes residual benefits and verifies the cooperative necessity through the net benefits of sub alliances. The invention converts the buyer and the seller into the benefit community, shortens the negotiation period, improves the fairness and the cooperation stability of the income distribution, effectively optimizes the water resource allocation, and is suitable for the scenes of agricultural internal circulation, cross-industry water intake right transaction and the like.

title_en: Receiving apparatus for escaping energency of a sufferers
title_ko: 이재민 비상대피 수용장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A victim emergency shelter accommodation unit is provided to grasp easily a number of people accommodated in a process of distributing bedclothes and a slogan article etc. to victims. CONSTITUTION: A victim emergency shelter accommodation unit (100) comprises a main body part (110), a recess (110a), and a dotted line part (120). The main body part has a bar shape, and the recess is formed in both sides of a lower part of the main body part. The dotted line part is perpendicularly formed in a center of the main body part. The dotted line part comprises a first cut-out line (120a) for keeping by folding the main body part, and a second cut-out line (120b) for cutting a part of the main body part.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 자연재해가 발생하여 이재민들이 임시거처인 대피소로 피난할 경우, 이재민들에게 침구류 및 구호물품 등을 분배하는 과정에서 수용할 수 있는 인원을 용이하게 파악하도록, 넓은 대피소 시설에서 다수의 이재민 인원 정리를 단기간에 신속하게 처리하는 이재민 비상대피 수용장치를 제공하는 것을 목적으로 한다.  
상기 목적을 달성하기 위해, 본 발명에 따른 이재민 비상대피 수용장치는, 바 형상을 가진 본체부와 상기 본체부의 하부의 양측에 형성된 오목부 및 상기 본체부의 중심부위에 수직으로 형성된 절취선부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Three-public scheduling model construction method based on kini coefficient
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-member scheduling model construction method based on a kini coefficient, which comprises the following steps: step 1, collecting various optimized data such as unit characteristic parameters and system loads, and determining a scheduling plan space. Step 2: according to the actual demand of a power grid, constructing a scheduling plan model with the aim of minimizing the total cost including the unit operation cost and the start-stop cost; and step 3: and characterizing the electric quantity balance condition of each power plant by using a Gini coefficient G, and adding the electric quantity balance condition serving as a constraint condition into the constructed scheduling plan model. And 4, step 4: and obtaining a scheduling plan scheme through an optimization technology and security check. The scheduling plan model established in the method disclosed by the invention can consider the aspects of safety, economy, fairness and the like of the system, and can effectively improve the optimal configuration of power resources.

title_en: Mutual-help project expense settlement system, method and device
abstract_en: The application provides a system, a method and a device for settling the expense of mutual-aid projects, wherein the system comprises the following components: the rights and interests grading subsystem is configured to determine the correspondence between rights and interests grading and normal distribution intervals; the fee junction subsystem includes: a risk equity calculation module configured to calculate a risk equity value from the participation period of the item member and the risk occurrence of the item member; the normal distribution conversion module is configured to perform normal distribution conversion on the risk equity value; the rights and interests grading retrieval module is configured to retrieve rights and interests grading corresponding to normal distribution intervals in which the normal distribution rights and interests values are located in the corresponding relation between the rights and interests grading and the normal distribution intervals; and the fee settlement module is configured to carry out fee settlement on the project members according to the searched fee payment amount classified by the rights and interests. The system sets more reasonable and fair payment amounts aiming at project members with different risk rights and interests, guarantees the interests of the project members, and improves the mutual project participation experience of the project members.

title_en: Disease prevention and control disease control facility configuration method with capacity limitation
abstract_en: The application discloses a disease prevention and control facility configuration method with capacity limitation, and belongs to the field of urban planning. A disease prevention control facility configuration method, comprising: the interval time of users reaching the disease control facilities successively is taken as poisson distribution, and the facilities providing user services for the disease control facilities are taken as service desks and queuing rules are established in a first-come first-get way; the attraction element of the disease control facility, the shortest travel time of the user to the disease control facility, the waiting time of the user at the disease control facility and the probability of the user refusing by the disease control facility are taken as influencing factors; compared with the prior art, the application aims at providing fair and reachable public health service, and provides a planning method of a disease prevention and control facility with capacity limitation under the constraint of limited budget. The method considers the capacity limitation of the disease control facilities and adopts a primary and secondary target method to realize fairness, thereby providing scientific basis for site selection and scale decision of the disease control facilities.

title_en: A kind of task weight pricing method in mass-rent express system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of weight pricing method of the task in mass-rent express system, the selection to influence and change courier is shifted by the numerical value of the price between task, so as to optimize system overall efficiency, mainly included the following steps that：(1) data prepare and model construction；(2) price transfer is selected with goal task；(3) maximum transfer calculation of price；(4) conditional test is set up in price transfer.The present invention has advantages below compared with prior art：1) the going after profit or gain property feature of courier in mass-rent express system is directed to, by resetting valency and reduce the biasing of task choosing to mass-rent express delivery task, and then optimizes the overall efficiency of system, meanwhile, take into account and consider fairness；2) system is without extraneous expense fund, but is realized by price transfer adjustment between task；3) algorithm is simply clear and definite, it is adaptable to large-scale practical problem scene.

title_en: The site selecting method of medical emergency facility after a kind of shake
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of site selecting methods of medical emergency facility after shake, comprising the following steps: (1) determines the alternative point of medical emergency facility after shake；(2) according to the concrete condition in region, the influence factor of medical emergency facility Optimizing Site Selection after shake is analyzed；(3) each influence factor weight is calculated using TOPSIS；(4) using fairness, high efficiency, coverage area are maximum and suitably consider that cost as target, establishes base's grade emergency medical facility site selection model；(5) on the basis of step (4) base grade emergency medical facility site selection model, advanced emergency medical command post site selection model after shake is established；(6) it is solved using the model of Nested Genetic Algorithm pair, determines primary care emergency service point set and advanced emergency medical command post.This site selecting method of the present invention can quickly, the determination medical emergency facility point of science, be of great importance to casualties after reducing shake.

title_en: System, method, storage medium and computing device for polling and distributing purchase orders
abstract_en: The invention provides a polling system and a polling method for purchase orders, which can correspondingly send orders to the hands of service personnel in the area where the orders are located through the system when the system receives purchase orders from different areas, ensure that the same number of purchase orders are distributed to the hands of all the service personnel through a polling distribution mode, realize the fairness of order distribution, solve the problem that the processing efficiency is reduced due to too much accumulated orders on the hands of the service personnel, and also solve the problem that the working enthusiasm is influenced due to too few orders distributed by the service personnel.
assignees: GUANGZHOU XINJING INFORMATION TECH SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Method for evaluating bus running condition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating bus running conditions, which comprises the following steps: s1, determining a bus running condition evaluation object; s2, acquiring the cumulative frequency distribution of the bus travel speed of the evaluation object; s3, determining an ideal speed absolute level value of the evaluation object; s4, calculating a bus running condition evaluation index of an evaluation object, namely a bus smooth running index; and S5, outputting the operation condition grade of the evaluation object. The invention provides an evaluation index of a bus smoothness index aiming at the problem that the existing bus running condition evaluation method is lack of objective fairness and universality, reflects the degradation degree of the actual running condition of the bus relative to the ideal running condition, and overcomes the influence of time (natural day) heterogeneity and space (city road network, line and road section) heterogeneity on the value stability of the evaluation index and the objective fairness of the bus running condition evaluation result.

title_en: Online collaborative task distribution system for digital media
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital media online collaborative task distribution system, which belongs to the technical field of digital media and comprises an input storage module, a task demand analysis module, a task personnel screening module and a task distribution module, wherein the input storage module is responsible for collecting storage members and task information, the task demand analysis module calculates personnel scheduling values according to task difficulty, urgency and error rate to determine the number of personnel required by each subtask, the task personnel screening module obtains personnel selection scoring values according to personnel task average consumption, task quality scoring and task light load values to screen out acknowledgement personnel, the task distribution module divides the subtasks into sub-skill tasks, distributes the sub-skill tasks according to the acknowledgement personnel technical task adaptation and the sub-skill task priority and dynamically adjusts the sub-skill tasks after distribution, the problems of low efficiency, lack of fairness and the like of traditional task distribution are solved, manpower resources can be scientifically allocated, the task completion quality and efficiency are improved, and fair and reasonable task distribution is realized.

title_en: Multi-agent asynchronous coordination method and system under centralized architecture
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-agent asynchronous coordination method and system under a centralized architecture, which are suitable for task scheduling and resource coordination of heterogeneous agents in an intelligent Internet of things environment. According to the method, a centralized control mechanism of a main dispatching node is adopted, a dispatching priority function is calculated according to real-time state information of a plurality of heterogeneous intelligent agents by combining a multi-intelligent-agent game model, and asynchronous allocation and feedback control of tasks are realized. Meanwhile, an asynchronous synchronous window mechanism is introduced, the scheduling continuity and the scheduling efficiency can be kept under the condition of incomplete information, and the fairness and the robustness of task allocation are realized through intelligent feedback delay modeling and revenue function design. The invention improves the throughput and response speed of the system, gives consideration to isomerism and expandability, and is suitable for multi-agent cooperation scenes such as disaster emergency, industrial manufacturing, intelligent home, intelligent traffic and the like.
assignees: SCHOOL OF SOFTWARE TECHNOLOGY NINGBO INNOVATION AND MANAGEMENT CENTER OF ZHEJIANG UNIV;UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: Public transport travel service big data processing method and system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of public transportation travel service, and discloses a public transportation travel service big data processing method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of accessing heterogeneous public transportation data, calibrating coordinate deviation, fusing real-time weather events and generating space-time grid entities; the method comprises the steps of constructing a priority decision tree and rule matching logic according to four-dimensional equity rules, generating a scheduling vector with an equity label, synchronously generating a network resource arbitration log, fusing the scheduling vector and the network resource arbitration log, defining and executing a three-level dynamic rule chain, generating a confidence arbitration result, carrying out path feasibility check, further generating a space-time constraint scheduling path, formulating a sharing distribution strategy according to the four-dimensional equity rules, classifying an associated data set, executing three-level quality check on the associated data set after the classification, triggering an anomaly correction mechanism, generating a data quality evaluation report, and reversely optimizing through space-time analysis to form a closed-loop treatment flow.

title_en: System for allocating advertising inventory in a unified marketplace
abstract_en: An advertisement impression distribution system includes a data processing system operable to generate an allocation plan for serving advertisement impressions. The allocation plan allocates a first portion of advertisement impressions to satisfy guaranteed demand and a second portion of advertisement impressions to satisfy non-guaranteed demand. The data processing system includes an optimizer, the optimizer to establish a relationship between the first portion of advertisement impressions and the second portion of advertisement impressions, the relationship defining a range of possible proportions of allocation of the first portion of advertisement impressions and the second portion of advertisement impressions. The optimizer generates an indicia in accordance with maximizing guaranteed demand fairness or representativeness, maximizing non-guaranteed revenue, and minimizing under-delivery penalties, where the indicia indentifies a determined proportion of the first portion of advertisement impressions to serve and a determined proportion of the second portion of advertisement impressions to serve. The data processing system outputs the allocation plan including the indicia to control serving of the advertisement impressions in the determined proportions.

title_en: A kind of flood season water power enrichment power network saves balancing power plant electric quantity of power supply distribution method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to Electric Power Network Planning and management and running field, disclose a kind of flood season water power enrichment power network and save balancing power plant electric quantity of power supply distribution method, dispatching of power netwoks fairness and economy objectives can be taken into account, for the problem that flood season rich water electricity grid generation ability is increased sharply, realize flood season each power supply, the reasonable distribution of power station electricity volume, it is ensured that desalinate benefits of different parties contradiction on the basis of power grid electric balance.Its solution is：Using the fairness and economy of dispatching of power netwoks as Optimized Operation target, the generation schedule for reporting is adjusted to determine each power plants generating electricity ability and same day actual load demand by various regions, it is determined that plan day the whole network electric quantity balancing situation, processed according to different situations classification, and the electricity volume of each power supply and station is distributed based on this, weight coefficient is introduced in assigning process and embodies preference of the policymaker between each sub-goal, finally provide the multiobjective decision-making collection based on different weight coefficients.The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows prediction power network future development, take into account the factors such as fairness, economy, operability, it is ensured that flood season dispatching of power netwoks it is reasonable effectively, with the important meaning of setting an example that takes the lead in.

title_en: Unit combination method based on variable frequency air conditioner virtual unit modeling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a unit combination method based on variable frequency air conditioner virtual unit modeling, which comprises the following steps: (1) establishing a thermodynamic model and an electrical model of a single air conditioner; (2) carrying out centralized scheduling and control on the air conditioner group through a load aggregator, and establishing an aggregation model of the air conditioner group; (3) modeling a virtual unit according to the characteristics of the traditional unit, and establishing a cost function of the virtual unit under the condition that the user response is uncertain; (4) in the day-ahead market, a combined unit combination model of a traditional unit and a virtual unit is established according to the next day load and temperature prediction, and a next day scheduling plan is arranged; (5) in the actual scheduling process, the economic benefit of the load aggregator and the fairness and comfort of the users participating in the virtual machine set modeling are comprehensively considered, and the optimal distribution of the load adjustment amount among the users is realized. The invention realizes the centralized scheduling control of the air conditioner cluster and reduces the calculated amount and the control difficulty of related scheduling departments.

title_en: Method, device, computer equipment and medium for configuring financial product incentive data
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of financial data processing of blockchains, and discloses a method, a device, computer equipment and a storage medium for configuring financial product incentive data, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring intelligent contracts of financial products configured based on blockchain, wherein the intelligent contracts comprise distribution rules and mining rules of incentives of the financial products; acquiring the order quantity of financial products of a user, and converting the order quantity into a calculation force value according to a preset calculation force rule; performing excitation mining according to the calculated force value based on the mining rule to obtain a first number of excitation; obtaining the release quantity corresponding to the incentive according to the distribution rule; acquiring the distributable value data of the financial product, and determining the target value of the incentive according to the distributable value data and the release quantity; and generating distribution value data of the user according to the target value and the first quantity. The method and the device can improve fairness and accuracy of financial product incentive data distribution.

title_en: NCFI carbon emission responsibility allocation method and device considering fairness
abstract_en: The invention discloses a NCFI carbon emission responsibility allocation method, a NCFI carbon emission responsibility allocation device, an electronic device and a readable storage medium, which consider fairness. The allocation device comprises a power flow distribution acquisition module, an original allocation result acquisition module, an allocation fairness interval acquisition module, an original satisfaction acquisition module and a satisfaction optimization adjustment module. The satisfaction optimization adjustment module comprises an original satisfaction calculation module, a first satisfaction optimization adjustment module and a second satisfaction optimization adjustment module. According to the invention, on one hand, the historical emission responsibility of the load nodes and the individual development opportunities can be better related to the carbon emission responsibility of the nodes, on the premise of not changing the total responsibility allocation amount, fairness is considered, the phenomenon of fairness deficiency of an allocation scheme is avoided, on the other hand, the responsibility allocation amount of most load nodes is reduced on the basis of reasonable and feasible allocation results, effective data support is provided for the establishment of an enterprise carbon reduction strategy, and the method has important significance for economic coordinated development.

title_en: Comprehensive energy system source-charge main body cooperative carbon reduction method based on block chain technology
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of low-carbon scheduling of integrated energy systems, and provides a comprehensive energy system source-load main body collaborative carbon reduction method based on a block chain technology. The system not only can enable users to actively participate in carbon transaction on the individual level under the guidance and the excitation of a market mechanism and adjust the electricity utilization strategy, but also can drive the side to coordinate and complement with multiple functions so as to increase the carbon emission reduction degree. Thus, a complete emission reduction system from an energy production source to terminal consumption is constructed, and the cooperative emission reduction effect of both supply and demand sides is realized. In addition, through DPoS consensus mechanism based on credit threshold, nodes can be stimulated to actively participate in consensus election, fairness of the consensus election is guaranteed, and abnormal nodes are effectively processed.

title_en: the equality allocation system of cars
title_ko: 균등배차관리 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention is for equally allocating all vehicles without allocating only a specific vehicle and provides an equal vehicle allocation management system including a waiting room PC (100) installed in a driver waiting room (100); a shipment server (200) receiving information including waiting information and attendance information of drivers from the waiting room PC (100) and displaying allocation information on an electronic display (230) by allocating vehicles to be driven through a shipment management program (210) so that the drivers can check the information while transmitting the allocation information to a wireless beeper or mobile terminal (400) of a corresponding driver; and a main gate RF receiver (300) installed at a main gate of a factory. When a driver directly inputs driver′s attendance to the waiting room PC (100) or a driver having an RF card approaches a waiting room RF receiver (110) connected to the waiting room PC (100), the attendance information of the driver is inputted to the waiting room PC (100) and when a vehicle driven by the driver having the RF card enters the main gate of the factory, entry information including vehicle entering information and vehicle leaving information is transmitted to the shipment server (200) and the waiting room PC (100) through the main gate RF receiver (300).
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 다수의 차량을 배차함에 있어서 특정 차량에 배차가 집중되지 않고 모든 차량에 공평히 분배되어 배차하기 하기 위한 것으로, 
운전자 대기실에 설치되는 대기실PC(100); 상기 대기실PC(100)로부터 운전자의 출근정보 및 대기정보를 포함한 정보를 수신하고 출하관리프로그램(210)을 통해 출차될 차량을 배차하여 배차정보를 운전자들이 볼 수 있도록 전광판(230)에 현시함과 동시에 상기 배차정보를 해당 운전자의 무선호출기나 이동단말기(400)에 전송하는 출하서버(200); 및, 공장정문에 설치되는 정문RF수신기(300);를 포함하여 구성되되, 출근한 운전자가 상기 대기실PC(100)에 출근여부를 직접입력하거나 상기 대기실PC(100)에 연결된 대기실RF수신기(110)에 RF카드를 소지한 운전자가 접근하면 상기 대기실PC(100)에 운전자의 출근정보가 입력되고, 상기 RF카드를 소지한 운전자가 탑승한 차량이 상기 공장정문을 출입할 때 상기 정문RF수신기(300)를 통해 차량의 입차시간 및 출차시간을 포함한 출입정보가 상기 대기실PC(100) 및 상기 출하서버(200)에 전송되는 것을 특징으로 하는 균등배차관리 시스템을 제공한다.

title_en: System for distributing and conveying emergency supplies
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system for distributing and conveying emergency supplies, and the system comprises a distributing and conveying vehicle and a navigator disposed on the distributing and conveying vehicle. The navigator comprises a signal module, a processing module, and a generation module. The system employs an optimized path algorithm, gives consideration to all cost factors in a distributing and conveying process, is good in optimizing effect, is high in solving efficiency, is stable in performance, improves the overall searching capability, can save the operation cost of distributing and conveying to maximum degree, and can achieve a good energy-saving effect.

title_en: Enterprise risk level evaluation method based on hierarchical analysis and fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an enterprise risk level evaluation method based on a hierarchical analysis and fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method, which optimizes the equal weight condition in the initial each-level index scoring system by establishing the initial each-level index scoring system, wherein the subjective factors in the system have too much specific gravity, so each-level index weight is objectively given through the hierarchical analysis, taking enterprise risk evaluation as an example, the initial final enterprise risk evaluation is that the possibility that each enterprise belongs to each risk level is given according to the final score of each enterprise by artificially judging the level and having a loss of fairness, in order to obtain an objective evaluation result, a fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model is established, a membership function is established, the weight obtained through the hierarchical analysis is combined, and the probability highest value is taken as the evaluation result, thereby improving the accuracy of the enterprise risk level evaluation.
assignees: ZHEJIANG FEIXIAN SHULIAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Online order matching method for taxi booking based on double-target LP
abstract_en: The invention provides a network car booking online order matching method based on double-target LP. Then, a coefficient matrix is created and two optimal numerical solutions for LP are found by means of a simplex algorithm. And then, when the order arrives online, rounding the numerical solution obtained by the LP to obtain a random binary vector. And finally, selecting a binary vector representing the income or fairness according to the set probability, and matching orders according to random arrangement. The invention considers the fairness problem in the order distribution scene, simultaneously considers the income of the network car booking platform and the fairness among drivers in the order matching process, and can flexibly adjust the weights of the income and the fairness among the drivers so that the platform can better weigh the driver resources and the monetary income, and the long-term development of the platform can be facilitated.

title_en: Evaluation optimization method and device for credit card activity in guest group performance and related equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a credit card activity in-guest group performance evaluation optimization method, a credit card activity in-guest group performance evaluation optimization device and related equipment, wherein the credit card activity in-guest group performance evaluation optimization method comprises the following steps: acquiring activity-related data of each credit card equity activity placed at each guest group, wherein the activity-related data comprises: at least one of activity feedback data, credit card user equity usage data, credit card equity activity achievement data on the guest group; and determining the guest group performance of each credit card equity activity in the released guest group according to the activity related data. The application effectively evaluates the performance effect of credit card equity activities on the guest group, overcomes the problems of lack of credit card activity evaluation and the like in the prior art, and the obtained guest group performance can be used for targeted optimization of credit card activities and the release of the activities, so as to improve the participation degree and the interest degree of the users on the activities, further improve the satisfaction degree of the users, reduce the customer loss, improve the credit card performance and expand the markets in the credit card and financial fields.

title_en: Laboratory equipment management method and system for chemical detection
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of equipment management, and provides a laboratory equipment management method and system for chemical detection, comprising the following steps of receiving the use requirement of experimental equipment input by a user, wherein the use requirement of the experimental equipment comprises an experimental project, user information, requirement equipment and a requirement time period; the method comprises the steps of judging whether the required equipment needs queuing for use, calling priority, credit and integrity of corresponding user information when the required equipment needs queuing for use, calculating to obtain equipment use base numbers of the user information, determining expiration time of a required time period, determining the allocated user information of the equipment when the expiration time is over, calling historical equipment use data of the allocated user information, analyzing the historical equipment use data, and sending equipment training information to a user account. The invention determines the base number of the equipment use by calling the priority, the credibility and the integrity of the user information based on the multidimensional equipment allocation strategy, thereby realizing the fairness and the rationality of the equipment allocation.
assignees: JIANGXI YUAN HAO DETECTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Water resource balance optimization configuration method for irrigation area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water resource balance optimization configuration method in a irrigated area, which can realize the 'real' total constraint under the combined action of groundwater and agricultural water-available distribution through the total constraint of water supply, groundwater burial depth control and reasonable consideration of groundwater from time to time; the balance of limited water quantity of the water using units can be realized through the space balance of the supply and demand allocation of different water using units, so that the fairness of regional social and economic development is reflected; the balance of the social and economic water and the ecological environment water under the constraint of the total amount of regional water can be realized by controlling the buried depth of the underground water; by optimizing time from time period to time period, the balanced distribution of different time periods under the space balanced constraint comprises the balanced distribution of irrigation water in the annual and annual period, the space balanced distribution of each water unit in the area is realized on the premise of ensuring the ecological safety of underground water, and the healthy coordinated development of ecological health regulation and control of an irrigation area, production water guarantee and sustainable cyclic development is promoted.

title_en: IT equipment time-sharing leasing service management system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of time-sharing leasing, in particular to an IT equipment time-sharing leasing business management system, the system comprises a user behavior analysis module, a market demand prediction module, a dynamic pricing module, a resource allocation optimization module, an energy efficiency management module, a danger early warning and response module, a fault diagnosis and tracing module and a flow recombination and optimization module. According to the invention, customer demands are understood through analysis, market trend is predicted through analysis, balance between resource supply and demands is guaranteed, matched sales promotion activities are formulated according to price sensitivity and market demands, flexible adjustment of realized price is realized, market change is adapted, competitive power of price strategies is enhanced, distribution of equipment in available time is adjusted, high efficiency and fairness of resource distribution are ensured, equipment energy consumption is optimized, operation cost is reduced, maximization of resource utilization is realized, diversified demands of users are met, management cost is reduced, and user satisfaction is improved.

title_en: Multi-unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative computing unloading and resource allocation method and system for emergency search and rescue of sudden disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative computing unloading and resource allocation method and system for emergency search and rescue of sudden disasters, which comprise the steps of building a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle assisted three-dimensional computing unloading network architecture for the emergency disaster search and rescue scene, taking unloading fairness of search and rescue equipment, load balancing of unmanned aerial vehicles and reduction of unmanned aerial vehicle energy consumption into consideration, building a system utility function, building a deep reinforcement learning model aiming at the maximum utility function of the search and rescue equipment for task unloading, training the deep reinforcement learning model based on an improved multi-agent dual-delay depth deterministic strategy gradient algorithm, introducing OU noise and a priority cloning learning mechanism, and learning and optimizing unmanned aerial vehicle track planning and task unloading decisions of the search and rescue equipment. According to the invention, the unmanned aerial vehicle can be used as a cooperative computing and unloading requirement of the MEC server in a disaster scene, so that the purposes of ensuring the fairness of search and rescue equipment service and reducing the energy consumption of the unmanned aerial vehicle can be achieved by reasonably and efficiently computing and unloading decisions and resource allocation.

title_en: Method and device for distributing carbon emission, electronic device, and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for distributing carbon emission, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The distribution method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining a first index set, a second index set and a third index set of a main body to be distributed in a preset time period, calculating the first index set, the second index set and the third index set respectively based on a pre-constructed carbon emission distribution model to obtain the carbon emission distributed to a first main body under a first level, the carbon emission distributed to a second main body under a second level and the carbon emission distributed to a third main body under a third level, and determining the carbon emission distributed to the main body to be distributed based on the carbon emission distributed to various main bodies under different levels. The invention solves the technical problem of lack of fairness and rationality caused by only carrying out region division on the main body with coarse granularity when distributing carbon emission for different main bodies in the related technology.
assignees: STATE GRID BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;BEIJING ELECTRIC POWER ECONOMY AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE LIMITED COMPANY;CHINESE PEOPLE UNIV

title_en: User side load optimal scheduling method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a load optimization scheduling method, a device, equipment and a storage medium considering carbon responsibility at a user side, wherein the method comprises the following steps: based on a carbon emission flow theory of the electric power system, constructing a tide model considering the carbon emission flow of the electric power system; based on carbon quota allocation and a generator cost model, embedding an electric energy pricing model of carbon transaction, and constructing a node electricity-carbon comprehensive price pricing model; based on a tide model of the carbon emission flow of the electric power system and a node electricity-carbon comprehensive price pricing model, constructing a load demand response optimization scheduling model, and calculating to obtain a load optimization scheduling result taking account of carbon responsibility of a user side; the device comprises a tide module, a pricing module and a scheduling module. According to the load optimization scheduling method considering the carbon responsibility at the user side, the carbon responsibility at the user side is distributed according to the actual equivalent carbon emission of different users according to the carbon emission flow theory, the unreasonable phenomenon of distributing the carbon responsibility only at the power generation side is avoided, and the principle of fairness and fairness in the power market is embodied.

title_en: Urban living circle planning method, device, equipment, medium and product
abstract_en: The invention discloses a city life circle planning method, a device, equipment, a medium and a product, belonging to the life circle planning technical field, wherein the method comprises the steps of preprocessing a city data set, wherein the preprocessing comprises weighting city infrastructure and public service facility data of different types by adopting an entropy weight method; the method comprises the steps of carrying out nuclear density search on a preprocessed city data set, determining search radius based on the center theory of the Krigler in the nuclear density search process, respectively determining cores of life circles of different levels based on different nuclear density graphs, and respectively determining the range of the life circle of each level based on the core of the life circle of each level and road data of a first city. The method can accurately divide the urban living circles, and the divided urban living circles can scientifically and reasonably deconstruct the urban space structure, so that the efficiency and fairness of urban resource allocation are improved, and the rationality of urban planning and management is enhanced.

title_en: System for constructing high-precision user behavior portraits by improving federal learning algorithm
abstract_en: The technical scheme of the invention discloses a system for constructing a high-precision user behavior portrait by an improved federal learning algorithm, which is characterized by comprising a multi-source privacy protection data acquisition module, a federal learning modeling module based on dynamic weighting and contribution demonstration, a multi-dimensional user behavior portrait module, a personalized vehicle-network interaction strategy generation module, a dynamic execution and fairness excitation module and a feedback and model self-optimization module. According to the invention, the historical data of the charge and discharge behavior habit of the user can be subjected to deep analysis and portrait construction, a high-precision and high-coverage user behavior portrait model is generated by improving the federal machine learning algorithm, the real-time income of the user is improved, the viscosity of the user is enhanced, and the stability of the power grid and the renewable energy consumption rate are further improved.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;SHANGHAI ELECTRICAL APPARATUS RESEARCH INST GROUP CO LTD;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RESEARCH INST CO LTD

title_en: Multi-supply-point emergency material address selection optimization method considering timeliness and fairness
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-supply-point emergency material site selection optimization method considering timeliness and fairness, which comprises the steps of sequentially constructing material supply points, temporary distribution centers, disaster areas and damaged roads, constructing a multi-target emergency material distribution model, constructing an initialization individual strategy, constructing a mutation operator and a local search operator based on the initialization individual strategy, constructing a selection strategy and an acceptance criterion, combining the mutation operator and the local search operator, outputting an optimal operator, evaluating the optimal operator and outputting an optimal scheme for emergency distribution. The invention provides a double-target multi-supply-point emergency material site selection distribution model, wherein in the model, the influence of disasters on a road network is considered, so that the concept of waiting time is provided, meanwhile, in order to make the distribution result more fair, the concept of lowest distribution material is introduced, a related calculation method is introduced, and the problem domain design of the emergency disaster relief material problem is completed.

title_en: Transaction-based big data rights and interests sharing method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transaction-based big data right and interest sharing method and system, which fully excavate the value of data through valuable transaction, realize the separation of the right of use, the right of income and the ownership of the data, further realize the sharing of the data right and interest in the whole network range, and provide a non-falsification and anti-repudiation mechanism aiming at the core data in the system. The method comprises the following steps: s1, calculating the use cost of the data facing the data consumption requirement; s2 distributing data equity benefits; s3 establishes a non-tamper and tamper resistant mechanism for all consumption and revenue records within the platform. The invention can eliminate the data island and avoid the data killing behavior on the premise of protecting the privacy of big data.
assignees: ZHEJIANG SIX EAR INFORMATION TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Loess region highway slope geological disaster susceptibility testing method based on time sequence
abstract_en: The application provides a loess region highway slope geological disaster susceptibility testing method based on a time sequence, which comprises the following steps: initializing a test object and an evaluation factor, and determining a geological disaster vulnerability evaluation factor; calculating the weight of each evaluation factor by using an analytic hierarchy process, and performing iterative optimization until the consistency check index CR reaches the global minimum; dividing the interval level of the evaluation factors, calculating the corresponding information quantity of each interval, and comprehensively obtaining the information quantity of the single side slope; calculating the AUC value of the evaluation result, and adjusting the interval grade division of the optimization evaluation factor until the evaluation result is relatively optimal; and defining a vulnerability evaluation section according to the evaluation result, and determining the slope evaluation grade. The method can improve the logic of the judgment matrix construction in the analytic hierarchy process, reduce the rationality of the division of the evaluation factor interval in the information quantity calculation, furthest reduce the influence of human subjective factors on the evaluation process, and improve the objective fairness and accuracy of the evaluation result.
assignees: SHANXI SMART TRAFFIC RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Block chain-based carbon transaction construction method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of carbon transaction, and discloses a carbon transaction construction method and system based on blockchain, which comprises the steps of registering carbon transaction information, creating a digital carbon transaction unit based on the information, collecting carbon emission data of each carbon transaction unit, issuing corresponding carbon transaction tokens, distributing the carbon transaction units to an edge server, the block chain technology is utilized for data management, the qualification of the carbon transaction unit is evaluated through multidimensional analysis, the transaction record is tracked, the parameters of the carbon transaction token are adjusted according to the qualification and the record, the carbon transaction is realized, the transparency and the efficiency of the carbon transaction are improved, the authenticity and the traceability of information are ensured, the dynamic supervision and the adjustment of the token value are realized, and the fairness and the flexibility of the market are promoted. Solves the problem that some enterprises can not timely obtain transactions in the prior art.
assignees: GUANGDONG ZONGHENG LINGTAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Enterprise carbon emission management system based on block chain technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses an enterprise carbon emission management system based on a blockchain technology, which comprises a carbon emission data storage module, a carbon emission quota allocation module and a carbon emission trans-regional transaction module. The invention has the advantages that the data processing efficiency and the intelligent analysis capability of the system under different time dimensions are enhanced through time weighting, dynamic compression and environment data embedding at the carbon data storage and management level. The intelligent, flexibility and fairness of enterprise carbon quota allocation are ensured by utilizing a dynamic quota allocation algorithm through self-adaptive learning, game theory optimization and a market feedback mechanism, and the method is suitable for continuously changing carbon markets and enterprise behaviors. The cross-regional carbon transaction mechanism is established, the isolated current situation of carbon transaction in different regions is broken through the automatic execution of inter-chain interoperation protocols and intelligent contracts, and globalization of carbon transaction market integration is realized. This mechanism promotes transaction transparency and market efficiency, pushing the development and standardization of the carbon trade market.
assignees: BEIJING TELECOM PLANNING & DESIGNING INST CO LTD;CHINA INF TECHNOLOGY DESIGNING CONSULTING INST CO LTD

title_en: Workforce management system with fairness scheduling
abstract_en: A workforce management system implements enhanced any-day-of-the-week or holiday fairness processing. The system provides one or more display interfaces indexed by day of week or given holiday dates, and through which a user defines a fairness policy with respect to each such day or dates. In use, the system compares a fairness policy with historical credit data to generate a rank order of agent eligibility to fulfill a contact center schedule for a given day or holiday date. This rank order of agent availability is then provided to a scheduler to enable generation of one or more contact center schedules for the given day or holiday date. The day of week and holiday fairness may be carried out independently or combined. The system also enables fairness days or dates to be processed according to a user-defined priority.

title_en: A kind of daily postitallation evaluation method of power network
