abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of daily postitallation evaluation method of power network, belongs to electric power system dispatching operation control technology field.This method includes：Daily dispatching of power netwoks postitallation evaluation index set is built, the index set includes four security, economy, fairness and the feature of environmental protection index aspects of operation；Each index is calculated according to corresponding data of the evaluation index collection power network of structure per day operation；The index result of calculating is integrated, result of the power network per day operation is evaluated.The evaluation of operation of power networks is defined in daily scope by the present invention, and the evaluation to operation of power networks effect is more targeted, can be formulated management and running strategy for power grid operation personnel and be provided reference, improve security, economy, fairness and the feature of environmental protection of operation of power networks.

title_en: Electric automobile charging guiding method considering user satisfaction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric vehicle charging, in particular to an electric vehicle charging guiding method considering user satisfaction, which comprises the following steps of collecting relevant information of all charging stations in a dispatching area; the method comprises the steps of collecting charging requirements and position information of an electric vehicle sending a charging application in a dispatching period, obtaining a charging guiding sequence of the electric vehicle based on a nearby guiding strategy, guaranteeing fairness of a charging process, constructing a user satisfaction evaluation model by taking total charging time and total charging cost of the electric vehicle as clustering points, guiding the electric vehicle according to the charging guiding sequence in sequence, and solving the user satisfaction evaluation model with the highest user satisfaction as a target when guiding any electric vehicle, so as to obtain an optimal guiding result of the current electric vehicle. The invention can save the time cost and the cost of charging for the electric automobile user, improve the satisfaction degree of the user and effectively consider the utilization rate of the charging station.

title_en: Weighted TOPSIS method-based refuse pollution problem responsibility distribution method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a weighted TOPSIS method-based method for dividing responsibility of garbage pollution problems, which comprises the following steps: determining influence factors of international responsibility of each country; the analytic hierarchy process is used for taking a fixed deprivation to the weight of the influence factors in the responsibility distribution problem; establishing an evaluation system by using a weighted Topsis evaluation model; data standardization processing; and (5) carrying out model inspection to obtain a conclusion. According to the invention, a hierarchical analysis method is substituted into the garbage pollution responsibility division to obtain the weight of the related parameters, so that the parameter analysis is more rigorous, the analysis and prediction results are more accurate and reliable, and a final scheme is obtained by combining a TOPSIS comprehensive evaluation model. In order to obtain a reasonable and effective scheme, quantitative analysis is carried out by considering a plurality of influence factors, and calculation is carried out by an analytic hierarchy process and a TOPSIS evaluation model, so that a scientific and reasonable responsibility distribution scheme is obtained.

title_en: Multi-dimensional case allocation method based on credit card post-credit collection service
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-dimensional case distribution method based on credit card post-credit collection service, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the following steps of generating a case to be urged to be collected according to overdue bills, classifying the case to be urged to be collected according to different dimensions, classifying the case according to fairness of urging collectors, and adopting a distribution scheme as follows: firstly, ordering the cases which are not yet left, then ordering the collectors, and distributing the cases which are not yet left and the collectors in a one-to-one correspondence manner; the case classified according to the stock of the receiver is distributed according to the following scheme: finding out the case with the largest sum of money which is not yet stored, distributing the case to the collector with the smallest sum of money of the case stored, and sequentially distributing the case; the case classified according to the hastening difficulty is distributed according to the scheme as follows: and (3) distributing cases with high difficulty to collectors with weak service capability, cases with medium difficulty to collectors with medium service capability, and cases with low difficulty to collectors with strong service capability. The invention sets a reasonable distribution method for the multidimensional case, makes the collection service clearer and increases the rate of money return.
assignees: SHANGHAI ALL IN FINANCIAL SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Distributed energy storage and power scheduling method and device based on master-slave game
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure provides a distributed energy storage and power scheduling method and device based on master-slave gaming, and relates to the field of power distribution network operation analysis. The method comprises the following steps: a master-slave game scheduling model is established according to a game relationship between the power distribution network and the micro-grid, wherein the master-slave game scheduling model comprises a power distribution network operation model, a micro-grid operation model and game variable constraint; and solving the master-slave game scheduling model according to a particle swarm algorithm, and determining a power distribution network optimization efficient operation strategy under the condition of maximum benefits of the power distribution network and the micro-grid. In this way, the optimal efficient operation strategy of the distribution network and the distribution network with the largest gain of the micro-grid can be formulated, the efficient consumption of renewable energy sources is promoted to the greatest extent, the maximum benefit of each distribution network operator and the micro-grid is ensured, and the market fairness is improved.
assignees: STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Metering appliance verification flow control device and method based on low-code technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a metering appliance verification process control device and method based on a low-code technology, comprising a tested metering appliance, a verification mechanism main unit portal, a verification process scheduling tool, a remote verification system cloud service, a verification personnel terminal device and a verification measuring tool, wherein the remote verification system cloud service is respectively connected with the verification mechanism main unit portal, the tested metering appliance, the verification personnel terminal device and the verification process scheduling tool, the verification measuring tool is connected with the verification personnel terminal device, the tested metering appliance is connected with the verification personnel terminal device, and the verification mechanism main unit portal is connected with the verification process scheduling tool. The invention solves the problems of various metering devices and complex and changeable verification processes through the graphical and visual verification process arranging tool. Meanwhile, the invention also greatly simplifies the operation process of the verification personnel, reduces the requirements on the skills and experience of the verification personnel, and improves the objectivity and fairness of the verification result.
assignees: METTLER TOLEDO CHANGZHOU MEASUREMENT TECH CO LTD;METTLER TOLEDO CHANGZHOU PREC INSTRUMENT CO LTD;METTLER TOLEDO INT TRADING SHANGHAI CO LTD

title_en: Power grid distribution strategy decision method, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a power grid distribution strategy decision method, computer equipment and a computer readable storage medium. The method for deciding the power distribution strategy of the power grid is respectively applied to micro-grids and power distribution network operators, and achieves the purpose of maximizing benefits of all parties in energy trading through limited information exchange on the premise of protecting privacy of all parties by establishing a master multi-slave game model. Therefore, the application can form dynamic game bidding between the micro-grid and the power distribution network operators, and the bidding can be completed only by conveying part of key information. The privacy and fairness among the micro-grids are guaranteed, and meanwhile, the communication burden in the bidding process is reduced. The small amount of information transmission not only meets the fairness of competition, but also improves the response speed of power transaction. The flexible participation enthusiasm of the micro-grid is stimulated, and the energy and asset utilization rate of the power distribution network is improved.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;KUNMING POWER SUPPLY BUREAU YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Adaptive space crowdsourcing task allocation method based on dynamic task demand prediction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-adaptive space crowdsourcing task allocation method based on dynamic task demand prediction, which relates to the technical field of space crowdsourcing and comprises the steps of carrying out dynamic task demand prediction based on a demand-dependent learning module and a graph neural network according to historical task data of a target area to obtain predicted task demand information; and according to the predicted task demand information, obtaining an optimal task distribution result based on worker dependency separation, task cost function learning and a self-adaptive algorithm by the current task set and an availability window of staff. The invention remarkably improves the efficiency, flexibility and fairness of space crowdsourcing task allocation by innovations of dynamic task demand prediction, global optimization task allocation strategy, reduction of computational complexity, enhancement of stability and reliability of task allocation and the like, and has wide application prospect and social and economic value.
assignees: YANGTZE RIVER DELTA RESEARCH INSTITUTE QUZHOU OF ELECTRONIC SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY UNIV

title_en: Systems and Methods for a Bidirectional Cooperative E-Commerce and Logistics Platform
abstract_en: Disclosed is a cooperative, computer-implemented framework, herein referred to as the e-Sellers Platform (eSP), that operates as a non-custodial marketplace to coordinate independent sellers, buyers, and logistics providers. The framework solves key problems in the e-commerce ecosystem, namely monopolies, inefficient returns, and carrier redundancies. The invention's architecture functionally decouples middle-mile transit (“xHood”) from local first-mile and last-mile (“hood”) operations. This decoupling is a key enabler, allowing for the creation of a symmetrical, bidirectional logistics network that re-configures and optimizes existing logistics assets, including the underutilized vehicle capacity of e-commerce platforms. Local operations are managed by a novel, fairness-based assignment algorithm that equitably assigns tasks to a cooperative fleet of any size. The resulting system scales the logistics infrastructure, reduces environmental and financial waste, and creates a more efficient and equitable marketplace for all stakeholders.

title_en: Fair crowdsourcing workflow distribution method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fair crowdsourcing workflow distribution method, which comprises the following steps: s1, inputting an online worker set, a crowdsourcing task workflow and a completion time; s2, initializing allocation parameters and starting allocation; s3, finding a task set to be distributed from the workflow; s4, naming workers according to the requirements of the first task to be allocated, and grouping according to the similarity of the named workers to generate a task allocation naming group; s5, soliciting worker opinion according to the group, and generating a corresponding task allocation candidate group; s6, calculating fairness among groups, and selecting a candidate group subjected to least fair treatment; s7, finding out a candidate worker which receives the least fair treatment from the candidate group, and distributing a task to the worker; and S8, after the tasks in all the task sets to be distributed are completed, updating the distribution parameters to continuously search the next task set to be distributed until the tasks in the workflow are distributed completely. The invention ensures the maximum fairness of distribution on the premise of ensuring that the workflow is completed on time.

title_en: Dynamic scheduling method for emergency resources under emergency situation of reservoir dam
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic emergency resource scheduling method under a reservoir dam emergency situation, which comprises the steps of carrying out flood evolution simulation under the emergency situation, constructing a flood-road network coupling model containing road, placement points, flood flow rate and water depth information, predicting disaster victims according to situation information, calculating resource demands according to a resource demand prediction model, determining resource allocation related coefficients, introducing resource demand coefficients and disaster victimization severity coefficients, constructing an emergency resource fairness index based on a foundation coefficient, determining an optimal route from a resource storage point to the placement points, constructing an emergency resource transportation efficiency index based on the optimal route, constructing an emergency resource scheduling model by taking scheduling fairness and transportation efficiency as target functions, and obtaining a scheduling scheme under the dynamic situation by solving the scheduling model.

title_en: Green space optimization system considering ecological connectivity and green space equality
title_ko: 생태 연계성 및 녹지 형평성을 고려한 녹지 최적화 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 녹지 형평성 및 생태 연계성을 고려하여 녹지의 최적 위치를 선정하여 평가하도록 전산 장치에서 소프트웨어적으로 구현되는 시스템으로서, 도시 블록과 기존 녹지의 위치에 기초한 녹지의 형평성을 계산하여 상기 도시 블록에 요구되는 녹지의 규모 및 위치를 계산하는 제1 녹지 계산부; 생태 연계성에 기초하여 상기 도시 블록에 요구되는 녹지의 규모 및 위치를 계산하는 제2 녹지 계산부; 산발적 녹지 형태를 방지하는 것으로서, 상기 도시 블록에 요구되는 녹지 형태를 계산하는 제3 녹지 계산부; 및 상기 제1 녹지 계산부, 상기 제2 녹지 계산부 및 상기 제3 녹지 계산부의 계산 알고리즘에 해당하는 각각의 목적함수(Object Function)를 다중목적함수로 적용하여 최적화된 녹지의 규모 및 위치를 도출하는 최적화 알고리즘 계산부를 포함하는 생태 연계성 및 녹지 형평성을 고려한 녹지 최적화 시스템을 제공한다.

title_en: Aircraft crew scheduling method and system realizing the same
abstract_en: The invention discloses an aircraft crew scheduling method, which comprises the following steps: (1) acquiring original data meeting requirements of a user from a user interface and a database, and analyzing, converting and arranging the original data to acquire all essential data meeting required forms; (2) carrying constraint control on the essential data according to a scheduling rule, generating all probably scheduled task combinations for each aircraft crew, namely generating a relative task string LoW for each aircraft crew, and evaluating and correcting the task strings LoW; (3) converting all corrected task strings into a task column and establishing a constraint matrix; (4) solving the constraint matrix by utilizing an algorithm of disassembling a large-scale problem formed by integer programming problems into sub problems; and (5) outputting calculation results. The invention further discloses a system for realizing the aircraft crew scheduling method, wherein the system comprises a data input module, a model generation module, a solving module, a control module, a basic module and the like. According to the system for realizing the aircraft crew scheduling method, disclosed by the invention, requirements on equitable distribution of flight number plane, aircraft crew scheduling and flight task are met through cooperation of all modules.

title_en: Remote attendance system and attendance implementation method thereof
abstract_en: Each staff-side intelligent terminal reports an attendance card punching instruction carrying staff identity information to an attendance terminal (S10); the attendance terminal searches the scheduling date and the workplace which establish a mapping relation with the employee identity information from a preset mapping relation of the scheduling date, the employee identity information and the workplace according to the employee identity information carried by the attendance card punching instruction (S20); acquiring a current date, and judging whether the current date is within the range of the shift schedule date (S30); if the current date is within the range of the shift schedule date, issuing a current position acquisition instruction to the corresponding staff-side intelligent terminal (S40); the corresponding staff-side intelligent terminal starts a GPS positioning function according to a current position acquisition instruction issued by the attendance checking terminal to acquire a current position; reporting the current position to the attendance checking terminal in real time (S50); the attendance checking terminal matches the current position reported by the corresponding staff-side intelligent terminal with the position of the searched work place (S60); and when the position matching is successful, recording the receiving time of the corresponding attendance card punching instruction, and defining the receiving time as the attendance card punching time of the corresponding employee (S70). The method and the system ensure that the attendance checking of the staff at any position of the workplace can be realized without influencing other staff, and ensure the fairness of the attendance checking of the staff.
assignees: COMIX BUSINESS MACHINE SHENZHEN CO LTD

title_en: Construction method of universal grain system model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction method of a general grain system model, which sets the factors of comprehensive evaluation indexes of a grain system as efficiency, profit, sustainability and fairness; setting independent secondary indexes and corresponding index parameters for the elements respectively; acquiring the secondary indexes, and determining index parameters of four secondary indexes by utilizing an analytic hierarchy process from the perspective of three groups of producers, operators and consumers of grain products; the comprehensive evaluation index of the grain system is determined according to the secondary index and the index parameters, a general grain system model is established, the comprehensive evaluation index of the grain system established by the invention comprehensively considers the mutual influence relationship of the factors such as efficiency, profit, sustainability and fairness on the operation of the grain system, and the grain system model obtained by optimization gives consideration to the social benefits such as sustainability and fairness on the basis of ensuring the efficiency and profit, and is more reasonable, effective and stable than the original system.

title_en: Information recommendation method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for recommending information, and relates to the technical field of computers. The method comprises the steps of carrying out feature extraction on behavior data of a plurality of fields of a user to obtain user features, wherein the user features comprise user flow features, user equity behavior features and user ordering lines as features, obtaining conversion probability of the user to each equity based on the user features, determining ordering probability of the user based on the user flow features and the user ordering lines as features, and carrying out operation optimization calculation based on the conversion probability of the user to each equity and the ordering probability of the user to obtain rights information to be recommended of the user. The implementation mode greatly reduces operation and maintenance cost and improves flexibility of rights and interests information recommendation.
assignees: BEIJING JINGDONG YUANSHENG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Railway capacity resource allocation method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application provides a method, a device, equipment and a medium for distributing railway capacity resources, which relate to the technical field of transportation and comprise the steps of determining part of shippers in a plurality of shippers as a first shipper under the condition that the current railway capacity resources of an enterprise cannot meet a first report plan submitted by the shippers on a first report day at the same time; performing plan matching according to a first report plan submitted by a first shipper and a second report plan submitted by the first shipper on a second report day, and if the plan matching is successful, distributing transport capacity resources to the first shipper based on the first report plan submitted by the first shipper; for a first shipper with failed plan matching, based on the relevant situation information, it is determined whether to allocate capacity resources to the first shipper based on a first reporting plan submitted by the first shipper. The application can effectively solve the problems of scientificity, rationality and fairness of the distribution result by using manual distribution of capacity resources.
assignees: CHN ENERGY NEW ENERGY TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;CHN ENERGY INVEST GROUP CO LTD;GUONENG BAOSHEN RAILWAY GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Multi-source data fusion carbon emission on-line monitoring and quota allocation control method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control method and a device for on-line monitoring and quota allocation of carbon emission of multi-source data fusion, and relates to the technical field of carbon emission monitoring and quota management, comprising the following steps of calculating comprehensive scores of carbon emission intensity of all process units through a comprehensive score model based on multi-source data, and constructing an urgency mapping function to convert the comprehensive scores to obtain carbon emission urgency of all process units; the carbon quota is primarily allocated according to the carbon emission urgency, the carbon quota demand condition of each unit is calculated, a quota allocation optimization model is built based on the carbon quota demand condition, and the optimization model is solved to obtain the final quota borrowing amount and the carbon quota of each unit. The invention is used for solving the problems that the subjectivity of the existing carbon emission quota allocation is strong, and fairness and efficiency are difficult to be considered.

title_en: A kind of new energy station is rationed the power supply period active distribution method
abstract_en: It rations the power supply period active distribution method this application discloses a kind of new energy station, comprising: obtain new energy in region and ration the power supply aggregate demand；Multiple indexs of each new energy station are analyzed, the calculation method of each index is formed；Multiple indexs are subjected to overall merit, calculate each new energy station comprehensive evaluation index；Each new energy station amount of rationing the power supply is calculated according to each new energy station comprehensive evaluation index.It rations the power supply period active distribution method new energy station provided by the present application, the practical operation situation for comprehensively considering each new energy station carries out dynamic optimization to allocation strategy, according to new energy station history run trend, electricity transaction performance, participate in system stable operation support situation, foundation is rationed the power supply period each new energy station limit Sharing Distribution Energy coefficient, operating condition is outstanding, the transaction lower new energy station of electricity performance in the period of rationing the power supply can more carry out active power output to allowing, and guarantees equity dispatching.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Hospital performance assessment management system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a hospital performance assessment management system. Comprises a basic medical module and a public health module; the basic medical module comprises four assessment modules, namely a daily assessment module, a KPI assessment module, a balance scorecard assessment module and a one-way reward punishment assessment module, and also comprises three accounting modules, namely a workload integral accounting module, a personal performance accounting module and a department performance accounting module, and further comprises a performance secondary distribution module; the public health module comprises a public health quality control assessment module, three accounting modules, namely a workload point accounting module, a personal performance accounting module and a department performance accounting module, and further comprises a performance secondary distribution module; the system also comprises a system performance assessment module, a system performance accounting module and a system performance distribution module. According to the invention, multiple assessment factors of the hospital are brought into the system, so that the humanization and fairness of the performance assessment management are improved, and systematic support is provided for the reform of the performance assessment scheme of the hospital.
assignees: TIANJIN CITY HONGQIAO DISTR DINGZIGU STREET COMMUNITY HEALTH SERVICES CENTER;TIANJIN TIANXIN TENGDA SOFTWARE TECH CO LTD;TIANJIN RUNZHI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Behavior data processing method and device, computer equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a behavior data processing method, a behavior data processing device, computer equipment and a readable storage medium, relates to the technical field of Internet, determines the variation trend of the bearing pressure of a vehicle seat, forms a behavior state, counts the behavior data, enables the behavior data to be actively formed, selects the optimal distribution personnel to assign, passively records the behavior without feedback of the distribution personnel, improves the authenticity of the behavior data, ensures the fairness of grading, reduces the risk of negative influence to the minimum, and ensures the distribution efficiency. The method comprises the following steps: detecting the pressure of the seat to determine the current bearing pressure of the seat; when the bearing pressure is detected to change and the variation reaches a pressure threshold, determining the changing time point of the change, and acquiring the geographical position information of the current position; generating a behavior state according to the change trend of the change of the bearing pressure; and taking the change time point, the behavior state and the geographical position information as behavior data, and transmitting the behavior data.

title_en: Block chain-based resource allocation method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a resource allocation method, device and equipment based on a block chain and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of block chains. The method comprises the following steps: under the condition that life auxiliary service is completed, acquiring consumption information of a first object, wherein the first object is a service object for receiving life auxiliary service, and the consumption information comprises resources consumed by the first object for the life auxiliary service; determining a plurality of second objects participating in resource allocation and a division proportion between the plurality of second objects based on a resource allocation rule in a blockchain, wherein the plurality of second objects comprise service personnel and a service platform for providing life auxiliary services, and the division proportion is a proportion of resources occupied by each object when resources are allocated; the resources are allocated to the plurality of second objects based on the consumption information and the division in proportion. The technical scheme improves the efficiency of resource allocation and ensures the accuracy and fairness of resource allocation.

title_en: Shared open laboratory reservation distribution system and method based on weighted scoring algorithm
abstract_en: The invention provides a shared open laboratory reservation distribution system and method based on a weighted scoring algorithm, comprising the following steps: s1: constructing a weighted scoring system; s2: the user initiates a reservation request; s3: receiving a reservation request of an application user and processing related data of the application user; s4: scoring calculation is carried out on the application users according to the processed data, and a shared open laboratory is distributed; according to the shared open laboratory reservation distribution method based on the weighted scoring algorithm, basic information and historical use behaviors of an application user are comprehensively considered through a weighted scoring system, so that human intervention is reduced, and fairness and scientificity of shared open laboratory distribution are further ensured; the problem that in the existing allocation method, laboratory resources are occupied by part of users for a long time, and other users with actual demands are difficult to obtain the laboratory resources is avoided; by automatically processing the request and distributing laboratory resources, the management cost is reduced and the management efficiency is improved.
assignees: NANJING NUOFEIER INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Channel and time slot collaborative optimization method considering preference of airlines
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of air traffic flow management in the aerospace field, and discloses a channel and time slot collaborative optimization method considering the preference of an airline company, which comprises the following steps of obtaining flight information, time slot information and airspace capacity information; determining an objective function as minimum total delay cost of flights and minimum fairness coefficient of airlines according to flight information and time slot information, setting a flight uniqueness constraint, a time slot feasibility constraint, a capacity constraint and a maximum threshold constraint, constructing a complete model for allocating the resources of the routes and the time slots, solving the constructed model for allocating the resources of the routes and the time slots by adopting a genetic algorithm, and outputting a scheme for allocating the resources of the routes and the time slots. The invention takes delay minimization and fairness promotion as dual-core targets, innovates a resource allocation mechanism, effectively reduces the flight delay rate, ensures that the inter-airline resources are acquired fairly, and builds an efficient and fair air traffic management system by assistance.

title_en: Scheduling and dispatching system for service staff at departure gate
abstract_en: A scheduling and dispatching system for service staff at a departure gate comprises: a flight management module, a resource plan module, a scheduling management module, a real-time dispatch module, a statistical analysis module, and a task bidding module. A service process of the dispatch system comprises the following: importing flight information by combining a support standard (a service rule) and historical data and experience; generating a flight support task; predicting an overall workload, and appropriately formulating a scheduling plan; generating a dispatch plan for the current day; performing abnormality monitoring on a flight plan; adjusting the dispatch plan correspondingly according to feedback from the abnormality monitoring; releasing a dispatch result; and collecting statistics on data, analyzing the same, and using the same as historical data and experience. The system improves flight punctuality and the efficient utilization of human resources, and meets requirements for the transparency of information relating to productivity, employee duty fairness, employee work intensity, and so on. Resources flow across job positions, thereby further improving the efficient utilization of human resources, and motivating employees.
assignees: HANGZHOU PI SOLUTION INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: System and decision model for optimizing product development portfolios and technology portfolios for building brand equity
abstract_en: A technology platform, software, business system and decision model to build brand equity or improve business performance through more effective product/technology portfolio management and better alignment of product and technology strategy with brand strategy

title_en: Fair bidirectional combined cloud resource allocation method and system based on block chain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fair bidirectional combination cloud resource allocation method based on a block chain, and relates to n cloud users U-U 1 ,…,u n N, m cloud providers P ═ P 1 ,…,p m In which u i I is more than or equal to 1 and less than or equal to n; p is a radical of j J is more than or equal to 1 and less than or equal to m and represents the jth user; the distribution method is characterized by comprising the following steps: an initialization phase, a quotation phase, a matching and pricing phase, a payment phase, and a dispute phase. The invention also discloses a fair bidirectional combination cloud resource distribution system based on the block chain. The method ensures that the bidding information disclosed by the users and the cloud providers can not be forged based on a commitment mechanism in the bidding stage, and realizes the fairness among the users in a capital punishment mode; in the dispute stage, by means of the delay execution characteristic of the block chain transaction, and by means of an arbitrator, the fairness of the transaction between the cloud user and the cloud provider is realized; fairness between cloud users and cloud users, cloud providers and cloud providers, and between cloud users and cloud providers is generally achieved.

title_en: Block chain consensus mechanism for intelligent Internet of things computing service
abstract_en: The invention discloses a block chain consensus mechanism for intelligent internet of things computing service, which comprises a block chain architecture for intelligent internet of things computing service, a matrix product computing task processing mechanism and a reward adjustment mechanism; four types of nodes exist in the block chain architecture facing the intelligent internet of things computing service: AIoT node, coordinator node, miner node, and verifier node. The series of matrix product calculation task processing mechanisms provided by the invention makes unified rules and interfaces for blockchain miners participating in computational power service, ensures fairness of blockchain mining competition, and is beneficial to attracting more miners to participate in blockchains, so that the safety of a blockchain network is further improved. By using the distributed computing service of miners in the block chain, the risk of security and privacy disclosure caused by the central service is reduced, and the security of the computing service is improved.

title_en: Emergency logistic route optimizing method based on improved ant colony algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency logistic route optimization method based on an improved ant colony algorithm. The method comprises the steps of: constructing a multi-target static route optimizing model with minimum delivery time and minimum delivery cost serving as a target, and determining constraint conditions of the optimizing model, such as the emergency supply flows of temporary transfer stations, the fairness, and the vehicle-mounted capacity; using the ant colony algorithm to search for all routes, ordering the routes according to the lengths of the found routes after that all ants complete once searching, attaching a corresponding pheromone increment to each ant finding each route according to the route lengths; and setting upper and lower bounds of the pheromone, updating the pheromone of each route, completing traversal of all disaster points, determining a total target function value of each route and determining the optimal route and the optimal target function value. According to the invention, the ant colony algorithm is improved on the aspects of pheromone updating, pheromone limiting and the like, the convergence rate and the solving quality are increased and a theoretical basis is provided for the optimizing of the emergency route.
assignees: TAIHUA WISDOM IND GROUP HOLDINGS LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle communication system and resource allocation strategy prediction method based on neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a resource allocation strategy prediction method based on a neural network, which comprises the following steps: firstly, building an unmanned aerial vehicle wireless communication base station and a user downlink transmission system; acquiring positions of a wireless communication base station and a user of the unmanned aerial vehicle; thirdly, determining an evaluation index corresponding to the communication resource allocation strategy and acquiring the weight of the evaluation index corresponding to the communication resource allocation strategy; acquiring an optimal communication resource allocation strategy of the unmanned aerial vehicle wireless communication base station; fifthly, acquiring training data; sixthly, establishing and training an LSTM neural network model; and seventhly, predicting a communication resource allocation strategy of the unmanned aerial vehicle wireless communication base station. The method has simple steps and reasonable design, realizes the resource allocation prediction of the power and the bandwidth of the wireless communication base station of the unmanned aerial vehicle, realizes the maximization of the throughput of a communication system and meets the fairness of resource allocation.
assignees: CHINESE COMMUNICATION CONSTRUCTION FOURTH ENGINEERING BUREAU LTD COMPANY

title_en: Garment production automatic time accounting method and system based on Internet of things and provided with offer one's services
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for calculating the working time of offer one's services in clothing production based on the Internet of things, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining production assignment task data of a current sewing machine station, judging whether the current sewing machine station is an effective working station according to the production assignment task data, continuously monitoring and collecting a bottom layer operation parameter sequence of the current sewing machine station through sensing equipment of the Internet of things, judging the bottom layer operation parameter sequence by offer one's services dynamic state based on a predefined effective working time judging logic rule, recording the duration time of entering the effective working state each time by a high-precision timer and accumulating to generate effective working time structured data, and generating a visual report and analysis data for performance management, production efficiency analysis and process optimization based on the effective working time structured data. The automatic calculation based on the real operation data of the equipment can be realized, personal errors and falsification are avoided, and the fairness, the credibility, the objectivity and the accuracy of the data are ensured.
assignees: BEIJING EASTONE HUARUI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Blockchain-based secondary copyright revenue distribution system and method thereof
title_ko: 블록체인 기반의 2차 저작권 수익 분배 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and a method for blockchain-based secondary copyright revenue distribution. The system includes: a content receiving unit receiving multimedia content uploaded through a secondary copyright holder's user terminal; an information acquisition unit acquiring information on an original copyright holder with respect to the received multimedia content; a determination unit determining the presence or absence of revenue generation with respect to a video or sound source uploaded by the secondary copyright holder; and a revenue distribution unit performing revenue distribution to the secondary copyright holder and the original copyright holder in accordance with a smart contract preset in a distributed ledger in a case where it is determined that revenue has been generated. According to the present invention, blockchain-based revenue distribution can be performed between secondary and primary copyright holders. Accordingly, it is possible to avoid existing abnormal copyright revenue distribution structures involving distributors or the like and perform smart contract-based license confirmation so that copyright revenue distribution to copyright holders and performers can be performed with relative fairness and transparency.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 블록체인 기반의 2차 저작권 수익 분배 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것이다.  
본 발명에 따르면, 블록체인 기반의 2차 저작권 수익 분배 시스템에 있어서, 2차 저작권자의 사용자 단말기를 통해 업로드된 멀티미디어 콘텐츠를 수신하는 콘텐츠 수신부, 수신된 멀티미디어 콘텐츠에 대한 원 저작권자의 정보를 획득하는 정보획득부, 2차 저작권자에 의해 업로드된 영상 또는 음원에 대한 수익 발생 여부를 판단하는 판단부, 그리고 수익이 발생된 것으로 판단되면, 분산 원장 내에 기 설정된 스마트 컨트랙트에 따라 2차 저작권자와 원 저작권자자에게 수익을 분배하는 수익분배부를 포함한다.  
이와 같이 본 발명에 따르면, 블록체인을 기반으로 2차 저작권자와 1차 저작권자의 사이의 수익을 분배할 수 있도록 하여 종래 유통사 등을 통한 비정상적인 저작권 수익 분배 구조를 탈피하고, 스마트 컨트랙트를 통해 라이선스를 확인하여 저작권자 및 실연권자들에게 비교적 투명하고 공정하게 저작권 수익이 분배될 수 있도록 한다.

title_en: Thermal power generating unit annual electric quantity planning method based on Kini coefficient fairness
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric power, in particular to a thermal power generating unit annual electric quantity planning method based on the fairness of a kini coefficient. The method comprises the following steps: constructing an annual electric quantity planning model objective function of the thermal power generating unit based on the kini coefficient; constructing power generator set electricity quantity fairness constraint, electricity quantity balance constraint, electricity quantity upper and lower limit constraint and parameter association constraint of a thermal power generating unit annual electricity quantity plan based on a kini coefficient; and (4) solving the annual planned electric quantity of each thermal power generating unit meeting the objective function and the constraint condition by adopting Cplex optimization software. The method takes the annual electric quantity of each unit as a decision variable, establishes an optimized model, and realizes the maximum reduction of energy and resource consumption and pollutant discharge in the true sense through the optimal electric quantity distribution result; and adopting a well-known fairness index of the Gini coefficient to carry out integral constraint on the electricity generation utilization hours of each unit so as to obtain a fair distribution scheme. The overall and various kinds of the Gini coefficient indexes are adjusted, and the requirements of different electricity distribution fairness are met.

title_en: Multidimensional scheduling rationality evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multidimensional shift rationality evaluation method and system. The method comprises the following steps: calculating a plurality of corresponding rationality evaluation indexes and comprehensive evaluation indexes of the shift schedule to be evaluated; calculating to obtain a plurality of rationality evaluation indexes of each historical shift schedule; calculating the correlation coefficient value of each principal component influence factor corresponding to each rationality evaluation index, and obtaining multiple groups of predictive evaluation indexes and comprehensive predictive evaluation indexes through a neural network model; optimizing a plurality of groups of predictive evaluation indexes; calculating the relevance of the personnel retention rate and the personnel retention rate of each optimized shift table; and comprehensively evaluating the optimization condition of each optimized scheduling list, and selecting the optimal scheduling list. In the invention, the comfort, the work shift fairness, the business performance and the economy of the call center staff scheduling can be analyzed through a plurality of influence factors, compared with the existing evaluation method, the evaluation dimensionality is richer, and the scheduling rationality can be comprehensively evaluated.
assignees: BEIJING JIARUI INTELLIGENT TECH GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Double-random-based combined average order-distributing method and device, electronic equipment and product
abstract_en: The invention discloses a combined average dispatch method, a device, electronic equipment and a product based on double random, which are used for extracting inspection personnel in each inspection list corresponding inspection group by combining with a personnel selection rule with less dispatch quantity of preferential extraction on the premise that personnel grouping and inspection list grouping are randomly distributed; therefore, the double-random allocation principle is adopted to ensure the randomness of allocation, and the personnel selection rule with less dispatching quantity is extracted preferentially, so that the inspection personnel can be allocated to the inspection sheets with the same quantity to the greatest extent, and the workload of each inspection personnel can be balanced; therefore, the invention not only ensures the fairness of customs law enforcement, but also avoids the problem of uneven distribution of personnel orders in the traditional technology, thereby being capable of effectively utilizing human resources, and being very suitable for large-scale application and popularization.
assignees: HONGQIAO HIGH TECH GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Light storage and charging integrated charging pile and shared charging model construction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optical storage and charging integrated charging pile and a shared charging model construction method, relates to the technical field of operation optimization of charging piles, and aims to solve the problems of inaccurate data processing, one-sided priority evaluation, stiff resource constraint and the like of the existing shared charging technology. The method is based on space-time associated data of an optical storage and charging system, a user and a power grid, a high-quality dynamic data set is processed and output through a double-index weighting algorithm, a priority sequence is formed by quantifying the charging priority of the user through a three-dimensional coupling algorithm based on the space-time associated data, an energy storage capacity and power grid interaction power constraint model which are dynamically adjusted along with the priority is built by combining the data and the sequence, a multi-objective optimization function of priority self-adaptive weight is built, a charging pile distribution and power scheduling scheme is solved by adopting a self-adaptive particle swarm algorithm, the full-flow coordination of data processing, priority evaluation, resource constraint, optimization targets and dynamic response is achieved, and the high efficiency, fairness and stability of shared charging are improved.
assignees: SUQIAN POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD SIHONG COUNTY POWER SUPPLY BRANCH

title_en: Accelerating data-driven scientific discovery
abstract_en: Techniques facilitating using a distribution system for incentivizing and accelerating data driven scientific research are described herein. The distribution system can track the input of various parties involved in scientific research, and when a reward, monetary or otherwise, is realized for one or more outcomes of the scientific research, the distribution system can distribute the reward among the parties that provided the input. The relative levels and contributions of the parties can be tracked to ensure that an equitable portioning of the reward is realized. A directed graph can be formed based on the transactions, wherein the nodes correspond to entities, researchers, publications, and the edges correspond to relationships between the entities. The directed graph can be analyzed to determine the relative or absolute levels of contributions from each of the entities, and the rewards can be distributed based on the contribution levels.

title_en: Inventory allocation with tradeoff between fairness and maximal value of remaining inventory
abstract_en: A method of balancing advertisement inventory allocation includes constructing a flow network of nodes having impressions connected to contracts through corresponding arcs such as to satisfy demand requests of the contracts; normalizing an impression value of each node to a predetermined cost range; setting a cost of each arc to each corresponding normalized value; iteratively performing a plurality of times: (a) sampling the nodes or the arcs to create sample nodes and arcs, each time starting from a different random seed; (b) optimally allocating impressions from the sample nodes to the contracts with a minimum-cost network flow algorithm; (c) separately allocating impressions from sample arcs of lowest cost before allocating those from sample arcs of higher cost; averaging allocations from iterations (b) to create a first allocation; averaging allocations from iterations (c) to produce a second allocation; and computing a weighted solution of the first and second allocations.

title_en: Rescue material distribution device and distribution method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a delivery device for rescue goods and materials, which comprises a delivery box main body consisting of two rotationally connected box bodies, it is characterized in that a placing bin for placing materials is arranged in the box body, a protective layer is arranged on the inner wall of the placing bin, the box bodies are provided with wireless communication devices for communication, and the box body locks are arranged on the sides of the two box bodies far away from the rotary connection, so that the method changes the original centralized distribution mode of substances into a distributed self-replacing or substituted distribution mode, the substance distribution time is more dispersed, disaster-stricken personnel can arrange to carefully take or replace the disaster relief material distribution box by other people according to the self time, thereby avoiding the possible situation of robbing by centralized distribution and being capable of quantitative distribution, thereby ensuring that each person can take enough substances and avoiding the phenomena of uneven distribution and waste.

title_en: Warehouse picking operation double-layer optimization method considering dynamic order constraint
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double-layer optimization method for warehouse picking operation considering dynamic order constraint, which belongs to the field of logistics and is characterized by comprising the following steps of digitizing warehouse layout, establishing an order batch optimization model taking minimum picking passage and highest service desk fairness as upper optimization targets, establishing an employee picking operation optimization model taking the shortest total picking time as lower optimization targets, and optimizing the models of the second and third steps. Aiming at the operation requirements of a certain logistics enterprise, research on order allocation and picking path problems is developed, a double-layer optimization model is constructed by taking the minimum total shelf number and the maximum service desk fairness as upper-layer optimization targets and the shortest total picking time as lower-layer optimization targets, practical operation constraints including warehouse physical layout, personnel and auxiliary tool capacity constraints and the like are comprehensively considered, and compared with the model constructed by the traditional model, the model has stronger practicability.

title_en: Investment and financing docking and equity value evaluation system for regional equity market
abstract_en: A investment and financing docking and equity value evaluation system for a regional equity market belongs to the technical field of enterprise valuation. The enterprise value evaluation system comprises a basic information management unit, an enterprise value evaluation unit, a value evaluation information output unit and a subsequent service unit, wherein an enterprise is in butt joint with the basic information management unit, the data output end of a data unit is connected with the input end of the enterprise value evaluation unit, the enterprise value is evaluated by using the enterprise value evaluation unit, the enterprise value evaluation unit outputs an enterprise value evaluation result, and the subsequent service unit is connected with the output end of the value evaluation information output unit; the subsequent service unit is simultaneously connected with the basic information management unit and the enterprise. The value of small and medium enterprises is evaluated through the investment and financing butt joint and the equity value evaluation system of the equity market in the region, the subsequent service of the enterprises is realized, and evaluation and valuation results are fed back to machine learning after the subsequent service, so that the model is continuously optimized, and valuation and service are more accurate.
assignees: QILU EQUITY EXCHANGE CENTER CO LTD

title_en: Airport time fairness calculation method based on peak demand
abstract_en: The invention discloses an airport time fairness calculation method based on peak demand, which comprises the steps of obtaining the flight time from each airport to an airway point according to historical flight operation data, and calculating the expected flight flow of the airway point by combining with an airport group strategic flight schedule; carrying out statistical processing on historical flight operation data, and setting the published capacity of waypoints; substituting the strategic flight schedule and the related parameters into a basic time distribution model, comparing the relation between the expected flow and the published capacity of the waypoints, determining the peak time period distribution of the waypoints, and counting the number of flights of each airport in the airport group in the peak time period of the waypoints; and counting the time offset of each airport flight at the waypoint, and calculating the airport fairness index of each airport at the waypoint according to a proportion principle. The method fully considers the peak time demand of each airport on the waypoint to obtain the fairness index value of each airport, and scientifically evaluates the fairness influence of the time offset result on each airport.

title_en: Comprehensive management system for competition of community robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive management system for competition of a community robot, which relates to the technical field of data analysis and comprises the following components: the system comprises a historical data acquisition module, a scoring module, a matching model module and an updating module; the historical data acquisition module is used for acquiring historical contest records of contestants to construct a historical contest record array; the scoring module is used for evaluating the strength level of each contestant based on the historical contestant record array to obtain contestant capacity indexes; the matching model module is used for performing matching operation based on contestant capacity indexes to obtain an optimal allocation scheme; the updating module is used for acquiring the competition result of the optimal allocation scheme and updating the historical competition record array; through a plurality of modules, comprehensive analysis of contestants is realized, fairness of contestant competition is ensured, and then the competition contestants with equivalent flagstones are added to improve ornamental value of the competition.
assignees: KUNSHAN JUNYOU TECH TRAINING CO LTD

title_en: Optimal unit combination method based on large-scale power grid load
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optimal unit combination method based on large-scale power grid load, which relates to the technical field of power dispatching and solves the problems of energy consumption reduction and cost control by not fully considering the combination conditions of different generator sets, and the invention precisely determines the power intervals to be regulated associated with different characteristic time periods by the method on the power supply allocation layer, so that the power scale required to be supplemented can be clearly known when the power requirements of different time periods are faced, thereby reasonably arranging the generator sets to supplement the power; the power supply system ensures the stability and reliability of power supply while meeting the power demand, avoids the condition of insufficient power supply or excessive power supply caused by improper power allocation, and forcefully maintains the stable operation of a power grid.
assignees: HEFEI TIANYING TECH CO LTD;FUYANG POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Green electricity transaction industry chain dynamic optimization method based on multi-factor evaluation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of green electricity transaction industry chain optimization, in particular to a green electricity transaction industry chain dynamic optimization method based on multi-factor evaluation, which realizes the accurate depiction of a green electricity transaction industry chain network structure through multi-dimensional node attribute definition and bidirectional relation edge construction, and can comprehensively capture economic cooperation and implicit decision-making conduction relation among nodes in an industry chain by distinguishing quantization logic of transaction relation edge and influence edge and combining comprehensive association strength to construct a unified adjacency matrix, the invention innovatively integrates the efficiency and fairness targets into a dynamic optimization framework, achieves the cooperative balance of the improvement of the industrial chain efficiency and the fairness guarantee by scientifically designing objective functions and introducing a multi-target optimization algorithm, focuses on resource allocation and cost optimization of the efficiency targets and focuses on the accessibility and association balance of the edge nodes of the fairness targets.
assignees: GUANGDONG ELECTRIC POWER TRANSACTION CENTER CO LTD

title_en: Information processing device, information processing method, and computer program
abstract_en: To generate a plurality of paths with fairness between the paths taken into account.SOLUTION: This information processing device comprises a processing unit that divides one or more pieces of stripe information containing a plurality of stop positions of a mobile body on which a crew member can board and at least one of the departure time and the arrival time of the stop positions on the basis of a stop position where the crew member can be replaced to generate a plurality of pieces of crew assignment fragment information indicating the crew assignment for each divided stripe part, and allocates each of the pieces of the crew assignment fragment information to one of a plurality of target periods longer than that of a basic path on the basis of constraints regarding the basic period including a period when the crew member continuously performs duty, thereby generating a plurality of paths indicating crew schedules for the respective target periods.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
