title_en: Method and system for managing resources on wireless communication network
abstract_en: A resource management method and apparatuses for a communication system are provided. The resource management method provides an algorithm for resource cost optimization, which defines the first weight for higher resource-use rates, based on the channel state allocated to each customer node, and the second weight for improved fairness among users, based on a willingness of a user of each customer node to pay, calculates the resource cost for each customer node from the first and the second weights, and controls resource allocation for resource cost optimization.

title_en: Resource allocation method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a resource allocation method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, relates to the technical field of resource allocation, and can be applied to an artificial intelligence service platform based on an artificial intelligence technology, and comprises the following steps: acquiring resource conversion data and user use data in a service platform; determining model parameters of a resource conversion distribution model according to the resource conversion data, and determining model parameters of a resource use distribution model according to the user use data; and performing target resource allocation on the content resource provider according to the resource conversion allocation model and the resource use allocation model. The method and the device can improve fairness and rationality of target resource allocation.

title_en: Industrial load equal proportion-based load index distribution method and device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of electric power, and particularly relates to a load index distribution method and device based on industrial load equal proportion, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining an industrial load total value of a target area in a power limiting period, predicting the highest power consumption load according to climate parameters of the next day, and determining power supply parameters of the next day according to power sources in the target area; and distributing load indexes according to the total value of the power limiting load parameters and the industrial load, and sharing the power limiting indexes according to the industrial load proportion of each city, wherein the cities with high industrial load share the power limiting indexes, and the cities with low industrial load bear little power limiting indexes, so that the fairness of the power limiting of the industrial load is ensured, and the realization of the aim that civil power consumption is not limited in the period of limited power supply capacity and power shortage is ensured.

title_en: Law enforcement quality supervision system based on computer vision and semantic analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of law enforcement supervision, in particular to a law enforcement quality supervision system based on computer vision and semantic analysis. According to the invention, the accurate identification and analysis of fingerprints, seals and signatures in law enforcement documents are realized through integrating computer vision and semantic analysis technology, the accuracy of document verification is remarkably improved, the fine capture of image details is ensured through boundary detection and pixel level optimization, so that a system can identify fine image changes with higher resolution, the response speed and sensitivity of the system to complex details are improved, the misjudgment is reduced, the reliability of true and false judgment is improved in the identification and coding process of image features by the deep learning technology, the compliance of law enforcement texts can be comprehensively inspected through automatic semantic analysis and logic verification, and the law enforcement transparency and fairness are enhanced.

title_en: Green electricity transaction industry chain dynamic optimization method based on multi-factor evaluation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of green electricity transaction industry chain optimization, in particular to a green electricity transaction industry chain dynamic optimization method based on multi-factor evaluation, which realizes the accurate depiction of a green electricity transaction industry chain network structure through multi-dimensional node attribute definition and bidirectional relation edge construction, and can comprehensively capture economic cooperation and implicit decision-making conduction relation among nodes in an industry chain by distinguishing quantization logic of transaction relation edge and influence edge and combining comprehensive association strength to construct a unified adjacency matrix, the invention innovatively integrates the efficiency and fairness targets into a dynamic optimization framework, achieves the cooperative balance of the improvement of the industrial chain efficiency and the fairness guarantee by scientifically designing objective functions and introducing a multi-target optimization algorithm, focuses on resource allocation and cost optimization of the efficiency targets and focuses on the accessibility and association balance of the edge nodes of the fairness targets.

title_en: System of testing the influence of income distribution and social security system on personal sense of fairness
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system of testing the influence of income distribution and a social security system on personal sense of fairness for solving the problem that personal subjective sense of fairness is difficult to test through a social survey method in the prior art and relates to data processing methods. The technical scheme includes the steps of S10, respectively calculating first income of all tested users according to a preset simple topic set; S20, respectively calculating second income of all of the tested users according to a random topic set randomly selected from a preset test bank; S30, respectively calculating third income of all of the tested users according to the test bank and difficulty factors of user purchase; S40, obtaining all income of every tested user; S50, obtaining subjective feelings for the gap of income of all of the tested users; S60, obtaining and analyzing physiological indicators of every user to obtain objective feelings for the gap of income of all of the tested users; S70, obtaining personal sense of fairness for the gap of income of all of the tested users.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle cooperative reconnaissance path planning method based on energy consumption fairness
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle cooperative reconnaissance path planning method based on energy consumption fairness, which utilizes an algorithm of a traveler problem to calculate a path covering all target points, so that the total energy consumption is minimum; distributing the N reconnaissance target points to K unmanned aerial vehicles by using a path decomposition algorithm and obtaining an initial path of each unmanned aerial vehicle; and (4) forming a closed path of the K unmanned aerial vehicles by adding the initial path of each unmanned aerial vehicle and the path from the starting point to the reconnaissance area. The invention effectively reduces the maximum energy consumption of the unmanned aerial vehicles, improves the energy consumption fairness among the unmanned aerial vehicles and ensures that the reconnaissance task is smoothly completed.

title_en: Distributed game interaction method under mass distributed resource aggregation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a distributed game interaction method under mass distributed resource aggregation, which comprises the following steps: establishing a distributed interaction model of a load aggregator; establishing a micro-grid operator distributed interaction model; performing interactive iteration between the load aggregator and the micro-grid operator; judging whether the interactive iteration of the step (3) is converged, if so, entering the next step, otherwise, returning to the step (3); the load aggregator interacts with the micro-grid operators. The invention establishes a cooperation alliance based on cooperation game match-up aggregators, and maximizes benefits of the aggregators while realizing on-site consumption of new energy and guaranteeing reliability of load power supply; adopting Nash bargained settlement formula to carry out multi-main body cooperation surplus distribution, so that cooperation surplus is distributed among aggregators in pareto optimal mode, and the distribution strategy has fairness and optimality; and the distributed interaction of the aggregators is carried out based on the ADMM algorithm, and only a small amount of coupling transaction information is needed to be interacted by the aggregators during interaction, so that the privacy of multiple subjects can be effectively protected.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Provincial domain carbon emission prediction method, device, equipment and medium based on self-adaptive multi-scale decomposition
abstract_en: The application discloses a provincial carbon emission prediction method, device, equipment and medium based on self-adaptive multi-scale decomposition, relating to the technical field of air prediction, comprising the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining and standardizing carbon emission data of each city in a province, inputting a preset carbon emission prediction model formed by a multi-head attention-encoder-decoder generator and a time sequence convolution discriminator, outputting predicted values of each city, summarizing the predicted values into a province domain result, adopting self-adaptive multi-scale decomposition and space-time feature fusion in a model training stage, and carrying out joint optimization by means of the fair loss of a day-month coefficient, so as to realize regional differentiation, fairness and high-precision carbon emission prediction, and provide credible and interpretable data support for provincial carbon quota scientific allocation and emission reduction responsibility division.

title_en: A method, a system and computer programs, for electrical energy distribution in a peer-to-peer distributed energy network
abstract_en: The method comprises receiving, by an energy controller (100) located in a site remote from a plurality of nodes, from each partner node (200) that request to be part of a distribution of electrical energy within a network, a list including a predicted energy generation, storage and demand over a period of time, actual price for supplying and/or demanding energy, including prices to traverse an intermediary node, and energy losses that would be incurred in transferring energy to/from each partner node (200), including losses to traverse an intermediary node; and calculating, by the energy controller (100), the distribution of the energy using the information of said lists and a predefined function including maximizing a ratio of energy distributed to cost, allocating energy resources in a balanced manner based on needs of different partner nodes (200) or a combination of cost and equity.

title_en: Food transaction optimization matching method based on block chain technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a food transaction optimization matching method based on a block chain technology, which is used for solving the problems of transaction configuration dislocation caused by information asymmetry, easy malicious tampering of transaction records and the like in the traditional food transaction. The method comprises the following steps: according to the information sets of the supply and demand parties, a scheduling node in the alliance block chain runs a transaction optimization matching algorithm to select an optimized transaction combination scheme for the two transaction parties, and an online bidirectional auction mechanism is used for eliminating the competition relationship of different buyers for the same seller combination, so that the transaction efficiency is improved and the fairness is ensured; for actually achieved transaction intention, automatic transaction of both transaction parties is achieved through the intelligent contract, after the transaction is completed, the intelligent contract and transaction information are encrypted by both transaction parties and then uploaded to the scheduling node for auditing, the improved PBFT consensus algorithm is adopted, inconsistency of the transaction information is avoided through comparing the actual transaction information with a transaction combination scheme in a cache table built in the scheduling node, and effectiveness of the transaction information recorded into a block chain is guaranteed.

title_en: Outbound service case distribution method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a case distribution method and a device for outbound service, which are used for deeply mining the potential relation between the combination of the outbound service case and the agent and the case completion result based on a neural network model, predicting the probability of completing the case targets of all case distribution combinations by utilizing the deep neural network model, constructing a network flow diagram based on the prediction result and finding the optimal distribution combination between the case and the agent, thereby realizing the distribution of the proper case to the proper agent, ensuring the fairness of case distribution, improving the completion rate of the case targets, and being beneficial to improving the work enthusiasm of the agent.

title_en: Self-adaptive answering optimization method and system based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention provides a self-adaptive answering optimization method and system based on reinforcement learning, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting multi-mode answering signals of students by using a sensor, preprocessing to obtain target signals, carrying out feature extraction and fusion, collecting target signals by an edge computing node to form multi-mode feature data, carrying out feature fusion on the multi-mode feature data, constructing a reinforcement learning model to prioritize the answering signals, dynamically adjusting the processing sequence and weight of the answering signals, optimizing the transmission path of the answering signals, encrypting and decrypting optical signals generated by an optical self-adaptive optical technology, receiving the decrypted optical signals by a central processing unit, processing and analyzing the decrypted optical signals, and sending analysis results to each edge computing node and a user. The invention provides a self-adaptive optical answering fairness optimization system based on reinforcement learning, which effectively solves the problems of signal transmission delay, fairness and safety of the conventional classroom answering system.

title_en: Risk scheduling method for water resource system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water resource system risk scheduling method which comprises the steps of obtaining regional basic data, constructing a supply and demand pressure field, identifying causal relations, generating heterogeneous computing grids and a space-time causal network, dynamically determining a water-required tail cutting threshold value by adopting a cascade buffer pool mechanism based on historical supply and demand sequence data of the heterogeneous computing grids and influence factors identified by the space-time causal network, outputting a regulated water-required sequence, generating a water scene set by adopting an optimal transmission method of tail conformal by utilizing the regulated water-required sequence, simplifying the water scene set into a representative scene subset, constructing a distributed robust optimization model aiming at the representative scene subset, and generating a water resource scheduling scheme and a risk assessment report by fairness constraint projection and causal path analysis. The invention can finely describe the space-time pressure, adaptively regulate and control the extreme requirements, and generate a scheduling scheme which takes robustness and fairness into consideration under the condition of keeping the tail risk characteristics.

title_en: Urban update section boundary dividing method and system based on cadastre data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of urban cadastral data analysis, and discloses a cadastral data-based urban updating zone boundary dividing method and system, which are characterized in that cadastral data are associated by collecting the dividing of an updating zone of a target city, an improved DTW algorithm is adopted, the method comprises the steps of screening current situation boundary address effective points and newly added candidate points with history continuity from current situation actual measurement data, extracting spatial features and ownership features, fusing the spatial features and the ownership features, constructing a feature matrix by using fused feature vectors, constructing a spatial ownership dual-constraint graph neural network, predicting a final boundary point set of an updated patch area of a target city, and generating a final land block boundary address boundary. Therefore, the invention realizes the joint optimization of space rationality and equity rationality by utilizing the double-constraint feature fusion while establishing accurate association between history and current situation address data by introducing the improved DTW algorithm and the space equity double-constraint graph neural network, and improves the division precision and division efficiency of the boundary address of the urban update slice area.

title_en: Fixed frequency air-conditioner aggregation modeling and frequency modulation service method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fixed frequency air-conditioner aggregation modeling and frequency modulation service method. The method comprises the following steps that (1) a single fixed frequency air-conditioner basic model is established; (2) the on/off state of a fixed frequency air-conditioner is considered, an indoor set temperature dead zone [Tmax,Tmin] is divided into OFF subsequences and ON subsequences according to the equitime principle, the state number of the OFF subsequences is Noff, the state number of the ON subsequences is Non, and an air-conditioner group equitime state aggregation model is established; (3) an air-conditioner group aggregation control model considering external control signals and air-conditioner compressor locking time is established; and (4) a frequency modulation service is provided for the system on the basis of the air-conditioner group aggregation control model, and an air-conditioner group priority stack control strategy is put forward. The fixed frequency air-conditioner aggregation model is established so that unified scheduling and control of large-scale air-conditioner load can be realized, and the relevant departments are facilitated.

title_en: Emulation training wisdom evaluation system based on adaptive learning
abstract_en: The emulation training wisdom evaluation system based on adaptive learning that the invention discloses a kind of comprising rule base, rule base management tool, information acquisition module and wisdom evaluation module；Information acquisition module acquires operation of power networks and student's operating process information；Wisdom evaluation module includes storage unit, evaluation of programme unit, adaptive learning unit and expert opinion unit；Storage unit carries out analysis using information of the rule base to acquisition and analysis result is transmitted to evaluation of programme unit；Evaluation of programme unit carries out first evaluation to student's operating process, if ideal, then export evaluation result, otherwise adaptive learning is carried out to evaluation of programme, student's Operations Analyst result, expert opinion unit using adaptive learning unit, optimize and improve evaluation of programme, successive ignition evaluation is carried out to student's operating process, and obtains final appraisal results.The present invention improves the efficiency and fairness of training evaluation, enhances training matter effect.
assignees: STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Data evacuation method and system suitable for cloud data center network
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a data evacuation method and system suitable for a cloud data center network, including: dividing time slots according to disaster diffusion characteristics, and switching the time slots according to state changes of the data center; optimizing in two stages in each time slot, selecting a safety data center and performing bandwidth time-varying scheduling on a plurality of parallel sparse streams to obtain a data evacuation scheme; when the safety data center selects, the sum of the products of the routing hop count of all evacuation tasks and evacuation data is minimized as a target; the bandwidth time-varying scheduling of multiple parallel sparse streams aims at maximizing the sum of the bandwidth allocated to all the sparse tasks. Factors such as routing hop number, evacuation data volume and the like are considered in the selection stage of the safety data center, so that the time delay of data evacuation can be better reduced; the sign-based sparse route time-varying searching method is utilized to improve the fairness of bandwidth allocation and can better support bandwidth allocation with personalized proportion.

title_en: Seat allocation method for reducing railway epidemic propagation risk
abstract_en: The invention discloses a seat allocation method for reducing railway epidemic propagation risks. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring train information and passenger information; establishing a railway train epidemic propagation and infection risk assessment method; according to the infection rate and the passenger information, obtaining an objective function in the train aiming at minimizing the infection rate and maximizing the railway ticket income, and listing passenger group demands, the infection rate, the transport capacity and social fairness constraint conditions according to the objective function; and solving the optimal solution of the model to obtain a seat allocation scheme which gives consideration to epidemic propagation risks and benefits of railway departments. The invention establishes an optimization model taking a seat allocation scheme as a decision based on passenger group demand and infection rate constraints, and maximizing the sum of the profit of the railway department and minimizing the infection rate under the constraints of transport capacity, group demand, infection rate, social fairness and the like, so as to obtain the seat allocation scheme which gives consideration to epidemic situation propagation risk and the benefit of the railway department, thereby improving the economic benefit of the railway while ensuring the safety of passengers.

title_en: Optimal path planning method and system for line inspection task distribution
abstract_en: An optimal path planning method and system for line patrol task allocation, comprising: step 1, obtaining line plane coordinate data; step 2, preprocessing the obtained line plane coordinate data to obtain preprocessed line plane coordinate data; step 3, dividing the preprocessed line plane coordinate data obtained in the step 2 to obtain line plane coordinate data of different areas; and 4, carrying out optimal path planning on line inspection of each zone according to the line plane coordinate data of the different zones obtained in the step 3. When the line inspection path is planned, the relationship among the line, the tower and the line channel and the inspection path mileage difference of a plurality of inspection staff are considered, and the obtained inspection path can realize comprehensive inspection of the line, ensure the fairness and the rationality of planning and effectively improve the efficiency and the quality of line inspection work.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD SUZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;ZHANGJIAGANG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Enterprise system integration method based on micro-service architecture
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of enterprise system integration and discloses an enterprise system integration method based on a micro-service architecture, which comprises the steps of executing an overtime office degree assessment strategy, calculating terminal indexes by combining click times and office interfaces, identifying two types of space-time behaviors of staff, weighting and averaging the terminal indexes to obtain the overtime office degree, executing a behavior rationality assessment strategy, comparing a position track with a reference path to assess track deviation degree, executing a consumption authenticity assessment strategy, assessing the authenticity of consumption amount according to per-person meal fees, analyzing a card swiping interval to identify a brushing-over behavior, executing a pseudo overtime behavior scoring strategy, identifying a pseudo overtime behavior according to the position track leaving a restaurant, identifying a secondary overtime behavior, calculating the overtime office degree for calculating a behavior score, executing a task checking overtime identification strategy, identifying the pseudo overtime behavior according to task demand score and behavior score, and improving the fairness and transparency of enterprise welfare distribution.
assignees: JIANGSU JINGSHU INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Online reservation and credit system based on blockchain
abstract_en: The invention relates to a block chain-based online reservation and credit system, which utilizes a block chain technology to uplink reservation information to form a set of complete credit management, and simultaneously provides a real-time determination flow to repeatedly inquire the use state of public resources. Compared with the traditional public resource use management system, the scheme is based on the fact that the reservation use of the public resource is automatically completed, manual approval is not needed, reservation efficiency is improved on one hand, and time flow is saved; on the other hand, the reservation system provided by the scheme does not need manual intervention, ensures good fairness, avoids the problem of unreasonable resource allocation caused by people's feelings, and finally, the reservation system based on credit points can avoid reservation persons wasting the public resources, thereby maximizing resource utilization.

title_en: Engineering project performance appraisal method and system
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of engineering project performance appraisal method and system.This method comprises: obtaining the examination node of current project, corresponding schedule parameter is obtained according to examination node；Project process score is calculated according to schedule parameter；Project cruising score is calculated according to the quality cruising result of project；Project is obtained according to examination node to apply for checking and examination parameter, is calculated project according to project parameter of applying for checking and examination and is applied for checking and examination integrity degree score；According to project process score, project cruising score and project apply for checking and examination integrity degree score carry out respectively project leader's performance float calculate and quality supervisor's performance float calculate, to obtain the performance appraisal result of current project.The present invention is by based on applying for checking and examination the calculating of integrity degree score to project process score, project cruising score and project, so as to carry out performance appraisal to project leader and quality supervisor automatically, it is therefore prevented that the problem using fairness and accuracy difference caused by manually marking assessment.
assignees: ZHANGZHOU HEYONG SOFTWARE DEV CO LTD

title_en: Mine accident emergency rescue dynamic scheduling modeling method integrating demand satisfaction and disaster victims loss
abstract_en: The invention relates to a dynamic dispatching and modeling method for mine accident emergency rescue of comprehensive demand satisfaction and disaster victims loss, which comprises the following steps: collecting mine accident information; expressing the demand satisfaction by using a relative demand satisfaction function; designing a loss function to minimize the loss generated when the requirements of emergency materials of the mine accident are not met; constructing a multi-target model of mine accident emergency material scheduling by taking the goals of the minimum delay time of the total materials of the system, the maximum satisfaction degree of the relative requirements of the whole mine accident disaster area on the mine accident emergency materials and the minimum loss when the mine accident emergency material requirements of mine accident victims are not met; and carrying out algorithm design on the solution of the model to obtain an optimal solution. The invention takes the improvement of the satisfaction degree of the public on the rescue work as a key factor in the mine accident emergency rescue coordination optimization problem, so that the dispatching of the mine accident emergency supplies is more suitable for the actual emergency rescue requirements.

title_en: Power demand side management alternate optimization method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric power demand side management alternate optimization method, which relates to the technical field of electric power systems and is used for solving the problem that the fairness of orderly power utilization is difficult to guarantee at present, and the method comprises the following steps: s1, generating an ordered power utilization user sequence according to the load decompression index completion rate, formulating an ordered power utilization scheme and storing the ordered power utilization scheme to a block chain; s2, collecting user load data during the orderly power utilization, calculating the load reduction amount, and storing the load reduction amount in a block chain; s3, updating the load pressure reduction index completion rate according to the load pressure reduction amount; repeating steps S1-S3 according to the updated load decompression index completion rate. The invention also discloses a power demand side management alternation optimization device, electronic equipment and a computer storage medium. According to the invention, the load index completion rate is automatically updated through the block chain, so that the ordered power utilization scheme is automatically updated, and the load index completion rate of the user is basically consistent.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENT RES INST STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV ZHEJIANG;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION BRANCH STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: User side dynamic carbon responsibility accounting method considering regional fairness and demand response
abstract_en: The invention discloses a user side dynamic carbon responsibility accounting method considering regional fairness and demand response, which comprises the steps of establishing a user side demand response double-layer optimization model, determining various basic parameters of the model, including user side carbon responsibility proportion parameters, cost parameters of a unit, power grid topology parameters and load initial quantity, calculating a starting marginal carbon emission factor as an average marginal carbon emission rate, considering the maximization of electricity cost, carbon transaction cost and electricity income of each load in demand response, solving a user demand response model, outputting a load side demand response plan under the current average marginal carbon emission rate, setting convergence conditions, solving an operator clearing model by taking the minimum electricity generation cost as constraint if the current average marginal carbon emission rate is not converged, obtaining new unit system carbon emission quantity, updating the average marginal carbon emission rate, outputting the new demand response plan, outputting a final load demand response plan if the convergence conditions are met, and accounting a user carbon emission responsibility value.
assignees: ECONOMIC TECHNOLOGY RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Novel risk prevention method and device for power system and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a risk prevention method, a risk prevention device and a storage medium of a novel power system, which are applied to the technical field of power market risk protection, and comprise the steps of constructing a multi-dimensional risk monitoring index system covering economy, society, fairness and the like, driving market optimization according to the system risk monitoring index system, realizing the crossing from single price limitation to systematic risk active management, improving the capability of the market to cope with complex uncertainty, smoothening the relationship among markets by designing cooperative constraints of electric energy, capacity, auxiliary service and green electricity markets, promoting the optimal configuration of various resources, improving the overall market efficiency, introducing a dynamic planning and closed-loop feedback mechanism, enabling market parameters (such as price limit, risk weight) and operation strategies to be dynamically adjusted according to real-time states of supply and demand, new energy output and the like, and obviously enhancing the adaptability of the market mechanism to the dynamic characteristics of the novel power system.
assignees: ECONOMIC TECHNOLOGY RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: An optimization method and device for humanitarian logistics through truck-drone integration
title_ko: 트럭-드론 연계를 통한 재난구호물자 전달 최적화 방법 및 장치
abstract_ko: 트럭-드론 연계를 통한 재난구호물자 전달 최적화 방법 및 장치가 개시된다.  본 발명의 일실시예에 따른, 트럭-드론 연계를 통한 재난구호물자 전달 최적화 방법은, 재난이 발생한 피해 지역 내에서, 복수의 노드에 관한 노드 데이터를 수집하는 단계; 상기 피해 지역으로 재난구호물자를 전달하기 위한 전달 수단으로, 하나의 트럭과, 상기 트럭에 장착되는 n개(상기 n은 자연수)의 드론에 관한 스펙 데이터를 수집하는 단계; 상기 노드 데이터와 상기 스펙 데이터를 고려하여, 상기 트럭과 상기 드론과의 연계에 의한 상기 재난구호물자의 전달이 이루어지도록, 상기 복수의 노드의 적어도 일부를 잇는 최적 경로를 채택하는 단계; 및 상기 채택된 최적 경로를 따라, 상기 트럭 또는 상기 드론을 이동시키는 단계를 포함 할 수 있다.
assignees: ULSAN NAT INST SCIENCE & TECH UNIST

title_en: Distributed generator and user electric energy transaction method based on block chain platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed generator and user electric energy transaction method based on a blockchain platform, which adopts point-to-point (P2P) market transaction operation as a method for sharing local electric energy and fully utilizing distributed energy, and simultaneously enables distributed generator and users to perform self-management operation through a reasonable transaction mechanism, thereby avoiding the problems of complex operation and information and transaction safety in matching transaction, and being very suitable for distributed power supply transaction. In addition, the process introduces the blockchain technology, has the advantage of short decision time when polygonal transaction is operated, and can effectively solve the influence of the selfiness of both sides purchasing electricity on the transaction fairness and the user privacy. The invention provides a distributed generator and user electric energy trading method based on a blockchain platform, which ensures the income and expenditure balance of enterprises and solves the problem that the existing electric market trading platform is not safe enough, establishes a social benefit maximization model, introduces the blockchain platform in electric market trading, and depends on a P2P trading system, thereby not only maintaining the trading safety, but also reducing the risk of exposing private information of both sides of the trading.

title_en: Real-time Sharing Method of Cargo Transportation Information through Cargo Information Sharing Community centered on Cloud Hub with Dynamic Routing and Safe Driving Requirements
title_ko: 동적 라우팅 기능 및 안전운행 요건을 구비한 클라우드 허브 중심의 화물정보 공유 커뮤니티를 통한 화물 운송 정보의 실시간 공유 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for sharing freight transportation information in real time through a cloud hub centered freight information sharing community with a dynamic routing function and safe driving requirements. More specifically, the present invention relates to the method improving dispatch efficiency of freight transportation vehicles using location based service, enhancing dispatch fairness, and increasing adaptability to state change changing in real time by utilizing a cloud hub centered freight information sharing community and sharing freight information in the community in real time by a shipper, an organizer, a carrier, a truck driver, etc. who are members of a freight transport system.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 동적 라우팅 기능 및 안전운행 요건을 구비한 클라우드 허브 중심의 화물정보 공유 커뮤니티를 통한 화물 운송 정보의 실시간 공유 방법에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 클라우드 허브를 중심으로 구성되는 화물정보 공유 커뮤니티를 활용하여 커뮤니티 내의 화물 정보 등을 화물운송체계를 구성하는 구성원이 되는 화주, 주선사업자, 운송업자, 화물차 기사 등이 실시간으로 상호 공유하여 위치기반서비스를 이용한 화물 운송 차량의 배차효율을 향상시키고 배차 공정성을 제고하면서 실시간으로 변화되는 상태 변화에 대한 적응성을 높이도록 하는 화물정보 공유 커뮤니티를 통한 화물 운송 정보의 실시간 공유 방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Interaction method of comprehensive energy micro-grid group based on dynamic energy price and non-cooperative game
abstract_en: The invention relates to an interaction method of a comprehensive energy micro-grid group based on dynamic energy price and non-cooperative game, which comprises the following steps: setting an integrated energy micro-grid group energy interaction strategy containing an energy interaction service provider EIP; constructing a dynamic energy price mechanism of the supply-demand relationship; taking the lowest running cost of the comprehensive energy micro-grid as an optimization target, and constructing a comprehensive energy micro-grid model based on various constraint conditions; establishing a non-cooperative game model based on the comprehensive energy micro-grid, the interaction strategy and the comprehensive energy micro-grid model; and the comprehensive energy micro-grid group performs energy interaction according to the solving result of the non-cooperative game model. Compared with the prior art, the invention establishes a non-cooperative game framework of the comprehensive energy micro-grid group, considers each comprehensive energy micro-grid as an equal participant, and ensures the fairness of the game process by the energy interactive price determined by all participants together, and designs a dynamic energy price mechanism to excite the enthusiasm of each micro-grid for comprehensive demand response.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV SHANGHAI ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Cloud control system for electric power material warehousing operation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cloud control system for electric power material warehousing operations, and relates to the technical field of warehousing operation cloud control. According to the electric power material warehouse operation cloud control system, through integrating the multi-warehouse node cooperative detection module, the material supply distribution module and the material scheduling equipment control module, accurate detection and qualification judgment of multi-warehouse node candidate electric power materials are achieved, the problem that the adaption judgment is on one side only due to the fact that the prior art depends on general attributes is solved, the problem that the allocation priority is disjointed and disordered is solved by determining the adaption fault demand, the efficient warehouse allocation and reliable material allocation sequence in a state through three-dimensional quantitative sequencing, the equipment state and priority are combined to generate a targeted supply allocation list, and an equipment time sequence and path cooperative operation scheme is formulated, so that the problems of confliction of allocation sequence and equipment operation conflict are solved.
assignees: CONSTRUCTION BRANCH HAINAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Resource distribution method, device, storage medium and computer equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a resource issuing method, a resource issuing device, a storage medium and computer equipment. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a resource verification user and a preset resource, comparing user characteristics of the resource verification user and a target user, determining first similarity between the resource verification user and the target user, comparing resource characteristics of the preset resource and a history resource corresponding to the first user, determining second similarity between the preset resource and the history resource, determining a target user verification probability relative to the preset resource according to the first similarity and the second similarity, and distributing the preset resource to the target user according to the resource verification probability. According to the method, automatic dynamic resource allocation can be realized without network model training, objective and fairness of resource allocation are guaranteed, a target user can obtain resources which meet the requirements of the target user, the use effect of the resources and shopping experience of the user are improved, and the loyalty of the user is enhanced.

title_en: Scheduling heterogeneous partitioned resources with sharing constraints
abstract_en: A system and method that provides an automated solution to obtaining quality scheduling for users of computing resources. The system, implemented in an enterprise software test center, collects information from test-shop personnel about test machine features and availability, test jobs, and tester preferences and constraints. The system reformulates this testing information as a system of constraints. An optimizing scheduling engine computes efficient schedules whereby all the jobs are feasibly scheduled while satisfying the users' time preferences to the greatest extent possible. The method and system achieves fairness: if all preferences can not be meet, it is attempted to evenly distribute violations of preferences across the users. The test scheduling is generated according to a first application of a greedy algorithm that finds an initial feasible assignment of jobs. The second is a local search algorithm that improves the initial greedy solution.
assignees: KIMBREL TRACY J;KUMAR TARUN;MCKENZIE KEVIN D;PREWITT JR RICHARD D;SVIRIDENKO MAXIM;TOMKOWID DEBRA;IBM

title_en: Ship piloting and scheduling method based on forest model and improved genetic algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ship piloting and scheduling method based on a forest model and an improved genetic algorithm. According to the method, the piloting task forest model is established according to piloting task linkage conditions, and the improved breadth-first search algorithm is adopted for traversing a piloting task forest to obtain an initial piloting task set; according to the initial piloting task set, the improved genetic algorithm is adopted for obtaining the optimal piloting and scheduling plan. Various written scheduling rules and unwritten scheduling habits adopted during piloting and scheduling are considered, meanwhile, constraint conditions involved in piloting and scheduling problems are converted into a cost model, and the ship piloting and scheduling method is worked out from the three aspects of feasibility, fairness and benefits.

title_en: Electric automobile charging management method based on network constraint
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric automobile charging management method based on network constraint. The method comprises the following steps: S1, establishing an optimal charging allocation plan taking furthest allocating charging flow for electric automobile as a target, including power grid safety operation constraint; S2, designing a direct charging mechanism framework taking charging behavioral preferences of electric automobile users into account; S3, introducing fairness constraint. The method takes electric automobile user behaviors and charging preferences into full account while taking basic power distribution network constraint into account, forms a novel electric automobile charging market mechanism, can guarantee the equal charging opportunity for each electric automobile user and efficient charging, and can further effectively prevent the electric automobile users from cheating during charging. The method can be applied to the formulating of multi-layered user charging plans according to aggregation demand response, and is beneficial to the enhancement of the interactive level of electric automobiles and electric systems.
assignees: ZHEJIANG AICHONG NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of ticket processing method and device
abstract_en: This application discloses a kind of ticket processing method and device, this method includes：Obtain the ticket purchasing request that terminal is sent, the identification information of booking user which carries billing information to be purchased and ask for a ticket；Based on the identification information of booking user, the credit standing for reflecting behavioural characteristic of the booking user in booking service platform is obtained；When the credit standing shows that booking user has first kind behavioural characteristic, according to the billing information, generation bill locking voucher；Bill locking voucher is returned into the terminal.The scheme of the application can realize more rational distribution bill, reduce the situation of bill waste, and be conducive to improve the fairness of bill purchase.

title_en: Method for allocating tasks, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of method for allocating tasks, device, equipment and storage medium, method includes: the task to be allocated obtained in current task pond；Obtain the task parameters of each task processing node；Wherein, the task parameters include remaining task amount and task amount are completed；According to the weighting task amount that task amount is completed and obtains each task processing node；The real surplus task amount of each task processing node is obtained according to the weighting task amount and the remaining task amount；And task to be allocated is distributed into the smallest task of real surplus task amount and handles node.Implement the present invention, can be realized more fair task distribution, and taken into account the efficiency of task distributional equity and task processing.

title_en: Important control and emission industrial carbon quota optimal allocation method considering bearing capacity of terminal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a key control and emission industry carbon quota optimal allocation method considering terminal bearing capacity, which relates to the technical field of carbon quota optimal allocation and comprises the steps of dynamically adjusting allocation strategies according to different energy utilization characteristics of terminals in each industry to conduct differentiated management and control in different industries to obtain fairness indexes, constructing a multi-index-method-based decision allocation model based on the fairness indexes to obtain initial carbon quota quantity, considering the effectiveness of a carbon quota allocation efficiency principle based on the fairness principle, introducing a zero and game data envelope analysis method (ZSG-DEA) to obtain a ZSG-DEA-based key control and emission industry carbon quota allocation model, performing key control and emission industry allocation efficiency evaluation on the initial carbon quota quantity, further obtaining all industry optimal carbon quota, and providing policy references for the carbon quota allocation method in each industry in China.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Automatic expressway toll collection management system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of transaction settlement, in particular to an automatic expressway toll management system, which comprises a traffic state capturing module, a vehicle speed and direction analyzing module and a vehicle passing and overtaking module, wherein the traffic state capturing module is used for collecting and recording the vehicle position based on vehicle running data, updating according to time sequence, determining a running track, determining the following and overtaking behaviors by utilizing the relative position among vehicles, and constructing nodes and sides of a graph. According to the invention, through comprehensive collection and real-time analysis of the vehicle running data, the fine capture and dynamic update of traffic states are realized, the interaction among vehicles is accurately evaluated, key vehicles affecting traffic flows are timely identified, based on the fact, the charging standard is dynamically set, reasonable road use cost distribution is ensured, the congestion risk is reduced, the charging fairness and the road use efficiency are improved, the charging information is synchronized in real time, the vehicle decision is more time-efficient, the path selection error caused by information lag is avoided, the traffic flow distribution is further optimized, the traffic efficiency is improved, and the congestion problem is effectively relieved.

title_en: Service personnel clock setting optimization method and system based on data driving
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of manual service operation management, in particular to a service personnel clock setting optimization method and system based on data driving. The method comprises the steps of obtaining clock-up data of a history service person, carrying out clock-up feature extraction according to the clock-up data of the history service person to obtain clock-up feature data, carrying out clock-down same-frequency processing according to the clock-up feature data to obtain clock-down same-frequency data, carrying out clock-arranging conflict processing according to the clock-down same-frequency data to obtain clock-arranging conflict data, carrying out clock-arranging order disturbance according to the clock-arranging conflict data to obtain clock-arranging disturbance data, carrying out cooling window control according to the clock-arranging disturbance data to obtain cooling window data, and carrying out dispersion degree processing on the clock-arranging disturbance data according to the cooling window data to obtain clock-arranging optimization data. The invention realizes the dynamic perception and intelligent optimization of the service personnel clock arranging process. Compared with the traditional static shift arrangement mode, the method can effectively relieve resource conflict and improve service continuity and fairness.
assignees: CHANGSHA TIMES BEAT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method, equipment and medium for mutual identification and distribution of green power and national verification voluntary emission reduction
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mutual identification and distribution method, equipment and medium for green electric power and national nuclear voluntary emission reduction, wherein the method comprises the steps of S1, constructing a park-type virtual power plant, conducting intermediate agency on user bodies with different emission reduction characteristic differences, S2, deducting new energy generating capacity from total electric quantity to revise an original electric power factor, S3, conducting mutual identification on the national nuclear voluntary emission reduction CCER and green electric power according to a revised electric power factor based on an environment rights uniqueness principle and a pollutant payment principle, S4, conducting claim on the national nuclear voluntary emission reduction by the park-type virtual power plant agency in a unified mode, and S5, distributing the national nuclear voluntary emission reduction by adopting a multi-weight shape method. Compared with the prior art, the invention ensures the fairness and effectiveness of the voluntary emission reduction distribution of the national evidence, is beneficial to promoting the low-carbon transformation of the power system and stimulating the users to actively participate in the renewable energy consumption.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Electric automobile cluster participation income distribution method based on aggregator mode
abstract_en: The invention provides an electric vehicle cluster participation profit distribution method based on an aggregator mode, which comprises the following steps of establishing an electric vehicle user willingness model by evaluating the electric vehicle user willingness, regulating and controlling an EV by an aggregator through a monomer EV charging and discharging model, participating in a frequency modulation market to obtain profits, and distributing the obtained profits to the aggregator and an EV owner based on shapley value theory. The electric vehicle user willingness model solves the problem that electric vehicle users participate in response influence factors, provides EV real-time margin, solves the problems of unreasonable profit allocation among electric vehicle users, unreasonable user contribution, unreasonable profit and the like, considers the energy resource occupation of the EV in energy cost allocation based on shapley value theory, considers the frequency modulation contribution of the EV in frequency modulation profit, and solves the problem of fairness of profit allocation between EVA and EV owners.

title_en: Relief supply distribution support system
abstract_en: To provide a relief supply distribution support system that can appropriately distribute relief supplies according to an evacuation situation such as the number of evacuees, age ratio, gender ratio of each shelter.SOLUTION: A relief supply distribution support system includes: basic attribute storage means 20 for storing users' basic attributes; check-in means 22 for transmitting information including the users' basic attributes as check-in information on a shelter to an information sharing platform 1; evacuation situation update means 11 for updating information on an evacuation situation as information on the shelter based on the check-in information transmitted by the check-in means 22; and evacuation information provision means 13 for providing the information on the evacuation situation based on a request from a manager's computer 3.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Bus trunk network identification method based on bus card swiping data
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of public transport management, in particular to a public transport trunk network identification method based on public transport card swiping data, which aims to solve the problems that the distribution of public transport resources is only researched from single angles such as the fairness between the transport resource allocation and the transport modes, the comprehensiveness is lacked, and the equalization is lacked in the prior art, and the technical scheme is the public transport trunk network identification method based on the public transport card swiping data, and comprises the following steps: acquiring passenger flow data related to public transportation, and selecting a bus route according to the passenger flow data; constructing an initial bus net based on the selected bus lines; optimizing an initial bus network to form an optimized bus network; detecting and optimizing uncovered channels in a bus network, and selecting a supplementary line capable of covering the uncovered channels; the supplementary lines are combined into the optimized bus network, and finally a bus network scheme is formed.
assignees: SUZHOU PLANNING & DESIGN RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Task allocation method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The method, the device and the electronic equipment determine matching degrees of different task objects to be allocated and different processing personnel respectively, determine processing time lengths required by the different processing personnel to process the different task objects respectively and an upper threshold value of the total processing time length of each allocated task object by a single processing personnel, and allocate the different task objects by taking the upper threshold value as a constraint according to the determined matching degrees and the processing time lengths. According to the task object allocation method and device, the task objects are allocated according to the matching degree of the task objects and the matching degree of the processing personnel and the time required by the processing personnel to process the task objects, the task objects can be allocated to the processing personnel with the matched attributes as far as possible, excessive difference of the processing time of the respectively allocated task objects by different processing personnel is avoided, the cooperative processing efficiency of tasks in a task processing scene with cooperation of multiple persons can be improved, and the fairness of task allocation is guaranteed.

title_en: Unloading decision method of intelligent reflection surface-assisted unmanned aerial vehicle mobile edge computing system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unloading decision method of an intelligent reflection surface-assisted unmanned aerial vehicle mobile edge computing system, which comprises the following steps: an effective phase shift model of the intelligent reflecting surface is built, and a wireless transmission model and an unloading calculation energy consumption model between user equipment and the unmanned aerial vehicle are built; constructing a local calculation energy consumption model of the user equipment; constructing a pushing energy consumption model of the unmanned aerial vehicle; constructing a minimum system total energy consumption optimization problem of a communication system to be optimized, dividing the minimum system total energy consumption optimization problem into a first optimization problem, and solving a second optimization problem and a third optimization problem; and solving the first optimization problem, the second optimization problem and the third optimization problem alternately and iteratively until the convergence to the preset precision is stopped, and obtaining the optimal unloading decision scheme. The invention is beneficial to rapidly deploying the mobile edge computing system in application scenes such as natural disaster areas, complex terrains and the like, improves the link performance better, and simultaneously gives consideration to the delay fairness of multi-user execution tasks.

title_en: Passenger train schedule optimization method considering efficiency and fairness
abstract_en: The invention discloses an efficiency and fairness-considered passenger railway train schedule optimization method which comprises the steps of 1, constructing a customized space-time network under passenger railways, 2, constructing a passenger railway efficiency-maximized train schedule model P  1 , 3, constructing a passenger railway fairness-based train schedule model P  2 , 4, solving an efficiency-oriented train schedule model P  1  by utilizing a train generation algorithm to obtain an efficiency-oriented train schedule scheme, 5, applying a decomposition scheme to the fairness-oriented train schedule model P  2 , and then solving by utilizing a train generation algorithm to obtain the fairness-considered train schedule scheme. The train schedule model for train operators is constructed based on the train schedule model with the maximum efficiency, and the train schedule model is decomposed so that the train schedule model can be solved by using an optimization algorithm generated by train lines, so that the technical problem that the efficiency and fairness of the existing train schedule are difficult to balance is solved.

title_en: Resident flow-based life circle identification and full-age adaptation facility supply and demand assessment method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of urban public service facility assessment and space planning, and discloses a life circle identification and full-age adaptation facility supply and demand assessment method based on resident flow. The method is characterized in that actual travel tracks of residents are dynamically captured by utilizing mobile phone signaling data, so that a life circle range highly fitting with actual behaviors is identified, differentiated demands of different age groups such as children, young and strong years, old people and the like on various public service facilities are finely quantized by constructing a two-dimensional demand weight matrix of the age groups and facilities, accurate matching assessment of facility supply and demand services is realized by fusing multi-source data such as population distribution, facility point positions and real-time road networks and the like, the limitation that traditional planning depends on static administrative boundaries is effectively overcome, life circle division is more scientific, and the accuracy and fairness of facility configuration are remarkably improved from an all-age demand assessment view.

title_en: system
abstract_en: To provide a system capable of realizing efficient and rapid supply of relief supplies.SOLUTION: A terminal means for inputting necessary items by a user in a chat format or a voice input format, a server means including a means for transmitting input data to a server, a natural language processing means for converting voice data into text data, a necessary item specifying means for analyzing the text data and specifying necessary items and urgency thereof, a means for visualizing necessary items on a map based on an analysis result and geographical information, a disaster data collecting means for collecting disaster data and predicting needs of items, and a prediction model learning means for learning a prediction model; The system includes a machine learning means for improving accuracy, a means for generating an article distribution plan based on an analysis result and a prediction, and a means for notifying the generated distribution plan.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Event stream distribution method, event stream distribution device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and discloses an event stream distribution method, an event stream distribution device and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an event stream set comprising more than one event stream to be distributed; calculating the priority of each event stream to be distributed according to the attribute information of each event stream to be distributed; respectively acquiring event stream queues of all users; screening the users corresponding to each event stream queue based on preset screening conditions to obtain user queues; according to the priority of each event stream to be allocated, allocating the event streams to be allocated to users in a user queue according to the sequence from high to low, and updating an event stream set after the allocation of the current round is finished; and if the event stream set is not empty, returning to execute the step and the subsequent step of respectively acquiring the event stream queues of the users until the event stream set is empty. The scheme can realize intelligent automatic distribution of event streams and ensure fairness of distribution.

title_en: Enforcing compute equity models in distributed blockchain
abstract_en: An example operation may include one or more of identifying a blockchain transaction submitted from a requestor member of the blockchain, identifying one or more task requests associated with the blockchain transaction, determining one or more blockchain members having resources available for completing the one or more task requests, wherein the resources are identified via known computing parameters associated with each of the one or more blockchain members, and assigning the one or more task requests to the one or more blockchain members based on the resources available.

title_en: A kind of degree resource allocation publicity method, system and equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: This application discloses a kind of degree resource allocation publicity method, system and equipment and computer readable storage mediums, are applied to block chain, and this method includes：Formulate and issue the intelligent contract of target school, wherein the intelligence contract is specially the intelligent contract for describing the target school enrollment flow；Obtain the school admission imformation and registration list of the target school, wherein the school admission imformation includes admission criterion and enrollment resource；The student for meeting the admission criterion in the registration list is ranked up according to the intelligent contract to obtain ranking results by preset condition, and according to the ranking results and enrollment resource generation list of enrollees.Degree resource allocation publicity method provided by the present application is based on block chain technology, ensures the fairness that authenticity guarantee's list of enrollees of school admission imformation and list of registering generates, while improving the supervision of degree resource.

title_en: The method of medical performance evaluation based on disease risks adjustment application
abstract_en: The method that the present invention discloses the medical performance evaluation based on disease risks adjustment application, including calculating the ACMI adjusted based on disease risks and the CCHI based on technical operation difficulty, it further include the assessment method of performance, the assessment method calculates hospital performance total value by historical data the following steps are included: S1；Performance total value is carried out calculating distribution by duty system by S2, obtains each duty system performance volume；Single duty system performance volume is carried out calculating distribution by department, obtains each department's performance volume by S3；Single department's performance volume is carried out calculating distribution by doctor individual, obtains Individual Performance volume by S4.The present invention provides a kind of accurate methods for calculating individual performance, ensure that the fairness of evaluation, have transferred the enthusiasm of medical staff, can also promote personal and organizational performance level promotion.
assignees: CHENGDU HOULI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Material detection management system and method based on block chain technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a material detection management system and method based on a block chain technology, which comprises a service flow data acquisition layer, a detection block chain layer and a distributed storage layer; the business flow data acquisition layer comprises a detection sample collection module, a detection scheme making module, a station detection module, a detection sample returning module, a detection auditing module, a detection report generating module and a detection application layer. The invention can promote the fairness and fairness of the power grid material detection and improve the reliability of the power grid material quality.
assignees: WUHAN NARI LTD LIABILITY CO OF STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Double-target emergency material conveying optimization method, system and equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double-target emergency material conveying optimization method, a system and equipment, which relate to the technical field of logistics supply chain optimization and comprise the following steps: receiving truck path parameters and unmanned plane path parameters; inputting the truck path parameters and the unmanned plane path parameters into a pre-established logistics cost function to obtain a minimized logistics cost function, and inputting the truck path parameters and the unmanned plane path parameters into a pre-established deprivation cost function to obtain a minimized deprivation cost function; combining the obtained minimized current cost function and the minimized deprivation cost function, and obtaining a mixed integer nonlinear programming model by utilizing the constraint of the truck-unmanned aerial vehicle cooperative distribution path; and solving the mixed integer nonlinear programming model by utilizing an improved non-dominant order genetic algorithm (INSSGA-II) with elite strategy to obtain a double-target emergency material transportation optimization result.

title_en: Three-dimensional loading optimization system and method based on multi-agent reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a three-dimensional loading optimization system and method based on multi-agent reinforcement learning. Aiming at the limitation of the traditional single-agent method in the multi-truck collaborative loading, the invention applies the VDN multi-agent architecture to the 3D multi-truck loading problem for the first time, adopts an original component group-based secondary adjustment cost algorithm, a dynamic constraint strategy and a fair competition mechanism, models each truck as an independent agent, realizes the multi-agent collaborative decision through the VDN, creatively proposes the component group-distributed secondary adjustment cost algorithm, effectively reduces the cross-truck adjustment cost, and remarkably improves the loading efficiency and the decision fairness by adopting a dynamic rotation (not put, vertical and horizontal) constraint strategy and the fair competition mechanism. Experimental results show that compared with the traditional method, the method has obvious improvement in space utilization rate, adjustment cost and decision efficiency.

title_en: Heuristic cross shipping of disaster relief supplies at points of distribution
abstract_en: Distributing disaster relief supplies, in one aspect, may include determining cross shipping of disaster relief supplies between points of distribution using one or more combinations of information. The information may include one or more of on-hand inventory of each point of distribution, in-transit inventory to each point of distribution, demand queue of disaster victims at each point of distribution, traveling time between supply staging area and points of distribution, traveling time between points of distribution, number of transportation vehicles available for cross shipping, minimum batch size for cross shipping, frequency of cross shipping, and point of distribution activation status, or combinations thereof.

title_en: Warehouse logistics-oriented different-speed multi-AGV nerve divide-by-two scheduling method and device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of path optimization and intelligent decision making, and provides a warehouse logistics-oriented multi-AGV nerve divide-and-conquer scheduling method and device, aiming at the problems of unbalanced multi-agent collaborative heterogeneous scheduling and low efficiency in the prior art, wherein the method is implemented by constructing a MDMTSP-V problem model aiming at minimizing the maximum travel time; the method comprises the steps of designing a neural dividing and controlling framework, decomposing a warehouse logistics problem into two stages of urban allocation and sub-travel business planning and solving, constructing a neural allocation strategy network, fusing spatial characteristics and heterogeneous speed characteristics, realizing efficient and fair urban cluster division, carrying out end-to-end training on the network by adopting a reinforcement learning mechanism, optimizing an allocation strategy, and solving the sub-TSP problem of each agent by adopting a high-efficient precision algorithm. The invention combines the learning ability of the neural network with the accuracy of the classical optimization algorithm, and remarkably improves the fairness and the overall efficiency of the warehouse logistics multi-agent collaborative heterogeneous scheduling scheme.

title_en: A kind of intelligent electricity utilization cell cutting load dispatching method of fairness
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of intelligent electricity utilization cell cutting load dispatching methods of fairness, purpose of the present invention cutting load dispatching method before the Family Day of a kind of meter of offer and electricity consumption behavior, this method is compared with general technology, the present invention is in the data characteristic for fully considering domestic consumer's dispatching in intelligent residential district, the day power load data information of domestic consumer is obtained by acquisition, obtaining user daily electricity consumption can cutting load, the dispatching of user is analyzed, the fairness criterion that science is established with data effectively improves intelligent residential district electricity consumption scheduling cutting load effect.

title_en: Task dispatch method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a task dispatch method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: under the condition of receiving a task request, determining at least one user to receive a task corresponding to the task request in a preset range of a task place; determining index parameters corresponding to each user based on preset indexes, wherein the index parameters comprise weight values and historical index values of each index; determining the grading value of each user through a good-bad solution distance method according to the index parameters corresponding to each user; and according to the grading value, sending the task corresponding to the task request to the user with the highest grading value. The embodiment ensures fairness of task dispatch.

title_en: Airport group flight time optimization method and device, storage medium and terminal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for optimizing airport group flight moments, a storage medium and a terminal. The optimization method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the following steps: establishing an airport group flight time optimization model based on absolute fairness; step two: solving the airport group flight time optimization model based on the absolute fairness, and performing airport group flight time optimization distribution according to the solving result. The invention makes the capacity limit and transit time limit of the airport and the waypoint as constraint conditions, sets up a dual-objective optimization model by taking the minimum target value of the overall fairness of the airport group and the minimum total offset of the flight time as targets, and respectively makes the capacity limit constraint of 5 minutes and 15 minutes for the airport and the waypoint, thereby enabling the optimization result to be more accurate and the flight time to be distributed more uniformly.

title_en: Building group comprehensive energy scheduling method, device, equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a method, a device, equipment and a readable storage medium for dispatching comprehensive energy of a building group, which can carry out real-time optimized dispatching on the comprehensive energy of the target building group, thereby effectively improving the digestion capability of a comprehensive energy management system of the target building group on renewable energy sources, guaranteeing the stability and economy of power grid operation, effectively guaranteeing the comfort of users and the safety of equipment operation of each building of the target building group, and the rationality of corresponding actions of each equipment, and effectively guaranteeing the fairness and rationality of the target building group in cooperation and collaborative operation benefit distribution.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG;GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Virtual power plant alliance optimal scheduling method and system based on electric carbon certificate transaction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system optimization scheduling, in particular to a virtual power plant alliance optimization scheduling method and system based on electric carbon evidence transaction, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a virtual power plant alliance collaborative cost minimization model considering electric energy, carbon rights and green evidence multidimensional value flows; the method comprises the steps of adopting a second special ordered set to precisely linearize the ladder-type carbon price, constructing a dynamic internal collaborative green license conversion mechanism, defining electric energy transaction quantity, carbon transaction quantity and green license transaction quantity for each virtual power plant to form a multi-commodity internal market with electricity, carbon and green license coupled, adopting an asynchronous self-adaptive alternating direction multiplier method to carry out distributed solution on the inside of the alliance, and based on a collaborative game theory, fairly distributing collaborative surplus according to contribution indexes of all alliance members. The invention can obviously reduce the total operation cost and carbon emission of the virtual power plant alliance by constructing the multidimensional value flow cooperative model and the equity cost allocation mechanism, and simultaneously ensure the cost allocation fairness to maintain the alliance stable.

title_en: Meat distribution method and related equipment
