abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a meat distribution method and related equipment, belonging to the technical field of resource distribution. The method comprises the steps of obtaining current meat data, determining low-grade shops and medium-high-grade shops distribution sequences based on the to-be-distributed shops according to the current meat data, historical sorting data, shop protection data and current demand, distributing whole units of shops according to corresponding sequence sequences to obtain whole unit distribution results of the low-grade shops and the medium-high-grade shops, calculating front and rear leg scores of shops of a subdivision unit based on front and rear leg sorting data, determining low-grade shops and medium-high-grade shops subdivision distribution sequences based on front and rear leg scores and historical sorting data, and distributing the current meat data according to the low-grade and medium-high-grade shops subdivision distribution sequences to obtain the subdivision unit distribution results of the low-grade shops and the medium-high-grade shops. According to the embodiment of the application, automatic meat distribution can be realized as required, and the distribution efficiency, accuracy and fairness are improved.
assignees: GUANGZHOU QIANDAMA INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Warehouse logistics-oriented different-speed multi-AGV nerve divide-by-two scheduling method and device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of path optimization and intelligent decision making, and provides a warehouse logistics-oriented multi-AGV nerve divide-and-conquer scheduling method and device, aiming at the problems of unbalanced multi-agent collaborative heterogeneous scheduling and low efficiency in the prior art, wherein the method is implemented by constructing a MDMTSP-V problem model aiming at minimizing the maximum travel time; the method comprises the steps of designing a neural dividing and controlling framework, decomposing a warehouse logistics problem into two stages of urban allocation and sub-travel business planning and solving, constructing a neural allocation strategy network, fusing spatial characteristics and heterogeneous speed characteristics, realizing efficient and fair urban cluster division, carrying out end-to-end training on the network by adopting a reinforcement learning mechanism, optimizing an allocation strategy, and solving the sub-TSP problem of each agent by adopting a high-efficient precision algorithm. The invention combines the learning ability of the neural network with the accuracy of the classical optimization algorithm, and remarkably improves the fairness and the overall efficiency of the warehouse logistics multi-agent collaborative heterogeneous scheduling scheme.

title_en: Systems and methods for multi-vehicle resource allocation and routing solutions
abstract_en: A computer system for allocating and routing a plurality of servicing objects within a map of a region such that work load is balanced across the plurality of servicing objects is provided. The system formulates a model for allocating and routing the plurality of servicing objects in the region. The model comprises a distance matrix based upon a first plurality of segments or a second plurality of intersections in the map. The memory stores instructions for partitioning the map into a plurality of disjoint contiguous sub-regions in view of the distance matrix using an equitable convex region partition algorithm. The memory further stores instructions for calculating a corresponding tour graph for each sub-region in the plurality of sub-regions, where, for each respective sub-region in the plurality of sub-regions, a servicing object in the plurality of servicing objects is assigned to the tour graph that corresponds to the respective sub-region.
assignees: CARLSSON JOHN GUNNAR;JIN HOLLY;YE YINYU;CARDINAL OPTIMIZATION INC

title_en: Equipment acquisition and supply informatization platform system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an equipment acquisition and supply informatization platform system and a method thereof, wherein the equipment acquisition and supply informatization platform system comprises: the client-side selection module comprises a client-side selection module of a demand party and a client-side selection module of a supply party, a client registration and integrity agreement module of the demand party, a client registration and integrity agreement module of the supply party, a client-side module of the demand party and a client-side module of the supply party. The equipment procurement and supply informatization platform system and the method can greatly save time and capital cost in the procurement process, avoid the influence of artificial subjective factors on procurement affairs, realize the optimized matching of the equipment procurement scheme and the process and capacity requirements of an acquirer, improve the cost performance of equipment procurement, ensure the fairness of the procurement process for a supplier and provide a beneficial improvement method for the existing bidding degree.

title_en: Work order distribution method, device, terminal and storage medium
abstract_en: The application is applicable to the technical field of property and provides a work order distribution method, a work order distribution device, a work order distribution terminal and a storage medium. The work order distribution method specifically comprises the following steps: acquiring work order information of a work order to be distributed, wherein the work order information comprises the operation requirement of the work order to be distributed; determining the preferred staff with the first priority according to the operation requirement; generating order waiting information pointing to the preferred staff; and if the order receiving operation triggered by the preferred staff according to the order receiving information is not received, generating order information to be robbed, and distributing the order to be distributed to target staff, wherein the target staff are staff who trigger order grabbing operation according to the order information to be robbed and meet the operation requirements. The embodiment of the application can improve the efficiency and fairness of work order distribution.
assignees: SHENZHEN LONGWA NETWORK TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Distribution channel management system and method of heterogeneous cooperation platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distribution channel management system and a distribution channel management method of a heterogeneous cooperation platform. In the commodity transaction process, the management platform carries out auditing on the commodity platform through the management module, the commodity auditing module carries out auditing on the commodity platform during auditing, the commodity auditing module carries out order auditing on the commodity, the auditing content can avoid the condition of merchant bill swiping, the logistics auditing module carries out qualification auditing on the delivery logistics units, the timeliness and the safety of logistics delivery are ensured, the commodity payment is saved through the commodity payment agent module, and the fairness of the transaction of both parties is ensured.

title_en: Charging pile interface distribution method, device and system and computing equipment
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a charging pile interface distribution method, a charging pile interface distribution device, a charging pile interface distribution system and a computing device. The method comprises the steps of obtaining charging pile information and a preset request, wherein the preset request comprises vehicle identification information, charging position information, charging period information and user bidding information, and obtaining an allocation result of a charging pile interface by adopting a Wickey-Clark-Grosven auction algorithm based on the charging pile information and the preset request. The VCG auction algorithm is applied to the distribution process of the charging pile interface, so that the real bidding of new energy automobile owners is promoted, the possibility that the new energy automobile owners perform strategic manipulation or bid too much is reduced, the efficiency and fairness of the charging pile booking process are improved, social benefit is improved to the greatest extent, and the motivation of the charging pile owners to participate in sharing a charging plan is increased.

title_en: Regional intelligent education investment layout optimization method taking fairness as guiding
abstract_en: An area intelligent education investment layout optimization method taking fairness as a guide belongs to the technical field of education science. By constructing a double-layer planning model, the upper-layer model aims at minimizing the maximum OD (optical density) versus cost, optimizes government intelligent education investment allocation strategies to improve school quality and achieve fairness of education resource allocation, and the lower-layer model aims at minimizing school selection cost and simulates parents' school selection behaviors and student flow distribution conditions. The upper layer model and the lower layer model are coordinated and optimized through an interaction mechanism, and finally government resource allocation and parent demands are balanced under the balance of the Stackelberg. Based on the theory of the network game theory, the invention combines the discrete selection model and the education quality function to describe the interaction between the parent's school selecting action and the government decision, adopts the genetic algorithm to solve the optimization scheme, and improves the calculation efficiency. The method effectively solves the contradiction between fairness and efficiency in educational resource allocation, provides scientific basis for regional education policy formulation, and is suitable for educational investment optimization scenes of different scales.

title_en: Traditional Chinese medicine dispensing task allocation method and system
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a system for distributing traditional Chinese medicine dispensing tasks, which relate to the technical field of traditional Chinese medicine dispensing, and solve the problems of uneven busy and idle of a working group and low dispensing efficiency caused by sequential alternate distribution according to the quantity of traditional Chinese medicine dispensing tasks in the prior art; the preparation task is distributed to a working group with the shortest current day accumulation duration, the predicted working duration of the preparation task processed by the working group is predicted, the predicted working duration is accumulated in the current day accumulation duration of the working group, the circulation is performed, a traditional Chinese medicine prescription list can be acquired from an HIS system through accessing the HIS system of a hospital, the preparation task is automatically generated, and the preparation task is distributed to the working group with the shortest current day accumulation duration, so that the fairness and the rationality of task distribution are realized, and the efficiency is improved.

title_en: Site selection method for post-earthquake medical emergency facility
abstract_en: The invention discloses a site selection method for post-earthquake medical emergency facilities, which comprises the following steps: (1) determining candidate points of post-earthquake medical emergency facilities; (2) analyzing influence factors of optimized site selection of the post-earthquake medical emergency facilities according to the specific conditions of the areas; (3) calculating the weight of each influence factor by adopting TOPSIS; (4) establishing a basic level emergency medical facility site selection model by taking fairness, high efficiency, maximum coverage range and proper consideration of cost as targets; (5) establishing an address selection model of the post-earthquake advanced emergency medical command on the basis of the address selection model of the basic level emergency medical facility in the step (4); (6) and solving the model by adopting a nested genetic algorithm to determine a basic medical emergency facility point set and an advanced emergency medical command post. The site selection method can rapidly and scientifically determine medical emergency facility points and has great significance for reducing casualties after earthquakes.

title_en: Intelligent city carbon emission panorama management and planning system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent city management, in particular to an intelligent city carbon emission panoramic management and planning system, wherein a multi-mode behavior sensing unit collects multi-subject differentiated use behavior data of a central air conditioning system, a shared parking lot and a heating power pipe network in real time through a heterogeneous sensing network deployed on a shared facility, a dynamic emission tracing unit receives the data, a carbon flow tracing algorithm engine carries out space-time coupling calculation on total energy consumption of the shared facility to generate a multi-subject responsible carbon footprint, a responsible weight distribution unit dynamically calculates contribution degrees of all subjects by adopting a Xia Puli value-Bayesian game fusion model based on the carbon footprint, outputs a responsible allocation proportion to a block chain excitation execution unit, and the block chain excitation execution unit automatically triggers a differentiated reward and punishment mechanism according to the responsibility allocation proportion through an intelligent contract, further degrades facility use authority for a behavior abnormal subject, improves accuracy and fairness of carbon emission management and low-carbon development of a power-assisted city.

title_en: Data similarity processing method and device, storage medium and computer equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the specification provides a data similarity processing method, a data similarity processing device, a storage medium and computer equipment. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring service skill data of a plurality of service personnel; calculating the minimum editing distance between the service skill data of different service personnel; and calculating the similarity between the service skill data of different service personnel according to the minimum editing distance. In the embodiment of the description, the similarity calculated by the service skill data can be used as a distribution basis for service distribution and grouping, so that the distribution accuracy and fairness are improved, and the service processing efficiency is improved.
assignees: ALIPAY HANGZHOU INF TECH CO LTD

title_en: Thermal power and wind power combined scheduling method considering electric heating in auxiliary service market
abstract_en: The invention relates to a thermal power and wind power combined dispatching method considering electric heating in an auxiliary service market, and belongs to the technical field of electric power system operation. The method considers scheduling fairness, constructs a thermal power and wind power combined scheduling model considering electric heating in an auxiliary service market composed of a target function and constraint conditions, solves the model by adopting an interior point method, takes the obtained optimal solution as a thermal power and wind power combined scheduling parameter considering electric heating in the auxiliary service market, and performs scheduling based on the scheduling parameter. The invention fully considers the effect of the auxiliary service market, ensures fair distribution of dispatching, obtains more reasonable dispatching result and ensures safe operation of the power system.
assignees: UNIV TSINGHUA;STATE GRID JILIN ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: Method for realizing shared benefits of community resource allocation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for realizing shared equity of community resources, which is used for realizing the allocation and management of shared equity corresponding to the community resources shared by owners by monitoring the community resources shared by the owners, so as to realize the balance and management of the ownership, income and expense owned by the owners, achieve the purpose of more reasonable and more refined allocation and management of the community resources, and lighten the workload of the owners for related matters of the property. Based on the balance and expense management of the ownership, the benefits and the expenses of the owners, after the community resources are modified and the community resources are increased, the method can automatically manage according to the authorization or the agreements without increasing the workload of the owners, greatly liberates the attention of the owners to the related balances of the ownership, the benefits and the expenses, and the like, and can improve the efficiency of upgrading and modifying the community resources.
assignees: YAOLING ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE ZHEJIANG CO LTD

title_en: Multi-objective optimization-based construction industry carbon emission weight quota method
abstract_en: The invention provides a building industry carbon emission right quota method based on multi-objective optimization, which is oriented to the distribution of the carbon emission right in the building industry, fully considers the multi-objective fairness principle including equal definition, historical responsibility and payment capacity, and provides a more reasonable carbon emission right distribution scheme. Firstly, determining the total carbon quota of the construction industry; secondly, quota allocation is carried out based on a single target; finally, obtaining multi-target weight by adopting a maximum deviation method, carrying out quota allocation based on a multi-target optimized view angle, and carrying out fairness measurement by adopting a Gini coefficient method; the method can solve the problem of one-sidedness of the carbon emission right quota of the building industry aiming at a single target, and fully embodies the fairness and scientificity of the distribution scheme.

title_en: Energy distribution system and method applied to hybrid energy storage
abstract_en: The invention provides an energy distribution system and method applied to hybrid energy storage, wherein the system comprises: the first state information acquisition module is used for acquiring first state information of an energy supply end for supplying energy to the hybrid energy storage bin; an energy supply reservation opportunity determining module, configured to determine whether to enter an energy supply allocation reservation opportunity based on the first state information; the second state information acquisition module is used for acquiring second state information of an energy utilization end for energy supply of the hybrid energy storage bin if the second state information is yes; the energy supply reservation scheme making module is used for making an energy supply distribution reservation scheme based on the second state information; and the energy supply distribution control module is used for correspondingly controlling the energy supply of the hybrid energy storage bin to the energy utilization end based on an energy supply distribution reservation scheme. According to the invention, a manager does not need to determine the electric energy distribution scheme, so that the labor cost is reduced, the system automatically formulates the electric energy distribution scheme when determining to enter the energy supply distribution reservation time, and the timeliness of determining the electric energy distribution scheme is further improved.

title_en: Disaster relief material reserve warehouse location method and device based on natural disasters
abstract_en: The invention provides a disaster relief material reserve warehouse location method and device based on natural disasters, and relates to the technical field of data processing, wherein the method comprises the following steps: solving all comprehensive indexes of the region by using an entropy weight method and a geometric average model to obtain a comprehensive factor result of the region before disaster; according to the comprehensive factor results of the pre-disaster area and the risk characteristics of different disaster types, the loss of the post-disaster area is specifically analyzed; acquiring regional geographic information system data and digital elevation model data according to post-disaster analysis results, determining disaster relief material reserve library functional conditions, and distributing regional multi-level disaster relief material reserve libraries according to each level constraint relation; and selecting addresses of the regional multistage disaster relief material reserves according to city planning conditions and layout results to obtain address selection results. The invention can fully consider the comprehensive factors of the pre-disaster area and the influence of post-disaster analysis on site selection, and improve the site selection accuracy and rationality of the disaster relief material reserve warehouse.
assignees: AERO GEOPHYSICAL SURVEY AND REMOTE SENSING CENTER FOR NATURAL RESOURCES OF CHINA

title_en: Low-altitude economic trusted data processing method and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a low-altitude economy credible data processing method and a storage medium, belonging to the technical field of low-altitude economy and data element circulation. The method comprises the steps of responding to a saproli value calculation instruction, reading low-altitude data corresponding to unmanned aerial vehicles from a block chain for each unmanned aerial vehicle in a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles operating cooperatively in a low-altitude space, determining unmanned aerial vehicle contribution values of the unmanned aerial vehicles according to the low-altitude data, determining alliance contribution values according to the unmanned aerial vehicle contribution values and a first airspace openness correction factor by utilizing a target saproli formula, determining weight coefficients according to the first airspace openness correction factor and an alliance scale, determining target saproli values of the unmanned aerial vehicles according to the alliance contribution values and the weight coefficients, and distributing value to all low-altitude data for each unmanned aerial vehicle according to the target saproli values respectively corresponding to each unmanned aerial vehicle. The technical scheme of the embodiment of the invention can ensure fairness in value allocation for low-altitude data.
assignees: ISOFTSTONE DATA TECH BEIJING CO LTD

title_en: Bid evaluation integrated with bid and bid tendering Bidding system and method of (2)
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of electronic commerce and business process management, and discloses a bidding system and a bidding method integrating bidding evaluation, wherein the system and the method comprise a characteristic decoupling module for automatically disassembling each bidding document into anonymous characteristic fragments separated from the identity of the bidding person, and synchronously establishing a background internal mapping table to encrypt the tracing relation of the recording fragments; the distributed comparison module pushes anonymous feature segment pairs which come from different bidders and aim at the same bid evaluation factor to bid evaluation experts to collect binary judgment data and criterion labels, and the consensus ranking module aggregates the binary judgment data of all the experts, calculates a quality score reflecting group consensus through a probability model and combines weights to generate a preliminary total ranking. The invention realizes the closed loop of deep anonymity, objective sequencing and logic verification of the evaluation, and remarkably improves the fairness, objectivity and accuracy of the evaluation.
assignees: ZHONGCHENG ZHIXIN ENG CONSULTING GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Method, device and storage medium for evaluating and solving maximum supply capacity of power grid
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method, a device and a storage medium for evaluating and solving the maximum supply capacity of a power grid, which are applied to the technical field of operation optimization of a power system, and comprise the steps of comprehensively considering complex dynamic boundary conditions such as coupling constraint of a power transmission section, reserve capacity constraint and the like in an optimization model, so that an evaluation result is closer to the actual operation characteristic of the power grid, and the accuracy and the reliability of decision making are obviously improved; the three-objective collaborative optimization is adopted, three core elements of power supply capacity, safety margin and standby balance can be balanced, so that the final scheme is not only technically optimal, but also is fairly and reasonably fair in resource allocation, the problem that the conventional single-objective optimization causes is avoided, a series of technically optimal alternatives are generated, multidimensional fairness quantization indexes are innovatively introduced, and a complete, scientific and closed-loop decision framework from 'multi-scheme generation' to 'single-scheme preferred' is provided for a decision maker, so that the decision process is more transparent and reasonable.
assignees: NORTH CHINA BRANCH OF STATE GRID CORP OF CHINA;BEIJING TSINTERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Enforcing compute equity models in distributed blockchain
abstract_en: An example operation may include one or more of identifying a blockchain transaction submitted from a requestor member of the blockchain, identifying one or more task requests associated with the blockchain transaction, determining one or more blockchain members having resources available for completing the one or more task requests, wherein the resources are identified via known computing parameters associated with each of the one or more blockchain members, and assigning the one or more task requests to the one or more blockchain members based on the resources available.

title_en: Worker based on big data algorithm assesses labor service resource allocation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses the worker based on big data algorithm to assess labor service resource allocation method and system, comprises the following steps：A：The quality evaluation data of work amount are completed in collection management to several construction teams and groups daily, gather the attendance data of each worker in each construction teams and groups, and wherein quality evaluation data include a work post quality evaluation grade；B：Establish the quality evaluation of work amount and worker's attendance data statistical model；C：The rate of attendance that each work post quality evaluation grade corresponds to worker in statistical model is ranked up, rate of attendance sequence is worker's ability rating order corresponding to the work post.The present invention realizes one kind and worker's labour skill level can be tested and assessed, and can improve the fairness of evaluating result, helps enterprise to find the purpose that corresponding work post is adapted to the mode of the talent.
assignees: SICHUAN MIGRANT WORKER NETWORK TECH CO LTD;WANG CHENGRONG

title_en: Sample plate-based fairness automatic scheduling method
abstract_en: The invention provides a sample plate-based fairness automatic scheduling method, which is applied to a scheduling system, wherein the scheduling system comprises a server and a client, and the server is in communication connection with the client, and the method comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring a scheduling basic information set value, a shift template and shift number information, wherein the shift template comprises one or more of an individual priority shift template, an overall prohibited shift template and an individual prohibited shift template; s2, acquiring scheduling period information and staff information participating in scheduling in a corresponding period; s3, acquiring the scheduling data of the previous period and calculating the under-supplement value of the personal rest days; s4, performing automatic shift scheduling through iterative computation based on the data acquired in the steps S1-S3; and S5, generating a scheduling list according to the automatic scheduling result. The method is beneficial to reducing the labor cost required to be input during the shift arrangement and improving the efficiency of the shift arrangement management of the staff.
assignees: HAINAN NEW CONCEPT INFORMATION SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Progressive planning power grid evaluation method and system based on combination evaluation theory
abstract_en: The invention discloses a progressive planning power grid evaluation method and a system based on a combination evaluation theory, which relate to the technical field of power grid evaluation and optimization and comprise the steps of carrying out weight correction on an obtained index by adopting a combination weighting method; the method comprises the steps of obtaining an evaluation value based on a similarity theory evaluation method, carrying out standardization processing on indexes by utilizing dimensionless processing, and carrying out evaluation based on non-parameter regression. The invention ensures the objectivity and fairness of the evaluation result by a subjective and objective combination weighting method. Through a deep learning model, particularly an LSTM network and an attention mechanism, the efficiency and the accuracy of evaluation are improved. The systemization method has wide application prospect. By automatically optimizing the design of the evaluation parameters, the invention can carry out self-adaptive adjustment according to the historical data and the real-time data, so that the evaluation result is closer to the actual, and the practicability of the evaluation is improved.

title_en: Fourth logistics information platform management method and system based on block chain technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a block chain technology-based fourth logistics information platform management method and system, and relates to the technical field of fourth logistics information platforms. The system comprises a block chain fourth logistics information platform and a third-party logistics information platform; the block chain fourth logistics information platform carries out logistics information interaction with the third-party logistics information platform through the data transmission and storage module; and the third-party logistics information platform respectively transmits data with the shipper, each branch company and each client of each department of the enterprise through the data transmission module. The invention solves the problems that when a plurality of platform resources of a logistics company are distributed, the reasonability and fairness are difficult to guarantee, linear and planar information flow cannot be formed, the distribution efficiency is low, the management is difficult, the coordination is difficult and the data safety exists through the block chain fourth logistics information platform.

title_en: Material detection management system and method based on block chain technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a material detection management system and method based on a block chain technology, which comprises a service flow data acquisition layer, a detection block chain layer and a distributed storage layer; the business flow data acquisition layer comprises a detection sample collection module, a detection scheme making module, a station detection module, a detection sample returning module, a detection auditing module, a detection report generating module and a detection application layer. The invention can promote the fairness and fairness of the power grid material detection and improve the reliability of the power grid material quality.

title_en: Meter and the electric grid operating task optimization method for changing maintenance risk and waiting time
abstract_en: The invention discloses meter and the electric grid operating task optimization methods of variation maintenance risk and waiting time, belong to electric power network field.This method realizes the optimization to electric grid operating task execution sequence to reduce the expectation of grid maintenance risk of loss and operator's waiting time cost as target according to the equipment operation task and power grid real-time traffic information obtained in automated system.The present invention considers the constraint conditions such as power grid security and manpower, materials and equipment resources, can provide conductive suggestion for the operation decision of dispatcher, help to improve operation of power networks reliability and scheduling fairness, is suitable for scheduling institutions at different levels.

title_en: Order allocation method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of logistics distribution and discloses an order distribution method, device, equipment and storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: receiving an order to be distributed, and determining a longitude and latitude value corresponding to address data according to the acquired address data of the order to be distributed; clustering orders to be distributed according to the longitude and latitude values, and determining at least one order cluster; searching whether a target mesh point corresponding to the longitude and latitude value of the order cluster exists in the longitude and latitude range according to the longitude and latitude range corresponding to the preset road grid; screening available couriers from a target network according to logistics capacity information of preset couriers, and calculating order matching degree between the available couriers and an order to be distributed; and determining a target courier corresponding to the order to be distributed according to the order matching degree, and sending the order distribution result to the client of the target courier and a preset order distribution center. According to the invention, through a logistics order forward order sorting strategy, automatic sorting is carried out according to the principle of taking fairness into account in the forward direction, so that efficient assignment of orders is realized, and express receiving efficiency is improved.

title_en: Building industry carbon quota method based on fairness and efficiency
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building industry carbon quota method based on fairness and efficiency. Belongs to the technical field of carbon quota in the building industry, and comprises the following specific steps: 1. determining the total amount of carbon quota of the building industry in the target year based on the carbon emission reduction task to determine the ideal carbon emission intensity of the building industry; 2. based on fairness principles comprising three dimensions of equity, lineage and payability, after the weight of each dimension is determined by adopting MDM, initial allocation is carried out on the carbon quota of the construction industry, and an initial allocation result of the carbon quota of the construction industry based on fairness is obtained; 3. adopting a ZSG-DEA model to carry out iterative optimization on an initial allocation result based on an efficiency principle to obtain a carbon quota reallocation result of the provincial building industry; 4. and (3) carrying out fairness measure on the inter-provincial building industry carbon quota reassignment result based on a coefficient of a kene method to obtain a building industry carbon quota scheme with fairness and efficiency. The carbon quota scheme of the building industry provides possibility and theoretical basis for improving efficiency and fairness of carbon quota of industry layers of the building industry and the like.

title_en: Government work order dispatching system based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence and government service, and discloses a government work order dispatching system based on deep reinforcement learning, which comprises an agent dispatching module, a control module and a control module, wherein the agent dispatching module is used for respectively configuring deep reinforcement learning dispatching agents for a plurality of government service areas and outputting execution work order allocation and priority ordering; the system comprises a fairness monitoring module, a bias analysis module, an agent optimizing module, a collaborative scheduling and auditing module, a collaborative scheduling system and a scheduling process recording module, wherein the fairness monitoring module is used for defining and monitoring fairness indexes, the bias analysis module is used for analyzing attention patterns in scheduling decisions, identifying potential bias characteristics related to changes of the fairness indexes and quantifying the influence of the potential bias characteristics on the fairness of the scheduling, the agent optimizing module is used for optimizing the scheduling agents, the collaborative scheduling and auditing module is used for constructing a collaborative scheduling system and recording scheduling processes to form auditable logs, and the original opaque deep reinforcement learning decision process is made understandable by integrating the interpretable artificial intelligent module, so that the transparency of the scheduling decisions is improved.
assignees: JIANGSU HUIZHI INTELLIGENT DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Prior investment type performer support system
abstract_en: To provide a prior investment type performer support system which enables prior investment targeting at obtaining continuous dividends at a later date regarding a performance presented by a performer, and in which revenues are continuously distributed also to the performer.SOLUTION: A prior investment type performer support system 100 constituted communicably with viewer terminals 302 includes: an investment receiving section 12 for receiving purchase applications for dividend rights regarding revenues that are disclosed in a mode where a performance distributed ad hoc generates revenues later; and a dividend determining section 15 for determining dividends for purchasers of the dividend rights, from the revenues. The dividend determining section 15 determines a dividend on the basis of an equity rate of the dividend rights of each purchaser, in the case that a plurality of purchasers of the dividend rights exist. The equity rate of the dividend rights is determined according to a purchase counter price of the dividend rights.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Steel management system and method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of storage information management and particularly relates to a steel management system and method. The steel management system comprises a steel management server, a label printer, a communication control module and a volume detection module, wherein the label printer is connected with the steel management server through a serial connecting line, and the communication control module is connected with the steel management server through a serial port connecting line. The volume detection module is connected with the communication control module through a serial port connecting line, and is used for performing scanning detection to acquire storage situations of steel in a storage yard and transmitting the storage information to the steel management server through the communication control module. Delivering and carrying of steel can be achieved accurately as required in a real-time mode, so that the system and method has significance in production efficiency improvement, cost reduction, optimization of supply allocation, displacement and storage, and guarantee of ship delivery.

title_en: Thermal power generating unit annual electric quantity plan making method based on coefficient fairness of foundation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric power, in particular to a thermal power generating unit annual electric quantity planning method based on coefficient fairness. Comprising the following steps: constructing a thermal power unit annual electric quantity planning model objective function based on a coefficient of Kerning; constructing electric quantity fairness constraint, electric quantity balance constraint, electric quantity upper and lower limit constraint and parameter association constraint of a generator set based on a thermal power unit annual electric quantity plan of a coefficient; and solving annual planned electric quantity of each thermal power generating unit meeting the objective function and the constraint condition by adopting Cplex optimization software. The annual electric quantity of each unit is used as a decision variable, an optimization model is established, and the energy, resource consumption and pollutant emission are reduced to the greatest extent in a real sense through the optimal electric quantity distribution result; and adopting a recognized coefficient fairness index to carry out overall constraint on the power generation utilization hours of each unit, thereby obtaining a fairness allocation scheme. And the overall and various coefficient indexes of the foundation are adjusted, so that the fairness requirements of different electric quantity distribution are met.

title_en: Unit shift method based on multi-population multi-target ant colony algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a unit shift method based on a multi-population multi-target ant colony algorithm. Aiming at the defects of the existing unit shift problem model, the invention firstly considers the fairness of scheduling and the satisfaction of members from the perspective of the members of the unit, provides a double-target unit shift model, and then combines an ant colony algorithm with a multi-population multi-target framework to design an efficient multi-target ant colony algorithm. Meanwhile, the invention provides a new hybrid complementary heuristic strategy, fully utilizes heuristic information about fairness targets and satisfaction targets and integrated heuristic information, and is beneficial to comprehensively exploring the pareto frontier. In addition, the invention also provides two different types of local searches for the two targets respectively, which is helpful for improving the quality of the solution. The multi-swarm multi-objective ant colony algorithm disclosed by the invention is stable in performance on the shift problems of actual units with different scales, and a series of high-quality feasible solutions can be obtained in a short time.

title_en: Disaster relief material reserve warehouse location method and device based on natural disasters
abstract_en: The invention provides a disaster relief material reserve warehouse location method and device based on natural disasters, and relates to the technical field of data processing, wherein the method comprises the following steps: solving all comprehensive indexes of the region by using an entropy weight method and a geometric average model to obtain a comprehensive factor result of the region before disaster; according to the comprehensive factor results of the pre-disaster area and the risk characteristics of different disaster types, the loss of the post-disaster area is specifically analyzed; acquiring regional geographic information system data and digital elevation model data according to post-disaster analysis results, determining disaster relief material reserve library functional conditions, and distributing regional multi-level disaster relief material reserve libraries according to each level constraint relation; and selecting addresses of the regional multistage disaster relief material reserves according to city planning conditions and layout results to obtain address selection results. The invention can fully consider the comprehensive factors of the pre-disaster area and the influence of post-disaster analysis on site selection, and improve the site selection accuracy and rationality of the disaster relief material reserve warehouse.

title_en: A kind of emergency communication relay system based on unmanned plane
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of emergency communication relay system based on unmanned plane, including riding over the main control module being tethered on unmanned plane, the main control module is electrically connected with goods and materials and transports module, HD image transmission module, interim commander's module, receiving station, wireless transport module and energy module, the goods and materials transport module for the transport to disaster relief material, the HD image transmission module is used for the Image Real-time Transmission of disaster-stricken scene to command centre, interim commander's module sues and labours to disaster-stricken scene for commander rescuer, the receiving station instructs for summarizing disaster-stricken information and issuing to interim command centre.The present invention communicates trunking with UAV flight, it is able to achieve 30 kilometers of diameter of effective communication guarantee, communication distance is set effectively to be prolonged Shen, after communication link erects, video and speech communication obtain effective guarantee, make disaster area personnel and command scheduling personnel close ties, information that can lead to, effectively dispatch.

title_en: Emergency material storage demand calculation method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides an emergency material storage demand calculation method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The emergency material storage demand calculation method comprises the following steps: determining a function type corresponding to the emergency material according to the function attribute; the emergency materials correspond to any one of the function categories; determining an application type corresponding to the emergency materials according to the application attributes; the application category is the combination of a use object, a disaster and an application scene; the emergency materials correspond to at least one combination; and establishing a calculation matrix according to the function type corresponding to the emergency materials and the requirement standard of the application type corresponding to the emergency materials, and calculating the storage requirement result of the emergency materials. The emergency material storage demand of each department can be planned to obtain the emergency material that should be stored in each kind of calamity, each department, effectively solves the unordered problem of emergency material storage to improve the rationality of emergency material storage, and be convenient for the dispatch of emergency material to use. Can be used for guiding the overall demand calculation and reserve management of emergency supplies.
assignees: UNIVERSITY OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY BEIJING;EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT SCIENCE AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF BEIJING

title_en: Electric bus charging plan optimization method considering charging station vehicle queuing
abstract_en: The invention provides an electric bus charging plan optimization method considering charging station vehicle queuing, which belongs to the field of charging management, divides a charging station into three areas of a queuing area, a charging area and a waiting area based on actual bus charging conditions, models an electric bus queuing charging process, enables electric buses to be charged sequentially according to queuing order, and ensures fairness and rationality of electric bus charging. On the basis of the queuing of the electric buses, an electric bus ordered charging model is further established, and whether the electric buses are charged in a stopping interval of a charging station or not is decided, and the corresponding charging starting time and charging duration are determined, so that the charging cost of the electric buses and the queuing cost of the system are the lowest. And finally, integrating optimal electric bus queuing and charging information into an electric bus running diagram, providing an electric bus SOC variation and charging pile charging load variation trend diagram, and directly applying the obtained result to electric bus charging planning and arrangement to promote electric bus charging efficiency.
assignees: SICHUAN CHINA BLUE SKY ENVIRONMENTAL TECH GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Identification method for high-carbon power nodes
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for identifying high-carbon nodes of electric power, which relates to the technical field of carbon emission distribution and aims to solve the problem that the carbon emission of a novel electric power system is unfavorable for the quantitative analysis of the low-carbon characteristics and carbon emission responsibility of the electric power system, and comprises the steps of carrying out carbon flow analysis and calculation on the whole electric power system based on a carbon emission flow theory to obtain key parameters of each node; the method comprises the steps of calculating carbon emission quantity at a load side according to an output result of key parameters, calculating carbon emission responsibility allocation quantity at a system load side according to a tide and carbon flow calculation result, constructing a responsibility allocation quantity critical value according to a carbon emission responsibility allocation result and a fairness theory, and identifying high-carbon nodes according to the allocation quantity critical value. The method can make key records on the nodes with higher carbon emission responsibility or exceeding the average value, and judge the nodes as high-carbon nodes, so that a reference basis is provided for the subsequent proposal of the carbon reduction strategy, and the method is favorable for the quantitative analysis of the low-carbon characteristics and the carbon emission responsibility of the electric power system.
assignees: HUZHOU POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Company equity scheme generation method and system based on data encryption
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of financial processing and discloses a method and a system for generating a corporate equity scheme based on data encryption, wherein the method comprises the steps of identifying the work purpose of a corporate member and analyzing the distribution requirement of the corporate member by utilizing the work purpose; the method comprises the steps of analyzing member contribution degree of company members to company targets, generating member voting grades of the company members by utilizing the member contribution degree to construct an initial distribution scheme of the company, carrying out member anonymous voting on the initial distribution scheme by the company members, counting normal voting data and regret voting data in anonymous voting results, calculating self-approval degree of single person in the company members, calculating other approval degrees of single person in the company members to others, counting single person approval degrees of the company members by utilizing the member voting grades, judging whether the initial distribution scheme needs to be regulated or not, and carrying out scheme intermodulation between high approval schemes and low approval schemes to obtain an intermodulation distribution scheme. The invention can promote equity of share right distribution.
assignees: SHENZHEN OCEAN NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Irrigation area water resource optimal allocation, scheduling and control system and software
abstract_en: The invention provides a system and software for optimizing configuration, dispatching and controlling water resources in a irrigation area, comprising a water resource configuration module, a water quantity optimizing dispatching module and an operation control module, wherein the water resource configuration module is used for realizing a water resource configuration process and comprises three parts of objective function determination, model expression and model solving, and in the water quantity optimizing dispatching module, according to the water resource configuration model, water distribution quantity of each water unit in each time period is obtained after substituting time period parameters for solving, and then water quantity dispatching is carried out according to the water distribution quantity. The invention realizes the omnibearing and multilevel configuration of water resources, and realizes the accurate management of the water resources by determining reasonable objective functions, such as considering economic benefits, social benefits, natural resource balance and the like, constructing corresponding mathematical models to express the water resource configuration problem, providing a basis for solving. The objective function can reflect the demands of different benefit groups, and ensure the fairness and sustainability of water resource allocation.
assignees: HUBEI CHUYU WATER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Staff work performance grade determining method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium for determining work performance levels of employees, which comprise the steps of carrying out data processing on core business work data of each month of the employees to determine core task performance index values of each month of the employees, carrying out core business score calculation on the basis of target performance score proportion of departments where the employees are located and core task performance index values, determining core business scores of each month of the employees, carrying out score calculation on basic business data of each month of the employees to determine basic business scores of each month of the employees, adding the basic business scores and the core business scores under the same month to determine month performance scores of the employees, and carrying out performance level assessment on a plurality of month performance scores of the employees based on a normal distribution function to determine the work performance levels of the employees. The influence of subjective judgment on the evaluation result is reduced, the fairness and accuracy of performance evaluation are ensured, and the evaluation efficiency is improved.
assignees: LIVZON SANMED BIOTECH LTD;ZHUHAI HENGQIN SHENGAO YUNZHI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Heating fee charging management system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of heating fee charge management and discloses a heating fee charge management system based on the Internet of things. The system collects multidimensional energy consumption data through the user energy consumption sensing module, and heterogeneous feature fusion is carried out through the energy consumption feature analysis module to generate an energy consumption feature vector. The dynamic pricing modeling module generates a user charging weight matrix based on a space-time random forest algorithm. And constructing a double-layer optimization library of the heat source supply and user demand prediction model by the resource balance scheduling library. The intelligent charging control module generates real-time charge accounting instructions and heat source regulation and control decisions by means of a multi-task deep reinforcement learning framework. The system can also detect abnormal heat utilization behaviors and construct a heat price fluctuation prediction model. The invention realizes accurate charging and intelligent heat source scheduling, improves charging fairness and heat source utilization rate, enhances system management capability, adapts to market change, and has obvious economic benefit and practical value.
assignees: XINJIANG SHUIFA WISDOM SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Multi-dimensional dynamic elastic identification method and system for key coupling nodes of power distribution information physical system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent power grids, in particular to a multidimensional dynamic elastic identification method and system for key coupling nodes of a power distribution information physical system, wherein the system comprises a key node screening unit, a unified CPDS model is constructed, and a candidate key node set is primarily screened based on structural controllability and structural observability; the invention provides a novel CPDS key coupling node precise identification method for integrating structure controllability, structure observability, dynamic fuzzy disaster scenes, reverse reinforcement learning and shape value comprehensive calculation, which is used for improving the accuracy, fairness and adaptability of system elasticity analysis and decision making and improving the quick response and recovery capability of a power grid to disasters or attack disturbance.
assignees: STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;TIANSHUI POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_ko: Ai 부서 관리
abstract_en: It is difficult for emotional humans to determine ″work efficiency″ due to emotions. In addition, the difference between ″juniors″ and ″seniors″ is a factor that may hinder ″work fairness″. A system in which ″artificial intelligence″ capable of detecting and deploying big data in real time identifies the characteristics of ″required tasks″ in each field and places the tasks in the most appropriate departments is capable of keeping balance by preventing mutual emotional intervention. In addition, in human resources management, artificial intelligence is capable of integrating ″work abilities and directions″ for uniform talent allocation in each field. The mankind is in need of this system as a technology. Getting angry and feeling hurt in relation to artificial intelligence will disappear and work efficiency will be enhanced. Inter-department gaps will disappear and an equal organizational culture will be established.

title_en: Apparatus and method for altruistic scheduling based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to an apparatus and method of altruistic scheduling based on reinforcement learning. An altruistic scheduling apparatus according to an embodiment of the present disclosure includes: an external scheduling agent for determining a basic resource share for each process based on information of a resource management system; an internal scheduling agent for determining a basic resource allocation schedule for each process based on information including the basic resource share and a resource leftover based on the basic resource allocation schedule; and a leftover scheduling agent for determining a leftover resource allocation schedule based on information including the resource leftover. According to an embodiment of the present disclosure, it may be expected that reinforcement learning will not only mitigate the diminution of fairness of an altruistic scheduler but also further improve other performance indicators such as completion time and efficiency.

title_en: Proactive seismic rehabilitation of water pipe networks for equitable recovery
abstract_en: Systems and methods to identify a rehabilitation policy for water pipe networks are provided. A graph is built to represent a water pipe network including edges for each pipe and nodes for each water source or water user. An approach based on proximity analysis is used to determine the criticality of each node in the graph based on the spatial distribution of water demand type in the neighborhood where the node is located. The spatial variabilities of demand criticalities along with the spatial variabilities of the seismic ground motion intensities are integrated into the formulation of an optimization problem to identify rehabilitation policies the water supply network. A purpose-built simulated annealing algorithm is then used to solve the optimization problem. Results of the optimization may then be used to identify pipes in the water pipe network to replace based on a replacement budget.

title_en: Ambulance parking and locating and sizing method considering fairness
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ambulance site selection and volume determination method considering fairness, which can optimize and select ambulance docking stations and optimize the number of the ambulance docks of each docking station on the basis of the site selection of the ambulance docking stations. The system is divided into a first-aid demand coverage maximization model, an ambulance reachable fairness maximization model based on a two-step mobile search method and a multi-objective optimization model of an ambulance travel cost minimization model. And integrating a plurality of objective functions into a single objective function by using a weight coefficient method, establishing a mixed integer nonlinear programming model, solving by using a Gurobi solver, defining an input model comprising variables, constraint conditions and the objective function, outputting the solution of the model, namely the value of the variables and the optimal value of the objective function, and realizing simultaneous decision of the location and the constant volume of the ambulance stop. The method reduces the time and error of manual judgment and improves the dispatching efficiency and response speed of the ambulance.

title_en: Ship -borne scientific investigation goods and materials supervisory systems based on electron radio frequency technology
abstract_en: The utility model provides a ship -borne scientific investigation goods and materials supervisory systems based on electron radio frequency technology comprises electronic tags, wireless reading ware, industry control server, data storage server, wireless communication master, display terminal, electronic tags is corresponding to be installed on every scientific investigation goods and materials, adopts wireless reading ware can read electronic tags's data message in proper order, and this storing management information is in setting up the industry control server on the scientific investigation ship, and rethread wireless communication master can show the current goods and materials use distribution condition with data information transmission to long -range data storage server on the bank, display terminal in real time, the utility model discloses forming and adopting the modular structure design, system design is equitable, the flexibility is strong, the installation deployment is simple and convenient, and information center carries out limited supervision to scientific investigation ship guarantee goods and materials on the bank, accomplishes the purpose of scientific and reasonable management, allotment scientific investigation goods and materials.

title_en: Fair assessment method for traditional taxi and network appointment service in peak time
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fairness evaluation method for traditional taxi and network taxi appointment services in peak hours, which is characterized in that fairness in general meaning for population and employment is estimated by introducing a Lorentz curve and a Keyny coefficient, and then a mixed geographic weighted regression model and a variation coefficient are used for estimating service fairness of taxies and fairness changes caused by network taxi appointment entering under the condition of comprehensively considering resident demands and activity capacity; the combination of the two methods can effectively estimate the service fairness of the taxi in the peak period and the change of the taxi service fairness caused by the occurrence of the taxi appointment. The evaluation process is relatively simple, the result is more accurate, and certain guiding significance and reference value are provided for further traffic scheduling or market operation.

title_en: Method for investigation and dispatch of business expansion site
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of investigation dispatch, in particular to an industrial expansion field investigation dispatch method. The method and system for searching and dispatching in the field are disclosed, and the method comprises the following steps: step one: generating a reconnaissance work order; step two: acquiring unprocessed business expansion application information and real-time working state information of investigation personnel; step three: performing priority calculation on the investigation worksheets based on a dynamic priority scheduling algorithm, and sequentially dispatching the worksheets based on the priority of the investigation worksheets; step four: and selecting the investigation work order with the highest priority in the investigation work orders to be processed, matching with all the investigation personnel in an idle state by integrating the skill matching degree and the load capacity, and distributing the work order to the investigation personnel with the highest order receiving priority P2. The method can meet the service requirement and simultaneously ensure the working efficiency and fairness of the investigation personnel.
assignees: WEIHAI POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Dynamic scheduling method for emergency resources under emergency situation of reservoir dam
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic emergency resource scheduling method under a reservoir dam emergency situation, which comprises the steps of carrying out flood evolution simulation under the emergency situation, constructing a flood-road network coupling model containing road, placement points, flood flow rate and water depth information, predicting disaster victims according to situation information, calculating resource demands according to a resource demand prediction model, determining resource allocation related coefficients, introducing resource demand coefficients and disaster victimization severity coefficients, constructing an emergency resource fairness index based on a foundation coefficient, determining an optimal route from a resource storage point to the placement points, constructing an emergency resource transportation efficiency index based on the optimal route, constructing an emergency resource scheduling model by taking scheduling fairness and transportation efficiency as target functions, and obtaining a scheduling scheme under the dynamic situation by solving the scheduling model.

title_en: Improved Shapley virtual power plant multi-layer benefit distribution method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multilayer benefit distribution method for improving a Shapley virtual power plant, and belongs to the technical field of benefit distribution. The method comprises the steps of constructing a multi-layer benefit distribution framework of a virtual power plant, dividing a participating main body into a first layer core main body and a second layer subdivision main body, adopting a shape value method based on cloud center of gravity improvement for first layer distribution with a small number of main bodies, correcting the traditional shape value by introducing three correction factors of resource investment, risk bearing and emission reduction contribution, improving fairness and rationality of distribution, and adopting a hierarchical sampling shape approximation method based on reinforcement learning for second layer distribution or large-scale scenes with a large number of main bodies to perform efficient approximate calculation so as to solve the problem of 'combined explosion'. The invention realizes the fairness and efficiency balance of the benefit distribution of multiple subjects of the virtual power plant, and effectively supports the stable and sustainable development of the virtual power plant alliance.

title_en: Equitable resource access through adjudication of flight plan requests or other requests
abstract_en: A method includes obtaining information associated with requests to access at least one shared resource. The requests are associated with multiple requestors wishing to access or use the at least one shared resource. The method also includes generating at least one expected distribution of requests. The at least one expected distribution of requests defines one or more expected or desired characteristics of the requests. The method further includes granting one or more first ones of the requests in response to determining that the one or more first ones of the requests have the one or more expected or desired characteristics. In addition, the method includes denying or demoting one or more second ones of the requests in response to determining that the one or more second ones of the requests do not have the one or more expected or desired characteristics.

title_en: System and method for marketing mix optimization for brand equity management
abstract_en: A method of marketing optimization with respect to brand lifetime management formulates a problem of brand equity maximization utilizing Markov Decision Process (MDP) thereby casting brand equity management as a long term regard optimization problem in MDP, The marketing mix is optimized by formulating the mix as actions in MDP and, utilizing historical marketing and transaction data, aspects of the MDP are estimated.

title_en: Mutual assistance Project Cost settlement system, method and device
abstract_en: The application provides mutual assistance Project Cost settlement system, method and device, wherein the system comprises: equity is classified subsystem, is configured to determine that equity classification and normal distribution section corresponding relationship；Disbursement and sattlement subsystem includes: risk equity computing module, is configured as according to the participation phase time of program member and the risk Incidence calculus risk equity value of program member；Normal distribution conversion module is configured as carrying out normal distribution conversion to risk equity value；Equity grading search module is configured as retrieval normal distribution equity value and is classified in equity classification equity corresponding with normal distribution section locating in the corresponding relationship of normal distribution section；Disbursement and sattlement module is configured as carrying out disbursement and sattlement to program member according to the payment amount of money of the equity classification retrieved.The system, more rationally with fair payment amount of money, has ensured the interests of program member, the mutual assistance project for improving program member participates in experience for the different program member's setting of risk equity.

title_en: Block chain-based whole asset/commodity ownership share transaction implementation method
abstract_en: The invention provides a block chain-based method for realizing the transaction of ownership shares of an overall asset/commodity, namely a method for respectively selling the ownership of a certain overall asset/commodity according to a plurality of equal parts or unequal parts, which can greatly reduce the investment threshold, balance the investment and consumption opportunities of the overall asset/commodity, break through the situation that the investment and consumption opportunities of the original overall asset/commodity are mastered in the hands of a small number of practical people, and can benefit more investors and consumers, thereby being capable of mastering the idle overall asset/commodity which is difficult to find the investors and consumers, realizing the uplink record of the ownership and/or ownership shares of the overall asset/commodity by using a block chain technology, and realizing the uplink, distribution, uplink, distribution, uplink and/or weight share transaction record storage of the overall asset/commodity and/or the ownership shares, And inquiring, so that the authenticity, fairness and safety of investment and/or consumption are greatly improved.

title_en: Balanced and efficient water resource allocation method for large-area agricultural irrigation area coping with climate change
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for balanced and efficient allocation of water resources in a large-area agricultural irrigation area, which can cope with climate change. The method comprises the following steps: s1: collecting basic data; s2: constructing a crop water utilization efficiency function, and quantifying the crop water resource allocation in a research area; s3: constructing an economic benefit function of the crop, and quantifying the economic benefit allocation fairness based on the user jealousy value; s4: constructing a social welfare function, establishing a multi-objective optimization model, and balancing irrigation district water resource allocation efficiency and economic benefit fairness; s5: setting a model boundary; s6, constructing a Bayesian network, and determining meteorological variables influencing the runoff of the research area; s7: and constructing a multi-objective optimization model, and calculating water resource allocation data of the large-area agricultural irrigation area coping with climate change. The method gives consideration to the comprehensive effect of multiple targets, processes the economic benefit relation from the perspective of subjectivity and objectivity, and comprehensively considers the uncertainty of the influence of multiple factors on the runoff from the current situation and the future, so that the sustainable and efficient management of water resources in the irrigation area is realized.

title_en: Industrial load equal proportion-based load index distribution method and device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of electric power, and particularly relates to a load index distribution method and device based on industrial load equal proportion, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining an industrial load total value of a target area in a power limiting period, predicting the highest power consumption load according to climate parameters of the next day, and determining power supply parameters of the next day according to power sources in the target area; obtaining a power limiting load parameter based on the highest power consumption load and the power supply parameter; and distributing load indexes according to the electricity limiting load parameters and the total industrial load value, and sharing the electricity limiting indexes according to the industrial load proportion of each city, wherein the cities with high industrial loads share the electricity limiting indexes, and the cities with low industrial loads bear the electricity limiting indexes, so that the fairness of electricity limiting of the industrial loads is ensured, and the realization of the aim that civil electricity is not limited in the period of limited electricity supply capacity and intense electricity consumption is also ensured.

title_en: Digital farm autonomous system and digital farm system based on crowd-sourced dispatch
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital farm autonomous system based on crowd-sourcing scheduling, which has the characteristics that a digital farm is constructed by adopting a ternary fusion model comprising a physical space, a digital space and a value space, wherein the digital farm comprises a physical subject, a physical object, a physical resource, a physical service, a physical activity, a digital subject, a digital object, a digital resource, a digital service and a digital activity, the physical space is a real farm space distributed in various places in reality, the digital space and the value space are all operated based on a block chain data infrastructure, the physical space interacts with the digital space through wearable equipment and Internet of things equipment, and the value space is independent of the physical space and the digital space and is treated through a digital farm treatment system. In a word, the method can provide the digital farm with full-element cross-domain integration, full-process efficient collaboration, multi-subject peer-to-peer fairness and integration, green and efficient.

title_en: Fresh product periodic distribution scheduling method considering customer service fairness
abstract_en: The invention relates to a periodic fresh product distribution scheduling method considering customer service fairness, and belongs to the technical field of logistics distribution scheduling optimization. The method comprises the steps of initializing delivery vehicle data, delivery driver sets and customer sets in a delivery area, constructing a delivery network diagram by taking a delivery center and customer positions as nodes, constructing a customer perception satisfaction evaluation index system, obtaining scores of evaluation indexes of different receiving time periods, calculating comprehensive perception satisfaction scores corresponding to the receiving time periods, establishing customer service fairness indexes based on the comprehensive perception satisfaction scores of the receiving time periods, establishing a fresh product periodic delivery scheduling model with minimum delivery total energy consumption and maximum customer service fairness as targets, and adopting a genetic algorithm to calculate a fresh product periodic delivery scheduling scheme. The invention can generate a reasonable and economic distribution path scheme, effectively optimize the energy consumption cost of the distribution process and balance the fairness of customer service.

title_en: Self-adaptive optimized hospital queuing and calling system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of resource and personnel data management, in particular to a self-adaptive optimized hospital queuing and calling system.
