The system acquires illness state information of a patient and queuing number of the patient through an information acquisition module; the priority of the queuing number of the patient is obtained through an information evaluation module and classified; the longest waiting number of the high-priority number is obtained through a data processing module; and dynamically calling numbers through the comprehensive processing module. The invention comprehensively considers the illness state information and fairness of patients and the current treatment condition of hospitals, so that the system can take precedence of emergency illness patients and consider fairness of other patients, the treatment result of the system is fairer and more reasonable, medical resources are more reasonably distributed, and the satisfaction degree of patients is improved.

title_en: Air pollution collaborative emission reduction scheme optimization method based on multi-model coupling algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of atmospheric science, and discloses an optimization method of an atmospheric pollution collaborative emission reduction scheme based on a multi-model coupling algorithm, which is used for simulating a preset reference annual emission reduction scene based on a multi-scale air quality model CAMx, carrying out statistical fitting on a simulation result, and constructing a PM  2.5  emission-concentration response curved surface model; acquiring data information of all emission sources and pollutants, quantitatively analyzing emission reduction potential of the emission sources and the pollutants based on the data information, and determining an optimization interval; optimizing an emission reduction scheme of the optimization interval according to a genetic algorithm and a PM  2.5  emission-concentration response curve model; based on the optimization result, the emission reduction amounts of pollutants are respectively distributed to corresponding pollution sources to determine the optimized emission reduction scheme, the invention can construct an atmospheric pollution cooperative emission reduction scheme optimization method according to multiple models, the method realizes the transformation from 'one-cut' to fairness emission reduction, and obtains an emission reduction scheme which meets the air quality target and simultaneously gives consideration to fairness.

title_en: Method and device for deciding cross-region river water flow distribution with balanced fairness and stability
abstract_en: The invention discloses a decision method and a decision device for cross-regional river water flow distribution with balanced fairness and stability, which comprise the steps of obtaining basic information data of cross-regional river water flow distribution, adopting a bankruptcy theory rule to generate a plurality of water distribution schemes, each water distribution scheme comprises water resource shares corresponding to each regional main body respectively, respectively obtaining fairness indexes and stability indexes of each water distribution scheme based on a base index and a Charpy-Shu Bike power index, adopting a game theory method to generate a combined index of the fairness indexes and the stability indexes of each water distribution scheme, and sequencing all water distribution schemes based on the combined index to obtain an optimal water distribution scheme. On the basis of the principles of quantized fairness and stability, the method adopts a game theory method to aggregate the two, and provides a practical and feasible water allocation strategy for solving the cross-region river water allocation conflict under the water shortage situation.

title_en: Material classification side storehouse
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a material classification side storehouse, including the rectangle storehouse body with the support basis that rectangle storehouse body below set up, the storehouse body is including bulkhead and cang ding, the storehouse top sets up distributed feed mechanism, distributed feed mechanism is connected with the material hoist structure, storehouse body bottom sets up distributed discharge mechanism, the internal portion in storehouse sets up the bulkhead supporting mechanism, the internal portion in rectangle storehouse corresponds distributed feed mechanism sets up the compartment. The utility model discloses the automatic operation that can realize material storage forms the fang cangqun who neatly changes under the prerequisite that leaves equitable fire fighting passageway and facility, can accord with city planning's requirement, and passes through separate disposing compartment in the other side storehouse, and the multiple different kinds of material of being convenient for is saved simultaneously, has improved material storage's variety, and the cost has been practiced thrift in more nimble the depositing multiple material of being convenient for.
assignees: WANG YONGFAN;WANG DUO;WANG FAGANG;NANYANG TIANTAI CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Energy consumption control strategy generation method, system, device, distribution and distribution system and medium
abstract_en: The energy utilization control strategy generation method, the system, the device, the distribution and energy distribution system and the medium are applied to the distribution and energy distribution system, and the prediction renewable energy supply of each future time slot is predicted through the first predictor; obtaining time decomposition slices and corresponding slice energy requirements according to the predicted renewable energy supply and the actual energy requirements; predicting unit energy supply parameters through a second predictor, and determining a strategy threshold value of the time decomposition slice at the current time slot; energy utilization control strategies constructed by the strategy thresholds are used for controlling energy utilization; the method and the device accurately predict the renewable energy supply and the cost parameter through the predictor to construct an online optimal control strategy for obtaining the energy supply, can effectively optimize the energy utilization efficiency and cost, are favorable for promoting rationalization of energy supply allocation, are favorable for energy conservation and emission reduction, and solve the problems in the prior art.
assignees: TURING AI INST OF NANJING CO LTD

title_en: Task allocation method for introducing fairness and reducing commuting cost
abstract_en: The invention discloses a task allocation method for introducing fairness and reducing the commuting cost, and provides an allocation scheme under the condition that tasks have precedence order constraint, so that the commuting cost of personnel can be effectively reduced, and the fairness of the personnel on duty is ensured. The tasks have a precedence relationship, namely: task S i And S j If there is a precedence order (S) between them i ,S j ) Then S must be completed first i Task can start executing S j And (5) performing tasks. The problem of this application research is how effectual reduction personnel cost of commuting guarantees the task allocation problem of personnel's fairness of going on duty simultaneously under the restriction condition that the task has precedence. The algorithm designed by the application effectively saves the commuting cost of workers, can ensure the fairness of the attendance times of the workers, and can ensure that the maximum difference of the attendance times of all the workers is within a controllable range.

title_en: Electronic commerce platform equity architecture design method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electronic commerce, in particular to a method for designing a stock right architecture of an electronic commerce platform, which comprises a stock holding object module, a stock holding proportion analysis module, a stock right investment module, a stock right interest module and a stock right exit module, wherein the stock right object module is used for storing stock right information; wherein: the stock holding object module comprises a consumer, a manufacturer, an investor, a technical party, a marketer, a manager, a staff member, a starting team and a platform, and is used as a component of the stock holding object module, after a new person joins in the stock holding object module, the stock holding object module is directly input through a platform system, and then the input information is divided into corresponding modules through an automatic distribution module; in the invention, 30% of the customer consumption amount is used as equity investment to share profits and value-added wealth together, so that the customers are promoted, benefit incentive and equity guidance are provided, the trust of the customers is enhanced, the consumption of the customers can be promoted, the income of the customers can be increased while the consumption is carried out, and the development of a platform is promoted.
assignees: XIAN QIANJIUJIAREN IOT NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Instant distribution dispatch system based on multiparty fairness
abstract_en: The invention discloses an instant dispatch system based on multiparty fairness, which comprises a feature processing module, an environment simulation module and an instant dispatch module, wherein the multiparty fairness refers to a service provider or a service receiver participating in an instant dispatch platform. The characteristic processing module collects the environments of different dispatch areas, the historical order records and the fairness information of multiple parties, and corresponding characteristic information is generated through preprocessing. The environment simulation module designs a simulation environment of the timely delivery scene based on the Markov decision process. The instant dispatch module generates a set of candidate riders for each order to be assigned and constructs a status feature space and an action feature space for the set of candidate riders, generates the most appropriate candidate rider based on the input feature space and dispatches the order to the rider. The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: not only increase the total income of the bill distribution platform, but also is full ofThe order of the customer is satisfied in time, and the margin between the coefficient of the base of the rider and the profit margin of the merchant is respectively reduced And 。

title_en: Customer service scheduling optimization method, customer service scheduling optimization device, customer service scheduling optimization equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a customer service scheduling optimization method, a customer service scheduling optimization device, customer service scheduling optimization equipment and a storage medium, wherein business volume prediction information and business processing information of customer service personnel are obtained; iterating the preset scheduling optimization model according to the traffic prediction information and the traffic processing information by using a preset particle swarm optimization algorithm to obtain a customer service scheduling scheme of each iteration; calculating an objective function of customer service personnel under a customer service scheduling scheme based on a preset fatigue index model and a preset fairness index model, wherein the objective function comprises fatigue index data and fairness index data; and if the objective function reaches the minimum value, determining the corresponding customer service scheduling scheme when the objective function reaches the minimum value as a target customer service scheduling scheme. Therefore, the computer is utilized to optimize the customer service scheduling through an optimization algorithm, the scheduling efficiency is improved, fatigue and fairness are considered in an optimization model to quantify the workload of customer service staff, and the scheduling result is more reasonable.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;CUSTOMER SERVICE CENTER OF GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Internet and data processing-based heat supply network management metering and charging system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of heat supply network management, discloses a heat supply network management metering and charging system based on the Internet and data processing, and aims to solve the defects of the traditional heat supply network management system in the aspects of data acquisition, energy consumption prediction, charging processing, anomaly detection and the like. The system comprises a data acquisition unit for collecting heat supply network operation data in real time, an energy consumption prediction unit for predicting future user energy consumption by utilizing a time sequence data set training model, a charging unit for generating a heat charge bill by combining a prediction result and a user type, an anomaly detection unit for identifying data anomaly through the model and ensuring stable operation of the heat supply network, and a system optimization unit for adjusting operation parameters according to the anomaly detection result and optimizing heat supply network efficiency. The invention adopts advanced data processing technology and internet communication means, realizes high efficiency, accuracy and intellectualization of the heat supply network management, improves the accuracy of energy consumption prediction, enhances the fairness of charging processing, and ensures the safe and stable operation of the heat supply network.
assignees: HANGZHOU DONGXIAN SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD

title_en: Local area network and main network global optimal operation method, device, equipment and storage medium based on asymmetric Nash negotiation
abstract_en: The application provides a local area network and main network global optimal operation method, device and equipment based on asymmetric Nash negotiation and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of power grids. The method comprises the steps of carrying out interaction characteristic analysis of different operation modes of a local area network according to functional characteristics and structural characteristics of different types of local power grids, establishing a model for coordinated and optimized operation of the different types of local power grids and a large power grid, fully considering product quality, yield and demand response characteristics of an electric smelting magnesium enterprise, constructing a model for coordinated and optimized operation of the local power grids and the large power grid, which aims at optimizing the overall operation cost of the system, carrying out transaction on electric energy transmission between the power grids by using respective interaction cost coefficients so as to achieve global optimization of the whole system, constructing a benefit distribution model among multiple main bodies based on Nash negotiation theory, and introducing comprehensive contribution rate to quantify the bargaining capability of each main body, so that contribution of each main body is compensated, and fairness of benefit distribution is improved.

title_en: Accelerating data-driven scientific discovery
abstract_en: Techniques facilitating using a distribution system for incentivizing and accelerating data driven scientific research are described herein. The distribution system can track the input of various parties involved in scientific research, and when a reward, monetary or otherwise, is realized for one or more outcomes of the scientific research, the distribution system can distribute the reward among the parties that provided the input. The relative levels and contributions of the parties can be tracked to ensure that an equitable portioning of the reward is realized. A directed graph can be formed based on the transactions, wherein the nodes correspond to entities, researchers, publications, and the edges correspond to relationships between the entities. The directed graph can be analyzed to determine the relative or absolute levels of contributions from each of the entities, and the rewards can be distributed based on the contribution levels.

title_en: Watershed water environment capacity distribution method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a watershed water environment capacity distribution method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of water environment monitoring. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a watershed to be distributed, which needs to perform water environment capacity distribution; acquiring each control unit related to the watershed to be distributed and river reach corresponding to each control unit one by one; acquiring the maximum water environment capacity allowed to be discharged by each river reach; determining the water environment capacity allowed by the control unit corresponding to each river reach based on the maximum water environment capacity allowed to be discharged by each river reach; and correcting the water environment capacity allowed by the control unit corresponding to each river reach. In the embodiment of the application, the control units in the distribution domain are divided, the catchment range of each control unit is determined, then the maximum water environment capacity allowed to be discharged of each river reach is obtained, and then the water environment capacity allowed by the control unit corresponding to each river reach is determined and corrected, so that the objectivity and fairness of the distribution result are guaranteed.

title_en: Transaction-based big data equity sharing method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transaction-based big data equity sharing method and a transaction-based big data equity sharing system, which fully mine the value of data through valuable transactions, separate the use right, the income right and the ownership of the data, further realize the sharing of the data equity in the whole network range and provide a tamper-proof and anti-repudiation mechanism for kernel data in a system. The method comprises the steps of S1 facing data consumption requirements, calculating data use cost, S2 distributing data rights and benefits, and S3 building a tamper-proof and anti-repudiation mechanism aiming at all consumption and benefit records in a platform. The invention can eliminate the data island and avoid the occurrence of data ripening behavior on the premise of protecting the privacy of big data.

title_en: Renewable resource recovery sheet dividing method for identifying aggregation unit and gravity center region
abstract_en: The invention relates to a k-piece dividing method for identifying an aggregation unit and a working gravity center area. According to the scheme, computer simulation division is adopted, related data in the project related range is set first, and a simulation matrix map is constructed through riding distance. In the running process, the original K clusters are divided, the original point positions are scattered into K rho aggregation subunits and H discrete subunits based on the set subunit unit coefficients rho, and the non-gravity units at the edges are continuously absorbed and combined based on the gravity units until the required quantity of the integrated aggregation subunits is greater than or equal to the human effect of the subunits. And finally distributing the obtained partition division result K+H based on the scheme, wherein K is the number of aggregation subunits, and H is the number of discrete partition units. Therefore, the responsible areas of the collectors can be reasonably divided, on one hand, the workload of the collectors is basically consistent, fairness is guaranteed, on the other hand, the cells are covered as much as possible, and the minimum number of the residual discrete units is guaranteed.

title_en: Energy scheduling and trading method for interconnected micro-grid system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy scheduling and trading method of an interconnected micro-grid system, which belongs to the technical field of multi-micro-grid interconnection and comprises the following steps: and introducing power trading volume, taking the declared power trading volume of the micro-grid and the actual power trading volume as constraints, dividing the energy scheduling model into two sub-models, wherein a decision variable of a first sub-model is not coupled with a decision variable of the energy trading model, solving the energy trading model on the premise that the first sub-model is optimal, and taking one of the optimal solutions of the energy trading model as the optimal solution of a second sub-model. The invention realizes decoupling between energy scheduling and transaction decision, and can improve decision accuracy; the multi-agent deep reinforcement learning algorithm and the P2P-based Nash negotiation game solution decoupled model are adopted respectively, so that the rapid solution can be realized, the requirement of real-time decision scheduling is met, the intermittent and uncertainty of renewable energy sources can be met, the privacy of a micro-grid is protected, and the fairness of transactions is ensured.

title_en: Supply chain optimization method and system based on digital rights and interests products
abstract_en: The application relates to a supply chain optimization method and a supply chain optimization system based on digital equity products, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining the product acquisition quantity and the product verification quantity of the digital equity products, carrying out product supply planning on the digital equity products to obtain supply plan data, obtaining supply plan and supply operation data of all suppliers, carrying out supply plan matching processing on each supplier, selecting the supplier with the highest matching degree, obtaining supply plan data related to the supply plan data, analyzing the supply association relation between the supply plan data and the supply plan data, constructing a supply chain management model of the digital equity products by combining with peer marketing data of the similar products, obtaining supply performance data of each supplier in the supply process, inputting the supply performance data into the supply chain management model for supply capacity assessment, and carrying out supply optimization processing according to the assessment result. The application has the effect of improving the supply timeliness of the digital rights and interests products.

title_en: New energy permeability threshold-based self-adaptive allocation method for carbon emission responsibility of electric power system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of new energy power systems, discloses a self-adaptive allocation method of carbon emission responsibility of a power system based on a new energy permeability threshold, and provides a dynamic responsibility allocation strategy aiming at the problem that the traditional carbon emission responsibility allocation mechanism is difficult to adapt to new energy volatility and permeability change; firstly, constructing a source-load collaborative carbon emission simulation model, defining a new energy permeability threshold and a hysteresis interval, dynamically switching three modes based on a permeability real-time value, namely a power generation side full-responsibility mode, a source-load benchmark allocation mechanism and a transition interval, and secondly, constructing a multi-objective optimization model, and collaborative optimizing fairness, new energy consumption and economy. The method can reduce the carbon emission responsibility distribution deviation, improve the new energy consumption rate and reduce the system operation cost, and provides technical support for the accurate carbon responsibility distribution of the high-proportion new energy power grid.

title_en: Accelerating data-driven scientific discovery
abstract_en: Techniques facilitating using a distribution system for incentivizing and accelerating data driven scientific research are described herein. The distribution system can track the input of various parties involved in scientific research, and when a reward, monetary or otherwise, is realized for one or more outcomes of the scientific research, the distribution system can distribute the reward among the parties that provided the input. The relative levels and contributions of the parties can be tracked to ensure that an equitable portioning of the reward is realized. A directed graph can be formed based on the transactions, wherein the nodes correspond to entities, researchers, publications, and the edges correspond to relationships between the entities. The directed graph can be analyzed to determine the relative or absolute levels of contributions from each of the entities, and the rewards can be distributed based on the contribution levels.

title_en: Event prediction method and device, electronic equipment
abstract_en: This specification one or more embodiment provides a kind of event prediction method and device, electronic equipment, is applied to block chain node；The described method includes: obtain the prediction result for being directed to specified event input by participant issued on block chain, the generation moment of the input time of the prediction result earlier than the actual result of the specified event；By being compared to the prediction result with the actual result, corresponding comparison result is issued to the block chain；Call the intelligent contract that asset allocation is used in the block chain, the intelligence contract is for reading the comparison result, with according to the comparison result, object sends distribution instruction to outside chain, the distribution instruction is used to indicate the outer object of the chain and distributes equity voucher outside the first chain to the participant.

title_en: Customer service quality inspection management method, customer service quality inspection management device, customer service quality inspection equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of customer service and discloses a customer service quality inspection management method, a customer service quality inspection management device, customer service quality inspection equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring call recording data of a quality inspector; converting the call recording data into a text format capable of scoring; scoring the performance of the inspected person according to the scoring text format; and sending the evaluation to a terminal of the inspected person, judging whether complaining is carried out by the inspected person, if yes, initiating a rechecking request by the inspected person, and if not, issuing an inspected amount according to the evaluation. According to the invention, the call recording data are converted into the text format capable of being scored, so that the performance of the inspected person is scored. And a brand new calculation formula is adopted, so that more objective scoring is realized, the scoring of all the inspected persons accords with normal distribution, and fairness of quality inspection are facilitated.
assignees: SHANGHAI YUNDA HIGH TECH CO LTD

title_en: Move lot size balancing system and method
abstract_en: A method and system for allowing a vehicle dealer and manufacturer to match dealer orders and manufacturing plant shipments easily and equitably are disclosed. The method significantly decreases processing time, saving valuable time, money, and manpower resources. An automated linear expression calculation for determining and balancing vehicle allocation allows for equitable balancing of manufacturing plant orders and efficient optimization. The linear expression calculation may be performed in an iterative series of steps. The linear expression calculation handles a plurality of attribute features, thereby accommodating a plurality of dealer requests and vehicle options. The linear expression calculation creates a matrix representing the plurality of attribute features, and with each iteration the values within the matrix are refined and optimized, with the resulting matrix representing an optimized and balanced allocation of manufacturing plant production orders among a plurality of manufacturing plants.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle route distribution system based on block chain technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle route distribution system based on a block chain technology, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle company and flight routes, wherein the difficulty coefficient of the calculation puzzle is adjustable for each node aiming at the calculation puzzle of any flight route; the node solves the computational puzzle of the flight route, firstly obtains an answer, broadcasts the answer to all nodes, verifies the answer by a plurality of nodes to obtain a verified answer, generates a new block by taking identity hash of the unmanned aerial vehicle company and the flight route as transaction information, and simultaneously obtains the use right of the flight route. The freight unmanned aerial vehicle group path planning method based on the block chains realizes the decentralization of path planning by using the design mode of the block chains, simultaneously considers the principle of fairness and avoids the relative fairness and reasonableness of participants on the right of acquiring the lines.

title_en: Comprehensive distribution method for local emergency mass storage materials
abstract_en: The invention provides a comprehensive distribution method of belonged emergency mass storage materials. The method comprises the following steps: after a disaster occurs and before rear rescue goods and materials do not arrive, a target function is established based on the shortest emergency time, and a first-stage centralized many-storage-point emergency goods and materials distribution operation is carried out by utilizing a property-first-stage centralized many-storage goods and materials distribution model; collecting the emergency materials and the transport tools of all the dispersed mass storage points to the concentrated mass storage points, combining the remaining emergency materials and transport tools after the first-stage concentrated mass storage point distribution, constructing a target function based on mass storage material distribution fairness and loss minimum, and performing distribution operation of the second-stage dispersed mass storage point emergency materials by using a local two-stage dispersed mass storage material distribution model. According to the method, various practical constraints are considered, the comprehensive distribution model of the local emergency mass storage resources is constructed, a scientific and reasonable distribution scheme is generated, the rapidness and the accuracy of the comprehensive distribution of the local emergency mass storage resources are ensured, and the emergency rescue effect is improved.

title_en: Air section operation time optimization method based on fairness of airlines
abstract_en: The invention discloses an air section operation time optimization method based on fairness of an air company, which comprises the following steps: acquiring historical flight operation data information of an air section; carrying out data preprocessing on the historical flight operation data information; calculating to obtain the operation time of the air section according to the preprocessed historical flight operation data information; and optimizing the operation time of the air section according to the constraint condition and the optimization objective function to obtain the standard operation time of the air section. According to the method, on the premise that the historical operation of the flight and the application of the airlines are comprehensively considered, the fairness of the airlines is comprehensively considered, a mathematical model for optimizing the operation time of the airlines is built for the first time, the operation time of the airlines in the whole country is optimized, and a flight standard operation schedule is formulated, so that scientific basis is provided for the flight scheduling.

title_en: Case allocation method, system, medium and electronic device based on knowledge graph
abstract_en: The invention provides a case distribution method, a case distribution system, a case distribution medium and electronic equipment based on a knowledge graph, wherein the court case balanced distribution method comprises the following steps: acquiring basic information required by case distribution, and extracting judge information and case information from the basic information; constructing a knowledge graph based on the judge information and the case information; the knowledge graph comprises a plurality of nodes influencing case division and node relations; and constructing a matching function of the judge and the case based on the knowledge graph, acquiring an optimal solution of the matching function, and distributing the case based on the optimal solution. The invention optimizes case allocation in the court by constructing the knowledge map and combining integer planning, visually displays the relationship among elements influencing case allocation, improves the working quality and the working efficiency of the court, can intelligently assist and guide data processing personnel to more accurately provide main information of judges and cases, and improves the case allocation fairness and the case allocation efficiency of case allocation personnel.

title_en: SKU asset management-based cost accounting system
abstract_en: The application relates to a cost accounting system based on SKU asset management, which is applied to the technical field of asset management and comprises the steps of realizing classified management, SKU attribute definition, asset price calculation and dynamic update of assets by constructing an asset price management system based on SKU, supporting a multidimensional pricing strategy and being capable of adapting to a scene of dynamic change of the assets, and simultaneously, in the cost accounting process, different allocation modes can be adopted according to user requirements to carry out allocation instead of a simple average allocation mode, so that the fairness and flexibility of the accounting are improved.

title_en: Endocrine nursing teaching decision-making system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and provides an endocrine care teaching decision system based on deep learning, which comprises a data acquisition module, a data preprocessing module, a feature extraction module, a teaching evaluation module and a teaching decision module, wherein the teaching evaluation module introduces a fair constraint dual-BiGRU model, improves consistency and stability of teaching evaluation among different student groups through a subgroup division and fairness constraint mechanism, the teaching decision module introduces a risk perception D3QN model, builds a risk sensitive Q value function, performs segmentation weighting on teaching action return by combining a static spectrum risk measurement mechanism, optimizes decision capability and risk regulation capability of a strategy network, is particularly suitable for complex medical teaching scenes such as endocrine care, and has good fairness, self-adaptability and practicability.

title_en: Basin water resources Optimal Configuration Method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to water resource assignment technologies, and it discloses a kind of basin water resources Optimal Configuration Methods, solve each department, water section is respectively used to use water contradictory problems in shortage of water resources, realize the Water Resources Allocation of fair exploitation, efficiency and economy.Method includes the following steps: a. considers that the fairness of initial water right distribution, the efficiency of stability and the water use-right distribution of Water Resources Allocation system construct the multiple target Hierarchical decision model of Water Resources Allocation；B. multiple target Hierarchical decision model is solved, Water Resources Allocation is carried out according to solving result.The present invention is respectively from raising basin water resources distributional equity, stability and business efficiency angle, by establishing multiple target bilayer model, consider the Staenberg Game Relationship between watershed management person and partition management person, Nash Game relationship between different water-using sectors helps watershed management person to realize sustainable water resource assignment and Regional Economic Development.

title_en: Power transmission network double-layer extension planning method based on clear results of main and auxiliary energy markets
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power transmission network double-layer extension planning method based on clear results of main and auxiliary energy markets, which comprises the following steps of: constructing an upper layer objective function and an upper layer constraint condition of an upper layer planning model by taking the minimum net cost of the power distribution network within a planning year as a target; constructing a lower-layer objective function and a lower-layer constraint condition of a lower-layer main and auxiliary energy market clearing model by taking the minimum net operating cost of a typical day as a target; and equivalently converting the double-layer problem into a single-layer linear integer programming problem containing equilibrium constraint by using the KKT condition of the lower-layer main and auxiliary energy market clearing model, and solving the problem. The invention aims to provide a power transmission network double-layer expansion planning method based on clear results of main and auxiliary energy markets, so that the supply and demand balance situation of a power system is guaranteed by a reasonable power transmission network expansion scheme, the power grid blockage is reduced, and the fairness of the power market is improved.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECHNICAL RES INSTITUTE STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Method, system, device and storage medium for dynamic issuing of rights and interests products
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of information processing, and particularly relates to a method, a system, a device and a storage medium for dynamically issuing rights and interests. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring user information and inventory rights and interests product information; performing data cleaning and preprocessing on the user information and the inventory right product information to obtain a first feature set; screening the first feature set to determine an optimal feature subset; constructing a verification probability prediction model of the same equity product; classifying the inventory equity products into different distribution levels, and matching the inventory equity products into corresponding distribution levels; predicting the verification probability of different release grades by using a verification probability prediction model to obtain the probability of verifying the same equity product by a user in different expiration time periods; and sorting the verification probability, and taking out the inventory from the release grade to release to the user according to the sorting result. The method solves the problems that the product to be expired cannot be fully utilized in the prior art by dynamically issuing the strategy.
assignees: SHANDONG DINGXIN DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Cooperative-type Stackelberg game irrigation area-based water right distribution method
abstract_en: The invention provides a water right distribution method based on a cooperative type Stackelberg game irrigation district, which relates to the technical field of water resource management and distribution. In the analysis framework, the irrigated area management bureau can set related conditional risk value parameters according to the risk preference degree of the management bureau so as to balance risks with expected benefits and determine water supply prices, and the analysis framework defines a distribution rule of benefits obtained by sharing water rights by using the GNB theory so as to encourage water rights transaction among irrigation domains, thereby ensuring fairness of benefit distribution. The method can further improve the capability of the irrigation area water resource management system for coping with risks, and improve expected benefits of various participation roles under different risk avoidance levels.
assignees: TAOSHENG ENVIRONMENT TECH SHAOXING SHANGYU CO LTD;UNIV NORTH CHINA WATER RESOURCES & ELECTRIC POWER;CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Urban junction site traffic fairness and land income comprehensive evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive evaluation method and system for traffic fairness and land income of urban junction sites, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining administrative boundaries of a research area, subway sites and route data in the research area, real-time population thermodynamic data and POI data, calculating the sum of time for each subway site to reach all other subway sites, establishing a first circular buffer area and a second circular buffer area, equidistantly taking a plurality of preset points on a side line, obtaining longitude and latitude coordinates of the preset points, obtaining time and distance from each junction site to each preset point in different travel modes, calculating population data in the first circular buffer area and the second circular buffer area, screening second-hand house data in a circle layer according to the circular buffer areas, calculating land income of the first circular buffer area and the second circular buffer area, calculating POI mixing degree of each junction site, and evaluating traffic fairness and land income of the urban junction sites. The invention provides quantitative decision support for city development and promotes the collaborative development of fair allocation of traffic resources and intensive land utilization.

title_en: Systems and methods for managing physical assets across territorial boundaries
abstract_en: Systems and methods are provided for the transfer of legal control of a physical asset when the physical asset is transported across a territorial boundary. Such systems and methods facilitate the transfer of assets within a network between network participants associated with and having control over territories when an asset crosses a territorial boundary. Such a transfer allows for efficient and equitable distribution of costs, revenues, and other elements associated with movable assets among network participants in a region of control.

title_en: A kind of business model of photovoltaic generation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of business model of photovoltaic generation, it is included in the company of county-level city's establishment, the company signs roof according to enterprise and village peasant household scale and uses agreement, individually project verification is put on record, power purchase agreement is signed with national grid, the at village level booster stations of investment construction, opens up income of electricity charge account, the management work such as construction O＆M, the granting of the electricity charge of the company to power station；Including being guarded to the power station of peasant household, income of electricity charge provides the cooperative society of related service sex work, and the company signs equity cooperation agreement with cooperative society；Include the peasant household for Specialty Co-operative Organization of becoming a shareholder, the peasant household provides funds to power station, the monitoring to Built hydropower station.The present invention provides a reasonable development, rational deployment, a finance model clearly business model, power helps the development in distributed roof power station, from national policy, overall situation situation, property model calculates, and corporate boss and peasant household's degree of recognition, this business model is implemented feasible, in the sharing economy epoch, win-win cooperation is realized.

title_en: Evaluation system and method for green space service level of city park
abstract_en: The invention discloses an evaluation system and method for urban park green space service level, wherein the system comprises a basic data entry module, an index analysis module and an evaluation result generation module; the basic data entry module is used for entering factors influencing the service level of the park greenbelt, wherein the factors comprise the supply quality of the park greenbelt service, the fairness of the park greenbelt service and the satisfaction degree of urban residents; the index analysis module is used for analyzing factors influencing the service level of the park green space to obtain an analysis result; and the evaluation result generation module is used for generating an evaluation result according to the analysis result. The method generates the evaluation result of the park green space service level according to the evaluation of three dimensions of the park green space service supply quality, the park green space service fairness and the urban resident satisfaction degree, obtains the service level of the target park green space, provides a theoretical basis for planning the urban park green space, and has important significance for the fair sense of the urban resident living quality and the social resource distribution.

title_en: Smart retail marketing platform system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a smart retail marketing platform system which comprises a conversion module, an iterative optimization module, a content module, a channel integration management module, an interaction module, an event identification module, a rights and interests service module and a marketing module; according to the invention, the conversion module, the iteration optimization module, the content module, the channel integrated management module, the interaction module, the event identification module, the equity service module and the marketing module are arranged for integration, so that the operation efficiency is improved, the operation cost is reduced, the marketing benefit is improved, the channel is widened, the management of clients is regulated, and the labor cost is reduced.

title_en: Underground mining efficiency score management and excitation system based on real-time compensation settlement
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent management and compensation incentive in mining areas, in particular to an underground mining efficiency management and incentive system based on real-time compensation settlement, which optimizes a profit allocation rule through a causal inference model and dynamically adjusts weight allocation of basic profits, task rewards and rewards; meanwhile, the multi-agent reinforcement learning technology is adopted to dynamically optimize task allocation and resource scheduling, so that the maximization of the resource utilization efficiency and the task completion rate is ensured; finally, the working enthusiasm of miners and teams is comprehensively stimulated by generating a multi-level incentive strategy of personal rewards, team rewards and global rewards, so that fairness of salary distribution, diversity of incentive mechanisms and high efficiency of mining area management are realized, and mining area production benefits and miner satisfaction are effectively improved.
assignees: SHAANXI SHANMEI CAOJIATAN MINING CO LTD;CHONGQING MAS SCI & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Virtual power plant optimization method considering multiple uncertainties under electric carbon market cooperation
abstract_en: The virtual power plant optimization method taking multiple uncertainties into consideration under the cooperation of the electric and carbon markets is characterized by establishing a single virtual power plant carbon mechanism model, establishing a plurality of virtual power plant operation optimization models, establishing a plurality of virtual power plant electric and carbon cooperation transaction models, solving, and finally solving the steps. The invention can effectively overcome the influence of the uncertainty of electricity price in the electric market and the uncertainty of new energy output on the optimal scheduling of the virtual power plant, improves the stable operation capability and economic benefit of the system, builds an electric-carbon market collaborative decision mechanism, realizes electric-carbon balance and simultaneously ensures the economic low-carbon operation of the virtual power plant, builds an electric energy sharing contribution degree and carbon quota sharing contribution degree model, realizes profit distribution among members of a alliance of the virtual power plant, improves the fairness and enthusiasm of the members participating in collaborative transaction, improves the ADMM algorithm, improves the convergence speed of the ADMM by dynamically adjusting penalty factors, and reduces the influence of initial selection of penalty parameters on the algorithm performance.
assignees: UNIV SHANGHAI JIAOTONG;STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Anonymous centralized transfer or allocation of resource
abstract_en: Systems and methods for centralized transfer or allocation of resources may include receiving a first set of data describing a plurality of providing entities and an associated number of units of a resource which are available for allocation; receiving a second set of data describing a resource request associated with a requesting entity; assessing the resource request according to a set of predefined allocation criteria; determining at least two providing entities for which the resource request satisfies the set of predefined allocation criteria; and dividing the resource request across the determined set of providing entities in accordance with a fairness criterion.

title_en: Scheduling heterogeneous partitioned resources with sharing constraints
abstract_en: A system and method that provides an automated solution to obtaining quality scheduling for users of computing resources. The system, implemented in an enterprise software test center, collects information from test-shop personnel about test machine features and availability, test jobs, and tester preferences and constraints. The system reformulates this testing information as a system of constraints. An optimizing scheduling engine computes efficient schedules whereby all the jobs are feasibly scheduled while satisfying the users' time preferences to the greatest extent possible. The method and system achieves fairness: if all preferences can not be meet, it is attempted to evenly distribute violations of preferences across the users. The test scheduling is generated according to a first application of a greedy algorithm that finds an initial feasible assignment of jobs. The second is a local search algorithm that improves the initial greedy solution.

title_en: Distribution method of saving power supply electricity of balance adjusting power plant through water and electricity enrichment power grid during flood season
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of planning and scheduling operation of a power grid, and discloses a distribution method of saving power supply electricity of a balance adjusting power plant through a water and electricity enrichment power grid during a flood season which can take the fairness and economy objectives of power grid dispatching into account, realize distributing the on-grid energy of all power supplies and all power stations reasonably during the flood season aiming at the problem that the generating capacity of water and electricity enrichment power grid is increased sharply during the flood season, and guarantee fading the conflicts of interest of all parities based on the electric quantity balance. The solution is that the fairness and economy objectives of power grid dispatching are served as an optimized dispatching objective, the generating capacities of all power plants and the actual load demand on that day can be determined through a generating plan reported by all local dispatchers, the on-grid energy of all power supplies and terminal yards can be distributed according to different conditions, a weight coefficient is introduced to embody the preference of a decision maker among all sub objects in the distributing process, and a multi-objective decision is given out based on different weight coefficients. The distribution method provided by the invention has the beneficial effects of prospecting the future development of the power grid, taking fairness, economy, operability and other factors, and guaranteeing the reasonability and effectiveness of the power grid dispatching during the flood season, thereby having an important leading meaning by example.
assignees: UNIV DALIAN TECH;YUNNAN ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCH CONTROL CT

title_en: peak regulation cost allocation method and system for promoting negative standby trans-provincial and trans-provincial regulation
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for promoting peak shaving cost allocation of negative standby trans-provincial and trans-provincial dispensing, which comprise the following steps: determining the negative standby power sharing proportion of the power generation enterprises in the designated time period according to the power generation amount which is generated by the power generation enterprises in the designated time period due to insufficient peak shaving; and determining the peak purchasing auxiliary service cost allocated by the power generation enterprises according to the negative standby power allocation proportion. The technical scheme provided by the invention provides a peak shaving expense fair allocation method for promoting the negative standby trans-provincial dispatching, and provides a feasible thought for fairly, equitably and reasonably allocating peak shaving expense to each responsible party causing the negative standby requirement according to the thought of multiple power generation and multiple charge.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;SGCC EAST CHINA BRANCH;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Mining rights method and device, electronic equipment
abstract_en: This specification one or more embodiment provides a kind of mining rights method and device, electronic equipment, is applied to block chain node；The described method includes: calling for generating character string first intelligent contract, described first intelligent contract be used to generate the random character sequence for meeting preset rules for participant, and the first of the random character sequence generates second of moment earlier than the target character sequence for meeting the preset rules and generate the moment；The identity information of the random character sequence and the participant is distributed to block chain in association；Call for distributing equity voucher second intelligent contract, described second intelligent contract be used to read the random character sequence and the target character sequence, and distribute the first equity voucher to the participant in the case where the random character sequences match is in the target character sequence.

title_en: Power plant waste credible environment-friendly data processing method based on block chain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a block chain-based credible environment-friendly data processing method for power plant waste. The method realizes distributed storage of detection data such as the detection report of the waste through a block chain technology, avoids centralized and closed storage of the detection data such as the detection report, ensures fairness, justice and publicity of detection results, facilitates traceable query of the detection data of the waste of the thermal power plant, and is beneficial to the thermal power plant to improve the production mode of the thermal power plant according to historical detection results, thereby reducing the pollution index of the waste. The secondary detection process of the waste data is automatically completed by adopting an intelligent contract, so that the interference of human factors is well avoided.

title_en: Dynamic carbon emission punishment method and system for low-carbon operation of park
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic carbon emission punishment method and system for park low-carbon operation, and relates to the technical field of intelligent energy optimization scheduling, wherein the method comprises the steps of distributing quota, punishment quota, reward quota, actual carbon emission of a park and calendar history data of step unit price gradient coefficients according to the uncompensated carbon emission right of the park, and predicting and obtaining the trade cost of the dynamic punishment of the park on the same day by adopting a neural network algorithm; establishing an optimization model of daily consumption cost according to the dynamic punishment on the stepped carbon transaction cost of the park on the same day; and optimizing and solving the optimization model by using the daily consumption cost minimization as an optimization target to obtain an optimal scheduling strategy based on the dynamic carbon emission penalty. According to the invention, by dynamically predicting the carbon transaction cost of the campus in a subsection interval and combining daily consumption cost minimization as an optimization target, the penalty coefficient and the reward coefficient are adjusted, an optimal scheduling strategy based on dynamic carbon emission penalty is deduced, and the fairness and rationality of reward and punishment are improved.
assignees: TISKA SCIENCE AND TECH GROUP LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Multi-region interconnected comprehensive energy collaborative optimization operation method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-region interconnected comprehensive energy collaborative optimization operation method and system, comprising the following steps: the system comprises a multi-region interconnected system frame which is further formed by a comprehensive energy system consisting of energy supply equipment, energy coupling equipment and energy storage equipment; and a collaborative optimization operation model targeting a minimum collaborative operation cost of the multi-region interconnected integrated energy system; further, the method also comprises a bargained gain distribution model adopting a Nash-Hassay bargained gain distribution method of the cooperative game. The method effectively realizes the collaborative optimization operation of the comprehensive energy systems in a plurality of areas and the flexible resource sharing between networks, promotes the consumption of renewable energy sources, reduces the operation cost of the system and ensures the fairness and rationality of income distribution.

title_en: Electric vehicle charging station planning and site selection method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of optimal planning and address selection of electric vehicle charging stations, and particularly relates to an electric vehicle charging station planning and address selection method, which comprises the following steps of S1, constructing an uncertainty set comprising roads and node traffic capacity loss; the method comprises the steps of combining historical travel data of vehicles to construct a travel scene set of a vehicle starting point-end point, S2, constructing a network balance model considering the fairness of arrival time of electric vehicle users to solve regional traffic flow distribution aiming at the cost difference of the transit time of the electric vehicle users on a traffic channel when the electric vehicle users go to a charging station from the starting point, S3, constructing a charging station planning model considering the fairness of the arrival time of the users based on the traffic flow distribution in S2, and determining the optimal address and capacity configuration scheme of the charging station. The invention can effectively cope with the traffic uncertainty of the traffic network section, ensure the fairness of the time for the electric automobile user to reach the charging station, and has better market application prospect.

title_en: Knowledge enhancement-based multi-water source multi-target water resource allocation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a knowledge-enhanced multi-water source multi-target water resource allocation method, which is characterized in that a two-stage multi-target model integrating a knowledge graph is established, and the model considers a plurality of water sources (namely ground water, surface water, external water, reclaimed water and river water) and complies with principles of fairness, high efficiency, sustainability and systematicness. The method provided by the research aims at converting the two-stage model into the one-stage model and then solving the one-stage model. The objective function is optimized by population-based searching. Based on the improved genetic algorithm fitness function, the quality of the result is optimized while the searching efficiency of the algorithm is improved. And finally, solving the single-layer model by adopting a modified genetic algorithm, and finally, realizing reasonable and efficient distribution of water resources.

title_en: Mine ventilation system with tunnel wind flow reverse resistance increasing function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine ventilation system with a roadway wind flow reverse resistance increasing function, which comprises two groups of flow control baffle assemblies oppositely arranged in two sides of a ventilation roadway, wherein a central through air passage is formed between the two groups of flow control baffle assemblies, each group of flow control baffle assemblies comprises a plurality of flow control baffles, each flow control baffle is divided into a plurality of wide flow control baffles and a plurality of narrow flow control baffles which are alternately distributed, the inner side ends of the wide flow control baffles are connected with the corresponding side inner walls of the ventilation roadway, an air flow gap exists between the inner side ends of the narrow flow control baffles and the corresponding side inner walls of the ventilation roadway, and a bypass air passage with two ends communicated with the central through air passage is formed between any narrow flow control baffle and two wide flow control baffles adjacent to the same side. The invention can effectively solve the problems that when the thermal power disaster accident occurs, the traditional air door is in a tight state due to the negative pressure generated by the working face disaster, disaster relief materials are difficult to smoothly transport, and working face operators are difficult to open the air door to quickly escape.

title_en: Middle-aged and young employment skill assessment and promotion system for disability due to diseases
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of employment evaluation, in particular to a middle-aged and young employment skill evaluation and promotion system for disability due to diseases, which comprises the following steps: the skill assessment module is used for assessing the skill level of the middle-aged and young people suffering from disabilities; the post analysis module is used for evaluating the skills posts of the middle-aged and young people suffering from disabilities; the employment evaluation module is used for predicting employment situations of middle-aged and young people suffering from disabilities; the personal analysis module is used for finding out group characteristics of high-quality posts which are easy to obtain; the invention has the advantages of personalized analysis, improvement of post matching degree, improvement of employment prediction accuracy, optimization of resource allocation, promotion of social fairness and inclusion and the like, thereby being convenient for helping the group to better integrate into society and realizing self value; the group characteristics of the easily available high-quality posts are convenient to find, the targeted employment guidance, training and policy support are convenient to provide for the people, and the people are convenient to help the people to realize better employment and development.

title_en: Hierarchical personalized federal learning method for oilfield production prediction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hierarchical personalized federal learning method for oilfield production prediction, which relates to the technical field of petroleum engineering and artificial intelligence fusion application, and adopts a client-server architecture, wherein each oil well is used as a client. Each client independently calculates the encrypted production structure features and updates its local model with regularized optimization objectives. The central server clusters the clients based on the encrypted PSFs and coordinates a double aggregation process, wherein the double aggregation process comprises a global model fusing cross-cluster knowledge and a cluster agent model capturing personalized features in each cluster. The method not only improves the prediction accuracy of the single oil well level, but also ensures the consistency of the prediction performance of different oil wells, promotes the model prediction fairness, can effectively balance the relationship between global generalization and local individuation, does not leak data privacy information, and improves the convergence rate of the prediction model training.

title_en: Ground transportation vehicle
abstract_en: A ground transportation vehicle includes a container having a bucket, a hook, and a handle, and a suspension system connected to the container and having first and second rockers and bogies, a plurality of wheels, a plurality of wheel connectors, and one or more variable fasteners. A method of operating a ground transportation vehicle is disclosed. Embodiments of the present disclosure provide solutions to ground transportation of supplies from disaster relief distribution sites to the homes or present lodging locations of disaster victims. In particular, solutions of the present disclosure provide efficient and ergonomic ground transportation when compared to conventional techniques currently used.
assignees: OKEEFE SIENA LYN;ASIF OMERA SYED;KENNARD BENJAMIN YEHL;YANZ ANA;JOHNSON BRAEDEN ARMSTRONG;FERRELL BENJAMIN

title_en: Line loss allocation method for distributed power supply access power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a line loss allocation method for a distributed power supply to access a power distribution network, which belongs to the technical field of line loss allocation and blockchain. The method comprises the following steps of: selecting a billing person node for writing data through a POS consensus mechanism of the blockchain, verifying and confirming transaction data, and writing correct data into the blockchain; step 2: the intelligent contract calculates line self-coupling loss and mutual coupling loss caused by electric energy transaction; step 3: the intelligent contract calculates an expected line loss allocation value according to Aumann _shape method of the cooperative game; step 4: and storing a calculation model of line loss allocation after the distributed power supply is connected into the power distribution network in the intelligent contract, and automatically executing fund allocation of the line loss allocation. On the basis of cooperative game, the method has the advantages that all running processes are public and transparent, all data can be traced, and higher fairness and safety are achieved.

title_en: Method is influenced based on the newly-increased high-speed rail hinge accessibility for improving two moved further search methods
abstract_en: The high-speed rail hinge accessibility calculation method that the present invention relates to a kind of based on improved two moved furthers search method, it is a kind of based on the coefficient of variation, the high-speed rail hinge accessibility spatial distribution Equity Assessment method of Spearman rank correlation coefficient, a kind of method is influenced based on the newly-increased high-speed rail hinge accessibility for improving two moved further search methods.Present invention improves over two moved further search methods, the transportation cost of valid metric facility point and demand point, during approachability analysis, pass through the search vector of room for improvement scope, the calculation method of road situation and the attribute of search radius, so that analysis is more in line with actual conditions, the precision of accessibility measuring and calculating is improved.The present invention is while analyzing accessibility raising, the Spearman rank correlation coefficient analysis high-speed rail construction of influence with the coefficient of variation and to(for) the compartment equalization up to distribution can allow this service spatially to realize balanced distribution so that the setting of high-speed rail can either allow resident to enjoy more high-speed rail services again.

title_en: A kind of commodity panic buying request distribution method
abstract_en: Commodity panic buying request distribution method disclosed by the invention, it is related to technical field of electronic commerce, pass through the SKU according to commodity, by commodity stocks be split as multiple commodity singletons and by multiple commodity it is single-row respectively in the form of key-value store, the quantity of server is obtained from redis database, the stockpile number of each commodity singleton, calculate the commodity panic buying number of requests of each server process, number of requests is rushed to purchase according to commodity and server responds thread weight, server is redistributed for commodity panic buying request, the case where avoiding oversold and tie-in sale, it ensure that the fairness of commodity panic buying, the user experience is improved.
assignees: BEIJING SHOUQI ZHIXING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Automatic power generation control method and device based on bidding auxiliary service market
abstract_en: The invention relates to an automatic power generation control method based on a bidding auxiliary service market, and belongs to the technical field of automatic power generation control. Determining the regional regulation requirement according to the current ACE value interval of the unit and the current ACE value interval of the power grid; determining an adjusting gear of unit output and a unit participating in adjustment under the limit type according to a preset limit type, the regional adjusting requirement and a quotation interval table obtained according to the quotation sequence table of each power plant; and calculating the output instruction value of the set according to the gear to be adjusted, issuing the instruction value to the set participating in adjustment, and executing the instruction value by the set participating in adjustment. In the invention, under different periods of a heating period and a non-heating period, a dynamic upper and lower limit mode is newly added on the basis of the original upper and lower limits of remote measurement and static upper and lower limits of AGC; and providing a plurality of sets of dynamic control limit values, and calculating the active instruction value of each unit controller. And the auxiliary service market is optimized by considering bidding price and fairness principles.
assignees: STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RES INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;BEIJING KEDONG ELECTRIC POWER CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Airline-oriented air traffic delay allocation fairness index calculation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an airline-oriented method for calculating air traffic delay distribution fairness indexes, which is used for calculating the average flight delay cost of each airline company in delay distribution; calculating the proportion of the delay cost of each airline company to the sum of the delay costs of all the airlines and the proportion of the number of flights of each airline company to the total number of the flights of all the airlines; respectively calculating the accumulated delay cost proportion and the accumulated flight number proportion based on the delay cost proportion and the flight number proportion of each airline company and the sequence arranged for the airline companies; constructing a Lorentz curve, an absolute common line and an absolute unfairness line; and (4) approximately solving a fairness index result in air traffic delay distribution based on polygon segmentation. The invention realizes the quantitative calculation of fairness concept in the technical field of air traffic flow management, and the calculation method is simple and operable; the method can truly reflect the fairness level of the whole system, and fully considers the influence of each element in the system on the whole system.

title_en: Multi-objective scheduling method considering efficiency and fairness of dispatch
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-objective scheduling method considering dispatch efficiency and fairness, which considers actual needs of network points and service soldiers, considers practical feelings of each service soldier as much as possible during dispatch, takes total transportation cost as an efficiency target, takes minimization of difference of order satisfaction as fairness target, establishes a multi-objective vehicle path planning model considering fairness and distribution efficiency, obtains a solving result by utilizing an optimization algorithm, and enables a manager to formulate a reasonable dispatch scheduling scheme according to the actual needs.
assignees: RIRISHUN SUPPLY CHAIN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Comprehensive energy multi-microgrid optimal operation method considering shared energy storage capacity configuration
abstract_en: The comprehensive energy multi-microgrid optimizing operation method considering shared energy storage capacity configuration comprises the steps of designing a multi-microgrid comprehensive energy system and a multi-main-body transaction framework of shared energy storage based on a carbon quota and a carbon transaction mechanism, establishing a double-layer optimizing model, coordinating multi-layer cooperation relation between an energy storage operator and the multi-microgrid, converting double-layer Nash negotiation game problems into 3 sub-problems respectively, namely a shared energy storage and multi-microgrid cooperation alliance cost minimization sub-problem P1 and a shared energy storage and multi-microgrid income distribution sub-problem PP1 and a microgrid income distribution sub-problem PP2, solving the sub-problem P1 to obtain the shared energy storage and multi-microgrid cooperation alliance minimum cost, and solving the sub-problem PP1 and the sub-problem PP2 to obtain the total cost of the multi-microgrid and the interactive electricity price of the energy storage and the electric energy sharing price between the microgrids respectively. The method can realize reasonable configuration of energy storage resources and optimal scheduling of the multi-micro-grid system, and ensures fairness of resource utilization benefit maximization and benefit allocation among all the main bodies.
assignees: UNIV CHINA THREE GORGES CTGU;STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD EHV CO

title_en: Network vehicle dispatching method and system for introducing satisfaction degree of passenger receiving driving time
abstract_en: The invention discloses a network appointment vehicle dispatching method for introducing satisfaction degree of passenger receiving driving time, which comprises the following steps: estimating the expected receiving driving time and the actual receiving driving time of the passengers in different time space states by utilizing historical order information of the network taxi, and calculating to obtain the satisfaction degree of the receiving driving time of the passengers; according to the space-time distribution, type division is carried out on a driver group and a passenger group, a point bipartite graph with weight is constructed based on the driver type group and the passenger type group, a connecting edge exists on a passenger in a driving range of the driver, and the weight of the point is the cost required by the passenger to drive; respectively establishing linear programming for maximizing the total profits Profit of a driver and maximizing the satisfaction fairness PTSF of the passenger receiving driving time; and obtaining the fractional solutions of the two targets through offline calculation, and carrying out online order assignment by using a KIID model. The invention can effectively balance the two different targets by considering the fairness of the satisfaction degree of the receiving driving time of the passengers while considering the requirement of a driver on higher order income.

title_en: Method, server and system for managing distribution assign for each chute
title_ko: 슈트별 물류 배정을 관리하기 위한 방법, 서버 및 시스템
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present invention provide a mechanism which matches and stores a chute according to a classification code of an article, transmits chute information assigned for assigning the chute according to the classification code of the article to a direction switching device, and stops the assignment of the article to the corresponding chute if the loading amount or volume of the article of a specific chute exceeds a preset value based on received information if the loading amount or volume information of the article for each assigned chute information is received. Accordingly, the embodiment of the present invention can equally assign the article for each delivery man through article assignment stop based on the loading amount and/or volume and can reassign the article for each chute, thereby preventing the delay of logistic (article) assignment in a logistic collection process.
abstract_ko:
