본 발명의 실시예들은 물품의 분류코드별로 슈트를 매칭시켜 저장하고, 저장된 정보를 이용하여, 물품의 분류코드에 따라 슈트를 배정하기 위해 배정된 슈트 정보를 방향전환장치로 전달하며, 상기 배정된 슈트 정보별로 물품 적재량 또는 체적 정보를 수신할 경우, 상기 수신된 정보를 토대로, 특정 슈트의 물품 적재량 또는 체적이 기설정된 수치를 초과할 경우 해당 슈트로의 물품 배정을 중지하는 메카니즘을 제공한다. 
이에, 본 발명의 실시예들은 적재량 또는/및 체적에 기반하여 물품 배정 중지를 통해 공평하게 배송기사별로 물품 배정이 이루어질 수 있고, 슈트별 물품 재배정이 이루어져, 물류 집하 과정에서 물류(물품) 배정이 지체되는 것을 방지할 수 있다.

title_en: A kind of performance and equity assessment system of behavior quantization
abstract_en: The present invention provides the performance and equity assessment system of a kind of behavior quantization, include at least data acquisition module, data evaluation module, calculation processing module, data storage and display module, reminding module, information inquiry and display module, authority module and report generation module.The present invention is by data evaluation module and calculation processing module to workload, wage, attendance, ceremony, health, conduct, work performance, professional level, the length of service, educational background, academic title, technical ability, prize card, speciality, consultant, technology, resource, information, the processing of policy and equity, it can be by above-mentioned data correlation wage, bonus and option etc., the driving source and creativeness of employee can not only be excited, to realize resonating from driving and labour and capital for employee work, to eliminate shareholder's in-fighting, the control and distribution for also ensuring start-up group are weighed, to realize Enterprise Efficiency resonance and development benign cycle.
assignees: CHANGXIANG TIMES SHENZHEN CULTURAL DEV CO LTD

title_en: Fairness enhancing method for hierarchical federal learning RSU scheduling in Internet of vehicles scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fairness enhancing method for hierarchical federal learning RSU scheduling in a car networking scene, which comprises the steps of firstly, defining the car networking scene and intelligently identifying tasks; then constructing a hierarchical federation learning framework in a car networking scene, and describing a main process of participating in cloud aggregation by a vehicle user and an RSU; then, the RSU scheduling problem is converted into a multi-arm slot machine problem, the RSU is selected by using a confidence upper bound algorithm, and meanwhile, the freshness of local data is introduced to enhance the fairness of the process; finally, using Jain index, and combining classification accuracy and overall system time delay to provide comprehensive index for evaluation; the method solves the fairness problem of hierarchical federal learning RSU scheduling problem in the scene of the Internet of vehicles.
assignees: UNIV NANJING POSTS & TELECOMMUNICATIONS;JIANGSU FUTURE NETWORKS INNOVATION INST

title_en: A system and method for budget-compliant, fair and efficient manpower management
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method and system for budget-compliant, fair and efficient manpower management primarily for service industries to improve customer service, save costs, improve employee morale and productivity. More particularly the present invention relates to a system and method enabling labour planners and schedulers to rapidly develop a budget-compliant, fair, effective, easy to use and manageable and deployable manpower schedule to optimize and increase effective manpower productivity. Further the system and method of the present invention generates manpower plans and schedules suitable for deployment, on the basis of two novel criteria's a) compliance of allocations to planned labour budgets while also being driven by business forecasts and b) using several fairness" criteria so that the desirable and undesirable features of the schedules are equitably dispersed. Further, the invention provides a system which can be deployed with several optional hardware and network architecture and configuration.

title_en: Anonymous centralized transfer or allocation of resources
abstract_en: Systems and methods for centralized transfer or allocation of resources may include receiving a first set of data describing a plurality of providing entities and an associated number of units of a resource which are available for allocation; receiving a second set of data describing a resource request associated with a requesting entity; assessing the resource request according to a set of predefined allocation criteria; determining at least two providing entities for which the resource request satisfies the set of predefined allocation criteria; and dividing the resource request across the determined set of providing entities in accordance with a fairness criterion.

title_en: Shipborne unmanned aerial vehicle communication channel access method
abstract_en: The invention provides a communication channel access method for a shipborne unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises the following steps: (1) the unmanned aerial vehicle and the shipborne base station are synchronized through synchronization-reply-broadcast and obtain the whole network topology; (2) the load balance and the real-time performance of the network in the data transmission stage are ensured by a self-adaptive time slot allocation algorithm considering the network throughput, the time delay and the node fairness; (3) the coverage area of the network is increased in a node relay mode; (4) arranging a new node to enter a network through a random access time slot; the invention fully utilizes the communication channel and time resources of the shipborne unmanned aerial vehicle, and meets the communication requirements of large-scale observation such as sea surface search and rescue, scientific investigation and the like of the shipborne unmanned aerial vehicle.

title_en: Hydropower station multi-target balanced scheduling method with minimum negative externality
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-objective balanced scheduling method for a hydropower station with minimum negative externality, which comprises the steps of selecting a scheduling objective function according to actual scheduling requirements, setting constraint conditions and optimization solving parameters to construct a multi-objective optimization scheduling model, solving each non-inferior solution on the pareto front of the multi-objective optimization scheduling model based on the selected solving algorithm to obtain a non-inferior solution set, calculating the negative externality of each non-inferior solution on the pareto front by utilizing a negative externality calculation method, and taking a scheduling scheme corresponding to the non-inferior solution with the minimum negative externality on the non-inferior solution set as an optimal balanced scheduling scheme. The method has the advantages that fairness and efficiency among targets are effectively balanced, and other targets such as ecology and the like can be fairly considered while the running benefit of the hydropower station is improved. Compared with the prior art, the balanced scheduling method obviously improves the benefits and fairness of multi-objective scheduling.

title_en: AI-based dairy cow feed proportioning optimization method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of feed proportioning optimization and discloses an AI-based cow feed proportioning optimization method and system, wherein the optimization method comprises the following steps of processing cow group characteristic data through a hierarchical heterogeneous graph network construction system to generate a dynamic cow group graph network structure; the hierarchical diagram reinforcement learning system is used for processing the real-time group network state tensor to generate a multi-level feed proportioning decision scheme, and the multi-level Nash equilibrium optimization system is used for processing the multi-level decision scheme to generate an optimal feed distribution strategy table. The method obtains the optimal feed distribution strategy table by optimizing the feed proportion of the dairy cows in multiple aspects, so that the dairy cows in the modern large-scale dairy cow pasture are intelligently fed, the effects of improving the yield and promoting fairness and strong adaptation and expansion are improved.

title_en: Optimized operation control method for wind turbine generators
abstract_en: The invention provides an optimized operation control method for wind turbine generators. The method is characterized in that the power margins of the wind turbine generators are calculated based on real-time measured wind data and ultra-short-period wind power predicted data, the operation time and the shutdown time of the wind turbine generators are counted in real time, and the operation constraint conditions of the wind turbine generators and the influence of the environmental factors are taken into full account, and therefore, the alternate operation of the wind turbine generators in the wind power plant can be guaranteed under the premise of meeting the requirement of dispatching on the power output of the wind power plant by virtue of coordination between the operation queue and the shutdown queue of the wind turbine generators, and meanwhile, frequent start and stop of the wind turbine generators are avoided and the fairness of operation for each wind turbine generator is improved.
assignees: STATE GRID JILIN ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO;BEIJING SIFANG AUTOMATION CO

title_en: A kind of demand response method based on residential customer cluster in smart grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of demand response method based on residential customer cluster in smart grid, include the following steps: the history electricity consumption data for collecting residential customer；The electrical appliance model of user is established by the data of collection；The characteristic model of user is established by the data of collection；If residential customer is divided into Ganlei using clustering algorithm by the data by collection；Different satisfactions, fairness and totle drilling cost coefficient are given for different types of user, calculates total cost.The present invention considers the key factors such as electric appliance power consumption mode, power cost, user satisfaction, fairness and the energy consumption habit of residential customer, new feature is extracted from the electricity consumption historical data of residential customer to describe the feature of user, and the method for application cluster is accustomed to explore the electricity consumption of user, and the electricity consumption behavior that these information dispatch residential customer in a manner of more flexible and is effective is further used, reduce the expenditure of network system and the power peak value average ratio of power grid.

title_en: Task list distribution method, device, equipment, storage medium and program product
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a task sheet distribution method, a task sheet distribution device, electronic equipment, a computer readable storage medium and a computer program product, and relates to the technical field of computers. The method comprises the steps of obtaining task parameters of each task list in a plurality of task lists, wherein the task parameters of each task list comprise a picking path length and a picking weight of each task list, determining a target allocation strategy for allocating the plurality of task lists to a plurality of pickers based on the task parameters of each task list, and the target allocation strategy is used for indicating the corresponding relation between the task list and the pickers and the task list processing sequence corresponding to each picker. According to the method, the attribute difference between different task sheets is considered when the task sheets are distributed, so that the fairness or rationality of the task sheet distribution can be ensured, the small difference of the working intensity among different pickers is ensured, the efficiency of the in-bin picking operation is improved, and the cost of the in-bin picking operation is reduced.

title_en: Cross-regional frequency modulation clearing method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric auxiliary service, in particular to a cross-region frequency modulation clearing method and equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a frequency modulation mutual aid objective function aiming at a plurality of regions in a region; aiming at the region needing to be supported with frequency modulation resources, determining the frequency modulation capacity requirement of the region based on a unified load prediction result, determining the frequency modulation capacity gap of the region based on the sum of standard frequency modulation capacity and frequency modulation capacity requirement of the regional schedulable frequency modulation resources, constructing a cost calculation model and a fairness loss function of actual frequency modulation service, and a local resource guarantee proportion target value, and determining the optimal scheme of cross-region frequency modulation resource scheduling based on the local resource guarantee proportion target value and the frequency modulation capacity gap through the cost calculation model, the fairness loss function and a frequency modulation mutual aid objective function. Therefore, on the premise of ensuring the frequency modulation capacity requirement of the system, the optimal allocation of resources and balance of regional interests can be realized according to different scene requirements.
assignees: CENTRAL CHINA BRANCH STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Dynamic reconfigurable battery network scheduling method and system based on monomer state aggregation in module
abstract_en: A dynamic reconfigurable battery network scheduling method and system based on monomer state polymerization in a module relate to the technical field of electrochemical energy storage systems. The method comprises the steps of acquiring running state parameters of all battery monomers in a battery network, calculating at least one module-level aggregation state index for each battery module based on the state parameters of all the monomers in the battery module, calculating the scheduling urgency of each module according to the module-level aggregation state index, obtaining historical scheduling frequency of each module and calculating the scheduling fairness of each module, fusing the scheduling urgency and the scheduling fairness to obtain comprehensive scheduling priority of each module, and selecting a target module to perform cut-in or cut-out operation according to the comprehensive scheduling priority to finish the reconstruction of the battery network topology. The method is mainly used for dispatching and optimizing the single batteries of the electrochemical energy storage system.
assignees: YUNCHU NEW ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent land mineral management judging method and system based on fairness AI
abstract_en: The invention relates to the AI auxiliary field, in particular to a land mineral management intelligent arbitration method and system based on fairness AI, the method comprises the steps of collecting historical arbitration data, calculating group arbitration result difference to screen out super-threshold attribute, and determining bias factors according to policy text; preprocessing data to construct a bias-removed feature set, taking a gradient lifting tree as a framework, setting bias factors as sensitive attributes, adding statistical uniformity and equal opportunity constraint, enabling a model to depend on a core decision basis through countermeasure training, abutting real-time data after verification and optimization, and outputting decision suggestions and recording. The invention filters historical prejudices from the source, ensures the unification of the fairness and the compliance of AI arbitration, realizes the long-term maintenance of fairness, and finally achieves the unification of intelligent decision and fairness guarantee.
assignees: SHANDONG LIUNIU NETWORK TECH CO LTD;DONGPING COMPREHENSIVE ADMINISTRATIVE LAW ENFORCEMENT BUREAU

title_en: System and method for analyzing effectiveness of distributing emergency supplies in the event of disasters
abstract_en: A computer-implemented method and system in one embodiment estimate the effectiveness of a dispensing plan of emergency supplies during disasters or in like scenarios, by simulating a flow of emergency supplies in a multi-echelon supply chain, dynamics of victims and progression of disaster. The performance metrics estimated in one embodiment include, but not limited to, overall coverage of distribution, inventory of supplies (e.g., shortage and surplus) and utilization of resources (e.g., shortage and surplus).

title_en: A kind of wireless cognition network frequency spectrum access method based on two-stage poll
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of wireless cognition network frequency spectrum access method based on two-stage poll, the present invention is using two-stage polling system technology as core, to improve the availability of frequency spectrum, it is starting point to reduce user's frequency spectrum access delay, provide in cognition network after user access authorization frequency range, the preferential multiuser channel sharing policy of authorized user.Roll-call access control mode based on reservation can be prevented effectively from collision, for delay sensitive business in emergency communication, on the premise of authorized user's proper communication is ensured, only to there is the user of business demand to distribute channel, it is that cognitive user and authorized user provide QoS and ensured in terms of propagation delay time, network throughput.And sent using the information of the Method of Scheduling Parallel control cognitive user based on reservation, it can avoid conflicting and improving channel utilization, in addition, the fairness in channel between authorized user's priority and cognitive user can be effectively ensured using two-stage roll-call access control method.

title_en: Explosive flow-oriented mobile edge computing unmanned aerial vehicle cluster auxiliary communication method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mobile edge computing unmanned aerial vehicle cluster auxiliary communication method facing explosive flow, which is used for providing computing service for users with computing requirements on the ground when a network is congested; firstly, a prediction part predicts the distribution situation of the calculation demand of a target area by using an improved PSO-BP neural network, and deploys an unmanned aerial vehicle supporting mobile edge calculation according to the demand; secondly, calculating a demand partition part, partitioning a target area based on a fairness principle, and serving users in the sub-area by each unmanned aerial vehicle; and finally, the unmanned aerial vehicle energy optimization part in the sub-areas performs combined optimization on the unmanned aerial vehicle calculation frequency and the unmanned aerial vehicle flight track on the premise of meeting the user calculation requirements, so that the energy consumption of the unmanned aerial vehicle in each sub-area is minimum, the energy consumption of the whole unmanned aerial vehicle cluster is minimum, and the service duration of the cluster is prolonged.

title_en: Distribution method for urban air quality improvement target
abstract_en: The invention relates to a distribution method of an urban air quality improvement target. The influence of each factor influencing the air quality is quantified, the pollutant concentration reduction adjustment coefficient is determined, the annual mean value of the air quality improvement target of each to-be-distributed area of the assessment year is obtained, the annual mean value of the air quality improvement target of each to-be-distributed area of the assessment year is refined to be within each quarter and each month, and the environmental air quality improvement target of each assessment year can be effectively and reasonably worked out. And on the basis of fairness, the invention constructs a set of air quality improvement target distribution index system which can cover fairness, social and economic benefits, environmental benefits and ecological benefits, and overcomes the defects that the existing distribution method is mainly based on qualitative analysis and is assisted by quantification, direct connection is not established with the influence factors of atmospheric environment quality, and the rationality and fairness of the distribution result cannot be explained.

title_en: Pure electric bus network planning method considering fairness
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of urban traffic planning, and relates to a pure electric public transportation network planning method considering fairness, which comprises the following steps of obtaining site distribution and inter-site distance of a design area to obtain a road network structure diagram of the design area, constructing an objective function of a fairness model of a pure electric public transportation system with a minimum traffic coefficient as a target and an objective function of a total cost model of the pure electric public transportation network with a minimum social travel total cost as a target, further constructing a double-target nonlinear planning model of the pure electric public transportation network, setting constraint conditions of the double-target nonlinear planning model of the pure electric public transportation network by adopting an NAGS-II genetic algorithm, and solving the double-target nonlinear planning model of the pure electric public transportation network to obtain the pure electric public transportation planning network. The method reduces the traffic coefficient while minimizing the total cost of travel, effectively improves the fairness of the public transportation line network design scheme on the premise of controlling the total cost, and has important reference significance.

title_en: Energy station energy supply allocation method and equipment based on energy utilization data of preset time period
abstract_en: The invention provides an energy supply allocation method and equipment for an energy station based on energy consumption data of a preset time period. The method comprises the following steps: determining energy utilization data indexes and limiting functions of the energy utilization data indexes in a preset time period, and constructing an energy utilization data curve according to the energy utilization data indexes; constructing a polymerization degree evaluation function of the energy consumption data curve, and repeatedly polymerizing and optimizing the energy consumption data curve to obtain a plurality of polymerization schemes; if the polymerization degree evaluation function of one polymerization scheme is strictly better than that of other polymerization schemes after optimization, determining the one polymerization scheme as the final optimized polymerization scheme using the energy data curve; and determining energy production quotas of the energy stations in different time periods according to the final optimized polymerization scheme. The invention can ensure accurate energy production of the energy station, lighten the resource waste in the energy production, ensure the economical efficiency and the environmental protection of energy supply production of the energy station and finally realize the balance and the optimization of energy supply of the energy station.

title_en: Software development outsourcing control system based on block chain and implementation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a software development outsourcing control system based on a block chain and an implementation method. The system comprises: the system comprises a demand release module, a test case generation module, an intelligent contract generation module, a software running sandbox, a task generation module, a task confirmation distribution module and a block chain system; based on the characteristics of decentralized and non-falsification of the block chain technology, all nodes participate in task generation, code verification and capability scoring, the authenticity of software development outsourcing tasks, the fairness for evaluating the software quality and the authority for evaluating the software development outsourcing completion capability of a developer are improved, and the developer is effectively encouraged to improve the participation degree and the completion degree; by utilizing the characteristics of traceability and privacy protection of block chain account book data, each change of the user currency and software copyright is recorded in an encrypted manner, the currency assets and the software copyright are protected, and the data credibility is improved. The invention also discloses a realization method of the software development outsourcing control system based on the block chain.
assignees: SHANGHAI DEVELOPMENT CENTER OF COMPUTER SOFTWARE TECH

title_en: Civil aviation flight time configuration method for popular travel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a civil aviation flight time configuration method for popular travel, which comprises the steps of firstly determining a multidimensional weight system for popular travel, and calculating the weight of each flight on the dimensions of a passenger type, a flight department type, a route type and a time type according to flight time application data; then, the contribution degree of flights to popular travel is evaluated by integrating the weight of each dimension, and the weight of each flight in the shift of the flight time is determined; then, building a civil aviation flight time configuration model oriented to mass travel, aiming at minimizing the total time offset with weight and restraining the total time offset; and finally, solving the established flight time model in a Python environment by using a Gurobi solver to obtain a civil aviation flight schedule oriented to popular travel. The invention establishes the civil aviation flight time configuration model for popular travel, balances the requirements, the configuration efficiency and the fairness of popular travel, and improves the operability of the civil aviation flight time configuration.

title_en: Blocking decoupling management-based power distribution network economic dispatching method and system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the field of energy market analysis. Provided are a blocking decoupling management-based power distribution network economic dispatching method and system. The blocking decoupling management-based power distribution network economic dispatching method comprises: receiving competitive bidding information submitted by all prosumers; performing energy competitive bidding matching by means of the competitive bidding information submitted by all the prosumers; settling a result of the energy competitive bidding matching; and performing blocking management on the basis of a preset blocking management model, the blocking management model being established by settling the result of the energy competitive bidding matching. The method not only allows power distribution network operators to recover costs correctly, but also helps to motivate prosumers to perform nearby energy matching; the energy matching and decoupling dispatching of blocking management provide the prosumers with more profit room and matching opportunities while improving fairness, and greatly improve the solving efficiency of economic dispatching, thus adapting to the requirements of rapid and high-frequency economic dispatching of power distribution networks in an ultra-large-scale prosumer scenario.

title_en: Scheduling method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a scheduling method and a scheduling device, and relates to the technical field of computers. One embodiment of the method comprises the following steps: selecting an object with the smallest virtual driving accumulation value in the selectable queue for operation, and moving the object to the non-selectable queue; and updating the virtual driving accumulated value and moving the virtual driving accumulated value to an optional queue after the object operation is completed. The method and the device can solve the problems that the existing scheduling mode lacks of intelligence and fairness and brings dangerous driving side effects for a long time.

title_en: Marketing rights and interests distribution method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of financial science and technology (Fintech), and discloses a marketing equity distribution method and a marketing equity distribution device, which are used for determining whether to use an experience value of i marketing equity on the premise of holding j marketing equity according to the historical distribution condition and the historical use condition of the marketing equity; the method comprises the steps of determining a right distribution rule according to experience values of each marketing right under n marketing rights, determining the holding value of the right user to be distributed for the n marketing rights according to the right holding condition of any right user to be distributed, and determining the allocable marketing rights of all right users to be distributed in a bit operation mode according to the right distribution rule and the holding value of all right users to be distributed. Based on this approach, the outcome of the marketing equity issuance for his individual can be quickly and reasonably determined for the user.

title_en: A kind of method for allocating tasks based on setting loss person's free time
abstract_en: A kind of method for allocating tasks based on setting loss person's free time, comprises the following steps: CU client calculates the free time of corresponding setting loss person；Server arranges and sends idle time threshold；If free time reaches this threshold value, then this CU user end to server sends task requests；Server receives task requests and records the time；Server generates task requests table；Server generates work distribution chart；Task in work distribution chart is sequentially allocated to the setting loss person in task requests table by server in order；Server update task requests table and work distribution chart；The CU client of acquisition task resets and stops calculating corresponding setting loss person's free time, and task terminates rear CU client and restarts to calculate its free time.The present invention, based on setting loss person's free time, sets up task requests table by setting threshold value, it is achieved that more efficient and rational autotask distribution, adds the work incentive of setting loss person, is greatly enhanced setting loss efficiency and fairness simultaneously.
assignees: SUZHOU HYC ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Case collection prompting and case dividing method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a case collection prompting and case division method, a case collection prompting and case division device and electronic equipment, and relates to the technical field of data processing; determining the rate of money return success of the Cartesian product of a case set to be urged to be collected and an urging collector set based on a binary prediction model; determining the number of cases to be collected of each type which are to be processed by each collector in the collector collection; and determining the collector of each case to be collected based on the rate of success of refund of Cartesian product and the number of cases to be collected of each type which are processed by each collector. The method utilizes a two-classification prediction model to predict the cash recovery success rate of all the cash collection combinations, and distributes the cash collectors for each to-be-collected case by combining the prediction result and the number of each type of to-be-collected case to be processed by each cash collector, thereby ensuring the fairness of case distribution, improving the working enthusiasm of staff and relieving the technical problem of low cash recovery success rate of the cash recovery promotion method in the prior art.
assignees: HUNAN HUAWEI JINAN ENTERPRISE MAN CO LTD

title_en: Multi-energy system scheduling method considering section safety constraint and scheduling fairness
abstract_en: The application discloses a multi-energy system scheduling method considering section safety constraint and scheduling fairness, aiming at a nested and layered section structure, priority sequences from an inner layer to an outer layer are gradually searched, the maximum space of the output of a new energy station is calculated under the condition that the section does not exceed a stability limit, meanwhile, a fairness calculation method is constructed on the basis of scheduling fairness indexes, the output limited distribution scores of all power plants related under an out-of-limit section are calculated, and the fair distribution of the output limits of all wind power plants and photovoltaic power plants is guaranteed.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG;CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO

title_en: Electric vehicle charging control method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a charging control method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for an electric vehicle, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring respective historical delivery order information and charging related information of electric vehicles in a current area; determining respective charging control information of the electric vehicles based on the historical delivery order information and the charging related information; and carrying out charging control on the electric vehicle based on the charging control information. The invention can reduce the deviation of the quantity of the distribution orders among the riders in the charging control process of the electric vehicle, improve the fairness of the charging control of the electric vehicle and ensure that the riders can work in a fair environment.
assignees: SHENGDOUSHI SHANGHAI TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Performance and preference-based resource allocation method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, which can be applied to business scenes such as the financial and technological field, and discloses a resource allocation method based on performance and preference, comprising the steps of collecting performance index data of a target object in a data platform and text information in an interaction platform; the method comprises the steps of performing performance grade classification processing on target objects according to performance index data to generate performance labels containing performance grade identifiers, extracting keywords related to resource item preferences from text information, generating preference labels based on the keywords, generating distribution parameters containing resource item value weights and distribution probability weights based on the performance labels and the preference labels, executing resource distribution operation according to the distribution parameters, and outputting distribution results. According to the invention, the resource allocation is optimized by combining the performance data and the preference information, so that individuation and fairness are improved, a high-performance object can obtain more reasonable resources, and the incentive effect and allocation flexibility are improved.
assignees: PING AN INT FINANCIAL LEASING CO LTD

title_en: Systems and Methods for Multi-Vehicle Resource Allocation and Routing Solutions
abstract_en: A computer system for allocating and routing a plurality of servicing objects within a map of a region such that work load is balanced across the plurality of servicing objects is provided. The system formulates a model for allocating and routing the plurality of servicing objects in the region. The model comprises a distance matrix based upon a first plurality of segments or a second plurality of intersections in the map. The memory stores instructions for partitioning the map into a plurality of disjoint contiguous sub-regions in view of the distance matrix using an equitable convex region partition algorithm. The memory further stores instructions for calculating a corresponding tour graph for each sub-region in the plurality of sub-regions, where, for each respective sub-region in the plurality of sub-regions, a servicing object in the plurality of servicing objects is assigned to the tour graph that corresponds to the respective sub-region.

title_en: Systems and methods for multi-vehicle resource allocation and routing solutions
abstract_en: A computer system for allocating and routing a plurality of servicing objects within a map of a region such that work load is balanced across the plurality of servicing objects is provided. The system formulates a model for allocating and routing the plurality of servicing objects in the region. The model comprises a distance matrix based upon a first plurality of segments or a second plurality of intersections in the map. The memory stores instructions for partitioning the map into a plurality of disjoint contiguous sub-regions in view of the distance matrix using an equitable convex region partition algorithm. The memory further stores instructions for calculating a corresponding tour graph for each sub-region in the plurality of sub-regions, where, for each respective sub- region in the plurality of sub-regions, a servicing object in the plurality of servicing objects is assigned to the tour graph that corresponds to the respective sub-region.
assignees: CARDINAL OPTIMIZATION INC;CARLSSON JOHN;JIN HOLLY;YE YINYU

title_en: A kind of flight airdrome scene running optimizatin method considering runway mouth waiting time
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of flight airdrome scene running optimizatin methods considering runway mouth waiting time, belong to airport scene optimisation technique field.The optimization method initially sets up MAGMO models, while optimizing coasting time and the runway mouth waiting departure time；Then design RSS strategies are all flight distribution paths, and release the time to flight distribution of taking off；Simultaneously according to waiting for node allocation strategy HNAS to select the node in path for flight and distribute the stand-by period, to acquire optimal solution to the optimization of Bi-objective airdrome scene.The present invention has fully considered fairness between the priority of flight, flight, the influence to environment, it is ensured that scene flight stream it is safe, orderly and efficient；The present invention can improve entire flight stream safety, effectively avoid flight conflict to a certain extent；It prevents simultaneously since a large amount of flights fall into a long wait and bring security risk, fuel consumption, environmental pollution.

title_en: Water distribution balancing method and system for regional economic department
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water distribution balancing method and system for regional economic departments. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring supply and demand analysis data of each water main body; constructing a regional value objective function according to supply and demand analysis data; constructing a region water use fairness objective function according to supply and demand analysis data and a region value objective function; adopting a regional value objective function and a regional water use fairness objective function to construct a regional economic department water distribution balance optimization model; optimizing and solving a water distribution balance optimization model of a regional economic department by adopting a non-dominated sorting genetic algorithm with an elite strategy to obtain an optimal strategy; and realizing the space distribution of the water resource configuration result of the regional economic department according to the optimal strategy. The invention can optimize and coordinate the water consumption among industries, realize the water consumption balance among industries, reasonably allocate water quantity and provide important support for water management departments to reasonably arrange water consumption plans.

title_en: Multidimensional scheduling rationality evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The application discloses a multidimensional scheduling rationality evaluation method and system. The method comprises the following steps: calculating a plurality of corresponding rationality evaluation indexes and comprehensive evaluation indexes of the scheduling table to be evaluated; calculating to obtain a plurality of rationality evaluation indexes of each historical schedule; calculating a correlation coefficient value of each principal component influence factor corresponding to each rationality evaluation index, and obtaining a plurality of groups of predictive evaluation indexes and comprehensive predictive evaluation indexes through a neural network model; optimizing a plurality of groups of predictive evaluation indexes; calculating the personnel retention rate correlation and personnel retention rate of each optimized scheduling table; and comprehensively evaluating the optimization condition of each optimized scheduling table, and selecting the optimal scheduling table. According to the application, the comfort, the work shift fairness, the business performance and the economy of the scheduling of the staff of the call center can be analyzed through a plurality of influence factors, and compared with the existing evaluation method, the evaluation dimension is more abundant, and the scheduling rationality can be comprehensively evaluated.

title_en: Block chain-based multi-microgrid-containing power distribution system supervision and regulation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a block chain-based supervision and regulation method and system for a multi-microgrid-containing power distribution system, and belongs to the technical field of microgrid power distribution system optimization. The method comprises the steps of obtaining an electricity selling request of an electricity selling micro-grid node and an electricity purchasing request of an electricity purchasing micro-grid node in a power distribution system, wherein the electricity selling request or the electricity purchasing request is predicted based on a preset operation scheduling model; based on a preset blockchain intelligent contract, carrying out transaction matching on the electricity selling request and the electricity purchasing request to obtain a transaction scheduling scheme; and respectively sending the transaction scheduling scheme to the terminal where the electricity selling micro-grid node is located and the terminal where the electricity purchasing micro-grid node is located, and performing transaction scheduling according to the transaction scheduling scheme. The block chain architecture is combined with the power distribution system with multiple micro-networks, so that the safety of data and the fairness of a regulation and control process can be guaranteed, and the problem that each micro-network main body is not suitable for traditional centralized regulation and control and is difficult to respond to a dispatching mechanism actively is solved.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO WEIFANG POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: Water environment capacity distribution method and system suitable for cross administrative areas
abstract_en: The application provides a water environment capacity distribution method and system suitable for cross administrative areas, which comprise the steps of obtaining ground resource data basic data of each administrative area in a target area, calculating the overall water environment capacity of a river based on the ground resource data basic data, dividing three levels of indexes based on economic factors, social population factors, resources and environmental factors, establishing a index dividing system of each level of indexes, obtaining water environment capacity distribution coefficients of planning water flat year of each administrative area based on the index dividing system, and carrying out water environment capacity distribution of planning water flat year based on the overall water environment capacity of the river and the water environment capacity distribution coefficients of planning water flat year of each administrative area. The application is applicable to an index system for water environment capacity distribution of the cross-administrative areas, has the characteristics of universality, objectivity and quantification with the index system, fully considers the heterogeneity of each area, and effectively ensures the economic optimality and fairness of the water environment capacity distribution scheme of the cross-administrative areas.
assignees: SHANGHAI INVESTIGATION DESIGN & RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Grid enterprise carbon quota optimization method, system, equipment and medium based on basketball team algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a grid enterprise carbon quota optimization method, a system, equipment and a medium based on a basketball team algorithm, which relate to the technical field of intelligent optimization and comprise the steps of collecting historical carbon emission data of a grid enterprise, calculating total carbon emission, setting target carbon quota and minimum carbon quota, constructing a multi-dimensional optimization objective function, introducing rewarding and punishing mechanisms, and optimizing and solving the multidimensional optimization objective function by using a group intelligent optimization algorithm to generate a carbon quota allocation scheme, determining whether convergence conditions are met by iteratively updating the position and the speed of each candidate solution, and outputting the carbon quota allocation scheme of the global optimal position as an optimal carbon quota allocation scheme when the convergence conditions are met. The method solves the problems of local optimum and difficult coordination of multiple targets in carbon quota allocation, and remarkably improves fairness, adaptability and execution efficiency of quota allocation while guaranteeing emission reduction targets.

title_en: Apparatus for eco-friendly waste collection
title_ko: 친환경 배출물 집합 수거장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An environment-friendly discharge collection apparatus is provided to implement the fairness of the billing system and to perform charge about food waste. CONSTITUTION: A recognition unit(110) recognizes a tag(200). A screen display unit(120) outputs discharger information about recognized information. A measurement unit(130) measures the weight of food waste. A control unit(140) controls the output of billing information or measured weight information. A transmitting unit(150) transmits charging information to a server.
abstract_ko:
본 발명에 의한 친환경 배출물 집합 수거장치는 배출자에 대한 식별정보가 수록된 태그를 인식하는 인식부; 상기 인식된 정보에 해당하는 배출자 정보가 출력되는 화면표시부; 개방된 투입구로 음식물쓰레기가 유입되면 유입된 음식물쓰레기의 중량을 계측하는 계측부; 상기 계측된 중량정보 또는 이에 해당하는 과금정보가 상기 화면표시부로 출력되도록 제어하는 제어부; 및 상기 화면표시부로 출력된 중량정보 또는 과금정보에 기초하여 배출자의 제1확인신호가 입력되면 상기 중량 정보 또는 과금정보를 서버로 전송하는 전송부를 포함하여 구성된다. 
상기 본 발명에 의하면, 음식물 쓰레기 수거에 대한 과금 체계를 더욱 정확하고 객관적이며 개별적으로 운용할 수 있는 인프라를 제공할 수 있어 배출자, 수거업체, 관공서 등의 모든 행위 주체의 업무 처리에 최적화된 음식물 쓰레기 수거 시스템을 구현할 수 있다.
assignees: INFINITY TECHNOLOGY & AMP INFORMATION SYSTEMS;KIM LAE HYUN;KIM TAEK JOONG

title_en: A method, a system and computer programs, for electrical energy distribution in a peer-to-peer distributed energy network
abstract_en: The method comprises receiving, by an energy controller (100) located in a site remote from a plurality of nodes, from each partner node (200) that request to be part of a distribution of electrical energy within a network, a list including a predicted energy generation, storage and demand over a period of time, actual price for supplying and/or demanding energy, including prices to traverse an intermediary node, and energy losses that would be incurred in transferring energy to/from each partner node (200), including losses to traverse an intermediary node; and calculating, by the energy controller (100), the distribution of the energy using the information of said lists and a predefined function including maximizing a ratio of energy distributed to cost, allocating energy resources in a balanced manner based on needs of different partner nodes (200) or a combination of cost and equity.

title_en: Social equity renewable energy credit datastructures and distributed generation engine apparatuses, processes and systems
abstract_en: A system and method for energy social equity allocation using at least one memory, and at least one processor configured to issue a plurality of processor-executable instructions to obtain an energy equity participation request data structure for the benefit of an underserved community, a site data structure from an energy production site, and a purchaser request data structure from an energy consumption site. The system and method further aggregate low amounts of energy generation from multiple sites into a larger saleable quantity for a purchaser and manages the transfer of power over an electrical grid. Payment for the energy is used to provide community apportionment values to requesting communities.

title_en: Fire-fighting power supply control system with electric quantity allocation function and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting power supply control system with an electric quantity allocation function and a control method thereof, which belong to the technical field of electric quantity allocation of fire-fighting power supplies and comprise a power supply and a controller, wherein the controller comprises a data acquisition module, a fire-fighting power supply control module, a data processing unit and a dynamic power supply allocation strategy module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for collecting power supply data and fire scene data, the fire-fighting power supply control module is connected with the data acquisition module, is internally provided with a real-time data analysis algorithm and is used for receiving the data transmitted by the data acquisition module and analyzing the conditions of each area in the emergency of a fire, and the data processing unit is electrically connected with the fire-fighting power supply control module and is used for rapidly processing the output result of the real-time data analysis algorithm and identifying the key areas of fire spreading and the demand priority of fire-fighting equipment.

title_en: Rural E-commerce product quality traceability system based on double chains
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rural e-commerce product quality traceability system based on double chains, which comprises: the product information acquisition module: the system comprises a block chain link point module, a chain link point module and a chain link point module, wherein the block chain link point module is used for acquiring quality information and production place information of a product; block link point module: the product information acquisition module is used for receiving information sent by the product information acquisition module, giving time stamps to the information and signing the information to share the information; product processing monitoring module: the processing, processing and storage information for recording the product is sent to the block chain link point module; product transportation monitoring module: the system comprises a block chain link point module, a chain link point module and a chain link point module, wherein the block chain point module is used for monitoring the environment, the path and the time information of a product in the transportation process; product sales site monitoring module: and the information for recording the distribution of the transported products to different sales places is sent to the block link point module. The system solves the problems of integrity, fairness and credibility of quality safety data in a rural e-commerce product quality safety traceability system.

title_en: Marking expert extraction system based on RPA technology and black box design
abstract_en: The invention provides a marking expert extraction system based on an RPA technology and a black box design. The system comprises a black box module, an expert extraction module, a dynamic parameter adjustment module and an automatic settlement function module. The black box module ensures data safety and operation compliance through data isolation and user authority management. The expert extraction module automatically performs expert extraction, parameter configuration and notification operations using RPA techniques. The dynamic parameter adjustment module carries out intelligent prediction and simulation based on a machine learning algorithm, adjusts the extraction strategy in real time, and improves the extraction efficiency and accuracy. And the automatic settlement functional module automatically adjusts the scheme state according to expert feedback and extraction results, and optimizes the management flow. Through the cooperative work of the modules, the system realizes full automation and intellectualization of the expert extraction process, and ensures fairness and efficiency of operation.
assignees: BEIJING GUODIANTONG NETWORK TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;STATE GRID INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION CO LTD

title_en: Library seat reservation optimization method and system integrating user behaviors and situation awareness
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent libraries, in particular to a library seat reservation optimization method and system integrating user behaviors and situation awareness, wherein the method comprises the steps of firstly constructing a multi-source data fusion frame and integrating historical behavior, real-time situation and seat state data of a user; designing an Att-BiLSTM model, and dynamically predicting the occupied time length and the default probability of the user seat; finally, generating an optimal seat allocation strategy through a deep reinforcement learning decision model, integrating the user behavior and situation awareness, and based on the real desensitization data verification of the universities, the method and the system for optimizing the library seat reservation, disclosed by the invention, have the advantages that the average utilization rate of seats is improved by 18.7%, the user default rate is reduced by 15.3%, the allocation fairness and the user satisfaction are obviously improved, and a reliable technical support is provided for the intelligent management and personalized service of library space resources.

title_en: Emergency supply stockpile used for disaster relief float shelter
abstract_en: To provide a disaster relief float shelter which floats and does not submerge even if it is hit by severe flooding, can be loaded overhanging both sides of a truck cargo bed, is transported to a disaster area without any sliding or falling accidents, and is installed horizontally on an uneven ground surface and is used for medical facilities after distributing relief supplies to disaster victims.SOLUTION: A disaster relief float shelter does not submerge as the barge's oar frame of a floating structure is outfitted with waterproofing. When trucks are traveling on steep curves or rough roads, jack seat plates on both sides of a cargo bed prevent the truck from sliding sideways, thus ensuring safe transportation without causing slipping or falling accidents. When unloading the truck on uneven ground, a base jack inserted in the jack seat plate is used to adjust and install the disaster relief float shelter horizontally. After distributing relief supplies from an emergency supply stockpile to disaster victims, beds which are used also for storage shelves are removed and separated, and used as medical beds to use the disaster relief floor shelter, and the empty storage space is used by a disaster relief medical team as a medical first aid station, or a hospital room for disaster victims as a post-disaster medical base. Thus, speedy lifesaving medical activities prevent related deaths due to severe disasters.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3
assignees: DEBARI NOBUAKI;DEBARI HIROYASU;DEBARI MICHIKO;YAMAZAKI REI;YAMAZAKI MAIKO

title_en: Method and system of prioritization for managing manufacturing processes
abstract_en: A system and method are disclosed for prioritizing a plurality of lots in a manufacturing process. Portions of a priority for each lot are created. The portions are combined to form a unique range priority for each lot. The range priorities may be used to equitable compare all of the active lots in a fabrication facility. The system and method may be implemented as part of a range management system.
assignees: BURDA RICHARD G;JOSHI ASEEM K;SHIKALGAR SAMEER T;OSS SUSAN K V;VAREKAMP PATRICK R

title_en: Three-public scheduling method for considering down double-track control of electric quantity of wind power high-occupancy-ratio power grid and adjusting fairness of unit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-way dispatching method for considering down double-track control of electric quantity of a wind power high-occupancy-ratio power grid and equitable adjustment of a unit, which comprises the following steps of: s1: establishing a conventional short-term power generation planning model, and carrying out item missing analysis on the conventional short-term power generation planning model; s2: and (3) improving the conventional model by missing items: in order to ensure the consumption of wind power and promote the execution of direct trade contract as much as possible, wind power output constraint and reducible contract constraint are introduced into constraint conditions; introducing a wind curtailment penalty term and a contract reduction penalty into the objective function; s3: adding a shallow peak regulation fairness constraint: two fairness constraints of a keny coefficient and an alternate system are adopted, and a unit adjusting mechanism for ensuring the shallow peak regulation fairness in two modes is designed. The invention increases the consideration to the market part and the large-scale wind power output part on the basis of the existing power generation planning model, and can ensure the relative fairness of the part of each unit in the system participating in operation and adjusting the shallow peak regulation.

title_en: Workflow task scheduling method, multi-workflow scheduling method and system thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a workflow task scheduling method, a multi-workflow scheduling method and a system of the multi-workflow scheduling method. The task scheduling method includes the steps that firstly, the upward weight of each task in a workflow is worked out, and the tasks are put into a list of the tasks to be scheduled according to the descending order of the upward weights; secondly, the task with the largest upward weight is selected, the time when the task can be completed fastest on each processing machine is traversed, and task is deployed to the processing machine where the task is fastest completed; thirdly, other tasks are deployed to corresponding processing machines according to the sequence of the tasks in the list of the tasks to be scheduled through the method in the second step. The main principle of the multi-workflow scheduling method includes the steps that the workflow priority received in real time is compared with the priority of a workflow being scheduled, a fairness strategy or a backfill strategy is implemented according to comparison results, and then task scheduling is carried out according to the WSS strategy. Based on the cloud computing environment, multi-priority multi-workflow scheduling can be effectively carried out.

title_en: Earthquake rescue equipment material storage information system and material storage and distribution control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an earthquake rescue equipment material storage information system and a material storage and distribution control method. The information system comprises a system setting module, a basic data management module, a daily in and out of warehouse management module, an integrated query module, an earthquake rescue operation response module, an earthquake emergency rescue basic database module, a rescue equipment material distribution algorithm module, an earthquake site rescue target carrying rescue equipment expert decision module and an earthquake site rescue team operation base equipment material management module; and intelligent identification and allocation and dispatching of earthquake relief materials are achieved. According to the earthquake rescue equipment material storage information system and the material storage and distribution control method, dynamic management of earthquake rescue equipment material information can be achieved; the timeliness of counting, storing and dispatching the rescue equipment materials is improved; the management efficiency on the earthquake rescue equipment material information is improved; and a data support and a guarantee of equipment materials are provided for the rescue team.
assignees: HU WEIJIAN;NAT EARTHQUAKE RESPONSE SUPPORT SERVICE;BEIJING CHUANGYIXINGSHENG TECHNOLOGY DEV CO LTD

title_en: Task matching fairness method for large-scale taxi taking platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a task matching fairness method for a large-scale taxi taking platform, and belongs to the field of computers; the method comprises the following steps: firstly, aiming at a certain city, forming a bipartite graph by idle online drivers and unserviced orders in a taxi taking scene at a fixed time frequency; updating each side weight of the bipartite graph in the current time window; then, calculating the order matching corresponding to each online driver on the bipartite graph with updated edge weights; finally, learning the matching result of the online driver and the corresponding order, and updating the value function for the evaluation of the next time window; and meanwhile, leading idle online drivers to enter an order hot area according to the updated value function, and avoiding cold start of online learning. The invention adds a guiding strategy to dispatch the drivers to nearby grids with high value, thereby realizing fair profit of each driver; meanwhile, the fairness check is embedded into the process of finding the augmented path, and extra time complexity is not increased.

title_en: Financial automatic subsidy settlement system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a financial automatic subsidy settlement system and a financial automatic subsidy settlement method, and relates to the technical field of subsidy settlement. The financial automatic subsidy settlement system and method specifically comprises the following steps of S1, data collection and integration, S2, dynamic data updating, S3, data preprocessing, S4, bill verification and calculation, S5, coefficient calculation, S6, subsidy amount calculation, S7, auditing and approval, S8, fund payment, S9, follow-up tracking and evaluation, and through high-level informatization and flow design, the real-time data updating and verification mechanism ensures the authenticity and timeliness of subsidy basis, effectively prevents false reporting, introduces a multidimensional coefficient calculation model, not only embodies personalized care on the disability degree, household economic condition and special requirements, but also ensures fairness of subsidy distribution, and the automatic auditing and payment flow reduces manual operation.
assignees: DONGYING XINCHUANG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: New energy power system source load carbon tax allocation method based on carbon responsibility factors
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for allocating source charge carbon tax of a new energy power system based on carbon responsibility factors, which comprises the steps of S1, confirming carbon emission responsibility of a renewable energy unit based on a carbon emission flow CEF model, S2, confirming carbon emission responsibility analysis of an energy storage unit based on the carbon emission flow CEF model, S3, confirming source charge double-side carbon responsibility factors of the new energy, S4, allocating source charge double-side carbon tax in a new energy scene based on the carbon responsibility factors, namely tracking footprint of carbon flow in a power grid based on the carbon emission flow CEF model, reflecting the carbon emission responsibility of the source charge double-side carbon, and allocating carbon emission responsibility amount born by the source charge in a carbon tax form. Compared with the prior art, the method can reasonably distribute the carbon emission responsibility to the two sides of the source load containing the new energy, realizes the reasonable fairness of the carbon emission responsibility distribution of the high-proportion new energy power system, and can excite the two sides of the source load to reduce the emission in the resource optimization operation and configuration problems.

title_en: Equitable shift rotation and efficient assignment mechanisms for contact center agents
abstract_en: Systems and methods are provided for facilitating equitable assignment of rotating shifts to agents in a contact center. In one embodiment, points are allocated to agents indicating their frequency of receiving undesirable shift assignments. Based on the previously allocated points, future undesirable shifts are assigned to agents. The point allocation scheme accommodates various exceptions scheduling periodic rotating shifts, such as skipping assignment of an agent from an upcoming undesirable shift, agents leaving, swapping a shift, and agents being added. In another embodiments, agents are assigned to rotating shifts using constructs of a cycle and a rotation template, which facilitates assigning agents to a work schedule with a calendar in a repetitious manner, and where certain shifts are non-rotational in nature and other shifts are rotational in nature.

title_en: Heuristic cross shipping of disaster relief supplies at points of distribution
abstract_en: Distributing disaster relief supplies, in one aspect, may include determining cross shipping of disaster relief supplies between points of distribution using one or more combinations of information. The information may include one or more of on-hand inventory of each point of distribution, in-transit inventory to each point of distribution, demand queue of disaster victims at each point of distribution, traveling time between supply staging area and points of distribution, traveling time between points of distribution, number of transportation vehicles available for cross shipping, minimum batch size for cross shipping, frequency of cross shipping, and point of distribution activation status, or combinations thereof.

title_en: Multi-party power alliance profit allocation method considering fairness
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multiparty power alliance profit allocation method considering fairness, which comprises the steps of firstly forming an alliance by a power generation company, a power selling company and power users, constructing an alliance profit model according to the cost and profit models given by each party, setting constraints, then optimizing by utilizing a particle swarm algorithm with the aim of maximizing the alliance profit, calculating the profits of each party under the condition of maximizing the profit, finally calculating profit allocation models of each party considering contribution degree, risk degree and investment amount respectively, establishing profit correction models by utilizing a triangular fuzzy number analytic hierarchy process, and correcting the profits of each party under the condition of maximizing the alliance profit by utilizing the profit correction models. The invention comprehensively considers the functions of factors such as price factor, contribution degree, bearing risk, investment amount and the like in profit allocation, provides theoretical guidance for the formulation of profit allocation rules in the alliance, and solves the problems of vicious competition in the alliance and the problem of carrying on the free-wheeling by alliance members by considering the competitiveness of market behavior and fairness of alliance cooperation.

title_en: NCFI carbon emission responsibility allocation method and device considering fairness
abstract_en: The invention discloses an NCFI carbon emission responsibility allocation method, device, electronic equipment and readable storage medium considering fairness. The apportionment device comprises a power flow distribution acquisition module, an original apportionment result acquisition module, an apportionment fairness interval acquisition module, an original satisfaction acquisition module and a satisfaction optimization adjustment module. The satisfaction optimization and adjustment module comprises an original satisfaction calculation module, a first satisfaction optimization and adjustment module and a second satisfaction optimization and adjustment module. On one hand, the method can better link the historical emission responsibility and the individual development opportunity of the load node with the carbon emission responsibility of the node, considers the fairness on the premise of not changing the total responsibility apportionment amount, and avoids the phenomenon of lacking of fairness of the apportionment scheme; on the other hand, on the basis of reasonable and feasible apportionment results, the responsibility apportionment quantity of most load nodes is reduced, effective data support is provided for the establishment of carbon reduction strategies of enterprises, and the method has important significance on economic coordination development.
assignees: STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INSTITUTE WUHAN ENERGY EFFICIENCY EVALUATION CO LTD;STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Management system and method for teenager safety education
abstract_en: The invention discloses a management system and a management method for teenager safety education, which relate to the technical field of safety education, wherein the escape consciousness degree of each student can be identified and analyzed through personalized psychological education plan and exercise evaluation analysis, the personalized psychological education plan is provided for each student, the students are helped to strengthen self-protection consciousness, the safety consciousness and escape skills of the students can be effectively improved, the safety education scheme is continuously improved, the school is helped to improve the safety management level, the exercise effect and daily safety behaviors of the students are comprehensively evaluated, the system can help the school to know the safety condition of the students more accurately, so that the distribution of educational resources is adjusted according to the requirement, the fairness and the effectiveness of the safety education are ensured, and the system can timely dredge the emotion of the students with escape consciousness disorder through the implementation of the psychological education plan, and is helped to establish confidence and cope with emergency.
assignees: JIANGSU JIECHENG MINGDAO CULTURE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-agent cooperative grouping and profit distribution method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-agent cooperation grouping and profit distribution method, which is characterized in that an improved HCS algorithm is introduced to reasonably initialize tasks and agents, task priorities are calculated according to skill demands and predicted workload distribution, cross-task resource distribution is optimized in a competition stage combining profit prediction and cost constraint, marginal contribution of the agents is calculated based on Shapley values, profit distribution is carried out by combining dynamic excitation coefficients, profit distribution proportion is adjusted according to parameters, and after individual rationality constraint and overall profit maximization are met, iterative strategy update is carried out on formed initial grouping results until Nash equilibrium is reached. The method and the system enable the initial allocation to be intelligent, remarkably improve the resource utilization rate and the total income of the tasks based on the skill demand prediction and the workload priority, ensure the fairness and the high efficiency of the income allocation, and are suitable for industrial automation, smart cities and other scenes.

title_en: In-situ examination route generation method, examination component and examination method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an on-site examination route generation method, an examination assembly and an examination method, and relates to the technical field of on-site examination. The method has the advantages of avoiding excessive use of target points and the phenomenon of bundling students by uniformly distributing the initial examination point selection times, using a random arrangement algorithm and a selection counter, improving examination fairness, ensuring that plant types in the same examination route are not repeated by integrating plant type information of the target points, enriching examination contents and avoiding examination point repetition, realizing integrated management of generation, distribution, navigation and result processing of the examination route by combining an on-site examination component and an on-site examination method, and improving convenience and effectiveness of an examination system.

title_en: Hierarchical collaborative optimization and settlement method for large-scale industrial demand response
abstract_en: The application provides a hierarchical collaborative optimization and settlement method of a large-scale industrial demand response, which relates to the technical field of electric power systems and comprises the steps of dividing a large-scale industrial demand response resource into a plurality of levels and constructing an optimization model, decomposing a global optimization problem into local sub-problems, defining a consistency variable constraint global consistency, generating a dispatching instruction through iterative computation, responding to the dispatching instruction to acquire actual response data, performing hash operation and digital signature processing on the actual response data to generate a signature abstract, verifying the signature abstract by using an intelligent contract, performing real-time settlement after verification to obtain real-time settlement data, and summarizing the real-time settlement data to obtain periodic settlement data, calculating a performance index according to the dispatching instruction and the actual response data, and performing numerical correction on the real-time settlement data and the periodic settlement data by using the performance index to obtain adjusted settlement data. The application realizes the rapid scheduling and convergence of large-scale resources, and effectively improves the enthusiasm and fairness of users for participating in scheduling.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD NINGBO POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: Water supply allocation method for water supply plant
abstract_en: The application discloses a water supply allocation method for a water supply plant, which comprises the following steps: determining population density, water demand type and water supply network distribution data of a plurality of subarea water supply areas of the water supply area; if the water supply area comprises a first water supply area, predicting the water consumption of each subarea water supply area according to the population density and the water demand type of each subarea water supply area; inputting population density, water demand type and water consumption into a regression analysis model to obtain predicted water supply quantity of each subarea water supply area; inputting population density, water demand type and water consumption into a regression analysis model to obtain predicted water supply pressure of each subarea water supply area; and obtaining the operation water supply quantity and the operation water supply pressure of each subarea water supply area in a fixed time period according to the maximum water supply pressure of the water supply plant, the maximum water supply quantity of the water supply plant, the distribution data of the water supply network, the predicted water supply quantity and the predicted water supply pressure. And water supply allocation is reasonably carried out.

title_en: Custom declaration document information flowing system
abstract_en: The utility discloses a custom declaration document information flowing system, which comprises a document number acquiring unit, a document number processing unit, a document number storage unit, a service request responding and scheduling unit and a service information associating unit, wherein the document number acquiring unit is used for acquiring document numbers, the document number processing unit is used for distinguishing whether the document numbers acquired by the document number acquiring unit are legal or not and destroying illegal document numbers, the document number storage unit is used for storing the legal document numbers, the service request responding and scheduling unit is used for responding and scheduling service requests of users with the legal document numbers, and the service information associating unit is used for providing service information associated with the service requests of the users with the legal document numbers. By the aid of the custom declaration document information flowing system, unnecessary queuing time can be shortened, waste of manpower resources is decreased, the fairness and the efficiency of queuing are ensured, and flowing smoothness of custom declaration document information is guaranteed.

title_en: Automatic order sending module
abstract_en: The invention relates to an automatic order sensing module, and particularly relates to an optimal operation model for production reality.
