Through multivariable analysis, an inventor finds out the relationship and inherent regularity of similar things, and the built structural system simplified optimal operation model has excellent performance such as stability, reliability, universality, interworking and the like in productive practice. In actual production, a working scene exists: the task of each employee is dispatched in a unified mode by a central console, and in order to ensure equity and justice, the central console needs a rule approved by people.
assignees: IN THE ANTE INSURANCE BEIJING INTERNAT TRADE CO LTD

title_en: Resource unified scheduling test system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a resource unified scheduling test system and method. The system comprises a test cloud platform, a test instrument resource pool, a personal cloud desktop unit, tested equipment/system and a switch; the test cloud platform is respectively communicated with the test instrument resource pool, the personal cloud desktop unit and the tested equipment/system through the switch; and a test instrument interface of the test instrument resource pool is connected with a tested interface of the tested equipment/system. According to the resource unified scheduling test system and method disclosed by the invention, test instrument resources are distributed and managed through the test cloud platform in a unified manner; test data is stored in a unified manner; therefore, the problems that resource shortage and seizing of a laboratory exist under an idle resource condition due to scattered instrument resources, and the test data is stored in a scattered manner and cannot be counted can be solved; optimization management and reasonable distributing and scheduling of test resources of the laboratory can be realized; unified storage, collection and management of the test data can be realized; the test resource utilization rate is increased; the test software consistency and the test result fairness are ensured; and furthermore, the working efficiency is increased.
assignees: NANJING NARI GROUP CORP;STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: A kind of heuristic search of the monthly fired power generating unit combinatorial problem of power system
abstract_en: A kind of heuristic search of the monthly fired power generating unit combinatorial problem of power system, is related to hydrothermal generation scheduling field.At present, dimension calamity is easily trapped into when unit is larger, search speed is slower, thereby increases and it is possible to the not unique of solving result can be caused, these are all difficult to meet the fast-developing dispatching of power netwoks operation needs of China.Technical solution of the present invention is：" follow-up rate of load condensate " index is introduced to describe " three is public " scheduling, and with power station " follow-up rate of load condensate is equal " for objective optimization unit unit commitment mode.In optimization process, it regard the follow-up rate of load condensate height in power station and system reserve capacity nargin as heuristic information, iterated revision power station start-up mode, opens the small large-sized unit of energy consumption or the preferential unit start-stop strategy for mediating the big small unit of energy consumption using preferential, realizes power network energy-saving power generation.The technical program can effectively meet " three is public " principle of power scheduling, it is ensured that each power plants generating electricity fairness, take into account energy-saving power generation demand, be a kind of practical available method.
assignees: UNIV DALIAN TECH;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Watershed water environment capacity distribution method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a watershed water environment capacity distribution method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of water environment monitoring. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a watershed to be distributed, which needs to perform water environment capacity distribution; acquiring each control unit related to the watershed to be distributed and river reach corresponding to each control unit one by one; acquiring the maximum water environment capacity allowed to be discharged by each river reach; determining the water environment capacity allowed by the control unit corresponding to each river reach based on the maximum water environment capacity allowed to be discharged by each river reach; and correcting the water environment capacity allowed by the control unit corresponding to each river reach. In the embodiment of the application, the control units in the distribution domain are divided, the catchment range of each control unit is determined, then the maximum water environment capacity allowed to be discharged of each river reach is obtained, and then the water environment capacity allowed by the control unit corresponding to each river reach is determined and corrected, so that the objectivity and fairness of the distribution result are guaranteed.
assignees: TIANJIN HUANKE ENVIRONMENT PLANNING TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Automatic case distribution system and method, storage medium and computing device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a case automatic allocation system and method, a storage medium and a computing device, wherein the system respectively receives an auditing request of a case to be audited through a receiving module and acquires case attribute information of the case to be audited; then, a queue selection module selects a target case queue from a plurality of project case queues based on the case attribute information, and the case to be audited is added to the target case queue; and finally, acquiring a first target auditor matched with the target case queue through an allocation module, and allocating the case to be audited to the first target auditor for auditing. Based on the case automatic system provided by the invention, when the audit request is received, the auditor matched with the audit request is selected to automatically dispatch the case, so that the case distribution time is saved. Moreover, the fairness of case distribution is ensured by combining the auditing role of auditors, the distributed case quantity, the online state and the like in the case distribution process.
assignees: BEIJING JIANKANG ZHIJIA TECH CO LTD

title_en: New energy power system source carbon charge tax apportionment method based on carbon responsibility factors
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for apportioning source carbon-loaded taxes of a new energy power system based on carbon responsibility factors, which comprises the following steps: s1, confirming carbon emission responsibility of a renewable energy unit based on a carbon emission flow CEF model; s2, confirming carbon emission responsibility analysis of the energy storage unit based on a carbon emission flow CEF model; s3, determining source-charge bilateral carbon responsibility factors of the new energy; s4, based on the carbon responsibility factors, performing source-charge bilateral carbon tax allocation under the new energy scene: tracking the footprint of the carbon flow in the power grid based on a CEF (carbon emission flow) model of the carbon emission flow, reflecting the carbon emission responsibility on the two sides of the source load by using a carbon responsibility factor, and distributing the carbon emission responsibility quantity borne by the source load in the form of carbon tax. Compared with the prior art, the method can reasonably distribute the carbon emission responsibility to the source-load sides including the new energy, realizes reasonable fairness of the carbon emission responsibility distribution of the high-proportion new energy power system, and can stimulate the low-carbon emission reduction of the source-load sides when being applied to the problems of resource optimization operation and configuration.

title_en: Blocking decoupling management-based power distribution network economic dispatching method and system
abstract_en: The application provides a blocking decoupling management-based power distribution network economic dispatching method and system, and relates to the field of energy market analysis. The power distribution network economic dispatching method based on blocking decoupling management comprises the steps of receiving bidding information submitted by all producers and consumers; performing energy bidding matching through bidding information submitted by each producing and eliminating person; settling the result of energy bidding matching; and performing blocking management based on a preset blocking management model, wherein the blocking management model is established through settlement energy bidding matching results. The method not only can enable the power distribution network operators to correctly recover the cost, but also is beneficial to stimulating the power generation and elimination operators to match nearby energy, and decoupling scheduling of energy matching and blocking management enables the power generation and elimination operators to have more profit space and matching opportunities while improving fairness, greatly improves the solving efficiency of economic scheduling, and can meet the requirements of rapid and high-frequency economic scheduling of the power distribution network in the scene of ultra-large-scale power generation and elimination operators.

title_en: Enterprise management assessment evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides an enterprise management assessment evaluation method and system, the method comprises the steps of obtaining report data, conducting filtering processing on the report data, generating a completion score corresponding to a rating index, generating the completion rating based on the completion score, determining an initial comprehensive score, determining the initial comprehensive rating through the initial comprehensive score, obtaining comprehensive information entropy based on a first category of the initial comprehensive rating and the number of staff, respectively designating different rating indexes as main indexes, obtaining index information entropy of the main indexes based on a second category of the completion rating corresponding to the main indexes, determining a plurality of gain values based on the comprehensive information entropy and the index information entropy, determining the rating proportion of the rating index through the gain values, and generating a final comprehensive rating. The relevance strength between different rating indexes and the overall evaluation result is clear through the gain value, different specific gravities are distributed, the staff is more accurately and integrally evaluated, and the fairness of enterprise management assessment is ensured.

title_en: Standardized examination room intelligent management method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and particularly discloses an artificial intelligence-based standardized examination room intelligent management method and system, wherein the method comprises the following steps of S1, obtaining target monitoring object coordinates of a target examination room, S2, screening covered target monitoring object coordinates, S3, analyzing monitoring coverage of the target examination room, S4, analyzing monitoring cost effectiveness of the target examination room, S5, establishing a management maintenance control index model, and S6, outputting management evaluation results of the target examination room; by introducing artificial intelligence technology, the invention realizes accurate coverage of the monitoring range, effectively reduces the monitoring blind area, improves the monitoring efficiency, optimizes the resource allocation and reduces the management cost through cost-effective evaluation, establishes a management maintenance control index model, provides scientific decision basis for examination room management, improves the fairness and fairness of examination, and provides a scientific and efficient solution for standardized examination room management.
assignees: SHANGHAI SHENYI ZHIGUANG TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Hierarchical game optimal scheduling and income distribution method oriented to load aggregators
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power system dispatching and discloses a hierarchical game optimal dispatching and income distribution method for load aggregators. The method comprises the steps of realizing unified aggregation of 10kV/35kV multi-voltage-class users through standardized modeling, extracting multi-market general bidding parameters, constructing an upper-layer optimization framework covering multiple markets such as electric energy, demand response and the like, adopting a particle swarm algorithm to cooperatively game with a commercial solver for solving, completing lower-layer user scheduling allocation and revenue allocation by taking an upper-layer result as input and combining a voltage class difference and a performance scoring recursion mechanism, and reversely correcting closed-loop cooperation of upper-layer bidding through physical feasibility and budget balance verification and credibility until convergence. The method can reduce the risk of market violations, promote the dispatching robustness and the profit potential, and give consideration to the allocation fairness and the user retention stability, ensure that the scheme can fall to the ground, and comprehensively enhance the market competitiveness and the operation safety of the load aggregator.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECHNOLOGICAL RESEARCH INST STATE GRID XINJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Methods and devices for equality ordering service in interrior materials
title_ko: 인테리어 자재 균등 발주 서비스 제공 방법 및 제공장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for supplying interior materials based on equity ratio revenue distribution. The method is performed by a server and includes the steps of: (a) providing a plurality of material information to a construction company terminal after a contract is concluded between a consumer terminal and a construction company terminal through an Internet platform service provided through the server; (b) receiving order request information including the type and quantity of materials to be ordered from the construction company terminal; (c) checking whether a requested material is present in a shared warehouse managed by the server, and delivering the material to a construction site; and (d) distributing profits from materials sold in the shared warehouse for each predetermined period to a plurality of material company terminals according to a preset ratio. The shared warehouse may be a warehouse for storing materials supplied by a plurality of material companies participating in the Internet platform service. According to the present invention, operation costs can be reduced.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 서버에 의해 수행되는, 지분율 수익배분 기반의 인테리어 자재 공급 방법에 있어서, (a) 상기 서버를 통해 제공되는 인터넷 플랫폼 서비스를 통해 소비자 단말과 시공업체 단말간의 계약 체결이 이루어진 후, 상기 시공업체 단말로 복수의 자재 정보를 제공하는 단계;  (b) 상기 시공업체 단말로부터 주문할 자재 종류 및 자재 수량을 포함하는 발주의뢰정보를 수신하는 단계; (c) 상기 서버가 관리하는 공유 창고 내에 의뢰 받은 자재의 유무를 확인하고, 시공장소로 배송이 이루어지도록 하는 단계; 및 (d) 소정의 주기 별로 상기 공유 창고 내에서 판매된 자재에 의한 수익을 복수의 자재업체 단말로 기 설정된 비율에 따라 분배하는 단계; 를 포함하고, 상기 공유 창고는 상기 인터넷 플랫폼 서비스에 참여한 복수의 자재업체들이 각각 공급한 자재를 저장하는 창고일 수 있다.

title_en: Anti-ticket-swiping method, server and client
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preventing a bill from being refreshed, a server and a client, wherein the method is applied to the server and comprises the following steps: counting according to login information of a user, and storing an account or equipment with a non-one-to-one relationship between a login account and login equipment into a sensitive library; acquiring peripheral equipment scanning information acquired by logged-in equipment according to a preset period, and matching the peripheral equipment scanning information with the account and the equipment in the sensitive library; according to the matching result, if the following account numbers or equipment exist, the account numbers or the equipment are forbidden: and the account number or the equipment is matched with the account number or the equipment in the sensitive library within the preset period of the preset number. The invention solves the problem that the distributor carries out order grabbing through multiple devices, ensures fairness and simultaneously improves customer experience.

title_en: Urban safety barrier optimization design method taking queuing fairness as guiding
abstract_en: The invention relates to urban safety barrier optimization design software taking queuing fairness as a guide, and belongs to the technical field of traffic engineering. Epidemic prevention lock line is an effective means for blocking virus transmission, and constructs a city safety barrier. However, how to make the queuing time of each incoming channel approximately equal under the constraint of limited inspection resources is a technical problem to be solved. The invention provides a double-layer planning model, wherein an upper layer model is the optimal configuration of an epidemic prevention inspection station, a lower layer model is balanced for a traffic system, and the queuing waiting time is calculated by a queuing theory and is considered as a part of generalized travel time. A heuristic algorithm is designed to solve the double-layer planning model, wherein the lower layer is a continuous average algorithm, and the upper layer is a genetic algorithm with elite strategy. Computing software was developed using the free open-source R language. Specific implementation shows that the invention is very effective for policy makers to determine fair epidemic prevention blocking station deployment policies.

title_en: A kind of resource allocation methods based on parallel batching
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of resource allocation methods based on parallel batching, step：(1) M group is set, N number of member, the number of group is N/M；(2) it is divided into several batches, the member of each batch reports the group of favorite, if this lot portion member reports identical group, the member of conflict is remained, and carries out next batch；If all members of this batch report identical group, equiprobability selects a member to add, and remaining member remains, and carries out next batch；(3) when encumbrance is equal to 0, algorithm terminates, or when being retained less than N/M, N/M member has conflict, and equiprobability selects a member to add, and loser adds a group having vacant position, and algorithm terminates when encumbrance is equal to 0；Otherwise repeat (2) (3).Policymaker's allocative efficiency is improved using technical scheme；By batch processing set of preferences, not only solves large-scale resource allocation problem, and there is good practicality and fairness.

title_en: Network appointment vehicle dispatching method and system introducing passenger pick-up time satisfaction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a network appointment vehicle dispatching method introducing the satisfaction degree of the passenger receiving and driving time, which comprises the following steps: estimating expected pickup time and actual pickup time of passengers in different time space states by using the network appointment historical order information, and calculating to obtain the satisfaction degree of the pickup time of the passengers; the method comprises the steps that a driver group and a passenger group are subjected to type division according to space-time distribution, a bipartite graph with points and weights is constructed on the basis of the driver type group and the passenger type group, the passengers in a driver receiving and driving range have a connecting edge, and the weights of the points are the cost required by the passengers to drive a vehicle; respectively establishing linear plans of maximizing the total driver income Profit and maximizing the passenger driving receiving time satisfaction fairness PTSF; and (4) calculating off-line to obtain a fractional solution of the two targets, and performing on-line order allocation by using a KIID model. The invention can consider the fairness problem of the satisfaction degree of the passenger driving receiving time while considering the requirement of a driver on higher order income, and effectively balance the two different targets.

title_en: Virtual preference driven heterogeneous unmanned aerial vehicle cluster multitasking monitoring matching coordination method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of unmanned system information, and relates to a virtual preference driven heterogeneous unmanned aerial vehicle cluster multi-task monitoring matching cooperation method, which comprises the following steps: firstly, performing modeling analysis on performances of different unmanned aerial vehicles in a monitoring system, and performing modeling analysis on energy consumption of the unmanned aerial vehicles when monitoring tasks are executed, wherein the types of the unmanned aerial vehicles are three types of unmanned aerial vehicles including shooting unmanned aerial vehicles, communication unmanned aerial vehicles and calculation unmanned aerial vehicles, and the energy consumption of the unmanned aerial vehicles comprises three types of flight energy consumption, hovering energy consumption and monitoring energy consumption; then obtaining a preference list of each monitoring task for the unmanned aerial vehicle according to the requirements of different monitoring tasks, and obtaining the preference list of each unmanned aerial vehicle for the monitoring tasks according to the energy consumption of executing different tasks; and finally, a task matching algorithm based on fairness is provided for distributing a proper unmanned aerial vehicle for each heterogeneous monitoring task, so that task scheduling optimization in a monitoring scene with valuable heterogeneity and unmanned aerial vehicle performance difference of the tasks is realized, and the income of a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle monitoring system is improved.

title_en: Multi-main-body collaborative optimization operation method considering dynamic carbon emission factors
abstract_en: According to the multi-main-body collaborative optimization operation method considering the dynamic carbon emission factors, in the process of multi-main-body collaborative operation, the carbon quota demand of each main body can be calculated after the initial carbon emission amount and the carbon emission quota of each main body are determined, and the carbon transaction cost of each carbon quota demand is determined by adopting a stepped carbon transaction mechanism; and finally, carrying out sub-problem solving on the initial carbon emission, the carbon transaction data and the Nash negotiation cracking points by adopting an ADMM algorithm to obtain optimal carbon flow data so as to obtain dynamic carbon emission factors based on the optimal carbon flow data. In summary, the dynamic carbon emission factor obtained by solving the stepwise carbon transaction mechanism and the ADMM algorithm can describe the virtual carbon flow generated by the energy transaction among multiple bodies, and ensure the stability and fairness of the carbon market.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG

title_en: Disaster area emergency unmanned aerial vehicle networking method based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle dispatching, in particular to a disaster area emergency unmanned aerial vehicle networking method based on reinforcement learning, which comprises the following steps of taking an unmanned aerial vehicle as an intelligent body, and taking an abscissa, a speed, a direction, residual energy consumption and user throughput of the unmanned aerial vehicle as an observation space of the unmanned aerial vehicle; the method comprises the steps of taking a speed scheduling scheme and a bandwidth allocation scheme of an unmanned aerial vehicle as an action space of the unmanned aerial vehicle, introducing a graph attention mechanism to aggregate observation features of adjacent unmanned aerial vehicles, obtaining bandwidth allocation actions and corresponding rewards of the unmanned aerial vehicle under each speed scheduling based on the aggregated observation features, introducing Jain's fairness index to measure fairness of service quality of the unmanned aerial vehicle in an area, and optimizing speed scheduling and bandwidth allocation of the unmanned aerial vehicle. The invention realizes reasonable allocation of communication bandwidth under the condition of limited resources and maximizes service coverage rate for disaster-stricken users.

title_en: Multi-target ship scheduling method based on GA-SA algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-target ship scheduling method based on a GA-SA algorithm, which comprises the following steps of obtaining ship information, comprehensively evaluating ship lock throughput rate, ship lock chamber area utilization rate, average time to lock and fairness of lock passing by using a fitness function, encoding a selection state of a ship to be locked into a binary character string to generate an initial population, selecting individuals with high fitness to enter the next generation through selection operation, performing crossover and mutation operation on the selected individuals to obtain a new population, performing simulated annealing optimization on partial individuals with high fitness of each generation in a main cycle of a genetic algorithm to perform disturbance operation on the individuals with high fitness to obtain a new solution, selecting whether to accept the new solution according to probability until the temperature is reduced to a designated temperature, retaining the optimal solution obtained by simulated annealing, judging whether the iteration number is reached, and outputting a scheduling scheme with the highest fitness. The invention solves the problems of manual dependence and low efficiency of traditional ship passing-gate scheduling.

title_en: Campus duty task self-adaptive scheduling system and method based on multi-source data
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of multi-source data processing, in particular to a campus duty task self-adaptive scheduling system and method based on multi-source data, which can analyze the consulting timeliness of different users on transmitted duty information, can realize the conflict with personal time arrangement of most users at regular intervals, can cause the users to initiate the duty shift of relay application to monitor, and prompt that people are uniformly shifted on the duty shift when shifting, so that the generated duty shift keeps certain fairness and avoids individual staff from bearing unpopular shifts for a long time; furthermore, on the premise of considering the timeliness of each user for consulting the on-duty information, after the on-duty adjustment occurs in response to relay application, the application can carry out early warning judgment on the possibility that whether partial related personnel can occur or not, which is caused by the failure of consulting the notification information in time, so that the normal execution of the on-duty work is influenced.

title_en: Task equity distribution method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a task equity distribution method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and is suitable for financial science and technology business scenes and medical science and technology business scenes. The method comprises the steps of predicting task efficiency based on historical task data to obtain predicted task efficiency data, obtaining target task progress of a target user, predicting task achievement of the target task progress according to the predicted task efficiency data to obtain target task achievement conditions of the target user, screening target equity distribution strategies from candidate equity distribution strategies according to the target task achievement conditions, and distributing equity to the target user based on candidate equity information of the target equity distribution strategies. According to the embodiment of the application, the candidate equity information based on the target equity allocation strategy is used for allocating equity for the target user, and corresponding equity information can be allocated according to the actual task completion condition of the user, so that the reasonability of task equity information allocation is ensured.
assignees: PING AN HEALTH INSURANCE CO LTD

title_en: Resource processing method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a resource processing method, a resource processing device, a resource processing equipment and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of networks. According to the technical scheme, the user is guided to repeatedly complete the target tasks related to the resource allocation activities in the associated application, the user acquisition probability of the user to the resources is displayed based on the accumulated repeated completion times of the target user group on the platform and the repeated completion times of the user, the user can make an effort for improving the acquisition probability by accessing the associated application, the user activity is greatly improved, and the information such as the acquisition probability is provided for the user in a visual mode, so that the user can know the existing acquisition probability based on intuition, the direction of network activity of the user is determined, the user is stimulated to improve the user activity under the condition that the fairness of resource allocation is guaranteed, and the purpose of effectively improving the user activity is achieved.

title_en: System and method for analyzing effectiveness of distributing emergency supplies in the event of disasters
abstract_en: A computer-implemented method and system in one embodiment estimate the effectiveness of a dispensing plan of emergency supplies during disasters or in like scenarios, by simulating a flow of emergency supplies in a multi-echelon supply chain, dynamics of victims and progression of disaster. The performance metrics estimated in one embodiment include, but not limited to, overall coverage of distribution, inventory of supplies (e.g., shortage and surplus) and utilization of resources (e.g., shortage and surplus).

title_en: Routing optimization method for truck-drone integrated rescue vehicles in forest firefighting
abstract_en: A routing optimization method for truck-drone integrated rescue vehicles in forest firefighting includes the following steps: collecting the data of the disaster sites caused by forest fires, calculating transportation time on road and flight time according to the data of the disaster sites, and getting the transportation time data of post-disaster relief; based on the disaster site data, transportation time data, and an amount of relief supplies that can be allocated to disaster relief sites, constructing a mathematical model of the truck-drone based vehicle routing problem; solving the mathematical model of the truck-drone based vehicle routing problem by the optimization algorithm, and specifying a post-disaster rescue route of the truck-drone integrated rescue vehicle according to the solution results. The model based on the truck-drone based vehicle routing problem method can reduce the impact of sudden natural disasters, and give full play to the advantages of truck-drone integrated rescue vehicles.
assignees: BEIJING EVERYONE SAFE TECH CO LTD;UNIV BEIJING CHEM TECH

title_en: Emergency rescue material high-dimensional multi-target distribution method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-dimensional multi-target distribution method and system for emergency rescue goods and materials, and relates to the technical field of multi-target optimization. The invention considers the complexity of the emergency rescue environment, designs the emergency response engineering from the systematicness and sociality on the basis of summarizing the existing work, comprehensively considers six optimization targets of the total emergency response time, the panic degree of disaster victims, the unsatisfied degree of disaster relief supplies, the fairness of material distribution, the loss of disaster victims and the total emergency response cost, constructs a high-dimensional multi-target distribution model with multiple reserve points, multiple release points and multiple disaster relief supplies, restores the complex emergency rescue scene to a certain extent, obviously improves the effectiveness and the practicability of the emergency rescue material distribution method, and can provide more comprehensive and scientific thinking for emergency decision makers.

title_en: Improved Shapley value allocation method considering new energy concealed carbon emission
abstract_en: The invention discloses an improved Shapley value allocation method considering new energy concealed carbon emission, which comprises the following steps: acquiring planned carbon emission data before the day and carbon emission data in the day, and calculating a carbon emission difference value; collecting carbon emission generated by the unit under the condition of single energy output fluctuation and carbon emission generated by the unit under the mode of cooperation output of a plurality of new energy alliances; acquiring the number of the coalition apportioned member units; acquiring the load capacity of a single new energy unit and the total load capacity of all units, calculating the load contribution rate of each unit, and calculating a Shapley value carbon emission correction factor; and calculating a Shapley value under axiom constraint according to the data acquired in the previous step to obtain a Shapley value corresponding to the load of each unit, namely the carbon emission share to be born. The invention adopts a Shapley value algorithm introducing carbon emission correction factors, realizes transparentization of various new energy grid-connected hidden carbon emission sharing mechanisms, relieves the condition of uneven carbon emission sharing caused by different unit work efficiency, and realizes the equity sharing of new energy hidden carbon emission.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;ZHEDA POWER TECH HANGZHOU CO LTD

title_en: Photovoltaic cluster batch control system and method for low-voltage transformer area
abstract_en: The invention relates to a photovoltaic cluster batch control system for a low-voltage transformer area, which comprises a dispatching master station, an edge side proxy substation and field controllable equipment, wherein the dispatching master station comprises a dispatching master station and a dispatching master station control unit, wherein the dispatching master station comprises a dispatching master station control unit, a dispatching master station control unit and a dispatching master station control unit, wherein the dispatching master station comprises a dispatching master station control unit, and a dispatching master: the edge side proxy substation communicates with the field controllable equipment in a downlink communication mode, collects the running state and power of the field controllable equipment, and sends opening and closing instructions to the field controllable equipment, wherein the opening instructions cut off the field controllable equipment, and the closing instructions grid-connect the field controllable equipment; and the edge side proxy substation communicates with the dispatching master station in an uplink communication mode to send the total power of the station area, the number of the photovoltaic switches put into the station area, the total photovoltaic power of the station area and the actual photovoltaic power removal value, and receives the photovoltaic power removal target value sent by the dispatching master station. The invention reduces the decision calculation amount of the dispatching master station, balances the cut-off times of each photovoltaic user and ensures the fairness of each photovoltaic user for receiving dispatching control.
assignees: STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;QUANZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Big data-based network freight management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a network freight management system based on big data, in particular to the technical field of freight management, the intelligent logistics ecological system comprises a virtual logistics ecological module for creating a virtual environment by utilizing digital twinning and blockchain technology, an intelligent emotion interaction module for identifying through voice emotion and virtual assistant technology, and an environment and health management module for monitoring and managing health and ecological driving behaviors of a driver in real time. The intelligent logistics park module monitors and predicts the states of vehicles and cargoes in real time through a digital twin technology and a blockchain intelligent contract, ensures transparency and fairness of a transport protocol, improves safety, monitors the emotion states of a driver through a voice emotion recognition technology, prevents safety problems caused by emotion fluctuation, provides emotion accompaniment and social support, reduces the feeling of long-time driving solitary, improves efficiency, uses unmanned vehicles and robots to carry cargoes, and optimizes operation in the logistics park.
assignees: WELLONG ETOWN INT LOGISTICS CO LTD

title_en: Adjustable resource optimal allocation method taking line loss optimization as target
abstract_en: The optimal allocation method of the adjustable resources with the line loss optimization as a target comprises the following steps of 1, carrying out mathematical modeling on a system annual loss reduction problem, 2, carrying out mathematical modeling on multiple types of adjustable resources, and 3, carrying out SOP, capacitor and distributed power supply allocation and running optimization scheme solving by using an EO iterative algorithm. The invention solves the optimization problem of SOP, capacitor and distributed power supply configuration and operation through the EO-based iterative optimization algorithm, and achieves the purpose of reducing annual line loss of the power distribution network.
assignees: ENSHI POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Renewable energy power consumption weight determining and decomposing method
abstract_en: The invention provides a renewable energy power consumption weight determining and decomposing method which comprises the steps of determining influence factors influencing renewable energy power consumption, including resource endowment factors, economic development factors, power consumption capacity factors, environment-friendly constraint factors and industry-commerce environment factors, evaluating indexes of the influence factors of each research subarea, calculating to obtain renewable energy power consumption comprehensive indexes, and distributing the increment of the whole renewable energy power consumption from the current year to the future year research subareas to each research subarea according to the ratio of the renewable energy power consumption comprehensive indexes of each research subarea so as to obtain the renewable energy power consumption required to be consumed by each research subarea in the future year. According to the invention, by constructing a multi-index comprehensive evaluation system and combining normalization processing and weighted calculation, the consumption responsibility weight is scientifically distributed, and the fairness and rationality of renewable energy power consumption distribution are ensured.
assignees: CHINA RENEWABLE ENERGY ENGINEERING INST;CHINA RENEWABLE ENERGY ENGINEERING INST CO LTD;CHINA WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER ENG CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Prior-investment-type performer assisting system
abstract_en: Provided is a prior-investment-type performer assisting system with which prior investments intended to obtain continuous dividends on later days can be made in regard to the performance showed by a performer, and with which earnings are continuously distributed to the performer, too. A prior-investment-type performer assisting system 100 constituted to be capable of communicating with a viewer terminal 302, is provided with a contribution acceptance unit 12 which, when an ad-hoc delivered performance is released in a way that earnings are produced later on, accepts an application for purchase of dividend rights to said earnings; and a dividend determination unit 15 for determining a dividend from said earnings to the purchaser of dividend rights. When there exists a plurality of purchasers of dividend rights, the dividend determination unit 15 determines the dividend on the basis of the equity percentage of dividend rights of each purchaser. The equity percentage of dividend rights is determined in accordance with a compensation for the purchase of dividend rights.

title_en: Intelligent port operation vehicle dispatching system and dispatching robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a scheduling system and a scheduling robot for an intelligent port operation vehicle, and relates to the technical field of intelligent port operation. The method aims at solving the problems that in the traditional port vehicle dispatching, the manual dispatching response is slow, the error rate is high, the resource allocation is uneven, the labor cost is too high, and the high-efficiency and intelligent requirements of modern ports are difficult to meet; according to the invention, the idle load distance of the vehicle is reduced by utilizing the bipartite graph matching strategy, the overload rate is improved, the predictive scheduling module is planned in advance, the backlog of the task and the idle of the vehicle are reduced, the operation efficiency is effectively improved, the constraint processing module optimizes the task distribution according to the task and the vehicle condition, the multi-objective optimizing module optimizes the task distribution and the dispatch fairness, so that the resource distribution is more reasonable, the scheduling robot integrated system function, the intelligent scheduling can be adapted to different operation environments through continuous optimization of the acquired data and the online learning technology, the scheduling accuracy and efficiency are improved, the labor cost is reduced, and the port overall competitiveness is improved.

title_en: Accelerating data-driven scientific discovery
abstract_en: Techniques facilitating using a distribution system for incentivizing and accelerating data driven scientific research are described herein. The distribution system can track the input of various parties involved in scientific research, and when a reward, monetary or otherwise, is realized for one or more outcomes of the scientific research, the distribution system can distribute the reward among the parties that provided the input. The relative levels and contributions of the parties can be tracked to ensure that an equitable portioning of the reward is realized. A directed graph can be formed based on the transactions, wherein the nodes correspond to entities, researchers, publications, and the edges correspond to relationships between the entities. The directed graph can be analyzed to determine the relative or absolute levels of contributions from each of the entities, and the rewards can be distributed based on the contribution levels.

title_en: Wireless cognitive network spectrum access method based on two-level roll polling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wireless cognitive network spectrum access method based on two-level roll polling. According to the method, a two-level roll polling control technology is used as a core, the purposes of improving spectrum utilization ratio and reducing user spectrum access time delay are used as a starting point, and after a user access authorized frequency band in a cognitive network is given out, a multi-user channel sharing strategy with users preferential is authorized. The roll polling access control mode based on appointments can effectively avoid collisions. For latency-sensitive services in emergency communication, under the premise that normal communication of authorized users is guaranteed, channels are only distributed to the users who have service demands, and a QoS guarantee is provided for cognitive users and the authorized users from the aspects of transmission time delay, network throughput and the like. A parallel scheduling method based on reservation is used for controlling message sending of the cognitive users, collisions can be avoided, and the channel utilization ratio is improved. In addition, a two-level roll polling control method is used so that the priority of the authored users and the equity of the cognitive users in the channels can be effectively guaranteed.

title_en: A kind of material evidence transport box background operating system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of material evidence transport box background operating system, including system application layer, system interface layer and mechanical floor, the system application layer is equipped with: database is managed user, permission, role, verifies to user information；Device management module is stored and is inquired to the monitoring of transport box real time position, facility information and equipment scheduling state is managed；Task management module, equity pending task, being carrying out for task and having completed for task are managed；Exterior interface, is attached with database；The system interface layer includes physical evidence management system interface, operator's SIM communications platform and network interface；The mechanical floor includes cam device, SIM communication device, remote control lock device.It is an advantage of the invention that realizing that the storage of data, user management and transport box track are drawn and control manages, intelligence degree is high, time saving and energy saving, highly-safe.
assignees: SHAANXI YUXIN TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Distribution task allocation method and device, electronic equipment and computer storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure discloses a distribution task distribution method, a distribution task distribution device, electronic equipment and a computer storage medium, wherein the distribution task distribution method comprises the following steps: determining, by at least one processor, a current allocation round parameter; distributing distribution tasks in different rounds for the distribution resources according to the distribution round parameters through at least one processor; in response to detecting, by the at least one processor, that a timeout occurred for the dispatched resource, performing, by the at least one processor, a preset process for the timed-out dispatched resource. According to the technical scheme, the matching degree between the distribution tasks and the distributors can be improved under the condition that the operation burden of the distributors is not increased, the distribution time of the distribution tasks is shortened, the communication cost is reduced, the fairness and the high efficiency of distribution of the distribution tasks are guaranteed, the distribution efficiency and the distribution quality of the distribution tasks are further guaranteed, the distribution quality of distribution resources is improved, and the service quality of an internet platform is improved.

title_en: Service demand prediction-based multi-beam satellite beam resource adaptation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-beam satellite beam resource adaptation method based on service demand prediction, which relates to the field of multi-beam satellite communication and specifically comprises the following steps: firstly, aiming at a downlink data transmission scene of a high-orbit multi-beam satellite co-frequency network, acquiring simulated flow data under each beam satellite coverage area by building a flow simulation model; training a hidden state Markov model to obtain model parameters, and predicting the required value of each beam service flow at the next moment; and then, collecting the predicted values of the flow of each beam output by using the hidden state Markov model at different dates and moments, training a deep reinforcement learning PPO network model, outputting the combined optimization values of the bandwidth and the power of each beam, allocating bandwidth resource blocks with different numbers and central frequencies for each beam, and realizing the adaptation of the multi-beam satellite beam resources by using power resources with different grades. The invention effectively reduces the same frequency interference, meets the beam service requirement and the fairness principle, reduces the resource waste and improves the resource utilization rate.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING POSTS & TELECOMM;54TH RES INST CHINA ELECTRONICS TECH GROUP CORP

title_en: Law enforcement quality supervision system based on computer vision and semantic analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of law enforcement supervision, in particular to a law enforcement quality supervision system based on computer vision and semantic analysis. According to the invention, the accurate identification and analysis of fingerprints, seals and signatures in law enforcement documents are realized through integrating computer vision and semantic analysis technology, the accuracy of document verification is remarkably improved, the fine capture of image details is ensured through boundary detection and pixel level optimization, so that a system can identify fine image changes with higher resolution, the response speed and sensitivity of the system to complex details are improved, the misjudgment is reduced, the reliability of true and false judgment is improved in the identification and coding process of image features by the deep learning technology, the compliance of law enforcement texts can be comprehensively inspected through automatic semantic analysis and logic verification, and the law enforcement transparency and fairness are enhanced.
assignees: GUIZHOU INST TECH;FOUNDER INT BEIJING CO LTD

title_en: Virtual equity operation visual monitoring platform based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a virtual equity operation visual monitoring platform based on digital twinning, which dynamically maps real-time states, historical circulation records and business indexes of virtual equity through a digital twinning model, realizes millisecond synchronization of physical and virtual worlds, eliminates monitoring delay, builds a circulation path diagram, supports dynamic backtracking and abnormal path identification, rapidly positions problem nodes, and a virtual equity state calculation unit calculates operation states in real time based on a comprehensive evaluation formula, dynamically generates strategy suggestions, optimizes issuing strategies by monitoring inventory, holding capacity and circulation efficiency, reduces expiration rate and resource waste, and the visual monitoring module displays global states in real time, reduces manual statistics workload, supports interactive screening and drilling, improves analysis efficiency.

title_en: Drone for a tent with a tripod, and first aid
title_ko: 삼각대가 부착된 천막 및 구급용 드론
abstract_en: The present invention provides a drone, to solve a problem of being used only for taking pictures in the conventional art. The present invention provides the drone, comprising: three step support rods capable of adjusting length and supporting a vinyl tent to be installed; a controller having a general joystick shape to be capable of controlling the drone; an emergency kit made of a light material to hold lactated Ringer′s solution, emergency rescue articles and other necessary articles and adopting a slider manner to be attachable to and detachable from the drone; a transceiver, commercially distributed, enabling the controller to wirelessly control a drone body; and vinyl forming a tent structure when the tripod is fully unfolded to install the tent by being connected to the tripod, such that the drone generates lifting force for flight via a propeller to overcome gravity and to maintain a non-contact state from the ground for smoothly sending rescue articles to a disaster spot.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 삼각대가 부착된 천막 및 구급용 드론에 관한 것으로서 재난지역에 물자를 조달할때 헬기로 후송하면 많은 먼지와 비용이 들고 좁은 위치에 착륙하지 못하기 때문에 지지봉이 부착된 구급용 드론을 이용하여 비용절감 및 카메라를 이용하여 재난현장을 실시간으로 모니터링이 가능하고 지지봉을 길게 펼치고 부착된 비닐로 지지봉에 고정하여 천막으로 임시 보호소를 설치가 가능하고 드론에 비상용구급용품과 수액을 보충해 재난상황에서 신속하게 응급처치를 받을 수 있게하도록 함으로써 기존의 찰영용도로 밖에 쓰지 못 하는 문제점을 해소 하도록 한 것이다. 즉 본 발명은, 드론에 있어서 비닐천막을 설치 할 수 있도록 지지 할 수 있게 지지봉이 3단봉 형태로 길이를 조절 할 수 있게한 3단 지지봉, 드론을 컨트롤 할 수 있게 일반 조이트론 형태로한 컨트롤러, 수액 및 응급구조용품을 담을 수 있게 가벼운 소재로 만들어지고 응급키트에 필수적인 용품이 들어 갈 수 있고 슬라이더 형식으로 드론의 탈부탁이 가능한 탈부착이 가능한 응급키트, 드론본체와 컨트롤러의 무선 조정이 가능 할 수 있게 시중에 판매되는 송수신기한 송수신기, 삼각대에 연결하여 천막을 설치 할 수 있게 삼발이를 최대로 펼쳤을 때의 텐트구조한 비닐, 재난현장으로 구호물품을 원활히 보낼 수 있게 프로펠러를 통하여 양력을 발생시켜 중력을 극복하고 지면과의 비접촉상태를 유지함으로서 비행이 가능하도록 구성한 드론으로 구성한 것이다. 따라서, 본 발명은 재난지역에 물자를 조달할때 헬기로 후송하면 많은 먼지와 비용이 들고 좁은 위치에 착륙하지 못하기 때문에 지지봉이 부착된 구급용 드론을 이용하여 비용절감 및 카메라를 이용하여 재난현장을 실시간으로 모니터링이 가능하고 지지봉을 길게 펼치고 부착된 비닐로 지지봉에 고정하여 천막으로 임시 보호소를 설치가 가능하고 드론에 비상용구급용품과 수액을 보충해 재난상황에서 신속하게 응급처치를 받을 수 있게하도록 함으로써 기존의 찰영용도로 밖에 쓰지 못 하는 문제점을 해소하도록 한 효과를 갖는 것이다.

title_en: Daily operation evaluation method for power grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a daily operation evaluation method for a power grid, and belongs to the technical field of power system scheduling operation control. The method comprises the steps of constructing a daily power grid scheduling operation evaluation index set, wherein the index set comprises four aspects of the operation, namely a safety index, an economy index, a fairness index and an environment-friendliness index; acquiring corresponding data of daily operation of the power grid according to constructed evaluation indexes to calculate each index; integrating calculated index results, and evaluating a result of the daily operation of the power grid. The evaluation on the operation of the power grid is limited in the daily range, so that the evaluation on the power grid operation result is more targeted; a reference can be provided for a power grid operating worker for making a scheduling operation strategy; the safety index, the economy, the fairness and the environment-friendliness of the power grid operation are improved.
assignees: STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV TSINGHUA

title_en: Power generation scheduling evaluation method, device and equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power generation scheduling evaluation method, a device and equipment, belonging to the technical field of power scheduling.A maximum power generation capacity of a target power generation enterprise in a target power grid is calculated based on a preset rule; determining the power generation margin of a target power generation enterprise according to the maximum power generation capacity and the power generation scheduling scheme; calculating expected risks of a target power generation enterprise based on a distribution structure of power generation margins; acquiring an expected risk Lorentz curve according to the expected risk; and obtaining an expected risk Gini coefficient based on the expected risk Lorentz curve, evaluating power generation dispatching and obtaining a power generation dispatching evaluation result. Compared with the traditional result-oriented power generation scheduling fairness evaluation method, the power generation scheduling fairness evaluation method based on the expected execution risk provided by the invention essentially belongs to a process evaluation method, can evaluate fairness in a power generation scheduling service execution process more accurately, and is more beneficial to service promotion and normalized management.

title_en: Task allocation method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a task allocation method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring task information of a task to be distributed; pushing the task information of the tasks to be distributed to terminal devices corresponding to a plurality of working personnel respectively so that each working personnel can select whether to seize the tasks to be distributed or not through the corresponding terminal devices; determining target workers for carrying the tasks to be distributed based on the acquisition results of the workers for the tasks to be distributed and historical positioning data of the workers; and distributing the tasks to be distributed to the target staff. The embodiment of the invention enables the task allocation method to be objective and fair, not only considers the subjective will of the workers, but also considers objective factors, and improves the fairness, flexibility and rationality of the task allocation method.
assignees: BEIJING JINGDONG QIANSHI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Local power grid and wind power storage alliance master-slave game optimization scheduling method considering adjustment compensation
abstract_en: The local power grid and wind accumulation alliance master-slave game optimization scheduling method considering adjustment compensation comprises the following steps: step 1: the pumped storage power station and wind power are built into a wind storage alliance, and a local power grid and wind storage alliance master-slave game optimization model is built; step 2: constructing constraint conditions of a master-slave game optimization model of a local power grid and a wind-storage alliance; step 3: constructing a Nash bargaining profit allocation model of the wind-accumulation alliance; step 4: constructing a KKT condition of a lower-layer wind reservoir alliance optimization model, and converting the lower-layer wind reservoir alliance optimization model into a constraint condition of an upper-layer model; step 5: and the pumped storage regulation compensation benefit is considered, so that the two-stage solution of local power grid and wind storage alliance master-slave game scheduling is realized. According to the invention, aiming at the compensation income distribution of wind power in the alliance to pumped storage, the Nash bargaining method is adopted to conduct bargaining, and finally, the compensation electricity price meeting fairness and rationality is obtained, thereby promoting the improvement of the benefits of all parties in the alliance and the dredging of the pumped storage regulation cost.

title_en: Cloud edge collaborative carbon intelligent management platform resource optimization scheduling method based on block chain
abstract_en: The invention relates to a cloud edge cooperative carbon intelligent management platform resource optimization scheduling method based on a blockchain, which comprises the following steps of collecting carbon emission data through measuring equipment, and the microprocessor performs preliminary processing, and then transmits the processed data to the blockchain server for unified formatting storage, and the safety and the integrity of the data are ensured by utilizing the blockchain technology. In addition, the method and the system classify the users according to the privacy sensitivity degree by constructing a user side model, and generate a smart grid real-time pricing strategy; through the standardized carbon transaction flow of intelligent contract, trust construction of both supply and demand parties is promoted, a carbon transaction model is optimized, and transaction flexibility and fairness are improved. According to the method, through a data processing mode of decentralization, the stability and the reliability of the system are enhanced, the efficiency of carbon management work is improved, and a user is stimulated to participate in energy conservation and emission reduction through a credit evaluation mechanism, so that the efficiency and the reliability of overall carbon management are improved.
assignees: NANJING JIANGXING LIANJIA INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: New energy permeability threshold-based self-adaptive allocation method for carbon emission responsibility of electric power system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of new energy power systems, discloses a self-adaptive allocation method of carbon emission responsibility of a power system based on a new energy permeability threshold, and provides a dynamic responsibility allocation strategy aiming at the problem that the traditional carbon emission responsibility allocation mechanism is difficult to adapt to new energy volatility and permeability change; firstly, constructing a source-load collaborative carbon emission simulation model, defining a new energy permeability threshold and a hysteresis interval, dynamically switching three modes based on a permeability real-time value, namely a power generation side full-responsibility mode, a source-load benchmark allocation mechanism and a transition interval, and secondly, constructing a multi-objective optimization model, and collaborative optimizing fairness, new energy consumption and economy. The method can reduce the carbon emission responsibility distribution deviation, improve the new energy consumption rate and reduce the system operation cost, and provides technical support for the accurate carbon responsibility distribution of the high-proportion new energy power grid.

title_en: Multi-agent collaborative city community space planning method and device based on large model driving
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-agent collaborative city community space planning method and device based on large model driving, wherein the method comprises the steps of converting original city space data into a structured community space distribution map; the method comprises the steps of constructing a 'planner' agent, utilizing the 'planner' agent to understand and analyze a community space distribution map, outputting an initial city planning scheme, dividing the initial city planning scheme into a plurality of community areas, respectively generating local optimization suggestions by a plurality of 'community planning reviewer' agents, fusing all community optimization suggestions by a 'advanced planner' agent, carrying out global reasoning and coordination, and outputting a final city space planning scheme. The intelligent level, the cooperative efficiency and the service fairness of urban space planning are improved through cooperative work of multiple intelligent agents, and the problems of lack of multiple value expression in traditional generation type planning, high labor cost, slow response and the like in participation type planning are solved.
assignees: UNIV SOUTH CHINA TECH;GUANGDONG URBAN & RURAL PLANNING AND DESIGN INSTITUTE TECH GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Multi-terminal cooperative wage resource intelligent distribution method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent medical dispatching, in particular to a multi-terminal cooperative wage resource intelligent distribution method, which comprises the steps of firstly collecting positioning, road, nursing physiology and old man demand data and generating multi-mode standardized data; the method comprises the steps of constructing a three-dimensional digital twin potential field, constructing a matching model by utilizing photon prediction to correct the potential field, constructing a correction potential field, a protection capability vector and an old man demand vector, performing annealing optimization to obtain initial matching, constructing a protection-old man-period trisection diagram based on a matching result, performing tension diffusion and gradient projection iteration to obtain optimal matching, performing double digital signatures on each matching, casting a non-homogeneous promise in a blockchain to realize credible performance, continuously outputting fatigue probability by a wearing-end pulse neural network, mapping the fatigue probability into a potential energy increment write-back potential field, triggering sub potential field re-decomposition, zero knowledge shift and closed-loop updating. The method and the system improve scheduling instantaneity and fairness, reduce fatigue risk and ensure service whole-course traceability.
assignees: HANGZHOU YUANJIE ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Methanol fuel supply risk early warning method and system for ship
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of ships and discloses a methanol fuel supply risk early warning method and a methanol fuel supply risk early warning system for ships, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining real-time environment state information of ships and running state data of methanol fuel supply system equipment, and preprocessing to obtain smoothed running state sequence data; the method comprises the steps of calculating a window boundary value of a replenishment time point, identifying an operation stable section corresponding to a stable environment, determining an initial replenishment time point, monitoring the liquid level change rate of a daily tank for methanol, adjusting conveying parameters to obtain a first conveying parameter set if the liquid level change rate exceeds a threshold value, calculating the strength of a route mutation signal, correcting the replenishment window boundary value if the threshold value exceeds the threshold value, generating fusion data by fusing real-time liquid level fluctuation and the corrected window value, determining a safe conveying reference for the methanol, generating a control instruction set under the reference constraint, and executing methanol supply allocation. By the technical scheme, the suitability of the supply opportunity and the route working condition is improved.

title_en: Method of providing service for offshore activities in offshore wind farm
title_ko: 해상풍력단지 내 해상활동 서비스 제공 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for providing an offshore activity service in an offshore wind farm. The method comprises a step of collecting environment information in an offshore wind farm; a step of calculating a prediction information based on the collected environment information; a step of allowing a service operating system to calculate a fitness for each offshore activity based on the calculated prediction information, a step of allowing the service operating system to receive information about an offshore activity utilization plan, and a step of allowing the service operating system to establish a schedule of the offshore activity based on the information about the received utilization plan and the calculated fitness. So, safety, fairness and profitability can be improved.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 해상풍력단지 내 해상활동 서비스 제공 방법에 관한 것으로, 서비스 운영 시스템이 해상풍력단지 내의 환경정보를 수집하는 단계, 상기 서비스 운영 시스템이 상기 수집된 환경정보에 근거하여 예측정보를 산출하는 단계, 상기 서비스 운영 시스템이 상기 산출된 예측정보에 근거하여 각각의 해상활동별 적합도를 산출하는 단계, 상기 서비스 운영 시스템이 해상활동 이용계획에 관한 정보를 수신하는 단계 및 상기 서비스 운영 시스템이 상기 산출된 적합도 및 상기 수신된 이용계획에 관한 정보에 근거하여 해상활동의 일정을 수립하는 단계를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Internet of things technology-based relief supply distribution management system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an Internet of things technology-based relief supply distribution management system, in particular to a relief supply distribution management system for ocean storm surge disasters. The system mainly comprises a wireless sensor network unit for sensing relief supply environmental data, a radio frequency identification (RFID) unit for identifying and transmitting relief supply basic attribute data, a unit for accurately positioning a moving object through a satellite and a vehicle-mounted global positioning system (GPS) chip, an information transmission unit for transmitting the relief supply environmental data through a wireless communication network, namely a global system for mobile communications (GSM), and a data processing unit for a relief supply information processing system to analyze the relief supply environmental data and make decisions. The system is mainly applied to the distribution management of relief supplies, dynamically monitors conditions such as the distribution quantity of the relief supplies on each shelter, the delivery condition of the supplies, the quality of the supplies in the transportation process and the like to ensure that the relief supplies can safely and timely arrive at each shelter on the premise of guaranteeing the quality and quantity.

title_en: Resource allocation method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a resource allocation method, a device, an electronic device and a storage medium, the method comprising: responding to a resource allocation request sent by a target terminal, and determining a target account corresponding to the resource allocation request; updating the information of the allocated account according to the target account; under the condition that the updated allocated account information meets a first preset condition, updating allocated terminal information according to the target terminal; under the condition that the updated allocated terminal information meets a second preset condition, determining resources to be allocated corresponding to the target account and the target terminal; and determining a current resource inventory, and distributing the resources to be distributed to the target account under the condition that the current resource inventory and the resources to be distributed meet a third preset condition. By utilizing the technical scheme provided by the embodiment of the disclosure, fairness and accuracy of resource allocation can be ensured, and meanwhile, efficiency of resource allocation is effectively improved.
assignees: BEIJING DAJIA INTERCONNECTION INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Logistics unmanned aerial vehicle task allocation method with priority division
abstract_en: The invention discloses a logistics unmanned aerial vehicle task allocation method with priority division, which comprises the following steps: s1, extracting three-dimensional operation space information of a logistics unmanned aerial vehicle based on a geographic environment, a low-altitude airspace structure and performance of the logistics unmanned aerial vehicle, and acquiring performance parameters of the logistics unmanned aerial vehicle; s2, acquiring transportation type, flow direction and flow time data of the logistics unmanned aerial vehicle by combining the requirements of a logistics company and clients, and constructing a logistics unmanned aerial vehicle operation scene; s3, establishing a service satisfaction index of the logistics unmanned aerial vehicle by combining task priority and fairness of the logistics company; s4, constructing a logistics unmanned aerial vehicle task allocation model by taking minimum flight impedance and maximum service satisfaction as targets; s5, solving the model by adopting an NSGA-II algorithm, and outputting an optimal resource allocation scheme of the logistics unmanned aerial vehicle. By adopting the task allocation method of the logistics unmanned aerial vehicle with priority division, the collaborative task allocation of a plurality of logistics unmanned aerial vehicles can be realized, and the operation efficiency and quality of the logistics unmanned aerial vehicle can be improved.

title_en: Blockchain-based carbon right-green evidence cooperative transaction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a carbon right-green certificate cooperative transaction method based on a blockchain, and belongs to the fields of blockchain technology and environment management. The method specifically comprises the steps of 1) deploying intelligent contracts based on an Ethernet platform, integrating power transaction, carbon quota delivery and green evidence verification flow chains to realize automatic execution of transaction rules and non-falsification of data, 2) innovatively designing a Carbon Token (Carbon Token) excitation mechanism, providing a DPoS-CT consensus algorithm considering Carbon Token rights, exciting a market subject to continuously reduce emission, 3) quantifying main body performance and distributing chain equity by a dynamic reputation model and a reward and punishment mechanism, and 4) resetting transaction periods every 24 hours, and optimizing quota distribution and consensus parameters based on historical data. The mechanism provided by the invention can effectively stimulate the renewable energy source transaction, and after the blockchain carbon-through certification system is introduced, the quota completion rate, the green electricity utilization rate, the carbon emission, the carbon right-green certification transaction amount and the economic benefit are optimized to a certain extent.

title_en: Remote off-site bid evaluation intelligent platform construction system and method based on multipoint distributed intelligent collaboration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote label evaluation intelligent platform construction system and method based on multipoint decentralized intelligent collaboration, comprising a user side, an application layer and a support layer, wherein the application layer comprises site management, expert resource management, expert signature, evaluation management, label evaluation system management, file transmission storage management and service guarantee collaborative management, data among all plates are seamlessly abutted and shared in real time, the support layer comprises a unified user management, a workflow platform, a general data management, a unified message platform, an intelligent analysis platform, a portal support platform and a data exchange platform, and the user side supports a transaction main body, a supervisor, a manager and the like to log in through access channels such as a mobile phone, a PC. The invention solves the problems that heterogeneous information in the current remote evaluation mark cannot be intercommunicated and shared, remote sites and equipment resources are difficult to share, and the supervision of a secondary field project is not sufficient, realizes the inter-regional interconnection and the resource sharing, and improves the evaluation mark efficiency and fairness.
assignees: SANMENXIA XIAOYUN INFORMATION SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Feature analysis and influence evaluation method, device, equipment, medium and product based on composite energy drought event
abstract_en: The application discloses a characteristic analysis and influence evaluation method, device, equipment, medium and product based on a composite energy drought event, and relates to the technical field of renewable energy low-carbon transformation. The method comprises the steps of obtaining information data, preprocessing the information data to obtain integrated information data, calculating the endowed spatial distribution of wind and light resources based on the integrated information data to obtain the endowed spatial distribution information of the wind and light resources, carrying out characteristic analysis of a composite energy drought event according to the endowed spatial distribution information of the wind and light resources to determine spatial distribution index information, and carrying out exposure spatial characteristic analysis based on a fairness quantitative analysis frame according to the spatial distribution index information to obtain an analysis result. Therefore, the method can evaluate the evolution trend of the influence of the drought event of the composite energy source and provide a quantitative basis for the influence bias.

title_en: BIPV building full life cycle energy benefit and cost allocation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a full life cycle energy benefit and cost allocation method for a BIPV (building integrated photovoltaic) building, and belongs to the field of building energy management and financial optimization. The technical scheme comprises four modules of data acquisition and modeling, full life cycle financial optimization, intelligent control and income optimization closed loop, block chain multi-party distribution and excitation. The method can break the data island, improve the accuracy of financial evaluation, cooperate with the income target, ensure the fairness of distribution and promote the large-scale development of BIPV industry.

title_en: System and Method for the Allocation of High Demand Properties
abstract_en: The invention provides a system and method for the equitable and efficient allocation of residences and properties. In accordance with the invention, individuals seeking to reserve high demand properties can first view and select properties and submit a reservation request. The reservation request may include a group of properties by name, preferred reservation dates, as well as a ranking of the individual's highest through lowest property preference.
assignees: BOYER TIMOTHY;CORBETT BRIAN;FILIPPINI TOM;HANDLER BRAD;HANDLER BRENT;LIVINGSTON CHARLES;PRICHARD RYAN;STUEVE MATT

title_en: Multi-beam satellite beam resource adaptation method based on service demand prediction
