abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-beam satellite beam resource adaptation method based on service demand prediction, which relates to the field of multi-beam satellite communication and specifically comprises the following steps: firstly, aiming at a downlink data transmission scene of a high-orbit multi-beam satellite same-frequency networking, acquiring simulation flow data under each beam satellite coverage area by constructing a flow simulation model; training a hidden state Markov model to obtain model parameters, and predicting the service flow demand value of each wave beam at the next moment; and then, collecting the flow predicted values of each beam output by using the hidden state Markov model under different dates and times, training the deep reinforcement learning PPO network model, outputting the bandwidth and power joint optimization values of each beam, distributing bandwidth resource blocks with different numbers and central frequencies for each beam, and realizing the resource adaptation of the multi-beam satellite beam by using different levels of power resources. The method effectively reduces the co-channel interference, meets the beam service requirement and fairness principle, reduces the resource waste and improves the resource utilization rate.

title_en: Multi-granularity weighted analysis method and device based on terminal verification
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-granularity weighted analysis method and device based on terminal verification, wherein the method comprises the steps of sending data, all secondary indexes in preset index types and scoring rules of each secondary index to at least two terminals in a one-way transmission mode, and verifying the safety and effectiveness of the one-way transmission mode; obtaining a target weight value of each primary index based on a preset index weight value and at least two characteristic values of each primary index, and calculating an evaluation value of result quality data according to the at least two characteristic values of each primary index and the corresponding target weight values. According to the invention, the final evaluation value is obtained by carrying out component calculation on the relevant characteristic values of the values corresponding to the indexes of different types and combining with the subjective index weight value, so that uncertainty caused by subjective will is effectively avoided, accuracy and fairness of the result can be ensured, and the subsequent improvement and optimization directions can be conveniently provided.

title_en: A order distribution management system for flexible processing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an order distribution management system for flexible processing, including central dispatch server, a plurality of through the cable connection the dispatch server's of central authorities subregion dispatch server, every subregion dispatch server goes up and is connected with demand terminal and processing service terminals through the cable, the demand terminal includes demand terminal processor, passes through the demand terminal data storehouse that the cable is connected with demand terminal processor, still includes to pass through the demand information IO mouth that the cable is connected with demand terminal processor, processing service terminals include the service terminals treater, through the cable with the haulage vehicle dispatch system that the service terminals treater is connected still includes processing service information IO mouth and machined part RFID collector. The utility model discloses can make user's processing demand sent the best processing service side equitablely high -efficient, shorten the order delivery time, guarantee the order and accomplish the quality.

title_en: Unit Combination method based on the modeling of convertible frequency air-conditioner virtual robot arm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of Unit Combination method based on the modeling of convertible frequency air-conditioner virtual robot arm, comprise the steps: that (1) sets up thermodynamical model and the electrical model of single air conditioner；(2) by Load aggregation business, air-conditioning group is carried out centralized dispatching and control, set up the polymerization model of air-conditioning group；(3) carry out virtual robot arm modeling according to conventional rack characteristic, and set up user and respond the cost function of virtual robot arm under uncertain condition；(4) in ahead market, according to secondary daily load and temperature prediction, set up the Unit erriger built-up pattern of conventional rack and virtual robot arm, arrange time daily dispatch scheduling；(5) during actual schedule, consider the economic interests of Load aggregation business and participate in user fairness and the comfort level of virtual robot arm modeling, it is achieved load adjustment amount optimized distribution between users.The centralized dispatching that present invention achieves air-conditioning group controls, and decreases the amount of calculation of relevant traffic department and controls difficulty.

title_en: High-proportion hydropower grid short-term power generation scheduling method considering electric quantity decomposition
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of hydropower dispatching operation, in particular to a high-proportion hydropower grid short-term power generation dispatching method considering electric quantity decomposition. The invention designs a daily electric quantity decomposition method based on a standard load curve by considering the fairness of electric quantity decomposition and different power supply characteristics; on the basis of the decomposition curve, an optimization model for planning decomposition electric quantity completion degree relative deviation maximum value minimum is provided, and a practical solving method for coupling limit area checking and electric quantity correction strategies is constructed so as to quickly determine a daily power generation plan of the power station. Verification is carried out by taking the formulation of the daily power generation plan of the Yunnan power grid as an example, and the example result shows that: the method can effectively reduce the execution deviation of the trading plan and quickly obtain the daily operation plan of the large-scale power station meeting the complex hydraulic and electric power dispatching operation constraint.
assignees: KUNMING ELECTRIC POWER TRANSACTION CENTER CO LTD;UNIV DALIAN TECH

title_en: Intelligent urban resource scheduling method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent cities, and particularly relates to an intelligent city resource scheduling method. The method comprises the steps of monitoring various resource states and demands of cities in real time, establishing a scheduling model comprehensively considering resource availability, demand emergency degree, fairness and efficiency, solving an optimal allocation scheme by improving a particle swarm optimization algorithm, and executing and adjusting the scheme. The method can comprehensively and accurately monitor resources, scientifically schedule the resources, improve the utilization efficiency of the resources, adapt to dynamic changes and improve the overall benefits of cities. Specifically, accurate scheduling can be performed according to monitoring data of different resources such as traffic, energy sources and the like, waste is reduced, the comprehensive multi-factor model enables resource allocation to be more reasonable, an optimal scheme can be quickly found by an optimization algorithm, the optimal resource allocation is ensured by dynamic adjustment, and therefore urban operation efficiency and sustainable development capability are improved.
assignees: LIAOCHENG ANXIN BIG DATA GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Post-earthquake emergency material distribution optimization method considering distribution fairness and demand urgency
abstract_en: The invention provides a post-earthquake emergency material distribution optimization method considering distribution fairness and demand urgency, which relates to the technical field of emergency logistics multi-objective distribution optimization under the background of urban earthquake disasters, and comprises the following steps of S1, determining a basic assumption, namely, taking actual situations of disaster rescue operation into consideration, and making the basic assumption on the problem of emergency material distribution; S2, establishing an emergency material distribution fairness model, S3, establishing an emergency degree evaluation index system of emergency material demands at disaster points, S4, establishing a multi-objective path optimization model, and S5, solving the established multi-objective model by utilizing an improved hybrid multi-universe optimization algorithm. The invention provides a hybrid multi-universe algorithm based on differential evolution, which has higher convergence precision, better robustness and uniformity, improves the optimization accuracy of an earthquake disaster emergency logistics distribution path, ensures the meeting and distribution fairness of material demand urgency, reduces distribution cost, and improves the disaster satisfaction degree and demand emergency adaptation degree.

title_en: Examination seat arrangement method and system based on intelligent examination table
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent education equipment and examination management, in particular to an examination seat arrangement method and system based on an intelligent examination table, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting environmental data through the intelligent examination table and generating an environmental characteristic matrix by combining an implicit perception technology; dividing examination room areas based on quantum dot distribution models, optimizing seat distribution through reinforcement learning to generate optimized seat distribution data, completing identity verification of an examinee by utilizing a multi-mode verification module, binding the verification data with the optimized seat distribution data, unlocking an examination interface and loading examination tasks. The invention effectively improves the fairness and the intellectualization level of the seat allocation of the examination room, realizes the preferential allocation of special demand examination workers and the dynamic management of the examination process, and has remarkable reliability and convenience.
assignees: BEIJING SHIDUN TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Computer implemented blockchain-based system for agricultural products
abstract_en: This specification discloses a platform built on blockchain that is designed to help increase traceability, efficiency and fairness in agricultural supply chains, such as the coffee, cocoa, tea, sugar, grains and fruit supply chains. The platform includes a Self-Sovereign Identity solution, a new form of digital identity built on distributed ledger technology. Farmers, wholesalers, traders and retailers can interact more efficiently using comprehensive, near real-time access to this data, and consumers can have new insights about the origins of the products they consume. The platform includes a consumer-facing application that pulls information directly from the blockchain and connects the final consumer, e.g. a coffee drinker, to farmers, traders, roasters and brands. The information is presented on an interactive map, allowing each product to tell a story in a simple and scalable way. The app also presents sustainability projects in coffee communities and an opportunity for consumers to directly support them. Consumers now can play an active role in sustainability governance by directly supporting coffee farmers in developing nations.

title_en: Generating capacity distribution method and device for plant
abstract_en: The invention relates to a generating capacity distribution method and device of a station, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining the evaluation score of each station according to the theoretical power prediction accuracy and the management level coefficient of the station; determining the instantaneous power generation power distributed by each station according to the evaluation score of each station; the power generation amount distributed by each station is determined according to the instantaneous power generation power distributed by each station, and the technical scheme provided by the invention fully embodies the fairness and fairness of scheduling, stimulates each station to accelerate the improvement of the power prediction accuracy and the management level, and ensures the safe and stable operation of a power grid.

title_en: Software development outsourcing control system based on block chain and implementation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a software development outsourcing control system based on a block chain and an implementation method. The system comprises: the system comprises a demand release module, a test case generation module, an intelligent contract generation module, a software running sandbox, a task generation module, a task confirmation distribution module and a block chain system; based on the characteristics of decentralization and non-falsification of a block chain technology, all nodes participate in task generation, code verification and capability scoring, so that the authenticity of software development outsourcing tasks, the fairness for evaluating the software quality and the authority for evaluating the software development outsourcing completion capability of developers are improved, and the developers are effectively encouraged to improve the participation degree and the completion degree; by using the characteristics of traceability and privacy protection of block chain account book data, each change of the currency and software copyright of a user is encrypted and recorded, the currency asset and software copyright are protected, and the data reliability is improved. The invention also discloses a realization method of the software development outsourcing control system based on the block chain.

title_en: Irrigated area water resource balance optimization configuration method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water resource balance optimization configuration method for an irrigation district, which can realize real total amount constraint under the combined action of underground water and agricultural available water distribution amount through total amount constraint of water supply, underground water burial depth control and time-interval-by-time-interval reasonable consideration of underground water; the balance of limited water quantity of the water using units can be realized through the space balance of supply and demand allocation of different water using units, and the fairness of regional social and economic development is reflected; by controlling the buried depth of underground water, the balance between social and economic water consumption and ecological environment water consumption under the constraint of the total amount of regional water consumption can be realized; through time-interval-by-time optimization, under the spatial equilibrium constraint, equilibrium distribution in different time intervals, including equilibrium distribution of irrigation water in anniversaries and between the annual periods, is realized on the premise of guaranteeing ecological safety of underground water, and healthy coordinated development of ecological health regulation, production water guarantee and cyclic development sustainability in irrigation areas is promoted.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Management method and device capable of reducing credit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a management method and a device capable of reducing a credit limit, and relates to the technical field of financial computers. One embodiment of the method comprises: acquiring first transaction data for sale limitation of one or more transaction accounts and deduction transaction data and/or interest change data corresponding to the first transaction data; registering the transaction data according to the transaction source of the transaction data to obtain second transaction data which corresponds to the transaction source and is sold without limitation; adjusting the second transaction data according to the withheld transaction data and/or the equity change data; and determining the target reducible credit line corresponding to each transaction account according to the adjusted second transaction data. According to the embodiment, more accurate second transaction data under different transaction sources can be obtained, and then target reducible credits of each transaction account under different transaction sources are obtained, so that the reducible credits can be reasonably distributed conveniently.
assignees: CHINA SECURITIES REGISTRATION CLEARING CO LTD

title_en: Comprehensive energy system energy-carbon interactive scheduling method and device based on multi-element game
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of energy scheduling of power systems, in particular to a comprehensive energy system energy-carbon interaction scheduling method and device based on multi-element games. In the invention, a multi-polymer and multi-producer and a multi-producer in the comprehensive energy system form a cooperative game, and a multi-polymer and multi-producer cooperative game mode considering multi-energy and carbon interaction and a low-carbon mechanism is established; and (3) establishing a cooperative game model and a characteristic function of the multi-producer and the multi-aggregator by considering electric energy, heat energy and carbon emission rights sharing. The double-layer profit distribution method based on the multi-subject participation contribution degree is provided, and the fairness of distribution is ensured. The invention introduces a multi-element and flexible interaction mode and a multi-energy-carbon transaction strategy, builds a multi-energy market cooperative energy-carbon coupling interaction mode, improves the system load characteristic, promotes renewable energy consumption and multi-energy mutual economy, and realizes the flexibility, low carbon and safety of multi-AOP and multi-yield operation.
assignees: UNIV TIANJIN;STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Virtual power plant cooperative game benefit distribution method considering credit value correction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power systems, in particular to a virtual power plant cooperative game benefit distribution method considering credit value correction, which is applied to power transactions participated in by virtual power plant aggregation multi-subject and comprises the following steps: determining power supply parameters and corresponding credit values of all transaction subjects in the cooperative alliance, checking whether the credit values meet a preset access threshold, and if so, determining the output power of the transaction subjects based on the power supply parameters; if not, rejecting the transaction main body; distributing power generation tasks for the transaction main body based on the output power, and calculating alliance benefits; the federated revenue is assigned to the transaction principal based on the reputation improved Shapley method and marginal contributions. The invention can improve the credit and performance rate of the transaction main body and realize the fairness of the income distribution.
assignees: NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER UNIV BAODING

title_en: Random number shaking distribution method for accommodation of colleges and universities
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of college accommodation management, and particularly provides a college accommodation random shaking number distribution method which comprises a mobile terminal, a management terminal and a college terminal; the method comprises the following steps: s1, a manager imports the number of beds at a management end; s2, applying for a bed by the student at the mobile terminal; s3, a manager confirms a student list of the allocated beds at a management end; s4, dividing accommodation areas at a management end by management personnel, and adding assignable beds; s5, the bed is allocated to the corresponding students in the universities, and the students check in at the mobile terminal; according to the invention, under the condition that the number of beds is larger than that of students, the qualification of the students for entering the residence is confirmed by adopting a shaking number mode, so that each student can be ensured to have equal opportunity to select the beds, and the fairness of the distribution process is improved; the shaking number is carried out on the basis of a linear congruence algorithm, so that manual intervention can be reduced, the workload of a host manager is lightened, and the distribution efficiency is improved.
assignees: JIANGSU SHUANGQI UNITED WISDOM TECH CO LTD

title_en: Urban green space fairness evaluation method for coupling social ecological supply and demand potential
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of urban ecological system regulation and discloses an urban green space fairness evaluation method for coupling social ecological supply and demand potential, which comprises the steps of collecting multi-source data and constructing a green space basic database based on the multi-source data; the method comprises the steps of constructing a green space comprehensive supply index, a green space comprehensive demand index and a green space line-of-sight reachable potential index based on a green space basic database based on multi-source data, generating a green space supply and demand coupling coordination degree index based on the green space comprehensive supply index and the green space comprehensive demand index through coupling coordination analysis, generating a green space fairness index based on the green space supply and demand coupling coordination degree index and the green space line-of-sight reachable potential index, and evaluating fairness of urban green space allocation by judging the category of the green space fairness index.

title_en: Knowledge graph-based environment equity asset management method and device
abstract_en: The application provides an environmental equity asset management method and device based on a knowledge graph, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining a first target node associated with a target user in the knowledge graph related to the environmental equity asset according to first information of the target user, obtaining environmental equity asset data associated with the target user according to a second target node connected with the first target node in the knowledge graph and attribute information of edges between the first target node and the second target node, inputting the environmental equity asset data into an asset evaluation model to obtain an evaluation result output by the asset evaluation model on the current environmental equity asset of the target user, and generating an asset management strategy of the target user according to the evaluation result. Therefore, the method can be combined with a knowledge graph and a machine learning model to dynamically evaluate and accurately predict the value and risk of the environmental equity asset, can provide advice of asset management optimization, and is beneficial to improving the efficiency and income of asset management.
assignees: HUANENG ZHAOCAI DIGITAL TECH CO LTD;BEIJING HUANENG CHANGJIANG ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;BEIJING YIQING NENGHUAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Remote attendance system and attendance implementation method therefor
abstract_en: An attendance implementation method for an remote attendance system, and a system, said method comprising: each employee-side smart terminal reporting, to an attendance terminal, an attendance check-in instruction carrying employee identity information (S10); according to the employee identity information carried by the attendance check-in instruction, the attendance terminal searching, from a mapping relationship between a preset scheduling date, employee identity information and a workplace, for a scheduling date and a workplace which establish a mapping relationship with the employee identity information (S20); acquiring the current date, and determining whether the current date is within the range of the scheduling date (S30); if the current date is within the range of the scheduling date, sending a current location acquisition instruction to the corresponding employee-side smart terminal (S40); the corresponding employee-side smart terminal initiating a GPS positioning function and acquiring the current position according to the current position acquisition instruction issued by the attendance terminal; and reporting, in real time, the current position to the attendance terminal (S50); the attendance terminal matching the current position reported by the corresponding employee-side smart terminal and the found workplace (S60); and when position matching is performed successfully, recording the receiving time of the corresponding attendance check-in instruction, and defining the receiving time as the attendance check-in time of the corresponding employee (S70). The method and system enable an employee to perform attendance check-in at any place in the workplace without affecting other employees, ensuring the fairness of attendance check-in for employee.
assignees: COMIX BUSINESS MACHINE SHENZHEN CO LTD

title_en: Prior-investment-type performer assisting system
abstract_en: Provided is a prior-investment-type performer assisting system with which, with respect to a performance presented by a performer, prior investment intended to obtain continuous dividends on later days can be made, and earnings are continuously allocated to the performer, too. A prior-investment-type performer assisting system  100  configured to be capable of communicating with a viewer terminal  302  includes a contribution acceptance unit  12  that, when an ad-hoc distributed performance is released in such a way that earnings are produced later on, accepts an application for purchase of a dividend right to the earnings, from the viewer terminal; and a dividend determination unit  15  that determines a dividend from the earnings with respect to the dividend right purchaser. When there are a plurality of dividend right purchasers, the dividend determination unit  15  determines the dividend based on the equity percentage of the dividend right of each purchaser. The equity percentage of the dividend rights is determined in accordance with a compensation for the dividend right purchase.

title_en: Electric power system optimal scheduling method considering economical efficiency and fairness
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optimal scheduling method of a power system, which is capable of considering economy and fairness, and is characterized by establishing an optimal power flow model comprising an objective function with lowest power generation cost, system power balance constraint and line transmission power, deriving node marginal power price according to the optimal power flow model, determining the node marginal power price of a generator node and a load node under the condition of alternating current model and direct current tide, solving the node marginal power price fluctuation rate, establishing an optimal scheduling model of the power system according to the power generation cost of a generator set, the node marginal power price fluctuation rate and set constraint conditions, and solving the optimal scheduling model to obtain the optimal scheduling method of the power system. The invention establishes the marginal electricity price fluctuation index of the nodes of the power system so as to reflect the fairness and rationality of the dispatching scheme, reduces the difference of the marginal electricity price among the nodes as much as possible by optimizing the dispatching mode, and is beneficial to promoting the construction of the power market and ensuring the benign operation of the power system.

title_en: Three-public scheduling model construction method based on kini coefficient
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-member scheduling model construction method based on a kini coefficient, which comprises the following steps: step 1, collecting various optimized data such as unit characteristic parameters and system loads, and determining a scheduling plan space. Step 2: according to the actual demand of a power grid, constructing a scheduling plan model with the aim of minimizing the total cost including the unit operation cost and the start-stop cost; and step 3: and characterizing the electric quantity balance condition of each power plant by using a Gini coefficient G, and adding the electric quantity balance condition serving as a constraint condition into the constructed scheduling plan model. And 4, step 4: and obtaining a scheduling plan scheme through an optimization technology and security check. The scheduling plan model established in the method disclosed by the invention can consider the aspects of safety, economy, fairness and the like of the system, and can effectively improve the optimal configuration of power resources.

title_en: A kind of prioritization scheme and device based on the distribution of shared bicycle resource fairness
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of prioritization scheme and device based on the distribution of shared bicycle resource fairness, belongs to shared bicycle and uses field.Present invention is generally directed to user during shared bicycle use, shared bicycle resource is maliciously forcibly occupied, provides corresponding solution and clear and definite punitive measures.The wasting of resources can be effectively reduced, and it is really shared to realize shared bicycle.
assignees: ZHENGZHOU YUNHAI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Energy management method and system for comprehensive energy system of multiple micro energy networks
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for managing energy of a comprehensive energy system of a multi-micro energy network. Firstly, acquiring operation parameters of each microgrid in an integrated energy system; establishing an operation cost model of the alliance in a cooperation mode and an independent mode according to the operation parameters, and further establishing a utility function; the utility function is maximized by optimizing the model parameters to obtain optimized parameters; controlling the operation of each microgrid in the alliance according to the optimized parameters; and distributing the income obtained by each microgrid in the alliance according to the utility function. The method combines the electric heating demand response of the user side, comprehensively considers factors such as user comfort degree and optimization cost, constructs a cooperative game model formed by each micro-grid in the multi-micro energy network comprehensive energy system, and distributes profits according to contribution degrees of each member by using a shape value method while realizing the maximum profits, thereby effectively improving the profits of each member in the alliance, ensuring the fairness of distribution and reducing the operation cost of the system.

title_en: City public sports space fairness measurement method based on multi-source city data
abstract_en: The invention provides a city public sports space fairness measurement method based on multi-source city data, which comprises the following steps: acquiring main data such as residential building outlines, sports spaces, public transportation station POIs, urban road networks, public comments and the like; carrying out corresponding cleaning and classification processing on the data, and then establishing a database in ArcGIS; the method comprises the steps that urban residents are set to go out mainly by walking, driving and public transport, life circle concepts are used as limiting conditions, and an ArcGIS network analysis module is used as a technical means to conduct urban public sports space fairness measurement evaluation; and carrying out public sports space fairness measurement on a specific city to obtain a visual and quantifiable result. The method has fine and accurate result, can effectively evaluate the current situation of public sports space distribution, and can be used as reference information for urban sports space development planning.

title_en: Multi-group time sequence student cognitive diagnosis method based on joint probability model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-group time sequence student cognitive diagnosis method based on a joint probability model, which belongs to the field of education and comprises the following steps of obtaining student answer data, group classification labels and covariate data of at least two continuous time points, constructing the joint probability model according to the student answer data, the group classification labels and the covariate data, wherein the joint probability model comprises a structure model and a measurement model, the structure model is used for describing a dynamic change process of a potential knowledge mastering state of a student, the measurement model is used for establishing an association relation between the student answer data and the potential knowledge mastering state of the student at each time point, and analyzing based on the joint probability model to obtain the potential knowledge mastering state of the student. The invention can compare the differences of potential knowledge mastering states and response modes among a plurality of groups, and provides important basis for evaluating educational fairness and optimizing teaching strategies.

title_en: Power carbon emission dynamic distribution method based on multistage responsibility main body
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power systems and discloses a dynamic distribution method of electric carbon emission based on a multistage responsibility main body, which comprises the steps of firstly determining a dynamic carbon emission factor and calculating direct carbon emission based on real-time load data of a generator set; and finally, dividing the power network into multi-stage responsibility bodies, calculating regional carbon emission factors of the bodies according to the node carbon emission factors, and calculating indirect carbon emission by combining the net electricity consumption of the regional carbon emission factors, thereby realizing dynamic and accurate distribution of carbon emission responsibility. The invention solves the problems of inaccurate and unbroken responsibility allocation of the traditional accounting method, improves the accuracy and fairness of allocation through dynamic factors and multistage tracing, and provides scientific basis for guiding the emission reduction of a user side and promoting the new energy consumption.

title_en: Retail user green electricity consumption measuring method and system based on electricity consumption scale and performance consistency
abstract_en: The invention relates to a retail user green electricity consumption measuring method and system based on consistency of electricity consumption scale and performance, which are used for solving the problems that the existing green electricity distribution mechanism excessively depends on contract electricity quantity, multiple iterative redistribution risks exist, and actual consumption contribution of users is difficult to fairly embody. According to the method, firstly, an index for calculating the green electricity consumption capability of the user is formed from two key dimensions of the planned electricity consumption scale and the contract performance consistency. Further, an initial allocation proportion is determined according to the green electricity consumption capability index, a minimized allocation deviation optimization model is introduced, constraint conditions such as practical upper power limit of a user, green electricity consumption capability sequencing consistency and the like are considered, and one-time fair and efficient allocation of green electricity resources is realized. The method overcomes the limitation that the traditional method relies on physical tide tracking or single contract electric quantity distribution, fully considers the actual influence of the electricity consumption behavior of the user on green electricity consumption, has fairness, excitation and engineering feasibility, and has good practical value.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle communication system and resource allocation strategy prediction method based on neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a resource allocation strategy prediction method based on a neural network, which comprises the following steps: 1. building a wireless communication base station of the unmanned aerial vehicle and a user downlink transmission system; 2. acquiring wireless communication base stations and user positions of unmanned aerial vehicles; 3. determining an evaluation index corresponding to the communication resource allocation strategy and acquiring the weight of the evaluation index corresponding to the communication resource allocation strategy; 4. acquiring an optimal communication resource allocation strategy of the unmanned aerial vehicle wireless communication base station; 5. acquiring training data; 6. establishing and training an LSTM neural network model; 7. prediction of communication resource allocation policies for unmanned aerial vehicle wireless communication base stations. The method has simple steps and reasonable design, realizes the prediction of the power and bandwidth resource allocation of the wireless communication base station of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and realizes the maximization of the throughput of the communication system and the satisfaction of the fairness of the resource allocation.

title_en: A method of the automatic row that has furniture made to order based on ERP system is single
abstract_en: The single method of automatic row that the invention discloses a kind of based on ERP system having furniture made to order, comprising the following steps: S1, in ERP system, to hand marker when single under order module business personnel, system records order attributes when order is submitted；S2, labeled order attributes order be submitted to check of drawings module, it is to be allocated that order enters check of drawings order pond to be arranged etc..The present invention is on the basis of process research singulated to Furniture manufacture, by analyzing singulated working characteristics, the workflow of singulated row's list is optimized, it will be repeated using computerized algorithm, the work of standard is summarized as arranging single algorithm, when arranging single, system transfers order data automatically, quick, fining a distribution function is provided for the singulated work of furniture, it ensure that the working efficiency of singulated personnel, and singulated distributional equity, it improves work efficiency, avoid it is time-consuming and laborious, increase cost of labor the case where occur.
assignees: GUANGZHOU KUJIANG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Emergency management and rescue platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses emergency management and rescue platforms, comprising: monitoring system, for acquiring the information in monitored environmental area；Communication system, for sending and receiving the information of monitoring system acquisition；Command system receives the information that communication system is sent, is handled, and send order command；Article dispatches system, receives the order command that command system is sent, and relief supplies are transported to the environmental area of monitoring；Rescue system receives the order command that command system is sent, and is rescued.The present invention can greatly reduce the casualties and reduction property loss when disaster and accident generation, improve rescue efficiency when disaster and accident occur.
assignees: UNIV TIANJIN SCIENCE & TECH;TIANJIN DUOZHI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-microgrid transaction optimization method and system under credit risk
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-microgrid transaction optimization method and system under credit risk, wherein the credit level of each microgrid main body is calculated based on historical transaction information of the microgrid main body; determining constraint conditions and optimization targets of a multi-microgrid transaction optimization problem under the credit risk, and establishing a transaction optimization model; considering the discreteness and continuity of variables, decomposing the multi-microgrid optimization model into a main problem for solving a microgrid transaction combination and a sub problem for solving a microgrid transaction plan considering the uncertainty of the credit level; and solving the decomposed main problem and sub-problem by using a column and constraint generation algorithm to obtain an optimal trading plan, and determining the electricity purchasing and selling state and the electricity quantity of each microgrid. The invention can improve the economy and fairness of multi-microgrid power transaction.

title_en: Barrier-free VR teaching resource color optimization method for people with abnormal color vision
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of teaching application of information technology, and provides a barrier-free VR teaching resource color optimization method for people with abnormal color vision, which comprises the following steps: (1) constructing a color cognition factor system; (2) constructing a color evaluation model; (3) and generating a color scheme optimization model. The method comprehensively considers the requirements of people with abnormal color vision, designs various types of tasks and analyzes the color cognition difference; constructing a color evaluation model by using an ensemble learning method; and (4) firstly dividing color patches on the image and then screening the scheme to optimize the color scheme. The invention is beneficial to non-professional persons to design and optimize VR teaching resources, achieves the universality of the color scheme and meets the fairness requirement of education resources.

title_en: Regional source load coordination scheduling method considering carbon emission cumulative entropy
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regional source load coordination scheduling method considering carbon emission cumulative entropy, and relates to the field of power system scheduling and management. A regional source load coordinated scheduling method considering carbon emission accumulated entropy comprises the following steps: the energy management system comprises a communication interface module, an energy management optimization module and an algorithm solving module; the communication interface module transmits generator set information and load side information at the power generation side; the energy management optimization module establishes a double-layer optimization scheduling model considering the source-load coordination of the comprehensive cost and the carbon emission cumulative entropy, the double-layer optimization scheduling model comprises an upper layer model and a lower layer model, and the carbon emission generated by the power generation side is reduced to the load side, so that the obtained scheduling scheme can take the fairness of the carbon emission responsibility apportionment of the load side into consideration on the basis of improving the system operation economy. The scheduling scheme provided by the invention can give consideration to the fairness of load side carbon emission responsibility allocation on the basis of improving the system operation economy.

title_en: Fairness-considered personal travel carbon transaction distribution method, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a personal travel carbon transaction distribution method, equipment and medium considering fairness. The method solves the problems that a carbon transaction mechanism in the transportation field does not have a fair and reasonable allocation method and does not consider a carbon quota price forming mechanism.
assignees: INSTITUTE OF TRANSP DEVELOPMENT STRATEGY & PLANNING OF SICHUAN PROVINCE;UNIV SOUTHWEST JIAOTONG

title_en: Bad asset subcontracting method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bad asset sub-packaging method and a system, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining bad asset data and object data to be allocated, wherein the bad asset data comprises the total number of cases of the bad asset and the total amount of the bad asset, and the object data to be allocated comprises the object information to be allocated, the target amount proportion and the target amount proportion; generating target amount, target quantity and ratio of the target amount to the target quantity of the objects to be distributed according to the bad asset data and the data of the objects to be distributed; taking the ratio of the target amount of each object to be allocated to the target number as an ideal bad asset allocation mean value of the objects to be allocated, and sequentially allocating the bad assets to the objects to be allocated which are closest to the ratio of the target amount to the target number after receiving the bad assets; and extracting the bad asset detail distributed by each object to be distributed. The bad asset subcontracting method and the bad asset subcontracting system have the advantages of flexibility, fairness and rapidity of distribution.
assignees: SHANGHAI RONGSHU INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Vehicle network interactive pricing strategy system based on energy transaction model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle-network interactive pricing strategy system based on an energy transaction model, relates to the technical field of vehicle-network interactive pricing, and solves the technical problem that the prior art lacks research on balanced benefit distribution of three parties and cannot realize balanced benefit distribution of a power grid dispatching center, an agent and an EV. The method comprises the steps of respectively establishing energy transaction models of EV users, agents and a power grid dispatching center; based on the energy transaction model, analyzing and establishing objective functions of EV users, agents and a power grid dispatching center, and establishing an objective function of a vehicle-network interaction system; according to market transaction data, solving an optimal solution of an objective function of the vehicle network interaction system by utilizing an optimization method, namely, outputting a pricing strategy; the balanced benefit distribution of the power grid dispatching center, the agent and the EV users is realized; and the adoption of the blockchain technology ensures the high security of the transaction environment and meets the requirements of various market bodies on the aspects of trust, fairness, privacy and the like.
assignees: HEFEI YUANLI ZHONGHE ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Land resource space optimization configuration method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of land resource management, in particular to a land resource space optimization configuration method and a land resource space optimization configuration system, which comprise the following steps: dividing grid cells based on a land research area, setting an initial land utilization state of each cell, updating the land utilization type by comparing land suitability of adjacent cells, recursively calculating the change in each time step, and iteratively executing transfer regulation to obtain a land utilization change state sequence. According to the invention, the land utilization state is calculated and updated in a recursion manner, the land utilization dynamics is simulated, the data continuity and the regional adaptability are enhanced, the data and environmental factor feedback is regulated by combining the vacancy value filling and the neural network, the prediction precision and the trend judging capability are improved, the land use proportion and the space layout are optimized by quantifying economic, social and ecological benefits, the land resource allocation efficiency is improved, the differential decision support is provided by combining the policy regulation and the scene simulation, and the social fairness and the efficient utilization of resources are promoted.
assignees: THE EIGHTH GEOLOGICAL BRIGADE OF SHANDONG PROVINCIAL BUREAU OF GEOLOGY AND MINERAL EXPLORATION AND D

title_en: Cooperative optimization method and device for urban village property safety and space reconstruction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cooperative optimization method and device for urban village property safety and space reconstruction, and relates to the technical field of urban updating and space management. The method is used for solving the problems that the conflict stacking of property rights is complex, the extrusion risk of low-income tenants is high, and the space scheme is difficult to integrate. The method comprises the steps of integrating cadastral data, a three-dimensional building model and income distribution information to generate a title conflict distribution diagram, simulating multi-class title disposal paths and space constraint thereof based on the conflict diagram, calculating the release space and volume rate compensation requirement of illegal construction and disassembly, outputting a space decoupling diagram, inputting the decoupling diagram into a risk model, predicting the loss scale of tenants and the fracture risk of social networks to generate a risk early warning diagram, constructing a three-party income distribution model of governments, villagers and developers, dynamically adjusting the proportion of guarantee rooms, and iteratively optimizing an updating scheme to form a collaborative scheme package considering fairness and space efficiency.

title_en: Multi-objective optimized water resource allocation scheduling method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-objective optimized water resource allocation scheduling method, which combines an LSTM-Prophet mixed prediction model with an attention mechanism, synchronously captures the characteristics of climate periodicity, policy regulation sensitivity and industry development trend in water demand prediction, and improves the water demand prediction precision through a genetic algorithm. The improved NSGA-III algorithm and PSO collaborative optimization mechanism is combined with the chaotic mapping technology, so that the convergence problem of a high-dimensional target space is effectively solved, and the multi-target optimization efficiency is improved by 40% by matching with a dynamic weight adjustment strategy of deep reinforcement learning. The multi-scenario simulation verification of the scheduling scheme is realized by utilizing the deep coupling of the digital twin system and the three-dimensional GIS, and the real-time feedback correction mechanism of the Markov decision process is further utilized. The finally constructed entropy weight-TOPSIS multidimensional evaluation system combines AR visualization and intelligent contract tracing technology, and provides a pareto optimal solution which gives consideration to social fairness, economic benefit and ecological integrity for decision makers.
assignees: YELLOW RIVER ENGINEERING CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Outbound service case allocation method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an outbound service case allocation method and device, based on a neural network model, the potential relation between the combination of outbound service cases and seats and the case completion result is deeply excavated, the probability of completing the case target of all case allocation combinations is predicted by using the deep neural network model, a network flow graph is constructed based on the prediction result, and the optimal allocation combination between the cases and the seats is found, so that the appropriate cases are allocated to the appropriate seats, the fairness of case allocation is ensured, the completion rate of the case target can be improved, and the working enthusiasm of the seats is improved.
assignees: DINGFU NEW POWER BEIJING INTELLIGENT SCIENCE AND TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Method for distributing credible power generation capacity of wind-solar-water complementary power generation system based on cooperative game
abstract_en: The application discloses a method for distributing the credible power generation capacity of a wind-light-water complementary power generation system based on cooperative game. The application is based on the mixed integer programming credible generating capacity cooperative game distribution strategy, can solve the problem that the MCRS method distribution scheme is not necessarily in the problem core solution domain and the core model constraint scale is overlarge, can reduce the invalid constraint of the distribution model by introducing binary variables into the scheduling model to traverse all sub-alliance combination scenes, reduce the solving scale of the distribution model and seek the distribution scheme in the core of the problem; the application takes the MCRS method as a cooperative gain allocation strategy of the iterative initial value, further iterates and optimizes the allocation scheme on the basis of reasonable allocation results, and can greatly improve the rationality, fairness and high efficiency of allocation.

title_en: Thermal power plant carbon quota allocation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of carbon quota allocation, in particular to a carbon quota allocation method for a thermal power plant, which can realize carbon quota allocation with efficiency as a target by using DEA, and is characterized in that the total amount of annual carbon quota allocation of an emission reduction target is t, n power plants of a traditional power generation type are provided, and each thermal power plant comprises three inputs, two expected outputs and one unexpected output; wherein investment includes energy, capital, labor, etc.; the expected output includes the power generation amount, the heat supply amount, and the like; the undesirable output is carbon emissions; the method specifically comprises the following steps: objective function, constraint, and carbon quota allocation algorithm that combines efficiency and fairness. Aiming at the electric heating requirements, the structural characteristics of the thermal power plant, the actual requirements such as carbon quota allocation of the thermal power plant and the like, a carbon quota basic allocation model with efficiency as a target is established by utilizing DEA, and the efficiency and fairness of the thermal power plant are considered on the basis of guaranteeing the safety of electric heating supply by combining a Tamu-compensation fair iterative allocation mechanism.

title_en: SKU asset management-based cost accounting system
abstract_en: The application relates to a cost accounting system based on SKU asset management, which is applied to the technical field of asset management and comprises the steps of realizing classified management, SKU attribute definition, asset price calculation and dynamic update of assets by constructing an asset price management system based on SKU, supporting a multidimensional pricing strategy and being capable of adapting to a scene of dynamic change of the assets, and simultaneously, in the cost accounting process, different allocation modes can be adopted according to user requirements to carry out allocation instead of a simple average allocation mode, so that the fairness and flexibility of the accounting are improved.

title_en: A kind of single method of anti-brush, server and client side
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of single method of anti-brush, server and client side, this method is applied to server, including：Counted according to the log-on message of user, the account or equipment that non-one-one relationship between login account and logging device be present are stored in sensitive storehouse；The peripheral equipment scanning information that logging device obtains according to predetermined period is obtained, and is matched with the account in the sensitive storehouse and equipment；According to matching result, the account or equipment are closed if in the presence of following account or equipment：The account or equipment match in the predetermined period of predetermined number with the account in sensitive storehouse or equipment.The present invention solves the problems, such as that dispatching person carries out competition for orders by more equipment, guarantees fairness, while lift customer experience.

title_en: Order distribution processing method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an order distribution processing method and device, and relates to the field of warehouse logistics. One embodiment of the method comprises the following steps: responding to the scanning receiving operation of the dispatcher on the first order through the terminal equipment, and determining the current receiving operation time point; acquiring the information of a receiver in the first order, searching an order set corresponding to the information of the receiver from the rest of to-be-distributed order sets, and searching a second order with an inbound operation time point earlier than the current receiving operation time point from the order set; and sending the information of the first order and the second order to the terminal equipment so that the dispatcher can carry out the distribution processing on the first order and the second order. The implementation mode is strictly based on the calculation principle that the dispatcher receives goods while standing, the calculation principle is bound with the delivery frequency of the dispatcher to be used as a charging calculation basis, and the calculation principle is irrelevant to the arrival batch of vehicles, so that fairness and transparency of an operation process are realized, and meanwhile, the real-time reminding function is realized, and order missing operation is avoided.
assignees: BEIJING JINGDONG ZHENSHI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Distributed energy scheduling method for interconnected multi-park comprehensive energy system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed energy scheduling method of an interconnected multi-park comprehensive energy system, which comprises the following steps: establishing an equipment output model; establishing a comprehensive demand response model; establishing a waste heat interaction and electric energy interaction model among parks; establishing a park energy balance constraint model; constructing a multi-park comprehensive energy system objective function by taking the lowest total running cost as a target; and solving an objective function by using a regularized alternating direction multiplier algorithm containing a self-adaptive step length link. According to the invention, a waste heat interaction model, an electric energy interaction model and a comprehensive demand response model are established, so that the energy utilization efficiency and the scheduling flexibility are improved; according to the method, the regularized alternating direction multiplier algorithm with the self-adaptive step length links is used for carrying out distributed solving on the multi-park comprehensive energy system scheduling model, regularization can be used for avoiding excessive freedom in the solving process while guaranteeing fairness of the sub-problems, the self-adaptive step length links are added to improve the convergence speed of the algorithm, and the privacy of each park can be protected in the iterative process during distributed solving.

title_en: Supply chain optimization method and system based on digital rights and interests products
abstract_en: The application relates to a supply chain optimization method and a supply chain optimization system based on digital equity products, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining the product acquisition quantity and the product verification quantity of the digital equity products, carrying out product supply planning on the digital equity products to obtain supply plan data, obtaining supply plan and supply operation data of all suppliers, carrying out supply plan matching processing on each supplier, selecting the supplier with the highest matching degree, obtaining supply plan data related to the supply plan data, analyzing the supply association relation between the supply plan data and the supply plan data, constructing a supply chain management model of the digital equity products by combining with peer marketing data of the similar products, obtaining supply performance data of each supplier in the supply process, inputting the supply performance data into the supply chain management model for supply capacity assessment, and carrying out supply optimization processing according to the assessment result. The application has the effect of improving the supply timeliness of the digital rights and interests products.

title_en: Path-based green land fairness evaluation method and device
abstract_en: The application discloses a green land fairness evaluation method and device based on a path, and relates to the field of urban ecological planning and evaluation, comprising the steps of acquiring green land characteristic data and individual activity data of an area to be evaluated; the green land feature data comprises remote sensing image data and street view image data, the individual activity data comprises population density distribution and individual activity position time sequence sets, activity paths of all the collected individuals are determined according to the individual activity position time sequence sets, green land coverage indexes corresponding to the activity paths of all the collected individuals are calculated according to the remote sensing image data based on the activity paths of all the collected individuals, street green vision rates corresponding to the activity paths of all the collected individuals are calculated according to the street view image data, comprehensive green land exposure indexes of all the collected individuals are calculated according to the population density distribution and by combining the green land coverage indexes and the street green vision rates, and green land fair assessment results of an area to be assessed are obtained according to the comprehensive green land exposure indexes of all the collected individuals and based on a base coefficient and a Talc coefficient.
assignees: HARBIN INSTITUTE OF TECH SHENZHEN INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECH INNOVATION

title_en: New energy digital twin skill training platform based on wind turbine generator
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of new energy skill training and discloses a new energy digital twin skill training platform based on a wind turbine generator. According to the application, the operation flow and the maintenance process of the wind turbine generator can be simulated in a virtual-real combination mode, real-time guidance and quantitative evaluation are provided, meanwhile, the data linkage of training and safety management is realized, the learning efficiency and examination fairness are ensured, the practical training environment is optimized, and comprehensive, safe and efficient skill training support is provided for students.
assignees: SHAANXI HUADIAN NEW ENERGY POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for distributing rights and interests of park enterprises
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for distributing rights and interests of a park enterprise, which are applied to the technical field of rights and interests distribution, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining data; the method comprises the steps of performing feature extraction processing on photovoltaic power generation data to obtain a photovoltaic power generation curve, performing feature extraction processing on the power utilization data to obtain an enterprise power utilization curve, processing the photovoltaic power generation curve and the enterprise power utilization curve by utilizing a dynamic time warping technology to obtain power utilization curve matching degree, inputting the power utilization curve matching degree, historical green electricity consumption data and acquired green evidence transaction contracts into a constructed equity distribution model to process, obtaining equity distribution indexes of a plurality of enterprises, processing the equity distribution indexes of the enterprises, and performing equity distribution on the enterprises in a target park based on the obtained equity distribution proportion. The method provided by the invention can solve the technical problem of uneven distribution of rights and interests in the park caused by neglecting the intermittence and fluctuation of green electricity, so as to realize the technical effects of equitable and accurate rights and interests distribution.
assignees: ZHEJIANG POWER EXCHANGE CENTER CO LIMITED

title_en: System for village-oriented disaster response intelligent unmanned information terminal
title_ko: 마을 중심의 재난대응 지능형 무인 정보 단말 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a village-centered disaster response intelligent unmanned information terminal system that enables optimal response within the golden time, such as rapid disaster situation dissemination and distribution of relief supplies, through a village-centered independent disaster response system in a village with low accessibility and insufficient transportation infrastructure, in the event of a disaster. More specifically, the village-centered disaster response intelligent unmanned information terminal system according to the present invention includes a disaster response system server that provides various disaster information, including nuclear power plant accidents and natural disasters, in real time to an unmanned information terminal when a disaster occurs, and an unmanned information terminal that is installed in a public facility including a village hall, a senior center, etc., and receives disaster information from the disaster response system server when a disaster occurs, disseminates the disaster situation, and distributes relief supplies.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 접근성이 낮고 교통 인프라가 부족한 마을에 마을 중심의 독자적인 재난 대응 시스템을 통해 재난 발생 시, 신속한 재난 상황 전파 및 구호 물자 배포 등 골든타임 내 최적의 대응을 가능하게 하는 마을 중심의 재난대응 지능형 무인 정보 단말 시스템에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 본 발명에 따른 마을 중심의 재난대응 지능형 무인 정보 단말 시스템은, 재난 발생 시, 실시간으로 원전 사고 및 자연재난 등을 포함하는 다양한 재난정보를 무인정보 단말기로 제공하는 재난대응 시스템 서버 및 마을회관, 경로당 등을 포함하는 공동시설에 설치되어 재난 발생 시, 상기 재난대응 시스템 서버로부터 재난정보를 수신하여 재난 상황을 전파하고, 구호물자를 배포하기 위한 무인정보 단말기를 포함한다.

title_en: Method for Transparent and Fair Resource Distribution
abstract_en: A computer-implemented system for allocation of a series of picks amongst multiple selectors in a selection process is configured to use total picks data, number of selectors data, and picks per selector data to determine a series of benchmark pick slots for each selector in accordance with a benchmark, for each selector, calculating a pick cost for awarding a pick position to the selector, awarding said pick position to the selector for whom the pick cost would least deviate the system from the benchmark and storing said pick cost of awarding said pick, and then iterating through the remainder of the draft using pick cost to determine who picks next, ensuring maximum fairness in the pick order. The system also manages the draft itself once the pick order is determined. It can assign value to the items chosen. It awards, or deducts, points from participants based upon their receiving picks that are better or worse than they should have, and for the quality of the items they have chosen.

title_en: Multi-class cheating identification and traceability analysis method for network security CTF competition
abstract_en: The invention relates to a network security CTF competition multi-class cheating identification and traceability analysis method, and belongs to the technical field of network security. The method comprises the steps of firstly monitoring a player match answering process and recording logs, then analyzing logically abnormal players of an answering step by using a finite state machine, judging the abnormal players when the answering step is used based on normal distribution, providing a player relevance calculating method according to flag submitting time, finding suspected high-similarity players, analyzing and tracing cheating sources of the players, finally collecting and comprehensively judging the answering logs of the suspected players Writeup in new and old environments, and outputting cheating identification results and analysis reports. The method effectively identifies cheating behaviors of replacing the marks or solving the problem of other players in the CTF competition, positions the suspected similar players, can collect multi-dimensional characteristic comprehensive comparison analysis of the suspected players, outputs more convincing judging results and cheating analysis reports, and ensures fairness of the competition.

title_en: Transformer-based person post matching method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a person post matching method, a system, equipment and a medium based on a Transformer, which belong to the technical field of natural language processing and human resource management cross application, and the technical problem to be solved by the invention is how to reduce subjective errors in the person post matching process, improve the accuracy, fairness and objectivity of matching and improve the efficiency of manual matching; the text preprocessing comprises the steps of preprocessing collected and tidied post description texts and resume texts, obtaining preprocessed post description texts and resume texts, fusing a transducer and a BERT model, constructing a encoder-decoder structure based on the transducer, optimizing the model, classifying multi-label texts, constructing a multi-label classification system, and outputting and evaluating a matching result.

title_en: Warning and analyzing method for power facility damage based on meteorological data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a warning and analyzing method for power facility damage based on meteorological data, comprising the following steps: collecting meteorological, geological and hydrological information of an area where grid equipment is located in real time; matching the monitored meteorological, geological and hydrological data information with grid lines or the grid equipment and storing the monitored meteorological, geological and hydrological data information; extracting meteorological data, power facility data and facility damage historical data; setting a warning threshold, and carrying out warning for and evaluating and displaying major meteorological disasters in the area where the grid equipment is located; integrating the extracted data, and analyzing the probability of facility damage based on the data after integration; comparing the result of analysis with the warning threshold, and issuing a warning instruction if the result of power facility analysis exceeds the threshold; and allocating, deploying and commanding emergency personnel, emergency vehicles and emergency supplies online according to the warning content, the level of warning and the level of emergencies.
assignees: JIANGSU LIWEIXUN ELECTRICAL TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Multi-level carbon emission right allocation method and system based on carbon marginal utility
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-level carbon emission right distribution method and a system based on carbon marginal utility, wherein the method comprises the following steps: according to the historical carbon emission data, performing optimal distribution of the carbon emission in the class for a plurality of enterprises; calculating marginal utility of various enterprises under equal allocation of resources among classes according to the optimal allocation result of the efficiency in the classes, and constructing a fair efficiency allocation model; solving a fairness efficiency distribution model to obtain fairness efficiency distribution results under different classification numbers, and determining enterprise classification results according to the ratio of efficiency loss to fairness loss under different classification numbers; classifying various enterprises and establishing a multi-level enterprise carbon quota pool; constructing a multi-stage carbon emission quota decision model based on a Markov decision process, and solving the multi-stage carbon emission quota decision model to obtain an optimal decision scheme; setting the carbon quota amount of each enterprise according to the optimal decision scheme; and the carbon emission rights are distributed by taking the marginal utility of the enterprise carbon as a measure index, so that the rationality and fairness of the carbon emission rights distribution are ensured.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD METROLOGY CENTER

title_en: Intelligent system suitable for evaluating comprehensive performance of power plant team
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent system suitable for evaluating the comprehensive performance of a group in a power plant, and relates to the technical field of big data intelligent management, comprising the following steps of inputting a group name, claiming a card punching record of the group and sending the card punching record to a computing device; the method comprises the steps of calculating month evaluation scores and annual average performance scores of all people in the teams, obtaining comprehensive capacity scores by all people in the teams according to answer scores in an answer device, calculating total scores of a plurality of staff to be annual total scores of the teams, calculating final performance scores of the teams by combining the annual total score ranking of all teams from nine aspects, calculating final performance scores of all teams after the annual total scores of all teams are ranked, and obtaining final total scores and ranking according to the final performance scores and the annual total scores. The intelligent system is suitable for evaluating the comprehensive performance of the teams in the power plant, increases the evaluation data sources and evaluation indexes, increases the calculation weight of basic staff, and optimizes the evaluation process and fairness of the teams.
assignees: CHN ENERGY GUIZHOU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Energy consumption analysis method and system based on micro-grid resource physical digital space model
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy consumption analysis method and system based on a physical digital space model of a micro-grid resource, wherein the method is used for constructing the physical digital space model of the micro-grid resource by acquiring first monitoring data of distributed energy equipment and second monitoring data of electric equipment in the micro-grid and fusing the data; constructing a distributed energy trading platform based on a blockchain based on the model; integrating an energy consumption tracing function in the transaction platform, constructing an energy consumption tracing tree model, further calculating the energy consumption contribution degree of each distributed energy device and the energy utilization responsibility sharing proportion of each electric device, generating an energy consumption tracing report and uploading a chain storage certificate; according to the invention, by constructing the energy consumption traceability tree model, the fine traceability and responsibility sharing of the micro-grid energy flow can be realized, accurate data support is provided for energy consumption analysis and management, and the transparency and fairness of micro-grid energy management are remarkably improved.
assignees: Jiangsu electric power information technology co ltd

title_en: Intelligent decision and priority distribution system for wound rescue
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wound rescue, in particular to an intelligent decision and priority distribution system for wound rescue, which comprises the steps of collecting original rescue data; the method comprises the steps of preprocessing original rescue data to obtain preprocessed rescue data, processing the preprocessed rescue data through a deep learning model to obtain shock probability, damage type and environment physiological associated data, calculating ISS total score priority in an associated mode by using the shock probability, the damage type and the environment physiological associated data, generating a patient priority list according to the ISS total score priority, and distributing resources to the patient priority with the highest score in the patient priority list. According to the invention, the patient injury scores are dynamically generated through the deep learning model, medical resources are automatically allocated according to the score high-low ordering, and the optimal route of the ambulance is generated by combining the GIS map, so that critical patients can be treated preferentially, and the fairness and timeliness of rescue are improved.

title_en: Unmanned vehicle-machine collaborative scheduling method and system under post-earthquake damaged road
abstract_en: The invention provides a collaborative scheduling method and system for unmanned vehicles and unmanned aerial vehicles under a post-earthquake damaged road, which belong to the technical field of earthquake disaster rescue scheduling. And constructing a comprehensive objective function by taking the shortest total rescue time, the highest rescue material distribution fairness and the highest wounded transferring efficiency as targets. And solving the comprehensive objective function based on the road condition change, the demand data and the carrier state to obtain the rescue material transportation and wounded transportation scheme after the unmanned aerial vehicle and the aircraft are cooperated to shake.
