Shortens the rescue and robs the time efficiency, realizes the multi-objective collaborative operation of unmanned vehicles and unmanned aerial vehicles, and improves the material delivery efficiency in the gold rescue period.

title_en: Method and system for determining local fairness of ml model with degree of fairness
abstract_en: State of the art model fairness approaches do not address the degree of local fairness of a ML model. A method and system for determining local fairness of a classification Machine Learning (ML) model with degree of fairness is disclosed. The method creates multiple perturb instances using multilevel GMM clustering approach and a constrained perturbation technique to ensure feature distribution of perturbed data, generated from a tabular base data is within the feature distribution of the tabular base data of the ML model. Further, the class of a protected attribute is flipped, black box model prediction probabilities and the cosine similarity constraint and multiplication factor on the probabilities is used to provide a degree of fairness for the local instance. Thus, provides magnitude of fairness or unfairness to the local instance.

title_en: System and method for optimizing product development portfolios and aligning product, brand, and information technology strategies
abstract_en: Business and software methods are described for cost-effectively optimizing product development portfolios, services development portfolios, and IT (information technology) portfolios, accelerating market entry, and optimizing alignment between product strategy, IT strategy, and brand strategy. Product and service attributes are characterized, categorized, and prioritized with numerical values amenable to statistical analysis of each assessed product development/IT initiative in terms of alignment with ideal customer experience and potential competitive impact relative to the resources and risks required to bring each initiative to market. Methods further include prioritization in the form of applied decision intelligence tools to allow an organization to reach better-informed judgments concerning resource allocation to develop, maintain, or optimize a given product or service portfolio or IT portfolio to improve business performance, increase market impact, and build brand equity.

title_en: Automatic scoring system and method based on smart power grid dispatching control system
abstract_en: The automatic scoring system comprises a plurality of examination systems and at least one judge system, wherein scoring points and scoring bases are deployed in the judge system, and the judge system is in communication connection with the examination systems and can conduct mutual remote data retrieval; the actual result of the examinee operation generated by the examination system is graded in a mode of real-time library comparison, standard configuration file and system parameter comparison, non-standard file comparison, relational library comparison and manual judgment by a judge after the files are uploaded to the judge system; the comprehensive evaluation on the operation of the examinees is realized, so that the accuracy and comprehensiveness of the evaluation are greatly improved, a large amount of manpower, material resources and time cost are saved, the resource waste is avoided, and the fairness of the examination are improved.
assignees: TECH COLLEGE BRANCH OF STATE GRID CORPORATION;Shandong electric power college;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Dynamic allocation method for supplies on airplane
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic supply allocation method on an airplane, which comprises the following steps: s1 preparation before preparation; s2 preparation rule conditions: screening all flight conditions and condition parameters related to the flight conditions; s3 calculation rule formulation: establishing a calculation rule for each supply in the flight according to the flight condition and the condition parameter; s4 begins with: inputting flight conditions, loading calculation rules by a rule engine, and loading condition parameters at the same time; the compiler associates the calculation rule with the condition parameter; the resolver executes the calculation rule of each supply according to the calculation rule and outputs the calculation result of each supply; s5 supply manifest generation: judging whether the number of the supplies is greater than 0, if so, continuing to generate the next supply, otherwise, rejecting the supply and continuing to generate the next supply, and completing the supply list; s6, supply preparation on the machine, the invention does not need to make a guarantee template any more, can rapidly make a supply list, and improves the working efficiency.
assignees: XIAMEN CIVIL AVIATION CARES CO LTD

title_en: Digital rights near-field real-time verification and verification system and method based on edge calculation
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of information and discloses a digital equity near-field real-time verification system based on edge calculation, which comprises a space-time coding module, a dynamic weight module, a blockchain segmentation module and a verification execution module, wherein the space-time coding module is used for generating a unique verification identifier according to the geographic position and time of a user and transmitting the identifier to the dynamic weight module, the dynamic weight module is connected with the space-time coding module, generates equity distribution strategies based on a federal learning model and an optimization algorithm and outputs the optimized strategies to the blockchain segmentation module, the blockchain segmentation module is connected with the dynamic weight module, dynamically divides a consensus network according to the real-time verification density, executes distributed verification in segments and generates verification authorization instructions, and the verification execution module distributes verification tasks according to the authorization instructions and synchronously updates the point inventory state. By adopting the technical scheme of meshing coordinate mapping, time window division and nonlinear hash of the space-time coding module, the technical effects of unpredictable and unique binding of the verification identifier are achieved.
assignees: HEBEI CHENDING HUAYUN TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Cooperative collaboration mutual compensation partnership enterprise network(ccmc pen) formation method and virtual partnership enterprise management and operation method
title_ko: 조합식 협업 상호보상 파트너쉽 기업 네트워크 구성 방법과 파트너쉽 가상 기업 관리 운영 방법
abstract_en: A method for forming a CCMC(Cooperative Collaboration Mutual Compensation) PEN(Partnership Enterprise Network) and the method for managing virtual partnership enterprises are provided to make interested persons to join in as a member, collect, open, and share information needed for all online/offline economical activities with each other, progress a project through collaboration, and divide profits fairly to each member. An organization of a CCMC partnership enterprise is formed by a CEO(Chief Executive Officer), a manager, and a staff. Respective joined partners progress a cooperated project with the managers in the capacity of the CEO by enabling the joined partner to invite the predetermined number of other partners as the manager. The invited manager invites the predetermined number of staffs to form the CCMC partnership enterprise as the CEO. A virtual company is formed by one CEO, the predetermined number of managers, and the predetermined number of staffs.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 웹 2.0 비즈니스 트렌드에 기반을 두고 모든 사람이 각자 전문분야의 비즈니스 또는 프로젝트 추진을 위하여 참여 공유 협업 할 파트너를 초청하면서 구성 되는 파트너쉽 기업 네트워크의 형성 방법과, 파트너가 설립한 가상기업의 CEO 로서 참여 협업하는 파트너와 함께 프로젝트를 추진하는 방법과, 파트너쉽 가상기업 경영 관리 시스템을 포함한 조합식 협업 상호보상 파트너쉽 기업의 Peer to Peer 네트워크 구성 방법에 관한 것이다. 또한 파트너쉽 가상 기업으로 구성된 Peer to Peer (P2P) 기업네트워크를 통하여 구현되는 파트너 B2B 및 B2C(쇼핑몰 등) 의 운영관리 방법 과 파트너가 제공하는 제품 및 서비스 거래에 참여하여 원가 및 판매가 정보를 공개 공유하면서 수익을 상호 분배하는 시스템 운영에 관한 것이다. 
     본 발명의 요약된 제목인 CCMC PEN 은  Cooperative (조합),  Collaboration (협업),  Mutual (상호),  Compensation  (보상)  Partnership  (파트너쉽)  Enterprise  (기업)  Network  의 약자로 유사한 산업 및 서비스 업체들이 공동의 이익을 위해 모이는 협동 조합의 의미와 모인 조합원들이 같은 목적 달성을 위해 참여 공유 협업( Collaboration ) 하고 이로 인하여 발생하는 이익을 공평하게 상호 보상하는 개념에 기반을 둔 파트너쉽 가상기업 P2P(Peer to Peer)네트워크를 구성하고 관리 운영하는 방법에 대한 것이다. 
       
     웹 2.0, 파트너쉽, 가상기업, CEO, 조합, 협업, 상호보상, B2B, B2C, 공개, 공유, 참여, 멘토, 멘티, OJP, 홈오피스, 구글, 쇼핑몰, ERP, Peer to Peer, P2P 네트워크,

title_en: Event prediction method and apparatus, and electronic device
abstract_en: An event prediction method and apparatus, and an electronic device, which are applied to a blockchain node. The method comprises: acquiring a prediction result input by a participant for a specified event and released on a blockchain, wherein the input moment of the prediction result is earlier than the occurrence moment of an actual result of the specified event (102); releasing a corresponding comparison result to the blockchain by comparing the prediction result with the actual result (104); and invoking a smart contract for asset allocation in the blockchain, wherein the smart contract is used for reading the comparison result so as to send an allocation instruction to an off-chain object according to the comparison result, and the allocation instruction is used for instructing the off-chain object to allocate a first off-chain equity credential to the participant (106).

title_en: Automatic power generation control method and device based on bidding auxiliary service market
abstract_en: The invention relates to an automatic power generation control method based on a bidding auxiliary service market, and belongs to the technical field of automatic power generation control. Determining regional regulation requirements according to the current period of a unit and the current ACE value of a power grid; determining the adjusting gear of the unit output and the unit participating in adjustment under the limiting value type according to the preset limiting value type, the regional adjusting requirement and the quotation interval table obtained according to the quotation sequence table of each power plant; and according to the output command value of the adjusting gear computer unit, issuing the command value to the unit participating in adjustment, and executing the command value by the unit participating in adjustment. The invention considers that under different periods of a heating period and a non-heating period, a dynamic upper limit mode and a dynamic lower limit mode are newly added on the basis of the original telemetry upper limit and the static lower limit of the AGC; and providing a plurality of sets of dynamic control limit values, and calculating the active command values of the controllers of all the units. The auxiliary service market is optimized by considering bidding quotation and fairness principles.

title_en: Task configuration method, device, system, storage medium and computer equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a task configuration method, a device, a system, a storage medium and computer equipment, and relates to the technical field of Internet. The method comprises the following steps: receiving a task configuration request, wherein the task configuration request carries a task issuer identification, a task type and a resource configuration limit of a target task; matching a target integral pool and/or target equity resources for the target task according to the task publisher identification and the task type, wherein the target integral pool is configured with at least one item of equity resources; and distributing the points and/or the target equity resources in the target point-of-interest pool to the target task according to the resource allocation quota so as to complete the allocation of the target task. The method improves the task configuration efficiency, saves the screening time when the task publisher manually configures the resources, improves the task configuration accuracy, meets the task configuration requirements of the task publisher, and enables the resources configured by the target task to have diversity and pertinence.
assignees: KOUBEI SHANGHAI INF TECH CO LTD

title_en: Block chain-based water resource management method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water resource management method based on a blockchain, which relates to the technical field of water resource management, and when a node initiates a transaction, each node suitable for the transaction is matched for the node according to the price, water quality and required water quantity of the node, so that the suitability of both transaction sides is ensured, the success probability of the transaction is improved, the formation of the transaction is effectively promoted, and the efficiency of the water right transaction on the blockchain is improved; according to the water consumption data, the water resource data, the transaction data and the industry data of each node in each period, analyzing the difference among the nodes, then analyzing whether the water resource allocation plan needs to be adjusted or not, simultaneously acquiring each node in a high consumption state, formulating a water saving scheme, improving the accuracy of water consumption evaluation of each area, providing reliable data reference for water resource allocation, improving the fairness of the water resource allocation, and reducing the waste of the water resource.
assignees: YANGZHOU ZHISHUI INTERNET OF THINGS CO LTD

title_en: Resource reservation method, electronic device, storage medium, and computer program product
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a resource reservation method, electronic equipment, a storage medium and a computer program product, and relates to the field of data processing. The resource reservation method comprises the steps of responding to a demand portrait of an initiator of a resource reservation request, determining the reservation priority of the initiator, wherein the resource reservation request is a request for the use permission of a target resource, the reservation priority represents the order of the initiator to obtain the use permission of the target resource, comparing the reservation priority of the initiator with a first mapping table, determining the resource level of a resource unit which can be reserved in the target resource by the initiator, recording the corresponding relation between the reservation priority and the resource level in the first mapping table, and distributing the use permission of the resource unit corresponding to the resource level to the initiator. According to the technical scheme, the fairness of resource allocation is guaranteed while the differentiated requirements are met in the resource reservation process.

title_en: Multi-district electric automobile cluster scheduling system based on network management
abstract_en: The application discloses a multi-zone electric automobile cluster scheduling system based on network management, which comprises a model execution unit, a cluster management and control unit and a consistency maintenance unit, wherein the model execution unit is used for generating a global Manager, a regional Manager and an Agent model, the Agent is used for describing the charge and discharge states of electric automobiles, the cluster management and control unit is used for carrying out task allocation according to a preset fixed equity queue, a preset competitive equity queue and charging prediction data obtained based on a bidirectional LSTM, calculating the density of an electric automobile cluster and carrying out charging resource allocation according to the density, and the consistency maintenance unit is used for decomposing the global scheduling target of the global Manager into a local decision target of the regional Manager according to an alternate multiplier algorithm, monitoring the execution deviation of the Agent in real time through a deviation correction mechanism and carrying out deviation adjustment based on a dynamic correction instruction. The application can solve the technical problems that the existing model has single function and depends on static rule allocation tasks, and hierarchical decisions are easy to conflict.
assignees: FOSHAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP

title_en: Integrated management system and method for administration information
title_ko: 행정 정보 통합관리 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an integrated management system and method for administration information. More specifically, the present invention relates to an integrated management system for integrally managing administration information that is distributed and processed by each administration system, and efficiently managing evaded and missed tax sources, and a method thereof. Also, the present invention includes an administration information collection part for collecting spatial information including administration information for each address and a cadastral-based cadastral map, a topical map generation part for generating a topical map by matching a lot on the cadastral map with the administration information, a target lot extraction part for extracting a target lot which requires taxation and maintenance, or is inconsistent with a usage condition, by comparing the topical map with an aerial photograph, and a taxation processing part for calculating and imposing taxation on the target lot. It is possible to efficiently collect and manage various kinds of administration information distributed and processed by each administration system, and to realize fair taxation by calculating and imposing taxation on evaded and missed lots.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 행정 정보 통합관리 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것으로, 구체적으로는 행정 시스템별로 분산 처리되고 있는 행정 정보를 통합 관리하고, 탈루 및 누락된 세원을 찾아내어 효율적으로 관리할 수 있는 행정 정보 통합관리 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것이다. 
또한, 본 발명은 행정 시스템들로부터 주소별로 저장된 행정 정보와 지번 코드 기반의 지적도를 포함하는 공간 정보를 수집하는 행정 정보 수집부와, 지적도 상의 필지에 행정 정보를 매칭하여 주제도를 생성하는 주제도 생성부와, 주제도와 항공사진을 중첩비교하여 사용 현황이 불일치하거나 정비가 필요한 과세 대상필지를 추출하는 대상필지 추출부 및 과세 대상필지의 과세를 산정하여 부과하는 과세 처리부를 구비하므로, 행정 시스템별로 분산 처리되고 있는 각종 행정 정보들을 수집하여 효율적으로 통합 관리할 수 있고, 탈루되거나 누락된 필지에 대한 과세 산정 및 부과를 통해 공평과세를 실현할 수 있다.

title_en: Computer implemented blockchain-based system for agricultural products
abstract_en: A platform built on blockchain that is designed to help increase traceability, efficiency and fairness in agricultural supply chains, such as the coffee, cocoa, tea, sugar, grains and fruit supply chains. The platform includes a Self-Sovereign Identity solution, a new form of digital identity built on distributed ledger technology. Farmers, wholesalers, traders and retailers can interact more efficiently using comprehensive, near real-time access to this data, and consumers can have new insights about the origins of the products they consume. The platform includes a consumer-facing application that pulls information directly from the blockchain and connects the final consumer, e.g. a coffee drinker, to farmers, traders, roasters and brands. The information is presented on an interactive map, allowing each product to tell a story in a simple and scalable way. The app also presents sustainability projects in coffee communities and an opportunity for consumers to directly support them.

title_en: Optimal path planning method and system for line inspection task distribution
abstract_en: An optimal path planning method and system for line patrol task allocation, comprising: step 1, obtaining line plane coordinate data; step 2, preprocessing the obtained line plane coordinate data to obtain preprocessed line plane coordinate data; step 3, dividing the preprocessed line plane coordinate data obtained in the step 2 to obtain line plane coordinate data of different areas; and 4, carrying out optimal path planning on line inspection of each zone according to the line plane coordinate data of the different zones obtained in the step 3. When the line inspection path is planned, the relationship among the line, the tower and the line channel and the inspection path mileage difference of a plurality of inspection staff are considered, and the obtained inspection path can realize comprehensive inspection of the line, ensure the fairness and the rationality of planning and effectively improve the efficiency and the quality of line inspection work.

title_en: Artificial intelligence-based fair examination method and system for bidding documents
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence examination and discloses a fair examination method and a fair examination system for bidding documents based on artificial intelligence. The system comprises a file acquisition unit, a scoring model unit and a fairness examination optimizing unit. The method comprises the steps of acquiring bidding document information and corresponding grading rule information input by a user, wherein the bidding document information comprises document type information and grading weight information, the grading rule information comprises business grading rule and technical grading rule, the grading model unit determines a grading program according to the document type information, and the fairness examination optimizing unit determines a grading optimizing program according to the document type information, the grading rule information and the grading program, and the fairness examination is completed through the program. The system can solve the problems of scoring deviation, program confusion, low efficiency and the like of the traditional manual examination, realizes examination automation and standardization through multi-unit cooperation, maintains a fair competitive environment for bidding, and meets the requirements of industry on efficient and fair examination.

title_en: Hierarchical collaborative optimization and settlement method for large-scale industrial demand response
abstract_en: The application provides a hierarchical collaborative optimization and settlement method of a large-scale industrial demand response, which relates to the technical field of electric power systems and comprises the steps of dividing a large-scale industrial demand response resource into a plurality of levels and constructing an optimization model, decomposing a global optimization problem into local sub-problems, defining a consistency variable constraint global consistency, generating a dispatching instruction through iterative computation, responding to the dispatching instruction to acquire actual response data, performing hash operation and digital signature processing on the actual response data to generate a signature abstract, verifying the signature abstract by using an intelligent contract, performing real-time settlement after verification to obtain real-time settlement data, and summarizing the real-time settlement data to obtain periodic settlement data, calculating a performance index according to the dispatching instruction and the actual response data, and performing numerical correction on the real-time settlement data and the periodic settlement data by using the performance index to obtain adjusted settlement data. The application realizes the rapid scheduling and convergence of large-scale resources, and effectively improves the enthusiasm and fairness of users for participating in scheduling.

title_en: The synthesis distribution method of many storings moneys of possession emergency
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of synthesis distribution methods of many storings moneys of possession emergency.This method comprises: before rear relief goods do not reach, being based on crash time most short building objective function after disaster generation, concentrates many storings to provide distribution models using one stage of possession and carry out the batch operation that the first stage concentrates many storage emergency materials；The emergency materials of many storage points of each dispersion and means of transport are pooled to many storage points of the concentration, remaining emergency materials and means of transport after concentrating many storage points to distribute in conjunction with the first stage, fairness in distribution is provided based on many storings and loss reduction constructs objective function, is dispersed many storing money distribution models using the possession two-stage and is carried out the batch operation that second stage disperses many storage point emergency materials.The present invention considers various realistic constraint conditions, constructs many storings of possession emergency and provides comprehensive distribution models, the reasonable allocation plan of generative science, it is ensured that the fast accurate of the comprehensive distribution of possession emergency crowd's storings money, promotion emergency management and rescue effect.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING JIAOTONG;UNIV BEIJING CHEM TECH;BEIJING SATELLITE INFORMATION ENGINEERING INST

title_en: Resource processing method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a resource processing method, a resource processing device, a resource processing equipment and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of networks. According to the technical scheme, the user is guided to repeatedly complete the target tasks related to the resource allocation activities in the associated application, the user acquisition probability of the user to the resources is displayed based on the accumulated repeated completion times of the target user group on the platform and the repeated completion times of the user, the user can make an effort for improving the acquisition probability by accessing the associated application, the user activity is greatly improved, and the information such as the acquisition probability is provided for the user in a visual mode, so that the user can know the existing acquisition probability based on intuition, the direction of network activity of the user is determined, the user is stimulated to improve the user activity under the condition that the fairness of resource allocation is guaranteed, and the purpose of effectively improving the user activity is achieved.

title_en: Marketing right and interest allocation method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of financial technology (Fintech), and discloses a marketing interest allocation method and a marketing interest allocation device, wherein an experience value of i marketing interest is determined whether to be used or not on the premise of holding j marketing interest according to the historical allocation condition and the historical use condition of the marketing interest; determining an equity distribution rule according to the experience value of each marketing equity under n marketing equity; determining the holding values of the right users to be distributed aiming at the n kinds of marketing rights according to the right and interest holding condition of any right user to be distributed; and determining the distributable marketing rights and interests of the users to be distributed according to the rights and interests distribution rule and the holding values of the users to be distributed by a bit operation mode. Based on the mode, the result of the marketing right issue aiming at the individual user can be quickly and reasonably determined for the user.
assignees: SHENZHEN QIANHAI WECHWAN BANK CO LTD

title_en: Multi-supply-point emergency material site selection optimization method considering timeliness and fairness
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-supply-point emergency material site selection optimization method considering timeliness and fairness, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of sequentially building a material supply point, a temporary distribution center, a disaster area and a damaged road, building a multi-target emergency material distribution model, building an initialized individual strategy, building a mutation operator and a local search operator based on the initialized individual strategy, building a selection strategy and an acceptance criterion, combining the mutation operator and the local search operator, outputting an optimal operator, evaluating the optimal operator and outputting an optimal scheme for emergency distribution. The invention provides a dual-target multi-supply-point emergency material site selection and distribution model, in the model, the influence of disasters on a road network is considered, so that a waiting time concept is provided, meanwhile, in order to enable distribution results to be more fair, a concept of lowest material distribution is introduced, and a related calculation method is introduced; and the problem domain design of emergency disaster relief supplies is completed.

title_en: Method and system for evaluating space distribution fairness of urban sports field
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a system for evaluating the fairness of urban sports field space distribution, comprising the following steps: obtaining evaluation data for performing the fairness evaluation, the evaluation data including: basic electronic map data of an administrative region of a city to be evaluated, planar boundary data of a sports field space range of the city to be evaluated, and WorldPop grid data of population space distribution of the city to be evaluated; carrying out data processing on the evaluation data based on the grid division standard of the Beidou grid position codes to obtain the per-capita sports field area of the city to be evaluated in each Beidou grid; evaluating the area of the per-capita sports field of the city to be evaluated according to a preset evaluation rule, wherein the evaluation rule comprises the following steps: the higher the per-person sports field area, the higher the score. The Beidou grid is used as a reference space unit, the continuity characteristic of the geographic space is fully considered, and the unreasonable influence of artificial administrative division on evaluation is avoided.
assignees: HUBEI POST TELECOMMUNICATION PLANNING DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: Route planning method considering heterogeneity of driver based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a path planning method considering driver heterogeneity based on machine learning, which comprises the steps of firstly constructing an on-demand distribution optimization model based on maximizing platform long-term benefits in a period of operation time; training a prediction model to predict a category of the real-time order using a two-stage classification prediction algorithm based on machine learning; and solving the established on-demand distribution optimization model to obtain an optimal solution and an optimal strategy of the vehicle path planning problem. The method can effectively improve order distribution efficiency, realizes the excitation of new drivers, and provides a tool for balancing efficiency and fairness for logistics service providers.

title_en: Optimized scheduling method and system for source network load generalized energy storage system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of peak regulation of power systems, and discloses an optimized scheduling method of a source network load generalized energy storage system, which comprises the following steps: s1, establishing a source-load double-layer optimization scheduling model, wherein an upper model aims at maximizing net benefit of source-side leased energy storage operation, and a lower model aims at minimizing net load variance; s2, generating an energy storage configuration result according to the upper layer model and transmitting the energy storage configuration result to the lower layer, and also discloses a source network load generalized energy storage system optimization scheduling system, which comprises the following steps: a source-load double-layer optimized scheduling model for maximizing the running net gain of source-side rental energy storage and minimizing the net load variance of the system. The peak shaving demand is determined through the optimized net load, peak shaving and clearing are carried out with the aim of minimizing the peak shaving cost of the system, the fairness and the effectiveness of peak shaving transaction are ensured, and each market body can participate in the peak shaving transaction in a fair competition environment, so that the economical efficiency is improved.
assignees: STATE GRID JILIN ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO;UNIV NORTHEAST ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Endocrine nursing teaching decision-making system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and provides an endocrine care teaching decision system based on deep learning, which comprises a data acquisition module, a data preprocessing module, a feature extraction module, a teaching evaluation module and a teaching decision module, wherein the teaching evaluation module introduces a fair constraint dual-BiGRU model, improves consistency and stability of teaching evaluation among different student groups through a subgroup division and fairness constraint mechanism, the teaching decision module introduces a risk perception D3QN model, builds a risk sensitive Q value function, performs segmentation weighting on teaching action return by combining a static spectrum risk measurement mechanism, optimizes decision capability and risk regulation capability of a strategy network, is particularly suitable for complex medical teaching scenes such as endocrine care, and has good fairness, self-adaptability and practicability.

title_en: Method and system for evaluating fairness of spatial distribution of urban stadium
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a system for evaluating fairness of space distribution of a city stadium, wherein the evaluation data comprises administrative region basic electronic map data of the city to be evaluated, plane boundary data of the space range of the stadium of the city to be evaluated and population space distribution WorldPop grid data of the city to be evaluated, the evaluation data is subjected to data processing based on grid division standards of Beidou grid position codes to obtain the area of a people-average stadium of the city to be evaluated in each Beidou grid, and the area of the people-average stadium of the city to be evaluated is evaluated according to preset evaluation rules, wherein the evaluation rules comprise that the higher the area of the people-average stadium is, the higher the score is. The Beidou grid is used as a reference space unit, the continuity characteristic of the geographic space is fully considered, and the unreasonable influence of artificial administrative division on evaluation is avoided.

title_en: A kind of food transaction Method of Optimal Matching based on block chain technology
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of food transaction Method of Optimal Matching based on block chain technology, for solving in traditional food transaction because the problems such as transaction configuration dislocation and transaction record are easily maliciously tampered caused by information asymmetry.Including：Information aggregate according to both sides of supply and demand, transaction optimization matching algorithm is run by scheduling node in alliance's block chain, the transaction assembled scheme of optimization is selected for both parties, different buyers are eliminated using online double auction mechanism, existing competitive relation is combined for identical seller, promote trading efficiency and ensure fairness；For the transaction intention being actually achieved, both parties are made to realize automated transaction by intelligent contract, intelligent contract and Transaction Information are uploaded to scheduling node audit after the completion of transaction after being encrypted by both parties, using improvement PBFT common recognition algorithm, the inconsistent of Transaction Information is avoided with the transaction assembled scheme built in scheduling node in cache table by comparison actual transaction information, has ensured the validity for the Transaction Information being recorded in block chain.

title_en: A kind of negotiation of equitable efficiency equilibrium and negotiate suggesting system for wearing and method
abstract_en: The present invention is claimed a kind of negotiation of equitable efficiency equilibrium and negotiates suggesting system for wearing and method; it solves in more subjects under discussion negotiation more than two sides and the thousands of possible schemes in negotiation space; seek by participating in the customized equitable efficiency equilibrium solution of each side, as negotiation scheme or suggestion of resolving through consultation；Also creatively solve the problems, such as that baseline exaggerates control problem, rigid boundary condition, the fair convergence problem with efficiency optimization solution in method simultaneously；It is that negotiating decision is supported, negotiates preparation, analysis, and a kind of intelligent method of training；Its technical solution are as follows: determine limited number of going back on one's word first, data are collected by negotiation template, it executes baseline and exaggerates controlling mechanism, News Search is executed in effective baseline collection basis that system is accepted, be pushed forward with equality or equality retreat step equitable efficiency convergence process, limited bout is gone back on one's word revision or iterative calculation again, is repeated above step, is obtained the proposed projects with equitable efficiency equilibrium characteristic.

title_en: Personalized dynamic weight teaching evaluation model and parameter adjustment method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a personalized dynamic weight teaching evaluation model and a parameter adjustment method thereof, and relates to the technical field of teaching evaluation. According to the invention, the personalized dynamic weight teaching evaluation model is constructed, teaching reality can be tightly combined, evaluation key points can be adjusted in real time according to teaching stages and student learning states, so that an evaluation result is more timeliness and accuracy, more accurate teaching feedback is provided for teachers, the teachers are helped to adjust teaching strategies in time, a plurality of important aspects of evaluation are comprehensively considered by utilizing a multi-objective optimized parameter adjustment method, fairness and interpretability are ensured while evaluation accuracy is improved, and the comprehensive optimization method improves the overall performance of the teaching evaluation model, meets the demands of different teaching scenes and student groups, and is beneficial to promoting the improvement of education and teaching quality.

title_en: Charging reservation optimization method and system based on block chain
abstract_en: The application relates to a charging reservation optimization method and system based on a block chain. The method comprises the steps of storing the encrypted charging requirements of users and parameters of the charging piles into a blockchain, automatically screening available charging pile lists meeting the position and time requirements by using the blockchain, checking the health degree of the charging piles to generate a final available list, generating a locking identifier through the blockchain after the users select the charging piles, starting charging after verifying the validity of the locking identifier when the users arrive, recording data to the blockchain in real time in the charging process, automatically settling fees after the charging process is finished and unlocking the charging piles, realizing the real-time synchronous verification of the charging pile state and the blockchain data, solving the problem that the actual state of the charging piles is inconsistent with the system display in the traditional reservation, avoiding invalid reservation, and simultaneously guaranteeing fairness of resource allocation of the charging piles through a timestamp mechanism of the blockchain.
assignees: ZHONGDE CENTURY TIANJIN NEW ENERGY TECH CO LTD;ZHONGDE CENTURY KUNSHAN NEW ENERGY TECH CO LTD;ZHIQING NEW ENERGY TECH TIANJIN CO LTD

title_en: Blind eye shopping control method and system based on intelligent matching technology
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the commodity purchasing field, and discloses a blind eye purchasing control method and a blind eye purchasing control system based on an intelligent matching technology, wherein only commodity standard library information is displayed through initialization setting so as to hide the identity of a supplier, and the blind eye purchasing is realized; the method comprises the steps of obtaining provider main data, commodity standard library data and real-time purchasing demand data in real time, calculating a provider performance score by utilizing a multi-dimensional weighted scoring model to measure comprehensive performance capability, calculating a cost performance index based on a commodity standard library and real-time demand to evaluate commodity comprehensive value, dynamically generating a sum distribution value of a same group by combining a sum occupancy rate and the performance score, and finally calculating a matching score by the comprehensive performance score, the cost performance index and the sum distribution value, and intelligently screening the provider. The method improves the contract resource allocation efficiency, prevents the limit from overrun or idling, enhances the data safety, reduces the risk of order tampering and historical migration conflict, and integrally optimizes the fairness, reliability and automation level of the purchasing system.
assignees: STATE GRID E COMMERCE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Modeling distribution of emergency relief supplies for disaster response operations
abstract_en: A method and system to supply multiple items through a network of inventory staging areas and distribution points by determining inventory stocking levels for a staging area and distribution points, and inventory shipments from said staging area to distribution points and between the distribution points, using an optimization formulation whose objective is to cover maximum overall demand at the distribution points in a given period of time, and to minimize total cost of meeting demand.

title_en: Enterprise actual controller supporting distributed computing and control path computing method
abstract_en: An enterprise actual controller and control path calculation method supporting distributed calculation comprises the following steps: 1) dividing a network graph formed by an enterprise equity structure into n unconnected sub-network graphs, and setting a cache region; 2) initializing enterprise states in each network; 3) iteratively updating the enterprise state in each network; 4) and judging the termination of iteration in each network, and acquiring the final state of the enterprise to obtain the actual controller and the actual control path of the enterprise. The invention can accurately calculate the actual control person and the actual control path of the enterprise based on the equity structure information of the enterprise, and simultaneously support distributed calculation, thereby greatly improving the operation rate when the data volume is huge.

title_en: Unmanned crawler vehicle carrying and conveying platform for complex environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned crawler vehicle carrying and conveying platform for complex environments, which comprises a stability-increasing transmission mechanism, a conveying mechanism and a material conveying mechanism, wherein the stability-increasing transmission mechanism comprises a transverse beam and an auxiliary rotating wheel, an outer cover positioned outside the transverse beam, a driving wheel arranged in the transverse beam, a driven wheel clamped in the middle of the transverse beam and a reinforced vertical plate connected to the inner end of the driving wheel. Through setting up protection top cap and bearing the drain pan, and be the pulley that oval annular distributes and put the actuating lever at the inboard movable assembly of protection top cap and bearing the drain pan, and put the inner welding level extension of actuating lever, and with movable mounting at the roof beam structure inboard, the track can twine in the outside of track and axostylus axostyle this moment, when the action wheel drives supplementary runner and carries out synchronous revolution from the driving wheel, the track can conveniently be stranded unmanned tracked vehicle and carry the defeated platform of follow-up relief supplies this moment, and then can avoid causing the jam to the relief disaster in spontaneous combustion disaster area.

title_en: Hierarchical personalized federal learning method for oilfield production prediction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hierarchical personalized federal learning method for oilfield production prediction, which relates to the technical field of petroleum engineering and artificial intelligence fusion application, and adopts a client-server architecture, wherein each oil well is used as a client. Each client independently calculates the encrypted production structure features and updates its local model with regularized optimization objectives. The central server clusters the clients based on the encrypted PSFs and coordinates a double aggregation process, wherein the double aggregation process comprises a global model fusing cross-cluster knowledge and a cluster agent model capturing personalized features in each cluster. The method not only improves the prediction accuracy of the single oil well level, but also ensures the consistency of the prediction performance of different oil wells, promotes the model prediction fairness, can effectively balance the relationship between global generalization and local individuation, does not leak data privacy information, and improves the convergence rate of the prediction model training.

title_en: User order dispatching system and user order dispatching method
abstract_en: The invention provides a user order dispatching system and a user order dispatching method, wherein an initial grouping relation table and a standard grouping relation table are formed according to an original list data table, the mapping relation between an initial grouping in the initial grouping relation table and a standard grouping in the standard grouping relation table and the adjustment action of the initial grouping are determined, and the adjustment processing of a target member in a source member group to a member group is sequentially carried out from a central point member, so that the grouping calculation meeting the double-line share requirements of an order dispatching amount and an order dispatching amount is rapidly completed, the even sharing of the order dispatching is realized, and the fairness of the order dispatching can be ensured.

title_en: Carbon flow real-time calculation method and system considering network loss
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of carbon emission flow calculation, in particular to a method and a system for calculating carbon flow in real time by considering network loss, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a network loss allocation model, and adopting a network loss allocation method for bidirectional allocation according to allocation coefficients to obtain allocation results; determining the power flow distribution in the network according to the allocation result; based on the tide distribution, constructing a real-time carbon flow calculation model; calculating the carbon emission flow before the day and the carbon emission flow of the deviation network before the day-real time based on a real-time carbon flow calculation model to obtain a load carbon flow rate and a branch carbon flow rate; based on the load carbon flow rate and the branch carbon flow rate, a daily planned amount and a deviation amount of the carbon flow rate are obtained, respectively, and based on the daily planned amount and the deviation amount, a real-time carbon flow rate is calculated. The method successfully solves a series of problems that the hidden carbon flow is not equitable in allocation, the carbon emission reduction contribution of the novel renewable energy power generation unit is difficult to quantify and the like by constructing the model and the calculation method.
assignees: SHANXI ENERGY INTERNET RES INSTITUTE;UNIV TAIYUAN TECHNOLOGY;UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG

title_en: Group recommendation method based on causal depolarization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a group recommendation method based on causal depolarization, which comprises the following steps: first, by establishing a causal graph and a Structural Causal Model (SCM), the causal relationship in group recommendation is deeply analyzed, a depolarization module of a causal mechanism is used for solving the deviation problem existing in a recommendation system, and the causal effect caused by confusion factors is reduced. Secondly, different group preference representations are obtained from the group item pairs and the group user pairs through a hypergraph convolution and a self-attention mechanism respectively, and then weights are dynamically adjusted through the attention mechanism. Finally, a final recommendation list is obtained through Bayes personalized ranking loss (BPR) optimization, and the fairness and quality of group recommendation are improved.

title_en: Method and system for informationized management of assessment results of fire rescue institutions
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for informationized management of examination results of fire-fighting and rescue institutions, wherein the method comprises the steps of manufacturing an actual examination scheme or examination paper, distributing the actual examination scheme or examination paper on an examination paper line, submitting an individual actual examination performance-proving examination-finished examination paper by an examinee, recycling the individual actual examination performance-proving examination-finished examination paper line, and checking and approving the actual examination performance-proving examination-finished examination paper line. According to the method, different courses are switched through manual selection scheme modes, and test questions under the current course are checked and browsed, so that the generated real operation examination scheme is selected in a targeted mode according to examination points, examination personnel are checked more accurately, the real operation examination scheme is input into a question library through manual input and batch identification and introduction, test question updating in a database is performed in real time, and the situations that the generated online real operation examination scheme is difficult and knowledge points are simpler are avoided, so that fairness and fairness cannot be ensured are avoided.

title_en: Rights resource allocation method, device, equipment, storage medium and product
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment, a storage medium and a product for distributing rights and interests resources, which relate to the technical field of data processing, wherein the method for distributing rights and interests resources comprises the steps of responding to rights and interests resource distribution requests, determining rights and interests resource distribution modes based on the rights and interests resource distribution requests, wherein the rights and interests resource distribution modes comprise manual segmentation, branch office application segmentation and channel end application segmentation; and carrying out the rights and interests allocation according to the rights and interests resource allocation parameters and rights and interests resource allocation strategies. Because the application allocates the equity resources according to the equity resource allocation mode corresponding to the equity resource allocation request, compared with the existing mode of allocating equity resources depending on a fixed organization framework, the mode of the application can allocate equity resources accurately and in multiple dimensions, improves the matching degree of the resources and business requirements and avoids resource mismatch.

title_en: Intelligent scheduling method, device and equipment for tobacco leaf vending and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent scheduling method, device and equipment for tobacco leaf vending and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining target sales information corresponding to each user to be sold and target equipment information corresponding to each tobacco leaf grading equipment, evaluating sales priority of the users to be sold based on the target sales information and the target equipment information, determining target users to be sold, and determining target sales scheduling strategies corresponding to the target users to be sold based on the target equipment information and the target users to be sold, so that the target users to be sold can sell tobacco leaves based on the target sales scheduling strategies. The invention can realize intelligent efficient scheduling of tobacco leaf vending, can meet the dynamic vending demands of large-scale tobacco farmers, improves the overall vending scheduling efficiency of tobacco leaves, reduces the labor cost, ensures the fairness of tobacco leaf vending scheduling, and thereby improves the satisfaction degree of tobacco leaf vending of users.

title_en: System and Method for Budget-Compliant, Fair and Efficient Manpower Management
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method and system for budget-compliant, fair and efficient manpower management primarily for service industries to improve customer service, save costs, improve employee morale and productivity. More particularly the present invention relates to a system and method enabling labour planners and schedulers to rapidly develop a budget-compliant, fair, effective, easy to use and manageable and deployable manpower schedule to optimize and increase effective manpower productivity. Further the system and method of the present invention generates manpower plans and schedules suitable for deployment, on the basis of two novel criteria's a) compliance of allocations to planned labour budgets while also being driven by business forecasts and b) using several fairness” criteria so that the desirable and undesirable features of the schedules are equitably dispersed. Further, the invention provides a system which can be deployed with several optional hardware and network architecture and configuration.
assignees: SENGUPTA SIDDHARTHA;SALSINGIKAR SHRIPAD;BOSE SOUMEN;GANESAN VISWANATH;TATA CONSULTANCY SERVICES LTD

title_en: Collaborative cost task allocation method and system based on concept lattice in social network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a concept lattice-based collaborative cost task allocation method and a concept lattice-based collaborative cost task allocation system in a social network. The method comprises the steps of modeling a social network, tasks in the social network, participants in the social network and skills possessed by the participants to obtain a task distribution system model; the small groups in the social network are obtained through formal concept analysis, participants meeting skill requirements of the small groups are recruited for the tasks based on internal strong contact attributes of the small groups, strong contact teams enough for completing the tasks are obtained quickly, and the completion efficiency of the collaborative tasks is improved. By utilizing the close connection characteristic among the members of the small groups in the social network, namely, any member can represent the whole small group, and the experts are selected from different small groups to construct a weak connection group, so that the groups are constructed in an all-round and multi-level manner, and the fairness of competitive tasks is ensured. Compared with the existing task allocation algorithm, the method provided by the invention has remarkable improvement on the performances such as cooperation cost, team scale, running time and the like.

title_en: Power distribution network optimization method based on cooperation of distributed sharing and centralized clearing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network optimization method based on the cooperation of distributed sharing and centralized clearing, which comprises the steps of constructing a power distribution network system based on the cooperation of distributed sharing and centralized clearing, uniformly clearing power prices of all nodes by power distribution network operators according to power purchasing quantity reported by all aggregators, transmitting the power prices of the nodes to all micro power grids in the nodes by the aggregators, optimizing operation and transaction of each micro power grid according to the power prices of the nodes and interacting with the node aggregators, solving and obtaining the power purchasing quantity and the power purchasing price of all micro power grids in the nodes by adopting a model based on a game theory or a model based on Lagrange relaxation, collecting the power purchasing quantity of the micro power grids in the nodes by the aggregators and transmitting the power purchasing quantity to the power distribution network operators, clearing the power prices of all the nodes again by the power distribution network operators, and repeating the steps until convergence. The stability of the operation of the power grid and the fairness of the electricity price liquidation are ensured, and free trading of each micro-power grid is realized on the premise that the fairness of the electricity price liquidation is met.

title_en: Printing order commission and resource allocation linkage method based on multi-channel data collaboration
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data collaborative analysis, in particular to a printing order commission and resource allocation linkage method based on multichannel data collaboration, which comprises the steps of integrating various key information of an order by constructing an order-resource map to reflect the association of the order and resources; the method comprises the steps of inputting an order-resource map into a map neural network model, extracting map embedded vectors, constructing subgraphs, excavating complex relations between orders and resources, achieving accurate initialization of bisection and resource nodes, sharing local subgraphs through distributed communication, generating a global commission resource map, achieving centralized overall planning of all channels and all resources, guaranteeing that commission and resource allocation decisions are based on the principle of overall optimization, generating a matrix and issuing instructions through linkage operation according to the global map, guaranteeing that orders of all channels obtain corresponding resources and commissions according to the principle of fairness and rationality, executing a node combination state execution algorithm, uploading data, and dynamically optimizing resource allocation paths in real time.

title_en: Decision-making method of uncertain emergency material distribution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a decision-making method of uncertain emergency material distribution, mainly for expanding a fuzzy decision-making unit theory into an uncertain fuzzy decision-making unit theory to support an uncertain decision-making index under the condition that disaster magnitude, material demands and road conditions are uncertain and fuzzy factors at the initial state of a large-scale emergency. Based on this, by taking fairness, benefits and feasibility as principles, index design is carried out on emergency material distribution unit decision-making system so that a distribution scheme of emergency life rescue materials can be determined in a scientific and rapid manner among multiple disaster points, and the first batch of life rescue materials can be brought into greatest play. According to the invention, at a disaster early stage, under the condition that correlation information is uncertain, a scientific decision-making method is provided for rapid determination of the distribution scheme of the life rescue materials in multiple disaster areas.

title_en: The classification appraisal procedure and device of a kind of distribution network loss
abstract_en: The invention discloses the classification appraisal procedure and device of a kind of distribution network loss, the method is according to electric network composition, equipment physical parameter, operation of power networks feature, the various indexs such as power structure feature and natural society's state of development build the judgment matrix of expert estimation, obtain the weight of the influence of the influence factor that is determined by expert to distribution network loss, influence by the Mathematical Modeling quantitative analysis of each index influence factor set up to line loss again, finally, the evaluation result that the weight and evaluation model of the influence factor that comprehensive expert estimation determines determine, evaluate influence of the influence factor to the network loss of power distribution network.The formulation for being configured to Line Loss of Distribution Network System rate index of the appraisement system provides scientific and rational division methods, improve fairness, the comprehensive and authority of Line Loss of Distribution Network System management, the year line loss per unit index for distributing to each company of county can timely and reasonably be adjusted, for science decision provides strong data supporting, good economic benefit and social benefit is produced.
assignees: STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Visual, intelligent and decentralized task allocation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a decentralized task allocation method, which comprises the following steps: uniformly calculating the task amount occupied by the sample making sheet according to the sample making type and the sample making quantity recorded in the sample making sheet; determining the task quantity occupied by each task and the sequence of each task according to the declaration of the salesman, and accordingly determining the comprehensive task quantity of each salesman in sequence of time; dividing the comprehensive task quantity in the sequence of time by the allocation proportion of each operator to obtain the priority of each order under the name of the operator, and sequencing the order priorities of all operators from small to large; and integrating orders applied by all the service personnel and transferring the orders to the technicians according to the priority sequence. The invention adopts a decentralized task allocation algorithm, and firstly, the fairness and the accuracy are greatly improved. The workload of each task and the time of each node are recorded and calculated, and any node and transaction can be traced. The working efficiency and the load level of the whole board house can be counted and analyzed, and great convenience is improved for management.
assignees: JIANGSU HIGH HOPE INT GROUP AGLOGY DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Benefit analysis method and system considering distributed adjustable resource multi-element main body
abstract_en: A benefit analysis method and system considering distributed tunable resource multi-element subjects. The method comprises the steps of analyzing operation characteristics of a multi-element main body, wherein the multi-element main body comprises a new energy generator, an energy storage operator, a thermal power generator and an electricity purchasing operator, establishing a quotation decision model based on reputation values according to the reputation values and the operation characteristics of the multi-element main body in electric power transaction, solving the quotation decision model through a multi-objective evolutionary algorithm to obtain clear electric quantity and clear electric quantity, establishing benefit evaluation indexes according to comprehensive benefits of the multi-element main body, output duty ratio of the new energy main body, peak-valley difference of a user and energy utilization rate, calculating weight vectors of the plurality of benefit evaluation indexes by using a game theory combined weighting method, and balancing the benefit evaluation indexes through a multi-criterion optimization and compromise solving method to obtain comprehensive benefit analysis results of the multi-element main body. The scheme of the invention improves the scientificity and fairness of decisions.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;UNIV NORTHEASTERN;STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Multi-star task scheduling method and system based on uniform revisit routine and emergency observation integration
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-star task scheduling method and system based on uniform revisit routine and emergency observation integration, and belongs to the technical field of remote sensing satellite task planning and autonomous scheduling. The method comprises the steps of dividing a ground area into a plurality of observation grids based on orbit parameters and imaging parameters of remote sensing satellites, traversing an orbit time sequence of each satellite under a unified time axis, dynamically planning conventional observation tasks of each satellite according to satellite point positions and grid observation marks, carrying out emergency observation task rescheduling according to the conventional observation tasks of the current satellites when an emergency observation request of a specific area is received, and obtaining a satellite joint scheduling plan containing the conventional observation tasks and the emergency observation tasks. The invention has the advantages of high scheduling fairness, controllable gesture adjustment, high response speed and the like, and is suitable for the high-efficiency task joint scheduling scene of the large-scale low-orbit remote sensing constellation under the conventional and emergency states.
assignees: SHANGHAI WEICHUANG LISHIKONG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent multidimensional evaluation analysis and decision method based on big data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent evaluation, and provides an intelligent multidimensional evaluation analysis and decision method based on big data, the method comprises the steps of obtaining original evaluation data from a multi-source heterogeneous data interface, and generating a space-time associated data set through fusion of semantic role labeling and a time stamp alignment algorithm. And performing multi-level cleaning to generate a high-confidence rating data set. And extracting multi-dimensional indexes based on the domain knowledge graph, generating a dynamic characteristic tensor, and dynamically distributing weights by adopting a coupling attenuation weight model. And constructing a bidder association network, calculating a node influence score, detecting potential bidder ring behaviors and generating a risk correction coefficient. And injecting the real-time data stream into the dynamic characteristic tensor, updating the index weight, and generating a three-dimensional scoring vector through a multi-objective aggregation decision algorithm. And performing pareto optimization by using the asymmetric game balancing model, and outputting an optimal winning-winning sequence and a risk early warning report. The invention can improve the bid evaluation efficiency and fairness and reduce bid-recruitment risk.

title_en: Carbon entropy theory-based power system carbon emission tracing method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of carbon emission monitoring and accounting of an electric power system, and discloses a carbon emission tracing method, a system, equipment and a medium of the electric power system based on a carbon entropy theory, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining power data and full life cycle carbon emission data of each equipment and load node in the electric power system; converting the full life cycle carbon emission data of each device into the equivalent carbon intensity of the device, defining a carbon entropy function by combining the principles of energy conservation and thermodynamic entropy increase, constructing a carbon entropy transfer matrix, calculating the equivalent carbon intensity of each load node, and quantitatively evaluating the carbon responsibility allocation fairness of each load node through the load side fairness deviation coefficient. According to the invention, the irreversibility and additivity principles of thermodynamic entropy are introduced into electric power carbon emission modeling, so that unified calculation of energy loss and carbon transmission is realized, physical consistency and statistical fairness of carbon emission allocation are improved, and scientific support is provided for electric power system carbon emission monitoring, carbon asset management and green electric power transaction.

title_en: Tobacco goods source supply allocation system based on market pretty degree
abstract_en: The utility model is suitable for the field of tobacco supply and allocation systems, and provides a tobacco goods source supply and allocation system based on market tightness, which comprises a plurality of sales node management devices, a plurality of control devices and a plurality of control devices, wherein the plurality of sales node management devices are respectively in communication connection with the control devices; the distribution management device is connected with the control device in a communication way. The utility model utilizes the sales node management equipment to detect and record the sales data of each sales node, transmits the recorded sales data signals of each sales node to the control equipment, then the control equipment sends the quantity data of the supplied products to the distribution management equipment according to the sales data detected by each sales node in real time, the distribution management equipment receives the distribution instruction sent by the control equipment and distributes the required goods source products to each sales node by the distribution management equipment, thereby avoiding the accumulation or shortage of the sales node products.

title_en: Three-public scheduling strategy for considering unit adjustment fairness under double-track control of electric quantity of wind power high-occupancy-ratio power grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-way dispatching strategy for considering the fair regulation of a unit under the double-track control of electric quantity of a wind power high-occupancy-ratio power grid, which comprises the following steps of: s1: establishing a conventional short-term power generation planning model, and carrying out item missing analysis on the conventional short-term power generation planning model; s2: and (3) improving the conventional model by missing items: in order to ensure the consumption of wind power and promote the execution of direct trade contract as much as possible, wind power output constraint and reducible contract constraint are introduced into constraint conditions; introducing a wind curtailment penalty term and a contract reduction penalty into the objective function; s3: adding a shallow peak regulation fairness constraint: two fairness constraints of a keny coefficient and an alternate system are adopted, and a unit adjusting mechanism for ensuring the shallow peak regulation fairness in two modes is designed. The invention increases the consideration of the market part and the large-scale wind power output part on the basis of the existing power generation plan model, and can ensure the relative fairness of the part of each unit in the system participating in operation and adjusting the shallow peak regulation.

title_en: Block chain-based multi-level multi-system pan-center cooperation platform system and method
abstract_en: A block chain-based multi-level multi-system pan-center cooperation platform system and a method are provided. The system comprises a plurality of hierarchical nodes forming a flat structure, when in demand distribution, the demand type node can issue a demand request message in the system, the supply type node matches the information of the demand product carried in the demand request message with the information of the supply side product stored by the supply type node, and under the condition of matching with a plurality of suppliers, the plurality of suppliers process through a game algorithm to obtain distribution results, the nodes of the demand type select proper distribution results, the product distribution process based on the cooperation competition of the block chain is completed, the system is based on blockchain establishment, macroscopically implements anti-monopoly, determines micro-rules for different products between underlying suppliers, therefore, macro and micro regulation and control are realized, the activity and fairness of the market are promoted, the turnover rate of resources is improved, the cooperation cost is reduced, and the benefit and the enthusiasm of each participant in each level of the market are improved.
assignees: DAKAI INVESTMENT SHENZHEN PARTNERSHIP ENTERPRISE LP

title_en: Regional fairness oriented power integrated operation and maintenance task and resource scheduling method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a region fairness oriented power integrated operation and maintenance task and resource scheduling method, which comprises the following steps: inputting non-sensitive input data into a variational automatic encoder for conversion to obtain mean value and variance data, constructing simulated Gaussian distribution, randomly sampling from the Gaussian distribution to obtain characterization features, dividing the characterization features into a zx part and a za part, fitting power integration operation and maintenance task and resource scheduling acceptance data by using the characterization features, fitting sensitive input data by using the za part data, and training by generating a countermeasure network, so that the independence of the zx part and the za part is improved, and finally, the output zx part is used as fair coding features with sensitive input removed to be input into a regression network, and further, an electric quantity demand prediction value is obtained. The scheduling method provided by the invention processes the data characteristics of the to-be-called areas by adopting a data representation method in deep learning, so that the operation and maintenance tasks and the resource scheduling have fairness among the areas.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD SUZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH

title_en: Driver service management system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of driver service management, and discloses a driver service management system, which obtains the quality of driver service based on the quality score, trip score, compliance score and safety score of the driver service through a service score evaluation module, a driver equity calculation module and a driver equity issuing module, further determines the driver equity and the driver issuing amount, is beneficial to objectively evaluating the driver performance and ensures equity distribution of equity.
assignees: BEIJING BAILONGMA YUNXING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Resource allocation method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a resource allocation method, a device, equipment and a medium. The invention relates to the technical field of virtual power plants. The method comprises the following steps: determining target transaction electricity quantity data of the virtual power plant and transaction association data of at least two users in the virtual power plant; determining a response force weight based on the demand response information of the current user; determining the target transaction cost of the current user based on the target transaction electric quantity data, the response force weight of each user, the electric quantity data to be transacted and the total loss of historical energy sources; and determining a target user from each user based on each target transaction cost, and performing resource allocation for the target user based on the to-be-transacted electric quantity data of the target user. According to the technical scheme, the fairness of resource allocation is ensured while the response rate of the user to the power demand is improved, and the effect of ensuring the running stability and economy of the virtual power plant is achieved.
assignees: SHANDONG INSPUR SMART ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Landscape multifunction and fairness optimization method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a landscape versatility and fairness optimization method, device, equipment and storage medium. Relates to the technical field of land space planning. The method comprises the steps of obtaining land utilization type data, generating an unconstrained sample set based on continuous uniform distribution based on a random sample generator, generating a constrained sample set based on discrete uniform distribution based on the unconstrained sample set based on constraint conditions and landscape proportion data of land utilization, simulating land utilization conversion quantity based on the constrained sample set according to continuous multivariable probability distribution and random weight to obtain a plurality of landscape combinations, calculating versatility and fairness of each landscape combination, and determining optimal landscape situations according to the versatility and fairness of each landscape combination. The application discovers the optimal landscape combination through the scene setting, realizes the promotion of the service versatility of the ecological system, and reduces the uneven phenomenon of ecological benefit in group distribution.

title_en: Three-stage thermal power generating unit capacity electricity price spot check optimization method, equipment and medium
