abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-stage thermal power generating unit capacity electricity price spot check optimizing method, equipment and medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining short-term prediction data before D days; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a D day optimal spot check number according to the D day short-term prediction data, constructing a spot check optimizing function of a thermal power unit, and solving to obtain details of the D day spot check unit to be spot checked. Aiming at the problems of rigidification of the existing fixed spot check time period, no consideration of maintenance of the unit and the like, the invention can screen out the optimal time period to execute spot check on the premise of ensuring the maximum consumption of new energy, dynamically adjust the spot check unit number according to ultra-short term prediction data, and realize the coordination and optimization of the safety and economic scheduling of the power grid and the spot check fairness by introducing a spot check penalty function.
assignees: NANJING NARI RELAYS ENG TECH;NORTHEAST BRANCH OF STATE GRID CORP OF CHINA

title_en: Cooperative game method for cost sharing and income distribution of comprehensive energy system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cooperative game method for cost allocation and income allocation of an integrated energy system, which can analyze the fairness of cooperative results of all participating bodies and comprises the following steps: acquiring participation subject information in the comprehensive energy system; establishing a first alliance matrix according to the number of participating bodies; converting the first alliance matrix according to the type of the participating subject and the corresponding relation between any comprehensive energy system and the participating subject to obtain a second alliance matrix; establishing a marginal contribution column vector according to the controllable capacity of the integrated energy system participating main body; calculating the cooperation surplus according to the increased total cost and the increased total income of the integrated energy system participating in the main cooperation mode; establishing a profit model of each participating subject according to a Shapley distribution rule, the second union matrix, the marginal contribution column vector and the cooperation residue; calculating net profits according to the cost and the income of each participating subject; and finally, carrying out key parameter sensitivity analysis on the net profit.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG;GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO LTD

title_en: Order allocation method, device, medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides an order distribution method, an order distribution device, an order distribution medium and electronic equipment, wherein the order distribution method comprises the following steps: acquiring a target order of a service person to be distributed; determining historical service personnel allocated to the historical order of the user according to the information of the user contained in the target order; and distributing the target order to the history service personnel. The technical scheme of the embodiment of the invention can effectively avoid malicious competition among service personnel and is beneficial to ensuring the objectivity and fairness of order allocation.

title_en: A kind of agricultural product whole-round supply chain logistics platform and allocator
abstract_en: The invention belongs to agricultural product logistics technical fields, a kind of agricultural product whole-round supply chain logistics platform and allocator are disclosed, the agricultural product whole-round supply chain logistics platform includes: temperature collecting module, humidity collection module, station acquisition module, main control module, lower single module, distribution route planning module, Logistic Scheduling module, sorting module, time prediction module, payment module, display module.The present invention obtains the location information of vehicle and cargo by Logistic Scheduling module in real time, vehicle quantity and vehicle list out are determined according to vehicle and goods matching scheme, worksheet processing is carried out according to worksheet processing rule, carry out logistics on-line scheduling, online, the Auto-matching of realization task and vehicle, thus the fairness of high overall operation efficiency and vehicle scheduling；Meanwhile sub-material is carried out by information to order cargo by sorting module, it is sorted, is improved work efficiency by sub-material label, reduce error rate；Different zones are set, goods in bad order is prevented, improve cargo security.

title_en: Electric vehicle charging electric energy transaction method based on block chain technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to an electric vehicle charging electric energy trading method based on a block chain technology, which comprises the steps of designing an electric vehicle charging electric energy trading market interaction mode and a decentralized trading platform based on the block chain storage technology; the power distribution network establishes an optimal power flow model and a blocking management model according to historical load data of the charging station, and the marginal electricity price of the power distribution network node is obtained through calculation; the charging station establishes an ordered charging scheduling model, makes a day-ahead electric energy plan according to the marginal price of the node of the power distribution network, and achieves a day-ahead electricity purchasing intelligent contract with the power distribution network through a decentralized trading platform; the charging station individually customizes charging cost for the electric vehicle user according to the real-time charging requirement of the electric vehicle user, and guides the electric vehicle user to charge in order through a charging recommendation strategy; and the electric vehicle user signs an intelligent contract of the charging service with the charging station through the decentralized transaction platform. The method improves the fairness of electric energy transaction of the electric automobile, reduces the charging cost and ensures the safe and economic operation of the electric power system.

title_en: Multi-energy system transaction plan making method under double-track system operation
abstract_en: A multi-energy system transaction plan making method under double-track system operation belongs to the technical field of multi-energy system transaction plan making, and comprises the following steps: s1: according to the actual requirements of the trading plan of the multi-energy system, a modeling method of the trading plan of the multi-energy system is provided, and the modeling method specifically comprises the following steps: analyzing the current medium and long term electricity trading plan situation of China and providing a multi-energy system trading plan modeling scheme; s2: modeling each part of the model according to the multi-energy system trading plan modeling method formulated in the step S1, specifically including: based on a target function with lowest operation energy consumption and emission comprehensive cost and a constraint condition of considering a damping coefficient fairness constraint set; s3: and carrying out model optimization solving by using Matlab-Cplex to obtain a final multi-energy system trading plan. According to the method, based on the parallel electricity price double-track system, monthly electricity balance constraint, monthly market electricity capacity reduction and introduction of a Kini coefficient fairness constraint set are added, and the optimal distribution of the multi-energy system trading plan in a double-track system operation mode can be more finely realized.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;SHENYANG POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER TRADING CENTER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Data processing method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a data processing method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a plurality of data to be distributed; carrying out batch classification on to-be-allocated data in the plurality of to-be-allocated data to obtain to-be-allocated batch data sets corresponding to the plurality of to-be-allocated data, wherein each allocation batch in the to-be-allocated batch data sets corresponds to a first preset allocation quantity of to-be-allocated data; determining at least one target dispense batch from the batch data set to be dispensed; creating an allocation task according to the target allocation batch and the second preset allocation quantity of data to be allocated corresponding to each target allocation batch; and executing the allocation task, and sequentially allocating the second preset allocation quantity of data to be allocated in each target allocation batch to the agents to be allocated. The method can effectively distribute the data to be distributed with the same or similar quantity and value to each seat to be distributed, thereby ensuring the distribution fairness of the data to be distributed.

title_en: Hierarchical clustering-based multistage contribution quantitative evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hierarchical clustering-based multistage contribution quantitative evaluation method and a hierarchical clustering-based multistage contribution quantitative evaluation system, which relate to the technical field of multidimensional contribution evaluation and divide each group of historical contribution data into K Gaussian classification clusters by collecting historical contribution data and using a Gaussian mixture model for preliminary clustering; and for the kth Gaussian classification cluster, clustering into kJ refined classification clusters by using a clustering algorithm, inputting historical contribution data in each refined classification cluster into a hierarchical clustering algorithm to obtain hierarchical distribution structures of each clustering level of each refined classification cluster, and automatically classifying each hierarchical distribution structure to obtain a classified boundary of each contribution index of each clustering level in each refined classification cluster, and determining the contribution level of each refined classification cluster based on the classified boundary to realize quantitative evaluation on comprehensive contribution of community members and improve the efficiency and fairness of community management.
assignees: SHANDONG WUHUI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Scheduling method, server, and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: A scheduling method, a server (2) and a computer readable storage medium, the method comprising: setting rest days and work days of a time interval according to a preset date policy (S400, S500); obtaining historical workload data, and predicting the workload in the time interval according to the historical workload data (S402, S502); calculating required manpower according to the predicted workload and a reference workload for a day of manpower (S404, S504); and carrying out scheduling on the set work days according to the required manpower and preset constraint conditions, and generating a scheduling table (S406, S506), wherein the preset constraint conditions comprise a hard constraint condition and a soft constraint condition. The present scheduling method, server and computer readable storage medium may meet personalized demands of employees in a scheduling process and guarantee scheduling fairness, thereby improving the work efficiency of employees.
assignees: PING AN TECH SHENZHEN CO LTD

title_en: Multi-dimensional dynamic elastic identification method and system for key coupling nodes of power distribution information physical system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent power grids, in particular to a multidimensional dynamic elastic identification method and system for key coupling nodes of a power distribution information physical system, wherein the system comprises a key node screening unit, a unified CPDS model is constructed, and a candidate key node set is primarily screened based on structural controllability and structural observability; the invention provides a novel CPDS key coupling node precise identification method for integrating structure controllability, structure observability, dynamic fuzzy disaster scenes, reverse reinforcement learning and shape value comprehensive calculation, which is used for improving the accuracy, fairness and adaptability of system elasticity analysis and decision making and improving the quick response and recovery capability of a power grid to disasters or attack disturbance.

title_en: Decentralized space-time crowdsourcing system based on block chain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a decentralized space-time crowdsourcing system based on a block chain, which comprises a client, a contract layer and a block chain layer. The blockchain crowdsourcing system registers crowdsourcing participants through a user management contract and manages the relevant flow of crowdsourcing tasks through a task management contract. The task management contract comprises three functional modules of task issuing, task distribution and task settlement. In particular, the system adopts a greedy algorithm based on skill coverage for the distribution process of the space-time crowdsourcing task with multiple skill requirements. The system is most different from the current block chain crowdsourcing system, supports the space-time crowdsourcing task with multiple skill requirements, and has wider application range. The greedy task allocation algorithm based on the skill coverage rate realizes efficient matching of tasks and workers and improves the efficiency of a block chain crowdsourcing system. Finally, the task quality assessment method based on crowdsourcing ensures the fairness of the system.

title_en: Heating load scheduling method based on data-physics-knowledge combined drive
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heating load scheduling method based on data-physics-knowledge combined drive, which is characterized in that aiming at the problems of high randomness and difficult regulation of heating load, a load clustering method and a load power prediction algorithm based on data, physics and knowledge models are firstly designed; then a heating double-layer scheduling model is designed, a user layer deploys a load control terminal, power data are collected and reported, a scheduling layer comprises a prediction module, an index set module and a scheduling module, the prediction module classifies loads and predicts heating power, the index set module comprises economy, comfort and fairness indexes, the scheduling module is based on load prediction data, the maximization of economy, comfort and fairness is used as a target, a particle swarm algorithm is adopted to solve scheduling power, the scheduling power is implemented by the load control terminal, and the feasibility of a double-layer scheduling strategy is analyzed according to an example. The invention provides a technical method for load prediction and scheduling under heating transformation, and can effectively improve the fairness and effectiveness of heating.

title_en: Method and device for proposing calculation, computer equipment, readable storage medium and chip
abstract_en: The application provides a proposal calculating method, a device, computer equipment, a readable storage medium and a chip, wherein the method comprises the following steps: dividing a plurality of service areas into a first area type and a second area type, wherein the receiving and dispatching difficulties of different service areas in the plurality of service areas are different, each service area comprises a plurality of receiving and dispatching personnel, each area type comprises one or more service areas, the average complaint quantity of each service area in the first area type is smaller than a first threshold value, and the average complaint quantity of each service area in the second area type is larger than or equal to the first threshold value; determining the type of the area to which the target receiver belongs according to the service area to which the target receiver belongs; determining the extraction coefficient of the target receiver-transmitter according to the type of the region to which the target receiver-transmitter belongs; and determining the promotion wages of the target receiver according to the promotion coefficients of the target receiver. The method has higher fairness for the receiving and dispatching personnel in the area with high service difficulty, and can improve the logistics service quality.

title_en: Artificial intelligence-based fair examination method and system for bidding documents
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence examination and discloses a fair examination method and a fair examination system for bidding documents based on artificial intelligence. The system comprises a file acquisition unit, a scoring model unit and a fairness examination optimizing unit. The method comprises the steps of acquiring bidding document information and corresponding grading rule information input by a user, wherein the bidding document information comprises document type information and grading weight information, the grading rule information comprises business grading rule and technical grading rule, the grading model unit determines a grading program according to the document type information, and the fairness examination optimizing unit determines a grading optimizing program according to the document type information, the grading rule information and the grading program, and the fairness examination is completed through the program. The system can solve the problems of scoring deviation, program confusion, low efficiency and the like of the traditional manual examination, realizes examination automation and standardization through multi-unit cooperation, maintains a fair competitive environment for bidding, and meets the requirements of industry on efficient and fair examination.
assignees: CHINA COMMUNICATIONS XIAMEN E COMMERCE CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for distributed distribution of water resources in multiple-agent reinforcement learning watershed based on physical guidance
abstract_en: The invention relates to the crossing field of water management and artificial intelligence, and the disclosed method solves the problems of difficult coordination of multi-main-body benefit conflict, insufficient utilization of a drainage basin space topological structure, physical constraint, splitting in a decision process, limitation of self-adaptation capability and the like in the prior art. The method comprises the steps of abstracting a drainage basin into a directed graph structure, generating node embedded vectors by utilizing a graph attention network guided by physics, explicitly introducing physical constraint factors into an attention mechanism, configuring intelligent agents for each sub-drainage basin to perform distributed strategy learning, performing collaborative training by adopting a multi-intelligent depth deterministic strategy gradient algorithm, guiding fair distribution by using a global reward function in a Nash product form, and combining a local reward function containing nonlinear physical penalty items to ensure physical constraints such as water balance. The invention realizes the distributed, physical consistent and self-adaptive optimal configuration of the water resources in the river basin, and is mainly used for improving the fairness, efficiency and feasibility of water resource allocation.

title_en: Shared energy storage dynamic configuration method and system based on income distribution strategy
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of energy storage analysis, and discloses a shared energy storage dynamic configuration method and system based on a benefit distribution strategy. The method comprises the steps of obtaining electricity demand and photovoltaic data of a user, quantitatively analyzing energy storage utilization contribution degree, establishing a profit distribution parameter, collecting photovoltaic historical data, decomposing uncertainty into three components, establishing a differentiated demand prediction model, constructing a source load matching degree evaluation system, calculating real-time, time period and daily matching degree to obtain a capacity configuration demand matrix, inputting a multi-user collaborative optimization algorithm, obtaining an optimal capacity distribution scheme through profit distribution strategy and benefit maximization, establishing a dynamic adjustment mechanism, monitoring profits in real time, redistributing capacity, and forming a feedback optimization mechanism and an operation configuration report. The application solves the problems of undefined revenue distribution and difficult photovoltaic uncertainty energy storage configuration of multiple investment subjects, and improves the operation efficiency and the revenue distribution fairness of the shared energy storage system.
assignees: SUQIAN POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Consistency scoring method and system for subjective content
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for scoring consistency of subjective content, which relate to the field of big data mining and analysis, and the method comprises the following steps: calculating the scoring probability of the scoring personnel for the scored objects of different grades by using historical scoring data; calculating the grading distribution of the grading personnel for the graded objects of different grades by utilizing historical grading data; calculating scoring differences among scoring personnel according to the scoring distribution, and selecting a plurality of scoring personnel with the scoring distribution differences larger than a distribution threshold value to form scoring groups; the method comprises the steps of obtaining the score of each scoring person to be scored in a scoring group, and calculating the reliability of the score given by each scoring person according to the scoring probability of each scoring person; and correcting the score of each scoring person according to the credibility of the score given by the scoring person to serve as the final score of the scoring person. The method solves the problems that in subjective content evaluation, the evaluation result is greatly influenced by subjective experience and judgment of evaluation personnel, and fairness and authenticity are difficult to guarantee.

title_en: Heterogeneous type emergency resource scheduling optimization method considering fairness
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heterogeneous type emergency resource scheduling optimization method considering fairness, and belongs to the field of emergency resource scheduling optimization. Aiming at compact cooperative heterogeneous resources, adopting time and satisfaction rate dual dimension modeling, adopting a mixed coding and decoding mode according to problem characteristics, expressing an emergency resource scheduling scheme in a mathematical form, aiming at target and constraint conditions, adopting a random rule with priority to ensure the quality of an initial population, adopting a cross operator combining shuffling cross and partial matching cross to ensure the diversity and stability of the population in an iterative process, adopting self-adaptive cross variation probability to maintain the diversity of the population, improving the efficiency of the algorithm, adopting an elite retention strategy with a lowest crowdedness threshold to increase the diversity of the population and prevent the population from maturing prematurely. The method is suitable for dispatching optimization of the close-cooperation type heterogeneous resources under the condition of supply and demand in the early period of disasters, and provides a new thought for solving the problem of dispatching the heterogeneous resources in emergency resources.

title_en: system
abstract_en: To provide a system for collecting information regarding natural disasters to provide guidance on appropriate evacuation places and reconstruction support.SOLUTION: A system comprises means of: collecting information regarding natural disasters to automatically distribute evacuation places and evacuation routes according to disaster situations of the respective areas to a preliminarily registered guidance destination including image information; and guiding procedures of reconstruction support, providing places of relief supplies, and selling places of required items by unit of municipality by reporting damage situations in reconstruction.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Airport moment fairness calculation method based on peak demand
abstract_en: The invention discloses an airport moment fairness calculation method based on peak demand, which is characterized in that the flight time from each airport to an waypoint is obtained according to historical flight operation data, and the expected flight flow of the waypoint is calculated by combining with an airport group strategic flight schedule; carrying out statistical processing on historical flight operation data, and setting the publishing capacity of the waypoints; substituting the strategic flight schedule and related parameters into a basic time allocation model, comparing the expected flow of the waypoints with the magnitude relation of the published capacity, determining the peak period distribution of the waypoints, and counting the times that each airport flight in the airport group belongs to the peak period at the waypoints; and counting the moment offset of each airport flight at the waypoint, and calculating the airport fairness index of each airport at the waypoint according to a proportion principle. The method fully considers the peak time demand of each airport on the waypoint to obtain the fairness index value of each airport, and scientifically evaluates the fairness influence of the time offset result on each airport.

title_en: Method and system for implementing a cloud based email distribution fairness algorithm
abstract_en: Disclosed is an approach for implementing a system, method, and computer program product for a marketing automation tool that implements an advanced fairness scheme for resources. The order that work items are deployed is carefully managed to ensure that customers are treated fairly. This prevents and/or minimizes any customer from being adversely affected by other customers.

title_en: A kind of evaluation method of transit trip fairness
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of evaluation methods of transit trip fairness, and by proposing the concept of equivalent walking time and combining some basic datas of public transport, sameization processing is carried out to different trip mode the time it takes.The present invention is plugged into equivalent walking time, road mileage, both ends, and this five quantification of targets evaluation residents of train number ratio and bus departure frequency take the fairness of transit trip on schedule for percentage of time, public transport, and data are more easy to obtain, and have higher feasibility.After calculating two-level index, the present invention is classified index with reference to actual conditions, sameization processing is carried out, and the weight of each index is determined with Delphi method, in order to intuitively calculate the fairness of a region transit trip, preferably for urban public transport service, to promote social benefit.

title_en: A kind of medical aid point site selecting method considering disaster-stricken demand urgency
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of medical aid point site selecting methods for considering disaster-stricken demand urgency, actually devastated nearby has several alternative rescue points, the present invention has comprehensively considered rescue point resource finiteness, disaster-stricken demand urgency, rescue efficiency high efficiency and medical material fairness in distribution, several rescue points are selected from alternative rescue point, to help to carry out the rescue after calamity.The present invention selectes injury to personnel degree, damage of building degree, the road extent of damage, index of disaster prepareaness capability and disaster derivation possibility as demand urgency evaluation index by the way of Empirical rules, and each index weight shared in demand urgency has been determined with analytic hierarchy process (AHP).An optimal site selection model is constructed by transporting to minimize total time the maximization of the sum of each disaster-stricken satisfactory rate of information demand, medical material, and centainly has goods and materials output, goods and materials aggregate supply to be less than aggregate demand etc. with the alternative rescue point chosen and uses restraint to objective function.

title_en: Double-layer multi-objective optimization water pollution load distribution method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double-layer multi-objective optimization water pollution load distribution method, which comprises the following steps: determining an environmental kini coefficient according to the environmental kini coefficient index and the weight of each environmental kini coefficient index; performing upper-layer load distribution according to a double-layer multi-objective optimization water pollution load distribution model based on the minimum environmental kini coefficient and the minimum unit pollutant discharge cost; and performing lower-layer load distribution according to a double-layer multi-objective optimization water pollution load distribution model based on the maximum total industrial output value and the minimum uneven reduction rate of each sewage discharge outlet. The invention constructs a double-layer multi-objective optimization water pollution load distribution model considering water environment protection tax, gives consideration to fairness and efficiency principles aiming at management mechanisms of different levels, enables a distribution scheme to be more reasonable and easier to be accepted by pollution discharge persons, and simultaneously solves the tax amount setting problem of a drainage basin management department.

title_en: Bus driver scheduling method based on task shift fairness
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bus driver scheduling method based on task shift fairness, which comprises the following three steps: step one, calculating all feasible shift combinations of a driver in one day; step two, performing combined calculation to obtain a task shift combination meeting the multi-day requirements; and step three, combining the multi-day task shift combination into a final driver shift scheduling scheme. The method can effectively distribute all the shifts to all the drivers on the premise of ensuring that each driver task shift is as fair as possible in any scheduling period (days or weeks and the like), realizes digital self-adaptive shift scheduling, and replaces the bottleneck problem that the traditional manual shift scheduling cannot be effectively scheduled.

title_en: Urging case allocation method, urging case allocation device, urging case allocation equipment and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to an artificial intelligence technology, and discloses a method for distributing cases to be collected, which comprises the following steps: acquiring case information and a collection of collection urging members of all cases to be urged; classifying the collection cases by utilizing a pre-constructed random forest classification model according to case information to obtain the grades of the collection cases; the collection efficiency and the collection rate are integrated to obtain the collection efficiency of the collector on the same day; acquiring the performance of a receiver corresponding to the case to be received, and calculating the preprocessing time of the case to be received based on the performance of the receiver and the grade corresponding to the case to be received; and distributing the cases on the next day based on the level of the cases to be collected, the preprocessing time and the collection efficiency of the collectors on the same day. In addition, the invention also relates to a block chain technology, and the case information can be stored in the nodes of the block chain. The invention also provides a collection case distribution device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The invention can improve the fairness of distribution of the collection cases.

title_en: Dam water resource allocation method based on whale algorithm
abstract_en: The invention mainly applies a mathematical modeling method, can be applied to solving the problems of water resource distribution and fairness thereof, and particularly relates to a dam water resource distribution method based on whale algorithm. Calculating the water distribution amount of the water-requiring side, converting into proportion, and obtaining the product of the water distribution amount and the total water supply amount of the water supply side as the optimal water resource distribution mode; the whale optimization algorithm is adopted, a specific distribution scheme is obtained through calculation, the method mainly adopts the idea of linear programming, various practical factors are modeled, practical limiting factors are expressed by mathematical inequalities, and the optimal solution of a target equation is solved within the range of limiting conditions, namely the optimal distribution scheme to be sought.

title_en: Resource allocation method, device, storage medium and computer equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a resource allocation method, a resource allocation device, a storage medium and computer equipment. According to the method, three aspects of user characteristics, resource characteristics and scene characteristics are used as reference bases for resource allocation, so that objective and fairness of resource allocation are guaranteed, a target user can obtain resources which meet requirements of the target user, the use effect of the resources can be improved, the total amount of the transaction can be improved, a proper preferential policy can be provided for the user, shopping experience of the user is improved, and loyalty of the user is further enhanced; and a tree structure of model sample feature classification is constructed based on feature engineering, and model sample features with obvious influence are screened out from a plurality of feature dimensions through splitting gains, so that a judging rule on a service is assisted to be determined, the interpretability of a model output result is improved, and the accurate prediction of the verification and marketing behavior of a target user on different resources under different service scenes is effectively realized.

title_en: Intelligent logistics data analysis system based on block chain
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent logistics data analysis system based on a blockchain, which relates to the technical field of blockchains, wherein a user module in the system realizes interaction with a blockchain platform and a cloud edge cooperative platform for a user; the cloud service business module comprises: resource equipment and cloud facilitator clients; the cloud service provider client side realizes interaction with the service side of the blockchain platform and the cloud edge cooperative platform for a cloud service provider administrator; the resource equipment provides cloud computing service support for users; the cloud edge cooperative platform performs intelligent resource scheduling according to the subscription data and the resource pool condition; cloud edge cooperation platform includes: platform equipment, a platform server and a blockchain access controller; the platform equipment realizes interaction with the blockchain platform through the blockchain access controller; platform server service display, registration, authentication and/or subscription. The invention can ensure the fairness and transparency of scheduling among the user, the cloud edge cooperative platform and the cloud service provider, thereby ensuring the cloud edge cooperative development.

title_en: Intelligent water-saving irrigation area scheduling system based on AI multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intersection of agricultural water conservancy and artificial intelligence, and discloses an intelligent water-saving scheduling system for a pouring area based on AI multi-source data fusion. The system realizes the deep fusion of data driving and physical mechanism by embedding a farmland hydro-thermal balance equation and channel hydrodynamic constraint into PI-STGNN, remarkably improves the accuracy of prediction of water demand and water supply capacity of crops and the robustness under extreme conditions, performs space-time alignment on multi-source heterogeneous data by utilizing dynamic time regularity and Kriging interpolation to generate a standardized characteristic tensor, generates a time-sharing partition gate control instruction which takes the maximization of the yield of grains per unit water amount and the fairness of water distribution into consideration based on reinforcement learning, and outputs natural language scheduling basis comprising growth period, soil moisture content and precipitation probability.

title_en: Systems and methods for decomposition in workforce optimization with search sub-problems
abstract_en: Systems and methods are provided for solving workforce management scheduling optimization decomposing and iteratively. Execution of a master problem can occur to select a best schedule among generated schedules for each employee of a group of employees while enforcing one or more global constraints. The generated schedule can be determined by execution of one or more sub-problems, each of the one or more sub-problems can be enforced work rules for the respective employee through the use of reduced cost for the employee. A flexible objective function can be executed to account for workforce management schedule wide metrics, including fitness of schedule to demand, fairness among the group of employees, schedule preferences and others.

title_en: Distributed power transaction contract consensus method based on energy block chain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed power transaction contract consensus method based on an energy block chain, which specifically comprises the following steps: constructing a alliance energy block chain; and designating a master node; formulating a distributed power transaction intelligent contract; formulating constraint conditions of distributed power transaction intelligent contract consensus, and determining effective power contract transaction; the block consensus is completed in five stages of request, preparation, submission and response of the effective power contract transaction, and the block consensus is recorded in a block chain; executing the distributed power transaction smart contract. The invention can realize the optimal allocation of energy resources and the efficient and reasonable utilization of the resources on the basis of ensuring fairness, safety and reliability of transactions.

title_en: Transparent data annotation crowdsourcing method, system and medium for settlement balance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transparent data labeling crowd-sourcing method, a system and a medium for settlement balance, wherein the method comprises the steps of establishing a data labeling crowd-sourcing system, determining an interactive entity, enabling a task requester to mix labeled data and unlabeled data to obtain data to be labeled, setting public conditions of the labeled data, enabling a task information tuple to be disclosed on a blockchain through an intelligent contract after encryption, storing task rewards, setting task deposit, disclosing task download links, enabling workers to confirm to accept tasks and store the task deposit, downloading and completing data labeling tasks, generating certificates, disclosing task results and certificates, enabling workers to prove the task requester, evaluating the task results, creating and broadcasting a hash time locking transaction, and paying the task rewards to the workers. The invention carries out fair transaction under the supervision of a non-trusted third party through the blockchain and the hash time lock, realizes the objectivity and fairness of task rewards distribution, and ensures the balance and transparency of task rewards settlement.

title_en: Common resource distributing method based on labor, law, capability, morality bottom line principle
abstract_en: The invention provides a common resource distributing method based on a labor, law, capability, morality bottom line principle. The common resource distributing method based on the labor, law, capability, morality bottom line principle is suitable for distribution according to work in a market orientated economy environment and directly links with legal compliance, work achievements and the like; factors such as social morality are considered; the common resource distributing method can be widely used for distributing various resources of companies, enterprises and public institutions and government agencies and organizations; objectivity and fairness can be embodied sufficiently; working enthusiasm of people is aroused; and the common resource distributing method has high reference and application value and serves for rules by law. According to the distributing scheme, preconditions are preset, and resources of people to be distributed are distributed according to the preset preconditions and a classifying type. The resources are distributed reasonably by the common resource distributing method, the labor amount bottom line is guaranteed, common resources are distributed under the condition that factors such as law, capability and social morality are considered, and the common resource distributing method based on the labor, law, capability, morality bottom line principle is suitable for distributing resources such as currencies (generally meaning cashes) and countable articles divided equally.

title_en: Steel based on scheduling fairness dispatches from the factory logistics two benches dispatching method and system
abstract_en: Dispatched from the factory logistics two benches dispatching method and system the invention discloses the steel based on scheduling fairness, by server storage module, server processing module, prestowage plan mathematics model module, task assign Mathematical Modeling module, queue machine and printing mechanism into, by two benches scheduling method, that is " prestowage plan+task assign " pattern, makes the dispatch from the factory scheduling process of logistics of steel tend to fair.Advance prestowage in two benches scheduling method is prestowage plan, be follow-up task assign in time creation it is convenient, driver queue up treat that single time is greatly decreased, dispatching efficiency is obviously improved.
assignees: SHANGHAI STEEL UNION LOGISTICS CO LTD

title_en: Order allocation method, device and mobile terminal
abstract_en: The embodiment of the present application provides a kind of order allocation method, device and mobile terminal.Wherein, the reservation order request that different drivers end is sent is received；Wherein, the reservation order request includes order requirement and driver's account；It determines order requirement and reserves the target reservation order request that order matches；Target driver's account in order request is reserved according to the target, by the reservation Order splitting to the target driver account.Technical solution provided by the embodiments of the present application ensure that the fairness of Order splitting.

title_en: Timesharing dispenses distribution method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a kind of timesharing dispatching distribution method and devices, by the dispensed amounts for estimating each dispatching period of target area, region configuration dispatching person's resource is dispensed for target, and reference is provided, it realizes dispatching person and dispenses the equity of demand, the waste for avoiding express delivery resource solves the problems, such as to distribute between dispatching person's resource and dispatching period demand not reciprocity.The method comprise the steps that obtaining target dispenses region；The influence factor weight table that period probability tables and target dispatching region are dispensed according to influence factor obtains influence factor dispatching period weight table；Daily dispensed amounts are estimated according to influence factor dispatching period weight table, the number of users in target dispatching region and target dispatching region, obtain each dispatching period in target dispatching region estimates dispensed amounts.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and storage medium for allocating income of microgrid
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for allocating earnings of a micro-grid, wherein the method comprises the steps of establishing a multi-party investment operation cost model and a multi-party investment earnings model, determining a total earnings rate by using a cost, earnings and average earnings rate algorithm, determining a target earnings rate corresponding to each party investment operation subject in the current year by selecting a minimum value of an unfair coefficient when a preset earnings allocation constraint condition is met as a target unfair coefficient and establishing a fairness objective function by combining the J-year multi-party total earnings rate, the preset earnings allocation constraint condition and the target unfair coefficient, and finally obtaining the target earnings of each party in the current year by using the target earnings rate and the cost of each party. By the method, the conflict of interests among different operation subjects is reduced, unfair and unfair market competition is avoided, single-side investment pressure and risk are reduced through diversified cooperation, the enthusiasm of each party is improved, and reasonable planning and rapid construction and development of the microgrid are accelerated.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Method and device for determining object allocation scheme
abstract_en: The embodiment of the specification provides a method and a device for determining an object allocation scheme. In the method, an allocation cost representation and constraint conditions are constructed according to users and objects to be allocated; performing iterative processing until an iteration stop condition is satisfied, in the following manner: aiming at each user, obtaining a current user allocation probability vector according to a user iteration association relation for representing the correlation between user allocation probability vectors in two adjacent iterations and a previous iteration user allocation probability vector or an initial user allocation probability vector corresponding to the user; calculating a current intermediate variable according to the current user allocation probability vector and the current fairness variable of each user; outputting a user allocation probability matrix obtained according to the user allocation probability vectors of the users; and determining the allocation mode between the user and the object according to the user allocation probability matrix.
assignees: ALIPAY HANGZHOU INF TECH CO LTD

title_en: Renewable energy consumption responsibility assessment method based on carbon market system
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of electric power markets, and discloses a renewable energy source consumption responsibility assessment method based on a carbon market system, which comprises the following steps of: s1, acquiring meteorological data, power grid data and power load data, and preprocessing; s2, predicting future renewable energy power generation capacity by using a machine learning model based on the preprocessed data; s3, calculating carbon emission according to the power generation data and the emission factor; s4, designing an optimization model based on renewable energy prediction and carbon emission calculation results, determining an optimization target and constraint conditions, and solving an optimal scheduling scheme; s5, designing a carbon quota allocation method and a transaction rule, and carrying out carbon market transaction; s6, calculating renewable energy source absorption responsibility of each region, and making absorption responsibility targets and assessment standards. The application improves the accuracy and fairness of renewable energy consumption, optimizes the scheduling and carbon emission management of the power system, and promotes the efficient utilization of renewable energy and the realization of carbon emission reduction targets.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID SHANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO;SHANXI XINXING ELECTRIC POWER MARKET RES INSTITUTE

title_en: Revenue distribution method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium for distributing benefits, relates to the field of digital payment, and can solve the problem of unfair distribution of the benefits. The method comprises the steps of determining a data contribution degree score of a data provider based on the number of sample data and the number of fields of the sample data, determining a calculation contribution degree score of a calculation force provider based on a resource consumption index, determining a model contribution degree score of the model provider based on the number of parameters of the model and the number of model calls, and respectively carrying out profit distribution on the data provider, the calculation force provider and the model provider based on the total profit of tasks, the data contribution degree score, the calculation force contribution degree score and the model contribution degree score to determine the profit of the data provider, the profit of the calculation force provider and the profit of the model provider. The application can realize according to labour values allocation and improve fairness of income allocation.

title_en: Mid-term examination information management system for high and new technology enterprises
abstract_en: The invention provides a medium-term examination information management system of a high and new technology enterprise, which mainly comprises a map module, a planning module, a mobile terminal connection module, an expert selection module, a scoring module, a display module and a database, wherein the map and the database are used for assisting in supporting the management and the use of examination information, and the distribution condition and the basic information condition of a reference enterprise are provided, so that an examination route and a plan are planned, the early-stage preparation work is reduced, the database is used for blindly selecting an examination expert, the examination fairness is realized, and the workload of manual selection and the unfair behavior are reduced. The invention effectively improves the working efficiency of middle-term examination, realizes office automation and improves the convenience of examination work.

title_en: Airspace allocation method and device based on block chain
abstract_en: The application discloses a block chain-based airspace allocation method and device, which relate to the technical field of airspace management and mainly aim to improve the fairness and efficiency of airspace allocation and the utilization rate of airspace resources by utilizing a block chain technology. The main technical scheme comprises the following steps: establishing a airspace allocation alliance block chain and constructing a corresponding block structure; expressing the airspace using plan by airspace grid coding; in the airspace scheme, determining whether conflicts with the spatial positions and the use time of other airspaces according to the spatial positions and the use time of the airspace use plan; if no conflict exists, reserving a airspace scheme; if the conflict exists, adjusting an airspace using plan according to a preset algorithm, taking a preset airspace evaluation standard as a consensus algorithm, and selecting an optimal airspace scheme; issuing a final airspace scheme for approval in an intelligent contract mode, and finishing accounting and block packing on the determined final airspace scheme to finish chain growth. The application can be applied to static and dynamic airspace allocation processes.

title_en: Bus driver scheduling method based on task shift fairness
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bus driver scheduling method based on task shift fairness, which comprises the following three steps: step one, calculating to obtain all feasible shift combinations of a driver in one day; step two, combining calculation to obtain a task shift combination meeting the multi-day requirement; and step three, combining and recombining the multi-day mission shifts into a final driver shift arrangement scheme. The method can effectively distribute all the drivers for all the shifts under the premise of ensuring that the shifts of tasks of all the drivers are as fair as possible in any scheduling period (days or weeks, etc.), realizes digital self-adaptive shift scheduling, and replaces the bottleneck problem that the traditional manual shift scheduling cannot be performed effectively.

title_en: Sampling investigation method and system considering distribution balance of power market members
abstract_en: The sampling investigation method and the system for considering the distribution balance of the power market members are characterized by selecting information showing the distribution of the power market members, including power consumption information, distribution coordinates and area information, calculating corresponding quantitative balance indexes based on the information to further obtain distance sums, and screening to obtain sampling investigation results considering the distribution balance of the power market members by adopting a mode of combining the distance sums with penalty functions. The invention has more stable effect in maintaining regional fairness and transaction electric quantity fairness, so that the obtained questionnaire is more typical, can fully reflect the overall situation of the electric power market, and can modify weight parameters according to requirements to obtain more targeted results.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle peer-to-peer logistics network distribution system and distribution method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle peer-to-peer logistics network system and a distribution method thereof, which are used for fully playing the characteristics of small batch, high efficiency and flexible scheduling of unmanned aerial vehicles and realizing direct and rapid delivery of end-to-end emergency articles and efficient sharing of emergency supplies in cities. Unmanned aerial vehicle logistics network delivery system includes: the unmanned aerial vehicle dispatching platform is used for planning and dispatching path information for the unmanned aerial vehicle according to the material dispatching starting point and the material dispatching end point and sending the information to an unmanned aerial vehicle automatic airport node; the unmanned aerial vehicle is used for landing on an unmanned aerial vehicle parking platform when arriving at each unmanned aerial vehicle automation airport node according to the received distribution path information and the distribution path; when receiving a takeoff notification, flying to a next unmanned automatic airport node according to a planned path; the unmanned aerial vehicle automation airport node is used for determining the next unmanned aerial vehicle automation airport node according to the received distribution path information; and rotating to a corresponding take-off direction according to the position information of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and informing the unmanned aerial vehicle to take off.
assignees: ELECTRONIC SCIENCE RES INST CHINA ELECTRONICS TECH GROUP CORP

title_en: P2P market mechanism considering individual market momentum of producers and consumers and fair distribution of benefits
abstract_en: The invention discloses a P2P market mechanism considering individual market momentum of producers and consumers and equitably distributing benefits in the technical field of electric economy and electric power market operation, which comprises the following steps: step 1: determining the electricity price controllable interval and the market price controllable index of each producer, and analyzing a rational quotation strategy; step 2: constructing a market center matching mechanism for emphasizing total social benefits and an individual center matching mechanism for emphasizing individual benefits; step 3, establishing a model; and 4, step 4: constructing an interaction model; and 5: and constructing a Nash bargaining model. The mechanism of the invention constructs a Nash bargaining model considering the fairness of benefit distribution by taking the market potential of each main producer and consumer into consideration, ensures the effectiveness of the P2P power market and follows the principle of incentive compatibility; according to the invention, an NLMF-Stackelberg master-slave differential game model is constructed, the interaction between a producer optimal quotation strategy and a consumer optimal electricity purchasing strategy is analyzed, the market potential is brought into the producer non-cooperative game model, and an individual center matching mechanism is ensured to meet the excitation compatibility principle.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHEAST;STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD JIAXING POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: Differential game-based data transaction income distribution method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a differential game-based data transaction income distribution method and a differential game-based data transaction income distribution system, which belong to the technical field of data transactions, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining an objective function of a government when conducting data transactions with an enterprise; obtaining the optimal effort degree of open shared data of government and enterprise, and calculating the open shared storage of data in a stable state; determining an optimal data transaction inventory; obtaining a profit distribution scheme matrix of governments and enterprises; determining a negative ideal profit allocation scheme, and taking the negative ideal profit allocation scheme as a starting point of profit allocation; establishing a dynamic profit allocation scheme; introducing a dynamic profit allocation mechanism to obtain a dynamic allocation profit function; by dynamically assigning revenue functions, the government is assigned respective revenue when conducting data transactions with the enterprise. The method can ensure the time consistency of a profit distribution mechanism when the government and enterprises conduct data transaction, promote the stability of profit distribution, and promote the fairness and stability of data open sharing cooperation between the government and enterprises.

title_en: Method for distributing benefits of virtual power plant internal alliance cooperative game
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for distributing benefits of virtual power plant internal alliance cooperative games, which comprises the steps of constructing an alliance by distributed energy sources, constructing a multi-subject optimization scheduling model in a virtual power plant with maximized electricity selling benefits, constructing constraint conditions of the multi-subject optimization scheduling model in the virtual power plant, determining a multi-subject cooperative game model of game participants, strategy sets and characteristic functions, determining the overall electricity selling benefits of the virtual power plant, designing a two-stage refined benefit distribution scheme of a multi-factor improvement shapley value method and a kernel method based on parity loops, and calling a CLPEX solver of YALMIP on a Matlab platform by the cooperative game scheduling model and the benefit distribution strategy to solve. The method realizes the cooperation and complementation operation among alliances in the virtual power plant, and ensures fairness and rationality of the income distribution among a plurality of subjects.

title_en: Resource allocation method and device for agents, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of data processing and financial science and technology, in particular to a resource allocation method, a device, computer equipment and a storage medium of agents, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining working state information and historical working information of a plurality of agents, and generating weight lists of the agents according to the working state information and the historical working information; the method comprises the steps of obtaining value evaluation information and residual deadline information of a plurality of distribution objects in a resource pool, generating a distribution sequence list of the plurality of distribution objects according to the value evaluation information and the residual deadline information, and matching the distribution objects for agents according to the distribution sequence list and the weight list. The application provides a single pool grabbing algorithm for distributing customer lists to agents, wherein the algorithm distributes a renewal pool list through weight, evaluation and resource distribution, improves business success rate, ensures fairness and efficiency of list distribution in a resource pool, and improves customer service efficiency and quality.
assignees: CHINA PING AN PROPERTY INSURANCE CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent management method and system based on multi-factor task allocation and performance evaluation
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent management method and system based on multi-factor task allocation and performance evaluation, comprising the steps of S1, performing multi-task creation on a system by an administrator, inputting corresponding task descriptions and relevant coefficients of tasks, S2, calculating total scores of all tasks by the system according to the task descriptions and the task relevant coefficients input by task performers, S3, selecting all tasks by the task performers through mutual negotiation, S4, recording by the task performers according to the task execution degree conditions, S5, calculating actual scores of all tasks by the system according to the recorded task completion degree conditions, S6, calculating total task score conditions of all task performers by the system according to the actual scores of all tasks, and S7, ranking and prize distribution by the system according to the total score conditions of all task performers. According to the intelligent management method and system for multi-factor task allocation and performance evaluation, fairness of task allocation and accuracy of performance evaluation can be effectively improved.
assignees: HAINAN DANZHOU YUEHAI WATER SUPPLY CO LTD

title_en: Metering method, metering device and metering equipment for classified load electric quantity of distributed photovoltaic power generation
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a metering method, a metering device and metering equipment for classified load electric quantity of distributed photovoltaic power generation. The method comprises the steps of setting electric quantity metering points for all distributed photovoltaic power generation modes respectively, determining the running mode of the load electric quantity of a distributed photovoltaic power generation user in response to the fact that classified electric loads exist, calculating the electric quantity of each electric quantity metering point corresponding to the determined running mode based on the determined running mode, and determining the classified electric load electric quantity of the distributed photovoltaic power generation user based on the electric quantity of each electric quantity metering point. The embodiment realizes the accuracy of classified electricity load metering, and further realizes the accuracy of classified electricity price electricity load metering, thereby meeting the requirement of metering fairness and fairness.

title_en: Intelligent gas pipe network gas supply allocation method, internet of things system and medium
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent gas pipe network gas supply allocation method, an Internet of things system and a medium, which comprise the following steps: the method comprises the steps that an internal combustion gas metering device in a target area is controlled to obtain gas statistical data and store the gas statistical data in a storage unit; acquiring historical gas consumption data of a target area; determining target demand information of a future time point of the target area based on the historical gas consumption data; based on the target demand information, predicting a target difference amplitude of a gas supply and demand difference at a future time point of a target area; determining supply and demand difference reasons corresponding to a target area based on gas statistical data, target difference amplitude and environment data of the target area for the target area with the target difference amplitude meeting a first preset condition; determining a gas supply adjustment parameter based on the target difference amplitude and the supply and demand difference reason, storing the gas supply adjustment parameter into a storage unit, generating a gas supply adjustment instruction based on the gas supply adjustment parameter, and sending the gas supply adjustment instruction to the terminal equipment; and generating an allocation instruction in response to the remaining storage space meeting a second preset condition.

title_en: Diversity recommendation optimization method integrating inventory information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a diversity recommendation optimization method for integrating inventory information, which comprises the steps of 1, constructing a data set of a user and commodities, 2, constructing a matrix decomposition model, 3, constructing a utility maximization function, embedding commodity inventory constraint and commodity type constraint to optimize recommendation results, and 4, solving a prediction score of the user on the commodities by adopting a heuristic algorithm, and obtaining a final recommendation result. The invention adopts the matrix-decomposed commodity recommendation model, and simultaneously fuses the inventory information of the commodity, thereby reducing the condition that the recommendation system recommends the backorder product, and further improving the fairness of system recommendation and the satisfaction degree of users on the platform.

title_en: A kind of fired power generating unit generation capacity allocation method considering carbon transaction cost
abstract_en: A kind of fired power generating unit generation capacity allocation method considering carbon transaction cost.It includes the carbon emission factor for calculating each fired power generating unit of t-1；Calculate t fired power generating unit carbon emission benchmark；Calculate t carbon quota granting amount；Determine t carbon quota deviation；Establish thermoelectricity overall cost model；Solving model calculates when meeting power generation needs the smallest thermoelectricity overall cost.The fired power generating unit generation capacity allocation method provided by the invention for considering carbon transaction cost is just on the basis of existing low-carbon technology and carbon market operating experience, it proposes and considers that the thermoelectricity of conventional coal-fired, carbon capture fire coal and combustion gas fired power generating unit discharge intensity unifies carbon emission benchmark method, purpose three classes thermoelectricity power supply being included in unified carbon allocation of quota mechanism is to consider different coal-fired and capacity unit emission performance differences, to guarantee the fairness of quota granting.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO RES INST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Lottery drawing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lottery drawing method, which comprises the following steps of firstly generating and publishing a first group of lottery numbers at preset time, secondly judging winning conditions by comparing purchased lottery numbers and distributing prizes according to rules, then detecting the balance of a prize pool, generating additional lottery numbers until the balance is lower than a preset threshold value or the number of times of additional, and finally carrying out winning judgment and prize distribution on the additional lottery numbers and rolling out non-distributed prizes to a next prize pool. The method improves the attraction and fairness of the lottery ticket by adding the lottery ticket for a plurality of times, and ensures reasonable distribution of the lottery ticket.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle unloading decision and track optimization method and system for sea
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of communication, and particularly relates to a method and a system for unloading decision and track optimization of an offshore unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the method comprises the following steps of S1, establishing a communication simulation model, including position information of a user and an unmanned aerial vehicle edge server, and setting parameters; and S2, under the condition of determining total computing resources, setting up a joint optimization model by taking the time delay and the energy consumption comprehensive cost of all tasks as targets, S3, optimizing an unloading strategy of ground equipment, searching an unloading scheme through a reinforcement learning method, distributing the computing resources of a server according to a differential evolution simulated annealing hybrid algorithm, and S4, optimizing the moving track of the unmanned aerial vehicle by taking load fairness as targets. According to the invention, computing and storage resources are provided for navigation users in a marine special communication environment, so that the service quality of the mobile users and the network use experience are improved. The invention can also be applied to offshore emergency rescue scenes to provide high-priority and low-delay quick service for emergency users.

title_en: Two-stage toughness improvement method and device for power distribution network, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a two-stage toughness improving method, a device, computer equipment and a storage medium for a power distribution network, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a pre-disaster fault scene and various known conditions required by calculation; according to various known conditions, a power distribution network operation model is established, optimization solution is carried out by taking the minimum load reduction weighted value as an objective function to obtain a minimum load reduction weighted value, the minimum load reduction weighted value is taken as the upper limit of the load reduction weighted value, new constraint is added in the power distribution network operation model, any fairness principle is used as the objective function to carry out optimization solution, and an optimal strategy meeting minimum coincidence reduction and meeting fairness reduction of general load is obtained. The invention has the advantages of ensuring that important nodes recover preferentially and the load of non-important nodes is reduced fairly on the premise of ensuring that the load reduction weighted value is minimum.

title_en: Mixed automatic driving sharing travel driver-multiplier matching method based on behavior perception
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of shared taxi taking systems, and discloses a behavior awareness-based hybrid automatic driving shared travel driver-passenger matching method, which comprises the steps of receiving passenger order information through a platform and collecting matchable vehicle information (HV and AV); the method comprises the steps of constructing a double-layer optimization model, generating an order recommendation scheme and commission for the HV which can be used currently, constructing a Markov model based on response behaviors of a human driver, obtaining response behavior probability of the Markov model, and generating a final scheme through the optimization model. According to the method, the selection behavior of a human driver on an order is considered, behavior perception optimization is combined with MDP, a multi-objective decision model at an individual level is built for each HV, a high-value user response is predicted by using a behavior model based on logit, high-value user selection, automatic driving vehicle availability and platform targets are integrated, a final order-vehicle distribution scheme is generated, and the overall dispatching result is guaranteed to have efficiency and fairness.

title_en: Nuclear power spare part inventory parameter distribution method and device, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of nuclear power, and particularly relates to a nuclear power spare part inventory parameter distribution method and device, a computer readable storage medium and electronic equipment. The method comprises the steps of obtaining nuclear power spare part service data of each power plant, constructing a group plant cooperative nuclear power spare part inventory parameter distribution objective function according to the nuclear power spare part service data, wherein the nuclear power spare part inventory parameter distribution objective function takes cost minimization and fairness deviation minimization as optimization targets, and carrying out optimization solution on the nuclear power spare part inventory parameter distribution objective function to obtain a nuclear power spare part inventory parameter distribution result. According to the application, the cost minimization and fairness deviation minimization can be used as optimization targets, the objective function of the inventory parameter distribution of the nuclear power spare parts coordinated by the group factory is constructed, and the obtained inventory parameter distribution result of the nuclear power spare parts can give consideration to the overall cost and fairness, so that the overall management effect is effectively improved.
assignees: CHINA NUCLEAR POWER OPERATIONS CO LTD

title_en: Regional water resource optimal allocation overall value assessment method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water resource value evaluation, and discloses a regional water resource optimal allocation overall value evaluation method which comprises the following steps of S1, calculating water demand, S2, calculating class value, S3, calculating processing cost, S4, calculating maintenance cost, S5, calculating political economy value, S6, overall value evaluation, S7 and outputting a result. The invention constructs an evaluation framework of policy-economy-cost three-dimensional fusion, breaks through the limitation of the traditional water resource value evaluation bias single economic dimension, realizes remarkable innovation in the aspects of policy-oriented quantization, cost accounting refinement and evaluation dynamics, converts abstract policy tendency into a computable weight variable, establishes a linkage mechanism with full chain cost, and ensures that the water resource allocation decision simultaneously meets the efficiency and fairness targets.
assignees: HUNAN INST OF WATER RESOURCES AND HYDROPOWER RESEARCH

title_en: Method for transparent and fair resource distribution
abstract_en: A computer-implemented system for allocation of a series of picks amongst multiple selectors in a selection process is configured to use total picks data, number of selectors data, and picks per selector data to determine a series of benchmark pick slots for each selector in accordance with a benchmark, for each selector, calculating a pick cost for awarding a pick position to the selector, awarding said pick position to the selector for whom the pick cost would least deviate the system from the benchmark and storing said pick cost of awarding said pick, and then iterating through the remainder of the draft using pick cost to determine who picks next, ensuring maximum fairness in the pick order. The system also manages the draft itself once the pick order is determined. It can assign value to the items chosen. It awards, or deducts, points from participants based upon their receiving picks that are better or worse than they should have, and for the quality of the items they have chosen.

title_en: System for managing cargo vehicle entry and exit and method thereof
title_ko: 화물 차량의 입출차 관리 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화물 차량의 입출차 관리 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 다수의 현장에서 화물 차량의 운전자들이 공통으로 사용하는 어플리케이션을 이용하여, 화물 차량의 기처리 운반 횟수(탕수)에 따라 입차 및 출차를 관리함으로써, 해당 현장에서의 업무가 특정 차량에 집중되지 않고 공평히 배분되도록 하는 것이 가능한 화물 차량의 입출차 관리 시스템 및 그 방법을 제공한다.

title_en: System and method for marketing mix optimization for brand equity management
