abstract_en: A method of marketing optimization with respect to brand lifetime management formulates a problem of brand equity maximization utilizing Markov Decision Process (MDP) thereby casting brand equity management as a long term regard optimization problem in MDP, The marketing mix is optimized by formulating the mix as actions in MDP and, utilizing historical marketing and transaction data, aspects of the MDP are estimated.

title_en: Unit shift method based on multi-population multi-target ant colony algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a unit shift method based on a multi-population multi-target ant colony algorithm. Aiming at the defects of the conventional unit shift problem model, the invention firstly provides a dual-target machine group shift model from the perspective of a machine group member and simultaneously considers the scheduling fairness and the member satisfaction degree, and then designs an efficient multi-target ant colony algorithm by combining the ant colony algorithm and a multi-group multi-target framework. Meanwhile, the invention provides a new hybrid complementary heuristic strategy, which makes full use of heuristic information about a fairness target and a satisfaction target and integrated heuristic information and is beneficial to comprehensively exploring pareto frontier. In addition, the invention also provides two different types of local search aiming at two targets respectively, which is beneficial to improving the quality of the solution. The multi-population multi-target ant colony algorithm disclosed by the invention is stable in performance on actual unit shift problems of different scales, and a series of high-quality feasible solutions can be obtained in a short time.

title_en: Multi-airport collaborative release method based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-airport collaborative release method based on deep reinforcement learning, which belongs to the field of air traffic management intellectualization, and comprises the following steps of firstly, aiming at m airports to be collaboratively released, and all flights of a local airline department in the m airports are sequenced from high to low according to priorities; generating an initial departure flight queue meeting the minimum total delay time based on airport fairness; then, establishing a multi-airport collaborative release model with the aim of minimizing the total delay cost for the initial departure flight queue based on the priorities of different flights; converting the multi-airport collaborative release model into a corresponding Markov decision process; and finally, a deep reinforcement learning algorithm A3C is selected to solve the Markov decision process to obtain a final multi-airport collaborative release departure queue, so that the total delay cost is reduced. The invention designs a novel multi-airport collaborative release method to reduce flight delay and improve the operation benefit of a multi-airport system.

title_en: Comprehensive load management user optimization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive load management user optimization method, belonging to the technical field of power load management; an integrated load management user preference method comprising: input into the load management system: test day h  n  Load gap of time period, response condition of each user with load gap time period on day before test, and history data of each execution time period on n-1 days before test; preprocessing input data; calculating the historical performance, risk avoidance, electricity production value and industry scenic spot degree of each user by utilizing the preprocessed data, carrying out weighted average, multiplying the invited quantity of each user to obtain a comprehensive evaluation index, and obtaining a user preferred scheme according to the comprehensive evaluation index; based on the coefficient of kunning, increasing a fairness constraint index to optimize the user preference; based on optimized user preference scheme, settingAnd calculating a rotation strategy of the factory under the comprehensive load management scheme.
assignees: STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;JINZHOU ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHEAST

title_en: P2P electricity right transaction price optimization method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric power markets, in particular to a P2P electricity right transaction price optimization method, a device, equipment and a readable storage medium, which comprise the following steps: the accounting electric quantity of each energy consumption enterprise and the electricity consumption right index of each energy consumption enterprise are determined, the electricity consumption right issuing of each energy consumption enterprise is completed, and a transaction main body in P2P transaction is determined; designing an electricity consumption right trading mechanism, calculating quotation expectations, solving the trading electricity consumption weights of all trading entities when the social benefit objective function is maximum in the current period according to the trading electricity consumption weight constraint conditions in the current period, and obtaining the final trading price and the trading electricity consumption weights of all trading entities; in the P2P transaction process, uncertainty of quotations of all transaction subjects participating in the transaction is fully considered, reserved prices of all transaction subjects are used as private information, so that the fact that the equity quotations under the speculative psychology do not exist in all transaction subjects in the transaction process is ensured, and economic benefits of all transaction subjects participating in the electricity utilization right transaction are improved.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID SHANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Multi-stage medical appointment intelligent scheduling optimization method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of medical system optimization technology and computer aided scheduling, and provides a multi-stage medical appointment intelligent scheduling optimization method, which comprises the steps of constructing a multi-stage appointment scheduling model, distinguishing direct and indirect waiting heterogeneity effects, and introducing a virtual scheduling node to adapt discontinuous appointment behaviors; and a logic-based Benders decomposition algorithm and a clustering-based Benders decomposition algorithm are provided, and scheduling evaluation and calculation efficiency are improved through iterative cutting optimization. The invention considers delay tolerance heterogeneity, perception delay heterogeneity and discontinuous reservation constraint simultaneously, effectively optimizes the patient flow, improves inquiry efficiency and reservation fairness, and provides a new direction for medical dynamic resource scheduling.

title_en: LSTM-based intelligent bus passenger flow prediction and demand response scheduling method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of urban public transportation scheduling and intelligent transportation control, in particular to an LSTM-based intelligent bus passenger flow prediction and demand response scheduling method. The method comprises the steps of 1, cleaning and fusing data such as card swiping records, vehicle positioning, dispatching logs, line stations, weather, holidays and the like to construct passenger flow characteristics, 2, predicting station-level short-time passenger flow by using a long-period memory neural network, 3, generating departure intervals of each period of each line through a dispatching strategy network according to predicted passenger flow, vehicle capacity and the like, 4, estimating average waiting time of the stations and the number of people in the vehicles by using a queue simulation network, 5, constructing a joint loss function considering prediction errors, waiting time, passenger carrying rate and line fairness, 6, jointly training the passenger flow prediction and dispatching strategy network under joint loss constraint, and 7, updating model parameters on line based on operation data collected by rolling to enable the system to adapt to passenger flow change and optimize a dispatching scheme.
assignees: CHINA XIONGAN GROUP TRAFFIC CO LTD

title_en: Multi-terminal collaborative intelligent scheduling platform and method for flexible labor management
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent scheduling platform and method for multi-terminal cooperation of flexible labor management, in particular to the technical field of labor management, comprising the following steps of carrying out work scheduling according to flexible labor requirements by a preset scheduling rule algorithm and generating scheduling schedule forms of each time; and in each scheduling period, the fairness and rationality of the work arrangement are evaluated by extracting the feature set influencing the scheduling, an evaluation report is generated, and whether the scheduling rule algorithm is optimized or not is determined according to the evaluation report and a feedback signal. In the optimization process, an optimization scheme is designed through a feedback signal, a scheduling algorithm is trained in an iteration mode, so that the scheduling algorithm is better adapted to the labor requirement, the work distribution is guaranteed to be more fair and reasonable, and the optimized algorithm is applied to scheduling of the next period.

title_en: Shared energy storage dynamic configuration method and system based on income distribution strategy
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of energy storage analysis, and discloses a shared energy storage dynamic configuration method and system based on a benefit distribution strategy. The method comprises the steps of obtaining electricity demand and photovoltaic data of a user, quantitatively analyzing energy storage utilization contribution degree, establishing a profit distribution parameter, collecting photovoltaic historical data, decomposing uncertainty into three components, establishing a differentiated demand prediction model, constructing a source load matching degree evaluation system, calculating real-time, time period and daily matching degree to obtain a capacity configuration demand matrix, inputting a multi-user collaborative optimization algorithm, obtaining an optimal capacity distribution scheme through profit distribution strategy and benefit maximization, establishing a dynamic adjustment mechanism, monitoring profits in real time, redistributing capacity, and forming a feedback optimization mechanism and an operation configuration report. The application solves the problems of undefined revenue distribution and difficult photovoltaic uncertainty energy storage configuration of multiple investment subjects, and improves the operation efficiency and the revenue distribution fairness of the shared energy storage system.

title_en: Amphibious calibration package
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a kind of amphibious calibration package, and described system includes: an activity is loaded into the casing on transport facility; One docks at the amphibious ship in above-mentioned casing; On the inwall of above-mentioned casing, be provided with multiple shelves.On above-mentioned shelf, be placed with emergency disaster relief goods and materials and equipment, anxious disaster relief supplies and equipment are including but not limited to fuel oil conservation tank, electrical generator, registration device, communication device, medical treatment device, potable water and grain.A kind of amphibious calibration package of the utility model, has the advantageous effect that scheduling is convenient, emergency ability is strong.
assignees: JIANGYIN RONGXING SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY DEV CO LTD

title_en: AI technology-based method for analyzing irregular behaviors in bidding process
abstract_en: The invention discloses an AI (Artificial intelligence) technology-based analysis method for irregular behaviors in a bidding process, which comprises the following steps of constructing a learning model in advance according to behavior sample data in the bidding process, adjusting and optimizing a machine learning result manually according to a result given by continuously input data during construction, optimizing behavior data content and a weight value, and enabling a predicted result to tend to a real situation; step two, importing relevant behavior data to carry out result prediction, analyzing all behaviors in the bidding process and obtaining a numerical conclusion through analyzing all behaviors in the bidding process, and quickly and efficiently providing accurate analysis process data and an approaching accurate analysis result; in the bidding process, possible irregular behaviors can be predicted and monitored, early warning is given in time, a supervision department is reminded to intervene early, the influence of the irregular behaviors on the bidding fairness is reduced, and the rights and interests of other bidders or bidders are damaged.
assignees: ZHEJIANG ZHAO TIANXIA BIDDING AND TRADING PLATFORM CO LTD

title_en: Airline fairness-based flight segment operation time optimization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flight segment running time optimization method based on airline fairness, which comprises the following steps: obtaining historical flight operation data information of a flight section; carrying out data preprocessing on the historical flight operation data information; calculating to obtain the flight segment operation time according to the preprocessed historical flight operation data information; and optimizing the flight segment running time according to the constraint conditions and the optimization objective function to obtain the standard flight segment running time. The method of the invention comprehensively considers the fairness of the airline company under the premise of comprehensively considering the historical operation of flights and the application of the airline company, establishes a mathematical model for optimizing the flight segment operation time for the first time, optimizes the national flight segment operation time, formulates a flight standard flight segment operation time table and further provides a scientific basis for scheduling flights.

title_en: Irrigation district water distribution method considering water resource allocation and canal system water distribution bidirectional mutual feedback influence
abstract_en: The invention discloses an irrigation district water distribution method considering water resource allocation and canal system water distribution bidirectional mutual feedback influence, which is implemented as follows: step 1, collecting data required by the text; 2. distributing the wool water distribution amount in different water consumption departments in different areas; step 3, distributing water for each water department to each secondary channel; step 4, establishing a canal system optimization water distribution model, wherein decision variables are canal water distribution flow and water distribution starting time, and the objective is that the canal leakage loss is minimum and the water distribution duration is shortest; step 5, calculating water leakage loss of each water department in each region; step 6, calculating the net water distribution amount; step 7, configuring a model for water resources, wherein a decision variable is net water distribution amount, and a target function is water supply benefit and fairness; and 8, summarizing the indexes to obtain a water distribution scheme. The invention solves the problem that only water resource allocation is considered to influence a canal system water distribution list in the prior water distribution technology, and provides a water distribution method considering the water resource allocation and the canal system optimization water distribution mutual feedback influence.
assignees: BEIJING LESHUI XINYUAN INTELLIGENT WATER TECH CO LTD

title_en: System software joint member business mode realization system supporting cross-platform account intercommunication
abstract_en: The invention provides a system software joint member business mode realization system supporting cross-platform account intercommunication, and relates to the technical field of computer software. The system solves the problems of isolated account number, loose member rights and interests management, low merchant cooperation efficiency and insufficient user awareness of the existing cross-platform software through an account intercommunication module, a joint member management module, a data linkage module, a merchant cooperation module, a user interaction module, a newly added rights and interests monitoring sub-module and a rights and interests adjustment notification sub-module. The method and the system have the core that the cross-platform intercommunication of account numbers is realized by means of unified identity authentication, and a dynamic equity combination, real-time equity monitoring, intelligent benefit splitting and active notification mechanism are combined to provide a combined member service of 'one account is communicated, equity is cleared and notification is accurate' for users, meanwhile, accurate operation of merchants is facilitated, risks are reduced, and finally, three-party value optimization and ecological win-win of multiple platforms, merchants and users are realized.
assignees: SHANDONG LIUXIN NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Gis-based integrated emergency supplies visualisation system and method
abstract_en: A GIS-based integrated emergency supplies visualisation system and method, comprising a comprehensive supplies data storage module, used for collecting comprehensive emergency supplies data, categorising said data, and storing the categorised data in a supplies allocation database; a GIS display module, used for marking on a GIS map the comprehensive emergency supplies data in the supplies allocation database; and a bidirectional service interaction module; when an emergency incident occurs, visualised distribution information of the supplies surrounding the emergency incident point on the GIS map, on the basis of information including the allocated supplies type, amount, and contact person, is rapidly formed into an emergency supplies allocation plan, and using a word file to establish a standard template, a standard word file is generated. In disaster incidents, comprehensive emergency supplies are immediately and effectively allocated, and by combining the GIS visualisation display principle, the present invention plays a role in preventing and reducing loss during a disaster, and making disaster prevention and mitigation outcomes more intuitive and real, and is beneficial for disaster monitoring and decision-making units.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;EMERGENCY MAN CT OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;SHANDONG LUNENG SOFT TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Determining technology costs associated with a financial product
abstract_en: The present invention provides for methods, apparatus and computer programs for determining technology costs associated with a financial product, and, in specific embodiments, an equity trade. In specific embodiments of the invention the technology application costs may be determined on a per-process basis and subsequently totaled to determine the overall cost. The invention provides for identifying a plurality of processes and a plurality of technology applications each of which are associated with a financial product. Once the processes and technology application have been identified, process allocation percentages are determined for each of the technology applications and identified processes associated with each of the technology applications and a per-financial product technology cost for each of the plurality of technology applications is determined over a predetermined time period. Additionally, the per-process technology cost is determined for the financial product based on the per-financial product technology cost for each of the plurality of technology applications and the process allocation percentages associated with a respective process and a respective technology application.

title_en: Device, method and storage medium for predicting scoring of question-answer content
abstract_en: The application relates to a big data technology, and discloses a device, a method and a storage medium for predicting scoring of question-answer content, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting the question-answer content of the history of the pen test link and the actual score corresponding to each question-answer content; constructing a word segmentation library, a corpus, a word frequency inverse text frequency index model and an implicit dirichlet allocation model based on the question-answer content, and storing the word frequency inverse text frequency index model and the implicit dirichlet allocation model in a database; the word segmentation library, the corpus, the word frequency inverse text frequency index model and the implicit dirichlet allocation model are imported into the database, after word segmentation and word segmentation statistics are carried out, the word frequency is input into the word frequency inverse text frequency index model and the implicit dirichlet allocation model, and a queue with the highest probability of outputting the question-answer content which belongs to the same history of a theme as the question-answer content to be scored is obtained; and calculating the predictive score of the question-answer content to be scored based on the actual score corresponding to the queue with the highest probability. The application can ensure the objective fairness of scoring.

title_en: A kind of logistics company equity management method and system based on block chain technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of logistics company equity management method and system based on block chain technology, it is related to logistics company equity administrative skill field.Including logistics company equity management platform；Logistics company equity management platform includes company information search system, enterprise's credit investigation system, block catenary system, registration unit and clearance unit；Block catenary system carries out information exchange with company information search system, enterprise's credit investigation system respectively by data transfer and memory module；Block catenary system is carried out data transmission with registration unit, clearance unit respectively by data transmission module；Logistics company equity management platform raises platform with equity crowd respectively, region exchange is connected.The present invention solves lack of standardization, inefficient in existing equity management by the effect of logistics company equity management platform；Can not effectively management company's equity establishment, distribution；Lack a kind of equity management platform that is credible, can checking in real time and lack effective means and realize the problem of merchandising at any time.
assignees: HEFEI WEITIAN YUNTONG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: It is a kind of meter and various energy resources monthly power trade plan time stimulatiom method
abstract_en: It is a kind of meter and various energy resources monthly power trade plan time stimulatiom method, belong to the monthly power trade plan technical field of electric system, step are as follows: first according to monthly power trade plan actual demand, establish monthly power trade plan modeling strategy: proposing the modeling method of monthly power trade plan and constructs the model structure of monthly power trade plan.Secondly, according to the monthly power trade plan modeling strategy of foundation, model each section is modeled: plan moon model cost function part, plan moon model constraint condition part, subsequent moon model cost function part, subsequent moon model constraint condition part and annual generated energy fairness constraints part；Finally, solving to model optimization, final monthly power trade plan is obtained.Time stimulatiom method is introduced into monthly power trade plan by the present invention, and is modeled stage by stage the moon and the subsequent moon according to plan, and the monthly power trade planning model that can ensure feasibility and fairness is finally obtained.

title_en: Training quality assessment method and system based on pilot attention distribution
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of operation training evaluation, in particular to a training quality evaluation method and system based on pilot attention distribution. The method comprises the steps of collecting data required by pilot attention distribution training quality assessment according to a specific flight mission scene, calculating a standard attention distribution model of a pilot in the specific flight mission scene based on the collected data, generating attention distribution and actual attention distribution of the standard attention distribution model, comparing the attention distribution and the actual attention distribution of the standard attention distribution model, assessing the training quality of the attention distribution of the pilot in the specific flight mission scene, and forming and displaying an assessment result. According to the invention, through quantifying the attention distribution mode of the pilot and combining with eye movement tracking technology and task related subjective and objective data, the performance of the pilot in the simulation training can be objectively and accurately estimated, and the scientificity, fairness and safety of the flight training are improved.

title_en: Emergency material dispatching system and material dispatching method based on ant colony algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent emergency material scheduling system and method based on an ant colony algorithm. A demand prediction module of the emergency material intelligent scheduling system utilizes a space-time diagram neural network to dynamically predict material demands and constructs a layered network model integrating multi-mode transportation of unmanned aerial vehicles, ground vehicles and the like. The optimization calculation module adopts an improved ant colony algorithm, introduces a demand urgency weight factor and a green weight factor to construct a multi-objective fitness function, and combines a dynamic pheromone updating mechanism and a multi-ant colony cooperative strategy to optimize a transportation path. The system is provided with a dynamic adjustment module driven by edge calculation to realize 30-second-level rapid path re-planning, creatively integrates a psychological aid priority model, and extracts a psychological crisis index optimization scheduling strategy through emotion analysis. The invention effectively solves the problems of lag response and insufficient multi-objective optimization of the traditional dispatching system, remarkably improves the transportation efficiency by 25% -35%, reduces carbon emission and ensures the high efficiency, fairness and humanity care of emergency dispatching.

title_en: Urban update section boundary dividing method and system based on cadastre data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of urban cadastral data analysis, and discloses a cadastral data-based urban updating zone boundary dividing method and system, which are characterized in that cadastral data are associated by collecting the dividing of an updating zone of a target city, an improved DTW algorithm is adopted, the method comprises the steps of screening current situation boundary address effective points and newly added candidate points with history continuity from current situation actual measurement data, extracting spatial features and ownership features, fusing the spatial features and the ownership features, constructing a feature matrix by using fused feature vectors, constructing a spatial ownership dual-constraint graph neural network, predicting a final boundary point set of an updated patch area of a target city, and generating a final land block boundary address boundary. Therefore, the invention realizes the joint optimization of space rationality and equity rationality by utilizing the double-constraint feature fusion while establishing accurate association between history and current situation address data by introducing the improved DTW algorithm and the space equity double-constraint graph neural network, and improves the division precision and division efficiency of the boundary address of the urban update slice area.
assignees: CHENGDU NATURAL RESOURCES SURVEY AND UTILIZATION RESEARCH INSTITUTE CHENGDU SATELLITE APPLICATION TE

title_en: Time sequence simulation method considering monthly electric energy transaction plan formulation of multiple energy sources
abstract_en: A time sequence simulation method for planning monthly electric energy trading plans by considering various energy sources belongs to the technical field of planning monthly electric energy trading plans of electric power systems, and comprises the following steps: firstly, establishing a monthly electric energy trading plan modeling strategy according to the actual demand of a monthly electric energy trading plan: a modeling method of the monthly electric energy transaction plan and a model structure for constructing the monthly electric energy transaction plan are provided. Secondly, modeling each part of the model according to the established monthly electric energy trading plan modeling strategy: the system comprises a planned month model cost function part, a planned month model constraint condition part, a subsequent month model cost function part, a subsequent month model constraint condition part and an annual power generation amount fairness constraint part; and finally, carrying out optimization solution on the model to obtain a final monthly electric energy trading plan. The invention introduces a time sequence simulation method into the formulation of the monthly electric energy transaction plan, and carries out staged modeling according to a planned month and a subsequent month to finally obtain a monthly electric energy transaction plan model which can ensure feasibility and fairness.

title_en: Newly-increased high-speed rail junction accessibility influence method based on improved two-step mobile search method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-speed rail hub accessibility calculation method based on an improved two-step mobile search method, a high-speed rail hub accessibility space distribution fairness evaluation method based on a variation coefficient and a spearman grade correlation coefficient, and a new high-speed rail hub accessibility influence method based on the improved two-step mobile search method. The invention improves a two-step mobile search method, effectively measures the traffic cost of facility points and demand points, and in the reachability analysis process, the analysis is more consistent with the actual situation by improving the search carrier of the spatial scope of action, the calculation method of the road traffic condition and the attribute of the search radius, thereby improving the precision of reachability measurement and calculation. The method analyzes the influence of the high-speed rail construction on the space balance of the accessible distribution by using the variation coefficient and the spearman grade correlation coefficient while analyzing the accessibility improvement, so that the arrangement of the high-speed rail can enable residents to enjoy more high-speed rail services and the services to realize the balanced distribution in space.

title_en: Data similarity processing method and device, storage medium and computer equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the specification provides a data similarity processing method, a data similarity processing device, a storage medium and computer equipment. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring service skill data of a plurality of service personnel; calculating the minimum editing distance between the service skill data of different service personnel; and calculating the similarity between the service skill data of different service personnel according to the minimum editing distance. In the embodiment of the specification, the similarity calculated through the service skill data can be used as a distribution basis for service distribution and grouping, so that the distribution accuracy and fairness are improved, and the service processing efficiency is improved.

title_en: Water pollution load distribution method considering region fairness and pollution source treatment difference
abstract_en: The invention provides a water pollution load distribution method considering region fairness and pollution source treatment difference, which comprises the steps of selecting evaluation indexes, and calculating the damping coefficient and the weight of each index; calculating the current comprehensive kini coefficient; setting a total amount control constraint; setting fairness constraints; setting a reduction rate constraint; determining the treatment cost of each administrative area related to each ton of industrial wastewater; determining the ton water treatment cost of urban domestic sewage in each administrative district; determining the ton water treatment cost of municipal upgrading reconstruction; determining the unit pollution load treatment cost of industrial wastewater, urban domestic sewage and municipal upgrading reconstruction in each administrative area; calculating comprehensive treatment cost; and solving the water pollution load distribution problem. The invention can scientifically and reasonably guide the pollutant reduction sequence and the reduction scheme in each region and various pollution sources to make.

title_en: Provincial domain carbon emission prediction method, device, equipment and medium based on self-adaptive multi-scale decomposition
abstract_en: The application discloses a provincial carbon emission prediction method, device, equipment and medium based on self-adaptive multi-scale decomposition, relating to the technical field of air prediction, comprising the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining and standardizing carbon emission data of each city in a province, inputting a preset carbon emission prediction model formed by a multi-head attention-encoder-decoder generator and a time sequence convolution discriminator, outputting predicted values of each city, summarizing the predicted values into a province domain result, adopting self-adaptive multi-scale decomposition and space-time feature fusion in a model training stage, and carrying out joint optimization by means of the fair loss of a day-month coefficient, so as to realize regional differentiation, fairness and high-precision carbon emission prediction, and provide credible and interpretable data support for provincial carbon quota scientific allocation and emission reduction responsibility division.

title_en: Micro grid energy storage device design method based on capacity limit value constrain
abstract_en: A micro grid energy storage device design method based on capacity limit value constrain includes 1, inputting the planning area distribution-type power supply allocation capacity and the type and distribution situation of an energy storage device; 2, inputting the planning area load and historical weather data; 3, establishing a distribution-type power supply force model and an energy storage charging and discharging module; 4, calculating the lower limit of the energy storage device allocation capacity; 5, calculating the upper limit of the energy storage device allocation capacity; 6, calculating the optimal value of the energy storage device allocation capacity in the range of the limit value. By the aid of the method, on the basis that the energy storage device capacity limit value of a connected-type micro grid is met, the optimal energy storage device capacity allocation matching with distribution type power generation is calculated, the requirements on reliability and economy of the micro grid can be met through the energy storage device capacity to the utmost extent, and clean, safe and reliable power is provided for loading.

title_en: A kind of logistics service system, path analysis method and Logistics Distribution Method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of logistics service system, path analysis method and Logistics Distribution Method, data interface module accessible database to logistics data calculate and forms display data to obtain logistics data；Database can be by access WWW to obtain the logistics information on WWW, then is stored after logistics information is converted to logistics data；Transport power algoritic module may have access to data interface module and obtain display data, and transport power algoritic module calculate analyzing to display data forms route scheme；Data interface module may also access transport power algoritic module to obtain at least route scheme with a paths plan.The advantages of the present invention are：With extremely strong autgmentability, adaptability and application range, data independence and safety ensure that, improve the reliability in acknowledgement of consignment path, provided a great convenience for client；Good capacity information display platform also is provided for common carrier simultaneously, is greatly improved the fairness and transparency of logistic industry.
assignees: NINGBO KAHANG NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Receiving and transporting scheduling method, system and medium based on renewable resources
abstract_en: The application provides a receiving and transporting scheduling method, a system and a medium based on renewable resources, comprising the following steps: acquiring the overflow duration of the garbage can and the idle busy state of a collector at the current time, and acquiring the garbage can point position of which the overflow duration belongs to the preset overflow duration based on the idle busy state of the collector at the current time; judging whether the transfer station to be recovered exists or not, if so, planning the shortest path of a driver and a time window for staying in the transfer station based on the transfer station to be recovered; and acquiring the point location of the transfer station to be recovered and the time window for the driver to stay in the transfer station, and planning the path of the collector based on the point location of the transfer station to be recovered, the point location of the garbage bin and the time window for the driver to stay in the transfer station, so that the collector reaches the point location of the transfer station to be recovered in the time window. Through the application, according to the collection work order sent by the user, the coupling relation of the collector and the driver in time is considered at the same time, the path planning of the collector is effectively planned, and the fairness of the collector is guaranteed on the premise of ensuring the user experience.
assignees: ZHEJIANG YUNQI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Project contribution score distribution method, apparatus, device, storage medium and program product
abstract_en: The application discloses a project contribution score distribution method, device, equipment, storage medium and program product. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring input information input by a user and generating a project card, wherein the content of the project card at least comprises one type of characters, pictures and videos; assigning a base score to the generated project card; recording a user participating in the supplement or modification of the project card and the supplement or modification information of the information card, and independently displaying the information in the project card as additional information; recording the execution user and the execution times of the project card; after the user project card is finished, assigning a value according to the participation degree of the user project, and assigning the basic value of the project card to the participating user according to the atmosphere assignment so as to realize project contribution scoring. The project card scoring method, device, equipment, storage medium and program product provided by the disclosure effectively score the contribution of the user to the project and improve the accuracy of contribution calculation and participation fairness.
assignees: DONGGUAN WUWU XIANGXUN SUSTAINABLE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Comment expert extraction system
abstract_en: The invention provides a bid evaluation expert extraction system which comprises a black box module and an expert extraction module. The black box module ensures data safety and operation compliance through data isolation and authority control. The expert extraction module realizes automatic expert extraction, notification and feedback management, and covers parameter configuration, random extraction, supplement scheme, timing task and automatic settlement functions. The system is controlled by a task automation and intelligent scheme, so that manual intervention is reduced, operation timeliness is optimized, fairness, transparency and high efficiency of the label evaluation process are ensured, and overall operation efficiency and data safety are improved.
assignees: BEIJING GUODIANTONG NETWORK TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;STATE GRID INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION CO LTD

title_en: Multi-source data fusion carbon emission on-line monitoring and quota allocation control method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control method and a device for on-line monitoring and quota allocation of carbon emission of multi-source data fusion, and relates to the technical field of carbon emission monitoring and quota management, comprising the following steps of calculating comprehensive scores of carbon emission intensity of all process units through a comprehensive score model based on multi-source data, and constructing an urgency mapping function to convert the comprehensive scores to obtain carbon emission urgency of all process units; the carbon quota is primarily allocated according to the carbon emission urgency, the carbon quota demand condition of each unit is calculated, a quota allocation optimization model is built based on the carbon quota demand condition, and the optimization model is solved to obtain the final quota borrowing amount and the carbon quota of each unit. The invention is used for solving the problems that the subjectivity of the existing carbon emission quota allocation is strong, and fairness and efficiency are difficult to be considered.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic adjustment method, device, equipment and medium for health industry management
abstract_en: The application relates to a dynamic adjustment method, a device, equipment and a medium for health industry management. The method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-level resource demand data, carrying out standardized processing on the resource demand data to obtain standard resource demand data, carrying out dynamic priority assessment on each level of demand based on the standard resource demand data to generate priority scores of each level of demand, wherein the priority scores are used for representing the emergency degree of health demands of different levels, obtaining an initial resource allocation scheme according to the priority scores by combining a preset multi-objective optimization model, wherein the initial resource allocation scheme is used for representing the resource allocation proportion and the resource allocation quantity of each level of demand, and carrying out dynamic adjustment on the initial resource allocation scheme to generate the resource allocation scheme. By adopting the method, the inclination of the resources to the single demand can be avoided, the fairness of demand response is ensured, and the dynamic allocation of the healthy resources is realized.
assignees: SHIZHEN COLLEGE OF GUIZHOU UNIV OF TRADITIONAL CHINESE MEDICINE

title_en: Equity finance execution support system, equity finance execution support method and program
abstract_en: To support execution of equity finance.SOLUTION: An equity finance execution support system 1 comprises means of: selecting a prerequisite of a targeting company; registering basic information on the company, an issuance resolution case, an issuance condition, allocation destination information, bills of a share-holder's general meeting or a board of directors, and a kind/holing method/holding schedule of the share-holder's general meeting or a kind/holing method/holding schedule of the board of directors; displaying resolutions; registering a holding time, a holding place of the board of directors, and participants therein; notifying the participant in the board of directors of calling the board of directors; acquiring a first reply of approval or disapproval to the bill from the participant of the board of directors; preparing minutes tabulating the first reply; registering a holing time/holding place of the share-holder's general meeting, and participants therein; notifying the participant in the share-holder's general meeting of calling the share-holder's general meeting; acquiring a second reply of approval or disapproval to the bill from the participant in the share-holder's general meeting; and preparing minutes tabulating the second reply, and a resolution notification.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Internal span type tire crane instruction scheduling method based on multidimensional dynamic priority and predictive scheduling
abstract_en: The invention discloses an internal cross tire crane instruction scheduling method based on multidimensional dynamic priority and predictive scheduling, which comprises the following steps of S1, S2, opportunistic overtaking window evaluation, S3, nonlinear dynamic sequencing of conventional instructions, and S4, instruction issuing and rescheduling. The invention quantifies and decides whether to execute the overtaking instruction with higher net benefit through the opportunistic overtaking window evaluation so as to improve the operation efficiency, ensures that the priority of the instruction waiting for a long time can be systematically improved by introducing the instruction waiting time length factor with exponential growth characteristic and the maximum tolerance threshold so as to ensure the dispatching fairness, and reduces the instruction priority of the congestion area through the local congestion factor so as to achieve the effect of relieving the traffic bottleneck.

title_en: Computer implemented blockchain-based system for agricultural products
abstract_en: A platform built on blockchain that is designed to help increase traceability, efficiency and fairness in agricultural supply chains, such as the coffee, cocoa, tea, sugar, grains and fruit supply chains. The platform includes a Self-Sovereign Identity solution, a new form of digital identity built on distributed ledger technology. Farmers, wholesalers, traders and retailers can interact more efficiently using comprehensive, near real-time access to this data, and consumers can have new insights about the origins of the products they consume. The platform includes a consumer-facing application that pulls information directly from the blockchain and connects the final consumer, e.g. a coffee drinker, to farmers, traders, roasters and brands. The information is presented on an interactive map, allowing each product to tell a story in a simple and scalable way. The app also presents sustainability projects in coffee communities and an opportunity for consumers to directly support them.

title_en: Automatic dispatching method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides an automatic dispatching method, an automatic dispatching device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, which are used for acquiring the take-off time of a flight to be refueled; determining whether the time interval between the takeoff moment and the current moment is smaller than a preset time interval; if so, acquiring the current position of each refueler at the current moment, the working data of the current day and historical refueling data aiming at the model type of the flight to be refueled; determining a dispatching score of each refueler for the flight to be refueled based on the obtained current position, the current day work data and the historical refuelling data of each refueler; and determining the refueler with the highest dispatching score as a target refueler capable of refueling the flight to be refueled. Like this, according to dispatching the worker and grading and select the best refueller and carry out automatic dispatch, help improving the rationality and the fairness of dispatching the worker, alleviate dispatcher's work burden, the resource of using manpower sparingly promotes work efficiency.
assignees: CHINA NAT AVIATION FUEL CO LTD

title_en: Information processing apparatus
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present invention relate to an information processing apparatus. The information processing device according to the embodiment includes a processing unit that calculates a control amount of electric power for a plurality of electric power devices from a management value of wiring in an electric power distribution system, a 1 st evaluation function for evaluating control of electric power for the plurality of electric power devices in the electric power distribution system from an economical point of view, and a2 nd evaluation function for evaluating control of electric power for the plurality of electric power devices from a fairness point of view.

title_en: Online automatic evaluation system for project process management
abstract_en: The invention discloses an on-line automatic evaluation system for project process management, which comprises a permission distribution module, a system login module, a coefficient setting module, an evaluation table editing module, a score calculation and ranking module, a performance assessment correlation module and a performance assessment correlation module, wherein the permission distribution module is used for performing permission distribution on a user by an administrator, the system login module is used for verifying login permission of the user according to the permission distributed by the permission distribution module, the coefficient setting module is used for setting different evaluation score additional coefficients according to project engineering scale, the evaluation table editing module is used for user-defined editing of an evaluation table according to project process management characteristics and requirements, the score calculation and ranking module is used for calculating project process management evaluation scores according to the evaluation score additional coefficients set by the user editing evaluation table and the coefficient setting module and performing project assessment ranking according to the sequence of the project process management evaluation scores from high to low, and the performance assessment correlation module is used for directly correlating the project process management evaluation scores with performance assessment of project managers. The invention realizes the on-line evaluation scoring of project process management and improves the efficiency and fairness of project process management.
assignees: CHINA NUCLEAR IND HUAXING CONSTR CO LTD

title_en: Remote sensing task fair scheduling method and device based on multistage feedback queue
abstract_en: The invention provides a remote sensing task fair scheduling method and device based on a multi-stage feedback queue, which relate to the technical field of satellite remote sensing, and the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining satellite remote sensing tasks to be scheduled, analyzing to obtain corresponding structured task parameters, further calculating multidimensional scores of the satellite remote sensing tasks on user side fairness, task type fairness and space demand fairness, distributing real-time task resources to the satellite remote sensing tasks, determining scheduling priorities of the satellite remote sensing tasks in a multistage feedback queue according to the real-time task resources and task execution windows of the satellite remote sensing tasks, and finally selecting an optimally matched remote sensing platform according to the scheduling priorities and executing the satellite remote sensing tasks. The method and the device are used for solving the problems of low response efficiency of task processing caused by unreasonable scheduling and resource allocation of the satellite remote sensing task in the prior art.
assignees: BEIJING SHIJI NONGFENG LAND TECH CO LTD

title_en: Systems and methods for multi-vehicle resource allocation and routing solutions
abstract_en: A computer system for allocating and routing a plurality of servicing objects within a map of a region such that work load is balanced across the plurality of servicing objects is provided. The system formulates a model for allocating and routing the plurality of servicing objects in the region. The model comprises a distance matrix based upon a first plurality of segments or a second plurality of intersections in the map. The memory stores instructions for partitioning the map into a plurality of disjoint contiguous sub-regions in view of the distance matrix using an equitable convex region partition algorithm. The memory further stores instructions for calculating a corresponding tour graph for each sub-region in the plurality of sub-regions, where, for each respective sub- region in the plurality of sub-regions, a servicing object in the plurality of servicing objects is assigned to the tour graph that corresponds to the respective sub-region.

title_en: Disaster assistance goods and materials method of adjustment and system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to disaster assistance fields, are related to a kind of disaster assistance goods and materials method of adjustment, including：Obtain the Outliers Detection data set of the disaster achievement data and current relief goods distribution data that include devastated；Data normalization is carried out to the data in Outliers Detection data set；Outliers Detection parameter is set；Outliers Detection data set is mapped into metric space according to Outliers Detection parameter and carries out Outliers Detection, acquisition most possibly n devastated of relief goods unreasonable distribution occurs as Outliers Detection result；Whether the relief goods quantity allotted for verifying n region is reasonable, and disaster relief supplies quantity allotted is not adjusted if rationally if quantity allotted.The present invention goes back while proposing a kind of disaster assistance goods and materials adjustment system.The present invention can balance the weight of meteorological disaster achievement data, relief goods distribution two generic attribute of data, accelerate meteorological disaster relief goods and adjust reaction speed, improve the degree of automation, and can be compatible with different types of meteorological disaster using metric space algorithm.
assignees: GUANGDONG OKING INFORMATION IND CO LTD

title_en: Peak regulation expense allocation method considering new energy consumption responsibility at electricity utilization side
abstract_en: The invention discloses a peak regulation expense allocation method considering new energy consumption responsibility at the electricity utilization side, which comprises the steps of firstly, analyzing peak regulation auxiliary rules in northeast areas, and establishing a 'step' peak regulation auxiliary service expense rapid calculation model; then, analyzing peak regulation values of all participants in a peak regulation market according to a shape marginal contribution theory, establishing a peak regulation cost allocation model at two sides of the power generation, and allocating the peak regulation cost allocation problem in the power generation side according to the mode of the on-line electric quantity ratio; for the problem of peak regulation expense allocation in the electricity utilization side, the unmatched degree of load electricity utilization and new energy power generation is checked by setting fluctuation trend difference coefficient and waveform amplitude difference coefficient parameters, so that unbalanced electricity consumption is calculated, and the respective peak regulation auxiliary service expense bearing amount is determined; the method provided by the invention can simultaneously ensure fairness and economy of the system and provide reference basis for power grid dispatching on the basis of improving the new energy consumption level of the system.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for managing system resources
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of system resource management, and particularly relates to a system resource management method, device, equipment and medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining node resource total amount owned by a system and historical service processing data of the system, determining service processing time length and node occupation amount of each historical service according to the historical service processing data, establishing a plurality of resource pools according to the service processing time length of all the historical services, determining node allocation amount of each resource pool according to the node occupation amount and the node resource total amount of all the historical services, and managing resources of the system according to all the resource pools and the service queues of each resource pool. The method realizes the operation isolation of different services, the operation time of the same service is fixed, and different users are relatively fair when using cluster resources, so that the service stability and the resource use fairness of the earthquake processing system are ensured.
assignees: CHINA PETROLEUM & CHEM CORP;SINOPEC GEOPHYSICAL RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Low-carbon regulation and control method and device for wind, light and hydrogen storage system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a low-carbon regulation and control method and a device for a wind, light and hydrogen storage system, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining characteristic parameters of various devices in the system; establishing a corresponding carbon emission model according to characteristic parameters of various devices in the system; constructing a carbon flow tracing model of the system according to the carbon emission model; calculating the network loss allocation rate when the system operates, and constructing a network loss equivalent carbon emission allocation model by combining a carbon flow tracing model; constructing an optimization decision model of a user and a wind-light-hydrogen storage system according to the network loss equivalent carbon emission allocation model, and determining constraint conditions; solving the optimization decision model to obtain an optimal operation strategy and benefit; according to the method, the network loss allocation rate is calculated based on the network loss generation factor and combined with the line physics and line parameters, the network loss equivalent carbon emission responsibility between the power generation main body and the energy consumption main body is divided, the carbon fairness of the power system is maintained, the main bodies of all parties can be stimulated to realize the carbon emission responsibility, and an accurate judgment basis is provided for implementing carbon excitation or carbon punishment measures.

title_en: Building site resource integration and distribution system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of resource allocation, in particular to a building site resource integration and allocation system, which comprises: the resource contribution evaluation module collects equipment use time and material consumption of a plurality of contractors based on the equipment scheduling data and the material flow records, calculates current resource contribution degree by comparing historical data of the plurality of contractors, calculates a shape value according to the contribution degree of each contractor, and generates a resource allocation reference. According to the invention, the resource contribution is dynamically evaluated by using the equipment scheduling data and the material flow records, the transparency and the accuracy of resource allocation are improved, based on the analysis of real-time and historical data, the system can effectively identify and reward contractors for high-efficiency resource use, the allocation fairness is enhanced, the resource allocation responds to the project progress change by real-time monitoring and dynamic adjustment, the targeted adjustment suggestion is provided by collecting the resource use efficiency and the project progress data, the accuracy of decision support is enhanced, and the cost caused by resource mismatching is reduced.
assignees: WEIHAI CHENAN WISDOM TECH CO LTD

title_en: Policy reporting and auditing method based on large language model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of large language models, in particular to a policy reporting and auditing method based on a large language model. The policy reporting auditing method based on the large language model comprises the steps of collecting policy reporting materials, converting the policy reporting materials into a text format, conducting cleaning and word segmentation processing, training and fine tuning the model by using a model based on a Transformer framework and using a marked policy reporting auditing data set, inputting the preprocessed policy reporting materials into the trained large language model, generating auditing results, conducting visual display, feeding the auditing results back to reporting enterprises, collecting feedback comments, conducting evaluation and analysis on the auditing results, and optimizing and adjusting the large language model according to the feedback comments and the evaluation results. The policy reporting auditing method based on the large language model shortens auditing time, reduces time cost and labor cost, avoids the influence of subjective factors in manual auditing, and improves the accuracy and fairness of auditing results.
assignees: TIANYUAN BIG DATA CREDIT MAN CO LTD

title_en: Overhead cost distribution device, overhead cost distribution method and overhead cost distribution program
abstract_en: To provide an overhead cost distribution device and others, capable of setting a distribution reference of an overhead cost in which imbalance has been corrected and fairness is high compared to a conventional one to achieve actual cost accounting more closer to an actual state.SOLUTION: An overhead cost distribution method according to the present embodiment includes: 1) referring to a man-hour table to calculate a person-specific total work time and a person-specific and contract specification-specific work time, dividing the calculated person-specific and contract specification-specific work time by the calculated person-specific total work time to calculate a man-specific specific gravity ratio for each employee and each contract, and summing up the calculated man-specific specific gravity ratio for each contract to calculate a contract specification-specific specific gravity; 2) referring to a contract specification table, a man-hour table, an employee master and a scheduled unit price master to extract an overhead cost, and referring to contract specification data and purchase data to extract an overhead cost to calculate a total of the extracted overhead costs; and 3) multiplying the calculated total by the calculated contract specification-specific specific gravity, and dividing the value obtained by multiplication by the number of contracts to which the total is to be distributed to calculate a distribution amount of the overhead cost for each contract.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Distributed photovoltaic distribution and storage method based on block chain
abstract_en: The invention relates to a distributed photovoltaic distribution and storage method based on a block chain, which comprises the following steps: constructing a distributed photovoltaic energy storage configuration block chain architecture, and carrying out block chain uplink and storage on user data; establishing a storage allocation demand degree assessment mechanism based on the user data, and acquiring the storage allocation demand degree of the user; and triggering an intelligent contract to generate a distribution and storage scheme and distribution and storage rights and interests based on the distribution and storage demand of the user, and selecting the distribution and storage scheme by the user to distribute and install the energy storage device. The invention establishes a public transparent distributed photovoltaic distribution and storage method by using a blockchain, takes real user data as an evaluation standard, preferentially provides the shortage of energy storage batteries for users with high distribution and storage requirements, greatly improves fairness of the distribution and storage process, reduces resource waste caused by improper competition, and contributes to accelerating the reasonable distribution and storage construction of distributed photovoltaic and realizing a double-carbon target.

title_en: Dangerous goods full-load distribution path optimization and vehicle dispatching method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of distribution path planning, and discloses a dangerous goods full-load distribution path optimization and vehicle scheduling method, which comprises the steps of establishing a model of vehicle quantity, total vehicle running cost and total risk and distribution time, establishing a vehicle path optimization mathematical model P1, establishing a vehicle scheduling model P2, and carrying out two-stage method solution (comprising a path optimization solution method and a vehicle scheduling optimization solution method). The invention can minimize the transportation cost and transportation risk in the transportation process by optimizing the driving route and scientifically dispatching the vehicles, and simultaneously, the invention can minimize the number of the distributed vehicles and ensure the fairness of the transportation task quantity of the vehicles.

title_en: Logistics unmanned aerial vehicle task allocation method with priority division
abstract_en: The invention discloses a logistics unmanned aerial vehicle task allocation method with priority, which comprises the following steps of S1, extracting three-dimensional operation space information of a logistics unmanned aerial vehicle based on a geographic environment, a low-altitude space structure and logistics unmanned aerial vehicle performance, obtaining performance parameters of the logistics unmanned aerial vehicle, S2, obtaining transportation type, flow direction and flow time data of the logistics unmanned aerial vehicle according to requirements of logistics companies and clients, constructing a logistics unmanned aerial vehicle operation scene, S3, establishing a logistics unmanned aerial vehicle service satisfaction index according to task priority and fairness of the logistics companies, S4, constructing a logistics unmanned aerial vehicle task allocation model according to the minimum flight impedance and the maximum service satisfaction, S5, adopting NSGA-II algorithm to solve the model, and outputting a logistics unmanned aerial vehicle resource allocation optimal scheme. By adopting the task allocation method of the logistics unmanned aerial vehicle with priority division, the collaborative task allocation of a plurality of logistics unmanned aerial vehicles can be realized, and the operation efficiency and quality of the logistics unmanned aerial vehicle can be improved.

title_en: Franchise system for realty deal
title_ko: 부동산 거래를 위한 프랜차이즈 시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명에서 프랜차이즈 구조를 갖는 부동산 거래 시스템을 개시한다. 
본 발명에 따른 시스템은, 임대인 정보를 포함하여 매물정보 및 계약정보가 등록 관리되는 데이터베이스; 프랜차이즈 등록 정보에 기반하여 등록 레벨별 부동산 중개 정보를 제공하며, 거래 요구자로부터 접속, 방문, 매매에 따른 할인권 발급 및 포인트 관리 운용을 토대로 프랜차이즈 이용료 관리를 수행하는 관리서버; 및 인터넷 통신망을 통해 상기 관리서버로부터 제공되는 홈페이지 또는 웹 페이지에 접속하며, 프랜차이즈 등록 레벨에 따라 매물에 대한 동영상 정보, 매물정보, 계약정보, 임대인 정보가 선별적으로 제공되고, 신규 매물정보에 대한 등록 또는 기존 매물정보에 대한 동영상 정보 등록에 따른 포인트 가산이 이루어지는 적어도 하나 이상의 중개사 단말기로 구성된다. 
따라서, 본 발명은 부동산 중개 시스템을 프랜차이즈 형태로 구현할 뿐만 아니라, 부동산 매물 정보에 대한 중앙 분배식 구조를 구현함으로써, 중개사 간의 경쟁력을 도모하고 정보공개의 형평성과 안전성을 확보할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Automatic scheduling method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of automatic scheduling method and system, the automatic scheduling method comprises the following steps：S1, obtained according to real work amount and required daily estimate total manpower；S2, the first working time parameter of all teams and groups of adjustment are iterated with obtaining daily actual total manpower to the total manpower of the reality, so that the total people's force curve of the reality estimates total people's force curve and have highest degree of fitting with described；The first working time parameter includes overtime and puts the not time.The automatic scheduling method and system of the present invention can improve manpower utilization and the fairness arranged an order according to class and grade by automatic scheduling.
assignees: CTRIP TRAVEL INFORMATION TECH (SHANGHAI) CO LTD

title_en: More scientific workflows based on cloud environment concurrently execute dispatching method
abstract_en: More scientific workflows based on cloud environment concurrently execute dispatching method.So-called Multi-workflow, which concurrently executes, refers to that multiple workflows are performed simultaneously, and the task in each workflow is interspersed to be executed.List workflow execution scheduling research at present is more, has ignored the waiting time of server, not only causes the waste of resource, and increases the waiting time of follow-up work stream.The method of the present invention includes the following steps: that reduction scheduling length achievees the effect that shorten task completion time firstly, passing through the calculative strategy of task order.Then, in order to guarantee to dispatch the fairness in implementation procedure, the strategy of building task pool is proposed；Secondly, the task in task pool is according to priority passed through resource selection strategy, reduce task completion time, improves the utilization rate of resource；Finally, reaching reduces the target for executing energy consumption to there are the resources of free time section to carry out voltage adjustment in such a way that dynamic voltage frequency adjusts.The present invention concurrently executes scheduling for more scientific workflows based on cloud environment.

title_en: Dangerous goods multi-mode intermodal transportation scheduling method based on branch delimitation and simulated annealing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dangerous goods multi-mode intermodal scheduling method based on branch delimitation and simulated annealing, which relates to the technical field of dangerous goods logistics safety and intelligent decision, and comprises the steps of constructing a double-layer integer linear programming model with minimized total transportation risk at an upper layer and minimized multi-mode intermodal cost at a lower layer, respectively designing a branch delimitation algorithm B & B and a simulated annealing algorithm SA according to network scale, quantitatively evaluating potential risks and operation costs of transportation road sections and transportation nodes on population, property and environment, creatively adopting an absolute difference method to measure the risk space distribution fairness, constructing a double-layer optimization framework for balancing transportation safety and economic benefits, remarkably reducing the overall transportation safety risk, relieving the problem of excessive concentration of local regional risks, optimizing logistics cost, and overcoming the limitation that the traditional mode or single-target optimization is difficult to consider the safety and the economic efficiency.

title_en: Pumped storage capacity cost allocation system and method for beneficiary object
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of economic dispatch of power systems and discloses a pumped storage capacity cost allocation system and method for benefiting objects, wherein the system comprises a benefit quantification module, a power system time sequence production simulation module and a power system time sequence analysis module, wherein the benefit quantification module is used for comparing and quantifying various benefits of a pumped storage power station; the inter-plant cost primary allocation module is used for dividing the cost between the power generation and the power grid side to generate the total allocation cost of the power grid side by utilizing the benefit, the inter-plant allocation weight determining module is used for determining the allocation weight of each provincial power grid through an entropy weight method according to a preset index system, and the inter-plant cost final allocation module is used for calculating the final allocation cost of each province by combining the total cost of the power grid side and the allocation weight and applying a TOPSIS method. The invention constructs a two-stage allocation model through benefit quantization and entropy weight and TOPSIS method, scientifically and equitably solves the problem of allocation of pumped storage capacity cost among multiple subjects.
assignees: STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Optimization algorithm and system for distribution of rails
title_ko: 선로 배분 방법 및 선로 배분 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention provides a rail distribution optimized algorithm enabling fair and efficient rail use among rail users and distributing rails in consideration of safety and fairness of rail use and efficiency and suitability of rail works while satisfying rail distribution constraints based on a train operation plan and a rail work plan submitted by a rail user. The rail distribution optimized algorithm performs a basic train arrangement generating step and an optimal train arrangement generation step.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 선로사용자가 제출한 열차운행계획 및 선로작업계획을 근거로 선로배분 제약조건을 충족하는 상태에서, 선로사용자 간의 공정하고 효율적인 선로사용이 가능하도록 하며, 선로사용의 안전성과 공정성, 선로작업의 효율성 및 적정성을 고려하여 선로의 배분을 수행하는 선로배분 최적화 알고리즘을 제안한다. 상기 선로배분 최적화 알고리즘은, 기초열차배열 생성단계 및 최적열차배열 생성단계를 수행한다.

title_en: Apparatus and Method of Altruistic Scheduling based on Reinforcement Learning
title_ko: 강화학습 기반 이타적 스케줄링 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a device and method for altruistic scheduling based on reinforcement learning. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the device for altruistic scheduling includes: an external scheduling agent for determining a basic resource share for each process based on information of a resource management system; an internal scheduling agent for determining a basic resource allocation schedule for each process based on information including the basic resource share and a resource leftover based on the basic resource allocation schedule; and a leftover scheduling agent for determining a leftover resource allocation schedule based on information including the resource leftover. According to an embodiment of the present disclosure, it may be expected that reinforcement learning will not only mitigate the diminution of fairness of an altruistic scheduler but also further improve other performance indicators such as completion time and efficiency.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 강화학습 기반 이타적 스케줄링 장치 및 방법에 관한 것이다.  본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 이타적 스케줄링 장치는 자원관리 시스템의 정보를 기반으로 프로세스 별 기본 자원 분배량을 결정하는 외부 스케줄링 에이전트, 상기 기본 자원 분배량을 포함한 정보를 기반으로 결정된 프로세스 별 기본 자원 할당 스케줄 및 상기 기본 자원 할당 스케줄을 기반으로 자원 잔여분을 결정하는 내부 스케줄링 에이전트, 상기 자원 잔여분을 포함한 정보를 기반으로 잔여자원 할당 스케줄을 결정하는 잔여 스케줄링 에이전트를 포함한다. 본 발명의 실시예에 의해, 강화학습을 이용하여 이타적 스케줄러의 공정성 하락을 완화시키는 동시에 완료시간 및 효율성과 같은 타 성능지표의 추가적 향상을 기대할 수 있다.

title_en: System and Method for Fair Employee Scheduling
abstract_en: A method for scheduling servers within a food-serving establishment or other business environment using a point-of-sale system based on a fairness processing module. The system includes a tablet, configured to receive a food order, and a computer having a transceiver, memory, and processor. The transceiver receives information about the food order from the tablet including payment and gratuity information. The memory stores payment and gratuity information along with information related to tables statistics and server-table assignments. The computer uses the fairness processing module to provide a preliminary recommendation of a first server from a group of servers for a non-routine scheduling assignment. The fairness processing module is based on a total amount of gratuities the first server has earned during a relevant period of time as compared to a total amount of gratuities earned by other servers in the group of servers.

title_en: Block chain-based multi-microgrid-containing power distribution system supervision and regulation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a block chain-based supervision and regulation method and system for a multi-microgrid-containing power distribution system, and belongs to the technical field of microgrid power distribution system optimization.
