The method comprises the steps of obtaining an electricity selling request of an electricity selling micro-grid node and an electricity purchasing request of an electricity purchasing micro-grid node in a power distribution system, wherein the electricity selling request or the electricity purchasing request is predicted based on a preset operation scheduling model, conducting transaction matching on the electricity selling request and the electricity purchasing request based on a preset blockchain intelligent contract to obtain a transaction scheduling scheme, and respectively sending the transaction scheduling scheme to a terminal where the electricity selling micro-grid node is located and a terminal where the electricity purchasing micro-grid node is located, and conducting transaction scheduling according to the transaction scheduling scheme. The block chain architecture is combined with the power distribution system with multiple micro-networks, so that the safety of data and the fairness of a regulation and control process can be guaranteed, and the problem that each micro-network main body is not suitable for traditional centralized regulation and control and is difficult to respond to a dispatching mechanism actively is solved.

title_en: Electric vehicle charging process optimization scheduling method based on queue theory
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric automobile charging process optimization scheduling method based on a queue theory. The charging process of the electric automobile is divided into an input process, a queuing process and a service process, and when the electric automobile is connected into a power grid according to the probability of discrete poisson distribution, the electric automobile enters the queuing process. When the number of electric vehicles connected to the power grid is not large or the power grid load is low, the electric vehicles can be directly charged without waiting, and when the number of electric vehicles connected to the power grid is large or the power grid load is at a peak value, the available power grid power resources are limited, and queuing waiting is needed. According to the invention, the queuing process is optimized, so that the efficiency and fairness of the charging process of the electric vehicle can be effectively considered, and the queuing length and waiting time of the electric vehicle at the charging station can be greatly reduced.

title_en: Explosive flow-oriented mobile edge computing unmanned aerial vehicle cluster auxiliary communication method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mobile edge computing unmanned aerial vehicle cluster auxiliary communication method facing explosive flow, which is used for providing computing service for users with computing requirements on the ground when a network is congested; firstly, a prediction part predicts the distribution situation of the calculation demand of a target area by using an improved PSO-BP neural network, and deploys an unmanned aerial vehicle supporting mobile edge calculation according to the demand; secondly, calculating a demand partition part, partitioning a target area based on a fairness principle, and serving users in the sub-area by each unmanned aerial vehicle; and finally, the unmanned aerial vehicle energy optimization part in the sub-areas performs combined optimization on the unmanned aerial vehicle calculation frequency and the unmanned aerial vehicle flight track on the premise of meeting the user calculation requirements, so that the energy consumption of the unmanned aerial vehicle in each sub-area is minimum, the energy consumption of the whole unmanned aerial vehicle cluster is minimum, and the service duration of the cluster is prolonged.

title_en: Disease prevention, control and disease control facility configuration method with capacity limitation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for configuring a disease prevention and control facility with capacity limitation, and belongs to the field of urban planning. A method of configuring a disease prevention and control facility, comprising: the interval time of the user arriving at the disease control facility in succession is taken as Poisson distribution, the facility of the disease control facility providing user service is taken as a service desk, and the first-come first-obtained queue rule is taken as a queue system; the attraction factor of the disease control facility, the shortest travel time of the user to the disease control facility, the waiting time of the user in the disease control facility and the probability of the user being rejected by the disease control facility are taken as influence factors; compared with the prior art, the method for planning the disease prevention and control facility with the capacity limitation under the limited budget constraint aims to provide fair and reachable public health service. The method considers the capacity limit of the disease control facility, realizes fairness by adopting a primary target method and a secondary target method, and can provide scientific basis for site selection and scale decision of the disease control facility.

title_en: Order processing method and device and computer storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses an order processing method, an order processing device and a computer storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a starting point position corresponding to a network car booking order to be distributed; obtaining the sequence of at least one candidate network appointment vehicle in the target area where the starting point position is located; the ordering of the candidate network appointment is determined based on at least two information of the order-receiving cancellation rate, the network appointment service score value and the accumulated waiting time in the target area of each candidate network appointment; and distributing the network car booking orders to be distributed to the candidate network car booking meeting preset conditions based on the sequence of the candidate network car booking. So, through ordering candidate net car appointment, and then match with net car appointment order based on the sequencing result, improved net car appointment order distribution's fairness and efficiency.
assignees: GEELY HOLDING GROUP CO LTD;HANGZHOU YOUXING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-granularity weighted analysis method and device based on terminal verification
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-granularity weighted analysis method and device based on terminal verification, wherein the method comprises the steps of sending data, all secondary indexes in preset index types and scoring rules of each secondary index to at least two terminals in a one-way transmission mode, and verifying the safety and effectiveness of the one-way transmission mode; obtaining a target weight value of each primary index based on a preset index weight value and at least two characteristic values of each primary index, and calculating an evaluation value of result quality data according to the at least two characteristic values of each primary index and the corresponding target weight values. According to the invention, the final evaluation value is obtained by carrying out component calculation on the relevant characteristic values of the values corresponding to the indexes of different types and combining with the subjective index weight value, so that uncertainty caused by subjective will is effectively avoided, accuracy and fairness of the result can be ensured, and the subsequent improvement and optimization directions can be conveniently provided.
assignees: JINHUA POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV ZHEJIANG;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Demographic data analysis method and system based on deep fairness clustering
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of data mining cluster analysis, and provides a demographic data analysis method and system based on deep fair clustering. The method comprises the steps of taking gender as a binary data point PSV attribute for providing a fairness protection effect, inputting a census data set, and acquiring sensitive attributes of the census data set to obtain two groups with different characteristics, namely a first group and a second group; proportional representation is carried out on the first group and the second group, rough evaluation is carried out on expected values of fairness protection, and target values of fairness protection, namely initial clustering clusters, are determined; constructing a clustered neural network, introducing a judging function, and mapping the fair distribution cluster matrix to an output matrix; calculating the information entropy of the fair distribution cluster matrix and the conditional entropy of the fair distribution cluster matrix and the output matrix; calculating a difference value between the information entropy and the conditional entropy, and maximizing the difference value; and constructing a clustering target constraint based on the initial clustering, the difference value and the elastic network.
assignees: QILU UNIV OF TECHNOLOGY SHANDONG ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title_en: Victim management system
title_ko: 이재민 관리 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention computerizes a task by having a victim registration step of confirming an identity, photographing a subject with a camera, and outputting a 2D barcode including victim information together to issue a victim card and store the corresponding information in a server, a relief supply distributing step of storing and managing whether to distribute a relief supply of the subject in the server by using the 2D barcode of the victim card after distributing the relief supply, and a meal management step of storing and managing whether the subject has a meal in the server by using the 2D barcode of the victim card when having the meal, by processing an existing handwriting-managed task. Further, a LoRa network is constructed by itself to transmit the status of personnel, supplies, meals, etc. of a corresponding shelter to a center which controls the shelters and the states of the shelters which are managed can be checked at a glance by processing data.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은, 기존의 수기로 관리하는 업무를 프로세스화 하여 신분증 스캐너로 신분을 확인하고 카메라로 대상자의 사진을 찍고 이재민 정보를 포함하는 2D바코드를 같이 출력하여 이재민 카드를 발급하고 해당 정보를 서버에 저장하는 이재민 등록 단계

식사 시 이재민 카드의 2D바코드를 이용하여 대상자의 식사여부를 서버에 저장해 관리하는 식사관리 단계로 업무를 전산화 하는것을 요지로 한다.

title_en: Blockchain network system, traceability management system, and method
abstract_en: The present invention contributes to objective, neutral, equitable, fair, and easy confirmation of a state present in data when tracing collected information. Provided is a blockchain network system in which nodes are connected in a network and which is configured to allow the nodes to hold identical information about an object in a distributed manner, the nodes comprising: a plurality of responsible nodes each responsible for providing a predetermined role; and a role-providing node configured to store a role database in which a corresponding role is defined for each responsible node, provide each responsible node with a role on the basis of the role database, and connect the responsible node to at least one corresponding terminal outside the blockchain network system.

title_en: Energy management method and system for comprehensive energy system of multiple micro energy networks
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive energy system energy management method and system of a multi-micro energy network. Firstly, acquiring operation parameters of each microgrid in an integrated energy system; establishing an operation cost model of the alliance in a cooperation mode and an independent mode according to the operation parameters, and further establishing a utility function; the utility function is maximized by optimizing the model parameters to obtain optimized parameters; controlling the operation of each microgrid in the alliance according to the optimized parameters; and distributing the income obtained by each microgrid in the alliance according to the utility function. The method combines the electric heating demand response of the user side, comprehensively considers factors such as user comfort degree and optimization cost, constructs a cooperative game model formed by each micro-grid in the multi-micro energy network comprehensive energy system, and distributes profits according to contribution degrees of each member by using a shape value method while realizing the maximum profits, thereby effectively improving the profits of each member in the alliance, ensuring the fairness of distribution and reducing the operation cost of the system.

title_en: Energy consumption analysis method and system based on micro-grid resource physical digital space model
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy consumption analysis method and system based on a physical digital space model of a micro-grid resource, wherein the method is used for constructing the physical digital space model of the micro-grid resource by acquiring first monitoring data of distributed energy equipment and second monitoring data of electric equipment in the micro-grid and fusing the data; constructing a distributed energy trading platform based on a blockchain based on the model; integrating an energy consumption tracing function in the transaction platform, constructing an energy consumption tracing tree model, further calculating the energy consumption contribution degree of each distributed energy device and the energy utilization responsibility sharing proportion of each electric device, generating an energy consumption tracing report and uploading a chain storage certificate; according to the invention, by constructing the energy consumption traceability tree model, the fine traceability and responsibility sharing of the micro-grid energy flow can be realized, accurate data support is provided for energy consumption analysis and management, and the transparency and fairness of micro-grid energy management are remarkably improved.

title_en: Service personnel clock setting optimization method and system based on data driving
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of manual service operation management, in particular to a service personnel clock setting optimization method and system based on data driving. The method comprises the steps of obtaining clock-up data of a history service person, carrying out clock-up feature extraction according to the clock-up data of the history service person to obtain clock-up feature data, carrying out clock-down same-frequency processing according to the clock-up feature data to obtain clock-down same-frequency data, carrying out clock-arranging conflict processing according to the clock-down same-frequency data to obtain clock-arranging conflict data, carrying out clock-arranging order disturbance according to the clock-arranging conflict data to obtain clock-arranging disturbance data, carrying out cooling window control according to the clock-arranging disturbance data to obtain cooling window data, and carrying out dispersion degree processing on the clock-arranging disturbance data according to the cooling window data to obtain clock-arranging optimization data. The invention realizes the dynamic perception and intelligent optimization of the service personnel clock arranging process. Compared with the traditional static shift arrangement mode, the method can effectively relieve resource conflict and improve service continuity and fairness.

title_en: Benefit distribution method and device of virtual power plant considering risks
abstract_en: The invention discloses a benefit distribution method and device of a virtual power plant considering risks, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring historical measured data and historical predicted data of each participating subject in the virtual power plant; obtaining a corresponding prediction error and probability density function according to calculation; fitting a probability density function to obtain a probability distribution curve; integrating the probability distribution curve to obtain an accumulative probability distribution function; obtaining a prediction precision score according to the prediction error and the cumulative probability distribution function; setting a weight for each prediction accuracy score so that the sum of all weights is 1; calculating to obtain a risk factor according to the prediction precision score and the corresponding weight; all risk factors are subjected to normalization processing to obtain corrected risk factors; and correcting the shape value according to the corrected risk factor to obtain the distribution income corresponding to each participating subject. According to the method, the risk factors of all participating bodies are introduced into the shapey value so as to ensure the fairness of distribution and the stability of alliance.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG

title_en: Emergency resource allocation method, system and application in sudden public health event
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of resource allocation, and discloses an emergency resource allocation method, system and application in a sudden public health event, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining the medical resource amount consumed by medical health institutions at all levels in quarantine, isolation observation, suspected case diagnosis and treatment and confirmed case treatment by adopting a data collection and management method, a questionnaire survey and interview survey method, a group discussion method, a Delphi method and a data statistical analysis method; constructing a sudden infectious disease epidemic situation prediction model based on different prevention and control measures and regional and time-interval division, and determining an optimized prediction model of intervention measures with minimum medical resource consumption; and formulating a medical resource supply and configuration mode based on the SEIAPHR optimization model prediction value. The invention predicts the demand of medical resources in different regions and time periods based on different intervention measures, and provides a reasonable supply mode to realize an emergency medical material configuration mode which gives consideration to both 'benefit' and 'fairness'.
assignees: CHILDRENS HOSPITAL OF CHONGQING MEDICAL UNIV

title_en: Power system optimal scheduling method considering economy and fairness
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optimal scheduling method for an electric power system considering both economy and fairness, which comprises the steps of establishing an optimal power flow model comprising a target function with the lowest power generation cost, system power balance constraint and line transmission power; deducing node marginal electricity prices according to the optimal power flow model, and determining the node marginal electricity prices, wherein the node marginal electricity prices comprise generator nodes and load nodes under the alternating current model and the direct current power flow; solving the fluctuation rate of the marginal electricity price of the node; establishing an optimized dispatching model of the power system according to the power generation cost of the generator set, the node marginal price fluctuation rate and the constraint conditions of the generator set; and solving the optimized scheduling model to obtain the optimized scheduling method of the power system. The invention establishes the marginal electricity price fluctuation rate index of the nodes of the power system to reflect the fairness and rationality of the scheduling scheme, reduces the difference of the marginal electricity prices among the nodes as much as possible by optimizing the scheduling mode, and is beneficial to promoting the construction of the power market and ensuring the benign operation of the power system.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECHNICAL RES INSTITUTE STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Energy acquisition cognitive wireless network joint time and power distribution method based on double-layer game
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for combining time and power distribution of an energy acquisition cognitive wireless network based on double-layer game, which comprises the steps of firstly introducing energy collection (energy harvesting, EH) into a CR network to construct the EH-CR network, and collecting and using energy by using an energy acquisition framework of acquisition-use. The interaction between the PU and the SUs is then modeled as a jackberg game, and the interaction between the SUs is modeled as an supermode game. In order to improve fairness among SUs, this method introduces a fairness evaluation coefficient. Then, by solving the NE solution of the supermode game, an equalized spectrum sensing time coefficient and an equalized power distribution scheme can be obtained.

title_en: Laboratory equipment intelligent reservation management system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of laboratory management and discloses an intelligent reservation management system of laboratory equipment, which comprises a data acquisition and processing module, a reservation scheduling engine module and a game theory decision module, wherein the data acquisition and processing module is used for collecting equipment state data, user reservation request data and historical use data in real time, cleaning, standardizing and storing the collected data, the reservation scheduling engine module is used for performing reservation scheduling on the equipment according to a multi-objective optimization algorithm, maximizing the utilization rate of the equipment, minimizing reservation conflicts and optimizing time distribution, and the game theory decision module is used for simulating a plurality of users to play games in the reservation process. By introducing deep learning, reinforcement learning, game theory and real-time feedback mechanisms, the problems of insufficient dynamic adjustment, unreasonable resource allocation, inaccurate demand prediction and frequent reservation conflict in the traditional laboratory equipment reservation system are solved, and the equipment utilization rate, fairness and scheduling response capability are remarkably improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG XINGMA ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of station P2G operation mode under multiagent based on Shapley value method is joint
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of joint station the P2G investment-operation modes shared in many ways with realization device production capacity of multiagent.Comprehensively consider flotation costs and fixed cost to calculate the daily operating cost of new model.Using Cost Allocation cost, fair allocat profit as target, deserved income can be divided in portion, it is ensured that result fairness is reasonable according to member's participation and contribution degree with classical Shapley value method.And analyze wind farm side, factory's net side, the interests height of the interests of each main body in gas turbine group side and the joint station P2G.

title_en: Block chain network-based train transfer guiding method, system and equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a block chain network-based train transfer guiding method, a system and equipment, wherein the train transfer guiding method is applied to a user terminal serving as a block chain node and comprises the following steps: under the condition that the geographic position of the user terminal is obtained, the virtual reward objects guiding transfer are displayed in the front of the geographic position in the user terminal in a three-dimensional mode, the user is guided to transfer to the virtual reward objects guiding transfer according to the set target transfer path, and under the condition that the user terminal is monitored to reach the virtual object, an intelligent contract is triggered to be executed, and rights and interests resources are distributed to the user. According to the invention, the equity resource allocation mechanism for train transfer is constructed by adopting a block chain technology, and equity resources are allocated to the users who follow guidance to complete transfer by combining the three technologies of the block chain, the Internet of things and the augmented reality, so that the users can be stimulated to complete transfer according to a guide route, thereby improving the transfer guidance efficiency, reducing the probability of congestion at congested stations and realizing the landing of the metasma.
assignees: SHANGHAI JIU NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle task allocation and path planning method based on intelligent airport
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle task allocation and path planning method based on an intelligent airport, which comprehensively considers factors such as flight distance constraint, signal strength, task fairness, demand coverage and the like, and performs joint optimization on unmanned aerial vehicle task allocation and path planning problems in an urban management scene by using a two-stage multi-target planning model. Meanwhile, the invention also discloses a task allocation and path planning algorithm which aims at the two-stage multi-target planning model and combines a genetic algorithm and a simulated annealing algorithm.
assignees: GUANGDONG WING SCENE INFORMATION SCIENCE AND TECH CO

title_en: Method and system for evaluating relationship between financial asset allocation and equity capital cost
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for evaluating a relationship between financial asset allocation and equity capital cost, and relates to the technical field of mining the relationship between the financial asset allocation and the equity capital cost. Firstly, determining evaluation variables of the relationship between long-term financial asset allocation and equity capital cost; then, establishing an evaluation model of the relationship between various long-term financial asset configurations and equity capital costs by adopting a common least square method based on evaluation variables, and carrying out reliability test on the evaluation model; and finally, obtaining an evaluation result of the relationship between the long-term financial asset configuration degree and the equity capital cost of the enterprise to be evaluated based on the inspected multiple evaluation models. Compared with the prior art, the method can more comprehensively and accurately evaluate the relationship between the long-term financial asset allocation and the equity capital cost of the enterprise, thereby being beneficial to a manager to reasonably allocate the scale of the long-term financial asset.

title_en: Inter-provincial power spot market operation evaluation method and related device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an inter-provincial power spot market operation evaluation method and a related device, wherein a multi-dimensional and multi-main evaluation index system is designed, dynamic self-adaptive evaluation is carried out on inter-provincial power spot market operation based on the multi-dimensional and multi-main evaluation index system to obtain an evaluation result, and optimization suggestion is carried out based on the evaluation result. The invention comprehensively improves the evaluation result, has more accurate evaluation accuracy, meets the fairness requirement, can improve the income-saving satisfaction degree of the sending end and the electricity-saving purchase cost of the receiving end, and greatly shortens the response time.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Public facility layout method and system based on user preference and behavior simulation
abstract_en: The application provides a public facility layout method and a system thereof based on user preference and behavior simulation, wherein the technical key points are that a facility selection preference of a user is obtained through a descriptive preference questionnaire, the influence of each element on the selection behavior is described by utilizing a discrete selection model, and a selection probability prediction model is established by combining overall or crowd-dividing parameters; the method comprises the steps of simulating a facility selection pattern of a demand point by a Monte Carlo method, taking the average utility maximization as a core optimization target, adopting a genetic algorithm to realize iterative search of facility positions to obtain an optimized layout scheme meeting the requirements of efficiency, fairness and multiple dimensions, carrying out index calculation such as matching relation analysis and utility, distance, coverage rate and the like on the result, outputting a visualization scheme, overcoming the defect that a traditional position-allocation model only considers distance, ignores individual differences and relies on candidate points, and providing a scientific and reasonable optimization tool for public service facility planning.

title_en: Model based on stock right and dividend incentive selection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a model based on equity and dividend incentive selection, which comprises the constraint requirements of the organized enterprise type range, implementation conditions, incentive objects, incentive modes and incentive amount, and five dimensions of 'policy conditions', 'incentive objectives', 'enterprise scale', 'business characteristics' and 'established years' are used as key elements for selecting the incentive modes through policy, enterprise actual investigation and expert discussion, so that the smooth proceeding of an equity incentive plan of a company is ensured, the governing structure of a company legal system is further improved, a well-balanced value distribution system is formed, high-level managers and core backbone personnel of the company are encouraged to diligently carry out work, the stable improvement of the performance of the company is ensured, and the equity and operation targets of the company are ensured to realize that a national science and technology type enterprise selects the equity or the dividend incentive mode.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU PROVINCE ELECTRIC POWER LTD COMPANY NANTONG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH COMPANY

title_en: Multi-path multi-target emergency material distribution path selection method based on SHADE algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a differential evolution (SHADE) algorithm based on success history adaptive parameters, which is used for searching emergency rescue paths of emergency supplies and mainly comprises the following steps: by learning the cross rate and the variation rate of successful individuals in the differential evolution algorithm, the method can find a more superior path. In order to search more equivalent emergency material rescue scheduling paths, the fitness sharing mechanism is simultaneously used in a target space and a decision space to ensure the diversity of the paths, provide various feasible paths for a user to select, and avoid the condition that a single path cannot pass due to some sudden reason. The invention not only can search the optimal emergency goods and materials rescue scheduling path meeting the target condition, but also can provide a plurality of equivalent paths, thereby providing guarantee for sending emergency goods and materials to the destination for rescue at the first time.

title_en: Comprehensive energy system source-charge main body cooperative carbon reduction method based on block chain technology
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of low-carbon scheduling of integrated energy systems, and provides a comprehensive energy system source-load main body collaborative carbon reduction method based on a block chain technology. The system not only can enable users to actively participate in carbon transaction on the individual level under the guidance and the excitation of a market mechanism and adjust the electricity utilization strategy, but also can drive the side to coordinate and complement with multiple functions so as to increase the carbon emission reduction degree. Thus, a complete emission reduction system from an energy production source to terminal consumption is constructed, and the cooperative emission reduction effect of both supply and demand sides is realized. In addition, through DPoS consensus mechanism based on credit threshold, nodes can be stimulated to actively participate in consensus election, fairness of the consensus election is guaranteed, and abnormal nodes are effectively processed.

title_en: Staff dormitory recommendation method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a staff dormitory recommendation method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium, wherein personal information and basic intention dormitory information of dormitory to-be-selected personnel are determined, sampling step sizes and dormitory recommendation quantity are recommended, the information of the to-be-selected personnel in the dormitory matched with the basic intention dormitory information is obtained, a matched dormitory set matched with the dormitory to-be-selected personnel is determined based on the information of the to-be-selected personnel and the personal information of the dormitory to-be-selected personnel, then the to-be-selected personnel in the matched dormitory set and the dormitory to-be-selected personnel are ordered, sampling to-be-selected personnel are determined based on the ordering numbers and the recommended sampling step sizes of the dormitory to-be-selected personnel, accordingly, the occupation ratio of various types of dormitory is determined based on the dormitory attribute information of the sampling to-be-selected personnel, and the recommended dormitory recommended to the dormitory to-be-selected personnel is selected from current room sources based on the occupation ratio of various types of dormitory types, and the dormitory allocation fairness is improved.

title_en: Digital twinning-based intelligent accounting and payment system for peasant wages
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twinning-based intelligent accounting and payment system for peasant wages, which relates to the technical field of intelligent accounting and payment for peasant wages and comprises an initial acquisition setting module, a data acquisition window module, a data analysis and feature extraction module, a task change classification module and a dynamic acquisition regulation module; the initial acquisition setting module is used for setting an initial acquisition interval duration to acquire data of a worker work task according to work arrangement of a construction site and initial complexity of the worker task. According to the invention, the data acquisition mode is optimized according to the complexity and the change mode of the work task of the worker by intelligently and dynamically regulating and controlling the acquisition interval. For complex and changeable tasks, the system shortens the acquisition interval, accurately records the switching of the high-intensity tasks and the low-intensity tasks, and ensures the fairness of wage accounting. For a single task, the acquisition interval is prolonged, redundant data is reduced, the resource utilization rate is improved, and the accuracy of wage accounting and the system operation efficiency are effectively improved.

title_en: One quality testing method and device
abstract_en: The present invention provides a quality testing method and device, is related to computer field.The quality detecting method is applied to quality inspection system, it include: to obtain the corresponding quality inspection sample of each first trial person, the corresponding quality inspection sample of each first trial person includes the sample extracted in the content of respective first trial according to preset ratio according to preset various dimensions characteristic and to the first trial result of the content；The corresponding quality inspection sample of each first trial person is distributed to the corresponding Quality Inspector of each first trial person.The quality detecting method, so that quality inspection result fairness is just, can accurately measure the auditing capabilities of first trial person according to the auditing capabilities of the measurement first trial person of the quality inspection sample objective reality.
assignees: BEIJING YIDIAN WANGJU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Energy scheduling and trading method for interconnected micro-grid system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy scheduling and trading method of an interconnected micro-grid system, which belongs to the technical field of multi-micro-grid interconnection and comprises the following steps: and introducing power trading volume, taking the declared power trading volume of the micro-grid and the actual power trading volume as constraints, dividing the energy scheduling model into two sub-models, wherein a decision variable of a first sub-model is not coupled with a decision variable of the energy trading model, solving the energy trading model on the premise that the first sub-model is optimal, and taking one of the optimal solutions of the energy trading model as the optimal solution of a second sub-model. The invention realizes decoupling between energy scheduling and transaction decision, and can improve decision accuracy; the multi-agent deep reinforcement learning algorithm and the P2P-based Nash negotiation game solution decoupled model are adopted respectively, so that the rapid solution can be realized, the requirement of real-time decision scheduling is met, the intermittent and uncertainty of renewable energy sources can be met, the privacy of a micro-grid is protected, and the fairness of transactions is ensured.

title_en: Virtual power plant low-carbon equity space-time credibility evaluation and optimal scheduling method and device
abstract_en: The application relates to a method and a device for evaluating and optimizing space-time credibility of low-carbon rights and interests of a virtual power plant, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a current regulation and control instruction of at least one sub-power distribution network area; based on the current regulation and control instruction, determining an energy storage scheduling strategy with the lowest current running cost by using an energy storage scheduling optimization model, wherein the energy storage scheduling optimization model is constructed according to an objective function and a preset core constraint condition based on the space-time characteristics of the electric energy value and the environmental value of the energy storage device of each sub-distribution network area; and optimally scheduling at least one sub-distribution network area according to the energy storage scheduling strategy with the lowest current running cost, and evaluating the carbon reduction benefits of the energy storage scheduling strategy with the lowest current running cost by utilizing an energy storage low-carbon interest evaluation model. Therefore, the problem that the related technology cannot fully evaluate the environmental benefit of the energy storage in the space-time multiple dimensions is solved.
assignees: UNIV TSINGHUA;STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Multi-unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative computing unloading and resource allocation method and system for emergency search and rescue of sudden disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative computing unloading and resource allocation method and system for emergency search and rescue of sudden disasters, which comprise the steps of building a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle assisted three-dimensional computing unloading network architecture for the emergency disaster search and rescue scene, taking unloading fairness of search and rescue equipment, load balancing of unmanned aerial vehicles and reduction of unmanned aerial vehicle energy consumption into consideration, building a system utility function, building a deep reinforcement learning model aiming at the maximum utility function of the search and rescue equipment for task unloading, training the deep reinforcement learning model based on an improved multi-agent dual-delay depth deterministic strategy gradient algorithm, introducing OU noise and a priority cloning learning mechanism, and learning and optimizing unmanned aerial vehicle track planning and task unloading decisions of the search and rescue equipment. According to the invention, the unmanned aerial vehicle can be used as a cooperative computing and unloading requirement of the MEC server in a disaster scene, so that the purposes of ensuring the fairness of search and rescue equipment service and reducing the energy consumption of the unmanned aerial vehicle can be achieved by reasonably and efficiently computing and unloading decisions and resource allocation.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHEAST;JIANGSU JICUI MOBILE COMMUNICATION TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for automatically distributing bill tasks, storage medium and server
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a method and a device for automatically distributing bill tasks, a storage medium and a server, and relates to the field of financial processing. According to the method, a bill task pool is traversed at task allocation time, bill types and associated operator lists with processing authorities are extracted, and after the current bill types and user lists are selected according to a preset sequence, matching tasks are screened to generate a set to be allocated. And calculating a weighted average value of the total to-do amount and the task amount to be distributed based on the number of to-do receipts of each operator in the current user list, and determining a dynamic distribution threshold. And in the distribution process, sequentially distributing tasks to be distributed to operators in the user list until the to-do amount of each operator reaches the upper limit of the threshold value. The application not only avoids the static stiffness defect of the traditional automatic dispatch, but also overcomes the fairness missing problem of manual robbing, ensures the load balance of high-efficiency staff and low-efficiency staff, and simultaneously improves the timeliness of task processing and the overall throughput of the system.

title_en: Fairness constraint-based platform economic flow distribution control method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a platform economic flow distribution control method and system based on fairness constraint, which belong to the technical field of flow distribution, and are characterized in that historical multidimensional data and real-time multidimensional data are acquired, based on the historical multidimensional data and preset fairness constraint rules, the real-time multidimensional data are calculated by using a dynamic weight distributor to obtain flow distribution weights of all resource suppliers, the current industry concentration of all the resource suppliers and a preset fusing threshold and industry concentration warning line are judged, if the current industry concentration is larger, an anti-monopoly fusing mechanism is triggered, if the current industry concentration is smaller, flow distribution is carried out according to the flow distribution weights of all the resource suppliers, the flow distribution of all the resource suppliers is timely regulated by using the dynamic weight distributor, monopoly trends can be effectively restrained, the understanding and the supervision of a platform, the resource suppliers and a supervision organization can be combined with real-time dynamics, flow distribution response is carried out, and application and popularization are facilitated.

title_en: Resource allocation method based on mMTC service classification
abstract_en: The invention provides a resource allocation method based on mMTC service classification, which comprises the following steps: initializing variables; reordering the MTCG set according to the MTC service classification table; performing priority processing on each emergency alert service type MTCG until the residual data volume of all the emergency alert type MTCGs is less than or equal to 0; then processing other service MTCGs until the residual data volume of the other service MTCGs is less than or equal to 0; according to the occupancy matrix O N×K The MTCG total sum rate is obtained. The method comprehensively considers the characteristics of different service types in actual life, thereby establishing the priority of different services, optimizing the sum rate of MTCG, ensuring the communication quality of LTE users and the emergency alarm type MTCG, ensuring the service quality of the emergency alarm type service with the highest priority while ensuring the capacity of the MTCG system, improving the effectiveness and reliability of a communication system and synchronously improving the fairness and effectiveness of the network.

title_en: Large-area agricultural irrigation area water resource balance efficient allocation method for coping with climate change
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large-area agricultural irrigation area water resource balance efficient allocation method for coping with climate change. The method comprises the following steps: s1: collecting basic data; s2: constructing a crop water utilization efficiency function, and quantifying crop water resource allocation in a research area; s3: constructing an economic benefit function of crops, and quantifying the fairness of economic benefit distribution based on the jealousness value of the users; s4: constructing a social welfare function, and building a multi-objective optimization model, and balancing the water resource allocation efficiency and the economic benefit fairness of the irrigation area; s5: setting a model boundary; s6, constructing a Bayesian network, and determining meteorological variables affecting runoff of a research area; s7: and constructing a multi-objective optimization model, and calculating water resource allocation data of the large-area agricultural irrigation area which is in response to the climate change. The method gives consideration to the comprehensive effect of multiple targets, processes the economic benefit relation from the subjective and objective angles, comprehensively considers the uncertainty of the influence of multiple factors on runoffs from the current situation and the future, and therefore realizes sustainable and efficient management of water resources in irrigation areas.

title_en: Medical facility accessibility evaluation method based on mobile phone signaling data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a medical facility reachability evaluation method based on mobile phone signaling data, aiming at the problem of medical facility space distribution fairness, and from the reachability perspective, considering supply-demand interaction, and evaluating the medical facility reachability by using an enhanced two-step mobile search method (E2 SFCA). The method comprehensively considers the influence of the travel time and the travel distance on the travel, defines the service range and the distance threshold of the medical facility according to the travel condition of the mobile phone user, and introduces a Gaussian attenuation function based on the time threshold to simulate the attenuation of travel attraction along with the travel time. The invention can simultaneously consider the accessibility of the medical facilities under different transportation modes and display the space distribution condition of the accessibility of the medical facilities under different transportation modes, thereby evaluating the space distribution equilibrium condition of the medical facilities and proposing suggestions for urban planning and equalization of the medical facilities.
assignees: NANJING RUIQI INTELLIGENT TRANSP TECHNOLOGY INDUSTRY RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Scheduling planning and dispatching system for boarding gate service personnel
abstract_en: A gate attendant shift planning and dispatching system comprising: the dispatching system comprises a flight management module, a resource planning module, a scheduling management module, a real-time dispatching module, a statistical analysis module and a task bidding module, wherein the service process of the dispatching system is as follows: importing flight information by combining guarantee standards (business rules) and historical data experience; generating a flight guarantee task; predicting the whole task quantity and reasonably making a scheduling plan; generating a dispatch plan of the current day; carrying out abnormity monitoring on the flight plan; correspondingly adjusting the dispatch plan according to the actual feedback of the abnormal monitoring; issuing a dispatching result; the data is statistically analyzed as a historical data experience. The system provided by the invention has higher flight punctuality rate and better utilization efficiency of human resources; the requirements for information transparentization such as labor production efficiency, staff duty fairness, staff working strength and the like are met; through the flow of the cross-post resources, the use efficiency of human resources can be further improved, and the enthusiasm of workers is improved.
assignees: HANGZHOU PAIER INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Efficiency-increasing, emission-reducing, acid-controlling and corrosion-preventing water and soil resource random dynamic regulation and risk avoidance method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a random dynamic regulation and risk avoidance method for water and soil resources, which comprises the steps of efficiency improvement, emission reduction, acid control and corrosion prevention. The method comprises the following steps: s1: respectively quantifying soil acidity, soil organic carbon and soil erosion amount by adopting a farmland soil acidification model based on nutrient input-output balance, an agricultural residue theoretical potential model and a RUSLE model of soil erosion; s2: establishing a soil acidification-carbon sequestration-erosion cooperative lifting successive transfer model; s3: constructing a joint distribution function of random variables of rainfall, runoff and water demand by adopting a three-dimensional Copula function, and determining joint occurrence probability; s4: creating a two-stage random planning condition risk continuous-taking model of agricultural water and soil resource dynamic regulation and risk management; s5: and synthesizing the models S2 and S4, and considering water supply and risk constraint conditions to form a nonlinear multi-target stochastic dynamic programming model. The method fully considers the uncertainty in the agricultural water and soil resource management, and ensures the fairness of agricultural water and soil resource allocation under the uncertain condition.

title_en: Carbon emission accounting method, system, equipment and medium for accounting carbon emission distribution in transaction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a carbon emission accounting method, a system, equipment and a medium for carbon emission distribution in transactions, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining an original carbon emission active set; the method comprises the steps of screening an original carbon emission active set to obtain a carbon emission active set, dividing carbon emission activities in the carbon emission active set to obtain a division result, calculating carbon emission quantity of the carbon emission activities based on the division result, and carrying out responsibility allocation on the carbon emission quantity through an allocation model to obtain the carbon emission quantity of both transaction parties. According to the invention, the flexible adjustable allocation coefficient is introduced to construct the bidirectional responsibility allocation model, so that the production end and the consumption end fairly bear carbon emission responsibility in the transaction in proportion, the problem of repeated calculation of the same carbon emission by the production end and the consumption end in traditional calculation is avoided, the fairness, accuracy and executable of carbon emission calculation are improved, and scientific support is provided for standardized operation of a carbon trade market.

title_en: Carbon distribution method, system and related equipment for charging electric automobile
abstract_en: The invention is applicable to the technical field of carbon emission and provides a carbon distribution method, a system and related equipment for charging an electric automobile, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring multi-source data comprising unique identity marks of users, power grid energy structure data, charging equipment parameters, vehicle energy efficiency data and user behavior data through a charging operation system; the method comprises the steps of calculating reference fuel vehicle carbon emission and electric vehicle charging carbon emission based on power grid energy structure data and vehicle energy efficiency data to generate user net carbon reduction, constructing a carbon universal index system, dynamically optimizing weights of indexes in the constructed carbon universal index system by utilizing a random forest model, calculating user carbon integration according to the optimized weights, and completing the storage and transaction of the user carbon integration through a blockchain intelligent contract, so that the fairness and excitation efficiency of carbon integration distribution are effectively improved.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Electric-gas comprehensive energy system planning method based on cooperative game
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric-gas comprehensive energy system planning method based on collaborative games, which comprises the steps of S1, establishing a multi-main-body electric-gas comprehensive energy system model comprising a carbon capture power plant, renewable energy sources and a carbon utilization unit, S2, establishing a distributed optimization objective function and operation constraint of each main-body model, S3, establishing a collaborative game model through distributed optimization according to the distributed optimization objective function and operation constraint based on a collaborative game alliance, and S4, decomposing and collaborative solving the collaborative game model by adopting an alternate direction multiplier method to generate electric-carbon bilateral transaction amount and dynamic negotiation price. The invention can process the distributed decision behaviors among multiple subjects, truly characterize the physical interaction relationship among the multiple energy flows in the electric-gas-carbon system, improve the physical reliability and engineering applicability of the model, maximize the income of each subject, and give consideration to privacy protection requirements and cooperative residual value distribution, and improve the running efficiency and fairness of the system.

title_en: System and method for marketing mix optimization for brand equity management
abstract_en: A method of marketing optimization with respect to brand lifetime management formulates a problem of brand equity maximization utilizing Markov Decision Process (MDP) thereby casting brand equity management as a long term regard optimization problem in MDP, The marketing mix is optimized by formulating the mix as actions in MDP and, utilizing historical marketing and transaction data, aspects of the MDP are estimated.

title_en: Method and system for determining local fairness of ml model with degree of fairness
abstract_en: State of the art model fairness approaches do not address the degree of local fairness of a ML model. A method and system for determining local fairness of a classification Machine Learning (ML) model with degree of fairness is disclosed. The method creates multiple perturb instances using multilevel GMM clustering approach and a constrained perturbation technique to ensure feature distribution of perturbed data, generated from a tabular base data is within the feature distribution of the tabular base data of the ML model. Further, the class of a protected attribute is flipped, black box model prediction probabilities and the cosine similarity constraint and multiplication factor on the probabilities is used to provide a degree of fairness for the local instance. Thus, provides magnitude of fairness or unfairness to the local instance.

title_en: Storage facilities for emergency relief supplies
abstract_en: A method of community service including placing a storage structure at a strategic location for direct distribution of emergency relief supplies from the storage structure to a populace in the event of an actual disaster. In addition the method includes marketing advertising on the storage structure.

title_en: Move lot size balancing system and method
abstract_en: A method and system for allowing a vehicle dealer and manufacturer to match dealer orders and manufacturing plant shipments easily and equitably are disclosed. The method significantly decreases processing time, saving valuable time, money, and manpower resources. An automated linear expression calculation for determining and balancing vehicle allocation allows for equitable balancing of manufacturing plant orders and efficient optimization. The linear expression calculation may be performed in an iterative series of steps. The linear expression calculation handles a plurality of attribute features, thereby accommodating a plurality of dealer requests and vehicle options. The linear expression calculation creates a matrix representing the plurality of attribute features, and with each iteration the values within the matrix are refined and optimized, with the resulting matrix representing an optimized and balanced allocation of manufacturing plant production orders among a plurality of manufacturing plants.

title_en: Scientific and technological project and achievement evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for evaluating scientific and technological projects and achievements, and relates to the technical field of information. The scientific and technological project and result evaluation method comprises the following steps: s1: and (4) auditing setting, namely firstly setting the reviewing party by a reviewing manager at the terminal, and then sending a reviewing notice to each reviewing terminal, wherein the reviewing party setting comprises a project to be reviewed, a reviewer, a reviewing manager, a reviewing principal, a billing rule, a voting rule and a reward rule. According to the scientific and technological project and result evaluation method and system, the evaluation voting results of the project to be evaluated are subjected to statistical sorting, and the allocation of rewards and the results of the statistical sorting are combined, so that the final reward result corresponds to the voting result, the reward quantity is set according to the proportion of the reward, the requirements of different voters are met, the evaluation efficiency and fairness are improved, and the evaluation work is more truly popular, standardized and scientific.
assignees: SHANDONG SHUIMU QINGQING INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Personnel examination scheduling method and system based on multidimensional data analysis
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of intelligent data analysis, in particular to a personnel examination scheduling method and system based on multidimensional data analysis. The method comprises the steps of collecting personal information of a target examinee object and personal information of other four examinee objects adjacent to the target examinee object, introducing a data processing and semantic understanding algorithm based on artificial intelligence and natural language processing technology to the rear end to extract semantic features of the personal information of the target examinee object and the personal information of the other four examinee objects, automatically learning and capturing implicit association relations and semantic difference measurement coefficients between the personal semantic features of the target examinee object and the personal semantic features of the other four examinee objects respectively, and accordingly performing intelligent evaluation of rationality of examination seat arrangement to judge reasonable grades of the examination seat arrangement. Thus, powerful guarantee can be provided for the fairness of the examination.
assignees: ANQING PERSONNEL EXAMINATION INST ANQING PERSONNEL TRAINING CENTER

title_en: Rescue system using drone and method thereof
title_ko: 드론을 이용한 재난구조시스템 및 재난구조방법
abstract_en: The present invention introduces a disaster rescue system using a drone, capable of automatically sensing the occurrence of a disaster by using a sensor, performing disaster broadcasting, controlling the disaster, saving a human life, and evacuating humans by using situation information of a disaster area transmitted from the drone by flying the drone in the disaster area, and a method thereof. The disaster rescue system includes an IoT sensor node and a control unit and further includes a drone operating unit. The disaster rescue method using the drone includes a disaster accident sensing step, a drone dispatch step, a disaster broadcasting performing step, a relief material airlifting step, an accident site control step, and an evacuation guidance step.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재난의 발생을 센서를 이용하여 자동으로 감지하고, 재난 발생 지역에 드론을 띄워 드론으로부터 전송되는 재난 지역의 상황 정보를 이용한 재난방송, 재난의 통제, 인명의 구조 및 인명을 대피하도록 하는 드론을 이용한 재난구조시스템 및 재난구조방법을 개시(introduce)한다. 상기 재난구조시스템은, 사물인터넷 센서노드 및 관제부를 포함하거나, 드론운용부를 더 포함한다. 상기 드론을 이용한 재난구조방법은, 재난사고감지단계, 드론 파송단계, 재난방송 수행단계, 구호물자 공수단계, 사고현장 통제단계 및 대피유도 단계 중 적어도 하나를 수행한다.

title_en: Emergency rescue item transfer system using drone
title_ko: 드론을 이용한 응급 구호 물품 배송 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an emergency relief product delivery system using a drone and, more specifically, to an emergency relief product delivery system using a drone, which can quickly provide an emergency relief product such as an automatic cardiac shock device to a required position within a golden time by using a drone outdoors such as a golf course where an ambulance cannot arrive quickly.
