title_en: Multi-energy system scheduling method considering section safety constraint and scheduling fairness
abstract_en: The application discloses a multi-energy system scheduling method considering section safety constraint and scheduling fairness, aiming at a nested and layered section structure, priority sequences from an inner layer to an outer layer are gradually searched, the maximum space of the output of a new energy station is calculated under the condition that the section does not exceed a stability limit, meanwhile, a fairness calculation method is constructed on the basis of scheduling fairness indexes, the output limited distribution scores of all power plants related under an out-of-limit section are calculated, and the fair distribution of the output limits of all wind power plants and photovoltaic power plants is guaranteed.

title_en: Intelligent building virtual machine management and control system based on Internet of things perception and block chain
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent building virtual machine management and control system based on internet of things perception and a block chain, which comprises independent buildings and virtual energy station platforms, wherein the virtual energy station platforms are provided with main nodes and play a role in issuing instructions and supervising, each independent building is provided with a block chain node, a plurality of independent buildings are connected with each other and are connected with the main nodes to form the block chain, and each block chain node stores all data information in the whole block chain; when the main node of the virtual energy station platform issues a power grid scheduling instruction, after each building node receives information, the intelligent contract is triggered, and the energy flow strategy is executed according to the intelligent contract to complete an energy flow event. The invention applies the block chain technology, integrates and implements a novel electric power transaction mode which is more reasonable, more information-transparent and stronger in transaction fairness, and realizes that resources such as building adjustable load, green electricity and the like participate in the marketized transaction of the power grid.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID SHANGHAI INTEGRATED ENERGY SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Multi-micro-grid two-stage collaborative scheduling method based on GBS-ADMM and generalized Nash balance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-micro-grid two-stage collaborative scheduling method based on GBS-ADMM and generalized Nash balance, which aims to construct a micro-grid day-ahead low-carbon scheduling model with minimized day-ahead running cost, solves the problem by using an alternate direction multiplier method to obtain a day-ahead scheduling result, constructs the micro-grid day-ahead low-carbon scheduling model with minimized day-ahead running cost as a target, solves the problem by using an improved alternate direction multiplier method with Gaussian back substitution to obtain a day-ahead scheduling result, aims to maximize micro-grid distribution income, constructs a benefit distribution model, solves the problem by using an NSGA-III algorithm to obtain a final day-ahead scheduling result and a benefit distribution result. The invention can provide the dispatching result with optimal system operation economy in two stages of day-before-day and the micro-grid operation income distribution result with fairness and reasonability, thereby providing support for the multi-time scale dispatching of the novel power system and having certain engineering use value.

title_en: Shared logistics network optimization method based on double-layer planning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a shared logistics network optimization method based on double-layer planning. The method comprises the steps of constructing an upper-layer planning model, generating and outputting a logistics center set and a resource distribution matrix, constructing a lower-layer planning model, carrying out multi-industry collaborative vehicle path optimization of the lower-layer planning model based on the logistics center set and the resource distribution matrix, obtaining actual resource consumption data and time window violation number statistical data, feeding back the actual resource consumption data to the upper-layer planning model, feeding back the time window violation number statistical data to the upper-layer planning model, verifying and evaluating fairness of resource allocation by the upper-layer planning model based on fairness constraint, adaptively adjusting the logistics center set position in subsequent iteration according to the fairness constraint, and adaptively adjusting the resource distribution matrix in the subsequent iteration based on updated credit score. The method can efficiently share and comprehensively schedule the logistics resources in a large range, can obviously reduce the total cost of the whole link system, and improves the operation economic benefit.

title_en: Emergency water supply allocation method for large-range long-duration drought
abstract_en: The invention provides an emergency water supply allocation method for large-range long-duration drought, which comprises the steps of classifying and identifying conventional water sources and emergency water sources of allocation units in a drought region; selecting an emergency water supply allocation mode according to different drought degrees; calculating and analyzing the water supply and demand of each allocation unit under different drought degrees; formulating the water source and water user drought emergency water supply allocation rule under different allocation modes of each allocation unit; the method comprises the steps of constructing a double-layer large-range long-duration drought emergency water supply allocation model by taking the minimum integral water shortage, the minimum integral disaster damage and economic cost and the minimum deviation between the actual water storage capacity of a reservoir and the target water storage capacity as targets, wherein the model comprises a data input module, a drought degree evaluation module, a water supply and demand module and an optimized allocation module. The method can improve the emergency water supply allocation efficiency, fairness and sustainability under the drought condition.

title_en: The distribution optimization method that Distributed sharing is mutually cooperateed with centralization clearance
abstract_en: The invention discloses the distribution optimization methods that Distributed sharing is mutually cooperateed with centralization clearance, the distribution network system mutually cooperateed with by building Distributed sharing with centralization clearance, distribution network operation business uniformly clears out the electricity price of each node according to the purchase of electricity that each polymerization quotient reports, polymerization quotient passes to node electricity price each micro-capacitance sensor of intra-node, each micro-capacitance sensor optimizes the operation of itself according to node electricity price and transaction and interacts with node aggregation quotient, using the model based on game theory or based on the model of Lagrange relaxation, solution obtains the purchase of electricity and power purchase price of each micro-capacitance sensor of intra-node, the purchase of electricity of micro-capacitance sensor inside polymerization quotient's collector node is simultaneously sent to power distribution network operator, clear out the electricity price of each node again by distribution network operation business, and so on until convergence.Guarantee the stability of operation of power networks and the fairness of electricity price clearance, realizes that each micro-capacitance sensor carries out free transaction under the premise of meeting electricity price clearance fairness.

title_en: Power wireless private network resource allocation method based on service priority
abstract_en: A wireless private network resource allocation method of electric power based on business priority, the said method is according to the business priority of the electric power user, minimum requirement of user rate, fairness criterion and QoS demand at first, regard total utility of the coexistence system of maximization as the objective function and construct the optimization and assign the model; and solving an optimal solution to an inequality constraint problem of the optimal distribution model by using an improved Lagrange multiplier method considering a KKT condition to obtain an optimal distribution scheme of an authorized frequency band and an unauthorized frequency band, so that the power users with all priorities select the optimal carrier frequency band and resource units for information transmission on the premise of meeting the requirements of speed, bandwidth, throughput and time delay. The invention aggregates the authorized frequency band and the unauthorized frequency band, provides broadband wireless access service by utilizing the idle frequency band, optimizes the carrier aggregation system through the resource allocation algorithm, ensures that the limited frequency spectrum resources can meet the requirement of power emergency communication, and provides powerful information transmission support for the emergency communication of power production.
assignees: STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION COMPANY;UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Data processing system and method for idle article poverty alleviation platform
abstract_en: A data processing system of an idle article poverty-relieving platform comprises a poverty-relieving object information data storage and conversion module, an article donation object recommendation module, an idle article sorting calibration module, a fund distribution module of a fund donation object, a cash change processing module and a poverty-relieving information encryption module. The data processing method of the idle article poverty alleviation platform comprises the steps of updating stored poverty alleviation object information data in real time, analyzing poverty alleviation states of poverty alleviation objects and generating corresponding demand article sets through calling of a database; the idle article are sorted and calibrated, the articles meeting the donation specification are donated, algorithm selection is carried out on donated objects, other articles are changed in the currency, and the changed idle articles are distributed based on the poverty relief distribution model and then fund distribution. According to the system and the data processing method, the processing of idle articles and the poverty alleviation problem are perfectly combined, so that the accurate poverty alleviation work of the platform can be well operated, and the use feeling of the platform is improved.
assignees: GOODFULL BEIJING TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Novel block chain consensus mechanism for intelligent Internet of things computing power service
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel consensus mechanism of a block chain for intelligent Internet of things computing power service, which comprises a block chain architecture for the intelligent Internet of things computing power service, a matrix product computing task processing mechanism and a reward adjusting mechanism; the intelligent internet of things computing power service oriented block chain architecture comprises four types of nodes: AIoT nodes, coordination nodes, miners' nodes, and verification nodes. The matrix product calculation task processing mechanisms provided by the invention set unified rules and interfaces for the blockchain miners participating in the calculation service, ensure the fairness of blockchain mine excavation competition, and are favorable for attracting more miners to participate in the blockchain, thereby further improving the safety of the blockchain network. By utilizing the distributed computing service of miners in the block chain, the security and privacy leakage risks caused by the central service are reduced, and the security of the computing service is improved.
assignees: YANGTZE DELTA RESEARCH INSTITUTE UNIV OF ELECTRONIC SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY OF CHINA QUZHOU

title_en: New energy power generation curve differentiation assessment method considering line transmission blocking
abstract_en: The invention discloses a new energy power generation curve differentiation assessment method considering line transmission blockage, which belongs to the technical field of novel power system scheduling and operation and comprises the steps of establishing an RES day time scale power curve differentiation deviation assessment mechanism considering transmission line blockage and regional power grid comprehensive regulation and control requirements, setting an assessment mechanism deviation correction method considering BESS use efficiency and assessment fairness, adjusting weights of the BESS use efficiency and the assessment fairness in an optimization target, establishing an assessment mechanism operation effect comprehensive evaluation index, assisting in quantifying implementation effects of the assessment mechanism, and guiding weight setting of the BESS use efficiency and the assessment fairness. The invention provides a differential assessment mechanism which can effectively give consideration to fairness and BESS comprehensive regulation and control efficiency, and the fairness of the mechanism can be enhanced by improving the weight coefficient alpha  fair  in a region with more abundant upper-level power grid flexibility regulation and control capability.
assignees: ECONOMIC TECHNOLOGY RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Standard on-line digital review platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of online review and discloses a standard online digital review platform which comprises a platform application and interaction module, a blockchain and intelligent contract module, an AI analysis engine module, a database module and a platform application and interaction module, wherein the platform application and interaction module is used for providing a unified user interface and processing operation instructions of different roles, the blockchain and intelligent contract module is connected with the platform application and interaction module and used for deploying a preset review process intelligent contract and storing key review operation logs in a non-falsifying mode, and the AI analysis engine module is connected with the blockchain and intelligent contract module and connected with the platform application and interaction module. The invention solves the technical problems that the process data of the existing review system are easy to tamper, objective and quantitative analysis is difficult to carry out, and the analysis model cannot be self-optimized, achieves the effects that key certificates in the review process cannot tamper, and the whole process is traceable, and builds a self-optimized closed loop combining analysis and management and control, thereby improving the fairness and reliability of the review.
assignees: BEIJING QUANKE ON LINE SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD

title_en: Distributed collaborative optimization method for energy management scheduling of electric automobile
abstract_en: The invention provides a distributed collaborative optimization method for energy management and scheduling of an electric automobile, which firstly adopts a price model to describe the willingness of a user to charge and discharge the electric automobile, and respectively constructs an electricity willingness coefficient and a charge and discharge cost coefficient according to the electricity economy target of the user and the power grid load stability requirement so as to ensure the fairness of electricity consumption of the user and the profitability requirement of a power grid company. And then describing the charge and discharge scheduling process of the electric automobile by using a multi-layer hierarchical multi-objective optimization model, and ensuring the minimum fluctuation of a load curve and the optimal cost of electricity consumption of a user. And finally, the uncertainty of the electricity consumption behavior of the user is solved by designing a dynamic time domain optimization scheduling algorithm, so that the optimization process can be adjusted in real time along with the behavior change of the user, the multi-period online optimization scheduling of the electric automobile is realized, the general electricity consumption field scene in the intelligent power grid system is met, and the win-win situation of the power grid supply and demand side is realized.

title_en: Chemical laboratory equipment whole-flow management method and system
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of experimental equipment management and provides a method and a system for managing the whole process of chemical laboratory equipment, comprising the following steps of receiving an experimental equipment application form, analyzing the experimental equipment application form to determine experimental projects, applicant, application equipment sequences and urgency; the method comprises the steps of receiving an audit passing instruction, entering a queuing mode through a corresponding experimental equipment application form, calling all experimental equipment application forms at each interval set time value, calculating the earliest available time of all experimental equipment in a laboratory, calculating the time concentration degree of the application equipment corresponding to each experimental equipment application form according to the earliest available time, calling the queuing time and the emergency degree of each experimental equipment application form, and distributing the experimental equipment to the experimental equipment application form based on the time concentration degree, the queuing time and the emergency degree. The invention comprehensively considers the factors of time concentration, queuing time and urgency, and realizes the quantitative balance of efficiency and fairness through dynamic adjustment.

title_en: Controller fairness scheduling method based on control requirements
abstract_en: A controller fairness scheduling method based on control requirements comprises the following steps: step one, selecting out the personnel e in a centralized way n (ii) a Step two, judging personnel e n Whether to leave or not, if not, directly carrying out the next step, if so, judging the number of the alternative workers, and selecting the maximum value of the seats S and the current workers; step three, judging personnel e n Whether the health certificate is valid or not and whether the qualification required by the seat is met or not are judged, if yes, the next step is carried out, and if not, the step two is carried out, and a person e n Leave-asking step; the scheduling method has the technical key points that the scheduling method can be used for automatically scheduling according to rules and standards, and the purpose of scheduling is as follows: the balance of the workload of each person is realized, and the optimal matching of the persons and the seats is realized, so that the normal and efficient operation of an enterprise is ensured.
assignees: XIAN THIYE ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Incremental power distribution business-based distribution network joint planning profit distribution method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distribution network joint planning profit distribution method and system based on incremental distribution business, which relate to the technical field of distribution network planning and comprise the following steps: establishing a single fault state probability model and a single power distribution network planning model, and determining independent planning cost; establishing a reliability cost model of the power distribution network; establishing a joint planning model of the power distribution network according to the three models, setting constraint conditions, and determining joint planning cost; making a difference between the combined planning cost and the independent planning cost, and regarding the difference as profit; and establishing a profit distribution model based on the Shapley value according to the principle of the cooperative game, and distributing the profit through the profit distribution model. According to the distribution network joint planning profit distribution method and system based on the incremental distribution service, profit is reasonably distributed, so that each distribution network investment entity participates in unified planning to better accord with fairness principles, and long-term cooperation of participants is facilitated.
assignees: SHANDONG LURUAN DIGITAL TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Multi-energy system supply and demand collaborative planning method based on consumer psychology
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of energy supply and demand analysis, in particular to a multi-energy system supply and demand collaborative planning method based on consumer psychology, which comprises the following steps of firstly, establishing demand response modeling based on consumer psychology; and step three, performing Nash game fair transaction optimization based on the Nash game theory. The method comprises the steps of establishing a consumer psychological demand response uncertainty model, describing response behaviors of consumers through piecewise linear functions, accurately capturing uncertainty of flexible energy demand capacity, comprehensively considering configuration and operation constraint of various energy technologies such as photovoltaic power generation, cogeneration and the like, constructing a multi-energy system design and operation optimization model covering electric power, heat supply and cold supply, adopting a Nash game theory to ensure balance of benefits of both supply and demand parties, and ensuring fairness and sustainability of energy transaction.

title_en: Shared bicycle scheduling optimization method considering bicycle allocation fairness among areas
abstract_en: The invention discloses a shared bicycle scheduling optimization method considering fairness of bicycle allocation among areas, which comprises the steps of 1 setting an operation period set, an area set and parameters and variables related to a shared bicycle deterministic scheduling optimization model of a free floating shared bicycle system, 2 establishing the shared bicycle deterministic scheduling model, 3 establishing the shared bicycle uncertainty scheduling model under the condition of considering random demands, 4 reconstructing the shared bicycle uncertainty scheduling model based on a strong dual principle of second order cone planning, and 5 solving the reconstructed shared bicycle uncertainty scheduling model by utilizing a binary search algorithm to obtain a scheduling optimization result. The invention can realize fairness of bicycle distribution among areas, ensure that the demands of users in each area are fairly met, and simultaneously, consider the uncertainty of the demands in an important way, enhance the adaptability and the robustness of a dispatching scheme, thereby reducing the waste of shared bicycle resources and improving the service quality of a shared bicycle system.

title_en: Electric vehicle charging process optimization scheduling method based on queue theory
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric automobile charging process optimization scheduling method based on a queue theory. The charging process of the electric automobile is divided into an input process, a queuing process and a service process, and when the electric automobile is connected into a power grid according to the probability of discrete poisson distribution, the electric automobile enters the queuing process. When the number of electric vehicles connected to the power grid is not large or the power grid load is low, the electric vehicles can be directly charged without waiting, and when the number of electric vehicles connected to the power grid is large or the power grid load is at a peak value, the available power grid power resources are limited, and queuing waiting is needed. According to the invention, the queuing process is optimized, so that the efficiency and fairness of the charging process of the electric vehicle can be effectively considered, and the queuing length and waiting time of the electric vehicle at the charging station can be greatly reduced.

title_en: Method for constructing and verifying drainage basin water resource comprehensive simulation and configuration model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for constructing and verifying a watershed water resource comprehensive simulation and configuration model, and belongs to the technical field of water resource planning and configuration. Based on a natural-social binary water circulation structure, a flow production, confluence and allocation module are coupled, a calculation unit is divided, a topological relation is determined, a model is built by taking minimum water shortage rate and optimal water supply fairness as targets, a multi-source database containing meteorological, land utilization, reservoir and water consumption unit information is built, iteration calibration and verification are carried out on natural water circulation and social water circulation parameters by utilizing historical data, and a model with reliable verification is coupled with underlying surface and climate situation data of the planning year in the future, so that a water resource optimal allocation scheme is operated and output. The invention solves the problems of low coupling degree and poor precision of the existing model, and realizes high-precision simulation and scientific configuration of the water resource system of the flow field.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Water pollution load distribution method considering region fairness and pollution source treatment difference
abstract_en: The invention provides a water pollution load distribution method considering region fairness and pollution source treatment difference, which comprises the steps of selecting evaluation indexes, and calculating the damping coefficient and the weight of each index; calculating the current comprehensive kini coefficient; setting a total amount control constraint; setting fairness constraints; setting a reduction rate constraint; determining the treatment cost of each administrative area related to each ton of industrial wastewater; determining the ton water treatment cost of urban domestic sewage in each administrative district; determining the ton water treatment cost of municipal upgrading reconstruction; determining the unit pollution load treatment cost of industrial wastewater, urban domestic sewage and municipal upgrading reconstruction in each administrative area; calculating comprehensive treatment cost; and solving the water pollution load distribution problem. The invention can scientifically and reasonably guide the pollutant reduction sequence and the reduction scheme in each region and various pollution sources to make.
assignees: CHANGJIANG INST SURVEY PLANNING DESIGN & RES CO LTD

title_en: Transportation capacity control method, device, equipment and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a capacity management and control method, a capacity management and control device, equipment and a computer readable storage medium, which belong to the technical field of information, and the method comprises the following steps: determining a shift result of the plurality of delivery capacities based on the quality parameters of the plurality of delivery capacities; when a scheduling request for a target freight note is received in a target time period, acquiring a plurality of target freight capacities of which the time period is the target time period based on a scheduling result; and scheduling the delivery capacity for the target freight bill based on the delivery quality parameters of the plurality of target freight capacities. The method accurately controls the scheduling and dispatching of the delivery capacity based on the delivery quality parameters, guarantees the normative and the certainty of the period capacity, and guarantees the fairness of the capacity control strategy, thereby ensuring the quick response of the waybill and improving the service quality of the instant delivery.

title_en: Public service facility layout evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for evaluating public service facility layout, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting multi-source space data in a research area, cleaning, standardizing and space matching the data, drawing a public service facility distribution diagram based on the public service facility data to obtain the space distribution of public service facilities, analyzing the current situation coverage situation of the public service facilities based on a network analysis method, calculating the public service comprehensive score of a living unit, and statistically analyzing to give a space site selection suggestion of public service setting according to the space distribution of the public service facilities, the current situation coverage situation of the public service facilities and the public service comprehensive score of the living unit. According to the invention, the traditional public service accessibility analysis is improved from the street or community scale to the living unit scale, so that the analysis is more refined, various factors are introduced to evaluate the accessibility of public service facilities, and the fairness of accessibility evaluation is improved.
assignees: SHENZHEN ZONDY SOFTWARE ENG CO LTD

title_en: Port integrated card driver dispatching method, system and related equipment based on intelligent prediction and fairness optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a port integrated card driver dispatching method, a port integrated card driver dispatching system and related equipment based on intelligent prediction and fairness optimization; the invention relates to the port integrated card driver dispatching field, and aims at the technical problems that the existing dispatching method only takes the empty driving distance as the matching cost, so that the task allocation of a driver is not public and lacks the prospective, the weight of a matching edge is defined as the comprehensive dispatching cost in a weighted bipartite graph, the cost is composed of three items of the empty driving distance, a fairness penalty item and a task demand guide item, and the fairness penalty item reflecting the historical load balance of the driver and the task demand guide item reflecting the future task distribution trend are explicitly introduced into the weight of the matching edge, so that when the optimal matching is solved, the task allocation fairness and the prospective of the system response are obviously improved on the premise of not sacrificing the transportation efficiency.
assignees: Ningbo port information communication co ltd

title_en: Method of distributing revenue through the equity division of the transport space using the space division of the transport container for ship or air transportation
title_ko: 선박 또는 항공 운송을 위한 수송 용기의 공간 분할을 이용한 운송 공간의 지분 분할을 통한 수익 분배 방법
abstract_en: According to the present invention, a method for distributing profits through equity division of a transport space using space division of a transport container for ship or air transport comprises the steps of: receiving investment according to the use of each transport container from a plurality of investors; equity division of the transport space of the transport container in response to the determined investment stake; and allocating the equity-divided transport space to each investor, and utilizing the allocated space to allow each investor to ship imports or exports and use them for ship or air transport.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 선박 또는 항공 운송을 위한 수송 용기의 공간 분할을 이용한 운송 공간의 지분 분할을 통한 수익 분배 방법은, 각 수송 용기의 사용에 따른 투자금을 다수의 투자자들로부터 받는 단계, 결정된 투자 지분에 대응하여 수송 용기의 운송 공간을 지분 분할하는 단계 및 지분 분할된 운송 공간을 각 투자자에 할당하고, 할당된 공간을 활용하여 각 투자자들이 수입품 또는 수출품을 선적하여 선박 또는 항공 운송에 사용할 수 있게 하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: A kind of power distribution network feeder line optimizing fractional method that maximum power supply reliability is distributed based on uniform load
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of power distribution network feeder line optimizing fractional method that maximum power supply reliability is distributed based on uniform load, belong to intelligent distribution network protection and control technology field.Power distribution network equitable subsection can improve efficiency of the power distribution automation in practical implementation, improve power supply reliability.The non-uniform problem of power distribution network feeder line generally existing power load distributing, Practical Project are not calculated usually and are directly segmented when constructing, and cause effect and contemplate that larger gap that actual segment reaches.The present invention is for the non-uniform problem of live power load distributing, based on power supply reliability, according to peak load, obtain maximum segment number, when calculating from two-section to maximum segment number, the reliability in the case of the optimal segmentation of each segments, is contrasted by the reliability curve with power load distributing when uniform, realize the optimal segmentation under optimizing fractional and each segmented mode, finally determine segments and waypoint according to actual conditions such as engineering costs.

title_en: Complex task distribution method based on community network
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the complex task distribution method based on community network.Community network SN of the present invention is by worker A, syntople E and weight D compositions, task requester submits a task R to platform, technical ability request and valuation including task, the worker formed in the A of community network submits possessed technical ability and corresponding cost to platform, after being collected into community network, task requester and the information of worker, platform is responsible for the running of whole assigning process as auctioneer, the main work for including two stages of winner's decision-making and pricing strategy.Instant invention overcomes community network, the cohesion of addition team and technical ability between not considering worker to contribute, and the defects of fairness.The present invention use auction technique, between consideration worker, team, technical ability etc., be a kind of distribution mechanism of anti-tactic.

title_en: Ensure the new energy active command calculation method of spot exchange and medium-term and long-term electricity
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of new energy active command calculation methods for ensureing spot exchange and medium-term and long-term electricity, belong to operation and control of electric power system technical field.For including interim spot exchange, basic guarantee electricity, the grid-connected active real-time control in new energy station of the complexity electricity target such as medium-term and long-term electricity transaction, the invention proposes be two stages solution by the active power output Command Resolution of new energy station, first stage considers that power grid receives ability, station performance indicator, the composite factors such as sensitivity and interim stock applications, for the interim stock application reply amount of each station optimal scheme, when second stage solution station finally instructs, using interim spot exchange electric power calculated on last stage as instruction lower limit constraint, and long-term electricity schedule index in being introduced into objective function, and interim spot exchange electricity is removed from generated energy, long-term electricity part in not influencing, the fairness of marketing is effectively ensured.
assignees: NARI TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;STATE GRID SHANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO;NANJING NARI GROUP CORP;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Building economic dynamic loss assessment and disaster reduction decision system under flood disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building economic dynamic loss assessment and disaster reduction decision system under a flood disaster, which is based on a fine physical model and considers the uncertainty of resistance distribution of building components when coping with the flood disaster, and can obtain time-varying disaster economic loss in the whole flood process when being applied to a pre-disaster simulation scene, thereby providing a basis for the scheduling of related disaster relief materials; when the method is applied to a real-time monitoring scene, compared with the existing method, the method can accurately obtain the economic loss condition of each building in the monitoring area at the current moment.

title_en: Stock right optimizing method, device and medium suitable for electric-hydrogen micro energy network hybrid all manufacturing companies
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device and a medium for optimizing the equity of all manufacturing companies by mixing an electric-hydrogen micro energy network, and belongs to the technical field of investment planning. The method comprises the steps of obtaining an improved electric-hydrogen micro energy network hybrid all-system company game payment model, solving the improved electric-hydrogen micro energy network hybrid all-system company game payment model by combining financial constraint and physical planning constraint according to the obtained related data of an electric-hydrogen micro energy network system and taking the maximum social benefit of the electric-hydrogen micro energy network hybrid all-system company as an optimization target, and determining the share right distribution and the benefit distribution proportion of the electric-hydrogen micro energy network hybrid all-system company according to the obtained maximum alliance benefit and the edge contribution of alliance members. The invention breaks through the individual investment mode of the traditional power enterprise, and effectively realizes the fair benefit distribution of each investment body by fully exerting the absorption and wind/photoelectric stabilization advantages of the electric-hydrogen hybrid energy storage.
assignees: JIANGSU POWER DESIGN INST CO LTD CHINA ENERGY ENG GROUP

title_en: Accelerating data-driven scientific discovery
abstract_en: Techniques facilitating using a distribution system for incentivizing and accelerating data driven scientific research are described herein. The distribution system can track the input of various parties involved in scientific research, and when a reward, monetary or otherwise, is realized for one or more outcomes of the scientific research, the distribution system can distribute the reward among the parties that provided the input. The relative levels and contributions of the parties can be tracked to ensure that an equitable portioning of the reward is realized. A directed graph can be formed based on the transactions, wherein the nodes correspond to entities, researchers, publications, and the edges correspond to relationships between the entities. The directed graph can be analyzed to determine the relative or absolute levels of contributions from each of the entities, and the rewards can be distributed based on the contribution levels.

title_en: Computer-implemented method for calculating trade price reference indicator
abstract_en: A computer-implemented method for calculating a trade price reference indicator includes step 101: creating a frequency distribution chart based on a price increment; step 102: selecting an accumulation distribution point from the frequency distribution chart; and step 103: calculating an average deviation of an active range based on the accumulation distribution point, calculating a significant range, and using the significant range as an equitable value of a market. The method calculates and generates a trading reference price indicator of a financial market product by superimposing discrete quantitative elements of time and quantity distributions onto conventional price-time, so as to accurately reflect real-time market transactions, avoid price manipulation, and achieve accurate statistics and analysis of financial prices.

title_en: Multi-energy micro-grid point-to-point energy scheduling method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for dispatching point-to-point energy sources of a multi-energy micro-grid, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a multi-energy micro-grid optimization model containing electric, gas and heat energy sources according to network coupling constraint, equipment characteristic constraint and dispatching operation constraint of an energy micro-grid, carrying out distributed iterative solution on the multi-energy micro-grid optimization model by adopting an alternating direction multiplication algorithm to obtain P2P energy exchange quantity among micro-grids, calculating P2P energy exchange price by adopting a lubine bargaining RBS strategy based on the P2P energy exchange quantity to obtain an excitation signal of micro-grid energy exchange, and obtaining a comprehensive dispatching scheme of the micro-grid according to the P2P energy exchange quantity and the excitation signal. The invention can perform multi-energy coordination, ensure information safety and improve interaction fairness and resource utilization rate.

title_en: Block chain mutual salary evaluation management method, system and storage device thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of management systems, and discloses a block chain mutual salary evaluation management method, a block chain mutual salary evaluation management system and a storage device of the block chain mutual salary evaluation management system, wherein the block chain mutual salary evaluation management system comprises a block chain module and an intelligent contract module; the intelligent contract module is arranged in the block chain module, and realizes the following contract functions: contract 1: generating a performance examination table; contract 2: distributing a performance examination table, and collecting a complete performance examination table after each staff finishes scoring; contract 3: automatically counting and calling a comprehensive weighting algorithm to calculate the performance assessment score of each person; contract 4: calculating the value evaluation weight value of each person; contract 5: automatically issuing the salary allocation amount of each person. The invention can achieve the effects of improving the efficiency, the accuracy and the fairness of salary distribution, can deal with different salary distribution rules, and has better adaptability.

title_en: Digital scheduling method and system based on priority
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital scheduling method and a system based on priority, wherein the method comprises the following steps: 1) Acquiring data information to be scheduled, including personnel information, post information and on-duty place information; 2) Providing a shift selection calendar, and receiving shift selection operation submitted by a shift scheduling person in a shift selection period, and canceling the shift selection operation; 3) After the working selecting period is finished, locking the working selecting register, and automatically triggering the scheduling after locking; according to the daily personnel requirement constraint, scheduling and distributing a scheduling table; 4) After the scheduling list is issued, receiving the shift application intention of all personnel, matching the shift application intention, returning the shift application intention which is not matched successfully and issuing shift information which is matched successfully; 5) After the scheduling result is determined, receiving a leave request initiated by a person; 6) And updating the shift table according to the shift information and the leave information. According to the invention, the flexibility and fairness of scheduling are considered through the design of selecting the shifts, the final scheduling result can be obtained rapidly, and the efficiency is improved.
assignees: NANJING KAIAOSI DATA TECH CO LTD

title_en: Block chain energy optimization method, device, equipment, medium and computer program product
abstract_en: The present application relates to a blockchain energy optimization method, apparatus, device, medium and computer program product. The method comprises the steps of obtaining alternative energy data, establishing an evaluation criterion corresponding to the alternative energy data, respectively establishing a weighted sum model, a risk aversion decision model and a fairness criterion weight model according to the alternative energy data and the evaluation criterion, establishing a multi-objective comprehensive optimization model according to the weighted sum model, the risk aversion decision model and the fairness criterion weight model, and determining an energy decision scheme of a current blockchain through the multi-objective comprehensive optimization model. By adopting the method, the block chain energy optimization efficiency can be improved, and the robustness, fairness and optimization efficiency can be considered.

title_en: Computing Fairness
abstract_en: Estimated and actual processor runtimes improve computer functioning in fairly sharing computing resources. Today's computers and cloud-based services serve many users and many software applications sharing CPU resources. An operating system thus implements a scheduling policy that fairly allocates CPU time. A scheduler thread implements the scheduling policy based on estimated processor runtimes, and actual processor runtimes, associated with tasks. The operating system may maintain running tallies or totals for a user/group/organization based on credits (e.g., the estimated processor runtimes) and/or on penalties (e.g., the actual processor runtimes). The scheduler thread may select tasks for worker threads based on the credits and/or the penalties, thus ensuring that no user/group/organization unfairly consumes CPU time.

title_en: A kind of dispatching method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses dispatching methods and device, are related to field of computer technology.One specific embodiment of this method includes: to choose the smallest object of virtual driving accumulated value in optional queue to carry out operation, and the object is moved in not optional queue；It completes, update virtual driving accumulated value and is moved it in optional queue to the object operation.The embodiment is able to solve existing scheduling mode lack of wisdom and fairness, and the problem of can bring dangerous driving side effect for a long time.
assignees: BEIJING JINGDONG SHANGKE INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;BEIJING JINGDONG CENTURY TRADING CO LTD

title_en: Immigrant management independent evaluations system
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of immigrant management independent evaluations system, including server and terminal, and the database purchase of independent evaluations management system is operated in server by data of the terminal to server；Independent evaluations management system includes sample Registration Module, investigation and management module, assessment management module and assessment report module；Sample Registration Module is used to register the data sample of quasi- investigation；Investigation and management module is for determining that survey plan planning, investigator are determining and survey plan is implemented；Assessment management module is for generating assessment surveys result, variance data assessment and generating assessment report；Assessment report module is used for the inquiry and statistics of assessment report.The present invention can greatly improve the independence and fairness of evaluation work, reduce the workload of evaluation work, promote the working efficiency of investigation and assessment, can largely save the cost of immigration allocation.
assignees: CHINA THREE GORGES CORP;YANGTZE RIVER WATER RESOURCES COMMISSION NETWORK AND INFORMATION CENTER

title_en: Event stream distribution method, event stream distribution device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence and discloses an event stream distribution method, an event stream distribution device and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an event stream set comprising more than one event stream to be distributed; calculating the priority of each event stream to be distributed according to the attribute information of each event stream to be distributed; respectively acquiring event stream queues of all users; screening users corresponding to the event stream queues based on preset screening conditions to obtain user queues; according to the priority of each event flow to be distributed, distributing the event flows to be distributed to the users in the user queue according to the sequence from high to low, and updating the event flow set after the distribution is finished in the current round; and if the event stream set is not empty, returning to execute the step of respectively acquiring the event stream queues of the users and the subsequent steps until the event stream set is empty. According to the scheme, intelligent automatic distribution of event streams can be realized, and distribution fairness is guaranteed.
assignees: PING AN INT SMART CITY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network difference characteristic diagnosis and analysis method based on power enterprise big data technology
abstract_en: The application discloses a power distribution network difference characteristic diagnosis and analysis method based on a big data technology of an electric power enterprise, a big data platform is used as a data source, so that the data acquisition source range is larger, the analysis angle is more comprehensive, meanwhile, a diagnosis index set is established by preset key index information extracted from the data source, so that the diagnosis index information is quantitatively determined, seed samples are obtained according to pre-acquired development state information of a plurality of target electric power enterprises, the seed samples are compared with the quantitative diagnosis index set, so that difference characteristics of the electric power enterprises in development construction are accurately obtained, the problem of insufficient fairness of difference diagnosis and analysis conclusions of the power distribution network is solved, the development direction of the electric power enterprises is guided in the development process, and the difference characteristics of different types of power distribution networks can be found.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Personalized customization system based on block chain
abstract_en: The invention provides a personalized customization system based on a block chain, which comprises: a decentralized autonomous organization is constructed through a user management module, a collator management module, a nominator management module and a sponsor management module, a production scheme module accurately captures user requirements, a production scheduling module ensures that a production scheme can be executed, a production bidding module searches for an optimal price to achieve minimum cost, a project review module achieves fairness of project acceptance through multi-party verification, a financial payment module achieves safe and compliant payment of capital, an order management module reduces default risks, and a block chain electronic data solid evidence storage module performs authenticity review and solid evidence on all electronic evidences. According to the invention, through a consensus mechanism and a commercial incentive mode, the personalized customization service can be ensured to run safely and stably without trust, and the setting of the role of the sponsor can ensure that the customization service fits with the requirements of users and the overall progress of the project is promoted.

title_en: Airline airplane engine model selection decision method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a model selection decision method for an aircraft engine of an airline company, which relates to the technical field of model selection of aircraft engines and comprises the following steps: firstly, determining a model selection decision factor of an aircraft engine; evaluating the decision factors by adopting an analytic hierarchy process to obtain weight vectors of all factors in the criterion layer and the index layer; finally, calculating to obtain the comprehensive value coefficient of each aero-engine by combining the weight vector of each factor and adopting a fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method; the method comprises the steps of evaluating each decision factor of airplane engine model selection by using an analytic hierarchy process and obtaining an evaluation weight matrix of the decision factor; the weight matrix is scientifically and fairly distributed to all evaluation factors in the engine type selection decision; when a specific engine model is selected, fuzzy comprehensive evaluation is carried out according to various current environmental factors and the like, and an evaluation coefficient is obtained; the method can solve various defects caused by independently using an analytic hierarchy process for decision making, and better reflects the applicability, continuity and fairness of model selection.

title_en: Queuing scheduling method and device for bank outlets
abstract_en: The invention provides a queuing and scheduling method and device for bank outlets, which can be applied to the financial field or other fields. The queuing and scheduling method for the bank outlets comprises the following steps: acquiring a queuing request of a client; the queuing request comprises request sending time, client information and service type; determining the priority data of the client according to the client information, the website information, the request sending time, the current time and the service type; the ordering data for the client is determined based on the priority data. The invention can give consideration to both efficiency and fairness and improve the service efficiency of the network points.

title_en: Highway network gradient optimization method and device based on big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a road network gradient optimization method and device based on big data, which belong to the technical field of traffic transportation engineering modeling, and the technical problems to be solved by the invention are as follows: the hierarchical function division of the highway network is fuzzy; the highway trip service capability is insufficient; the highway network has weak sustainable development capability. The specific method of the invention comprises the following steps: collecting regional basic geographic information data, traffic geographic information data, economic and social development data and traffic development data; the large data technology is utilized for processing and analyzing, the scale adaptability, the space accessibility, the fairness and the connectivity of the regional highway network are obtained, a highway network development gradient evaluation result is formed, key factors influencing highway network gradient optimization are further determined, an optimization algorithm is used on the basis, the highway network layout is optimized according to the key factors, an implementation scheme is formulated, the implementation effect is evaluated, and the aims of optimizing the regional highway network structure and improving the regional highway network transportation function are achieved.
assignees: UNIV XINJIANG;XINJIANG HUAYUAN YUNCHI ENTERPRISE MAN CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent dispatching method and system thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of equipment maintenance dispatching software, in particular to an intelligent dispatching method and a system thereof, wherein the intelligent dispatching method and the system thereof comprise the following steps: acquiring maintenance work order information; analyzing the fault information to generate a diagnosis report, and generating a work order information set according to the maintenance work order information and the diagnosis report; screening all the maintainer information meeting the requirements according to the diagnosis report and the customer information; generating matching priority according to the work order information set and the work order information in processing; generating total priority according to the matching priority and the order allocation priority, and sequentially transmitting work order information sets according to the total priority to match, wherein the transmission time interval between different total priorities is H, and the same total priority is transmitted simultaneously; the method and the system can automatically allocate the worksheets according to the priority, thereby guaranteeing high-quality service provision and allocation fairness.

title_en: Crowd sensing task scheduling method and system based on multi-space modeling and fairness reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the crossing field of crowd sensing technology and artificial intelligence technology, in particular to a crowd sensing task scheduling method and a system based on multi-space modeling and fairness reinforcement learning, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a ground and air collaborative multi-layer space task structure according to acquired tasks; the method comprises the steps of establishing a topological association model among tasks according to space region division results, defining a priority sequence of task scheduling through a critical path extraction mechanism, constructing a differentiated agent matching strategy, reasonably configuring critical path tasks based on the priority sequence, dynamically distributing non-critical path tasks by utilizing a fairness perception multi-objective scheduling algorithm, reducing search space through a space division and path screening mechanism, improving task completion rate and overall scheduling performance of a system, and being suitable for high-efficiency resource configuration requirements in a multi-space collaborative perception task scene.

title_en: Multi-channel fund integration method for national digital equity platform in combination with business management scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-channel fund integration method of a national digital rights and interests platform in a business management scene, and relates to the technical field of financial data processing. The method realizes unified integration management of multi-source funds such as government funds, commercial income, bank running water and the like by establishing a plurality of independent integrating pools such as a commercial integrating pool, a social management integrating pool and the like. The system employs an event driven architecture to configure a plurality of profit items, each profit item containing a unique code identification, profit calculation formulas, and entry rules. When the user executes the actions of payment, answering questions and the like, the system automatically matches corresponding profit items, determines profit values through a special calculation formula and distributes the profit values to the score pool and the user account according to a preset proportion. The invention solves the problems of the traditional system such as the decentralized management of funds, the rigidity of allocation rules, the insufficient transparency and the like, realizes the intelligent profit allocation based on the user behavior, supports the concurrent processing of ten thousand grades per second, and provides high-efficiency technical support for digital social management and business operation.
assignees: QINGDAO BLUEPRINT THINK TANK INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Photovoltaic and electro-hydrogen charging station power transaction optimization method considering conditional risk value theory
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photovoltaic and electric hydrogen charging station power transaction optimization method considering a conditional risk value theory, which comprises the steps of firstly establishing a photovoltaic optimization model and an electric hydrogen charging station optimization model, then introducing a dynamic risk penalty factor into a system optimization objective function, constructing a conditional risk value cost photovoltaic objective function, constructing a photovoltaic-electric hydrogen charging station collaborative optimization model according to the electric hydrogen charging station optimization model and the objective function based on the conditional risk value cost photovoltaic, adopting an improved self-adaptive alternating direction multiplier algorithm to distributively solve the transaction electric quantity and the transaction electric price between the photovoltaic and the electric hydrogen charging station, finally determining an initial profit distribution scheme based on the photovoltaic-electric hydrogen charging station collaborative optimization model to obtain an optimal distribution result, and realizing reasonable balance of overall system benefit and individual contribution degree by optimizing the adjustment coefficient to ensure that the distribution result meets the dual objective of collaborative fairness and transaction excitation simultaneously.

title_en: Order processing method, system, device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses an order processing method, an order processing system, an order processing device and electronic equipment, and relates to the field of Internet. The method comprises the steps that a server receives orders sent by a plurality of clients and stores order information, the server analyzes the order information, responds to order state update, the server updates order states corresponding to the stored order information, the server screens orders meeting resource allocation conditions from the orders sent by the clients to serve as target orders, the server creates and executes resource allocation tasks for the target orders according to user information of the target orders and resource allocation quota corresponding to amount information of the target orders, the server sends resource allocation information of the resource allocation tasks to the clients, and the clients display the resource allocation information sent by the server. The method improves the conversion rate of the resources to the users under the condition of ensuring the fairness of the resource allocation.

title_en: Low-carbon regulation and control method and device for wind, light and hydrogen storage system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a low-carbon regulation and control method and a device for a wind, light and hydrogen storage system, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining characteristic parameters of various devices in the system; establishing a corresponding carbon emission model according to characteristic parameters of various devices in the system; constructing a carbon flow tracing model of the system according to the carbon emission model; calculating the network loss allocation rate when the system operates, and constructing a network loss equivalent carbon emission allocation model by combining a carbon flow tracing model; constructing an optimization decision model of a user and a wind-light-hydrogen storage system according to the network loss equivalent carbon emission allocation model, and determining constraint conditions; solving the optimization decision model to obtain an optimal operation strategy and benefit; according to the method, the network loss allocation rate is calculated based on the network loss generation factor and combined with the line physics and line parameters, the network loss equivalent carbon emission responsibility between the power generation main body and the energy consumption main body is divided, the carbon fairness of the power system is maintained, the main bodies of all parties can be stimulated to realize the carbon emission responsibility, and an accurate judgment basis is provided for implementing carbon excitation or carbon punishment measures.

title_en: Emergency rescue item transfer system using drone

title_en: A kind of power distribution network Investment Allocation decision-making technique based on Balanced scorecard
abstract_en: The power distribution network Investment Allocation decision-making technique based on Balanced scorecard that the embodiment of the invention discloses a kind of, including the preliminary allocation proportion of subregion calculates, partition power grid reports feasibility study plan, preference Investment Allocation, calculating residue can distribute the total disk of investment, carry out project investment Decision of Allocation, summarizes project investment and the verification of allocation result, the present invention passes through various dimensions overall merit, make Investment Allocation decision-making work more effectively and rationally, thus the problems such as solving investment decision distributional equity, science and reasonability；By establishing the checking system that scores in area town year, it is set with Investment Allocation ratio according to can follow；By establishing project access system, quantizing examination is carried out to project implementation effect, reaches the preferred purpose of project；By the way that the foundation of preceding two aspects achievement can be carried out quick computation sheet model using automation computation sheet, decision-making work efficiency is improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;DONGGUAN POWER BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Cooperation cost method for allocating tasks and its system in social networks based on concept lattice
abstract_en: The invention discloses the cooperation cost method for allocating tasks and its system in social networks based on concept lattice.The technical ability that the present invention has the task in social networks, social networks, the participant in social networks and participant models, and obtains task distribution system model；The groupuscule in social networks is obtained using form concept analysis, the inside strong tie attribute based on groupuscule recruits the participant for meeting its skill requirement for task, is quickly obtained the strong tie team for the task of being enough to complete, and promotes the completion efficiency of collaborative task.Using the characteristic that is closely connected between member of community small in social networks, i.e. any member can represent entire Small Groups, and expert is selected to construct weak connection team from different groupuscules, comprehensive, construct team at many levels, guarantee the fairness of competitive type task.Compared with existing task allocation algorithms, the mentioned method of the present invention is obviously improved in performances such as cooperation cost, team size and runing times.

title_en: Company stock right distribution method based on mathematical model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a company equity distribution method based on a mathematical model, which comprises the following steps: establishing a closed fund model, dividing the interior of the fund model into a plurality of hollow units according to a quota mode, determining actual investment amount, filling the hollow units with the actual investment amount to convert the hollow units into effective solid units, planning a lower node increment factor, filling the hollow units with the increment factor and asset increment to convert the hollow units into limited solid units, and repeating the steps. The invention constructs a honeycomb fund model, establishes hollow units in the honeycomb model in a quota mode, forms solid units after actual capital investment, distributes asset increment by using an increment factor, and simultaneously specifies an exit mode and the expansion of the fund model.
assignees: ZHONGHUAN GLOBAL TIANJIN COMPRESSION MACHINERY CO LTD

title_en: Shared energy storage cost allocation method based on collaborative playing and cost causal relationship
abstract_en: The invention discloses a shared energy storage cost allocation method based on collaborative games and cost causal relation, which belongs to the technical field of electrical engineering, and aims at the current situation that the shared energy storage cost allocation of a community at the current stage is unreasonable, and simultaneously, in order to reduce the cost of community energy storage construction, the shared energy storage is used as a flexible resource, and a main body in the community performs cost allocation according to the collaborative games, firstly, the operation and the cost allocation of an ES are considered together through the cost causal relation and the form of the collaborative games so as to realize the maximization of economic benefit; then, the traditional shape model is improved by utilizing the principle based on cost causal relationship; and finally, obtaining the allocation value allocated to each main body according to the improved cost allocation model. The invention can fairly distribute the energy storage cost among community bodies, the calculated amount of the improved shape model is reduced, and the fairness can be ensured.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Scheduling recommendation system and method for field authentication checking expert in authentication industry
abstract_en: The application discloses a dispatching recommendation system and a dispatching recommendation method for field authentication and inspection specialists in an authentication industry, wherein the dispatching recommendation system comprises the steps of acquiring task information of field authentication and inspection to be distributed currently and specialist information of the authentication specialists, and carrying out data analysis on the task information and the specialist information; the expert is comprehensively evaluated according to qualification conditions, service areas and working schedules of the authentication expert by a weighted average method, and a comprehensive evaluation result is obtained; and sequencing the comprehensive evaluation results and outputting a recommended expert list through a visual page to finish recommendation. Compared with the prior art, the method and the device can acquire the comprehensive data of the expert and the task, can process more dimensional information under the condition of meeting constraint conditions, and realize finer and intelligent scheduling, thereby effectively avoiding the error of manual scheduling, improving the efficiency and the success rate of expert scheduling, and ensuring the fairness and standardization of the development of authentication business.

title_en: Dynamic distribution method and system for data element service effect based on car pile network scene
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data distribution and optimization, in particular to a dynamic distribution method and a dynamic distribution system for data element service effects based on a vehicle pile network scene, which are used for carrying out static distribution on the service effects and determining the static distribution proportion; according to the principle of distribution of data element service effect markets of a car-pile-network scene, the contribution degree of a data provider in multiple main bodies is dynamically calculated, a dynamic distribution mechanism is implemented, the data quality of the data provider is dynamically calculated, the dynamic distribution proportion of the data element service effect is calculated based on service characteristics and data characteristics, distribution weights are dynamically adjusted by monitoring the contribution degree and the quality of the data in real time, fair and efficient benefit distribution is ensured, and the data provider is motivated to continuously optimize the data quality. The multi-main-body cooperative cooperation improves the utilization efficiency of data resources and promotes the healthy development of a car-pile-net ecological system. Meanwhile, the block chain technology enhances the transparency and the credibility of the distribution process, and ensures fairness and reliability.
assignees: INF CT YUNNAN GRID POWER CO LTD

title_en: Multi-star collaborative observation task distributed planning method for emergency response
abstract_en: The application relates to an emergency response-oriented multi-satellite collaborative observation task distributed planning method which comprises the steps of modeling a plurality of satellites as intelligent agents with autonomous decision-making capability, and realizing task broadcasting, bidding and confirmation between a task manager and an executor by adopting an improved contract network protocol. By constructing a multi-factor dynamic evaluation function, the task urgency, the observation feasibility, the resource state and the task conflict probability are comprehensively considered, and the intelligent bidding allocation of the observation subtasks is realized. The task conflict game diagram mechanism is introduced, so that the problem of multi-satellite bidding conflict is effectively solved, and the task scheduling fairness and the resource utilization rate are improved. The application has the functions of communication topology perception and local task re-planning, supports self-adaptive recovery under the condition of node failure or communication interruption, and improves the robustness of the system and the task completion rate. The application has the advantages of fast task response, high scheduling efficiency, strong distributed autonomy and the like, and is suitable for the collaborative planning requirement of the multi-star system in the emergency response.
assignees: XIAN INST OF SPACE RADIO TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Resource allocation method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a resource allocation method, a device, equipment and a medium. The invention relates to the technical field of virtual power plants. The method comprises the following steps: determining target transaction electricity quantity data of the virtual power plant and transaction association data of at least two users in the virtual power plant; determining a response force weight based on the demand response information of the current user; determining the target transaction cost of the current user based on the target transaction electric quantity data, the response force weight of each user, the electric quantity data to be transacted and the total loss of historical energy sources; and determining a target user from each user based on each target transaction cost, and performing resource allocation for the target user based on the to-be-transacted electric quantity data of the target user. According to the technical scheme, the fairness of resource allocation is ensured while the response rate of the user to the power demand is improved, and the effect of ensuring the running stability and economy of the virtual power plant is achieved.

title_en: Intelligent distribution method, server and storage medium for real estate channel customers
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent distribution method, a server and a storage medium for real estate channel customers, which receive a customer preparation request sent by a first terminal; determining corresponding channel broker information and identity information of the backuped customers based on the customer backuping requests; generating a distribution mechanism option based on the channel broker information and/or the identity information of the reported customer, and sending the corresponding distribution mechanism option to the first terminal; receiving a selection request of a first terminal for the allocation mechanism selectable items, allocating the replacement clients by using a replacement advisor based on the selected allocation mechanism, and notifying the allocated replacement advisor to take care of the replacement clients; the method helps developers to solve the problems that the off-line channel client distribution supervision is weak, time is wasted, and distribution fairness cannot be guaranteed, meanwhile, the cooperation rights and interests among brokerages, agents, brokers and business placement consultants are guaranteed, and the method has high actual popularization and use values.

title_en: Incremental power distribution network project multi-investment main body income distribution method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power distribution networks, in particular to a multi-investment main body income distribution method for incremental power distribution network projects. Firstly, constructing an incremental power distribution project multi-investment subject income distribution method based on a Shapley value; and then, based on different risk shares, job contribution degrees and contract execution degrees of the investment subjects, correcting the initial Shapley value by adopting a triangular fuzzy number chromatographic analysis method, and determining the final distribution scheme of the investment subjects. The distribution scheme after the Shapley value is corrected can reflect the fairness and the rationality of the income distribution of each investment entity.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG;CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO

title_en: Transformer-based person post matching method, system, equipment and medium
