abstract_en: The invention discloses a person post matching method, a system, equipment and a medium based on a Transformer, which belong to the technical field of natural language processing and human resource management cross application, and the technical problem to be solved by the invention is how to reduce subjective errors in the person post matching process, improve the accuracy, fairness and objectivity of matching and improve the efficiency of manual matching; the text preprocessing comprises the steps of preprocessing collected and tidied post description texts and resume texts, obtaining preprocessed post description texts and resume texts, fusing a transducer and a BERT model, constructing a encoder-decoder structure based on the transducer, optimizing the model, classifying multi-label texts, constructing a multi-label classification system, and outputting and evaluating a matching result.
assignees: INSPUR CLOUD INF TECH CO LTD

title_en: Ambulance parking and locating and sizing method considering fairness
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ambulance site selection and volume determination method considering fairness, which can optimize and select ambulance docking stations and optimize the number of the ambulance docks of each docking station on the basis of the site selection of the ambulance docking stations. The system is divided into a first-aid demand coverage maximization model, an ambulance reachable fairness maximization model based on a two-step mobile search method and a multi-objective optimization model of an ambulance travel cost minimization model. And integrating a plurality of objective functions into a single objective function by using a weight coefficient method, establishing a mixed integer nonlinear programming model, solving by using a Gurobi solver, defining an input model comprising variables, constraint conditions and the objective function, outputting the solution of the model, namely the value of the variables and the optimal value of the objective function, and realizing simultaneous decision of the location and the constant volume of the ambulance stop. The method reduces the time and error of manual judgment and improves the dispatching efficiency and response speed of the ambulance.

title_en: Material cooperative distribution method based on integral excitation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a material cooperative distribution method based on integral excitation, and belongs to the field of emergency logistics and blockchain technology intersection. The method aims to solve the problems that the existing disaster relief material distribution mode is low in efficiency, insufficient in excitation and easy to cheat. The method comprises the steps of quantizing physical contribution and social evaluation of users through Internet of things equipment and feedback of a receiver to generate comprehensive scores, forming a double-track incentive system based on non-transferable honor points and negligable emergency points of blockchain casting, automatically triggering expansion of an emergency integral pool and docking with an enterprise tax deduction system to construct a public benefit-business closed loop when disaster reaches a specific level through intelligent contracts, setting up daily and emergency double-channel exchange modes, and introducing a dynamic weight adjustment mechanism based on abnormal behavior detection to prevent cheating. The invention realizes the high efficiency, fairness and sustainability of material distribution, and remarkably improves the emergency response efficiency and the enterprise participation.

title_en: Dynamic multi-rule intelligent case dividing platform for poor case of individual credit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic multi-rule intelligent case division platform for bad asset cases, which belongs to the field of financial bad asset management and data processing and comprises an initialization module, a dynamic rule engine module, a batch verification module, a weight calculation module, an allocation decision module, an execution module and a balancing module, wherein the platform firstly acquires three-dimensional upper limit and load data, calculates a global pressure load index and dynamically determines a rule priority sequence. After distribution, the platform calculates a multidimensional fairness index, and if the multidimensional fairness index is incorrect, the platform triggers a directional fine adjustment operation. The invention adopts dynamic priority adjustment, predictive weight calculation and closed-loop self-learning gradient mechanism, can sense the load of the asset handling executor in real time, accurately constrains complex business, and improves the fairness of case distribution, the self-adaptive capacity of the system and the overall operation efficiency.
assignees: GUANGDONG HENGQIN SHENSHUI YUNKE DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Systems and methods for managing physical assets across territorial boundaries
abstract_en: Systems and methods are provided for the transfer of legal control of a physical asset when the physical asset is transported across a territorial boundary. Such systems and methods facilitate the transfer of assets within a network between network participants associated with and having control over territories when an asset crosses a territorial boundary. Such a transfer allows for efficient and equitable distribution of costs, revenues, and other elements associated with movable assets among network participants in a region of control.

title_en: System and method for optimizing product development portfolios and integrating product strategy with brand strategy
abstract_en: A business and software method to cost-effectively optimize product and/or service development portfolios, to reduce time to market, and to better integrate and align product or service strategy with brand strategy. The business and software method includes defining in detail the product and service attributes that characterize the ideal customer experience, categorizing the attributes, assigning a numerical value of importance to the attributes, and applying those values to statistical analysis of each assessed product development initiative in terms of alignment with ideal experience and potential competitive impact relative to the resources and risks required to bring each initiative to market. A prioritization for product development resource allocation is developed based upon these analyses. The prioritization is presented in the form of decision intelligence tools for an organization to use and reach informed judgments concerning resource allocation to develop, maintain, or optimize a given product or service portfolio. The decision intelligence tools serve to improve business performance, increase market impact, and build brand equity for products and services of a given organization by improving alignment between what the organization promises customers and what it actually delivers.

title_en: Intelligent government affair and innovative social management system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent government affair and innovative social management system which comprises a basic data management module for data supporting, a module making government affairs public and used for information disclosure and showing, a government service management module for service and dynamic supervising and management, an interaction module for network communication, a monitoring module and a mobile client-side module for function expansion. The intelligent government affair and innovative social management system can make party building government affair organization to be transparent and public and achieve dynamic control of social significant factors, analysis, studying and judgment of the basic-level popular will situation, joint mediation of disputes among the people, serves as a platform at the service of party building, comprehensive management, plan optimization, politics and law and the like of governmental functional departments and relates to all aspects of social management. The manpower and capital cost for management of the governmental functional departments can be reduced, direct communication among the people, companies, units and the government can be enhanced and social equity and social stability are promoted through the network platform.

title_en: A kind of net of trip in time about car order allocation method and system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to net about car technical field, more particularly to a kind of net of trip in time about car order allocation method and system.A kind of net of trip in time about car order allocation method, vehicle predetermined information including receiving user, screening has turned on the net about car of direct route car mode, calculate and use car distance difference, calculating destination distance difference between car destination and vehicle destination between car place and vehicular seat, vehicle selects, Order splitting.A kind of trip net about car order distribution system, including order generation module, direct route car setting module, distance difference computing module, the first net about car searching modul, the second net about car searching modul, Order splitting module in time.The invention provides a kind of compatibility timely trip net about car order allocation method and system that normally automatic order and direct route car pattern, empty wagons can obtain an equitable breakdown, and solving the problems, such as to net can not be high to order progress order of going on a journey in time, vehicle empty wagons rate when Yue Che driver itself has destination.
assignees: LESHAN YITONG TIANXIA NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multiple target water resource equilibrium allocation method based on Conditional Lyapunov ExponentP constraint
abstract_en: The present invention relates to water resource assignment technology, it discloses a kind of multiple target water resource equilibrium allocation method based on Conditional Lyapunov ExponentP constraint, quantification fairness and the controllable water resource assignment of risk are realized.This method comprises: a. determines the objective function of multiple target water resource assignment；B. the constraint condition of multiple target water resource assignment is determined；C. according to the world model of objective function and constraint condition building multiple target water resource assignment；D. the world model of multiple target water resource assignment is optimized.The present invention establishes objective linear water resource assignment model, the water resource in basin is liberally assigned to industry, agricultural, family, ecological water by the water resource assignment strategy aid decision making person of optimization, while controlling economic loss risk.

title_en: Line loss sharing method for connecting distributed power supply to power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a line loss sharing method for a distributed power supply to be connected into a power distribution network, and belongs to the technical field of line loss sharing and block chains. The method comprises the following steps of 1: selecting a 'bookkeeper' node written with data through a POS (point of sale) consensus mechanism of the block chain, verifying and confirming the transaction data, and writing correct data into the block chain; step 2: the intelligent contract calculates the line self-coupling loss and the mutual coupling loss caused by the electric energy transaction; and step 3: the intelligent contract calculates an expected line loss apportionment value according to an Aumann _ Shapley method of the cooperative game; and 4, step 4: and storing a calculation model of line loss sharing after the distributed power supply is connected into the power distribution network in an intelligent contract, and automatically executing fund allocation of the line loss sharing. On the basis of cooperative game, all operation processes are transparent, all data can be traced, and the method has higher fairness and safety.
assignees: HULUNBEIR POWER SUPPLY COMPANY EAST INNER MONGOLIA ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Railway temporary facility construction progress optimization method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of construction management, and discloses a method and a system for optimizing construction progress of temporary railway facilities based on artificial intelligence; the method realizes the accurate quantification of construction contradiction through heterogeneous data fusion and conflict map modeling, combines a multi-agent auction mechanism with a virtual credit system, improves the fairness and efficiency of resource allocation, and breaks through the limitations of the traditional algorithm from the local and global levels respectively through a self-healing mechanism of a pulse neural network and quantum genetic optimization. And at the system level, the edge computing nodes and the distributed consensus engine ensure the reliability of real-time decision making, the dynamic digital sand table realizes the visual prediction of risks, and the self-organizing control tower ensures the compliance of the specification. Through practical verification, the invention reduces the number of resource conflict, improves the emergency response, has higher early warning accuracy of major risks, and remarkably improves the construction efficiency and the safety.

title_en: Method, device, equipment, medium and program for determining disaster relief materials
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for determining disaster relief supplies, which comprises the steps of obtaining the number of people to be saved reported in a plurality of disaster-stricken areas, obtaining at least one disaster-stricken statistical data of crop disaster-stricken areas, crop receiving areas, disaster-stricken population data, death population data, missing population data, collapse house data, damaged house data and regional economic loss data reported in the disaster-stricken areas under the condition that the number of people to be saved in the disaster-stricken areas meets a number constraint condition and the disaster-stricken areas are not preset areas, determining the resource allocation data of the disaster-stricken areas according to regional resource information and regional population data of the disaster-stricken areas, determining disaster-stricken level corresponding to each disaster-stricken data according to the disaster-stricken index data, and determining the disaster-stricken data of each disaster-stricken area according to the number of people to be saved, the disaster-stricken level, the disaster-stricken data and the resource allocation data, and improving the rescue precision and rescue efficiency of the disaster-stricken areas.
assignees: NAT DISASTER REDUCTION CENTER OF EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT DEPARTMENT EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT DEPARTMENT SAT

title_en: system
abstract_en: A system is provided.SOLUTION: A system comprising: means for automatically collecting information from social media or other information sources on a network based on a preset keyword when a disaster occurs; means for assessing reliability of the collected information and indicating the reliability in percentage; means for plotting the assessed information on a map and visually displaying a disaster-stricken situation; means for proposing a necessary rescue plan based on the disaster-stricken situation and presenting supplies, human resources, and a transport route necessary for rescue; and means for calculating an optimal physical distribution route based on real-time traffic information and making a transport plan for relief supplies.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Virtual power plant frequency modulation income distribution method and device considering DLMP
abstract_en: The method and the device for distributing the frequency modulation benefits of the virtual power plant considering the DLMP are used for establishing an economic dispatch model of the power distribution network, and an objective function of the economic dispatch model of the power distribution network is constructed into a Lagrange function form; calculating the frequency modulation cost price of the aggregation main body by considering the marginal electricity price of the nodes of the power distribution network, and calculating the income of the virtual power plant in the frequency modulation auxiliary service market; performing type division on game participants according to a game price strategy distribution interval, calculating benefit expectations of a k-th round game virtual power plant and an aggregation main body, and judging balance point conditions of a virtual power plant internal benefit distribution strategy based on Bayesian game; under the condition that the first round of games are not matched, estimating the quotation mean value and the transaction achievement probability of the opposite game party by adopting the prior probability; and adjusting the quotations of the two game parties through a linear relaxation algorithm until the Bayesian-Nash equilibrium is achieved, so as to achieve the transaction of the two game parties. The invention improves the fairness of the benefit distribution process; and the cooperation stability of the virtual power plant and each aggregation main body is ensured.

title_en: Method and system for evaluating information value of collaborative scheduling excitation and sharing application
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for evaluating and sharing application of information value of collaborative scheduling excitation, which comprise the following steps: the household nodes collect multi-source information such as energy storage, distributed output, electricity consumption and the like, construct quality indexes according to credibility, timeliness and marginal contribution and combine the quality indexes into scheduling characteristics. The centralized control end quantifies the value of each information source based on marginal benefit and improved Shapley contribution metric (layered Monte Carlo sampling approximation), generates value weight and updates node reputation. And embedding the information value weight and the reputation factor into an optimized scheduling model, and adopting a main-auxiliary decoupling solving framework to perform layered iterative solving under the matched information contribution distribution and clearing framework to form and issue an executable control instruction. And converting the benefits into compensation or points according to the contribution degree of the information of each node according to the period to finish settlement. The method systematically excavates the data potential of the user side on the premise of not remarkably increasing hardware investment, and improves the economy, toughness and cooperative fairness of the micro-grid.

title_en: Fair block chain-based bidirectional combined cloud resource allocation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fair bidirectional combination cloud resource allocation method based on a block chain, and relates to n cloud users U-U ═ U 1 ,…,u n H, m cloud providers P ═ P 1 ,…,p m H, where u i Representing the ith user, wherein i is more than or equal to 1 and less than or equal to n; p is a radical of formula j J is more than or equal to 1 and less than or equal to m and represents the jth user; the distribution method is characterized by comprising the following steps: initialization phase, quotation phase, matching and pricing phase, payment phase, dispute phase. The invention also discloses a fair bidirectional combination cloud resource distribution system based on the block chain. The method ensures that the bidding information disclosed by the users and the cloud providers can not be forged based on a commitment mechanism in the bidding stage, and realizes the fairness among the users in a capital punishment mode; in the dispute stage, the fairness of the transaction between the cloud user and the cloud provider is realized by means of the delay execution characteristic of the block chain transaction and the adjudicator; overall implementation of cloud users and cloud users, cloud providers and cloud providers, and cloud users and cloud providersFairness between quotients.

title_en: A kind of task distributing method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of task distributing method and systems, include the following steps, write-in employee information, release tasks, server forwarding task, subordinate functional department complete and submit task, upper management person's examination & approval, approval results are recorded in the information of employee in the form to score, and employee's ability value is generated, and distribute corresponding task according to the ability value of employee.The present invention distributes mode relative to traditional task, combine Internet technology, employee's ability and task difficulty are digitized, and it is realized and is matched by algorithm, only needs will need distributing for task is same to be sent to server to leader, it can be realized by server and reasonably distribute, and during distributing, task and ability equity are realized by algorithm, improve the working efficiency of employee, guarantee task normally completes, and eliminates leader's existing human factor during distributing, and avoids Subjective to task and distributes bring inconvenience.

title_en: Multi-operator cooperative electric automobile distribution network ordered charging control method and device
abstract_en: The method analyzes the charging capacity requirement of a specified period by taking the minimum operation cost as a target through a CSP charging requirement assessment model to obtain a CSP expected charging capacity requirement; sending the obtained CSP expected charging capacity requirement to a DSO, judging whether the total charging capacity requirement of the specified CSP does not exceed the available charging capacity limit of the transformer in the station area, and if the total charging capacity requirement does not exceed the available charging capacity limit of the transformer in the station area, allowing the execution of a charging plan; if the available charging capacity exceeds the available charging capacity of the transformer in the area, introducing a weight coefficient into a maximum-minimum fairness allocation algorithm through an available charging capacity allocation model of the area, and allocating limited available charging capacity of the transformer in the area to the designated CSP; and optimizing and adjusting the designated CSP charging power time sequence by taking available charging capacity of the transformer of the limited distribution area allocated to the CSP as constraint through an EV ordered charging optimization model. The invention effectively avoids overload operation of the transformer in the transformer area.
assignees: UNIV TIANJIN;STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Scoring system for hospital work order report
abstract_en: The invention discloses a scoring system for hospital work order report, which comprises a management end, a comment login module, a work order consulting module, a scoring processing module, a storage database and an interactive display interface. This a scoring system for hospital work order is reported, through being provided with scoring system, utilize the management end to realize the input of data and handle the operation of carrying out the distribution after the back, utilize the work order to consult the module and select the work order, accomplish the consulting operation of producing concrete real-time process to the work order, can withdraw from the score after satisfying the consulting condition, realize the operation of grading and grading calculation at last, in the in-process of realizing the grading, realize checking the definition of real-time process to the commentaries on classics personnel, and carry out the operation of grading after complete consulting, summarize the score numerical value of many different commentaries on classics personnel and carry out average calculation simultaneously, with this fairness of guaranteeing the grading, and make final grading result more accurate.

title_en: Carrier automatic assessment method and system based on big data analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of logistics management, in particular to an automatic assessment method and system for a carrier based on big data analysis, comprising the following steps of S1, data collection and preprocessing, S2, data analysis, S3, complex network analysis and dynamic adjustment, S4, model establishment, S5, automatic assessment, real-time assessment of the carrier through the carrier assessment model, and generation of assessment reports, S6, feedback and optimization, wherein the key performance indexes of the carrier are extracted, the complex network analysis and dynamic adjustment, the key nodes and bottlenecks are identified, the key performance indexes are dynamically adjusted, the model establishment, the carrier assessment model is established, the various indexes of the carrier are comprehensively scored, the real-time assessment of the carrier is carried out through the carrier assessment model, and the assessment reports are generated, and the feedback and optimization are carried out according to the assessment results, the assessment results and the optimization suggestions are fed back to the carrier, and the assessment model is optimized according to the actual performance of the carrier. The invention can reflect the change of external environment in real time and improve the accuracy and fairness of the examination result.
assignees: SICHUAN KUANZHAI SMART LOGISTICS CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent party construction decision optimization method based on multi-source data fusion and virtual simulation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of party construction and big data analysis, and relates to an intelligent party construction decision optimization method based on multi-source data fusion and virtual simulation, which comprises the steps of constructing a standardized behavior data set by integrating multi-source data such as party identity information, activity records, thought report, party membership dues payment and the like; the method comprises the steps of dynamically distributing data weights by adopting a gradient descent method, improving data quality, combining a space-time similarity algorithm and a track prediction model, realizing accurate division and behavior trend prediction of party groups, introducing a virtual simulation technology to simulate party construction scenes, and optimizing propaganda strategies and resource release. The method realizes decision scientization through data driving, remarkably improves group management efficiency, reduces redundancy cost, enhances adaptability of strategies to regional differences, and ensures fairness and transparency of decision execution. The invention provides technical support for intelligent upgrade of the new times of party construction work, and is suitable for party construction management scenes such as party institutions, enterprises and public institutions and the like.
assignees: INF CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Urban rail transit passenger flow control optimization method based on arrival proportion
abstract_en: The invention provides an urban rail transit passenger flow control optimization method based on an arrival proportion. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring urban rail transit network data, and designing a parallel straight line train schedule according to the minimum departure interval of the train; according to the parallel straight line train schedule and urban rail transit network data, a passenger flow control strategy optimization model based on the incoming proportion is established based on set constraint conditions and an objective function; and solving the passenger flow control strategy optimization model based on the arrival proportion by adopting an approximate dynamic programming algorithm based on heuristic decomposition to obtain the arrival quantity of each train at each station under the optimal passenger flow control strategy. From the aspect of passenger arrival fairness, the urban rail transit station arrival flow optimization method under the condition of equal proportion arrival is provided, and the passenger flow fine management and control under the condition of early and late peak crowding is realized.

title_en: Low-altitude economic trusted data processing method and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a low-altitude economy credible data processing method and a storage medium, belonging to the technical field of low-altitude economy and data element circulation. The method comprises the steps of responding to a saproli value calculation instruction, reading low-altitude data corresponding to unmanned aerial vehicles from a block chain for each unmanned aerial vehicle in a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles operating cooperatively in a low-altitude space, determining unmanned aerial vehicle contribution values of the unmanned aerial vehicles according to the low-altitude data, determining alliance contribution values according to the unmanned aerial vehicle contribution values and a first airspace openness correction factor by utilizing a target saproli formula, determining weight coefficients according to the first airspace openness correction factor and an alliance scale, determining target saproli values of the unmanned aerial vehicles according to the alliance contribution values and the weight coefficients, and distributing value to all low-altitude data for each unmanned aerial vehicle according to the target saproli values respectively corresponding to each unmanned aerial vehicle. The technical scheme of the embodiment of the invention can ensure fairness in value allocation for low-altitude data.

title_en: Search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, wherein a transport case is fixedly connected to the lower side of the unmanned aerial vehicle body, a double-output-shaft motor is fixedly connected to the inner side of the transport case, and a first straight gear is fixedly connected to the left side of the double-output-shaft motor. According to the utility model, the transportation box is arranged, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle can carry disaster relief materials, the disaster relief materials are timely distributed, the search and rescue efficiency of the device is improved, the rescue materials are conveniently discharged from the inner side of the transportation box by arranging the movable studs, the search and rescue efficiency of the device is further improved, the disaster relief materials can be clamped through the push plate when the device is transported by arranging the lifting studs, the shaking damage of the disaster relief materials is avoided, and after the device is transported to a disaster relief position, the disaster relief materials can be pushed out through the push plate, so that the search and rescue efficiency of the device is further improved, and the problem that the search and rescue efficiency is reduced due to the fact that the conventional unmanned aerial vehicle cannot rapidly transport disaster relief materials is solved.

title_en: Online reservation and credit system based on block chain
abstract_en: The invention relates to an online reservation and credit system based on a block chain, which utilizes the block chain technology to chain reservation information to form a set of complete credit management and simultaneously provides a real-time determination process to repeatedly inquire the use state of a public resource. Compared with the traditional public resource use management system, the scheme is that the reservation use of the public resource is automatically completed based on the system without manual examination and approval, so that the reservation efficiency is improved and the time flow is saved; on the other hand, the reservation system provided by the scheme does not need manual intervention, ensures good fairness, and avoids the problem of unreasonable resource distribution caused by the social intercourse.
assignees: CHENGDU ZHONGKE DAQSOFT SOFTWARE CO LTD

title_en: Order processing method, system and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses an order processing method, an order processing system, an order processing device and electronic equipment, and relates to the field of the Internet. The method comprises the following steps: the server receives orders sent by a plurality of clients and stores order information; the server analyzes the order information; responding to the order state update, and updating the order state corresponding to the stored order information by the server; the server screens out orders which meet the resource allocation conditions from the orders sent by the clients to serve as target orders; the server creates and executes a resource configuration task for the target order according to the user information of the target order and the resource configuration limit corresponding to the amount information of the target order; the server sends the resource configuration information of the resource configuration task to a plurality of clients; and the client displays the resource configuration information sent by the server. The method improves the conversion rate of the resources to the users under the condition of ensuring the fairness of resource allocation.

title_en: Method and system for evaluating cooperative medical system policy of agriculture and animal husbandry
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for evaluating a medical system policy of agriculture and animal husbandry cooperation, which relate to the technical field of medical insurance system research, and realize accurate allocation of medical resources and personalized assistance by analyzing medical requirements of agriculture and animal husbandry areas and economic conditions of herd and herd people in detail; firstly, by collecting disease data and the balance of herdsmen, the medical self-expense upper limit is customized for the herdsmen with different economic conditions, the accuracy and fairness of medical assistance are enhanced, and then, by analyzing the matching index and the personal self-expense burden index, the reimbursement policy is optimized, the effective utilization of resources is ensured, and the economic burden of the herdsmen is lightened; finally, the constructed adjustment evaluation model improves the flexibility and the instantaneity of policy adjustment, ensures the adaptability and the fairness of the system, promotes the overall improvement of the medical service level, and realizes the fair and efficient medical resource allocation.

title_en: Scheduling plan adjustment method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a scheduling plan adjusting method, device, equipment and medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a to-be-scheduled object input in a scheduling configuration interface, selecting a current shift sequence for the to-be-scheduled object from a preset shift mechanism configured by a shift management service system, obtaining executed times of all preset shifts in the current shift sequence from an attendance data source, determining priority adjustment reference values of all preset shifts according to the executed times of all preset shifts and initial sequence numbers, determining a target ending shift based on the priority adjustment reference values, generating a shift adjustment message for the target ending shift for display, responding to confirmation feedback of the target ending shift, determining a target shift sequence according to the sequence execution sequence between the target ending shift and all preset shifts, and adjusting a shift plan of the to-be-scheduled object. The technical scheme can simplify the scheduling adjustment process and improve the scheduling adjustment efficiency while guaranteeing the fairness and the rationality of scheduling.

title_en: Combat resource scheduling method for incoming targets
abstract_en: The invention discloses a combat resource scheduling method aiming at an attack target, which comprises the following steps: s1, initializing parameters of at least one incoming target; s2, dividing the defense area into a plurality of foot-drop point areas, and sequentially selecting the foot-drop point areas; s3, acquiring the threat degree of an attack target in the selected foothold area based on the parameters; s4, judging whether an attack target in the foot drop point area meets constraint conditions or not based on the threat degree; and S5, allocating defense weapons for the attack targets meeting the constraint conditions to realize the battle resource scheduling. The invention realizes the fairness scheduling of combat resources aiming at defense positions and optimizes firepower distribution by selecting the foothold areas and judging the threat degree of the attack targets in the foothold areas, and the scheduling method is simple and is beneficial to engineering application.

title_en: Construction method of collaborative distribution alliance model based on geographic social network
abstract_en: The invention provides a construction method of a collaborative distribution alliance model based on a geographic social network, which belongs to the technical field of logistics, and comprises the steps of determining decision parameters for constructing the distribution alliance, calculating radiation force of a distribution center, forming a alliance cluster, determining a income distribution index system of the alliance cluster, determining an alliance utility feature function in a income distribution principle of the alliance cluster, and distributing the income of the alliance cluster. The invention relates to a process and a method for constructing a collaborative distribution alliance based on geographic attributes and social attributes, wherein the average radiation radius of a distribution center is planned, and XY coordinates of the distribution center are introduced for clustering, so that a collaborative distribution alliance cluster is obtained. Meanwhile, a revenue distribution mode for forming a alliance on the basis is formulated, and a collaborative distribution alliance benefit revenue distribution index with economic attributes, geographic attributes and social attributes is constructed. Equitable reasonable distribution alliance income promotes alliance stability. The method and the system promote the demand integration of distribution enterprises, improve the resource allocation efficiency and reduce the distribution cost.

title_en: Urban raw water supply allocation path identification method, system and storable medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system and a storable medium for identifying a water supply allocation path of urban raw water, which relate to the technical field of water supply allocation and comprise the following steps: generalizing the urban raw water system, and dividing the urban raw water system into a supply community and a demand community based on a complex network theory; classifying the computing nodes in the supply communities according to the water supply topological relation, and providing a control strategy; according to the category of the computing node, carrying out feasible path recognition by combining engineering capability; and judging according to the operation working condition and engineering capacity of the computing node to generate a water quantity allocation scheme. The invention can calculate water quantity allocation feasible paths aiming at different water quantity allocation targets and generate a water quantity allocation scheme according to the operation conditions of pump stations and gate engineering, thereby providing reference for urban water supply allocation preview and planning and laying a foundation for intelligent management of urban water supply.

title_en: Task dispatch method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a task dispatching method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining at least one user to receive a task corresponding to a task request in a preset range of a task place under the condition of receiving the task request; determining index parameters corresponding to each user based on preset indexes, wherein the index parameters comprise weight values and historical index values of each index, determining the grading value of each user through a good-bad solution distance method according to the index parameters corresponding to each user, and sending a task corresponding to the task request to the user with the highest grading value according to the grading value. The embodiment ensures fairness of task dispatch.

title_en: Method and system for preventing conflict in on-line examination time period
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a system for preventing conflict in an on-machine examination time period, which comprise the steps of obtaining real-time examination reservation requests of examinees, recording time periods of each examination reservation request, predicting examinee flow and examination room resource requirements during examination based on the real-time examination reservation requests and a mixed prediction model, obtaining prediction results, dynamically adjusting the examination time periods to generate time period distribution results, optimizing the time period distribution results by utilizing a multi-objective optimization algorithm, generating a preliminary examination time period distribution scheme, detecting whether the preliminary examination time period distribution scheme has time conflict or not by utilizing a real-time monitoring mechanism, and adjusting the preliminary examination time period distribution scheme based on the severity of the time conflict to obtain a conflict-free examination schedule, so that examination scheduling efficiency and fairness are improved.

title_en: Examination seat arrangement method and system based on intelligent examination table
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent education equipment and examination management, in particular to an examination seat arrangement method and system based on an intelligent examination table, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting environmental data through the intelligent examination table and generating an environmental characteristic matrix by combining an implicit perception technology; dividing examination room areas based on quantum dot distribution models, optimizing seat distribution through reinforcement learning to generate optimized seat distribution data, completing identity verification of an examinee by utilizing a multi-mode verification module, binding the verification data with the optimized seat distribution data, unlocking an examination interface and loading examination tasks. The invention effectively improves the fairness and the intellectualization level of the seat allocation of the examination room, realizes the preferential allocation of special demand examination workers and the dynamic management of the examination process, and has remarkable reliability and convenience.

title_en: Multi-agent reinforcement learning-based multi-mode intermodal route selection method
abstract_en: The application relates to a multi-agent reinforcement learning-based multi-mode intermodal route selection method. The method comprises the steps of constructing a multi-agent intermodal transportation network and a system environment, carrying out initial planning by adopting a self-adaptive large neighborhood search algorithm based on the multi-agent intermodal transportation network and the system environment, acquiring accident information when an accident occurs, optimizing the initial planning by adopting a multi-agent reinforcement learning algorithm based on the accident information and a cost objective function to obtain an accident action decision, and carrying out transportation tasks based on the accident action decision. By constructing a large neighborhood disturbance response mechanism fused with ALNS, when the node/path service time deviation is detected to exceed a threshold value, the intelligent trigger path reconstruction is performed, a new alternative path is generated, based on a MADDPG multi-Agent reinforcement learning framework, each carrier Agent can obtain global information in centralized training, independent decision is made in execution, and the utilization efficiency of transportation resources and the task allocation fairness are effectively improved.

title_en: Real-time Sharing Method of Cargo Transportation Information through Cargo Information Sharing Community centered on Cloud Hub with the Enforced State Change Adaptability and Allocation Stability
title_ko: 강화된 상태 변화 적응성 및 안정성을 구비한 클라우드 허브 중심의 화물정보 공유 커뮤니티를 통한 화물 운송 정보의 실시간 공유 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a real-time freight transportation information sharing method through a freight information sharing community centered on a cloud hub and, more particularly, to a real-time freight transportation information sharing method through a freight information sharing community, capable of increasing the dispatch efficiency of freight transportation vehicles using location-based services by enabling shippers, freight forwarders, carriers, and drivers of freight vehicles, who are members constituting a freight transportation system, to mutually share the freight information or the like in real time in the sharing community centered on the cloud hub, and obtaining dispatch fairness and stability while increasing adaptability for a state which is changed in real time.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 클라우드 허브 중심의 화물정보 공유 커뮤니티를 통한 화물 운송 정보의 실시간 공유 방법에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 클라우드 허브를 중심으로 구성되는 화물정보 공유 커뮤니티를 활용하여 커뮤니티 내의 화물 정보 등을 화물운송체계를 구성하는 구성원이 되는 화주, 주선사업자, 운송업자, 화물차 기사 등이 실시간으로 상호 공유하여 위치기반서비스를 이용한 화물 운송 차량의 배차 효율의 향상시키고 아울러 실시간으로 변화되는 상태 변화에 대한 적응성을 높이도록 하면서도 배차 공정성 및 안정성을 확보할 수 있도록 하는 화물정보 공유 커뮤니티를 통한 화물 운송 정보의 실시간 공유 방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Intelligent vehicle scheduling method based on time satisfaction degree algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent vehicle scheduling method based on a time satisfaction degree algorithm, and belongs to the technical field of computers. In the conventional manual vehicle scheduling operation, vehicle scheduling personnel needs to manually fill up the names of a large quantity of transport products, the queue number of a current transport vehicle is memorized accurately by means of an Excel table or the conventional office tools, and vehicle transport products cannot be arranged in real time according to the characteristics of industrial enterprises, leading to poor instantaneity and poor flexibility. According to the method, assembly operation numbers are intelligently allocated to scheduling vehicles by setting important information such as product names and reservation numbers, and the transport sequence and quantity are adjusted in real time according to the current vehicle running situation, so that the fairness is ensured, and the efficiency is increased.
assignees: ZHENJIANG JINRUAN COMP TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Ant colony algorithm-based emergency medical material distribution optimization method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an ant colony algorithm-based emergency medical material distribution optimization method based on an area-group concept, k-means clustering, an ant colony algorithm, a fair algorithm and a binary expression mode. Firstly, classifying by adopting k-means clustering according to coordinates of distribution points; secondly, further classifying the load capacity of the distribution vehicle by utilizing binary full traversal; then, determining a group distribution path by adopting an ant colony algorithm; the calculation amount is reduced by sequentially returning and judging the satisfied condition and setting the parameter; and finally, giving out a specific distribution scheme by adopting a fairness algorithm according to the emergency. The whole steps are simple and clear, and the method has great application value in the field of emergency medical logistics distribution.

title_en: Method for evaluating equity investment risk of power grid provincial industry
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of risk assessment, discloses a method for assessing the equity investment risk of a power grid management industry, which comprises the steps of identifying equity investment risk types by a system, defining main influencing factors of different risks, constructing a GDP growth prediction model based on ARIMA, forming a market risk quantitative assessment standard formulation, constructing a load prediction model based on SAO optimization LSTM, forming an operation risk quantitative assessment standard formulation, constructing an operation risk grade assessment model based on Markov and LS-SVM, realizing operation risk quantitative assessment standard formulation, applying a neural network model, realizing scientific setting of market risk, operation risk and operation risk scoring weight, and obtaining a final risk assessment result.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic space-time supply and demand adaptation-based fair transaction method and system for computing power resources
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of server resource management and transaction, but is not limited to, and discloses a server resource fair transaction method and a system based on dynamic space-time supply and demand adaptation, wherein in a computing resource market, computing resource supply provides computing resources for a computing matching transaction platform, and a utility function of a computing provider is utilized to optimize computing supply strategies; in the transaction flow, an algorithm force resource demand party submits a resource application to an algorithm force matching transaction platform according to the real-time demand of a calculation task, and an utility function of the algorithm force resource demand party is utilized to enable the algorithm force resource demand party to obtain an algorithm force resource meeting the calculation time delay demand, and meanwhile, the payment cost is ensured to be in a reasonable range. The invention improves the transaction efficiency by optimizing the resource allocation of the server and ensures the fairness of supply and demand.
assignees: GUANGZHOU RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF XIDIAN UNIV;GUANGZHOU YUNQU INFORMATION TECH CO LTD;UNIV XIDIAN;GUANGZHOU LIANRONG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Emission trading product and method
abstract_en: The present invention provides a system and method for determining equivalency factors for use in comparative performance analysis of industrial facilities by determining a target variable and a plurality of characteristics of the target variable. Each of the plurality of characteristics is ranked according to value. Based on ranking value, the characteristics are divided into categories. Based on the sorted and ranked characteristics, a data collection classification system is developed. Data is collected according to the data collection classification system. The data is validated, and based on the data, an analysis model is developed. The analysis model then calculates the equivalency factors for use in one embodiment in performance measurement and equitable benchmarking of green house gas (GHG) emissions from industrial facilities for the purposes of allocating GHG emission allowances for permits, licenses, etc. Furthermore, a system and method is described for quantifying, transferring, managing, underwriting, or insuring the risk associated with emissions from manufacturing, operating a facility, or engaging in an activity that emits, produces, or potentially emits or produces permitted or regulated emissions. In addition to insuring against emissions that exceed permitted or regulated amounts, a system for pooling, managing, and trading emission credits is also described herein.
assignees: HSB SOLOMON ASSOCIATES LLC;TROUT WILLIAM L;BROADFOOT ROBERT;HILEMAN MICHAEL;JONES RICHARD

title_en: Fair assessment method for traditional taxi and network appointment service in peak time
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fairness evaluation method for traditional taxi and network taxi appointment services in peak hours, which is characterized in that fairness in general meaning for population and employment is estimated by introducing a Lorentz curve and a Keyny coefficient, and then a mixed geographic weighted regression model and a variation coefficient are used for estimating service fairness of taxies and fairness changes caused by network taxi appointment entering under the condition of comprehensively considering resident demands and activity capacity; the combination of the two methods can effectively estimate the service fairness of the taxi in the peak period and the change of the taxi service fairness caused by the occurrence of the taxi appointment. The evaluation process is relatively simple, the result is more accurate, and certain guiding significance and reference value are provided for further traffic scheduling or market operation.

title_en: Urban public sports space fairness measurement method based on multi-source urban data
abstract_en: The invention provides a city public sports space fairness measurement method based on multi-source city data, which comprises the following steps: main data such as residential building outlines, sports spaces, public transit stops POIs, urban road networks, public critique and the like are obtained; carrying out corresponding cleaning and classification treatment on the data, and then establishing a database in an ArcGIS; setting urban residents to conduct measure evaluation on fairness of urban public sports space by taking walking, bus running and public transportation as main travel modes, taking life circle concepts as limiting conditions and taking an ArcGIS network analysis module as a technical means; and carrying out public sports space fairness measure on the specific city to obtain a visual and quantifiable result. The method has the advantages that the obtained result is fine and accurate, the current situation of public sports space distribution can be effectively estimated, and the method can be used as reference information for urban sports space development planning.

title_en: System and method for graph-based resource allocation using neural networks
abstract_en: A method for using a neural network to generate an improved graph model includes receiving, by the neural network, a graph model. The graph model is based on data relating to an environment for allocating resources to a first group and a second group. The method further includes receiving, by the neural network, a budget for editing the graph model based on a cost of corresponding modification to the environment, and determining, by the neural network, a fairness representation based on a fairness requirement between the first and second groups. It is determined by the neural network, a utility function for the graph model based on first and second group utilities representing resource allocation to the first and second groups respectively. Reinforcement learning is performed on the neural network to generate the improved graph model using the utility function and the fairness representation.

title_en: System for allocating advertising inventory in a unified marketplace
abstract_en: An advertisement impression distribution system includes a data processing system operable to generate an allocation plan for serving advertisement impressions. The allocation plan allocates a first portion of advertisement impressions to satisfy guaranteed demand and a second portion of advertisement impressions to satisfy non-guaranteed demand. The data processing system includes an optimizer to establish a relationship between the first portion and the second portion. The relationship defines a range of possible proportions of allocation of the first portion and the second portion. The optimizer generates indicia in accordance with maximizing guaranteed demand fairness or representativeness, maximizing non-guaranteed revenue, and minimizing under-delivery penalties, where the indicia indentifies a determined proportion of the first portion to serve and a determined proportion of the second portion to serve. The data processing system outputs the allocation plan including the indicia to control serving of the advertisement impressions in the determined proportions.

title_en: For the Express firm city distribution method under demand blowout
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of Express firm city distribution methods under blowout for demand, comprising steps of (1) visits and investigates related electric business, acquire the order volume under the blowout of electric business demand, based on big data information, analyze the characteristics of City Object dispense under demand blowout situation and there are the problem of；(2) using distribution time, distribution cost, dispatching three indexs of fairness as target, with the path planning model of mathematical modeling building multiple target, optimal Distribution path is obtained；(3) judgment matrix that 3 targets compare two-by-two is constructed with analytic hierarchy process (AHP), the relative weighting for being haggled over element is calculated by judgment matrix, determines the weight of each optimization aim；(4) its city distribution model is solved using multiple target heuritic approach；The present invention proposes the optimization strategy in the case of demand blowout by the modeling and optimization in the city distribution path to express delivery, promotes service ability of the Express firm under demand blowout situation.

title_en: Method and device for configuring incentive data of financial products, computer equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of financial data processing of block chains, and discloses a method and a device for configuring incentive data of financial products, computer equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining an intelligent contract for a financial product configured based on a blockchain, the intelligent contract comprising incentivized allocation rules and mining rules for the financial product; acquiring the order quantity of financial products of a user, and converting the order quantity into a calculation force value according to a preset calculation force rule; performing excitation excavation based on the excavation rule according to the calculated force value to obtain a first number of excitations; acquiring the issuing quantity corresponding to the incentive according to the distribution rule; acquiring distributable value data of the financial product, and determining the target value of the incentive according to the distributable value data and the release quantity; and generating the value data of the user according to the target value and the first quantity. The method and the device can improve fairness and accuracy of financial product incentive data distribution.
assignees: PING AN LIFE INSURANCE CO CHINA LTD

title_en: Distributed generator and user electric energy trading method based on block chain platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed generator and user electric energy trading method based on a blockchain platform, which is a method for sharing local electric energy and fully utilizing distributed energy by adopting point-to-point (P2P) market trading operation, and simultaneously, the distributed generator and the user can carry out self-management operation through a reasonable trading mechanism, thereby avoiding the problems of complex operation and information and trading safety in matching trading, and being very suitable for distributed power supply trading. In addition, the block chain technology is introduced in the process, the method has the advantage of short decision time when the multilateral transaction runs, and the influence of the selfishness of the electricity purchasing and selling parties on the transaction fairness and the user privacy can be effectively solved. The invention provides a distributed generator and user electric energy trading method based on a blockchain platform, which ensures the balance of income and expenditure of enterprises and solves the problem that the existing electric power market trading platform is not safe enough, establishes a social welfare maximization model, introduces the blockchain platform into the electric power market trading, and depends on a P2P trading system, thereby not only maintaining the safety of trading, but also reducing the risk of exposing the privacy information of two parties of trading.
assignees: TAIZHOU POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF ZHEJIANG PROVINCE ELECTRIC POWER LTD COMPANY OF STATE GRID;NAT ELECTRICITY NANYI NANJING CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD;SOUTHERY SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Fairness-oriented crowdsourcing tester recommendation method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fairness-oriented crowdsourcing tester recommending method and device, which comprises the steps of expressing the requirement description of a crowdsourcing task as a descriptive term vector; predicting the defect detection probability of each person to be recommended in the crowdsourcing task according to the descriptive term vector and the attribute information of the person to be recommended; and setting a plurality of fairness targets including the maximum defect discovery probability and the minimum recommendation frequency difference, performing multi-objective optimization, and obtaining the recommendation result of crowdsourcing testers. The invention can reduce unfair problems and generate fairer recommendations, and the method of the invention does not influence the defect detection efficiency on the basis of generating fairer recommendations and also improves the defect detection efficiency.

title_en: Metering method, metering device and metering equipment for classified load electric quantity of distributed photovoltaic power generation
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a metering method, a metering device and metering equipment for classified load electric quantity of distributed photovoltaic power generation. The specific implementation mode of the method comprises the following steps: setting electric quantity metering points for each distributed photovoltaic power generation mode respectively; determining an operation mode of the load electric quantity of the distributed photovoltaic power generation user in response to determining that the classified power load exists; based on the determined operation mode, calculating the electric quantity of each electric quantity metering point corresponding to the determined operation mode; and determining the classified electricity load electric quantity of the distributed photovoltaic power generation user based on the electric quantity of each electric quantity metering point. The embodiment realizes the accuracy of classified electricity load metering, and further realizes the accuracy of classified electricity price electricity load metering, thereby meeting the requirement of metering fairness and fairness.
assignees: State Grid Chongqing Electric Power Company Marketing Service Center;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Rights and interests distribution method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a rights and interests distribution method, device, equipment and storage medium, which can be applied to the field of artificial intelligence or finance. The method comprises the following steps: obtaining a budget allocation model; the budget allocation model is used for deciding allocation information of the equity budgets; optimizing a budget allocation model based on an improved strength pareto evolution algorithm to output optimal decision results of rights and interests budget allocation to a plurality of channels; when determining the user to be assigned with the rights and interests, determining the types of the rights and interests to be assigned with the user based on the rights and interests sensitivity of the user; the rights and interests sensitivity of the user is obtained by solving a Lagrange relaxation algorithm based on a sub-gradient method; and determining the category of the rights to be allocated and the optimal decision result as a rights allocation scheme. Thus, the rights issuing channel and the issuing category can be flexibly and comprehensively considered.

title_en: Port safety production responsibility insurance rate optimization method under multi-factor influence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a port safety production responsibility insurance rate optimization method under the influence of multiple factors, which comprises the steps of analyzing historical accident cases to obtain risk factor groups, constructing a judgment matrix, calculating a characteristic vector corresponding to the maximum characteristic root of the judgment matrix to obtain each risk factor weight, determining each node risk association function according to the flow relation of a port network topology structure and the risk factor weight, further obtaining position weight, determining risk factors by combining the controllable degree of the risk factors, constructing an insurance rate calculation model of each node, adding uncertain disturbance items to form a risk evolution model, acquiring an accident cause chain set, determining an insurance rate scheme set, and finally selecting a scheme of balancing the fairness of the insurance rates and the capital income rate from the set. The method can scientifically price by comprehensively considering various factors, gives consideration to fairness and income, improves the reasonability and risk management and control level of the port safety production responsibility insurance rate, and has better interpretability.

title_en: Storage facilities for emergency relief supplies
abstract_en: A method of community service including placing a storage structure at a strategic location for direct distribution of emergency relief supplies from the storage structure to a populace in the event of an actual disaster. In addition the method includes marketing advertising on the storage structure.

title_en: A kind of right of drainage configuration method based on double plating layer
abstract_en: The right of drainage configuration method based on double plating layer that the invention discloses a kind of, efficiency principle is taken into account on the basis of considering regional economy development degree, the fairness doctrine of history displacement including (1), constructs and double plating layer is configured based on fair and efficiency right of drainage；(2) right of drainage allocation models is solved with the leader follower strategy interactive mode iterative algorithm based on satisfaction, right of drainage configuration is carried out according to solving result.The present invention is on the basis of considering influence that the factors such as social environment, economic environment, ecological environment and dewatering needs, drainage efficiency distribute right of drainage, it constructs fair weigh with area sewerage under Efficiency Perspective and configures double plating layer, realization basin comprehensive benefit is maximized and optimized, it reduces flood, promote each department balanced development, the distribution for carrying out area sewerage power is of great significance.

title_en: Charging station pricing method considering vehicle, station and network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the electric power system technology, in particular to a charging station pricing method considering three parties of a vehicle, a station and a network, which comprises the steps of establishing an optimal power flow model of a power distribution network by taking the minimum load fluctuation as a target; establishing a charging station ordered charging scheduling model with the maximum income of the charging station as a target; establishing an electric vehicle user decision model by taking the minimum charging cost as a target; converting a vehicle, station and network three-party game model into a single-layer optimization model through a master-slave game model; converting the single-layer optimization model into a convex optimization model through a second-order cone relaxation and polyhedron approximation strategy; and solving the convex optimization model for multiple times by a standard quantization method to obtain a vehicle, station and network three-party game equilibrium solution, thereby formulating the charging price. The method provides a fair pricing method, so that the fairness of the charging electric energy trading market can be improved, the ordered interaction of electric vehicle users, charging station operators and distribution network operators is promoted, and the win-win of three parties of a vehicle, a station and a network is realized.

title_en: Distribution algorithm for subjective examination question reader of examination
abstract_en: The invention discloses an assignment algorithm for subjective examination question readers, belongs to the technical field of examination question assignment algorithms, and aims to provide an assignment algorithm for subjective examination question readers, wherein a mode of mutual evaluation by students is innovatively provided, namely, examinees mutually evaluate answer sheets, fairness and effectiveness are guaranteed when the subjective examination paper readers are assigned, a teacher only needs to set certain examination paper reading parameters, and the algorithm can assign corresponding examination paper readers to the subjective examination paper answers according to the parameters. After successful distribution of the reader, students can read the examination papers, and the problems that teachers read a large number of examination papers and the workload is too large are solved. The flexibility and the participation degree of the examination activities are effectively improved, the burden of teachers is relieved, and students can deepen the understanding of the examination contents in the examination reading process. The method is suitable for the distribution algorithm of examination subjective question examiners.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle network resource allocation method for urban neighborhood emergency communication
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle network resource allocation method for urban block emergency communication, and belongs to the technical field of wireless communication. The method firstly provides a layered rate division multiple access transmission model to cope with communication interference in a cell and among cells, converts the resource allocation problem of an unmanned aerial vehicle network into an optimization problem of combining multiple unmanned aerial vehicle deployment positions, precoding and rate allocation to maximize the minimum user accessibility, and then solves the optimization problem based on a rapid simulated annealing algorithm to obtain the unmanned aerial vehicle network deployment positions, precoding and rate allocation. The method solves the problems that a plurality of air-ground links are seriously interfered by communication and the communication links are blocked by obstacles, can ensure the fairness coverage of urban ground user communication service, improves the communication capacity of the system, and realizes the efficient resource allocation of the unmanned aerial vehicle network in the urban street environment.

title_en: Energy station energy supply allocation method and equipment based on energy utilization data of preset time period
abstract_en: The invention provides an energy supply allocation method and equipment for an energy station based on energy consumption data of a preset time period. The method comprises the following steps: determining energy utilization data indexes and limiting functions of the energy utilization data indexes in a preset time period, and constructing an energy utilization data curve according to the energy utilization data indexes; constructing a polymerization degree evaluation function of the energy consumption data curve, and repeatedly polymerizing and optimizing the energy consumption data curve to obtain a plurality of polymerization schemes; if the polymerization degree evaluation function of one polymerization scheme is strictly better than that of other polymerization schemes after optimization, determining the one polymerization scheme as the final optimized polymerization scheme using the energy data curve; and determining energy production quotas of the energy stations in different time periods according to the final optimized polymerization scheme. The invention can ensure accurate energy production of the energy station, lighten the resource waste in the energy production, ensure the economical efficiency and the environmental protection of energy supply production of the energy station and finally realize the balance and the optimization of energy supply of the energy station.
assignees: TIANJIN TIANCHUANG GREEN ENERGY INVESTMENT MAN CO LTD;TIANJIN JIAYUANXING INNOVATION ENERGY TECH CO LTD;TIANJIN CAPITAL ENVIRONMENTAL PROT GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Model construction method for urban rail emergency facility site selection-distribution problem
abstract_en: The invention relates to a model construction method for address selection-allocation problems of urban rail emergency facilities, and belongs to the field of address selection and planning of emergency facilities. The method comprises the steps of S1, assessment of site vulnerability parameters, S2, establishment of site selection and material distribution strategies of urban rail emergency facilities, S3, symbolic definition of parameters and decision variables, S4, construction of a two-stage site selection-distribution model under uncertain transportation time, and S5, dynamic site selection and material distribution of the facilities. The method is used for solving the technical problems that the existing urban rail transit lacks reasonable layout of emergency facilities, has low material distribution efficiency and fairness and has insufficient flexibility for coping with disaster change when coping with storm flood disasters.

title_en: Task configuration method, device, system, storage medium and computer equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a task configuration method, a device, a system, a storage medium and computer equipment, and relates to the technical field of Internet. The method comprises the following steps: receiving a task configuration request, wherein the task configuration request carries a task issuer identification of a target task, a task type and a resource configuration limit; matching a target integrating pool and/or target equity resources for the target task according to the task issuer identification and the task type, wherein the target integrating pool is configured with at least one equity resource; and allocating the points and/or the target equity resources in the target point pool to the target task according to the resource allocation limit so as to complete the allocation of the target task. The method improves the efficiency of task configuration, omits screening time when the task publisher manually configures resources, improves the accuracy of task configuration, meets the task configuration requirements of the task publisher, and enables the resources of target task configuration to have diversity and pertinence.

title_en: Personnel scheduling method and device for changing electricity of shared electric bicycle and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a personnel scheduling method, a device and electronic equipment for changing the power of a shared electric bicycle, wherein the historical task amount occupation ratio of each area to be changed is determined according to the obtained total historical task amount and each second historical task amount; wherein the total historical task amount is the sum of each second historical task amount; aiming at each waiting person, determining the expected pickup probability of the waiting person for each waiting area according to the acquired first historical task quantity of the waiting person in each waiting area; and determining a scheduling result corresponding to the to-be-scheduled staff based on the historical task amount duty ratio of each to-be-scheduled area and each expected pickup probability corresponding to the to-be-scheduled staff. According to the method, the final scheduling result is determined according to the expected pickup probability of the to-be-scheduled staff and the historical task amount ratio of the to-be-scheduled power exchange area, and the fairness of distribution of the to-be-scheduled power exchange area and the to-be-scheduled staff can be improved by integrating the task amount of the to-be-scheduled staff and the task amount of the to-be-scheduled power exchange area.
assignees: ZHEJIANG LIUBIKE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: User resource scheduling method, system and storage medium based on multi-agent reinforcement learning framework
