abstract_en: The invention relates to a user resource scheduling method, a system and a storage medium based on a multi-agent reinforcement learning framework, wherein the method comprises the following steps: formalizing a target application scene and constructing a basic mode of resource scheduling; describing user work logic by using a state machine idea based on discrete time sequence, and taking the user work logic as a basis for operation of a scheduling algorithm; constructing a reinforcement learning algorithm frame, and defining a standardized observation space for reinforcement learning agents; the reinforcement learning agent makes a decision in the action space according to the observation index, and calculates a reward function; designing a strategy function and a cost function matched with the observation space of the agent based on a performer-criticizing home framework; and finishing the training and deployment of the decision model, and carrying out user resource scheduling. The invention can more intelligently cope with complex resource scheduling scenes, reasonably distributes resources between the dominant users and the inferior users, and greatly improves the fairness of resource scheduling on the premise of ensuring the total utilization rate of the resources to be basically unchanged.

title_en: Multi-main body energy system guaranteed capacity distribution method, device and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device and a medium for distributing the guaranteed capacity of a multi-main body energy system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: establishing a calculation model of the guaranteed capacity of each benefit body; determining constraint conditions of the guaranteed capacity calculation model, and taking the maximum guaranteed capacity of the system in a scheduling period as an objective function; and introducing a Nash negotiation theory to unify the cooperative wish of multiple benefit subjects, establishing a wind-light-water multi-subject guaranteed capacity allocation model based on the Nash negotiation theory, excavating the speaking right characteristics of the individuals through a continuous multi-stage negotiation process, endowing different negotiation positions to a game player, and ensuring the fairness and pareto optimality of the cooperative residual allocation. The invention improves the stable power generation capacity of the wind-light-water multi-body energy system, and ensures the fair distribution of the capacity increment of the system on the premise of realizing unspecified cooperation individuals.

title_en: Power grid emergency material intelligent supply chain dynamic allocation and priority ordering method based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for dynamically adjusting and prioritizing an intelligent supply chain of power grid emergency supplies based on reinforcement learning, which relates to the technical field of power grid emergency management and intelligent supply chains, in particular to a method for dynamically adjusting and prioritizing an intelligent supply chain of power grid emergency supplies based on reinforcement learning, comprising the steps of constructing a digital twin environment model integrating geographic information, real-time traffic, inventory status and fault prediction; defining a reinforcement learning framework, wherein a state space covers stock, in-transit materials, demand urgency and traffic states, an action space comprises material allocation instructions and task priority ordering, a reward function synthesizes shortage relief, delivery timeliness and cost, and a strategy network capable of outputting optimal dynamic allocation strategies is obtained through training an intelligent agent. The invention realizes intelligent dynamic allocation and priority optimization of emergency materials, and effectively improves the emergency response efficiency and resource utilization rate of the power grid.
assignees: MAT BRANCH OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: A kind of decision-making technique of uncertain emergency materials distribution
abstract_en: The present invention is a kind of decision-making technique of uncertain emergency materials distribution, mainly for the initial stage occurred in extensive accident, in the case of Disaster degree, material requirements and road condition are uncertain fuzzy quantity, fuzzy decision Element Theory is expanded into uncertain fuzzy decision Element Theory, to support decision under uncertainty index.On this basis, using fairness, benefit and feasibility as principle, index Design is carried out to emergency materials allocation unit decision system, so that science quickly determines that emergent life is required assistance the allocative decisions of goods and materials between multiple disaster-stricken points so that first batch of life rescue goods and materials can play maximum utility.The present invention in the case of relevant information is uncertain, science decision method can be provided for the quick allocative decision for determining life rescue goods and materials in multiple disaster areas in initial stage of disasters.

title_en: Ticket processing method and device
abstract_en: The application discloses a resource processing method and a device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a resource request sent by a terminal, wherein the resource request carries resource information to be acquired and identity identification information of a resource object requesting resources; acquiring performance conditions reflecting behavior characteristics of the resource object in the resource service platform based on the identity identification information of the resource object; when the performance status shows that the resource object has the first type of behavior characteristics, generating a resource locking certificate according to the resource information; and returning the resource locking voucher to the terminal. The scheme of the application can realize more reasonable resource distribution, reduce the condition of resource waste and be favorable for improving the fairness of resource acquisition.

title_en: Case allocation method, system, medium and electronic device based on knowledge graph
abstract_en: The invention provides a case distribution method, a case distribution system, a case distribution medium and electronic equipment based on a knowledge graph, wherein the court case balanced distribution method comprises the following steps: acquiring basic information required by case distribution, and extracting judge information and case information from the basic information; constructing a knowledge graph based on the judge information and the case information; the knowledge graph comprises a plurality of nodes influencing case division and node relations; and constructing a matching function of the judge and the case based on the knowledge graph, acquiring an optimal solution of the matching function, and distributing the case based on the optimal solution. According to the invention, the case allocation in the court is optimized by constructing the knowledge graph and combining with integer programming, the relationship among the factors influencing the case allocation is visually displayed, the working quality and the working efficiency of the court are improved, the data processing personnel can be intelligently and auxiliarily guided to more accurately provide the main information of judges and cases, and the case allocation fairness and the case allocation efficiency of the case allocation personnel are improved.

title_en: Supporting evaluation and optimization method for primary school infrastructure in area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a supporting evaluation and optimization method of primary school infrastructure in an area, which comprises the steps of measuring and calculating shortest talent time of a kilometer grid, measuring and calculating shortest talent time of administrative areas such as county/village and town, evaluating fairness of educational resources in the Qinghai-Tibet plateau area on a space level by adopting a coefficient of a foundation, evaluating comprehensive cost of educational service, identifying a preferential layout area of the educational facility and optimizing the space layout of the Qinghai-Tibet plateau educational facility. According to the method, the average education expense cost of students, the average teacher index of the students and the average study time cost are integrated to evaluate the education integrated cost of each administrative unit, a differential configuration target is provided according to population density and integrated cost characteristics, and an area which does not reach the target is identified as a priority layout area and layout optimization is performed. Can provide scientific basis for the targeted realization of the space optimal allocation of the primary facilities of Qinghai-Tibet plateau.

title_en: Construction method of unified scheduling universal model of load side response resources of virtual power plant
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power systems and energy management, and discloses a universal model construction method for unified scheduling of load side response resources of a virtual power plant. The method comprises the steps of firstly collecting and standardizing multi-source heterogeneous data such as industrial loads, commercial buildings, residential electricity, vehicle network interaction, controllable air conditioners and heat pumps, distributed energy storage, distributed new energy sources and the like, then generating a counterfactual load track and rebound risk priori under different excitation and constraint conditions based on causal structure learning, realizing micro description of multidimensional adjustable power and uncertainty by constructing response form tensors and flexible envelope surfaces, completing cross-main body representation alignment of privacy protection under a federal learning framework, and injecting proving type safety constraints of power grid safety, user comfort and market rules. The method can realize unified modeling and flexible scheduling of the load side response resources on the premise of ensuring the safety of the power grid and the user experience, and has the comprehensive advantages of privacy protection, economy, fairness, compliance and the like.
assignees: BEIJING JINGNENG DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for distributing profit of aggregate in consideration of comprehensive contribution in electric-carbon-green evidence market
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric power systems, in particular to a method for distributing the profit of an aggregate, which considers comprehensive contribution in the electric-carbon-green evidence market, and comprises the following steps of S1, collecting and preprocessing operation data of an aggregate on external and internal resources, S2, constructing output, cost and carbon emission models of wind power, photovoltaic, gas turbines, energy storage and controllable loads, S3, constructing and solving a profit maximization model considering the profit of the electric-carbon-green evidence market and multiple constraints, S4, distributing the first profit based on a Shapley value method, S5, distributing the second time by combining group contribution degree, responsivity and credibility, and introducing a ladder pumping strategy to optimize the profit of the aggregate. According to the invention, through multi-market collaborative optimization, fair distribution based on Shapley values and an excitation mechanism driven by comprehensive contribution, the collaborative unification of aggregate gain maximization, member gain distribution fairness and response performance excitation is realized.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA POWER GROUP MENGDIAN ECONOMIC TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER UNIV BAODING

title_en: Micro-grid group optimization operation method based on conditional risk value and Nash negotiation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a microgrid group optimization operation method based on conditional risk value and Nash negotiation, which is applied to the technical field of multi-microgrid optimization operation regulation and control. The method comprises the steps of constructing a double-layer energy management bidding model based on a conditional risk value CVaR model and improved Nash negotiation, converting the double-layer energy management bidding model into a single-layer mixed integer linear programming model by adopting a KKT condition and Big-M method, and solving the converted single-layer mixed integer linear programming model by utilizing a CPLEX solver to finish operation optimization of a micro-grid group. The method can improve the order and rationality of energy interaction among the micro-grid groups, and ensure the fairness of benefit distribution while realizing the maximization of social benefit.

title_en: System and method for managing resources on wireless communication network
title_ko: 무선 통신망의 자원 관리 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: A system and a method for managing resources in a wireless communication network are provided to increase the utilization of resources in order to maximize a service provider's interests, to efficiently allocate resources in order to increase user fairness, and to encourage users to increase the utilization of resources voluntarily. A resource manager(12A) in a common node, such as an AP(Access Point) which communicates with a client node(20A), comprises a resource cost calculation part(102) and a resource allocation part(106). The cost calculation part receives the first weight, which is based on the state of a channel allocated to the client node, and the second weight, which is based on the client node user's willingness, from the client node and calculates resource cost for the client node. As the client node calculates the volume of necessary resources in order to optimize the calculated resource cost and makes a request for them, the resource allocation part allocates the requested resources to the client node.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 통신 시스템의 자원관리 방법에 관한 것으로, 특히 다수의 가입자들 사이에 공정성과 자원 이용률을 높이기 위하여 통신 시스템의 자원을 효율적으로 배분하는 자원관리 방법이 제공된다. 본 발명에 따르면 자원 이용률 제고(提高)를 위한 것으로 고객 노드에 할당된 채널 상태에 기초한 제1 가중치와, 사용자 공정성 제고를 위한 것으로 고객 노드 사용자의 자발적 지불의사(willingness to pay)에 기초한 제2 가중치를 각각 정의하고 이들을 이용하여 각 고객 노드에 대한 자원 코스트(cost)를 산출하며, 산출된 자원 코스트를 최적화하는 방향으로 자원 필요량을 조정하는 알고리즘을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 이에 따라, 다수의 가입자들 사이에 공정성과 자원 이용률을 높이고, 특정 사용자의 자원 독점을 방지하며, 사용자의 자발적인 의사에 따라 자원 이용률을 높이도록 유도하는 효율적인 자원관리 방법을 제공할 수 있다. 
     
     자원 이용률, 자원할당, 자원분배, 자원관리, starvation

title_en: Water resource allocation scheme decision method and system based on multi-main-body game
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water resource allocation scheme decision method and system based on multi-main game, and relates to the technical and method field of water resource management. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a water resource allocation scheme set of a research area, calculating water utilization benefits of multiple subjects, calculating water utilization fairness of the multiple subjects, determining a allocation scheme preference matrix of the multiple subjects, analyzing a allocation scheme negotiation space of the multiple subjects, carrying out multi-subject negotiation based on group decision game, and determining a water resource allocation scheme under balanced game. The invention is beneficial to considering reasonable utilization requirements of each main body in the decision, and gives consideration to the public distribution of benefits and the water resource allocation efficiency.

title_en: A kind of Energy-saving Projects benefits distribution method based on betting model
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of Energy-saving Projects benefits distribution method based on betting model, whether there is agency by agreement for energy-conservation company and energy unit, there is provided different energy-saving benefit allocation algorithms.When energy-conservation company and energy unit have not Principal-agency Relationship, the principle according to power and responsibility equity determines Gain sharing rate, such that it is able to maximize project energy saving profit.Its spy determines Gain sharing rate by non-cooperative game model when energy-conservation company and energy unit have Principal-agency Relationship.To set up the basis of negotiation of energy-conservation company and energy unit, promote both sides to be reached an agreement on benefits distribution, accelerate the propulsion energy-saving project implementation.
assignees: WUHAN NARI LTD LIABILITY CO OF STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Future community construction method and system based on government big data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent communities, in particular to a future community construction method and system based on government big data, comprising the following steps: and collecting electric power use data, water resource consumption data and public traffic utilization rate data in the community, synchronizing the data and performing standardized processing to generate a community resource use data set. According to the invention, the resource demand of a community in the future week can be effectively predicted by a time sequence analysis method, a resource flow simulation model is established, prediction data is input in real time, model parameters are adjusted, the influence of a policy is continuously simulated and evaluated, the optimal configuration of community resources is realized, the high efficiency and fairness of resource allocation are realized by constructing a resource allocation diagram and determining an optimal path, the adaptability and the persistence of resource allocation are further ensured by continuously tracking the allocation effect and resident feedback, the community resource management is optimized, the welfare of residents is promoted, and the sustainable development of the community is enhanced.
assignees: GUANGZHOU URBAN PLANNING & DESIGN SURVEY RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Multi-factor-considered renewable energy consumption responsibility weight distribution optimization method
abstract_en: A multi-factor renewable energy consumption responsibility weight distribution optimization method relates to the technical field of electric power markets and comprises the following steps of S1, taking multiple factors into consideration, utilizing an entropy weight method to calculate objective renewable energy power consumption responsibility weights of market main bodies, S2, establishing an upper-layer optimization objective function, S3, establishing a lower-layer objective function, and S4, iteratively solving optimal renewable energy consumption responsibility amounts and consumption amounts of the market main bodies based on a double-layer optimization model established in the steps S2 and S3. According to the invention, by taking province as a unit, the resource endowment, the power supply structure and the economic level of each region and the green electricity consumption proportion and the profit capability of each market subject are comprehensively considered, the renewable energy consumption responsibility weight is reasonably distributed, the optimal allocation of resources is realized, the utilization efficiency of renewable energy sources is further improved, the energy waste is reduced, and the fairness and the operability of policies can be improved.
assignees: STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER UNIV BAODING;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Resource allocation method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a resource allocation method, a resource allocation device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of medical equipment. The method comprises the steps of determining at least one dealer needing to perform resource allocation, determining the total amount of allocated resources for the at least one dealer, and respectively executing the following operations for the at least one dealer, wherein the total amount of resource requirements corresponding to the one dealer is determined based on the total amount of allocated resources and the predicted required duty ratio corresponding to the one dealer, the total amount of resource requirements comprises the amount of inventory resources, the corresponding amount of resource allocation corresponding to the one dealer is determined based on the total amount of resource requirements, and the at least one dealer is respectively allocated with resources according to the corresponding amount of resource allocation. According to the technical scheme, through accurate demand prediction and resource allocation, not only are the efficiency and the accuracy of resource allocation improved, but also inventory management is optimized, market response speed is enhanced, fairness of resource allocation is promoted, and dealer satisfaction is improved.

title_en: Device scheduling method and system based on dynamic priority and multi-objective optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device scheduling method and a system based on dynamic priority and multi-objective optimization, wherein the method takes minimized waiting time mean square error, minimized total waiting time and minimized maximum finishing time as optimization targets, comprehensively considers task dependency relationship, device maintenance time window, time window constraint, learner learning progress priority and delay compensation mechanism constraint conditions, introduces a dynamic priority computing mechanism, dynamically adjusts priority in real time according to task waiting time, deadline and urgency, generates a high-quality initial population through CMA-ES, combines a non-dominant ordering framework optimized by NSGA-II, uses PSO to update cross variation of a traditional genetic algorithm, and searches for optimal solution by using an elite reservation mechanism. The method and the device can effectively improve the utilization rate of equipment resources, reduce the task completion time, optimize the fairness of task allocation, are suitable for equipment sharing and dynamic scheduling scenes, and have strong practicability and popularization value.

title_en: IPD project profit distribution method based on multidimensional fairness preference and BIM
abstract_en: The invention discloses an IPD project profit distribution method based on multidimensional equity preference and BIM, which comprises the following steps of establishing a basic assumption of a model according to a Stackelberg game theory, constructing the model by analyzing output utility, effort cost, equity utility and risk cost of participants, introducing the multidimensional equity preference of the participants to determine an optimal sharing coefficient of equity preference of each dimension in the model, and finally adopting a simulation method for analysis. Based on the Stackelberg game theory, the invention builds an IPD project profit distribution model by utilizing BIM technology under multidimensional fairness preference by considering the fairness preference of participants, finds out the optimal sharing coefficient, promotes reasonable distribution of project profit among allied members, enhances team cooperation, promotes smooth implementation of the IPD project, and improves the profitability of the project while perfecting the IPD project profit distribution mechanism.
assignees: COMPREHENSIVE SERVICE CENTER OF STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Multi-energy alliance profit-risk collaborative distribution system based on improved Shapley value method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-energy alliance profit-risk collaborative distribution system based on an improved Shapley value method, which belongs to the field of multi-market collaborative optimization and comprises a multi-dimensional contribution degree calculation module, a risk evaluation and correction module, a dynamic adjustment module and a data interface module, wherein the multi-dimensional contribution degree calculation module is used for calculating low-carbon contribution degrees, comprehensive profit contribution degrees and cost contribution degrees respectively, the risk evaluation and correction module is used for dynamically correcting Shapley values to obtain corrected Shapley values, namely alliance profit distribution results, the dynamic adjustment module is used for executing Shapley value redistribution considering comprehensive contribution degrees of different power generation subjects to obtain redistribution results, and adjusting the redistribution results according to differences between the comprehensive contribution degrees and average contribution degrees of all the power generation subjects. By adopting the multi-energy alliance profit-risk collaborative distribution system based on the improved Shapley value method, the profit fairness and the operation stability of the multi-energy alliance are obviously improved through multi-dimensional contribution quantification, dynamic risk correction and a differential excitation mechanism, and the multi-energy alliance profit-risk collaborative distribution system has important theoretical significance and engineering application value.

title_en: Monitoring system and method for preventing power station from flooding based on Internet
abstract_en: The invention discloses a monitoring system and a method for preventing a power station from flooding based on the Internet, which relate to the technical field of power station management, the intelligent water regime prediction system comprises an intelligent water regime prediction module, an intelligent drainage optimization control module, an underwater perception network module, an environment collaborative perception module, an automatic facility protection module, an abnormal event instant alarm module and a community linkage emergency response module. The monitoring system and the method for preventing the power station from flooding on the basis of the Internet overcome the defects of the prior art by integrating the technologies of intelligent water regime prediction, real-time drainage optimization, underwater perception network and the like, realize the multi-dimension of data perception, the dynamics of prediction analysis and the intellectualization of protective measures, not only remarkably improve the monitoring precision and the response efficiency of complex hydrologic events, but also enhance the transparency and fairness of resource scheduling through a cooperative network based on a block chain, and provide a comprehensive and efficient protection solution for the power station and surrounding communities.
assignees: THREE GORGES JINSHA JIANGCHUAN CLOUD HYDROPOWER DEV CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent traffic service processing method based on block chain distributed predictors
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent traffic service processing method based on a block chain distributed prediction machine, which relates to the technical field of intelligent traffic service based on block chains and the distributed prediction machine, and comprises the steps of collecting original traffic data, and sending the original traffic data to a block chain network for encryption storage through the distributed prediction machine network to obtain encrypted traffic data; the method comprises the steps of generating prompt word information according to encrypted traffic data and user demand information, encrypting and storing the prompt word information in a blockchain network to obtain blockchain prompt word data, obtaining the encrypted traffic data and the blockchain prompt word data from the blockchain network, carrying out reasoning calculation by combining the prompt word information after decryption to obtain model reasoning result data, and automatically executing intelligent traffic service according to the model reasoning result data to obtain transaction execution result data. The invention can be used for decentralizing to improve the system stability, enhance the data privacy safety, improve the model output accuracy and ensure the fairness and fairness of transactions through intelligent contracts.
assignees: HUBEI COMMUNICATIONS INVESTMENT SMART TECH CO LTD

title_en: Classified evaluation method and device for network loss of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a classification evaluation method and a classification evaluation device for the network loss of a power distribution network, wherein the method constructs a judgment matrix scored by experts according to various indexes such as a power grid structure, equipment physical parameters, power grid operation characteristics, power utilization structure characteristics, natural social development conditions and the like to obtain the weight of the influence factor determined by the experts on the network loss of the power distribution network, then quantitatively analyzes the influence of the influence factor on the line loss through the established mathematical model of each index, and finally, evaluates the influence of the influence factor on the network loss of the power distribution network by integrating the weight of the influence factor determined by the expert scoring and the evaluation result determined by the evaluation model. The construction of the evaluation system provides a scientific and reasonable division method for making the line loss rate index of the power distribution network, improves the fairness, comprehensiveness and authority of line loss management of the power distribution network, can timely and reasonably adjust the annual line loss rate index distributed to each county company, provides strong data support for scientific decision making, and generates good economic benefit and social benefit.

title_en: Comprehensive energy system energy-carbon interactive scheduling method and device based on multi-element game
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of energy scheduling of power systems, in particular to a comprehensive energy system energy-carbon interaction scheduling method and device based on multi-element games. In the invention, a multi-polymer and multi-producer and a multi-producer in the comprehensive energy system form a cooperative game, and a multi-polymer and multi-producer cooperative game mode considering multi-energy and carbon interaction and a low-carbon mechanism is established; and (3) establishing a cooperative game model and a characteristic function of the multi-producer and the multi-aggregator by considering electric energy, heat energy and carbon emission rights sharing. The double-layer profit distribution method based on the multi-subject participation contribution degree is provided, and the fairness of distribution is ensured. The invention introduces a multi-element and flexible interaction mode and a multi-energy-carbon transaction strategy, builds a multi-energy market cooperative energy-carbon coupling interaction mode, improves the system load characteristic, promotes renewable energy consumption and multi-energy mutual economy, and realizes the flexibility, low carbon and safety of multi-AOP and multi-yield operation.

title_en: Scientific and technological rewarding form examination system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a scientific and technological rewarding form examination system, and belongs to the technical field of computer application. The scientific and technological rewarding form examination system of the invention utilizes the form examination information management module to create examination tasks and distribute input personnel and examination personnel, examines the support materials of the rewarding items according to set examination contents, automatically gives examination suggestions, and can generate form examination reports. The invention utilizes the computing technology to automatically compare the contents in the prize-awarding item supporting material according to the examination contents, thereby avoiding the problems of low efficiency and incomplete examination caused by manual examination, improving the accuracy and the working efficiency of formal examination work and ensuring the fairness of scientific and technological rewarding examination.

title_en: Space-time perception and dynamic optimization-based health intelligent collaborative service system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a space-time perception and dynamic optimization based health care intelligent cooperative service system and a space-time perception and dynamic optimization based health care intelligent cooperative service method, which belong to the field of aged health care intelligent, and realize the transition of aged health care service from static response to dynamic cooperation by constructing a full-link closed-loop service system of behavior perception, risk early warning, resource scheduling and rights and interests excitation. The accuracy and timeliness of health risk prediction are effectively improved based on ST-GNN (fast Fourier transform-based) behavior map modeling, the service waiting time and the resource empty rate are obviously reduced by a mixed resource cooperative scheduling mechanism, the user viscosity and the platform operation benefit are enhanced by DQN-driven dynamic equity recommendation, and the system has strong consistency and logic closed loop performance as a whole and is suitable for large-scale deployment of urban intelligent health maintenance service platforms.
assignees: BEIJING HEALTHY PENSION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Designated driving dispatch method, apparatus, electronic device, computer readable storage medium and program product
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a designated driving dispatch method, a designated driving dispatch device, electronic equipment, a computer-readable storage medium and a program product, and relates to the technical field of computers. The method comprises the steps of carrying out order receiving judgment by combining customer order information and a system load state, improving the running stability of the system and the rationality of order receiving, screening target suppliers with service capability based on the customer order information after determining the order receiving, obtaining candidate drivers, realizing preliminary matching of the capacity, sorting according to business value data, quality data, driver coverage data and service scores of the target suppliers when the number of the candidate drivers is insufficient, establishing a priority order, expanding a search range of the target suppliers according to the order, dynamically supplementing the candidate drivers, improving the successful order receiving probability in a capacity sparse area, pushing the driving order to all the candidate drivers, sending the driving order to a first receiver, taking efficiency and fairness into consideration, and effectively improving the order receiving success rate and the resource utilization rate.

title_en: A kind of ship piloting scheduling method based on forest model and improved adaptive GA-IAGA
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of ship piloting scheduling method based on forest model and improved adaptive GA-IAGA.This method builds pilotage task forest model according to pilotage task convergence condition, and initial pilotage task groups are obtained using breadth-first search traversal pilotage task forest is improved；According to initial pilotage task groups, sampling improved adaptive GA-IAGA obtains optimal Piloting and Marshalling plan.The present invention, which is considered, various in Piloting and Marshalling written arranges an order according to class and grade rule and non-existing writings are arranged an order according to class and grade custom, the constraints involved by Piloting and Marshalling problem is converted into cost model simultaneously, from feasibility, fairness, three angles of benefit, ship piloting scheduling method is solved.

title_en: Method, system, equipment and medium for dynamically analyzing reserves of multi-type ore storage yard
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, equipment and a medium for dynamically analyzing reserves of a multi-type ore yard, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring multi-type ore yard images of an open mine acquired by unmanned aerial vehicle aerial photography; analyzing various types of ore yard images through an aerial triangular analysis method, converting the images into various types of three-dimensional dense point cloud data of the ore yards, and processing the three-dimensional dense point cloud data to obtain various types of three-dimensional models of the ore yards; extracting elevation point information of the ore yard based on three-dimensional models of various ore yards; and (3) extracting elevation point information of the multi-type ore yards in different periods by loop iteration, carrying out reserve dynamic analysis to obtain multi-type ore yard reserve data in different periods, and analyzing change conditions of the multi-type ore yard reserve data in different periods. The invention lays a foundation for scientifically optimizing the ore mining design of the stope, further establishes a scientific plan of stope ore allocation and ore supply, and is favorable for reasonably establishing stope ore supply allocation indexes.

title_en: Route planning method considering heterogeneity of driver based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a path planning method considering driver heterogeneity based on machine learning, which comprises the steps of firstly constructing an on-demand distribution optimization model based on maximizing platform long-term benefits in a period of operation time; training a prediction model to predict a category of the real-time order using a two-stage classification prediction algorithm based on machine learning; and solving the established on-demand distribution optimization model to obtain an optimal solution and an optimal strategy of the vehicle path planning problem. The method can effectively improve order distribution efficiency, realizes the excitation of new drivers, and provides a tool for balancing efficiency and fairness for logistics service providers.

title_en: Economic cascade load distribution method based on full-featured space curved face modeling
abstract_en: The invention discloses an economic cascade load distribution method based on full-featured space curved face modeling, and belongs to the technical field of hydroelectric energy optimizing operation. The method comprises: building a cascade load distribution module with a goal of maximum grade total energy storage; constructing full-featured space curved faces of hydropower stations according to the power characteristics of all units of the hydropower stations; applying a combined theory and ascertaining combined vibrating areas of the hydropower stations according to the vibrating areas of all units of the hydropower stations; applying a differential evolutionary algorithm to solve a cascade load distribution model according to the full-featured space curved faces and the combined vibrating areas of the hydropower stations; and issuing the optimal cascade load distribution scheme to all hydropower stations. According to the economic cascade load distribution method provided by the invention, output feasible regions of the hydropower stations can be directly ascertained through the combined vibrating areas by taking the hydropower stations as calculating units of the cascade load distribution; and furthermore, one the premise of taking the solving precision into account, the calculating efficiency can be effectively improved, the equitable distribution of the cascade total load can be realized among all the hydropower stations, and the safe, stable and economic operation of the cascade hydropower station groups can be ensured.

title_en: Resource allocation process reengineering system and resource allocation method
abstract_en: The invention provides a resource allocation process reengineering system and resource allocation method. The system consists of a newly established service subsystem, a high enterprise service package subsystem, an intellectual property service package subsystem, an analysis and testing service package subsystem, a national-equities-exchange-and-quotations listing service package subsystem, a backstage management subsystem, a data analysis and static subsystem, and a unified user management subsystem. Therefore, a technical problem of reasonable resource allocation between a service provider and a service demander is solved. Real-time docking between a service provider and a service demander is realized; the resource allocation process reengineering is realized; the data examination pressure is reduced; and the information examination precision is improved.

title_en: Cooperative game theory-based intelligent community household electricity consumption cooperative income allocation method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of cost allocation, and particularly relates to a method for allocating household power consumption cooperative income of an intelligent community based on cooperative game theory, which comprises the following steps: establishing an intelligent community family cooperative electricity utilization optimization model, and quantifying the income of each family electricity utilization cooperation; the method comprises the following steps of adopting a proportion allocation method and a method based on a cooperative game theory to allocate the income of each household power utilization cooperation; and comparing and analyzing the apportionment results obtained by the proportion apportionment method and the method based on the cooperative game theory to determine the applicable scene of each method. The method realizes the quantification of the distributed power generation resource benefits brought by the cooperation of all household electricity, obtains the applicability of the cooperation game method in the intelligent community cooperation electricity utilization environment according to the characteristic difference of the method, realizes the fair allocation of the income brought by all household cooperation electricity utilization according to different fairness definitions, stimulates the household users to participate in the cooperation electricity utilization, and promotes the high-efficiency utilization of the electricity utilization resources in the community and the improvement of the electricity utilization benefits of the household users.

title_en: Consequence study and judgment based emergency resource allocation method and system for narrow non-exposed space
abstract_en: The invention provides an emergency resource allocation method and system for a narrow non-exposed space based on consequence study and judgment, belonging to the technical field of emergency rescue and comprising the following steps: constructing various weight influence factors of secondary disaster occurrence under the emergency of a narrow non-exposed area; constructing an ideal point approaching degree model to estimate the probability of secondary disasters in a narrow and small non-exposed space; the resource demand of the disaster-stricken point is determined, and the improved bee colony algorithm is used for distributing the materials, so that the requirements of highest time satisfaction degree, fairness distribution and minimum total cost are met. The method can timely and efficiently carry out emergency resource allocation for the disaster situation of multiple narrow non-exposed spaces which simultaneously occur, and has good allocation result and good timeliness.

title_en: Block chain system for agricultural non-point source pollution treatment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a blockchain system for agricultural non-point source pollution control, which constructs a Fabric alliance chain architecture system, and innovates agricultural non-point source pollution control data storage, information tracing, excitation and constraint mechanisms by utilizing technologies such as a blockchain consensus mechanism, distributed storage, cryptography, point-to-point transmission, cross-chain mutual recognition and the like so as to improve development dilemmas of unsafe monitoring information storage transmission, asymmetric information, poor multi-head management collaboration, frequent enterprise renting and gambling behaviors, government authority dissimilarity and the like existing in the current agricultural non-point source pollution control mechanism. In mechanism design, the ideas of the characteristics and decentralization of the blockchain are applied to construct a data safety storage, transparent disclosure, credible traceability and consensus autonomous agriculture non-point source pollution treatment blockchain network, a safe and credible treatment environment is created, efficient and lossless transfer of government and enterprise information is realized, and disclosure, fairness and fairness of pollution treatment are promoted.

title_en: Double-queue ordered full-capacity charging method for private charging piles of public transformer area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a public transformer area private charging pile double-queue ordered capacity-saving charging method, which takes whether the total charging power of the public transformer area private charging pile is smaller than or equal to the distribution capacity as a judging condition, and is provided with an on-charging queue, a fixed equity charging queue and a competitive charging queue in an ordered capacity-saving charging strategy to perform charging management on the charging pile, so that the charging pile realizes different charging control under different time periods according to the two queues, namely the fixed equity charging queue and the competitive charging queue. The embodiment of the invention meets the increasing installation requirement of the charging pile and balances the peak-to-valley load of residential electricity of the cell on the premise of not increasing the existing distribution capacity of the cell.
assignees: HANGZHOU YINGLING TECH CO LTD;ZHU CHUANBAI

title_en: Disaster relief material distribution algorithm based on multi-agent reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster relief material distribution algorithm based on multi-agent reinforcement learning, which relates to the technical field of computer application, and comprises Markov process modeling based on multi-agent reinforcement learning, a deep neural network comprising a codec based on an attention mechanism and corresponding training and application methods; the method comprises the steps of establishing a problem formalized expression of disaster relief material distribution through Markov process modeling, and providing a deep neural network for learning a vehicle team strategy, wherein an encoder takes a distribution task target place as input, outputs an embedded vector of the target place, and combines an environment state and the embedded vector to output a next task point of a vehicle, training of the neural network depends on a simulation environment and a classical multi-agent reinforcement learning training algorithm, the trained network can be deployed in a real scene, and the algorithm is provided for solving the problems of high time requirement, unknown material requirement, complex vehicle cooperation and the like in an emergency disaster relief scene and can be used for various emergency material delivery scenes.

title_en: ETC traffic data-based adaptive game regulation and control method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ETC (electronic toll collection) passing data-based self-adaptive game regulation and control method and system, which comprise the steps of generating a toll station space coordinate set, generating a user province card collection schedule, counting the passing frequency, the passing mileage and the trans-province behaviors of a user in a preset time window, writing a user liveness model into a user file, setting trigger thresholds for the passing card-punching behaviors and the social sharing behaviors respectively, generating card objects and writing the card objects into the user province card collection schedule when the corresponding thresholds are met, analyzing the user province card collection schedule in real time, tracking the single number state of a logistics until signing is completed and a user seal warehouse is updated, and recording the reflux access quantity and writing the user fissile value table when a reflux monitoring module detects an access event. The invention obviously improves the application depth of the data and the fairness of the user interaction.
assignees: JIEYOU DIGITAL TECH NANJING CO LTD

title_en: Progressive planning-based power grid evaluation method and system based on combined assessment theory
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the technical field of power grid assessment and optimization. Disclosed are a progressive planning-based power grid evaluation method and system based on a combined assessment theory. The method comprises: using a combined weighting method to perform weight correction on an obtained index by; obtaining an assessed value on the basis of a similarity theory-based assessment method; performing standardization processing on the index by means of non‑dimensionalization processing; and performing evaluation on the basis of non-parametric regression. By means of a combined subjective-objective weighting method, the present invention ensures the objectiveness and fairness of assessment results. By means of a deep learning model, in particular an LSTM network and an attention mechanism, the efficiency and accuracy of assessment are improved. The systematic method of the present invention has wide prospects for application. In the present invention, by means of the design of automated optimization of assessment parameters, adaptive adjustment can be performed on the basis of historical data and real-time data, so that assessment results are closer to actual values, thereby improving the practicality of assessment.

title_en: System and method for fair employee scheduling
abstract_en: A method for scheduling servers within a food-serving establishment or other business environment using a point-of-sale system based on a fairness processing module. The system includes a tablet, configured to receive a food order, and a computer having a transceiver, memory, and processor. The transceiver receives information about the food order from the tablet including payment and gratuity information. The memory stores payment and gratuity information along with information related to tables statistics and server-table assignments. The computer uses the fairness processing module to provide a preliminary recommendation of a first server from a group of servers for a non-routine scheduling assignment. The fairness processing module is based on a total amount of gratuities the first server has earned during a relevant period of time as compared to a total amount of gratuities earned by other servers in the group of servers.

title_en: Enterprise power generation completion rate balance evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for evaluating the balance of the power generation completion rate of an enterprise, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining the progressive data of the power generation completion rate of the enterprise corresponding to each power generation sequence based on the power generation sequence of each enterprise, fitting a Lorentz curve of the power generation completion rate of the enterprise according to the progressive data of the power generation completion rate of the enterprise corresponding to each power generation sequence, determining a Gini coefficient of the power generation completion rate of the enterprise and a fitting residual according to the Lorentz curve of the power generation completion rate of the enterprise, and evaluating the balance of the power generation completion rate of the enterprise by using the Gini coefficient of the power generation completion rate of the enterprise and the fitting residual; the technical scheme provided by the invention can objectively and accurately evaluate the power generation completion rate balance of an enterprise, wherein the fitting residual error is introduced on the basis of the traditional evaluation of the fairness of the Gini coefficient, and the degree of violating the power generation sequence scheduling principle is more comprehensively evaluated.

title_en: Dynamic charging-sharing coupling scheduling method and system for new energy automobile
abstract_en: The invention relates to a dynamic charging-sharing coupling scheduling method and system for a new energy automobile, wherein the method comprises the steps of dividing a target area into a plurality of subareas, obtaining relevant parameters of each subarea and vehicle scheduling constraint, calculating travel benefits of a sharing platform, calculating regional fairness benefits of each subarea, calculating photovoltaic power generation utilization rates of all subareas in all time periods, taking the travel benefits of the sharing platform, the regional fairness benefits and the photovoltaic power generation utilization rates as target functions, calculating an evaluation value of each target function by using a pareto optimal solution method, and generating a vehicle charging scheduling strategy based on the evaluation values. Compared with the prior art, the photovoltaic power generation method has the advantages that photovoltaic power generation is brought into the consideration range of vehicle charging scheduling, and vehicle sharing charging scheduling is comprehensively optimized from the aspects of travel benefits, regional fairness benefits and photovoltaic power generation utilization rate of a sharing platform.

title_en: Automatic expressway toll collection management system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of transaction settlement, in particular to an automatic expressway toll management system, which comprises a traffic state capturing module, a vehicle speed and direction analyzing module and a vehicle passing and overtaking module, wherein the traffic state capturing module is used for collecting and recording the vehicle position based on vehicle running data, updating according to time sequence, determining a running track, determining the following and overtaking behaviors by utilizing the relative position among vehicles, and constructing nodes and sides of a graph. According to the invention, through comprehensive collection and real-time analysis of the vehicle running data, the fine capture and dynamic update of traffic states are realized, the interaction among vehicles is accurately evaluated, key vehicles affecting traffic flows are timely identified, based on the fact, the charging standard is dynamically set, reasonable road use cost distribution is ensured, the congestion risk is reduced, the charging fairness and the road use efficiency are improved, the charging information is synchronized in real time, the vehicle decision is more time-efficient, the path selection error caused by information lag is avoided, the traffic flow distribution is further optimized, the traffic efficiency is improved, and the congestion problem is effectively relieved.

title_en: Case allocation method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a case distribution method, which comprises the steps of obtaining a plurality of case labels of a plurality of cases; acquiring a plurality of personnel tags corresponding to a plurality of processing personnel, and determining the distribution priority of each processing personnel according to the plurality of personnel tags corresponding to the plurality of processing personnel; determining target processing personnel correspondingly matched with the plurality of cases from the plurality of processing personnel according to case priorities corresponding to the plurality of cases and distribution priorities of the plurality of processing personnel, and distributing the plurality of cases to the corresponding target processing personnel. The invention generates the matching degree of the cases and the treating personnel through the case priority of the cases and the distribution priority of the treating personnel, ensures the fairness of case distribution and the timeliness of treatment, and improves the efficiency of case distribution. The invention can be applied to the field of medical claims, and is distributed to corresponding processing personnel according to the case priority of medical claims, so that the claim settlement efficiency of medical claims is improved, and the customer satisfaction is improved.
assignees: PING AN PENSION INSURANCE CO LTD

title_en: Urban waterlogging disaster forecasting, early warning and emergency rescue system and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an urban waterlogging disaster forecasting, early warning and emergency rescue system and a method thereof, wherein the system comprises the following steps: the system comprises an information input module, a geographic information processing module, a city rainfall converging and calculating module, a city waterlogging inundation calculating module, a disaster analysis module, an early warning information release and feedback module and a disaster relief material management and rescue team communication coordination module. The invention can calculate the inundation range of urban rainfall and issue early warning information, instruct disaster-stricken personnel to evacuate, and supplement and schedule disaster relief materials and disaster relief personnel.

title_en: Staff dormitory recommendation method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a staff dormitory recommendation method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium, wherein personal information and basic intention dormitory information of dormitory to-be-selected personnel are determined, sampling step sizes and dormitory recommendation quantity are recommended, the information of the to-be-selected personnel in the dormitory matched with the basic intention dormitory information is obtained, a matched dormitory set matched with the dormitory to-be-selected personnel is determined based on the information of the to-be-selected personnel and the personal information of the dormitory to-be-selected personnel, then the to-be-selected personnel in the matched dormitory set and the dormitory to-be-selected personnel are ordered, sampling to-be-selected personnel are determined based on the ordering numbers and the recommended sampling step sizes of the dormitory to-be-selected personnel, accordingly, the occupation ratio of various types of dormitory is determined based on the dormitory attribute information of the sampling to-be-selected personnel, and the recommended dormitory recommended to the dormitory to-be-selected personnel is selected from current room sources based on the occupation ratio of various types of dormitory types, and the dormitory allocation fairness is improved.
assignees: CAPITAL INFORMATION TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based intelligent accounting and payment system for peasant wages
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twinning-based intelligent accounting and payment system for peasant wages, which relates to the technical field of intelligent accounting and payment for peasant wages and comprises an initial acquisition setting module, a data acquisition window module, a data analysis and feature extraction module, a task change classification module and a dynamic acquisition regulation module; the initial acquisition setting module is used for setting an initial acquisition interval duration to acquire data of a worker work task according to work arrangement of a construction site and initial complexity of the worker task. According to the invention, the data acquisition mode is optimized according to the complexity and the change mode of the work task of the worker by intelligently and dynamically regulating and controlling the acquisition interval. For complex and changeable tasks, the system shortens the acquisition interval, accurately records the switching of the high-intensity tasks and the low-intensity tasks, and ensures the fairness of wage accounting. For a single task, the acquisition interval is prolonged, redundant data is reduced, the resource utilization rate is improved, and the accuracy of wage accounting and the system operation efficiency are effectively improved.
assignees: YUNNAN HUIJI TECH CO LTD;JIUYUAN YUNSHU TECH BEIJING CO LTD

title_en: Personalized dynamic dispatching method and system for urban cleaning vehicle
abstract_en: The invention provides a personalized dynamic dispatching method and system for urban cleaning vehicles. The method comprises the steps of collecting road information, business information related to enterprises and vehicle information, wherein the road information is collected according to road line segments which are split in advance, the vehicle information comprises operation vehicle information and cleaning vehicle information, business information corresponding to the operation vehicle information is obtained according to the operation vehicle information, consumption registration of the road line segments is completed by combining the obtained position information, when the accumulated consumption value of the road line segments reaches a threshold value, a cleaning task is generated according to the consumption value and distributed to the cleaning vehicle, the consumption value of the road line segments needing to be checked and approved is obtained according to an executed track, and the consumption value of the road line segments needing to be checked and approved is summarized in enterprise dimensions, so that a check algorithm for equitable sharing of cleaning cost by a plurality of enterprises is formed. The personalized dynamic dispatching method and system for the urban cleaning vehicle can effectively avoid the spread of road pollution.

title_en: Fair crowdsourcing work flow distribution method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fair crowdsourcing work flow distribution method, which comprises the following steps: s1, inputting an online worker set, a crowd-sourced task workflow and completion time; s2, initializing distribution parameters and starting distribution; s3, finding a task set to be distributed from the workflow; s4, nominating workers according to the requirements of the first task to be allocated, and grouping according to the similarity of the nominated workers to generate a task allocation nominated group; s5, soliciting the opinion of workers according to the group, and generating a corresponding task allocation candidate group; s6, calculating fairness among the groups, and selecting a candidate group subjected to the least fair treatment; s7, finding the candidate worker subjected to the least fair treatment from the candidate group, and distributing the task to the worker; and S8, after the tasks in all the task sets to be allocated are completed, updating the allocation parameters and continuously searching the next task set to be allocated until the tasks in the workflow are all allocated. The invention ensures the maximum fairness of distribution on the premise of ensuring that the workflow is completed on time.

title_en: Distributed central large kitchen system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed central large kitchen system. The system comprises: processing food materials into finished products or semi-finished products according to order information, and manufacturing the food materials into a package central kitchen of a standardized meal; a food material supply base for purchasing, culturing, and storing food materials; a logistics distribution system for distributing food material from a food material supply base to the central kitchen and distributing meal packages from the central kitchen to community aid distribution; the community meal assisting distribution is used for distributing the meal packages to the appointed places within the range of the responsible area; and the enterprise industrial Internet system is used for connecting links and collecting data, and performing big data analysis by using the collected data so as to reduce the cost. The invention can provide more convenient and special kitchen products for the elderly users, and ensure the consistency of commodity quality and sanitary standard. Through centralized purchasing, production and price control, the added value of commodities is improved, and the profit of enterprises is ensured, so that the reciprocal win-win between enterprises and users is realized.

title_en: Water supply flow detection and allocation optimization system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water supply flow detection and allocation optimization system, which comprises a water supply flow equipment physical module, a virtual digital twin module, a digital twin implementation layer and a communication layer, wherein: the water supply flow equipment physical module is used for collecting various physical entity data in the water supply process; the virtual digital twin module is used for simulating the physical module of the water supply flow equipment by constructing a water supply flow automatic detection virtual digital twin model and is used for showing physical water supply detection data and deciding water supply allocation; the digital twin implementation layer inputs the received data of the physical module of the water supply flow equipment into each training model, and converts the data into a water supply allocation decision to carry out water supply allocation optimization adjustment through algorithm simulation; the communication layer is used for realizing data and command transmission among the modules. The invention can solve the problems that the water supply system is easy to cause pipe explosion and the like in the moment or in the initial stage, and makes a pre-judgment decision for water supply allocation.

title_en: Subway passenger scheduling optimization method considering fairness under full-automatic operation environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a subway passenger scheduling optimization method considering fairness under a full-automatic operation environment, which comprises the following steps: 1. constructing a space-time network of subway passenger scheduling customization; 2. building a subway passenger scheduling model based on a multi-commodity network flow; 3. solving a subway passenger scheduling model by using a Lagrange relaxation algorithm to obtain an initial scheduling scheme; 4. and adjusting the initial scheduling scheme by using an insertion heuristic algorithm to obtain an optimal scheduling scheme considering fairness. The invention starts from the equilibrium angle of the scheduling efficiency and the fair allocation of the passengers, takes Lagrange relaxation and insertion heuristic algorithm as optimization means through the construction of the customized space-time network and the establishment of the scheduling model of the passengers, obtains a high-quality initial scheduling scheme, adjusts on the basis to obtain a fairer scheduling scheme, and remarkably improves the scheduling efficiency and the working quality of the passengers of the subway.

title_en: Primary sanitary resource allocation method and system for epidemic prevention and control
abstract_en: The invention discloses a primary sanitary resource allocation method and system for epidemic prevention and control, which relate to the technical field of public sanitary epidemic prevention and control and comprise the steps of predicting epidemic trend of communities based on a distributed space resource coupling SEIR model, introducing parameters such as medical resource indexes, constructing a community side preference function and a medical facility side preference function, solving matching relation between communities and medical facilities at all times and isolating resource allocation schemes under an edge cloud cooperative framework. The scheme utilizes the peak value advance, the resource occupation proportion and the trust factor to comprehensively measure the service priority, improves the configuration priority of resource shortage communities through urban and rural compensation items, reduces urban and rural gaps, reduces data transmission quantity by adopting edge preprocessing and encryption uploading sequencing results, improves scheduling timeliness, fairness and safety, and realizes closed loop linkage of epidemic propagation inhibition and resource dynamic scheduling.

title_en: Method for optimizing the allocation of water resources for maintaining constant bearing capacity
title_ko: 지지력 향상에 대한 맞춤형 수자원 최적화 배치방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지지력 향상에 대한 맞춤형 수자원(水資源) 최적화 배치방법을 제공하고, 유역 수토자원 리스크 평가 기술분야에 속하며, 배치 대기 영역의 수자원 데이터를 확정하는 단계; 배치 대기 영역의 물 부족량 최소의 사회 효과 및 이익 최적화 목표, 1만 위안 GDP의 물 사용량 최소의 경제 효과 및 이익 최적화 목표, 카본 싱크(carbon sink) 능력 최대의 환경 효과 및 이익 최적화 목표 및 생태 기저 유량 만족도 최대의 생태 효과 및 이익 최적화 목표를 각각 확정하는 단계; 배치 대기 영역의 물 수량 평형 제약 조건, 오염물 배출량 제약조건 및 배치 대기 영역의 수자원 지지력이 임계 과부하 수준보다 높지 않는 급수 형평성 제약조건을 각각 확정하는 단계; 헝거 게임(hunger game) 검색 알고리즘을 통해 영역의 수자원에 대해 최적화 배치를 진행하는 단계;를 포함한다. 본 발명은 종래방법을 기반으로 하여 획득한 수자원 배치의 정확성이 비교적 낮은 문제를 해결한다.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Method and system to assess, diagnose, and optimize leadership and other performance skill development
abstract_en: A method and system of assessing, diagnosing, and optimizing leadership and other performance skills of an individual within an organization is realized through ratings of various leadership and/or other performance skills within a tired dimensions and sub-dimensions framework by raters of various constituencies within the organization. The ratings may be based on a quantitative score for each dimensions and sub-dimensions as well as a equity on-the-margin qualitative evaluation of the rated score. A developmental recommendation follows from the analysis identifying key areas of improvement needs for the leadership or other performance skills. Further analysis may be conducted with respect to comparisons and identifying discrepancies between the ratings by groups of the constituencies such as the self, superordinates, peers, and subordinates of the individual. The individual may also be assessed relative to norms by organization types, organizational roles, and positions within the organization.

title_en: It is a kind of to be directed to more runway flights into the dynamic dispatching method left the theatre
abstract_en: It is as follows into dynamic dispatching method of leaving the theatre, its step that the present invention discloses a kind of more runway flights：Cost of flight delay is analyzed, proposes that more runway flights minimize object function into all cost of flight delay of scheduling of leaving the theatre；The theoretical delay time at stop is calculated, the flight delay time at stop of different type of machines is scaled the delay time at stop of flat delay cost；Analyze the fairness of more runway scheduling and construction considers the object function of fair factor；It is proposed the General Constraint Condition of more runway Scheduled Flight scheduling；Design considers delayed more runway flight schedule constraints conditions；More runway flights are solved into the dynamic scheduling problem left the theatre using genetic algorithm, realize that flight into runway dynamic dispatching of leaving the theatre, realizes the target for improving runway utilization rate and reducing cost of flight delay.The present invention takes into full account influence of the flight delay to the scheduling of more runways, realizes the target for improving more runway utilization rates and the target for reducing cost of flight delay.

title_en: Task matching fairness method for large-scale taxi taking platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a task matching fairness method for a large-scale taxi taking platform, and belongs to the field of computers; the method comprises the following steps: firstly, aiming at a certain city, forming a bipartite graph by idle online drivers and unserviced orders in a taxi taking scene at a fixed time frequency; updating each side weight of the bipartite graph in the current time window; then, calculating the order matching corresponding to each online driver on the bipartite graph with updated edge weights; finally, learning the matching result of the online driver and the corresponding order, and updating the value function for the evaluation of the next time window; and meanwhile, leading idle online drivers to enter an order hot area according to the updated value function, and avoiding cold start of online learning. The invention adds a guiding strategy to dispatch drivers to nearby grids with high value, thereby realizing fair profit of each driver; meanwhile, the fairness check is embedded into the process of finding the augmented path, and extra time complexity is not increased.

title_en: Online continuous education resource allocation and management method based on artificial intelligence algorithm technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses an on-line continuous education resource allocation and management method based on an artificial intelligence algorithm technology, and provides the following scheme aiming at the problems of violation of an education fairness principle, poor allocation efficiency and insufficient transparency of an allocation mode, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1: the staff uploads the student identity information and the hiring teacher identity information collected through the platforms to the education system; s2: an education resource manager logs in an online continuous education platform to integrate the identity information of teachers and students; s3: and respectively issuing survey information questionnaires for the teacher and the students in an e-mail mode. The invention effectively and directly hooks the superior teaching information disclosed by the teacher and the subject to be improved by the student through the connection of the resource information matching module, so that the reasonable supply and demand balance is efficiently realized for the bidirectional matching of the teacher and the student, the achievement of the student is improved, and the targeted teaching in the teaching process is enriched.
assignees: HENGJI CULTURE INFORMATION TECH SHENZHEN CO LTD

title_en: Benefit distribution method, device, equipment and medium of electric power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a benefit distribution method, device, equipment and medium of an electric power system, and relates to the technical field of electric power engineering; the method comprises the steps of determining an environmental protection correction coefficient of each benefit body based on environmental protection contribution degree of each benefit body, wherein the environmental protection contribution degree is related to environmental protection input cost of the benefit body, obtaining environmental protection weight parameters of each benefit body, wherein the environmental protection weight parameters are related to the environmental protection correction coefficient, correcting a value distribution result determined based on a first cost distribution model based on the environmental protection weight parameters and the environmental protection correction coefficient, and obtaining a corrected value distribution result. According to the invention, the environmental protection contribution degree of each benefit body is fully considered, the value distribution result is readjusted according to the environmental protection contribution degree of each benefit body, and the value distribution fairness of each benefit body is ensured.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Elevator operation control method and system based on optimized elevator operation strategy
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of elevator operation, in particular to an elevator operation control method and system based on an optimized elevator operation strategy. An elevator operation control system based on an optimized elevator operation strategy comprises a call request information acquisition module, an elevator operation task management module, an elevator agent game module, a task sequence updating module and an elevator operation strategy execution module. The method and the system realize request priority ordering through task value weighted evaluation, can improve response sensitivity of a dispatching system to key requests, optimize resource allocation sequence, ensure service fairness and timeliness of users at different floors in peak periods, carry out disturbance value game analysis on target tasks through a plurality of elevator agents, execute the target tasks by optimizing an elevator with the least disturbance, and ensure that task insertion has the least influence on the original path, thereby improving overall dispatching efficiency and path utilization rate.

title_en: Medical material multi-level warehouse intelligent management system and method based on demand prediction
