abstract_en: The invention provides a medical material multi-stage warehouse intelligent management system and method based on demand prediction, wherein the medical material multi-stage warehouse intelligent management system comprises an intelligent identification module, a stock shortage pre-picking module, a demand prediction module, a dynamic priority adjustment module, a multi-target optimization distribution module, a multi-stage warehouse collaborative scheduling module, a real-time monitoring early warning module and an intelligent analysis optimization module, wherein the intelligent identification module is used for realizing quick warehouse-in and warehouse-out operation of medical materials, the stock shortage pre-picking module is used for receiving and recording request applications when the stock is insufficient, the demand prediction module is used for adopting a prediction model with multi-granularity time decomposition, the dynamic priority adjustment module is used for constructing an evaluation system, the multi-target optimization distribution module is used for distributing the materials, the multi-stage warehouse collaborative scheduling module is used for monitoring stock differences of multi-stage warehouses in real time, the real-time monitoring early warning module is used for monitoring warehouses, and the intelligent analysis optimization module is used for generating visual reports. The invention comprehensively improves the intelligent level and the operation efficiency of medical material management. The system can ensure quick response of urgent medical demands, and simultaneously gives consideration to group fairness and resource utilization efficiency, thereby remarkably reducing the risk of shortage and operation cost.

title_en: Motor-truck utilization type disaster countermeasure system
abstract_en: To provide a motor-truck utilization type disaster countermeasure system which is capable of quickly providing emergency supplies to people who require them at the time of a disaster by utilizing the enormous number of motor-trucks traveling all over Japan everyday.SOLUTION: A motor-truck utilization type disaster countermeasure system is configured so as to take out a handbag 31 from an upper face opening 23 by opening a cardboard 23 which is normally installed on a front passenger seat Ka of a motor-truck K when a disaster occurs and next, to put a plurality of item packaging bodies 19 into the handbag 31. It thereby makes it possible to convey the plurality of item packaging bodies 19 easily. And then, the system is configured so as to distribute the item packaging bodies 19 to people who require emergency supplies by moving with the handbag 31. The system can function effectively for a person who receives the item packaging body 19 because a plurality of kinds of emergency supplies are packaged for every person in the item packaging body 19.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Green space optimization system considering ecological connectivity and green space equality
title_ko: 생태 연계성 및 녹지 형평성을 고려한 녹지 최적화 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system implemented in software in a computer device to select and evaluate an optimal location of a green area in consideration of green area equity and ecological connectivity. Provided is a green area optimization system in consideration of ecological connectivity and green area equity, which includes: a first green area calculation unit for calculating the size and location of the green area required for a city block by calculating the equity of the green area based on the location of the city block and the existing green area; a second green area calculation unit for calculating the size and location of the green area required for the city block based on ecological connectivity; a third green area calculation unit for preventing sporadic green area shapes and calculating the green area shapes required for the city block; and an optimization algorithm calculation unit for deriving the optimized size and location of the green area by applying each object function corresponding to the calculation algorithm of the first green area calculation unit, the second green area calculation unit, and the third green area calculation unit as a multi-purpose function.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 녹지 형평성 및 생태 연계성을 고려하여 녹지의 최적 위치를 선정하여 평가하도록 전산 장치에서 소프트웨어적으로 구현되는 시스템으로서, 도시 블록과 기존 녹지의 위치에 기초한 녹지의 형평성을 계산하여 상기 도시 블록에 요구되는 녹지의 규모 및 위치를 계산하는 제1 녹지 계산부; 생태 연계성에 기초하여 상기 도시 블록에 요구되는 녹지의 규모 및 위치를 계산하는 제2 녹지 계산부; 산발적 녹지 형태를 방지하는 것으로서, 상기 도시 블록에 요구되는 녹지 형태를 계산하는 제3 녹지 계산부; 및 상기 제1 녹지 계산부, 상기 제2 녹지 계산부 및 상기 제3 녹지 계산부의 계산 알고리즘에 해당하는 각각의 목적함수(Object Function)를 다중목적함수로 적용하여 최적화된 녹지의 규모 및 위치를 도출하는 최적화 알고리즘 계산부를 포함하는 생태 연계성 및 녹지 형평성을 고려한 녹지 최적화 시스템을 제공한다.

title_en: Centralized scheduling optimization method, system, equipment and medium for energy storage power station
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of energy storage regulation and control, and discloses a centralized scheduling optimization method, a system, equipment and a medium for an energy storage power station, wherein the method comprises the steps of monitoring a thermal power unit with the control deviation regulation of a region between the energy storage power station and the participation region in real time according to the preset sliding window time to obtain the parameters of the energy storage power station and the parameters of the thermal power unit; based on the energy storage power station parameters and the thermal power unit parameters, the total adjustment rate of the thermal power unit is obtained, the total adjustment rate of the energy storage power station after the rate is limited by the energy storage power station is judged, and the maximum charge/discharge rate constraint of the energy storage power station equipment is combined to obtain the optimized adjustment rate of the energy storage power station. The method can obviously reduce the impact of centralized calling of the energy storage power station on the running stability of the power grid, improves the coordination efficiency of the thermal power unit and the energy storage power station, simultaneously gives attention to fairness and flexibility in an allocation mechanism, meets the real-time scheduling requirement of the spot market, and promotes the efficient application of the energy storage technology in the power grid.

title_en: Apparatus and method for altruistic scheduling based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to an apparatus and method of altruistic scheduling based on reinforcement learning. An altruistic scheduling apparatus according to an embodiment of the present disclosure includes: an external scheduling agent for determining a basic resource share for each process based on information of a resource management system; an internal scheduling agent for determining a basic resource allocation schedule for each process based on information including the basic resource share and a resource leftover based on the basic resource allocation schedule; and a leftover scheduling agent for determining a leftover resource allocation schedule based on information including the resource leftover. According to an embodiment of the present disclosure, it may be expected that reinforcement learning will not only mitigate the diminution of fairness of an altruistic scheduler but also further improve other performance indicators such as completion time and efficiency.

title_en: Seat distributing system for public reading room
abstract_en: The utility model provides a seat distributing system for a public reading room, which belongs to a computer management system and comprises a seat management server. A seat distributing terminal and a seat managing terminal are connected with the seat management server by a wireless gateway, and a manager terminal, a hall broadcasting device and a door control device are respectively connected with the seat management server by an Ethernet. The seat distributing system for the public reading room automatically distributes seats of the public reading room, a user can use the seat distributing terminal to apply for a seat, the door control device of the system controls entry and exit of the user, accordingly, the seats of the public reading room are distributed more efficiently and speedily, the problem that a person occupies multiple seats of the public reading room is avoided, existing seat resources are sufficiently utilized, and service efficiency and service fairness of the seat resources are improved.

title_en: Scheduling method, server and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of scheduling methods, including：The day off and working day of a time interval are set according to default date strategy；It obtains history workload data and the workload of the time interval is predicted according to the history workload data；The workload computing demand manpower obtained according to prediction；And arranged an order according to class and grade within the working day of the setting according to the demand manpower and default constraints, and generate shift report；Wherein, the default constraints hard constraint condition and soft-constraint condition.The present invention also provides a kind of server and computer readable storage mediums.Scheduling method, server and computer readable storage medium provided by the invention may be implemented that staff's individuality demand can be met during arranging an order according to class and grade, and ensure the fairness arranged an order according to class and grade, and improve the working efficiency of employee.
assignees: PING AN TECH SHENZHEN CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network electric power big data transaction management system based on artificial intelligence and block chain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network electric power big data transaction management system based on artificial intelligence and a block chain, wherein an electric quantity intelligent optimization module counts the lack of electric quantity of a power utilization side and the residual electric quantity of the power generation side and generates bilateral transaction, a transaction monitoring module generates a code number for the transaction, a compression storage module packs and processes the transaction amount, the information of the power utilization side, the information of the power generation side and the transaction electric quantity of the bilateral transaction and transmits the transaction amount and the code number generated by a spontaneous transaction monitoring module to the block chain, and a money amount control module searches for the corresponding bilateral transaction in the block chain according to the code number and transmits the transaction amount of the bilateral transaction to a butt joint arrangement module. The invention combines the block chain technology, realizes the storage and the non-falsification of the electric power transaction data, ensures the fairness of the transaction, intelligently optimizes and considers the generation transaction of the power consumption side and the power distribution side in a differentiated matching way, and achieves the maximum benefit.
assignees: WUHAN KEZERUI NEW MATERIAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Self-adaptive answering optimization method and system based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention provides a self-adaptive answering optimization method and system based on reinforcement learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting multi-mode answering signals of students by using a sensor, preprocessing to obtain target signals, and extracting and fusing characteristics; the edge computing node collects target signals to form multi-mode feature data, performs feature fusion on the multi-mode feature data, and builds a reinforcement learning model to prioritize the answering signals; dynamically adjusting the processing sequence and the weight of the answering signal; optimizing a transmission path of the answering signal, and encrypting and decrypting the optical signal generated by the optical self-adaptive optical technology; and the central processing unit receives the decrypted optical signals, processes and analyzes the decrypted optical signals, and sends analysis results to each edge computing node and the user. The invention provides a self-adaptive optical answering fairness optimization system based on reinforcement learning, which effectively solves the problems of signal transmission delay, fairness and safety of the conventional classroom answering system.

title_en: Chemical laboratory equipment whole-flow management method and system
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of experimental equipment management and provides a method and a system for managing the whole process of chemical laboratory equipment, comprising the following steps of receiving an experimental equipment application form, analyzing the experimental equipment application form to determine experimental projects, applicant, application equipment sequences and urgency; the method comprises the steps of receiving an audit passing instruction, entering a queuing mode through a corresponding experimental equipment application form, calling all experimental equipment application forms at each interval set time value, calculating the earliest available time of all experimental equipment in a laboratory, calculating the time concentration degree of the application equipment corresponding to each experimental equipment application form according to the earliest available time, calling the queuing time and the emergency degree of each experimental equipment application form, and distributing the experimental equipment to the experimental equipment application form based on the time concentration degree, the queuing time and the emergency degree. The invention comprehensively considers the factors of time concentration, queuing time and urgency, and realizes the quantitative balance of efficiency and fairness through dynamic adjustment.
assignees: JIANGXI YUAN HAO DETECTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Transaction generation price intelligence technology and AI method based on agricultural supply chain vector metadata
abstract_en: The invention provides a transaction generation price intelligence technology and an AI method based on agricultural supply chain vector metadata, which relate to the technical field of agricultural product transaction. The artificial intelligent transaction price generation topological structure comprises an input layer neuron, a hidden layer neuron and an output layer neuron, wherein the AI system physical component comprises a feedback and optimization module, a multi-stage transaction support module and a modularized interface. The business body can acquire information transaction data in a second level, the transaction business decision is shortened and graded from the heaven, the transaction time is shortened by more than 30%, the transaction cost is reduced by more than 13-46%, and the settlement cost is shortened from a plurality of days to a plurality of hours. The market fairness is enhanced, quotation and transaction mode innovation are realized, and the method has the advantages of universality and low marginal cost.

title_en: Prior investment type performer support system
abstract_en: To provide a prior investment type performer support system which targets at obtaining continuous dividends at a later date regarding a performance presented by a performer, and in which revenues are continuously distributed also to the performer.SOLUTION: A prior investment type performer support system 100 includes: a live relay section 11; an investment receiving section 12; a video recording distribution section 13; a billing section 14; a dividend determining section 15; a communication section 16; and a data storage section 17. In the performer support system 100, the investment receiving section 12 receives, from viewer terminals, purchase applications for dividend rights regarding revenues that are disclosed in a mode where a performance distributed ad hoc generates revenues later. The dividend determining section 15 which determines a dividend for a purchaser of dividend rights from the revenues, determines a dividend on the basis of an equity rate of dividend rights of each purchaser in the case that a plurality of purchasers of the dividend rights exist.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Exercise data processing method and apparatus in equity incentive, device, medium, and product
abstract_en: The present application provides an exercise data processing method and apparatus in equity incentive, a device, a medium, and a product. The method comprises: acquiring a stock deduction exercise request sent by a target client, the stock deduction exercise request comprising a target exercise quantity; and allocating stocks of a target quantity in an account to be vested to an employee account of the target client, updating the quantity of stocks in the employee account according to the target quantity, transferring the stocks of the target quantity in the account to be vested to a vested account, and updating the quantity of stocks in the vested account according to the target quantity, wherein the target quantity is determined by the target exercise quantity and the quantity of stocks used for deducting exercise cost corresponding to the target exercise quantity, the account to be vested is used for escrowing stocks which are not actually allocated to an employee, and the vested account is used for escrowing stocks which are actually allocated to an employee. Thus, the security and accuracy of exercise data during the exercise of employees are improved, the security of an exercise mode of deducting some stocks is ensured, and the stock transaction efficiency is improved.
assignees: SHENZHEN FUTU NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of Wind turbines optimizes progress control method
abstract_en: In a kind of wind power plant, Wind turbines optimizes progress control method, the method is based on surveying wind data and the power margin of ultra-short term wind power prediction data calculating Wind turbines in real time, and the real-time statistics running of wind generating set time, downtime, take into full account operation constraints and the impact of environmental factors of Wind turbines, by the operation queue of Wind turbines, shut down the coordination between queue, exerting oneself wind energy turbine set in satisfied scheduling requires under premise, can ensure that the Wind turbines in wind energy turbine set runs in turn, avoid Wind turbines frequent start-stop simultaneously, improve the fairness of each running of wind generating set.

title_en: Power transmission network double-layer expansion planning method based on primary and secondary energy market clearing results
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transmission grid double-layer expansion planning method based on a primary and secondary energy market clearing result, which comprises the following steps of constructing an upper objective function and an upper constraint condition of an upper planning model by taking the minimum net cost of a distribution network in a planning period as a target, constructing a lower objective function and a lower constraint condition of a lower primary and secondary energy market clearing model by taking the minimum operation net cost of a typical day as the target, and utilizing a KKT condition of the lower primary and secondary energy market clearing model to equivalently convert a double-layer problem into a single-layer linear integer planning problem with balanced constraint for solving. The invention aims to provide a double-layer expansion planning method for a power transmission network based on a clear result of a main and auxiliary energy market, which is used for guaranteeing the supply and demand balanced situation of a power system, reducing the power network blocking and improving the fairness of the power market by using a reasonable power transmission network expansion scheme.

title_en: Multi-level multi-system universal center cooperation platform system and method based on block chain
abstract_en: A multi-level multi-system universal center collaboration platform system and method based on blockchain. The system comprises a plurality of hierarchical nodes forming a flattened structure, when in demand distribution, demand type nodes can issue demand request messages in the system, supply type nodes are matched with information of products of suppliers stored by the supply type nodes according to information of products of demands carried in the demand request messages, and under the condition of being matched with a plurality of suppliers, the suppliers process through a game algorithm to obtain distribution results, the demand type nodes select proper distribution results, a product distribution process based on cooperative competition of a block chain is completed, the system is based on the establishment of the block chain, inverse monopoly is realized macroscopically, microcosmic regulation is determined for different products among the suppliers at the bottom layer, so that macro and microcosmic regulation is realized, market activity and fairness are promoted, resource turnover rate is improved, cooperation cost is reduced, and benefits and enthusiastics of all participants at each level of the market are improved.

title_en: Authorization for auction-competition for orders all-win control method, electric terminal and medium
abstract_en: The present invention provides all-win control method, electric terminal and the medium of a kind of authorization for auction-competition for orders, applied to a logistics platform, the described method includes: according to reverse auction mechanism supplier success competition for orders after or according to positive auction mechanism demander success competition for orders after, platform freezes the auction target volume M1 that demander provides, after the confirmation order taking responsibility for receiving demander or the transmission of demander affiliated party completes information, the psychological M2 that offers of supplier is paid from the auction target volume that demander pays；Obtain the auction target volume of demander's payment and the psychology quotation of supplier, the two profit difference d is obtained according to the psychology quotation of the auction target volume of demander's payment and supplier, and the profit difference is assigned to by the demander, the supplier and the platform according to the default method of salary distribution.In the present invention, by the way that commission platform is reversed or positive auction and client's competition for orders realize the sharing of profits of supplier, demander and platform to reach the all-win that market and competitive mechanisms are combined with social equity benefit.
assignees: SHANGHAI RUNTING ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Civil and biological material unified scheduling and distribution system based on big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a civil and biological material unified scheduling and distributing system based on big data, and relates to the field of logistics transportation. The system comprises an information acquisition unit, a data acquisition unit and a data processing unit, wherein the information acquisition unit is used for acquiring the positions of a plurality of residential points, material demands and redundant materials; the system is also used for acquiring the positions of a plurality of material centers and residual materials; the dispatching distribution center is used for summarizing the positions of the residential points, the material demands, the redundant materials, the positions of the material centers and the residual materials to obtain an information summarizing result; and distributing the residual materials of the material center and the redundant materials of the residential points to the residential points which put forward the material demands according to the information summarizing result. According to the invention, through data collection and material distribution of logistics personnel, the problem of transmission of big data of material scheduling is solved, and the problem that civil disaster relief materials cannot be reasonably distributed is effectively avoided.
assignees: JIAYUAN JIAXING INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Electric power system load side carbon responsibility accounting system, method and medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a system, a method and a medium for accounting carbon responsibility at the load side of an electric power system, wherein a system power flow calculation module of the system is used for obtaining active power flow distribution and network loss of each branch of the electric power system; the net loss fair allocation model module is used for calculating the net loads of the system and the net output force of each unit according to the active power flow distribution; the secondary power flow calculation module is used for constructing a virtual lossless network, carrying out secondary power flow calculation on the virtual lossless network by adopting a direct current power flow calculation method, and determining the time-by-time carbon emission condition of each load member of the system; the total carbon emission amount calculation module is used for obtaining the monthly carbon responsibility amount, the typical electricity consumption amount and the typical carbon intensity of each load member; the final carbon responsibility calculation module is used for correcting the typical electricity consumption of each load member to obtain a final carbon responsibility calculation result. The invention considers the influence of the network loss of the system and the peak load characteristic of the user on the carbon emission of the system, solves the problem of insufficient fairness of the past accounting result, and improves the accuracy of responsibility calculation.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD HUZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: Salary budgeting method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the field of salary budgeting, and in particular, to a salary budgeting method, apparatus, computer device and storage medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining task configuration data and a pay settlement mode of a target dispatcher, wherein the task configuration data comprise a delivery area, a new configuration time range of a new delivery task and an old configuration time range of an old delivery task, determining a time range to be released of the target task according to the new configuration time range and the old configuration time range, generating a budget application form corresponding to the new delivery task according to the new configuration time range, the pay settlement mode and all delivery areas, generating a budget release form corresponding to the target task according to the time range to be released, the pay settlement mode and all delivery areas, and determining pay budget data according to the budget application form and the budget release form. The invention considers the distribution area, the salary settlement mode and the new and old configuration time ranges, ensures the fairness of budget release and reasonably distributes the budget resources.

title_en: AGV charging pile distribution method and system based on dynamic graph neural network and PSO optimization
abstract_en: The invention provides an AGV charging pile distribution method and system based on a dynamic graph neural network and PSO optimization, and belongs to the technical field of AGV charging control. The method comprises the steps of obtaining operation data of a charging pile and an AGV, extracting time sequence features of the operation data by using a sliding window technology, reducing dimensions by means of principal component analysis, taking the charging pile and the AGV as nodes in a graph, taking a charging request and a state as edges, updating the node features by using a cross-layer graph attention mechanism, combining a self-attention mechanism and a multi-head attention mechanism, fusing different features, and respectively optimizing charging speed and user fairness by using a multi-branch neural network. And further optimizing a neural network architecture through a PSO algorithm to generate a final charging pile distribution scheme. The method solves the problem of insufficient multi-objective collaborative optimization, reduces the AGV charging waiting time, improves the system resource utilization rate and the user fairness, and is suitable for large-scale AGV cluster intelligent charging management.
assignees: LIYANG RESEARCH INSTITUTE SOUTHEAST UNIV;UNIV NANJING POSTS & TELECOMMUNICATIONS

title_en: Method and device for deciding cross-region river water flow distribution with balanced fairness and stability
abstract_en: The invention discloses a decision method and a decision device for cross-regional river water flow distribution with balanced fairness and stability, which comprise the steps of obtaining basic information data of cross-regional river water flow distribution, adopting a bankruptcy theory rule to generate a plurality of water distribution schemes, each water distribution scheme comprises water resource shares corresponding to each regional main body respectively, respectively obtaining fairness indexes and stability indexes of each water distribution scheme based on a base index and a Charpy-Shu Bike power index, adopting a game theory method to generate a combined index of the fairness indexes and the stability indexes of each water distribution scheme, and sequencing all water distribution schemes based on the combined index to obtain an optimal water distribution scheme. On the basis of the principles of quantized fairness and stability, the method adopts a game theory method to aggregate the two, and provides a practical and feasible water allocation strategy for solving the cross-region river water allocation conflict under the water shortage situation.

title_en: Methanol fuel supply risk early warning method and system for ship
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of ships and discloses a methanol fuel supply risk early warning method and a methanol fuel supply risk early warning system for ships, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining real-time environment state information of ships and running state data of methanol fuel supply system equipment, and preprocessing to obtain smoothed running state sequence data; the method comprises the steps of calculating a window boundary value of a replenishment time point, identifying an operation stable section corresponding to a stable environment, determining an initial replenishment time point, monitoring the liquid level change rate of a daily tank for methanol, adjusting conveying parameters to obtain a first conveying parameter set if the liquid level change rate exceeds a threshold value, calculating the strength of a route mutation signal, correcting the replenishment window boundary value if the threshold value exceeds the threshold value, generating fusion data by fusing real-time liquid level fluctuation and the corrected window value, determining a safe conveying reference for the methanol, generating a control instruction set under the reference constraint, and executing methanol supply allocation. By the technical scheme, the suitability of the supply opportunity and the route working condition is improved.
assignees: HUBEI HONGYI INTELLIGENT EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Load side carbon emission-oriented comprehensive energy system energy carbon optimization scheduling method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a load side carbon emission oriented comprehensive energy system energy carbon optimization scheduling method and system, which are used for constructing a multi-energy subsystem unified model based on operation constraint and energy balance relation of an electric subsystem, a natural gas subsystem and a thermodynamic subsystem, combining the multi-energy subsystem unified model, taking node carbon potential as a decision variable, establishing a cross-subsystem carbon flow equation based on a carbon flow theory and a ladder type carbon emission transaction mechanism, constructing a load side carbon emission responsibility quantification model, calculating load side carbon emission responsibility based on the load side carbon emission responsibility quantification model, acquiring a scheduling scheme, and realizing system establishment by the method. According to the invention, an actual carbon emission model is refined to load side nodes, a linearization framework is constructed, the model is unified into a linear programming problem, the feasibility and the precision of model solving are effectively balanced, a support is provided for a carbon transaction system in a market environment, a node-level carbon settlement mechanism improves the transparency and fairness of carbon accounting, and a new idea is provided for carbon transaction.

title_en: System and method for optimizing product development portfolios and integrating product strategy with brand strategy
abstract_en: A business and software method to cost-effectively optimize product and/or service development portfolios, to reduce time to market, and to better integrate and align product or service strategy with brand strategy. The business and software method includes defining in detail the product and service attributes that characterize the ideal customer experience, categorizing the attributes, assigning a numerical value of importance to the attributes, and applying those values to statistical analysis of each assessed product development initiative in terms of alignment with ideal experience and potential competitive impact relative to the resources and risks required to bring each initiative to market. A prioritization for product development resource allocation is developed based upon these analyses. The prioritization is presented in the form of decision intelligence tools for an organization to use and reach informed judgments concerning resource allocation to develop, maintain, or optimize a given product or service portfolio. The decision intelligence tools serve to improve business performance, increase market impact, and build brand equity for products and services of a given organization by improving alignment between what the organization promises customers and what it actually delivers.

title_en: Cross-region water resource allocation method based on two-stage asymmetric Nash-master-slave game model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cross-region water resource allocation method based on a two-stage asymmetric Nash-master-slave game model, which comprises the following steps: acquiring basic information data of water resource distribution; constructing a model of the upper leader; providing an improved lower-layer follower conservative income calculation method based on a yield-breaking theory principle; providing a comprehensive negotiation weight determination method comprehensively considering fairness and high efficiency principles; an asymmetric Nash-Haishani negotiation model for the lower tier followers was constructed. The cross-regional water resource allocation method based on the two-stage asymmetric Nash-master-slave game model, which considers the priority among participants and the direct and indirect interaction, can provide a reasonable and feasible water resource allocation result, the improved participant conservative income calculation method based on the bankruptcy theory principle can guarantee the basic water demand requirement of the lower-layer followers, and the proposed negotiation weight balances the economic and social development level among the lower-layer followers.

title_en: Distributed energy scheduling method for interconnected multi-park comprehensive energy system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed energy scheduling method of an interconnected multi-park comprehensive energy system, which comprises the following steps of establishing an equipment output model; the method comprises the steps of establishing a comprehensive demand response model, establishing a garden interval waste heat interaction and electric energy interaction model, establishing a garden energy balance constraint model, establishing a multi-garden comprehensive energy system objective function by taking the minimum total running cost as a target, and solving the objective function by utilizing a regularized alternate direction multiplier algorithm containing a self-adaptive step link. The invention establishes a waste heat interaction model, an electric energy interaction model and a comprehensive demand response model, improves energy utilization efficiency and scheduling flexibility, carries out distributed solution on a multi-park comprehensive energy system scheduling model through a regularized alternate direction multiplier algorithm containing self-adaptive step length links, can prevent the excessive freedom of a solving process while guaranteeing fairness of the subproblems through regularization, can improve convergence speed of the algorithm through adding the self-adaptive step length links, and can protect privacy of each park in an iterative process through distributed solution.

title_en: Elevator operation control method and system based on optimized elevator operation strategy
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of elevator operation, in particular to an elevator operation control method and system based on an optimized elevator operation strategy. An elevator operation control system based on an optimized elevator operation strategy comprises a call request information acquisition module, an elevator operation task management module, an elevator agent game module, a task sequence updating module and an elevator operation strategy execution module. The method and the system realize request priority ordering through task value weighted evaluation, can improve response sensitivity of a dispatching system to key requests, optimize resource allocation sequence, ensure service fairness and timeliness of users at different floors in peak periods, carry out disturbance value game analysis on target tasks through a plurality of elevator agents, execute the target tasks by optimizing an elevator with the least disturbance, and ensure that task insertion has the least influence on the original path, thereby improving overall dispatching efficiency and path utilization rate.

title_en: Dynamic adjustment method for electricity utilization priority of intelligent cabin equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent cabin energy management and power consumption scheduling control, and discloses a dynamic adjustment method of power consumption priority of intelligent cabin equipment. The method comprises the steps of uniformly numbering all devices, collecting power requirements, minimum continuous power supply duration, categories and request states, screening out real needed devices in the current period according to a fixed period, counting average power and reference duration, combining the categories, relative power and relative duration to generate bidding factors, sequencing the factors, performing prefix accumulation allocation according to allocable power, giving priority to form a record list, recursively delaying counting for the devices which are not allocated continuously at the end of the period, setting a forced threshold, ensuring fairness at the front of the next period, executing on-off instructions, identifying the devices which are not requested for a long time after clearing, meeting conditions, re-incorporating and circularly advancing.

title_en: Accelerating data-driven scientific discovery
abstract_en: Techniques facilitating using a distribution system for incentivizing and accelerating data driven scientific research are described herein. The distribution system can track the input of various parties involved in scientific research, and when a reward, monetary or otherwise, is realized for one or more outcomes of the scientific research, the distribution system can distribute the reward among the parties that provided the input. The relative levels and contributions of the parties can be tracked to ensure that an equitable portioning of the reward is realized. A directed graph can be formed based on the transactions, wherein the nodes correspond to entities, researchers, publications, and the edges correspond to relationships between the entities. The directed graph can be analyzed to determine the relative or absolute levels of contributions from each of the entities, and the rewards can be distributed based on the contribution levels.

title_en: Method for regulating and controlling power consumption of large industrial users at different time intervals
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for regulating and controlling power consumption of large industrial users at different time intervals, which comprises the following steps: calculating long-term increment cost values of the transmission and distribution network; calculating the current value of the cost of the transmission and distribution network borne by each voltage class user; calculating the power transmission and distribution value of each voltage class; calculating a time-sharing transmission and distribution power price demand elastic matrix; and calculating the time-sharing power transmission and distribution value of each voltage class. The method can automatically calculate the power transmission and distribution prices of large industrial users with different voltage grades in different regions according to the long-term marginal cost of the power distribution network in each region, and on the basis, the time-sharing power transmission and distribution prices of the large industrial users are calculated according to the time-sharing power transmission and distribution price demand elastic matrix, so that the problem that each provincial power grid company designs the time-sharing power transmission and distribution prices meeting the local region demand according to the local region actual situation is solved. Efficiency and fairness can be considered, the demand of power consumers can be effectively adjusted, peak clipping and valley filling are realized, and the problem of blockage of a transmission and distribution network is relieved to a certain degree.
assignees: ECONOMIC RES INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID SHANXI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Rights and interests distribution system and method based on cone block chain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rights and interests distribution system and a rights and interests distribution method based on a cone block chain, wherein the system comprises the following steps: the task issuing module is used for receiving the work tasks sent by the rights and interests main body and uploading the work tasks to the consensus storage module; the authentication module is used for performing real-time identity authentication on the rights and interests person and uploading identity authentication information to the consensus storage module; the equity examination module is used for receiving the work tasks selected by the authenticated equity people and the corresponding work task contributions, and automatically carrying out workload evaluation and equity distribution on the contributions uploaded by the equity people according to an equity examination intelligent contract; and the consensus storage module is used for storing the task information, the identity authentication information, the workload evaluation information and the rights and interests allocation information in a cone block chain associated block in a consensus mode. The invention makes each rights and interests person form the interest correlation body through consensus, can realize real-time sharing of rights and interests distribution information and information transparentization, and has the advantages of energy saving and low cost.
assignees: SHANXI TEXIN HUANYU INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-target dynamic water resource optimal allocation method based on improved NSGA III algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-target dynamic water resource optimal allocation method based on an improved NSGAIII algorithm, which relates to the technical field of water resource management and comprises the following steps: s1, making a hypothesis for a water resource of a flow field and a manager decision; s2, determining objective functions, namely, maximally improving the economic benefit of water consumption in each period, maximally realizing regional water fairness, and maximally improving the water resource allocation efficiency in each period of the river basin to achieve the aim; s3, considering constraint conditions of water resource optimization configuration, and respectively taking available water resource limitation, limitation of water consumption of a partition i, drainage basin economic efficiency loss limitation, ecological environment water limitation, water demand limitation, state transition equation and non-negative variable as constraint limits to be considered; s4, combining the objective function with constraint conditions to obtain a global model of multi-objective multi-stage dynamic planning considering uncertainty risk and randomness; s5, solving the proposed dynamic multi-objective optimization model by adopting a multi-objective evolutionary algorithm NSGAIII.

title_en: Civilization construction unified platform for basic-level electronic government affairs
abstract_en: The invention discloses a civilization construction unified platform for basic-level e-government affairs, which particularly relates to the field of a data system, and comprises an application information acquisition module, an information preprocessing module, a service module, a database module, a management platform and a man-machine interaction module, wherein the application information acquisition module comprises an informationized dispatching center, the informationized dispatching center is used for the civilization information management optimization treatment, the management platform comprises a practice management unit and a background operation management unit, the background operation management unit is an informationized management unit for preparing operations based on the early stage of practice activities, and the practice management unit is a construction unit for the practice management process of the activities; the invention helps the quick judgment and quick assignment of the public problems based on the data judgment, ensures the fairness of informatization processing, reduces human interference, realizes the high efficiency of informatization realization data, and realizes the real-time feedback of the mutual assistance process by the platform, the progress is transparent and open, thereby reversely promoting the staff to effectively and truly solve the public problems.

title_en: New energy base resource adjustment and allocation method and device
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of peak shaving auxiliary service of an electric power system, and particularly provides a new energy base resource adjustment and allocation method and device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: calculating peak regulation total cost of each new energy type based on historical output data of power generation resources of each new energy base in the area to be allocated; according to the peak regulation total cost of each new energy type, carrying out cost allocation on each new energy base under each new energy type; and according to the cost allocation result of each new energy base, carrying out cost allocation on each station under each new energy base. According to the technical scheme provided by the application, the cost allocation of the new energy bases of various new energy types is realized, the fairness of the cost allocation of the new energy bases is improved, the calculated amount of calculation allocation cost is reduced, and the method has strong practicability.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;NORTHWEST BRANCH OF STATE GRID CORP OF CHINA;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Water supply allocation method for water supply plant
abstract_en: The application discloses a water supply allocation method for a water supply plant, which comprises the following steps: determining population density, water demand type and water supply network distribution data of a plurality of subarea water supply areas of the water supply area; if the water supply area comprises a first water supply area, predicting the water consumption of each subarea water supply area according to the population density and the water demand type of each subarea water supply area; inputting population density, water demand type and water consumption into a regression analysis model to obtain predicted water supply quantity of each subarea water supply area; inputting population density, water demand type and water consumption into a regression analysis model to obtain predicted water supply pressure of each subarea water supply area; and obtaining the operation water supply quantity and the operation water supply pressure of each subarea water supply area in a fixed time period according to the maximum water supply pressure of the water supply plant, the maximum water supply quantity of the water supply plant, the distribution data of the water supply network, the predicted water supply quantity and the predicted water supply pressure. And water supply allocation is reasonably carried out.
assignees: SHANDONG INSPUR ZHISHUI DIGITAL TECH CO LTD;INSPUR SMART TECH CO LTD

title_en: New energy automobile charging station monitored control system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent charging network management and new energy automobile support systems, in particular to a new energy automobile charging station monitoring system. In the invention, the energy management module adopting the convolutional neural network and the long-term and short-term memory network improves the power demand and the power grid load prediction accuracy and improves the energy utilization rate. The safety early warning module combines a support vector machine, a decision tree and an isolated forest algorithm, so that the system safety is improved. In the aspect of pricing optimization, charging prices are adjusted according to power grid loads and user demands by using an ARIMA model and a Q learning algorithm, so that fairness and market response are improved. The charging scheduling module improves and adopts linear programming and genetic algorithm, and charging efficiency is improved. The data acquisition and processing analysis module is upgraded to provide comprehensive and accurate monitoring data.
assignees: GUANGDONG LINKJOY ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for generating college entrance examination football score based on neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of sports score evaluation, in particular to a method and a system for generating a football score of a middle school examination based on a neural network, which comprises the following steps: based on the athlete's basic data and game performance data, a data envelope analysis model is used to analyze various inputs of the athlete, a random front analysis model is used to process random fluctuations in the data, an efficiency front is constructed, and an efficiency analysis result is generated. According to the invention, through the technologies of fusion data envelope analysis, complex event processing, hypothesis testing, information theory analysis, gradient elevator algorithm, neural symbol learning, ensemble learning and the like, the objectivity, timeliness and accuracy of sports score evaluation are improved. The techniques enable key events in the game to be captured in real time and rapidly update the performance data of the athlete, ensure that the scoring system can instantly reflect the actual performance of the athlete, optimize the scoring criteria by applying hypothesis testing and confidence interval estimation, and enhance the fairness of the scoring process.
assignees: GUAGNZHOU HUAXIA HUIHAI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Distributed multi-energy transaction method based on aggregated game strategy
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed multi-energy transaction method based on an aggregate game strategy, which comprises the following steps: constructing a distributed multi-energy transaction system, and participating in real-time sharing and information interaction among the main bodies; an energy trading platform is built and used for matching energy trading among all participating subjects, and real-time monitoring and analysis of trading data are provided; the participating main body formulates an aggregate game strategy according to own interests and targets; the energy trading platform realizes automatic matching and optimal configuration of energy trading; and (3) establishing a strict supervision mechanism, and monitoring and evaluating the transaction process in real time. The transaction method provided by the invention has the advantages and effects of high-efficiency resource allocation, fairness guarantee, flexibility and adaptability, stability and sustainability, technical innovation and application, user experience improvement, safety improvement and the like. The advantages and the beneficial effects lead the invention to have wide application prospect and market competitiveness in the field of distributed multi-energy transaction.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD

title_en: Automatic distribution and management system for digital member rights based on block chain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a blockchain-based digital member equity automatic distribution and management system, which relates to the technical field of digital member equity management and comprises a state fingerprint generation module, a state abstract communication module, a consistency feature extraction module, a consistency risk assessment module and an intelligent contract delay control and rollback module, wherein the state fingerprint generation module extracts key parameters representing the current blockchain state from a chain account book unit and a consensus unit, performs feature coding, hash compression and instruction stream abstract modeling on the key parameters, and forms a state fingerprint which uniquely identifies the current node chain state. The intelligent delay and rollback control of key equity issuing on the chain is realized through the state fingerprint comparison and the support vector machine risk assessment mechanism, the issuing accuracy and the system stability under abnormal states are improved, and the false issuing, missed issuing and repeated issuing risks are effectively prevented.
assignees: HEFEI LIANSHI DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Resource allocation method of non-dominant ordering genetic algorithm containing heuristic information
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of space resource allocation of relocation optimization of old urban areas, in particular to a resource allocation method of a non-dominant ordering genetic algorithm containing heuristic information. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a comprehensive living quality score of a current land block, selecting candidate migration land blocks, calculating compensation amount of each candidate migration land block, constructing a multi-target migration optimization model comprising the compensation amount, introducing heuristic information to correct decision variables, solving the multi-target migration model by using a non-dominant sorting genetic algorithm, and calculating the final migration land block. The invention designs the candidate migration plots and the migration compensation strategy based on the plot comprehensive scoring difference, and ensures the fairness and acceptability of migration. Meanwhile, by introducing a non-dominant ordering genetic algorithm containing heuristic information, the multi-objective intelligent relocation optimization model is solved, and high-quality solutions can be effectively searched under the condition that the dimension and the search range of the solution are remarkably reduced.

title_en: Road traffic resource allocation fairness measurement method
abstract_en: The invention provides a road traffic resource allocation fairness measuring method, which is characterized in that a Kanberga index-based road traffic resource allocation measurement model is established according to the road area occupied by people in different travel modes, quantitative evaluation of the Kanberga index is applied, and the Kanberga index of a city is calculated from the perspective of traffic fairness among the road areas occupied by people in various traffic modes, so that the fairness of road traffic resource allocation in different districts is measured, a realistic basis is provided for solving the problem of resident travel fairness, the travel service guarantee work is facilitated to be effectively carried out, and government-related departments can make effective decisions according to the evaluation results, guide government organization management strategies to be improved, and promote the operation efficiency to be improved.

title_en: Emergency water supply allocation method for large-range long-duration drought
abstract_en: The invention provides an emergency water supply allocation method for large-range long-duration drought, which comprises the steps of classifying and identifying conventional water sources and emergency water sources of allocation units in a drought region; selecting an emergency water supply allocation mode according to different drought degrees; calculating and analyzing the water supply and demand of each allocation unit under different drought degrees; formulating the water source and water user drought emergency water supply allocation rule under different allocation modes of each allocation unit; the method comprises the steps of constructing a double-layer large-range long-duration drought emergency water supply allocation model by taking the minimum integral water shortage, the minimum integral disaster damage and economic cost and the minimum deviation between the actual water storage capacity of a reservoir and the target water storage capacity as targets, wherein the model comprises a data input module, a drought degree evaluation module, a water supply and demand module and an optimized allocation module. The method can improve the emergency water supply allocation efficiency, fairness and sustainability under the drought condition.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Multi-terminal collaborative intelligent scheduling platform and method for flexible labor management
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent scheduling platform and method for multi-terminal cooperation of flexible labor management, in particular to the technical field of labor management, comprising the following steps of carrying out work scheduling according to flexible labor requirements by a preset scheduling rule algorithm and generating scheduling schedule forms of each time; and in each scheduling period, the fairness and rationality of the work arrangement are evaluated by extracting the feature set influencing the scheduling, an evaluation report is generated, and whether the scheduling rule algorithm is optimized or not is determined according to the evaluation report and a feedback signal. In the optimization process, an optimization scheme is designed through a feedback signal, a scheduling algorithm is trained in an iteration mode, so that the scheduling algorithm is better adapted to the labor requirement, the work distribution is guaranteed to be more fair and reasonable, and the optimized algorithm is applied to scheduling of the next period.

title_en: Fire-fighting power supply control system with electric quantity allocation function and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting power supply control system with an electric quantity allocation function and a control method thereof, which belong to the technical field of electric quantity allocation of fire-fighting power supplies and comprise a power supply and a controller, wherein the controller comprises a data acquisition module, a fire-fighting power supply control module, a data processing unit and a dynamic power supply allocation strategy module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for collecting power supply data and fire scene data, the fire-fighting power supply control module is connected with the data acquisition module, is internally provided with a real-time data analysis algorithm and is used for receiving the data transmitted by the data acquisition module and analyzing the conditions of each area in the emergency of a fire, and the data processing unit is electrically connected with the fire-fighting power supply control module and is used for rapidly processing the output result of the real-time data analysis algorithm and identifying the key areas of fire spreading and the demand priority of fire-fighting equipment.

title_en: Quality inspection bill distribution method, device and equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a quality inspection list distribution method, a device and equipment, belonging to the technical field of computers, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a plurality of quality inspection lists to be distributed and distribution rules of the plurality of quality inspection lists, wherein the distribution rules are associated with quality inspection requirements; the quality inspection method comprises the steps of sequentially distributing quality inspection sheets to each quality inspector according to a plurality of quality inspection sheets until the sum of quality inspection time periods corresponding to the quality inspection sheets distributed to a first quality inspector reaches a first preset time period, sequencing unallocated quality inspection sheets in the plurality of quality inspection sheets according to a distribution rule to obtain at least one target sequence, distributing the quality inspection sheets to each quality inspector again according to the arrangement sequence of the quality inspection sheets in the at least one target sequence, and enabling the sum of the quality inspection time periods corresponding to the quality inspection sheets distributed to each quality inspector to be not smaller than a second preset time period, wherein the second preset time period is longer than the first preset time period. Therefore, the distribution efficiency and the distribution fairness of the quality inspection bill can be improved, and the labor cost is reduced.
assignees: YUANBAO KECHUANG BEIJING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Green energy-saving building planning method and system based on big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a green energy-saving building planning method and system based on big data, which relate to the technical field of building energy-saving planning and information, in user behavior analysis, dynamic influence of user behavior on energy consumption is accurately quantified by collecting and comparing data such as historical energy consumption of a building, active temperature adjustment times and the like, mechanical refrigeration with insufficient passive design and active temperature adjustment energy consumption of a user are distinguished in refrigeration energy consumption prediction, influence of climate change on building refrigeration is treated in a prospective manner, a green planning index containing renewable energy power generation capacity, refrigeration energy consumption and microclimate temperature rise is constructed in a planning stage, comprehensive unified indexes of emission reduction mean value and standard deviation are introduced in an evaluation link, carbon fairness is quantified, balance of regional low-carbon targets is guaranteed, a systematic scientific path is provided for green building planning through multi-source data fusion, energy consumption coupling modeling and regional collaborative optimization, and adaptability and sustainability of planning are effectively improved.
assignees: HANGZHOU DEYUN CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Multi-park comprehensive energy system optimal operation method considering energy mutual-aid contribution degree
abstract_en: A multi-park comprehensive energy system optimization operation method considering energy mutual contribution degree comprises the steps of establishing a multi-park comprehensive energy system key equipment model, including a cogeneration unit model, other energy conversion equipment models and energy storage equipment models formed by an electric refrigerating unit and an absorption refrigerating unit, establishing a multi-park comprehensive energy system cooperative game optimization model, including an objective function formed by total cost C of a cooperative alliance formed by N parks, constraint conditions formed by alliance energy supply and demand constraint, energy purchasing constraint, equipment power constraint and energy storage equipment constraint, and distributing the total cost C of the cooperative alliance by utilizing an improved shape method. The model for minimizing the total cost of the alliance, which is built by the invention, comprehensively considers the operation constraint of the energy conversion equipment and the energy storage equipment and the energy interaction among parks, effectively realizes the collaborative optimization operation of MCIES, ensures the fairness and the rationality of the alliance benefit distribution, and enhances the stability of the alliance.
assignees: NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER UNIV BAODING

title_en: Expressway service area charging pile configuration method and system integrating power allocation and multi-agent system
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a system for configuring a charging pile of a highway service area by combining power allocation and a multi-agent system. According to the application, the new energy automobile runs on the expressway and the charging behavior is simulated and described through an Agent-based Model (ABM), and the charging pile arrangement scheme is optimized by utilizing a multi-objective optimization algorithm. The application not only considers the charging demand end of the interaction of the vehicle-road-charging pile on the basis of the multi-agent system, but also establishes a power allocation system (charging supply end) of the power grid-service area-charging pile, allocates the power of the service vehicle under the maximum load power of the power grid, establishes a set of allocation rules under the consideration of fairness and integral effect, and optimizes the configuration of the charging pile in the expressway service area by combining the existing optimization algorithm so as to realize the aims of meeting the charging demand of users and optimizing the resource configuration.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG;ZHEJIANG JIAOGONG HONGTU TRAFFIC CONSTRUCTION CO LTD

title_en: Three-stage thermal power generating unit capacity electricity price spot check optimization method, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-stage thermal power generating unit capacity electricity price spot check optimizing method, equipment and medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining short-term prediction data before D days; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a D day optimal spot check number according to the D day short-term prediction data, constructing a spot check optimizing function of a thermal power unit, and solving to obtain details of the D day spot check unit to be spot checked. Aiming at the problems of rigidification of the existing fixed spot check time period, no consideration of maintenance of the unit and the like, the invention can screen out the optimal time period to execute spot check on the premise of ensuring the maximum consumption of new energy, dynamically adjust the spot check unit number according to ultra-short term prediction data, and realize the coordination and optimization of the safety and economic scheduling of the power grid and the spot check fairness by introducing a spot check penalty function.

title_en: Method and system of prioritization for managing manufacturing processes
abstract_en: A system and method are disclosed for prioritizing a plurality of lots in a manufacturing process. Portions of a priority for each lot are created. The portions are combined to form a unique range priority for each lot. The range priorities may be used to equitable compare all of the active lots in a fabrication facility. The system and method may be implemented as part of a range management system.

title_en: Distributed photovoltaic distribution and storage method based on block chain
abstract_en: The invention relates to a distributed photovoltaic distribution and storage method based on a block chain, which comprises the following steps: constructing a distributed photovoltaic energy storage configuration block chain architecture, and performing block chain winding and storage on user data; establishing a distribution and storage demand degree evaluation mechanism based on the user data to acquire the distribution and storage demand degree of the user; and triggering an intelligent contract to generate a distribution and storage scheme and a distribution and storage equity grade based on the distribution and storage demand degree of the user, and selecting the distribution and storage scheme by the user to distribute and install the energy storage device. The invention establishes a public and transparent distributed photovoltaic distribution and storage method by using the block chain, takes real user data as an evaluation standard, preferentially provides the shortage of energy storage batteries to users with high distribution and storage requirements, greatly improves the fairness of the distribution and storage process, reduces the resource waste caused by improper competition, and contributes to accelerating the construction of the distributed photovoltaic reasonable distribution and storage and realizing the aim of 'double carbon'.

title_en: Capacity cost compensation method and device for power grid side energy storage power station
abstract_en: The invention relates to a capacity cost compensation method and device for a power grid side energy storage power station, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining relevant data of the power grid side energy storage power station in the current year; analyzing the related data based on an operation mode of the power grid side energy storage power station, and determining annual unit capacity cost of the power grid side energy storage power station; according to the annual unit capacity cost and the preset compensation degree, determining annual capacity cost to be compensated of the power grid energy storage power station and a power distribution standard of each distribution object; and determining monthly capacity cost compensation logic of the power grid side energy storage power station for allocation and settlement according to the power allocation standard of each allocation object. The technical scheme provided by the invention can more accurately quantitatively analyze the capacity cost of the power grid side energy storage power station, and ensure the fairness and rationality of the capacity cost compensation standard verification.
assignees: STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;BEIJING TSINTERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic distribution method for arid period river basin water quantity
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic water distribution method for a arid period river basin, which comprises the following steps: dividing a river basin into a plurality of distribution units according to a water resource partition nested administrative region, and dividing a hydrologic forecasting period into a plurality of time periods from front to back at equal intervals in sequence; setting a particle group comprising a plurality of storage allocation unit water allocation scheme particles, wherein the particles comprise a position tensor and a speed tensor; calculating fairness balance of water distribution based on satisfaction of water distribution, calculating total energy output efficiency based on energy output of various water consumption, and constructing a particle fitness function by combining drought control factors; determining a water distribution scheme of the current period through iterative calculation optimizing of particle fitness; and configuring the water consumption of the river basin in the current period, and then circularly starting the water distribution scheme in the next period to optimize. The method and the system realize the dynamic distribution of the water quantity of the river basin by combining with real-time hydrologic forecast, fully coordinate the fairness, balance and efficiency of the water distribution of the river basin in the drought period, and provide reference for the regulation and control of the water resource of the river basin in the drought period.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Intelligent analysis method for accounting subjects in financial data based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent analysis method of accounting subjects in financial data based on machine learning, which relates to the field of financial data analysis and comprises the following steps: p1: acquiring financial data; p2: data identification and classification; p3: abnormality analysis; p4: risk analysis; p5: checking abnormal vocabulary entries; the association degree of the entry and the meeting and accounting purposes can be more accurately estimated by setting feature words and calculating important scores by using a TF-IDF algorithm, so that the classification accuracy is improved, and the automatic classification of the entry and the meeting and accounting purposes is realized; through sorting and selecting the early warning entries, the potential risk caused by missed examination of high-risk entries is reduced, the timely processing and examination of key abnormal entries are ensured, and the possible problems of financial inaccuracy or violation are avoided; meanwhile, the priority value is obtained through analysis according to the processing efficiency of each processing person, and the cyclic scheduling distribution is carried out according to the priority value, so that the efficiency and fairness of task distribution can be realized, and the overall processing efficiency is improved.
assignees: JIANGSU TAX SOFTWARE TECH CO LTD

title_en: House type confirmation and house area increasing purchase solving method applied to shed improvement project
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for confirming house type and solving house area increasing purchase applied to a shed changing project, which relates to the technical field of shed changing and comprises the steps of forming an alternative house type of shed changing and returning to a resident aiming at the total returning area of shed changing and returning to the resident; the method comprises the steps of obtaining confirmation conditions of the shed-changing and returning households for alternative house types, updating house types of a built shed-changing and returning house, obtaining house type requirements of the shed-changing and returning households, forming modified house types of the shed-changing and returning households according to the house type requirements, obtaining confirmation conditions of the shed-changing and returning households for the modified house types, numbering the shed-changing and returning households, and selecting the shed-changing and returning households which are not returned from the house types of the shed-changing and returning house according to the numbering sequence to obtain the final house types. The reasonability and the relative fairness of the allocation scheme are ensured by forming the alternative house type of the shed-changing-back resident, forming the modified house type of the shed-changing-back resident and obtaining the final house type, so that the shed-changing project can be normally propelled.
assignees: SHENZHEN GUOFANGYUN DATA TECH SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Data processing method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data processing method and device, and relates to the field of warehouse logistics. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a delivery bill, screening delivery single file data of cross-region delivery from the delivery bill, determining purchase application line data matched with each delivery single file data, obtaining the allocable shortage number of each purchase application line data, comparing the allocable shortage number with the delivery number of each delivery single file data, determining the hit delivery number of each purchase application line data according to a comparison result, updating the allocable shortage number, and determining whether the cross-region delivery of each delivery single file data is caused by the shortage of an upstream supply warehouse according to a processing result. According to the embodiment, whether transregional delivery is caused by the shortage of the upstream delivery warehouse can be determined, the intelligent responsibility division closed loop is realized, the judgment precision and efficiency are obviously improved, and the fairness and reliability of transregional delivery responsibility definition are optimized.
assignees: BEIJING JINGDONG YUANSHENG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for distributing initial water right of river basin across provinces
