abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for distributing initial water right of a river basin across provinces, wherein the method comprises the following steps: reading water resource survey data of river basin crossing provinces, and obtaining and analyzing a representative hydrological series capable of reflecting withering changes and current underlying surface conditions; acquiring basic data of river basin across provinces, wherein the basic data comprises water resource development and utilization data, economic and social data and ecological environment data; obtaining an evaluation index of an evaluation index system for constructing initial water resource distribution across provinces, rivers and watersheds, and reducing the evaluation index; and constructing an SMAA-VIKOR initial water weight distribution model, solving, and obtaining the initial water weight distribution proportion of each provincial administrative region. The invention can improve the water resource distribution precision and fairness across provincial river basins.

title_en: A kind of distribute leaflets method of the instant task of Hospital Logistic wisdom delivery system
abstract_en: A kind of distribute leaflets method of the instant task of Hospital Logistic wisdom delivery system, comprises the following steps：1) arrange that Bluetooth beacon, by network configuration into the basic network connection mode for being based on multi-user, by detection signal intensity, the positional information for transporting work is obtained by triangle polyester fibre algorithm by hospital；2) decision model is built；3) busy value M is calculated；4) meet distribute leaflets requirement when busy value M is negative, when M values are positive number the workman not as suggestion distribute leaflets object, selecting the transport work of busy value M minimum carries out distribute leaflets.The invention provides a kind of dispatching efficiency it is higher, operating efficiency is higher, the instant task distribute leaflets method of the preferable Hospital Logistic wisdom delivery system of fairness.
assignees: HANGZHOU YIHAO NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of distribution method of task, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: It is that identification information corresponding with target operation task is determined from pre-set task data sheet after getting target operation task this application discloses a kind of task distribution method；It recycles target identification information to search from pre-stored personal information table and obtains personnel to be selected corresponding with target identification information；Then target operation personnel are determined from personnel to be selected according to preset rules.Therefore, on the one hand this method, which is avoided, determines target operation personnel according to the progress task distribution of target operation task by dispatcher, to reduce the consumption to human resources；On the other hand, this method is that target operation personnel are determined from personnel to be selected according to preset rules, avoids doping factor and individual subjective factor, therefore can be improved the fairness of determining target operation personnel, improves task distributional equity.Disclosed herein as well is a kind of task distributor, equipment and computer readable storage mediums, all have above-mentioned beneficial effect.
assignees: CHINA RESOURCES POWER HEZE CO LTD

title_en: Method for determining position of judicial organization in cross-administrative division in consideration of efficiency and fairness
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for determining the position of a judicial organization of a cross-administrative division, which is capable of considering efficiency and fairness. The method is characterized in that the advantages of the interdisciplinary are utilized to combine the problem of the setting of the current-stage legal hot spot across administrative division judicial institutions with the graph optimization theory so as to set the approximate optimal position. The method comprises the steps of constructing a directional full-connection network, enabling nodes in the network to be linked according to rules, dividing the nodes into two unconnected subsets by using a graph-cut algorithm, and obtaining an approximate optimal position through calculation.

title_en: Emergency rescue resource scheduling dynamic planning method for post-disaster wounded evacuation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency rescue resource scheduling dynamic planning method for evacuation of wounded persons after disaster, which particularly relates to the technical field of emergency rescue, and is based on a preset disaster area rescue environment, wherein the method divides the wounded evacuation rescue process into multi-stage calculation of deprivation cost of each stage by setting tent and service constraint, keeping wounded circulation and conservation, ambulance scheduling constraint, treatment of non-rescue wounded persons and hospitals and setting decision variable types, and introducing deprivation cost, including deprivation cost of heavy wounded persons, total deprivation cost of each wounded person and total deprivation cost of all wounded persons; the total deprivation cost of all wounded persons is combined with the moving cost of the medical rescue tent, the transportation cost of the ambulance, the penalty cost of the wounded persons not being cured, i.e. the total cost of the whole emergency rescue is minimized.

title_en: Distribution method for urban air quality improvement target
abstract_en: The invention relates to a distribution method of an urban air quality improvement target. The influence of each factor influencing the air quality is quantified, the pollutant concentration reduction adjustment coefficient is determined, the annual mean value of the air quality improvement target of each to-be-distributed area of the assessment year is obtained, the annual mean value of the air quality improvement target of each to-be-distributed area of the assessment year is refined to be within each quarter and each month, and the environmental air quality improvement target of each assessment year can be effectively and reasonably worked out. And on the basis of fairness, the invention constructs a set of air quality improvement target distribution index system which can cover fairness, social and economic benefits, environmental benefits and ecological benefits, and overcomes the defects that the existing distribution method is mainly based on qualitative analysis and is assisted by quantification, direct connection is not established with the influence factors of atmospheric environment quality, and the rationality and fairness of the distribution result cannot be explained.
assignees: UNIV HENAN AGRICULTURAL;HENAN PROVINCE ECOLOGICAL ENV MONITORING CENTER

title_en: Optimal selection method for ground node subset in wireless power transmission of multiple unmanned aerial vehicles
abstract_en: The invention relates to an optimal selection method of a ground node subset in wireless power transmission of multiple unmanned aerial vehicles, which belongs to the field of unmanned aerial vehicle auxiliary wireless communication and comprises the following steps: s1: dividing the ground nodes into a plurality of circular areas with the same radius according to the power transmission range of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and taking the circular areas as a ground node subset; s2: constructing an optimal selection model of the ground node subset; s3: and optimizing the hovering points of the unmanned aerial vehicle in each ground node subset, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle can charge the ground nodes at the optimal hovering points. The method is suitable for a large-scale low-power-consumption ground node charging scene, and by optimizing the selection of the ground node subset, the hovering charging times of the unmanned aerial vehicle are reduced, and the flight energy consumption of the unmanned aerial vehicle is reduced, so that the energy receiving efficiency and fairness of the ground node are improved.

title_en: Network-contracted vehicle fleet scale and charging rate collaborative optimization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a network vehicle team scale and charging rate collaborative optimization method, which comprises the following steps: s1, determining input parameters and output parameters of an optimization model; s2, under the condition that passengers sensitive to price and waiting time are considered, calculating through expected utility functions under the condition that service benefits are considered, and further calculating possible passenger candidates and taxi pricing rates according to average passenger demand rates; s3, calculating profit of the service platform; s4, calculating passenger benefits; and S5, optimizing an objective function, wherein the objective function is that the profit of the platform is maximized or the profit of the platform and the profit of passengers are maximized. According to the invention, the taxi platform vehicle resource allocation efficiency is fully exerted, the social fairness is considered, and the benign development of the market is promoted.

title_en: Household service system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of household services, and discloses a household service system which comprises a user system module, a service management module, an order scheduling module and an evaluation wind control module, wherein the user system module supports hierarchical authentication and authority allocation of clients, service personnel and administrators, and generates portrait tag drive matching based on behavior data of the clients and the service personnel, the service management module constructs a secondary classification system, adopts an intelligent recommendation engine driven by a fusion collaborative filtering algorithm and a deep learning algorithm to recommend household items, the order scheduling module utilizes order period management and the intelligent matching engine to optimize a service flow, and the evaluation wind control module ensures service quality monitoring and fairness of a credit system through a bidirectional evaluation mechanism and abnormal evaluation detection. The invention can improve the supply and demand matching efficiency of the household service, optimize the service standard, perfect the credit system and provide decision basis for data support for large-scale operation.
assignees: WUHU JINCHEN HOUSEKEEPING SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Task allocation method and device based on artificial intelligence, computer equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and relates to a task allocation method, a device, computer equipment and a storage medium based on artificial intelligence, wherein the task allocation method comprises the steps of carrying out data association and cleaning treatment on acquired agent information, incomplete task information, allocable task information and residual working time length information of a target agent to obtain target agent data; the method comprises the steps of carrying out workload prediction on target agent data based on a called workload evaluation model to obtain the number of predicted tasks, judging whether the number of the predicted tasks is larger than 0, if so, obtaining target task types good for the target agents, obtaining target number thresholds corresponding to the target task types, and carrying out task allocation processing corresponding to the target task types on the target agents based on the target number thresholds and the number of the predicted tasks. Furthermore, the number of prediction tasks of the present application may be stored in the blockchain. The application can be applied to task dispatch processing in the financial field, and improves the processing efficiency, accuracy and fairness of task allocation.
assignees: CHINA PING AN PROPERTY INSURANCE CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent supervision and resource scheduling system for patient ward monitoring state
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medical informatization and intelligent decision making, and discloses an intelligent supervision and resource scheduling system for monitoring states of patient areas; the method comprises the steps of extracting an association relation between an entity and the entity from acquired patient monitoring data, establishing a semantic knowledge graph, analyzing the semantic knowledge graph based on a constructed semantic prediction model, generating a prediction query response list comprising sign trend prediction and resource demand prediction, deploying multiple agents based on the prediction query response list, interacting the multiple agents with the semantic knowledge graph, acquiring a collaborative scheduling decision vector, generating a supervision instrument panel and an executable task list based on the collaborative scheduling decision vector, performing task execution based on the executable task list by an execution terminal, feeding back an execution effect to update the semantic knowledge graph, and reducing decision-making rigid bureau or sub-optimal allocation in a complex competition scene, so that the overall treatment efficiency and fairness of a disease area are maximized.
assignees: HENAN QINGWO AUTOMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Franchise system for realty deal
title_ko: 부동산 거래를 위한 프랜차이즈 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A franchise system for realty deal real estate transactions is provided to increase the competitiveness of agents and to ensure the fairness and safety in the opening of information. CONSTITUTION: A database (203) is registered with landlord, sale, and contract information to manage. A management server (201) provides real estate brokerage information by registered levels on the basis of franchise registered information and manages franchise fees. Sale information is selectively provided according to franchise registered levels in a homepage using an internet network (207). Points are registered with the registration of new sales or the video information of existing sales. An agent terminal (205) stores sale information in a transaction request person terminal (211) using a wireless network (209). [Reference numerals] (207) Internet network; (209) Wireless network
abstract_ko:
본 발명에서 프랜차이즈 구조를 갖는 부동산 거래 시스템을 개시한다. 
본 발명에 따른 시스템은, 임대인 정보를 포함하여 매물정보 및 계약정보가 등록 관리되는 데이터베이스; 프랜차이즈 등록 정보에 기반하여 등록 레벨별 부동산 중개 정보를 제공하며, 거래 요구자로부터 접속, 방문, 매매에 따른 할인권 발급 및 포인트 관리 운용을 토대로 프랜차이즈 이용료 관리를 수행하는 관리서버; 및 인터넷 통신망을 통해 상기 관리서버로부터 제공되는 홈페이지 또는 웹 페이지에 접속하며, 프랜차이즈 등록 레벨에 따라 매물에 대한 동영상 정보, 매물정보, 계약정보, 임대인 정보가 선별적으로 제공되고, 신규 매물정보에 대한 등록 또는 기존 매물정보에 대한 동영상 정보 등록에 따른 포인트 가산이 이루어지는 적어도 하나 이상의 중개사 단말기로 구성된다. 
따라서, 본 발명은 부동산 중개 시스템을 프랜차이즈 형태로 구현할 뿐만 아니라, 부동산 매물 정보에 대한 중앙 분배식 구조를 구현함으로써, 중개사 간의 경쟁력을 도모하고 정보공개의 형평성과 안전성을 확보할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: System and method for optimizing product development portfolios and integrating product strategy with brand strategy
abstract_en: A business and software method to cost-effectively optimize product and/or service development portfolios, to reduce time to market, and to better integrate and align product or service strategy with brand strategy. The business and software method includes defining in detail the product and service attributes that characterize the ideal customer experience, categorizing the attributes, assigning a numerical value of importance to the attributes, and applying those values to statistical analysis of each assessed product development initiative in terms of alignment with ideal experience and potential competitive impact relative to the resources and risks required to bring each initiative to market. A prioritization for product development resource allocation is developed based upon these analyses. The prioritization is presented in the form of decision intelligence tools for an organization to use and reach informed judgments concerning resource allocation to develop, maintain, or optimize a given product or service portfolio. The decision intelligence tools serve to improve business performance, increase market impact, and build brand equity for products and services of a given organization by improving alignment between what the organization promises customers and what it actually delivers.

title_en: Task distribution method considering user heteroplasmy and user preference in crowdsourcing system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a task distribution method considering user heteroplasmy and user preference in a crowdsourcing system; the method considers task budget, user heteroplasmy and user preference, and uses a multi-to-one matching mechanism to find the best user-task match; the core of the method is that in the whole algorithm operation process, quality sum non-reduction of each task can be completed; the method provides a novel distribution thinking and specific scheme for the crowdsourcing system, thus solving the problems that an existing crowdsourcing system task distribution strategy cannot consider user heteroplasmy and user preference; the matching result by the algorithm has individual rationality and fairness, and has no wasteness.

title_en: Method and device for constructing virtual power plant cost allocation model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for constructing a virtual power plant cost distribution model, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining basic parameters; establishing an internal cost distribution model of the virtual power plant through a cooperative game theory, wherein the model comprises an objective function and constraint conditions; substituting the basic parameters into the model, solving the model with the goal of highest stability of the virtual power plant cooperation alliance, highest fairness of the virtual power plant internal cost allocation and highest attraction of members participating in the virtual power plant, and outputting the virtual power plant internal cost allocation scheme. According to the invention, the goals of benefit distribution fairness, the participation stability of each member in the cooperation alliance and the attraction of the participation members are fully considered, so that each participation member can obtain satisfactory benefit distribution, and the participation stability of each member in the virtual power plant alliance is improved. The benefit distribution method for each participation member in the virtual power plant provided by the invention can effectively encourage the production and marketing type users to participate in the cooperation of the virtual power plant.
assignees: NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER UNIV BAODING

title_en: Reordering method for guaranteeing minimum recommendation utility while considering fairness of both parties
abstract_en: The invention relates to a reordering method for guaranteeing minimum recommendation utility while considering fairness of both sides, which comprises the following steps: calculating the preference score of the user for the articles according to the interest and hobbies of the user, and forming an initial recommendation list according to the ranking from high score to low score And will each Are all considered runways; from the slave According to the front Top-K articles, corresponding exposure resources are allocated for each provider; distributing a fair lifting speed to each provider through a heuristic function according to the distribution condition of provider side exposure resources; each runway The articles on the table acquire the corresponding fair lifting speed according to the provider to which the articles belong; and (3) re-calculating the score according to the determined preference score of each article and the determined corresponding fair lifting speed obtained by the article, and reordering the articles from high to low according to the new score, wherein the reordered recommendation list is denoted as l  u . The method is applicable to static and dynamic recommended scenes and has the characteristics of easy expansion and lower time complexity.

title_en: Water resource allocation scheme decision method and system based on multi-main-body game
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water resource allocation scheme decision method and system based on multi-main game, and relates to the technical and method field of water resource management. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a water resource allocation scheme set of a research area, calculating water utilization benefits of multiple subjects, calculating water utilization fairness of the multiple subjects, determining a allocation scheme preference matrix of the multiple subjects, analyzing a allocation scheme negotiation space of the multiple subjects, carrying out multi-subject negotiation based on group decision game, and determining a water resource allocation scheme under balanced game. The invention is beneficial to considering reasonable utilization requirements of each main body in the decision, and gives consideration to the public distribution of benefits and the water resource allocation efficiency.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES;JIANGSU WATER CONSERVANCY SCI RES INST

title_en: Task allocation method and system based on hybrid dynamic strategy
abstract_en: The invention relates to a task allocation method and a task allocation system based on a hybrid dynamic strategy, wherein the task allocation method comprises the steps of dividing a working area of an agent into K sub-areas, combining task points belonging to the same sub-area in a current order to obtain a task set to be allocated, calculating execution time cost of the agent to be allocated according to current state information of the agent, predicting area density prediction cost of the agent to be allocated when the agent is executed according to the current state information of the agent, calculating total bid cost of the agent to be allocated according to the execution time cost of the agent to be allocated and the area density prediction cost of the agent to be allocated when the agent is executed, and allocating the task to be allocated in the task set to be allocated to each agent by taking the minimum total bid cost of the agent to be allocated as a target. The invention can ensure fairness and stability of task allocation in a dynamic execution environment, and effectively avoid phenomena of resource waste and uneven load.

title_en: Emergency supplies stockpile cabinet for emergency
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an emergency supplies stockpile cabinet for emergency which is less in the burden of expense, an increase in burden of a building manager and the burden of crime prevention measures for emergency supplies and can successfully distribute the emergency supplies to people who are forced to stay inside a building because of an earthquake by distributing many emergency supplies at conspicuous places.  <P>SOLUTION: An upper part 2a of a box body 2 is made to be a storage space 4 for emergency supplies for emergencies 3, the storage space 4 is provided with a door 5 in a freely openable and closable way, and a lower part 2b of the box body 2 is made to be a different purpose space 6 available for different prescribed purposes, the box body 2 is provided with a quake detection sensor 7, a crime prevention buzzer 8 and a control device 9 for them. When the quake detection sensor 7 detects a quake that is equal to or greater than a prescribed quake, the crime prevention buzzer 8 does not operate even if the door 5 is opened, and when the door 5 is opened even though the quake detection sensor 7 does not detect a quake that is equal to or greater than the prescribed quake, the crime prevention buzzer 8 is operated.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Brand Health Measurement - Investment Optimization Model
abstract_en: A system and method are disclosed for optimizing brand equity return on investment (ROI). Original input data associated with a plurality of brand equity variables is processed using a brand equity ROI model to generate a first brand equity value, which in turn is processed to generate a dependent variable. Input data corresponding to an individual brand equity variable is then processed to generate changed input data, which in turn is processed by the brand equity ROI model with the original input data and the dependent variable to generate a second brand equity value. The first and second brand equity values are then processed to determine the effect of the changed data on the first brand equity value.
assignees: KORTUM NATALIE;NARANG RAJIV;CHEN YINGCHI;SADLER GEORGE;VAUGHN BRANDON

title_en: Data processing system and method for idle article poverty alleviation platform
abstract_en: A data processing system of an idle article poverty-relieving platform comprises a poverty-relieving object information data storage and conversion module, an article donation object recommendation module, an idle article sorting calibration module, a fund distribution module of a fund donation object, a cash change processing module and a poverty-relieving information encryption module. The data processing method of the idle article poverty alleviation platform comprises the steps of updating stored poverty alleviation object information data in real time, analyzing poverty alleviation states of poverty alleviation objects and generating corresponding demand article sets through calling of a database; the idle article are sorted and calibrated, the articles meeting the donation specification are donated, algorithm selection is carried out on donated objects, other articles are changed in the currency, and the changed idle articles are distributed based on the poverty relief distribution model and then fund distribution. According to the system and the data processing method, the processing of idle articles and the poverty alleviation problem are perfectly combined, so that the accurate poverty alleviation work of the platform can be well operated, and the use feeling of the platform is improved.

title_en: Calculating units and determining method for electric power system carbon emission flow distribution indexes
abstract_en: The invention provides calculating units and a determining method for electric power system carbon emission flow distribution indexes. The calculating units collect the active power flow in a local area and the direct carbon emission concerned information. The neighboring two calculating units, through iteration communications, conduct calculations on the carbon emission flow distribution of an entire system. The determining method comprises the following steps: making calculating units available in all carbon emission flow distribution equipment in a targeted electric power system; collecting active power flow in a local area and the direct carbon emission concerned information by the calculating units; and performing iteration communications between two adjacent calculating units so as to calculate the carbon emission flow distribution of an entire system. According to the invention, the calculating units and the determining method can rapidly figure out the accurate distribution of carbon emission flow of an entire system while not weighing much on a central server. By providing an accurate and reliable carbon emission flow of an electric system to the users, the method makes the responsibility of carbon emission cut shared more equitably, helps prevent the occurrence of carbon leakage, and encourages an active part in cutting carbon emission of an electric system from the user's side.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;UNIV TSINGHUA

title_en: It is a kind of for enhancing the connection plan design method of satellite system independent navigation ability
abstract_en: It is a kind of for enhancing the connection plan design method of satellite system independent navigation ability, obtain visual matrix according to ephemeris computation；Connection plan output is calculated using fairness connection planning algorithm according to visual matrix in each satellite node；Each node is performed simultaneously link scheduling in connection plan design cycle initial time according to connection plan design result respectively on the basis of time synchronization.For each link scheduling period, connection plan design process completed on star and independent of earth station: 1) in satellite network each satellite node by with other satellite nodes carry out information exchange, obtain the newest ephemeris of unified the whole network, and visual matrix, the i.e. input of connection plan design are obtained according to ephemeris computation；2) each node plans algorithm for design using deterministic connection to input to the determining connection plan design cycle in satellite network, and identical connection plan design output is calculated on star；3) each satellite node is performed simultaneously link scheduling in connection plan design cycle initial time according to connection plan design result respectively on the basis of time synchronization in satellite network.

title_en: Network contract freight vehicle scheduling optimization method based on mixed heuristic algorithm
abstract_en: A mixed heuristic algorithm-based network contract freight scheduling optimization method comprises the steps of firstly constructing a network contract freight scheduling model of a plurality of freight vehicles considering fairness according to the actual situation of network contract freight scheduling of the plurality of freight vehicles. The weighted income sum of the shipper in the unit scheduling period is maximized as a target; secondly, designing a water wave optimization algorithm based on a dynamic grouping optimization strategy, and solving the distribution problem of the freight order; and finally, designing a tabu search algorithm of a hybrid greedy strategy, and solving the transportation path optimization problem of the freight car. The method is used for solving the problems of vehicle-cargo matching and transportation path optimization in daily operation of the network contract freight transportation platform. The present invention maximizes revenues for the carrier driver.

title_en: Logistics unmanned aerial vehicle package receiving station site selection-public route planning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for selecting addresses of parcel receiving stations of logistics unmanned aerial vehicles and planning public routes. The method comprises the steps of obtaining geographic environment information, demand distribution and other information in a logistics unmanned aerial vehicle operation area; determining an optimization method of a single route planning model of the logistics unmanned aerial vehicle, planning single routes among stations and storing planning results into an alternative route library; determining an optimization method of a parcel receiving station site selection-public route planning model; iteratively solving a parcel receiving station site selection-public route planning model, and updating a solution set until the maximum iteration times; according to the final planning result, comparing objective function values of all schemes in the solution set, and selecting an optimal planning scheme; the system comprises a flight environment modeling module, a single-route planning module, an iteration solving module and an optimal logistics unmanned aerial vehicle package receiving station site selection-public route planning scheme determining module. The invention improves the economy and fairness of the location selection of the parcel receiving station and the safety and high efficiency of the public way.

title_en: Education and evaluation integrated verifiable generation and causal optimization education intelligent system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent system and method for education and evaluation-oriented integrated verifiable generation and causal optimization education. The system comprises a data access and learning image, a knowledge retrieval and knowledge graph, a Verifiable Generation (VGE), consistency/contradiction rate/coverage rate verification, multi-expert agent collaboration and arbitration, causal structure learning and anti-facts optimization, a context protocol and edge-Yun Shuanghuan compliance module. The method comprises the steps of selecting optimal intervention based on a causal objective function, closing a loop, writing back a teaching plan, a calendar and a task list, realizing end-to-end optimization of question, reading, lecture and teaching intervention, improving learning gain and considering fairness and teacher workload.

title_en: Large-scale urban emergency material distribution method based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a large-scale urban emergency material distribution method based on deep reinforcement learning, which combines the advantages of the deep learning and the reinforcement learning, and realizes emergency material distribution in a large-scale urban disaster response scene by training the method through a DQN network. The method specifically comprises the following steps: modeling a disaster area, and constructing an emergency material distribution task model; step two, defining emergency material distribution combined target optimization functions for multiple disaster areas; thirdly, constructing a Markov decision process, defining environmental states, action spaces, rewarding functions and the like; training a deep reinforcement learning model; and fifthly, inputting the initial state of the disaster area to generate an optimal emergency allocation strategy. The emergency material distribution method provided by the invention has higher calculation efficiency, improves the emergency response speed and further reduces the loss caused by disasters on the premise of ensuring fairness and effectively carrying out emergency material distribution so as to relieve the pain of disaster citizens.

title_en: Passenger train schedule optimization method considering efficiency and fairness
abstract_en: The invention discloses an efficiency and fairness-considered passenger railway train schedule optimization method which comprises the steps of 1, constructing a customized space-time network under passenger railways, 2, constructing a passenger railway efficiency-maximized train schedule model P  1 , 3, constructing a passenger railway fairness-based train schedule model P  2 , 4, solving an efficiency-oriented train schedule model P  1  by utilizing a train generation algorithm to obtain an efficiency-oriented train schedule scheme, 5, applying a decomposition scheme to the fairness-oriented train schedule model P  2 , and then solving by utilizing a train generation algorithm to obtain the fairness-considered train schedule scheme. The train schedule model for train operators is constructed based on the train schedule model with the maximum efficiency, and the train schedule model is decomposed so that the train schedule model can be solved by using an optimization algorithm generated by train lines, so that the technical problem that the efficiency and fairness of the existing train schedule are difficult to balance is solved.

title_en: Garment production automatic time accounting method and system based on Internet of things and provided with offer one's services
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for calculating the working time of offer one's services in clothing production based on the Internet of things, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining production assignment task data of a current sewing machine station, judging whether the current sewing machine station is an effective working station according to the production assignment task data, continuously monitoring and collecting a bottom layer operation parameter sequence of the current sewing machine station through sensing equipment of the Internet of things, judging the bottom layer operation parameter sequence by offer one's services dynamic state based on a predefined effective working time judging logic rule, recording the duration time of entering the effective working state each time by a high-precision timer and accumulating to generate effective working time structured data, and generating a visual report and analysis data for performance management, production efficiency analysis and process optimization based on the effective working time structured data. The automatic calculation based on the real operation data of the equipment can be realized, personal errors and falsification are avoided, and the fairness, the credibility, the objectivity and the accuracy of the data are ensured.

title_en: Urban group space toughness collaborative planning method, system, terminal equipment and medium based on collaborative game
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cooperative game-based urban mass space toughness collaborative planning method, a system, terminal equipment and a medium, and relates to the technical field of urban planning. The method comprises the steps of obtaining city group basic data, dividing the city group basic data into space unit sets with unified assignment according to attributes, constructing a multi-disaster scene set and quantifying risk loss parameters of each unit, defining candidate land utilization states and planning constraint condition sets for each unit, constructing a comprehensive benefit function of a corresponding city based on the candidate land utilization states of the units, constructing a cooperative game by taking the city as a participant, solving an optimal strategy in the planning configuration set meeting the constraint with the aim of maximizing the benefit of the city group, calculating marginal contributions of each city to the benefit of the city group under the optimal strategy, and distributing the cooperative benefit based on the marginal contributions. The invention provides an improved mechanism in the aspect of multi-disaster prevention and regional collaborative optimization, is beneficial to improving the toughness level of urban mass space planning and ensures the fairness and stability of regional collaboration.

title_en: Demand response resource dynamic allocation method and device for virtual power plant
abstract_en: The invention provides a demand response resource dynamic allocation method and device for a virtual power plant, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting load regulation characteristic parameters of various users in the virtual power plant; establishing a target function of the comprehensive adjustment cost of the user and a corresponding constraint condition according to the load adjustment characteristic parameters; and constructing a mixed integer linear programming problem according to the objective function and the constraint condition, and solving by adopting a branch-and-bound algorithm to obtain a dynamic allocation scheme of demand response resources. According to the dynamic demand response resource allocation method for the virtual power plant, the fairness and the economy of the allocation scheme can be improved, and the implementation effect of demand response can be effectively improved.
assignees: CHANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH COMPANY OF JIANGSU PROVINCE ELECTRIC POWER LTD COMPANY OF STATE GRID;STATE GRID JIANGSU PROVINCE ELECTRIC POWER LTD COMPANY;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Cross-regional water resource allocation method based on Lubinstein discussion price counter-price model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cross-regional water resource allocation method based on a Lubinstein discussion counter-price model, which comprises the following steps: basic information data of water resource allocation in a research area are obtained; constructing a one-to-many Lubinstein discussion counter-offer water resource allocation conceptual model; introducing a concept of a virtual equivalent competitor, and converting a one-to-many Lubinstein discussion counter-offer water resource distribution conceptual model into a one-to-one Lubinstein discussion counter-offer water resource distribution model; calculating a discount factor comprehensively considering fairness and high efficiency principles; constructing a quotation strategy considering the minimum water supply; solving a one-to-one lubinstein discussion price counter-offer water resource distribution model. The method can effectively reflect the economic and social development level of each benefit body; meanwhile, a decision maker can make a more reasonable quotation strategy, so that the basic water requirement of each benefit body is ensured; the concept of introducing virtual equivalent competitors reduces bilateral negotiations, and efficiency is improved by 58.3% compared to the mathematical expectation of bilateral negotiations.

title_en: Card friend community management system based on WEB3.0
abstract_en: The invention discloses a card friend community management system based on WEB3.0, which comprises the following steps: the block chain system responds to the DID data uplink request and stores the DID data in different block chain accounts; the DID identity recognition system generates a corresponding DID digital identity; the card friend forum system receives requirements and interaction information created by a truck driver, and generates DID requirements and interaction data to be uplink to the blockchain system; the network freight system receives the freight bill information created by a freight owner enterprise and generates DID freight bill data to be uplink to the block chain system; receiving logistics information created by a logistics company, and generating DID logistics data to be uplink to a block chain system; and the vehicle service provider system receives the vehicle service information created by the vehicle service provider and generates DID vehicle service data to be uplink to the block chain system. The invention adopts WEB3.0 internet technology, and realizes community data ownership fairness, data value distribution fairness and data credibility and safety based on block chain.
assignees: HEFEI WEITIAN YUNTONG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Data processing method and system in urban green space optimization based on big data
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a data processing method and device in urban green space optimization based on big data, and relates to the technical field of big data, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring green land distribution information corresponding to each sub-region and remote sensing data; acquiring green land investment information, quality evaluation information and resident satisfaction information of each sub-area; calculating green quantity evaluation scores corresponding to each sub-region according to the remote sensing data and the green land distribution information; calculating a green land evaluation score for enjoyment of residents according to the green land distribution information; calculating fairness quantization scores according to green land investment information, quality evaluation information and resident satisfaction information; calculating a comprehensive planning score according to the green amount evaluation score, the green land enjoyment evaluation score, the fairness quantification score and the corresponding reference score; and determining a city green space planning strategy. When planning the urban green space, the maldistribution of the green space can be reduced, and the possibility that residents equally enjoy all the services provided by the urban green space resource is improved.

title_en: Multi-target water resource allocation method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-target water resource allocation method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of water resource allocation. According to the scheme, economic benefits, social benefits and environmental benefits of a region to be configured are taken as optimization targets, a multi-target optimization configuration model taking distribution water quantity, water demand, pollutant discharge quantity and water supply fairness as constraints is firstly constructed, then the multi-target optimization configuration model is converted into a single-target optimization configuration model taking maximized comprehensive satisfaction as an optimization target through fuzzy processing, and finally the solution is carried out according to each constraint. According to the scheme, water supply fairness constraint is added in the water resource allocation process, and when the multi-objective optimization configuration model is solved, the multi-objective optimization configuration model is converted into a single-objective fuzzy optimization configuration model, so that the maximum comprehensive satisfaction of all optimization objectives is obtained, the labor cost is reduced, the interference of human factors is avoided, and the accuracy and fairness of water resource allocation are improved.
assignees: HEBEI INSTITUTE OF WATER CONSERVANCY SCIENCES HEBEI PROVINCE DAM SAFETY TECH CENTER HEBEI EMBANKMENT

title_en: Examination and evaluation method for experimental operation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an examination evaluation method for experimental operation, which relates to the technical field of experimental operation and comprises the following steps that firstly, an examinee enters an examination room for carrying out identity verification by using an identity verification module in advance for half an hour, when the identity verification is wrong, the examinee is not allowed to enter the examination room, after the identity verification is correct, the examinee randomly extracts the examination questions, after the examination questions are extracted, each examinee is randomly allocated to a corresponding examination position by using a seat allocation module, after all the examinees are in place and reach examination time, an examination timing module starts to count down, the examinee starts to carry out experimental examination, after each step is completed, the examinee presses a shooting button on a desktop, a camera can shoot the picture, when the examination time is still 10 minutes, a voice reminding module carries out on-site broadcasting reminding, and after the examination is finished, a prison teacher reaches each examination position and scores by using an experiment scoring module. The invention improves the accuracy and fairness of scoring in experimental examination.
assignees: SHANGHAI YINGJIA IND GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Initial carbon emission right distribution method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an initial carbon emission right distribution method, an initial carbon emission right distribution system, initial carbon emission right distribution equipment and a storage medium, wherein initial carbon emission rights which can be distributed are distributed to a plurality of areas based on a basic fair distribution model of a bankruptcy theory; carrying out weighted average treatment on different fair distribution results in the basic fair distribution model by using a total distribution method to obtain an initial carbon emission right distribution result of a comprehensive fair principle; evaluating the relative efficiency of comparing the results of the initial carbon emissions assignments for the different regions based on the data envelope analysis model to determine which regions are assigned in a relatively optimal and less efficient state; adjusting the distribution amount of the carbon emission weights of all areas based on a zero and data envelope analysis model, and ensuring that the distribution total amount is kept unchanged according to an efficiency principle until the front of the efficiency is reached; and calculating information entropy weight coefficients of the equity principle and efficiency principle distribution results by adopting an information entropy method, and weighting to obtain the initial carbon emission weight comprehensive distribution results of the equity principle and the efficiency principle.

title_en: Disabled person subsidy management and control system based on big data analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of information processing, in particular to a disabled person subsidy management and control system based on big data analysis, which is used for solving the problems that the prior art cannot comprehensively evaluate user demands from multiple angles, cannot reasonably sequence priorities and cannot effectively support resource allocation and service decision, and the invention utilizes the historical data of the users to carry out objective, accurate and real-time analysis through a demand evaluation module, avoids subjective deviation, ensures fairness and timeliness of evaluation results, comprehensively evaluates the user demands from multiple angles, identifies demand characteristics, provides basis for service optimization and expansion, calculates demand pressing coefficients by adopting a formulation method, divides the priorities according to percentiles, ensures scientificity and rationality of sequencing and effectively supports resource allocation and service decision.
assignees: ZHEJIANG WANGSHENG SHUXIN SOFTWARE CO LTD

title_en: Performance management system and method based on cloud computing and artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of enterprise management, and provides a performance management system and a performance management method based on cloud computing and artificial intelligence, wherein the performance management system comprises a user management module, a performance evaluation module, a display module, a message leaving module, an address book module, a reward and punishment module and a data analysis module; the system utilizes cloud computing technology to ensure data safety and efficient access, combines an artificial intelligent algorithm to dynamically adjust performance indexes and weights, improves assessment fairness, improves prediction accuracy through deep learning and time sequence prediction, provides powerful support for enterprise decision and personnel development, enhances communication and interaction among personnel, optimizes a reward and punishment mechanism and promotes overall performance level.

title_en: Evaluation method, device and system based on multi-benefit body
abstract_en: The application discloses an evaluation method, device and system based on multiple benefit subjects, the method comprises the steps of constructing an economic, ecological and social multidimensional evaluation index system, calculating subjective weights of all benefit subjects by an AHP method, synthesizing the weights of all the parties by a Shapley value game theory model to obtain comprehensive subjective weights, calculating objective weights by an entropy weight method, combining the subjective and objective weights by a convex optimization model to obtain final weights, and sequencing and optimizing schemes based on a TOPSIS method and the final weights. According to the application, the benefits of multiple parties are balanced through the game theory, and the subjective and objective weighting method is combined, so that the scientific decision problem under the conflict of multiple benefits and main bodies is solved, and the scientificity and the fairness of evaluation of complex engineering schemes such as water conservancy junctions are improved.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY WATER CONSERVANCY AND HYDROPOWER PLANNING AND DESIGN GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Green control parameter combination optimization method, system and storage medium for user demand response
abstract_en: The invention discloses a green control parameter combination optimization method, a system and a storage medium for user demand response, and belongs to the technical field of electric power energy. Relates to the technical field of power distribution automation. The method comprises the steps of obtaining green electricity consumption data, electricity price information and constraint conditions of a user side, constructing a demand decision model of the user under different prices and constraints to obtain a user decision relation set, deriving optimal decisions of the user under different control parameters based on the relation set to obtain a user reaction function, embedding the user reaction function as a subordinate layer equilibrium constraint, constructing a Stackelberg double-layer optimization model with comprehensive performance as an upper layer objective function, and solving the double-layer optimization model to obtain optimal control parameters. The invention is used for solving the problems that the conventional green control parameter setting depends on experience, the user differential response is difficult to be described, and the efficiency and fairness are difficult to be considered.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Aid distribution decision system and method using internet
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To enable Internet-based collection of various donee information and a wider distribution in order to solve the problems wherein, in existing aid activities, donees are decided by donors or foundations and supplies cannot be distributed according to various donee information collected from many unspecified people, and there have been no systems and methods for recognizing and timely aiding many regions in need of aid around the world.  <P>SOLUTION: An aid distribution decision system includes a plurality of terminals 9 for receiving information about donees 5 that users 9p think should receive aid and sending the received information as vote information, and a distribution decision server 18 for receiving the vote information sent from the terminals 9 via the Internet and deciding a distribution ratio of supplies according to the vote information.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Civil aviation flight time configuration method for popular travel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a popular travel-oriented civil aviation flight time allocation method, which comprises the steps of firstly determining a popular travel-oriented multidimensional weight system, calculating the weight of each flight on the dimensions of a passenger type, an airline type and a time type according to flight time application data, then evaluating the contribution degree of the flight to the popular travel by integrating the weight of each dimension, determining the weight of each flight in flight time offset, then establishing a popular travel-oriented civil aviation flight time allocation model, aiming at minimizing the total weight of the weighted time offset and restraining the time offset, and finally solving the established flight time model under a Python environment by using a Gurobi solver so as to obtain a popular travel-oriented civil aviation flight time table. The invention establishes the civil aviation flight time configuration model for popular travel, balances the requirements, the configuration efficiency and the fairness of popular travel, and improves the operability of the civil aviation flight time configuration.

title_en: Charging pile charging load balance scheduling method
abstract_en: The application provides a charging pile charging load balance scheduling method, which comprises the following steps: a charging pile terminal subsystem initiates a charging request; and the dispatching center subsystem judges whether the charging request of the new charging pile terminal can be born according to the current load power of the administered area, if so, the charging service is carried out according to the nominal voltage value and the current value of the new charging pile terminal, and if not, the charging configuration parameters of each charging pile terminal in the administered area are adjusted according to the load balancing principle, and then the charging service is carried out on the automobile. According to the application, the budget load power in the jurisdiction is taken as constraint, and the charging configuration parameters of the charging pile terminal are dynamically scheduled and updated based on event triggering by a scheduling strategy of a remaining time fairness principle, a new priority guarantee principle and a saturation yielding principle, so that the purpose of maximum intelligent use of the budget load power is realized on the premise of not overloading electric energy.

title_en: A kind of relief goods dispenser and allocator
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of relief goods dispensers, the dispatching box main body formed including the cabinet being rotatablely connected by two, it is characterized in that, the place position for placing goods and materials is equipped in the cabinet, the place position inner wall is equipped with protective layer, the cabinet is equipped with the wireless communication apparatus for communication, two cabinets are equipped with box lock far from the side of rotation connection, the application is by by the substance releasing mode of original centralized distribution, become the releasing mode that dispersion is asked for or generation takes, so that substance Time Of Release more disperses, disaster affected people can go carefully to take or by other people on behalf of disaster relief supplies distribution box of taking according to the arrangement of time of oneself, thus avoid concentrate provide be likely to occur the case where making a mad rush for, and it can be rationed, and then it ensure that each enough substances that can take per capita, the distribution avoided is uneven and unrestrained The phenomenon that taking.

title_en: Urban park exposure fairness assessment method based on population and social value weighting
abstract_en: The invention discloses a city park exposure fairness evaluation method based on population and social value weighting, which comprises the following steps: firstly, evaluating the cultural service social value of an urban park ecological system in a research area by using SolVES models; step two, acquiring data of flow distribution points of a person's mouth in a research area; step three, constructing a city park exposure evaluation model weighted by population and social value; step four, evaluating fairness of urban park exposure by using a kenel coefficient method by taking streets and villages as research scales; and fifthly, identifying the difference of the exposure unfairness driving mechanism among the villages and towns by using a random forest model. The evaluation method has guiding significance for improving social value benefits of the urban park and planning construction.

title_en: Influence resource allocation method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to an influence resource allocation method, an influence resource allocation device, computer equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of estimating influence boundary values of a plurality of seed nodes in a social network, determining densities of the seed nodes according to the influence boundary values of the seed nodes and spending of the seed nodes, determining influence resources owned by each agent in the plurality of agents, and allocating the seed nodes with the largest densities in a budget range to each agent according to the order of the influence resources from small to large. By adopting the method, when the real influence of the seed node is unknown, the finally obtained influence resource allocation scheme is ensured to have better fairness.
assignees: HANGZHOU HIGH TECH ZONE BINJIANG BLOCKCHAIN AND DATA SECURITY RES INSTITUTE;UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: Base layer management system and method based on block chain technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of office automation and time management, in particular to a base layer management system and method based on a blockchain technology. The method comprises the steps of automatically collecting basic management task data, generating a hash value of a task, updating a task state based on the hash value of the task, calculating a task priority score, performing resource allocation based on the task priority score, dynamically adjusting task execution efficiency based on the resource amount obtained by the task, dynamically adjusting the planned completion time of the task, and dynamically adjusting the task state, the resource allocation and approval circulation based on the corrected task plan completion time. The method solves the problems that the traditional management system is easy to attack and lacks traceability, task scheduling priority management is disordered, resource allocation cannot be flexibly adjusted according to task states, task execution efficiency is low, overtime task influence is not reasonably modeled, approval circulation depends on manual auditing, performance assessment is easy to be manually interfered, and fairness and reliability of basic management are reduced.
assignees: JILIN RUNSHI SOFTWARE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Staff reddening intelligent distribution system with post differentiation and fairness adaptation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of community canteens and employee restaurants and discloses an employee distribution system with post differentiation and fairness adaptation, which comprises the following steps of determining post levels of employees of a company, dividing the post of the employee into a plurality of different levels according to factors such as post responsibility, work difficulty, work intensity and the like, wherein each level corresponds to a different weight coefficient; work performance data of the staff is collected, including but not limited to performance in terms of work outcome, work quality, work efficiency, team cooperation, etc., and the data is quantitatively processed to obtain performance scores of each staff. The differentiation and fairness adaptation of employee reddening are realized by comprehensively considering multidimensional factors such as the post level, work performance, attendance rate, work attitude, special contribution and the like of the employees. Compared with the existing reddening system, the system can reflect the actual contribution of staff to the company more accurately, and avoid unfairness caused by reddening according to the post level or performance.

title_en: Performance management method and system based on rehabilitation technology grading
abstract_en: The invention discloses a performance management method and a performance management system based on rehabilitation technology grading, which relate to the field of medical informatization and hospital performance management, and comprise the following steps of S1, acquiring performance related data of a rehabilitation therapist, wherein the performance related data at least comprises rehabilitation treatment projects executed by the rehabilitation therapist; S2, calculating the personal actual weighted workload of the rehabilitation therapist by utilizing a predefined rehabilitation technology grading model based on the rehabilitation therapy project, determining the workload performance of the rehabilitation therapist according to the proportion of the personal actual weighted workload to the total workload of the department, S3, calculating the basic performance according to basic information of the rehabilitation therapist, calculating the management performance according to management post information of the rehabilitation therapist, and calculating the scientific reward performance and the medical quality performance according to scientific research and service data of the rehabilitation therapist, and S4, integrating the basic performance, the management performance, the scientific reward performance, the medical quality performance and the workload performance to generate the comprehensive performance of the rehabilitation therapist. And fairness and motivation of performance distribution are improved.
assignees: ANHUI PROVINCIAL HOSPITAL THE FIRST AFFILIATED HOSPITAL OF USTC

title_en: Financial incentive method for responding to power demand
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power demand response and financial incentive, in particular to a power demand response financial incentive method. The method comprises the steps of collecting information from power demand response signals and user response data, generating an incentive distribution list through a multi-dimensional contribution degree calculation model, and further optimizing and generating a final incentive scheme structure. A token prize is then generated from the list and transparent issuance of the prize and tamper-proof data is ensured by smart contract triggering, blockchain techniques. And then, verifying the reward data through the blockchain record, generating a user feedback report, and summarizing the user feedback report into a complete financial incentive report. The method effectively improves fairness and transparency of excitation distribution, achieves automation and instantaneity of prize distribution in the power demand response process, reduces human errors, enhances user trust, and is suitable for complex power grid loads and diversified response scenes.
assignees: BEIJING FEIBO XINDA TECH CO LTD

title_en: Information processing device, information processing system, information processing method, and program
abstract_en: To provide an information processing device, an information processing system, an information processing method, and a program that are capable of appropriately controlling a distribution system.SOLUTION: An information processing device includes a processing unit that calculates a control amount of power for a plurality of power units based on: a management value of wiring in a distribution system; a first evaluation function for evaluating power control for the plurality of power units in the distribution system, in terms of economy; and a second evaluation function for evaluating the power control for the plurality of power units in terms of fairness.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4
assignees: TOSHIBA CORP;TOSHIBA ENERGY SYSTEM & SOLUTION CORP

title_en: Port integrated card driver dispatching method, system and related equipment based on intelligent prediction and fairness optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a port integrated card driver dispatching method, a port integrated card driver dispatching system and related equipment based on intelligent prediction and fairness optimization; the invention relates to the port integrated card driver dispatching field, and aims at the technical problems that the existing dispatching method only takes the empty driving distance as the matching cost, so that the task allocation of a driver is not public and lacks the prospective, the weight of a matching edge is defined as the comprehensive dispatching cost in a weighted bipartite graph, the cost is composed of three items of the empty driving distance, a fairness penalty item and a task demand guide item, and the fairness penalty item reflecting the historical load balance of the driver and the task demand guide item reflecting the future task distribution trend are explicitly introduced into the weight of the matching edge, so that when the optimal matching is solved, the task allocation fairness and the prospective of the system response are obviously improved on the premise of not sacrificing the transportation efficiency.

title_en: System for controlling enterance and managing seat of library
title_ko: 도서관 출입 통제 및 좌석 관리 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a library access control and seat management system. A problem to be solved is to make it easy for anyone to easily reserve a seat in a library to a desired seat regardless of location, and to control and authenticate access to the library. As an example, disclosed is a library access control and seat management system including: a library seat reservation unit that reserves a seat and entrance time in the library on the basis of a user's access authentication information and terminal identification information of a mobile communication terminal, and receives seat reservation authentication information upon completion of the reservation; a library seat reservation management unit, wherein upon completion of reservation through the library seat reservation unit, seat reservation information including access authentication information, terminal identification information, seat information, and entry time information is stored and managed, and the seat reservation authentication information matching the seat reservation information is allocated and transmitted to the corresponding mobile communication terminal; and a library access and entrance authentication management unit that receives the seat reservation authentication information from the mobile communication terminal through short-distance wireless communication when entering the library and certifies access control and entry to the library.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 도서관 출입 통제 및 좌석 관리 시스템에 관한 것으로, 해결하고자 하는 과제는 장소에 구애 받지 않고, 누구나 공평하게 원하는 자리에 도서관의 좌석을 쉽게 예약하며, 더불어 도서관의 출입을 통제 및 인증할 수 있도록 하는데 있다. 
일례로, 사용자의 출입인증정보와 모바일 통신단말의 단말식별정보를 기반으로 도서관의 좌석과 입실시간을 예약하고, 예약 완료 시 좌석예약인증정보를 부여 받는 도서관 좌석 예약부; 상기 도서관 좌석 예약부를 통한 예약 완료 시 출입인증정보, 단말식별정보, 좌석정보 및 입실시간정보를 포함하는 좌석예약정보를 저장 관리하고, 상기 좌석예약정보와 매칭되는 상기 좌석예약인증정보를 할당하여 해당 모바일 통신단말로 전송하는 도서관 좌석 예약 관리부; 및 도서관 입실 시 해당 모바일 통신단말로부터 상기 좌석예약인증정보를 근거리무선통신방식으로 입력 받아 도서관의 출입 통제 및 입실을 인증하는 도서관 출입 및 입실 인증 관리부를 포함하는 도서관 출입 통제 및 좌석 관리 시스템을 개시한다.

title_en: Improved blocking cost distribution method based on Shapley value
abstract_en: The invention discloses a blocking cost distribution method based on Shapley value improvement, which comprises the following steps: (1) calculating the running state of the power system considering network constraint and not considering network constraint to obtain the blocking cost at each moment; (2) forming alliances by taking the load as a participant according to a user revocation mode, taking the negative blocking cost as a characteristic function, obtaining the characteristic function of each alliance and forming a cooperative game model; (3) solving a Shapley value of the cooperative game model; (4) establishing a cooperative game solving model improved based on a Shapley value, namely an equity minimum core solving model; (5) and carrying out blocking cost distribution according to the distribution strategy obtained by solving. The invention has higher stability.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ECONOMIC RES INST;UNIV SOUTHEAST

title_en: Project resource element management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a project resource element management system, wherein a project resource element management system model is established, and profit, net cash flow, rights and interests, output value, actual collection, two funds, total cost, actual payment and balance payable data of a project level and each level of a company are obtained; the project resource element management system model consists of the following relational expressions: yield-total cost-profit; actual collection-actual payment-a net cash flow; two funds-balance due is a right interest; yield-actual collection of money is two gold; total cost-actual payment-balance due; profit-net cash flow is equity; the invention constructs a project resource element management system by utilizing three dimensions of profit, net cash flow and equity, six basic formulas and nine core data, can fully reflect the project profitability, the cash theory and the resource receiving and paying relation, and can guide a manager to carry out resource allocation and element control on the project, thereby realizing value creation.

title_en: Real bilateral auction method for platform logistics
abstract_en: The invention provides a real bilateral auction method facing to platform logistics, and relates to the technical field of logistics. The platform determines a bid conversion parameter through a simulation optimization method, determines the comprehensive bids of both sides based on the original bid information of both sides of the client and the logistics company, the rest required information of both sides and the predetermined bid conversion parameter, constructs a supply and demand pool based on the comprehensive bid information of both sides, and determines the winning client and the logistics company, the respective transaction amount and the transaction price. The invention ensures that the real bidding is optimal for each bidder of the two parties no matter how other bidders bid, and the platform can obtain non-negative profits, thereby simplifying the bidding decisions of the two parties and improving the information reliability and the transaction fairness of the platform; and allows the platform to flexibly select an operation target; the comprehensive bid replaces the original bid to carry out calculation, and the demand response speed and the logistics service quality provided by the platform are improved.

title_en: Water supply allocation system based on flow data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water supply allocation system based on flow data, which comprises an intelligent decision module, a big data algorithm center module and a sub-station monitoring transmission module, wherein the intelligent decision module and the big data algorithm center device are connected with each other, the sub-station monitoring transmission module is respectively connected with the intelligent decision module and the big data algorithm center module, and the sub-station monitoring transmission module can carry out monitoring control and related data acquisition feedback transmission on water supply equipment, a flowmeter and a water quality monitoring device which are contained in a corresponding sub-station of the water supply system, and can transmit instructions of the intelligent decision module to the corresponding water supply equipment, the flowmeter and the water quality monitoring device. The invention solves the problems that the traditional water supply system relies on personnel experience judgment, and the water quantity of the water supply network is allocated by manually issuing the regulation and control instruction, so that the allocation of the water supply system network has great subjective dependence on personnel and is seriously limited by personnel professional level and experience reserve.
assignees: ANHUI SHUNYU WATER AFFAIRS CO LTD

title_en: Distributed carbon transaction market consensus method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a distributed carbon trade market consensus method, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps that a node is established, the node comprises a common node and a common node, the common node is used for processing a transaction proposal, checking enterprise qualification and data authenticity, and the common node is used for data submission and data synchronization; starting a consensus algorithm based on the nodes, wherein the consensus algorithm distributes identities for the consensus nodes, and comprises a transaction center, candidate nodes and common consensus nodes; the method comprises the steps that a transaction proposal is created by a common node and sent to a transaction center, the transaction center forwards the transaction proposal to all the consensus nodes, all the consensus nodes audit the transaction proposal, an audit result is generated and sent back to the transaction center, and if the audit is passed, the transaction proposal is broadcasted; and carrying out carbon transaction based on the transaction proposal after the verification, and completing carbon integral management of both transaction parties. The invention can effectively ensure the issuing of the carbon quota, the fairness of the transaction and the safety of the transaction data, and accurately identify and shield the nodes and the clients which try to tamper with the transaction information.

title_en: Fairness-based energy quota allocation and double-layer decision relationship method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fairness-based energy quota allocation and double-layer decision relation method. Belongs to the technical field of energy policy and planning. And constructing a fairness measurement index system comprising responsibility, capability and equal principles, and determining a region comprehensive score and fairness constraint by integrating the multiple data. The decision maker aims at maximizing the renewable energy proportion under the constraint of fairness and cost, sets the objective function and constraint conditions, and the executor aims at minimizing the implementation cost and definitely associating the constraint. The reasonable quota allocation scheme is finally determined through the establishment of an energy production transaction plan by an executor and the establishment of an allocation target by a decision maker, interactive evaluation and adjustment and repeated cyclic optimization so as to coordinate the targets of the decision maker and the executor in renewable energy quota allocation and implementation.

title_en: New energy transaction settlement deviation compensation method, device, equipment and computer program
abstract_en: The invention discloses a new energy transaction settlement deviation compensation method, device, equipment and computer program, which comprises the steps of determining transaction settlement decision variables of a new energy generator, an electricity selling company and an electric power user, determining settlement deviation variables, constructing an objective function of the generator, an objective function of the electricity selling company and a user objective function, determining compensation coefficient sensitivity indexes of the new energy generator, the electricity selling company and the electric power user, constructing a deviation compensation optimization model based on game balance, constructing a compensation coefficient dynamic adjustment model, solving the deviation compensation optimization model through a particle swarm algorithm combined with chaotic particle swarm and Nash balance guide to obtain an optimal solution of the transaction settlement decision variables, determining an optimal compensation coefficient according to the optimal solution and the compensation coefficient dynamic adjustment model, and further performing new energy transaction settlement deviation compensation.
