The invention improves the accuracy, fairness and real-time performance of new energy transaction settlement deviation compensation, and can be applied to the technical field of electric power markets.
assignees: INF CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD;GUANGDONG ELECTRIC POWER TRANSACTION CENTER CO LTD

title_en: Anonymous centralized transfer or allocation of resources
abstract_en: Systems and methods for centralized transfer or allocation of resources may include receiving a first set of data describing a plurality of providing entities and an associated number of units of a resource which are available for allocation; receiving a second set of data describing a resource request associated with a requesting entity; assessing the resource request according to a set of predefined allocation criteria; determining at least two providing entities for which the resource request satisfies the set of predefined allocation criteria; and dividing the resource request across the determined set of providing entities in accordance with a fairness criterion.

title_en: System and method for optimizing product development portfolios and aligning product, brand, and information technology strategies
abstract_en: Business and software methods are described for cost-effectively optimizing product development portfolios, services development portfolios, and IT (information technology) portfolios, accelerating market entry, and optimizing alignment between product strategy, IT strategy, and brand strategy. Product and service attributes are characterized, categorized, and prioritized with numerical values amenable to statistical analysis of each assessed product development/IT initiative in terms of alignment with ideal customer experience and potential competitive impact relative to the resources and risks required to bring each initiative to market. Methods further include prioritization in the form of applied decision intelligence tools to allow an organization to reach better-informed judgments concerning resource allocation to develop, maintain, or optimize a given product or service portfolio or IT portfolio to improve business performance, increase market impact, and build brand equity.

title_en: Analysis method for nonstandard behaviors in bidding process based on AI technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses an analysis method for nonstandard behaviors in a bidding process based on an AI technology, which comprises the following steps of firstly, pre-constructing a learning model according to behavior sample data in the bidding process, wherein the result given by continuously input data is manually adjusted and optimized according to the result given by the continuously input data during the construction, and optimizing behavior data content and weight values to enable a prediction result to trend towards a real situation; step two, importing relevant behavior data to predict results, analyzing all behaviors in the bidding process and obtaining numerical conclusion, so as to realize the analysis of all behaviors in the bidding process, and rapidly and efficiently give accurate analysis process data and approaching to accurate analysis results; in the bidding process, possible nonstandard behaviors are predicted and monitored, early warning is given in time, a supervision department is reminded of early intervention, the influence of the nonstandard behaviors on fairness of bidding is reduced, and other bidders or rights and interests of the bidders are damaged.

title_en: Method for random dynamic regulation and control of water and soil resources and risk avoidance through efficiency improvement, emission reduction, acid control and corrosion prevention
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for random dynamic regulation and control and risk avoidance of water and soil resources, which comprises the steps of efficiency improvement, emission reduction, acid control and corrosion prevention. The method comprises the following steps: s1: adopting a farmland soil acidification model based on nutrient input-output balance, and respectively quantifying soil acidity, soil organic carbon and soil erosion amount by an agricultural residue theoretical potential model and a RUSLE model of soil erosion; s2: creating a soil acidification-carbon fixation-erosion collaborative lifting continuous multiplication model; s3: constructing a joint distribution function of random variables of precipitation, runoff and water demand by adopting a three-dimensional Copula function, and determining joint occurrence probability; s4: creating a two-stage stochastic programming condition risk continuous multiplication model for dynamic regulation and control and risk management of agricultural water and soil resources; s5: and (3) synthesizing the models in S2 and S4, and taking the water supply and risk constraint conditions into consideration to form a nonlinear multi-objective random dynamic programming model. The invention fully considers the uncertainty in the agricultural water and soil resource management and ensures the fairness of the agricultural water and soil resource allocation under the uncertain condition.

title_en: Multi-terminal cooperative wage resource intelligent distribution method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent medical dispatching, in particular to a multi-terminal cooperative wage resource intelligent distribution method, which comprises the steps of firstly collecting positioning, road, nursing physiology and old man demand data and generating multi-mode standardized data; the method comprises the steps of constructing a three-dimensional digital twin potential field, constructing a matching model by utilizing photon prediction to correct the potential field, constructing a correction potential field, a protection capability vector and an old man demand vector, performing annealing optimization to obtain initial matching, constructing a protection-old man-period trisection diagram based on a matching result, performing tension diffusion and gradient projection iteration to obtain optimal matching, performing double digital signatures on each matching, casting a non-homogeneous promise in a blockchain to realize credible performance, continuously outputting fatigue probability by a wearing-end pulse neural network, mapping the fatigue probability into a potential energy increment write-back potential field, triggering sub potential field re-decomposition, zero knowledge shift and closed-loop updating. The method and the system improve scheduling instantaneity and fairness, reduce fatigue risk and ensure service whole-course traceability.

title_en: Enterprise actual controller supporting distributed computing and control path computing method
abstract_en: An enterprise actual controller and control path calculation method supporting distributed calculation comprises the following steps: 1) dividing a network graph formed by an enterprise equity structure into n sub-network graphs which are not communicated with each other, and setting a cache region; 2) initializing enterprise states in each network; 3) iteratively updating the enterprise state in each network; 4) and judging the termination of iteration in each network, and acquiring the final state of the enterprise to obtain the actual controller and the actual control path of the enterprise. The invention can accurately calculate the actual control person and the actual control path of the enterprise based on the equity structure information of the enterprise, and simultaneously support distributed calculation, thereby greatly improving the operation rate when the data volume is huge.

title_en: Disaster relief material two-stage vehicle scheduling path optimization method and system based on KMG-ALNS algorithm
abstract_en: The invention provides a disaster relief material two-stage vehicle dispatching path optimization method, system, storage medium and electronic equipment based on a KMG-ALNS algorithm, and relates to the technical field of vehicle dispatching. Aiming at the problem of optimizing the dispatching paths of two-stage vehicles for disaster relief materials, the invention sequentially determines the position of the stop point of the first-stage vehicle and the optimal distribution path of the second-stage vehicle from the stop point to the disaster relief point under the condition of known disaster relief condition and considering the limitation of the carrying capacity and the cruising ability of the second-stage vehicle, thereby quickly acquiring the optimal solution and realizing the minimization of the system cost.

title_en: Traffic flow prediction method based on dynamic sampling and related equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a traffic flow prediction method and related equipment based on dynamic sampling, which take calculated sampling probability and preset total sampling number of road nodes as constraint conditions, and sample the road nodes in each traffic area to obtain balanced and diversified data, thereby improving the unbalanced problem of traffic flow data and enabling areas containing different road nodes to obtain similar prediction performance; and forming double-layer fairness constraint according to the discrimination loss, individual dynamic fairness loss, model utility loss and regional static fairness loss of the space-time prediction model so as to promote training and optimization of the space-time prediction model, so that the optimized space-time prediction model generates a fair and accurate traffic flow prediction result, and the accuracy and fairness of regional traffic flow prediction are improved.
assignees: UNIV CENTRAL SOUTH;SHENZHEN RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF NANJING UNIV OF AERONAUTICS AND ASTRONAUTICS

title_en: Vehicle charging management method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a vehicle charging management method, device, equipment and storage medium, relates to the technical field of vehicles, and aims to improve the accuracy of vehicle charging management, effectively improve the utilization rate of charging resources by optimizing the distribution and dispatch of the charging resources, and help a power grid to balance the power consumption requirements of different time periods, so that the user charging satisfaction is improved. The method comprises the steps of obtaining charging emergency degree information, charging economy information and scheduling fairness information of a vehicle to be charged, carrying out weighted fusion on the charging emergency degree information, the charging economy information and the scheduling fairness information to obtain comprehensive priority scores of the vehicle to be charged, and generating a corresponding charging strategy by a real-time power distribution function based on the obtained electric pile power information and the comprehensive priority scores, wherein the charging strategy is used for planning a charging power curve of the vehicle changing along with time in a preset future time period.

title_en: Management apparatus of stockers
abstract_en: To provide a management apparatus of stockers ensuring fairness to a plurality of users.SOLUTION: In a sales management system 10, a management apparatus 30 of stockers 40 has a plurality of delivery chambers 41 and manages stockers used by a plurality of users (entrepreneurs). The plurality of delivery chambers includes delivery chambers of a plurality of sizes, and at least one of the plurality of sizes is a size used for a plurality of delivery chambers of that size. The management apparatus comprises a memory unit which stores, for each size, allocated users who are one or more users to whom usable delivery chambers are allocated among the plurality of users, and the number of allocated delivery chambers which is the number of delivery chambers allocated to the respective allocated users, for the plurality of delivery chambers of the size with the plurality of delivery chambers.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Systems and methods for managing physical assets across territorial boundaries
abstract_en: Systems and methods are provided for the transfer of legal control of a physical asset when the physical asset is transported across a territorial boundary. Such systems and methods facilitate the transfer of assets within a network between network participants associated with and having control over territories when an asset crosses a territorial boundary. Such a transfer allows for efficient and equitable distribution of costs, revenues, and other elements associated with movable assets among network participants in a region of control.

title_en: Subway train running chart and demand management collaborative optimization method in reservation trip mode
abstract_en: The invention provides a subway train running chart and demand management collaborative optimization method under a reservation travel mode, which comprises the steps of obtaining subway line data and passenger flow data, establishing decision variables, constructing constraint conditions according to fairness between the number of passengers served by a train at each station and the number of waiting passengers and the coupling relationship between the capacity and the traffic volume of the train according to the coupling relationship between reserved passengers and unreserved passengers in a subway system, constructing an initial subway train running chart and demand management collaborative optimization nonlinear programming model by combining the subway line data, the passenger flow data, the decision variables and the constraint conditions, equivalently converting the nonlinear programming model into a linear form according to large M constraint to obtain a demand management collaborative optimization linear programming model, and solving by designing a solving algorithm according to mathematical characteristics of the linear programming model until a standard subway train running chart, a reservation name allocation scheme and a passenger flow control scheme are obtained. The method of the invention improves the service efficiency and reduces the operation cost.

title_en: A six rotor crafts for disaster relief supplies are put in
abstract_en: The utility model provides a six rotor crafts for disaster relief supplies are put in, includes frame and control circuit, the frame includes fuselage and six cantilevers, and the fuselage includes mounting panel, lower mounting panel and is used for connecting the spliced pole of going up mounting panel and lower mounting panel, goes up and forms accommodation space between mounting panel and the lower mounting panel, goes up the first connecting seat that the mounting panel edge was equipped with six circumference evenly distributed, and lower mounting panel edge is equipped with six circumference evenly distributed's second connecting seat, and the setting is just presented down with second connecting seat one -to -one to first connecting seat, first mount pad forms the installation station rather than the second mount pad that corresponds, and cantilever one end is installed on the installation station, the other end of cantilever is equipped with the motor, and the output shaft and the screw of motor are connected. The utility model discloses the carrying capacity is big, can realize the input of goods and materials, and is reliable and stable. (U /)

title_en: Equity recommended method, device and equipment
abstract_en: This specification provides a kind of equity recommended method, device and equipment, the described method includes: the amount range to equity has divided multiple sections, the input of recommended models includes each section of all kinds of equity, estimates the rate of checking and writing off so as to obtain user for each section of every class equity.And, income and cost of the present embodiment in view of each section of each equity, under conditions of with cost constraint, with user gather in the provisional profit maximum of all users turn to optimization problem, cost control coefficient is solved using Optimization Solution algorithm, final recommendation decision is carried out based on cost control coefficient, the optimization aim of the present embodiment is to maximize whole promotion effect, solves the problems, such as the cost constraint of different equity.

title_en: Comprehensive talent management system
abstract_en: The invention particularly relates to a comprehensive talent management system. In the comprehensive talent management system, an administrator creates a declaration template through a template creation module, and an upper management department is responsible for issuing a comment task through a task issuing module, so that a comment standard and time schedule are defined; the declaration person submits the declaration through a declaration and auditing module according to the task requirement; the expert evaluation selecting and scoring module is responsible for constructing and maintaining an expert evaluation library, and scoring online or offline is carried out on the basis of the expert evaluation extracted from the expert evaluation library according to the specific requirements of the evaluation task; the scoring summarization and decision-making module is responsible for summarizing scoring results, and the superior management department makes decisions and publishes according to the comprehensive scores. The comprehensive talent management system solves the problems of low efficiency, insufficient transparency, lack of flexibility and expandability and inconsistent evaluation and selection standards in the prior art, simplifies talent management flow, improves the efficiency and fairness of evaluation, and is suitable for talent management of organizations of various scales.

title_en: Method for selecting number of black start power supply nodes by considering fairness and openness
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for selecting the number of black start power supply nodes by considering fairness and openness, which comprises the following steps: s1, constructing a fairness imbalance level evaluation model of which a units are selected from n units as a black start power supply; s2, determining inherent cost required by providing black start service according to the ith BSU and corresponding cost factors; s3, taking the selected frequency of each BSU under different purchase numbers as a value index; s4, for a certain BSU address selection combination obtained through bidding, the scheduling mechanism takes the highest BSU cost in the combination as a reference to determine the purchase price paid to each unit; s5, calculating expected E  a  of the total purchase price of the market under different values of a, and carrying out objective function modeling by a scheduling center decision process to solve the number of units which enable the objective function to be minimum. The invention can establish the optimal BSU purchasing total number under the dual requirements of comprehensively considering the control fairness and the improvement of the purchasing scheme economy.
assignees: UNIV CHINESE HONG KONG SHENZHEN;CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO

title_en: Inland ship reservation and gate passing scheduling method in key reservation and declaration queuing mode
abstract_en: The invention provides a inland ship reservation and passing scheduling method in a key reservation and declaration queuing mode, which is characterized in that the priority of a ship is set according to the type of the ship, the priority of a common ship needing to be declared and queued is set as the lowest, the priority of the key ship needing to be reserved and passed is higher than the priority of the common ship, and a cost function is constructed based on the priority of the ship, the waiting time of the ship and the navigation time of the ship Constructing a queuing fairness function through ship passing time difference Establishing a comprehensive congestion function through a complex network model By a cost function And the fairness function Comprehensive congestion function Chamber utilization function And a gate-discharging frequency function And solving the objective function and the constraint conditions through an optimization algorithm to obtain a gate passing scheduling scheme. The operation efficiency of the ship lock is effectively improved, and support is provided for scheduling of inland navigation.

title_en: Virtual power plant transaction scheduling method and device based on block chain consensus
abstract_en: The invention discloses a virtual power plant transaction scheduling method and device based on blockchain consensus, which construct a virtual power plant transaction scheduling framework, wherein the virtual power plant transaction scheduling framework comprises a blockchain main chain and at least one blockchain slave chain, transaction center nodes, scheduling center nodes and at least one distributed energy node are deployed on the blockchain main chain, each blockchain slave chain is provided with at least one distributed energy node, and effective coordination of virtual power plant transaction scheduling is realized through a blockchain-based distributed consensus and token bucket electric power flow control algorithm. The invention can ensure fairness and balance of scheduling of each distributed energy node in the virtual power plant, realize peak clipping and valley filling when external power transaction demand fluctuates, ensure transparency and traceability of transaction scheduling, and enhance safety of the device.
assignees: UNIV BEIHANG;YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Large-area flight recovery energy efficiency optimization method integrating deep learning and genetic algorithm
abstract_en: The invention provides a large-area flight recovery energy efficiency optimization method integrating deep learning and genetic algorithm, belongs to the technical field of intelligent scheduling and optimization, and solves the problem of multi-objective efficient recovery after large-scale flight delay. The technical scheme includes that firstly, standardized dispatching input features and economic loss factors are built by means of real flight data, then, a multi-objective function is designed, total delay, economic loss, serious delay times and dispatching fairness are comprehensively considered, then, a dispatching sample is generated and a training set is constructed based on an evolution strategy, a deep neural network agent model is trained to replace a high-cost evaluation function, and finally, an optimal dispatching scheme is quickly searched in evolution optimization by combining the agent model and an elite screening mechanism. The invention has the beneficial effects of efficiently completing large-scale flight recovery scheduling tasks, taking global efficiency and local fairness into account, helping command departments to quickly formulate recovery strategies, and having stronger practical application value.

title_en: Method for performing urban development and method for controlling economy
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To create a mechanism for turning profit in community redevelopment to collect demand in urban development.SOLUTION: In community redevelopment, when a method is employed in which an inhabitant enjoys development profit and a part of profit is passed to enterprises through a public service body, the inhabitant is likely to be gathered toward community development, urban development is promoted, and large-scale community development becomes possible in an area separated from a city center. Only by controlling a manpower distribution factor of enterprise at a level where recession is avoided, fairness of taxation is kept rather than enterprise tax and income tax, resulting in increase in income and increase in expenditure much more directly than current enterprise tax, income tax, and public investment.SELECTED DRAWING: None

title_en: Shares segmentation investment platform of solar plant based on blockchain
title_ko: 블록체인기반 태양광 발전소 지분분할투자 플랫폼
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a blockchain-based solar power plant equity split investment platform comprising: an equity generation part (110) which divides an equity for a solar power plant (100) to provide corresponding investment equity information to an investment terminal (200) of an individual investor; a profit distribution part (120) which distributes sales profits of the solar power plant (100) according to a ratio corresponding to the investment equity information; an information collection part (130) which collects transaction information and power plant information, respectively; a transaction information storage part (140) which distributes and stores the investment equity information, the transaction information, and the power plant information in a distributed ledger based on a blockchain, respectively; and an information providing part (150) which transmits market price, price fluctuation trend, annual return, transaction information of annual return, and power plant information for the equity for each solar power plant to the investment terminal (200) to enable real-time confirmation on the web or app, thereby disclosing the transaction information and the power plant information to increase the reliability of the individual investor and maximize profitability through power plant management.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 태양광 발전소(100)에 대한 지분을 분할하여 개인투자자의 투자 단말기(200)로 해당 투자지분정보를 제공하는 지분 생성부(110), 태양광 발전소(100)의 매전 수익을 투자지분정보에 상응하는 비율에 따라 배분하는 수익 배분부(120), 거래정보 및 발전소정보를 각각 수집하는 정보 수집부(130), 투자지분정보와 거래정보와 발전소정보를 블록체인기반으로 각각 분산원장에 분산저장하는 거래정보 저장부(140), 및 태양광 발전소별 지분에 대한 시가와 가격변동추이와 연수익률의 거래정보, 및 발전소정보를 투자 단말기(200)로 전송하여 웹 또는 앱에서 실시간으로 확인이 가능하도록 하는 정보 제공부(150)를 포함하여, 거래정보와 발전소정보를 공개하여 개인투자자의 신뢰도를 높이도록 하고 발전소 관리를 통해 수익성을 최대화하는, 블록체인기반 태양광 발전소 지분분할투자 플랫폼을 개시한다.

title_en: Work area division system and method for recycling renewable resources
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of garbage classification, in particular to a working area dividing system and method for recycling renewable resources. In the method, a matrix coordinate system is constructed through information of all cells in the project, then a local optimal path L for connecting all cells is obtained in the matrix coordinate system according to a GA gene genetic path planning algorithm, then all cell points in the optimal path L are respectively calculated to be k slices by taking 1,2,3 and n as initial points, and { S  1 ,S 2 ,...,S n  } is respectively formed. And finally, calculating an evaluation index for each group of division schemes to obtain an optimal division scheme. The scheme scientifically divides the working area of the renewable resource garbage collector, and ensures the labor cost balance of project operation and the labor allocation fairness among collectors.

title_en: power grid dispatching operation comprehensive evaluation method considering index correlation
abstract_en: the invention discloses a power grid dispatching operation comprehensive evaluation method considering index association, which comprises the steps of firstly taking a power generation company, a power grid company and a power consumer as evaluation objects of power grid dispatching operation evaluation, respectively screening out secondary and tertiary indexes of five primary indexes of each evaluation object, namely economy, cleanness, safety, fairness and service quality, and establishing a power grid dispatching operation comprehensive evaluation system; according to the variability of the index, an entropy weight method is used for obtaining the initial weight of the index; solving a gray correlation matrix between indexes by adopting a gray correlation analysis method; adjusting a grey correlation matrix through a threshold principle; adjusting the weight determined by the entropy weight method by combining a threshold variable weight method, and reducing the influence caused by index association; and carrying out nonlinear aggregation on the evaluation values of the indexes by using the fuzzy measure and Chouqet fuzzy integral to obtain a comprehensive evaluation value. The invention can eliminate the interaction between indexes and improve the accuracy of the evaluation result.

title_en: Water right initial allocation optimization method based on remorse theory
abstract_en: The invention relates to a water resource planning method. The method aims to provide an optimization method for initial distribution of water rights based on the regret theory, so as to realize the initial distribution of water rights in different areas and industries, improve the management capability of water resources, and improve the utilization efficiency of the water resources while ensuring fairness. The technical proposal is as follows: the water right initial allocation optimization method based on the remorse theory comprises the following steps: 1. preparing a basic data set, and collecting regional related social, economic, water conservancy and agricultural related data; 2. setting objective functions, and determining three objective functions by considering that water resource utilization has economic, social, ecological and other values: the social benefit is maximum, the economic benefit is maximum and the ecological benefit is maximum; 3. constraint conditions are set, and water resource water supply balance constraint and water demand constraint of water use departments are set. 4. A multi-objective optimization algorithm, which adopts a second-generation non-dominant order genetic (NSGA-II) algorithm as the multi-objective optimization algorithm; 5. and (5) a water right initial allocation scheme based on the remorse theory.
assignees: ZHEJIANG INSTITUTE OF HYDRAULICS & ESTUARY ZHEJIANG MARINE PLANNING AND DESIGN RES INSTITUTE

title_en: Electric power communication service risk balance route optimization method and system based on service characteristics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power communication service risk balance route optimization method based on service characteristics, which mainly comprises two parts, namely a multi-type multi-service oriented part and a single-type multi-service oriented part. Firstly, aiming at multiple types of multiple businesses, an analytic hierarchy process is introduced, related evaluation indexes of the businesses are selected, and a business importance evaluation model is constructed; the concepts of overall network risk degree, overall network risk balance degree and the like are provided, and optimal screening is carried out by utilizing a maximum and minimum fairness constraint formula based on risk balance; secondly, according to single-type multiple services, service related constraint conditions are induced, then a risk balance route optimization model based on real-time delay is arranged, and then a route optimization mechanism is designed based on common evolution and self-adaptive fuzzy genetic algorithm. The invention can solve the problem of a power communication service risk balance route optimization mechanism, ensure the stable operation of the network, and improve the performance indexes such as safety, reliability, real time and the like of the service.
assignees: DALIAN POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Excitation and visualization presentation device are accomplished in patent index distribution
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of data analysis, and particularly relates to a device for completing excitation and visualization demonstration of patent index distribution, which comprises an information input module, a judgment and selection module, a technician quantity input calculation module, a technician power level input calculation module, a technician title calculation module, an examination module and a completion condition display module, wherein the information input module inputs information of related personnel, the judgment and selection module judges what index distribution calculation is adopted, the technician quantity input calculation module calculates the technician power level input condition among all departments, the technician title calculation module calculates the technician title condition among all departments, the examination module examines the overall income of all x+1-level departments, and the completion condition display module displays the actual completion index condition of all departments. The application can fully mobilize the enthusiasm of vast staff while meeting fairness, fairness and transparency, and simultaneously ensures the stability of staff. The subjective judgment of people is reduced, objective management is achieved, and the method and the basis are provided.

title_en: Draft survey case processing progress real-time monitoring and resource rescheduling dispatch system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a draft survey case processing progress real-time monitoring and resource rescheduling dispatching and dispatching system, which relates to the technical field of draft survey intelligent dispatching and comprises the steps of obtaining draft survey case state information of draft survey cases in a processing link, displaying current state information of each draft survey case in a visual mode on a monitoring platform, generating resource capacity representation capable of being quantitatively evaluated, dispatching and dispatching draft survey case processing with different emergency degrees by adopting a dynamic weight optimization algorithm, and constructing a closed-loop control link. The invention solves the technical problems of state perception lag, rough resource matching, static dispatch strategy, disjoint monitoring and execution and the like in the traditional dispatching mode, improves the response speed, the resource utilization efficiency, the dispatching fairness and the service traceability of draft survey case processing, and provides a highly reliable, quantifiable and extensible technical support for the intellectualization of insurance claims.
assignees: SHAANXI HUIXIANGBAO TECH CONSULTING SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Supply allocation calculating system
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To solve the conventional problem wherein it is impossible to cope with change of requirement from bases or change of an available amount, so as to optimize an inventory.  <P>SOLUTION: An allocation amount of articles to the bases is calculated based on: an available total amount (including other than "quantity") in a prescribed period; an amount required for shipment from the bases on a distribution channel (required amount including other than "quantity"); and a promise amount for the amount required for shipment. The promise amount is the allocation amount promised with the bases in a promise period as the prescribed period. This invention may compare the available amount and the total amount of the promise, and change the allocation method based on the comparison result.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Smart dynamic equity distribution framework
abstract_en: This invention introduces the Dynamic Equity Distribution Method, a groundbreaking system designed to enable fair, transparent, and adaptable equity allocation in startups and collaborative ventures. By integrating blockchain technology, tokenization, and dynamic adjustment mechanisms, this method overcomes the limitations of static equity models, ensuring that ownership shares continuously align with each member's real-time contributions. Key features include: Comprehensive Contribution Valuation: A structured approach to evaluate both financial and non-financial contributions, such as intellectual property, network resources, physical assets, skills, and time, using Fair Market Value (FMV) assessments. Dynamic Adjustment Mechanism: Automated equity realignments powered by smart contracts, conducting periodic reviews to reflect ongoing contributions and performance milestones. Tokenization and Blockchain Integration: Equity shares represented as digital tokens stored on a blockchain, ensuring transparency, security, and ease of ownership transfer. Structured Exit Protocols: Predefined procedures for member exits, including buy-back options, share dilution mechanisms, reserve funds to manage ownership transitions seamlessly.
assignees: MANAFI MIRALILOO FAEGHEH;BAKHSHI GHOURT TAPPEH VAHID

title_en: Emergency rescue material high-dimensional multi-target distribution method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-dimensional multi-target distribution method and system for emergency rescue materials, and relates to the technical field of multi-target optimization. The invention considers the complexity of the emergency rescue environment, designs on the basis of summarizing the existing work from the systematicness and the sociality of the emergency response engineering, comprehensively considers six optimization targets of the total emergency response time, the panic degree of victims, the unsatisfied degree of disaster relief supplies, the fairness of material distribution, the loss of victims and the total emergency response cost, constructs a high-dimensional multi-target distribution model with multiple reserve points, multiple release points and multiple disaster relief supplies, restores the complex emergency rescue scene to a certain extent, obviously improves the effectiveness and the practicability of the emergency rescue material distribution method, and can provide more comprehensive and scientific thinking for emergency decision makers.

title_en: Motivating equitable behavior in calendar events
abstract_en: An event scheduling request is received, and a disruption factor is associated with each of a plurality of invitees. The disruption factor is based upon, at least in part, an event parameter and at least one invitee attribute. An event is scheduled based upon, at least in part, the disruption factors associated with each of the plurality of invitees.
assignees: JU LIN;O'SULLIVAN PATRICK J;STERN EDITH H;WEIR ROBERT C;WILLNER BARRY E;IBM

title_en: Relief supplies reserve management and distribution system based on Internet of Things technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a relief supplies reserve management and distribution system based on an Internet of Things technology. The relief supplies reserve management and distribution system comprises a vehicle positioning management subsystem, wherein the vehicle positioning management subsystem is used for tracking and positioning a vehicle proceeding position, collecting the vehicle positioning data of the vehicle, the article information of cargoes and surveillance video information and sending the vehicle positioning data of the vehicle, the article information of cargoes and the surveillance video information to a monitoring center, and the vehicle positioning data of the vehicle, the article information of cargoes and surveillance video information are stored and processed by the monitoring center. The vehicle positioning management subsystem comprises a vehicle-mounted terminal, an RFID (Radio Frequency Identification) module, a visual supervision module and a warehouse management subsystem, wherein the warehouse management subsystem is communicated with the RFID module and is used for managing the receiving, the delivery, the ordering, the checking and the operation of the cargoes according to the article information read by an RFID information reading unit. Relief working efficiency and quality can be improved, relief supplies distribution is especially monitored and managed, and blindness and disorder in a traditional emergency relief process are avoided so as to ensure that emergency relief and security work can be successfully carried out.
assignees: BEIJING CREATIVE & INTELLIGENT TECHNOLOGY DEV CO LTD

title_en: Event prediction method and device, electronic equipment
abstract_en: This specification one or more embodiment provides a kind of event prediction method and device, electronic equipment, is applied to block chain node；The described method includes: determine that participant is directed to the prediction result of specified event input and is released to block chain, the generation moment of the input time of the prediction result earlier than the actual result of the specified event；Call the intelligent contract for being used for evaluation and foreca situation, the intelligence contract be used to read the prediction result and the actual result, and the prediction result is compared with the actual result, with according to comparison result, object sends distribution instruction to outside chain, the distribution instruction is used to indicate the outer object of the chain and distributes equity voucher outside the first chain to the participant.

title_en: Method and system for distributing initial water right of river basin across provinces
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for distributing initial water right of a river basin across provinces, wherein the method comprises the following steps: reading water resource survey data of river basin crossing provinces, and obtaining and analyzing a representative hydrological series capable of reflecting withering changes and current underlying surface conditions; acquiring basic data of river basin across provinces, wherein the basic data comprises water resource development and utilization data, economic and social data and ecological environment data; obtaining an evaluation index of an evaluation index system for constructing initial water resource distribution of a river basin crossing provinces, and reducing the evaluation index; and constructing an SMAA-VIKOR initial water weight distribution model, and solving to obtain the initial water weight distribution proportion of each provincial administrative region. The invention can improve the water resource distribution precision and fairness across provincial river basins.
assignees: MINI OF WATER RESOURCES AND HYDROPOWER PLANNING AND DESIGN INSTITUTE

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle wireless charging service optimization method and system based on game theory
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for optimizing wireless charging service of an unmanned aerial vehicle based on game theory, wherein the method comprises the steps of establishing a wireless charging service model of the unmanned aerial vehicle based on single-master multi-slave Stackelberg game; setting initial total rewards of wireless charging service of the terminal by taking the maximization of utility function of the terminal as a target; setting initial charging strategies for wireless charging service to the terminals according to initial total rewards of the wireless charging service and respective electric energy loss by taking the maximization of respective utility functions of each unmanned aerial vehicle as targets; solving the Stackelberg equilibrium of the unmanned aerial vehicle wireless charging service model by using a reverse induction method; and finally, the charging service platform dispatches a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles with charging will to provide wireless charging service for the terminal; according to the invention, the energy transaction between the terminal and the unmanned aerial vehicle is planned from the game theory perspective, so that the individuality of the unmanned aerial vehicle is endowed and the fairness of the energy transaction process is ensured.

title_en: Educational resource sharing method and system based on big data
abstract_en: The system comprises a resource acquisition module, a target customer information distribution module, a teaching fee collection module, a resource acquisition timing fee collection result and an additional fee collection processing result, wherein the resource acquisition module acquires teaching resource information of each industry and resource information of all learning entity stores, the target customer information acquisition module acquires teaching resource demand information of a target customer, the teaching resource distribution module acquires target teaching resources required by the target customer according to the teaching resource demand information, the teaching fee collection module carries out information pushing analysis and teaching fee collection processing on the target teaching resources corresponding to a teacher and the target customer, the teaching teacher is selected and determined by the target customer, the resource acquisition timing fee collection result and the additional fee collection processing result are output, and the customer information management module carries out teaching resource information popularization and data introduction and quotation on a platform. The educational resource sharing method and system based on big data provided by the invention expand the class of educational resources and the fairness of resource acquisition.
assignees: HANGZHOU WUXI E COMMERCE CO LTD

title_en: Multi-station collaborative pipelined capability verification sample online distribution method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-station collaborative pipelined capacity verification sample online distribution method and system, which specifically comprises the steps of 1, manufacturing a preparation mark for each sample, 2, evaluating the samples, 3, setting laboratory marks and associating laboratories, 4, setting sample combination and associating distribution numbers in the laboratories, 5, distributing the samples for the laboratories and associating the distributed samples with each other, and 6, packaging and express delivering the distributed and associated samples. The invention avoids the situation of capability verification sample false sending or false identification, provides solid data support for sample tracing, and ensures confidentiality and fairness.

title_en: Aversion type facility site selection method based on power graph and improved genetic algorithm
abstract_en: The invention provides an aversion type facility site selection method based on a Power diagram and an improved genetic algorithm, which belongs to the technical field of facility planning site selection, and improves decision fairness and acceptability of aversion type facility site selection by combining Maximin site selection models, the Power diagram, the improved genetic algorithm and a local search algorithm, has more accurate global search capability and reduces negative influence on residents nearby or environments nearby. Specifically, the dual goals of maximizing public benefits and minimizing adverse effects are considered through a Maximin addressing model, a Power graph can accurately describe the adjacency and the influence range of each potential position, the application of an improved genetic algorithm can more effectively find a global optimal solution in a complex search space, effective position optimization is carried out through a simulated evolution process, and the accuracy of knowledge is further improved through a local search algorithm, so that a better solution is ensured to be achieved in a local area.

title_en: Evaluation mechanism method of carbon emission detection index
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of evaluation of carbon emission detection indexes, in particular to an evaluation mechanism method of the carbon emission detection indexes, which comprises the following steps of constructing a three-level index system, establishing 3 first-level indexes, setting 6 second-level indexes and subdividing the three-level index system into 18 third-level indexes, monitoring index data, collecting the original data of the three-level indexes of an enterprise, including values of target year setting, energy source occupation ratio, carbon emission, energy consumption intensity and the like, performing index scoring through a comprehensive scoring method, a standardized scoring method and a quantile scoring method, calculating level scores and calculating the total score of the enterprise. According to the invention, three classification methods are customized according to index characteristics and embedded in MK trend test, the significant emission reduction trend is objectively identified through the statistic Z value, the traditional static evaluation device is broken through, the transverse fairness and longitudinal comparability of an evaluation result are improved, an enterprise is driven to actively optimize an emission reduction path through a dynamic scoring mechanism, and a reliable basis is provided for policy accurate regulation.
assignees: QINGDAO MENGDOU NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Resident electricity-saving scene carbon benefits method and system based on reference value
abstract_en: The invention discloses a resident electricity-saving scene carbon benefits method and system based on a reference value, and relates to the technical field of carbon benefits. The method comprises the steps of user registration and authorization, multi-source data collection, accounting boundary and scene judgment, emission reduction accurate calculation, data quality control and recording, income distribution and platform support. The system consists of a data aggregation platform module, an accounting model management module and the like. According to the invention, the household population parameter setting differentiated reference value is introduced, the MRV principle is followed for standardized accounting, the fairness and the credibility are improved, the large-scale application is supported, and the problems of unscientific reference setting, irregular accounting and the like in the prior art are effectively solved.
assignees: TIANJIN RICHSOFT ELECTRIC POWER INFORMATION TECH CO LTD;SIJI ZHILIAN TIANJIN INFORMATION COMMUNICATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Emission trading product and method
abstract_en: The present invention provides a system and method for determining equivalency factors for use in comparative performance analysis of industrial facilities by determining a target variable and a plurality of characteristics of the target variable. Each of the plurality of characteristics is ranked according to value. Based on ranking value, the characteristics are divided into categories. Based on the sorted and ranked characteristics, a data collection classification system is developed. Data is collected according to the data collection classification system. The data is validated, and based on the data, an analysis model is developed. The analysis model then calculates the equivalency factors for use in one embodiment in performance measurement and equitable benchmarking of green house gas (GHG) emissions from industrial facilities for the purposes of allocating GHG emission allowances for permits, licenses, etc. Furthermore, a system and method is described for quantifying, transferring, managing, underwriting, or insuring the risk associated with emissions from manufacturing, operating a facility, or engaging in an activity that emits, produces, or potentially emits or produces permitted or regulated emissions. In addition to insuring against emissions that exceed permitted or regulated amounts, a system for pooling, managing, and trading emission credits is also described herein.

title_en: Geolocation Verification of Humanitarian Aid Token Distribution
abstract_en: A blockchain-based smart contract system for decentralized humanitarian aid distribution implementing multi-stage verification protocols, government database integration, and emergency protocol switching capabilities. The Global Positioning Satellite Food (GPSF) Token Protocol comprises specialized hardware and software systems for zone-locked token distribution with geolocation-enforced access controls and adaptive verification algorithms that switch between comprehensive community aid verification and expedited emergency aid verification based on real-time disaster declarations and conflict zone detection. The system establishes multi-layered fraud prevention architecture combining biometric liveness detection, cross-document correlation algorithms, anti-spoofing detection systems, and real-time government database verification to prevent fraudulent aid claims while ensuring legitimate beneficiaries receive assistance within minutes. The protocol implements atomic cross-chain protocols with multi-signature escrow mechanisms and threshold-signature authentication requiring consensus from multiple authorized entities, creating a trustless environment for humanitarian aid across routine aid programs, emergency disaster response, and active conflict zone operations.

title_en: Power generation scheduling evaluation method, device and equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power generation scheduling evaluation method, a power generation scheduling evaluation device and power generation scheduling evaluation equipment, which belong to the technical field of power scheduling, and are used for calculating the maximum power generation capacity of a target power generation enterprise in a target power grid based on a preset rule; determining the power generation margin of a target power generation enterprise according to the maximum power generation capacity and the power generation scheduling scheme; calculating expected risks of a target power generation enterprise based on a distribution structure of power generation margins; acquiring an expected risk Lorentz curve according to the expected risk; and obtaining an expected risk Gini coefficient based on the expected risk Lorentz curve, evaluating the power generation dispatching and obtaining a power generation dispatching evaluation result. Compared with the traditional result-oriented power generation scheduling fairness evaluation method, the power generation scheduling fairness evaluation method based on the expected execution risk provided by the invention essentially belongs to a process evaluation method, can evaluate fairness in a power generation scheduling service execution process more accurately, and is more beneficial to service promotion and normalized management.

title_en: New energy automobile charging pile load balancing and scheduling method based on intelligent algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of new energy automobiles, in particular to a new energy automobile charging pile load balancing and scheduling method based on an intelligent algorithm, which comprises the following steps of S1, data acquisition, real-time acquisition of operation data of a charging pile; the method comprises the steps of S2, predicting charging demands of all charging piles in a preset time in the future through a graph rolling network model, S3, optimizing space dispatching of the charging piles, namely, optimizing the dispatching of the charging piles in space according to geographic distribution conditions of the charging piles, surrounding vehicle flow and charging demand prediction results, S4, carrying out load dispatching and resource allocation, namely, carrying out resource allocation according to the charging demand prediction and charging pile space dispatching optimization results and combining power grid load conditions. The invention improves the utilization efficiency of the charging pile resources, optimizes the layout of the whole charging network, and ensures the fairness of charging service and the balance of power grid load.

title_en: Omni-channel multi-level demand prioritization and allocation
abstract_en: A system and method are multi-level replenishment planning with independent channel demand prioritization that initiates production of a product by a first supply chain entity that receives orders for the product from a second supply chain entity and supplies the product to a third supply chain entity that receives orders for the product from a fourth supply chain entity. Embodiments further disclose calculating the supply of the product for the first supply chain entity for a supply allocation duration time period, receiving demand orders high priority demand orders from the fourth supply chain entity, allocating supplies within the supply allocation duration time period to firm plan arrivals based on a location priority and a demand date, and generating a shipment recommendation for each allocated supply that meets a firmed planned arrival.

title_en: Medical institution inspection method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a medical institution inspection method and device and electronic equipment. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a target score of a target medical institution; under the condition that the target value is lower than a preset value, first indication information is sent to a medical insurance terminal, and the first indication information is used for indicating inspectors and auditing equipment; and acquiring medical institution data which is uploaded by the auditing equipment and related to the target medical institution, wherein the medical institution data is acquired by the inspector at the target medical institution through the auditing equipment. According to the scheme, the auditing equipment is used as a carrier to acquire the data of the medical institution, so that the fairness of data acquisition can be ensured; moreover, the optimization and supervision of the conventional flying inspection process are realized by applying a block chain technology, so that the human intervention is reduced, and the credibility of the inspection result is improved.
assignees: TAIKANG INSURANCE GROUP CO LTD;TAIKANG PENSION & INSURANCE CO LTD

title_en: Average distribution method and system based on post-loan overdue piece average sum
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-loan overdue item average amount distribution method and system, and relates to the technical field of financial analysis. The method comprises the following steps: recording daily case condition information of each operator; counting the average value of the piece average money of each operator; sorting the distribution priority of the operators according to the average value of the piece average money of each operator to obtain the distribution priority sequence of each operator; obtaining and calculating a threshold value according to the information of the case to be distributed; sorting the cases to be distributed; sequentially distributing each sequenced case to be distributed to the corresponding operator according to the distribution priority sequence of each operator; after each operator finishes the distribution, judging whether the amount of money in the distributed case exceeds a threshold value, and if not, continuing the distribution; otherwise, the allocation is ended. The invention can improve the distribution uniformity and fairness rationality, thereby improving the processing efficiency of operators.

title_en: Pure electric bus network planning method considering fairness
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of urban traffic planning, and relates to a pure electric bus network planning method considering fairness, which comprises the following steps: acquiring site distribution and inter-site distances of a design area to obtain a road network structure diagram of the design area; constructing an objective function of a fairness model of the pure electric bus system with the minimum traffic coefficient as a target, and an objective function of a total cost model of the pure electric bus network with the minimum social travel total cost as a target, and further constructing a double-target nonlinear programming model of the pure electric bus network; and adopting an NAGS-II genetic algorithm, setting constraint conditions of a pure electric bus network double-target nonlinear programming model, and solving the pure electric bus network double-target nonlinear programming model to obtain the pure electric bus programming network. The method reduces the traffic coefficient while minimizing the total cost of travel, effectively improves the fairness of the public transportation line network design scheme on the premise of controlling the total cost, and has important reference significance.

title_en: Financial transaction risk assessment method, device, equipment and medium based on federal forgetting learning
abstract_en: The application discloses a financial transaction risk assessment method, a device, equipment and a medium based on federal forgetting learning, which relate to the technical field of federal forgetting learning and are applied to a central server, and comprise the steps of determining an original model trained by the central server and a plurality of financial institution clients through federal learning, and remaining financial institution clients corresponding to the federal forgetting learning; and determining a target forgetting model corresponding to federal forgetting learning according to an optimal solution of the function to be optimized, and evaluating financial transaction risks related to a central server and the clients of the rest financial institutions through the target forgetting model. Therefore, the multi-objective optimization function can be constructed by combining the forgetting verification index, the global stability index and the local fairness index, and the objective forgetting model can be obtained by function solving, so that the efficiency and effect of federal forgetting learning can be improved.

title_en: A book sharing system and its method of working
abstract_en: The novel book sharing platform offers a multifaceted solution to address the diverse needs and interests of users within the literary community. The platform facilitates knowledge sharing, collaboration, and engagement through centralized hubs for selecting reading lists, facilitating discussions, and connecting with fellow readers and writers. Authors leverage the platform for book promotion, feedback gathering, and audience engagement, while access Meta data for reader preference statistics. Additionally, the platform enhances the user experience by offering personalized recommendations, fair and equitable exchanges through a credit management system, and cost optimization features for shipping. Overall, the novel book sharing platform serves as a dynamic and inclusive space that enriches the reading experience, promotes knowledge sharing, and fosters connections within the literary community.

title_en: Progressive Power Grid Planning Evaluation Method and System Based on Combination Assessment Theory
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a progressive power grid planning evaluation method and system based on a combination assessment theory, and relates to the technical field of power grid assessment and optimization. The method includes: correcting a weight of an obtained index by using a combination weighting method; obtaining an assessed value based on a similarity theory assessment method; standardizing an index by dimensionless processing; and performing evaluation based on nonparametric regression. The present invention ensures objectivity and fairness of an assessment result and the efficiency and the accuracy of assessment are improved. The present invention may be adaptively adjusted, making the assessment result closer to reality.

title_en: Control requirement-based controller fairness scheduling method
abstract_en: A controller fairness scheduling method based on control requirements comprises the following steps: step one, intensively selecting personnel e  n  The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the Step two, judging personnel e  n  If yes, judging the number of alternative staff, and selecting the maximum value of the seat S and the current staff; step three, judging personnel e  n  If the health card is valid and meets the qualification of the seat requirement, the next step is carried out, if not, the step II is carried out, and the person e  n  A step of leave-out; the technical key point is that the scheduling method can automatically schedule the shifts according to rules and standards, and the aim of scheduling is achieved: the workload balance of each person is realized, and the optimal collocation of the person and the seat is realized, so that the normal and efficient operation of enterprises is ensured.

title_en: Multi-micro-grid two-stage collaborative scheduling method based on GBS-ADMM and generalized Nash balance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-micro-grid two-stage collaborative scheduling method based on GBS-ADMM and generalized Nash balance, which aims to construct a micro-grid day-ahead low-carbon scheduling model with minimized day-ahead running cost, solves the problem by using an alternate direction multiplier method to obtain a day-ahead scheduling result, constructs the micro-grid day-ahead low-carbon scheduling model with minimized day-ahead running cost as a target, solves the problem by using an improved alternate direction multiplier method with Gaussian back substitution to obtain a day-ahead scheduling result, aims to maximize micro-grid distribution income, constructs a benefit distribution model, solves the problem by using an NSGA-III algorithm to obtain a final day-ahead scheduling result and a benefit distribution result. The invention can provide the dispatching result with optimal system operation economy in two stages of day-before-day and the micro-grid operation income distribution result with fairness and reasonability, thereby providing support for the multi-time scale dispatching of the novel power system and having certain engineering use value.

title_en: Combat resource scheduling method for attack target
abstract_en: The invention discloses a combat resource scheduling method aiming at an attack target, which comprises the following steps: s1, initializing parameters of at least one incoming target; s2, dividing the defense area into a plurality of foot-drop point areas, and sequentially selecting the foot-drop point areas; s3, acquiring the threat degree of the attack target in the selected foothold area based on the parameters; s4, judging whether an attack target in the foothold area meets constraint conditions or not based on the threat degree; and S5, allocating defense weapons for the attack targets meeting the constraint conditions to realize the battle resource scheduling. The invention realizes the fairness scheduling of combat resources aiming at defense positions and optimizes firepower distribution by selecting the foothold areas and judging the threat degree of the attack targets in the foothold areas, and the scheduling method is simple and is beneficial to engineering application.

title_en: Unmanned crawler vehicle carrying and conveying platform for complex environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned crawler vehicle carrying and conveying platform for complex environments, which comprises a stability-increasing transmission mechanism, a conveying mechanism and a material conveying mechanism, wherein the stability-increasing transmission mechanism comprises a transverse beam and an auxiliary rotating wheel, an outer cover positioned outside the transverse beam, a driving wheel arranged in the transverse beam, a driven wheel clamped in the middle of the transverse beam and a reinforced vertical plate connected to the inner end of the driving wheel. Through setting up protection top cap and bearing the drain pan, and be the pulley that oval annular distributes and put the actuating lever at the inboard movable assembly of protection top cap and bearing the drain pan, and put the inner welding level extension of actuating lever, and with movable mounting at the roof beam structure inboard, the track can twine in the outside of track and axostylus axostyle this moment, when the action wheel drives supplementary runner and carries out synchronous revolution from the driving wheel, the track can conveniently be stranded unmanned tracked vehicle and carry the defeated platform of follow-up relief supplies this moment, and then can avoid causing the jam to the relief disaster in spontaneous combustion disaster area.
assignees: JIANGSU YINGTUO POWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for controlling two-stage flexible climbing capacity of heat pump virtual power plant day-day before day
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for controlling the dual-stage flexible climbing capacity of a heat pump virtual power plant in the day-ahead and day, which comprises the following steps: acquiring parameters required by the flexible climbing capability of the single heat pump based on a cloud-side-end heat pump virtual power plant architecture, and establishing a flexible climbing capability assessment model of the single heat pump by utilizing an affine mathematical theory and considering the uncertainty of outdoor temperature and illumination intensity; on the basis of a single heat pump flexible climbing capacity evaluation model, a heat pump cluster virtual power plant day-ahead flexible climbing capacity evaluation model is constructed, and a climbing capacity boundary is provided for the next day of issuing flexible climbing demands of the power system; and establishing a virtual power plant flexible climbing capacity correction model in the daily stage, correcting the daily flexible climbing capacity of the virtual power plant in a rolling manner, and distributing climbing demands among the heat pumps based on a maximum-minimum fairness algorithm.
assignees: UNIV TIANJIN;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD MARKETING SERVICE CENTER

title_en: Diversity recommendation optimization method integrating inventory information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a diversity recommendation optimization method for integrating inventory information, which comprises the steps of 1, constructing a data set of a user and commodities, 2, constructing a matrix decomposition model, 3, constructing a utility maximization function, embedding commodity inventory constraint and commodity type constraint to optimize recommendation results, and 4, solving a prediction score of the user on the commodities by adopting a heuristic algorithm, and obtaining a final recommendation result. The invention adopts the matrix-decomposed commodity recommendation model, and simultaneously fuses the inventory information of the commodity, thereby reducing the condition that the recommendation system recommends the backorder product, and further improving the fairness of system recommendation and the satisfaction degree of users on the platform.

title_en: Industrial park intensive electricity charge calculation system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an industrial park intensive electricity charge calculation and system, which comprises a data interaction module, a user setting module, a comprehensive calculation module and a system verification and inspection module, wherein the data interaction module is used for extracting basic data of industrial park users from a power grid marketing system database, the user setting module is used for classifying each industrial park user, setting an owner and at least one terminal user, adding extended attributes for the users to distinguish roles of the users, and checking the correctness of user setting, the comprehensive calculation module is used for carrying out intensive calculation on the electricity charge of the users in the industrial park according to set rules and algorithms, and the system verification and inspection module is used for checking the correctness of calculation results, so that the electric quantity of the owner of the industrial park is ensured to be larger than the sum of electric quantity of the terminal users, and the basic electricity charge of an owner transformer is ensured to be larger than the sum of basic electricity charge of the terminal users. The invention also provides a corresponding method. By implementing the method, the fairness, reasonable calculation and allocation of the electric charge in the industrial park can be realized, the phenomenon of 'middle layer' to power supply and price adding is eliminated, the electricity cost of a park terminal enterprise is reduced, and the efficiency and transparency of electric charge management are improved.

title_en: Rights distribution method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a rights and interests distributing method, device, equipment and storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a payment triggering message of a target user, wherein the payment triggering message carries an ID of the target user; according to the target user ID, a data interface is called to obtain target data and target equity ID related to equity distribution, the target risk level of equity distribution failure of the target user is estimated according to the target data, an equity distribution strategy to be used is determined according to the target risk level, and the target equity corresponding to the target equity ID is distributed to the target user according to the equity distribution strategy. According to the method, based on a mechanism of dynamically matching the rights and interests distribution strategy by the target risk level, distribution holes in a high-risk scene can be avoided in advance, probability of rights and interests distribution failure is reduced from the source, user consultation quantity caused by the distribution failure is further reduced, and response pressure, processing pressure and communication cost of customer service team are effectively reduced.
assignees: BEIJING QIYI CENTURY SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Method and System for Monitoring Accountability and Fairness for An Enterprises
abstract_en: An automated system & method for real time monitoring and enhancing performance for an enterprise is disclosed herein. The present invention measures the performance objectively, instead of subjective measurement. The system comprises of plurality of electronic devices (1), a remote server (3), and an interface (2) providing link between the electronic devices (1) and the remote server (3), The system of the present invention facilitates time scheduling, parameter setting, progress updation, resource planning, task initiation, survey management and feedback, leave of absence and loss of pay management for the enterprise, day planning and management for the task executor, automated recovery in case of collapse of schedule and such.

title_en: Motivating equitable behavior in calendar events
abstract_en: An event scheduling request is received, and a disruption factor is associated with each of a plurality of invitees. The disruption factor is based upon, at least in part, an event parameter and at least one invitee attribute. An event is scheduled based upon, at least in part, the disruption factors associated with each of the plurality of invitees.
assignees: JU LIN;STERN EDITH HELEN;WEIR ROBERT CAMERON;WILLNER BARRY E

title_en: Method for realizing high bandwidth under condition of multi-tenant solid-state disk performance isolation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for realizing high bandwidth under the condition of multi-tenant solid-state disk performance isolation, which adopts a local garbage recovery mode in a multi-tenant solid-state disk, allocates bandwidth budget for each tenant, adopts a request scheduling method of polling scheduling, and periodically adjusts the bandwidth budget allocation according to the actual bandwidth ratio of the tenant to ensure the performance isolation so as to realize bandwidth fairness; the distribution of the reserved space resources is adjusted according to the demand degree of each tenant for the reserved space resources periodically to improve the bandwidth performance, and meanwhile, the damage of the dynamic adjustment of the reserved space to the performance isolation effect is avoided by controlling the garbage recovery rate and the write mapping rate of the adjusted blocks in the process of adjusting the reserved space. The invention can not only ensure the performance isolation effect among tenants, but also reduce the bandwidth loss caused by the performance isolation and realize high bandwidth performance in the multi-tenant solid-state disk.

title_en: Emergency material distribution and dispatching decision support method and system thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency material distribution and dispatching decision support method and a system thereof. In the invention, according to a post-disaster emergency material dispatching decision requirement, a decision system demand is analyzed; aiming at an emergency material distribution and dispatching and transport route selection problem, a geographical information system and a decision support system are combined and an emergency material distribution and dispatching decision support system based on the geographical information system is designed. The system takes a man-machine interaction system as a principal portion and takes a traditional database, a space database, a model database, a knowledge base and a method base as supports. A man-machine interaction subsystem is provided with submodules of demand prediction, emergency material deploying scheme analysis, an emergency material transport path analysis and material management. A GPS global positioning system, a GSM global mobile communication system and the GIS geographical information system are integrated. Integration management and a distribution and dispatching decision analysis are performed on disaster relief materials.
assignees: TIANJIN ZHONGKE INTELLIGENT IDENTIFICATION IND TECH RES INST CO LTD

title_en: New wholesale mode and rural fresh electricity merchant platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electronic commerce, in particular to a new wholesale mode and a rural fresh electric commerce platform, wherein the platform comprises: the transaction module consists of a supply issuing system and a demand issuing system; the order module is used for matching supply and demand data in the supply and distribution system and the demand distribution system and generating order data; and the logistics module is used for generating a distribution task list according to the order data. The invention provides a new wholesale mode which is the assistance of poverty-deprivation, attack and stiffness, serves vast farmers, perfects a new retail process through the new wholesale mode and finally realizes real new retail in the whole society.

title_en: Green land fairness evaluation method and device based on park green land supply measurement
abstract_en: The invention provides a green land fairness evaluation method and device based on park green land supply measurement.
