The method comprises the following steps: first, quality factor data of the UPGS is obtained from a large dataset of maps AOI, POI, OSM, etc. A new data source is then introduced: the hundred degree thermodynamic diagram represents the amount of access to the UPGS, making it the basis for establishing UPGS quality factor weights. This approach weakens the subjectivity previously seen in establishing the UPGS quality factor. In addition, the present invention determines its service radius according to the scale of the UPGS and measures the supply of different types of UPGS. The present invention improves the provisioning model of the UPGS to guide optimization of city management.
assignees: AEROSPACE INFORMATION RESEARCH INSTITUTE CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES;HAINAN KONGTIAN INFORMATION RES INSTITUTE

title_en: Transparent data annotation crowdsourcing method, system and medium for settlement balance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a settlement balanced transparent data labeling crowdsourcing method, a system and a medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: establishing a data annotation crowdsourcing system and determining an interactive entity; the task requester mixes marked data and unmarked data to obtain data to be marked, sets the public condition of the marked data at the same time, discloses a task information tuple on a blockchain through an intelligent contract after encryption, stores the task information tuple in a task rewards and sets a task deposit, and discloses a task downloading link; the worker confirms the task acceptance and stores the task deposit, downloads and completes the data labeling task, then generates a proof, and discloses a task result and the proof; the task requester worker proves that the task result is evaluated, a hash time locking transaction is created and broadcast, and the payment task is rewarded to the worker. The invention carries out fair transaction under the supervision of a non-trusted third party through the blockchain and the hash time lock, realizes the objectivity and fairness of task rewards distribution, and ensures the balance and transparency of task rewards settlement.

title_en: Real estate data processing method and device based on block chain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a house property data processing method and device based on a block chain, and relates to the technical field of block chains, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining resident information of residents to be placed; the method comprises the steps of auditing intelligent contracts based on residents in a house property distribution block chain and a zero knowledge proof technology, creating resident information nodes after auditing is passed, matching the intelligent contracts with basic information of different house properties based on the house property distribution, determining matched target house properties, building association relations between the residents and the target house properties, uploading the association relations to the house property information nodes, broadcasting the association relations by a house property management node and the resident nodes, generating digital property proofs corresponding to the target house properties when the association relations pass the auditing, and broadcasting the digital property proofs in the block chain. The real estate data processing method is used for realizing automation, transparency and traceability of real estate data processing and improving fairness, standardization and efficiency of real estate distribution.
assignees: CHINA CONSTRUCTION BANK CORP;CCB FINTECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent decision method and system based on neural network
abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent decision method and system based on a neural network, which relate to data processing and comprise the steps of obtaining location data and corresponding attribute data of an item to be decided, establishing a fuzzy relation matrix between the location and the attribute, generating a network model reflecting the trust relation strength among users through trust propagation operation of a graph neural network according to the fuzzy relation matrix, identifying a community structure comprising community overlapping degree through a community discovery algorithm according to the network model, calculating influence weight of a decision maker according to the trust relation strength among users and the community overlapping degree, forming group consensus through a robust optimization method according to the influence weight and the community structure, and generating a decision result of the item to be decided. The trust relationship among users is usually ignored in the traditional project decision, and the community structure containing the overlapping degree is identified by combining secretary bird optimization algorithm and improved K-means cluster, and influence weight and the like are calculated based on trust strength, so that the scientificity and fairness of the decision are improved.
assignees: BEIJING CHANGHE SHUZHI TECH CO LTD;CHANGHE INFORMATION CO LTD;UNIV SHANXI

title_en: Emergency multi-airport flight cooperative release method based on dual fairness
abstract_en: The invention is applicable to the technical field of airport regulation and control, and provides an emergency multi-airport flight collaborative release method based on dual fairness, which comprises the following steps of obtaining data; respectively establishing mathematical models which aim at minimizing total delay deduced time of all non-cancelled flights, aim at minimizing total loss of all cancelled flights, aim at maximizing airport fairness of all flight delay deduced time deviation of each airport and aim at maximizing airline fairness of all flight cancelled flight loss deviation of each airline company, converting the four mathematical models into target planning models, and solving problems based on a solver. The invention seeks the coupling relation among the dispatching cost, airport fairness and avionics fairness, improves the cooperative release efficiency of multiple airports, and provides technical support for intelligent emergency release of a plurality of daily related airports.
assignees: SHANGHAI AIRPORT AUTHORITY;CHINA ACADEMY OF CIVIL AVIATION SCIENCE AND TECH CHINA CIVIL AVIATION ADMINISTRATION OF AVIATION SAF

title_en: System for automating a collaborative network of musicians in the field of original composition and recording
abstract_en: An automated system of multiple and integrated processes that connects high level and industry relevant performing artists, conductors and composers around the globe to any composers interested in original music composition and recording. The purpose of the invention is to automate the process of making and scheduling these projects and connections, thus improving the ease of scheduling, the frequency of encounters, and the equity in educational possibilities.

title_en: Seat allocation method for reducing railway epidemic spreading risk
abstract_en: The invention discloses a seat allocation method for reducing railway epidemic spreading risks. The method comprises the steps of obtaining train information and passenger information, establishing a railway train epidemic situation spreading and infection risk assessment method, obtaining an objective function which aims at minimizing the infection rate and maximizing the railway ticket income in a train according to the infection rate and the passenger information, listing passenger group requirements, the infection rate, the transportation capacity and social fairness constraint conditions according to the objective function, solving an optimal solution of a model, and obtaining a seat allocation scheme which takes epidemic situation spreading risk and benefits of railway departments into consideration. The invention establishes an optimization model taking seat allocation scheme as decision based on passenger group demand and infection rate constraint, and takes the sum of maximized railway department income and minimized infection rate as a target under the constraint of transportation capacity, group demand, infection rate, social fairness and the like, thereby obtaining the seat allocation scheme taking epidemic situation spreading risk and railway department benefit into account, ensuring passenger safety and improving railway economic benefit.

title_en: Optimal selection method for ground node subset in wireless power transmission of multiple unmanned aerial vehicles
abstract_en: The invention relates to an optimal selection method of a ground node subset in wireless power transmission of a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles, belonging to the field of unmanned aerial vehicle auxiliary wireless communication, comprising the following steps that S1, ground nodes are divided into a plurality of circular areas with the same radius as each other according to the power transmission range of the unmanned aerial vehicles to serve as the ground node subset; and S2, constructing an optimal selection model of the ground node subsets, and S3, optimizing the hovering points of the unmanned aerial vehicle in each ground node subset to enable the unmanned aerial vehicle to charge the ground nodes on the optimal hovering points. The method is suitable for a large-scale low-power-consumption ground node charging scene, and by optimizing the selection of the ground node subset, the hovering charging times of the unmanned aerial vehicle are reduced, and the flight energy consumption of the unmanned aerial vehicle is reduced, so that the energy receiving efficiency and fairness of the ground node are improved.

title_en: Flight airport scene operation optimization method considering runway port waiting time
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flight airport scene operation optimization method considering runway port waiting time and belongs to the flight airport scene optimization technology field. The method comprises the following steps of firstly, establishing a MAGMO model and simultaneously optimizing slipping time and runway port waiting takeoff time; then, designing an RSS strategy so as to distribute paths for all the flights and distributing launch time for a departing flight; simultaneously, according to a waiting node, distributing a strategy HNAS, selecting the mode in the path for the flight and distributing waiting time so as to obtain an optimal solution to double target airport scene optimization. Priorities of the flights, fairness among flights and an influence to environment are fully considered, and safety, orderliness and high efficiency of a scene flight flow are ensured. By using the method of the invention, safety of the whole flights can be increased and flight conflicts can be effectively avoided to some extent. Simultaneously a potential safety hazard, fuel oil consumption and environment pollution brought by long time waiting of a lot of flights can be prevented.

title_en: Agricultural material allocation method based on large data and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an agricultural material allocation method based on large data and a device. The method comprises the steps that supplied first agricultural material data and first impact factor data are received, wherein the supplied first agricultural material data and the first impact factor data are by collected by a client in past preset time; the first agricultural material data and the first impact factor data are put into a distributed database; a large data mining algorithm is used to acquire the relationship function between the first agricultural material data and the first impact factor data; second impact factor data in future preset time are acquired and put into the distributed database; the first agricultural material data, the first impact factor data, the relationship function and the second impact factor data are used for calculation to acquire second agricultural material data in future preset time; and the second agricultural material data are used as agricultural material supply in future preset time. According to the method, overall agricultural materials are reasonably allocated; the accuracy and the efficiency of agricultural material supply allocation are improved; and labor cost is saved.

title_en: Data processing method, apparatus, readable storage medium and computer program product
abstract_en: The invention provides a data processing method, a data processing device, a readable storage medium and a computer program product. The data processing method comprises the following steps: acquiring a plurality of pieces of position information, wherein the plurality of pieces of position information are in one-to-one correspondence with a plurality of service objects, and the plurality of service objects comprise a first type service object and a second type service object; acquiring object dependency relations among a plurality of business objects; creating a position relation model according to the position information and the object dependency relation; receiving demand data of a first service object, wherein the first service object is a service object in a first type of service object; determining a plurality of second business objects associated with the first business object based on the position relation model, wherein the second business objects are business objects in the second class of business objects; and determining a supply allocation scheme of the plurality of second business objects according to the demand data.

title_en: AI-based dairy cow feed proportioning optimization method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of feed proportioning optimization and discloses an AI-based cow feed proportioning optimization method and system, wherein the optimization method comprises the following steps of processing cow group characteristic data through a hierarchical heterogeneous graph network construction system to generate a dynamic cow group graph network structure; the hierarchical diagram reinforcement learning system is used for processing the real-time group network state tensor to generate a multi-level feed proportioning decision scheme, and the multi-level Nash equilibrium optimization system is used for processing the multi-level decision scheme to generate an optimal feed distribution strategy table. The method obtains the optimal feed distribution strategy table by optimizing the feed proportion of the dairy cows in multiple aspects, so that the dairy cows in the modern large-scale dairy cow pasture are intelligently fed, the effects of improving the yield and promoting fairness and strong adaptation and expansion are improved.
assignees: ANSHAN IND GROUP DAIRY IND CO LTD

title_en: Multi-energy micro-grid point-to-point energy scheduling method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for dispatching point-to-point energy sources of a multi-energy micro-grid, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a multi-energy micro-grid optimization model containing electric, gas and heat energy sources according to network coupling constraint, equipment characteristic constraint and dispatching operation constraint of an energy micro-grid, carrying out distributed iterative solution on the multi-energy micro-grid optimization model by adopting an alternating direction multiplication algorithm to obtain P2P energy exchange quantity among micro-grids, calculating P2P energy exchange price by adopting a lubine bargaining RBS strategy based on the P2P energy exchange quantity to obtain an excitation signal of micro-grid energy exchange, and obtaining a comprehensive dispatching scheme of the micro-grid according to the P2P energy exchange quantity and the excitation signal. The invention can perform multi-energy coordination, ensure information safety and improve interaction fairness and resource utilization rate.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD WENZHOU CITY DONGTOU DISTR POWER SUPPLY COMPANY;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD WENZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: An optimization device and method for relief supplies distribution based on floating population data and equity
title_ko: 유동인구 데이터 분석 및 에퀴티를 고려한 재난구호물자 물류 최적화 방법 및 장치
abstract_ko: 유동인구 데이터 분석 및 에퀴티를 고려한 재난구호물자 물류 최적화 모델 방법 및 장치가 개시된다.  본 발명의 일실시예에 따른, 유동인구 데이터 분석 및 에퀴티를 고려한 재난구호물자 물류 최적화 모델 방법은, 유동인구 데이터를 분석하여, 재난취약계층의 위치 데이터를 추정하는 단계; 상기 추정된 위치 데이터를 수요지점으로 하는 재난구호물자의 전달 경로를 설계하는 다수의 물류 솔루션을 구축하는 단계; 및 상기 다수의 물류 솔루션 중에서, 재난취약계층 Equity 관련 지표(Slack) 및 재난구호물자 물류에 필요한 비용(Cost)을 고려하여, 최적 솔루션을 도출하는 단계를 포함 할 수 있다.
assignees: ULSAN NAT INST SCIENCE & TECH UNIST

title_en: Heating load scheduling method based on data-physical-knowledge combined driving
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heating load dispatching method based on data-physical-knowledge combined driving, which aims at the problems of high randomness and difficult regulation of heating loads, firstly designs a load clustering method and a load power prediction algorithm based on data, physical and knowledge models, then designs a heating double-layer dispatching model, deploys a load control terminal by a user layer, collects and reports power data, and comprises a prediction module, an index set module and a dispatching module, wherein the prediction module classifies loads and predicts the heating power, the index set module comprises economic, comfort and fairness indexes, the dispatching module adopts a particle swarm algorithm to solve the dispatching power based on the load prediction data with the maximum aim of economical, comfort and fairness, and is implemented by the load control terminal, and the feasibility of the double-layer dispatching strategy is analyzed by an example. The invention provides a technical method for load prediction and scheduling under heating transformation, and can effectively improve the fairness and effectiveness of heating.

title_en: Industrial park intensive electricity charge calculation system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an industrial park intensive electricity charge calculation and system, which comprises a data interaction module, a user setting module, a comprehensive calculation module and a system verification and inspection module, wherein the data interaction module is used for extracting basic data of industrial park users from a power grid marketing system database, the user setting module is used for classifying each industrial park user, setting an owner and at least one terminal user, adding extended attributes for the users to distinguish roles of the users, and checking the correctness of user setting, the comprehensive calculation module is used for carrying out intensive calculation on the electricity charge of the users in the industrial park according to set rules and algorithms, and the system verification and inspection module is used for checking the correctness of calculation results, so that the electric quantity of the owner of the industrial park is ensured to be larger than the sum of electric quantity of the terminal users, and the basic electricity charge of an owner transformer is ensured to be larger than the sum of basic electricity charge of the terminal users. The invention also provides a corresponding method. By implementing the method, the fairness, reasonable calculation and allocation of the electric charge in the industrial park can be realized, the phenomenon of 'middle layer' to power supply and price adding is eliminated, the electricity cost of a park terminal enterprise is reduced, and the efficiency and transparency of electric charge management are improved.

title_en: Particle swarm optimization-based real-time load gap allocation optimization method
abstract_en: The invention provides an optimization method for real-time load gap distribution based on a particle swarm algorithm, which belongs to the technical field of power system operation and control, and specifically comprises the following steps of 1, constructing an adaptability function for fusing economic influence and environmental benefit; and step 2, setting constraint conditions comprising total load notch constraint and a single enterprise safety load interval, and step 3, adopting a particle swarm optimization algorithm to solve the minimum value of the fitness function and outputting an optimal load distribution scheme. According to the invention, the load gap is scientifically distributed through the quantitative index, so that the communication cost is reduced, and the efficiency, fairness and environmental benefit of load management are improved. The method is used for enterprise elastic load management in the power demand peak period, and scientific distribution and optimization of load gaps are realized.

title_en: A kind of water pollution load Equity Assessment and distribution method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of water pollution load Equity Assessment and distribution method, include the following steps: to evaluate the blowdown status fairness of survey region using single-factor environment Gini Coefficient analysis；Total amount of pollutant reduction target and pollutant original allocation scheme are formulated according to evaluation result；It realizes that environment Gini coefficient minimizes based on Information Entropy, determines pollutant optimal distributing scheme.The present invention establishes a set of completely new totalizing method system, on the one hand it avoids and only economically considers that cost minimization causes the unfairness of distribution, on the other hand Environmental Equity theory is applied to conscientiously in pollutant distribution, fair allocat scheme is determined after the many-sided objective factor of comprehensive consideration, and the fair combination with efficiency is realized in water pollutant totalizing method.

title_en: Dangerous goods full-load distribution path optimization and vehicle dispatching method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of distribution path planning, and discloses a dangerous goods full-load distribution path optimization and vehicle scheduling method, which comprises the steps of establishing a model of vehicle quantity, total vehicle running cost and total risk and distribution time, establishing a vehicle path optimization mathematical model P1, establishing a vehicle scheduling model P2, and carrying out two-stage method solution (comprising a path optimization solution method and a vehicle scheduling optimization solution method). The invention can minimize the transportation cost and transportation risk in the transportation process by optimizing the driving route and scientifically dispatching the vehicles, and simultaneously, the invention can minimize the number of the distributed vehicles and ensure the fairness of the transportation task quantity of the vehicles.

title_en: Virtual power plant optimal scheduling method for power grid peak shaving service
abstract_en: The invention discloses a virtual power plant optimization scheduling method for power grid peak shaving service, which comprises the following steps of 1, constructing a virtual power plant peak shaving response model, 2, taking the maximum profit of a virtual power plant as an objective function by considering the virtual power plant peak shaving response model obtained in the step 1, setting constraint conditions of the objective function, constructing the virtual power plant optimization scheduling model for the power grid peak shaving service, 3, introducing virtual power plant peak shaving punishment rewards, 4, solving the virtual power plant optimization scheduling model for the power grid peak shaving service, introducing the virtual power plant peak shaving punishment rewards, and realizing virtual power plant optimization scheduling according to a solving result. The invention ensures fairness and high efficiency of resource utilization through rationalization benefit distribution, and stimulates active participation of users and operators.
assignees: NANJING POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Centralized scheduling optimization method, system, equipment and medium for energy storage power station
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of energy storage regulation and control, and discloses a centralized scheduling optimization method, a system, equipment and a medium for an energy storage power station, wherein the method comprises the steps of monitoring a thermal power unit with the control deviation regulation of a region between the energy storage power station and the participation region in real time according to the preset sliding window time to obtain the parameters of the energy storage power station and the parameters of the thermal power unit; based on the energy storage power station parameters and the thermal power unit parameters, the total adjustment rate of the thermal power unit is obtained, the total adjustment rate of the energy storage power station after the rate is limited by the energy storage power station is judged, and the maximum charge/discharge rate constraint of the energy storage power station equipment is combined to obtain the optimized adjustment rate of the energy storage power station. The method can obviously reduce the impact of centralized calling of the energy storage power station on the running stability of the power grid, improves the coordination efficiency of the thermal power unit and the energy storage power station, simultaneously gives attention to fairness and flexibility in an allocation mechanism, meets the real-time scheduling requirement of the spot market, and promotes the efficient application of the energy storage technology in the power grid.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Electric power spot market unbalanced cost compensation allocation method under different modes
abstract_en: The invention discloses a compensation and allocation method for unbalanced cost of an electric power spot market under different modes, and relates to the technical field of electric power markets. The method comprises the following steps of S1, obtaining power compensation data of each area of a power spot market in different modes, S2, constructing a weight function according to the power compensation data in different modes, S3, carrying out weighting processing on the weight function to obtain an allocation coefficient, S4, calculating compensation allocation proportion of each area according to different allocation coefficients, and S5, distributing unbalanced cost of the power spot market into corresponding accounts according to the compensation allocation proportion of each area. According to the invention, the power compensation data of each area of the power spot market in different modes are obtained, the weight function is constructed to calculate the allocation coefficient, and the compensation allocation proportion of each area is calculated according to the difference of the allocation coefficient, so that the rationality and fairness of the compensation allocation of each area are improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG ELECTRIC POWER TRANSACTION CENTER CO LTD

title_en: Closed-loop power grid-oriented carbon emission flow analysis system and method for electric energy tracking and tide tracing coupling
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of carbon emission flow analysis of an electric power system, in particular to a carbon emission flow analysis method for electric energy tracking and tide tracing coupling of a closed-loop power grid. By establishing a tide distribution matrix, a unit injection matrix, a load distribution matrix and a carbon emission intensity vector, recursively calculating the carbon potential, the branch carbon flow rate and the load carbon flow rate of each node, coupling an electric energy tracking method with tide tracing, iteratively optimizing node allocation, and accordingly revealing the actual flow path and the spatial distribution characteristic of carbon flow in a power grid. The method can adapt to the scenes of complex multi-source access, ring network structure and the like, improves the scientificity and fairness of closed-loop power grid carbon emission management, and provides theoretical and method support for low-carbon scheduling, carbon accounting and low-carbon economic development.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER;STATE GRID ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic adjustment method for electricity utilization priority of intelligent cabin equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent cabin energy management and power consumption scheduling control, and discloses a dynamic adjustment method of power consumption priority of intelligent cabin equipment. The method comprises the steps of uniformly numbering all devices, collecting power requirements, minimum continuous power supply duration, categories and request states, screening out real needed devices in the current period according to a fixed period, counting average power and reference duration, combining the categories, relative power and relative duration to generate bidding factors, sequencing the factors, performing prefix accumulation allocation according to allocable power, giving priority to form a record list, recursively delaying counting for the devices which are not allocated continuously at the end of the period, setting a forced threshold, ensuring fairness at the front of the next period, executing on-off instructions, identifying the devices which are not requested for a long time after clearing, meeting conditions, re-incorporating and circularly advancing.
assignees: JUJIN AUTOMOBILE PARTS GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Irrigation area resource priority allocation method, system, equipment and medium based on peasant household credit score
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, equipment and a medium for preferentially distributing irrigation district resources based on credit scores of farmers, which belong to the technical field of irrigation district resource distribution and comprise the steps of acquiring dynamic information reflecting water consumption and related behaviors of the farmers through a multisource information acquisition means; the method comprises the steps of establishing a peasant household credit scoring model based on the acquired dynamic information, constructing a multi-factor scoring structure according to the behavior compliance, the responsiveness, the water saving level and the dimensionality of the payment record, obtaining comprehensive credit scores through weighted calculation, sequencing peasant households according to the comprehensive credit scores, collecting and analyzing the behavior information of the peasant households in the executing process through a feedback and updating mechanism, dynamically correcting the credit scoring result, and realizing the periodic optimization of a water resource allocation strategy. The invention realizes the transition from average water supply to credit drive dispatch, enhances the fairness, the diversity and the incentive guidance of the dispatch, reduces the management burden, automatically identifies deviation and default behavior by means of a feedback mechanism, and improves the execution force and constraint force of a dispatch plan.
assignees: NANJING HEHAI NANZI HYDROPOWER AUTOMATION CO LTD

title_en: Behavior data processing method and device, computer equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a behavior data processing method, a behavior data processing device, computer equipment and a readable storage medium, relates to the technical field of Internet, and aims to determine the change trend of the bearing pressure of a vehicle seat, form a behavior state, count behavior data, enable the behavior data to be formed actively, select optimal distribution personnel to assign, and passively record behaviors without feedback of the distribution personnel, so that the authenticity of the behavior data is improved, the score fairness is guaranteed, the risk of negative influence is reduced to the minimum, and the distribution efficiency is guaranteed. The method comprises the following steps: detecting the pressure of the seat to determine the current bearing pressure of the seat; when the bearing pressure is detected to be changed and the variation reaches the pressure threshold, determining the changed time point, and acquiring the geographical position information of the current position; generating a behavior state according to the change trend of the change of the bearing pressure; and taking the change time point, the behavior state and the geographical position information as behavior data, and transmitting the behavior data.

title_en: Electric bus charging plan optimization method considering charging station vehicle queuing
abstract_en: The invention provides an electric bus charging plan optimization method considering charging station vehicle queuing, which belongs to the field of charging management, divides a charging station into three areas of a queuing area, a charging area and a waiting area based on actual bus charging conditions, models an electric bus queuing charging process, enables electric buses to be charged sequentially according to queuing order, and ensures fairness and rationality of electric bus charging. On the basis of the queuing of the electric buses, an electric bus ordered charging model is further established, and whether the electric buses are charged in a stopping interval of a charging station or not is decided, and the corresponding charging starting time and charging duration are determined, so that the charging cost of the electric buses and the queuing cost of the system are the lowest. And finally, integrating optimal electric bus queuing and charging information into an electric bus running diagram, providing an electric bus SOC variation and charging pile charging load variation trend diagram, and directly applying the obtained result to electric bus charging planning and arrangement to promote electric bus charging efficiency.

title_en: Electric vehicle ordered charging guiding method and system based on block chain intelligent contract
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of a block chain technology and an electric vehicle charging scheduling technology, in particular to an electric vehicle ordered charging guiding method and system based on a block chain intelligent contract. The electric vehicle user submits the charging demand parameters to the charging platform, and the block chain system acquires the distance between the user and each charging station through the commercial map interface to form a reachable charging station set and a distance matrix for the electric vehicle user. And the charging station nodes call the ordered guidance model constructed in the intelligent contract in turn to solve to obtain a charging station recommendation set, and the calculation data is stored in the block chain system through a consensus mechanism. According to the method, a block chain technology is combined, fairness indexes are introduced, the fluctuation degree of single-pile income is limited, a charging station set is provided for a user through a user selection model and an ordered charging guide model, the fairness of income distribution of a charging station operator is guaranteed, and the charging effectiveness of the user is improved.
assignees: UNIVERSITY OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY BEIJING

title_en: Method for determining priority of ecological water and economic and social water
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for determining the priority of ecological water and economic and social water, which comprises the following steps of S1, developing the demand analysis of ecological water; s2, carrying out demand analysis of water for economic and social use; s3, checking whether the maximum demand of ecological water and economic water exceeds the total amount of regional water resources; s4, sequencing the requirements of the ecological water and the economic water for the society in each level according to the inspection result; s5, assigning scores to sequencing results of the requirements of the ecological water and the economic water for society in each level; s6, summarizing scoring results to obtain total scores of the ecological water and economic and social water for each level of demand; and S7, sorting the total scores of the water demands and determining the priority. The advantages are that: the method can determine the water type which should be satisfied preferentially under the condition of restriction of total water resource amount, can give consideration to fairness and efficiency and easy acceptance of all parties using water, and provides support for optimal allocation of water resources.
assignees: CHINESE WATER CONSERVANCY AND HYDROPOWER SCIENCE RES INSTITUTE

title_en: Daily emergency disaster relief material storage and emergency distribution method with maximum flow control
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of daily multi-cycle storage of stock materials, and provides a daily storage and emergency distribution method of emergency disaster relief materials with maximum flow control, which comprises the following steps: 1. issuing a purchase amount to a supplier; 2. updating the net stock, and collecting daily demands in the current period, so that suppliers can perform commodity production work; 3. based on the known daily demands of the current period, making inventory decisions; after being used for meeting inventory decisions, the rest part is used for meeting daily demands in the current period; 4. generating a rescue protocol based on inventory decisions for unknown bursty demands; 5. rescue is carried out according to a rescue protocol after the disaster. If the short-term single-stage emergency rescue process is considered, the method comprises a pre-disaster multi-inventory strategy, a rescue protocol based on the inventory strategy and a centralized clearing strategy based on the protocol. If a multi-stage continuous rescue process is considered, a pre-disaster multi-inventory strategy, a rescue protocol based on the inventory strategy, and a multi-stage decentralized settlement strategy based on the protocol are included. The invention has higher management efficiency and low cost.

title_en: Intelligent gas pipe network gas supply allocation method, internet of things system and medium
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent gas pipe network gas supply allocation method, an Internet of things system and a medium, which comprise the following steps: the method comprises the steps that an internal combustion gas metering device in a target area is controlled to obtain gas statistical data and store the gas statistical data in a storage unit; acquiring historical gas consumption data of a target area; determining target demand information of a future time point of the target area based on the historical gas consumption data; based on the target demand information, predicting a target difference amplitude of a gas supply and demand difference at a future time point of a target area; determining supply and demand difference reasons corresponding to a target area based on gas statistical data, target difference amplitude and environment data of the target area for the target area with the target difference amplitude meeting a first preset condition; determining a gas supply adjustment parameter based on the target difference amplitude and the supply and demand difference reason, storing the gas supply adjustment parameter into a storage unit, generating a gas supply adjustment instruction based on the gas supply adjustment parameter, and sending the gas supply adjustment instruction to the terminal equipment; and generating an allocation instruction in response to the remaining storage space meeting a second preset condition.
assignees: CHENGDU QINCHUAN IOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Regional obligation education resource layout optimization method considering study area room premium
abstract_en: An area obligation education resource layout optimization method considering the price of a study area room belongs to the technical field of education science. By constructing a double-layer planning model based on network games, the upper layer planning is used for school layout decision of education management departments, the aim is to minimize the total cost of the system, and the lower layer planning is used for parents to choose school behaviors, so that the purpose of choosing school effectiveness is maximized. According to the method, factors such as the attraction of schools, geographical positions, price of schools and the like are comprehensively considered, and reasonable allocation of educational resources is realized by using a Stackelberg equilibrium theory. Through algorithm optimization, the upper layer planning realizes the scientization of school site selection and resource allocation, and the lower layer planning guides parents to conduct school selection, so that the phenomenon of price overflow of a study area room is effectively relieved, and the problem of uneven education resource distribution is solved. The invention provides a scientific decision tool for education management departments, which can obviously improve the allocation efficiency and fairness of obligation education resources and promote the balanced development of education quality.

title_en: Data processing method and device combining power grid tide calculation and environmental equity assessment
abstract_en: The invention provides a data processing method and device combining power grid power flow calculation and environmental equity assessment, wherein the method comprises the steps of carrying out power grid power flow analysis on a target power grid to obtain a power flow analysis result of the target power grid, wherein the power flow analysis result is used for indicating the running state of the target power grid in the running process of the target power grid, determining the environmental equity assessment result of the target power grid by adopting an environmental equity assessment model according to the power flow analysis result, wherein the environmental equity assessment result is used for indicating the environmental influence brought by the target power grid in the running process of the target power grid, and integrating and analyzing the power flow analysis result and the environmental equity assessment result to generate an assessment report based on the analysis result. Therefore, by comprehensively considering power flow calculation and environmental benefit analysis of the power grid, the environmental impact in the operation of the power grid can be accurately estimated, and the dual aims of power grid optimal scheduling and environmental protection are achieved.
assignees: HUANENG ZHAOCAI DIGITAL TECH CO LTD;BEIJING HUANENG CHANGJIANG ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;BEIJING YIQING NENGHUAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital teaching material profit allocation intelligent contract method supporting dynamic weight
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital teaching material profit distribution intelligent contract method supporting dynamic weights, and belongs to the field of block chain and digital education fusion. The method is deployed in a blockchain network and comprises the core steps of multi-source heterogeneous data acquisition and trusted uplink, multi-dimensional data such as using intensity, user feedback and the like are transmitted to the chain in a trusted mode through a predictor, comprehensive heat indexes are calculated on the chain, the trusted indexes reflecting the value of teaching materials are generated through normalization and weighted aggregation, income weights are dynamically adjusted based on the heat indexes, the updating of the weight in an epoch mode is achieved through various adjustable functions, and the atomization income distribution and full-link audit are automatically completed after sales events are triggered. The invention breaks through the traditional static division mode, realizes precise hook of profit distribution and teaching material dynamic expression, improves distribution fairness and efficiency, reduces trust cost, effectively stimulates high-quality content creation, and provides an intelligent value distribution infrastructure for digital education ecology.

title_en: Public transport travel service big data processing method and system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of public transportation travel service, and discloses a public transportation travel service big data processing method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of accessing heterogeneous public transportation data, calibrating coordinate deviation, fusing real-time weather events and generating space-time grid entities; the method comprises the steps of constructing a priority decision tree and rule matching logic according to four-dimensional equity rules, generating a scheduling vector with an equity label, synchronously generating a network resource arbitration log, fusing the scheduling vector and the network resource arbitration log, defining and executing a three-level dynamic rule chain, generating a confidence arbitration result, carrying out path feasibility check, further generating a space-time constraint scheduling path, formulating a sharing distribution strategy according to the four-dimensional equity rules, classifying an associated data set, executing three-level quality check on the associated data set after the classification, triggering an anomaly correction mechanism, generating a data quality evaluation report, and reversely optimizing through space-time analysis to form a closed-loop treatment flow.

title_en: Automatic scheduling algorithm based on rule constraint
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic scheduling algorithm based on rule constraint, which comprises the following steps: respectively constructing a nursing staff set according to the nursing staff level; estimating the number of different levels of nursing staff required by each team in a scheduling period according to the number of actual inpatients and the condition of the patients; creating a combination enumerator of nursing staff at different levels, and generating a scheduling combination of the current shift; checking the original scheduling data according to the constraint conditions; outputting the scheduling data when the checking is passed, and repeating the previous step after the original scheduling data is adjusted when the checking is not passed; according to the invention, the original scheduling data is subjected to the preset constraint condition test, the scheduling data which accords with the constraint condition is directly output, the constraint condition test is carried out after the adjustment is carried out on the scheduling data which does not accord with the constraint condition, the scheduling data which accords with the constraint condition after the adjustment is output, and the working time of nursing staff can be improved and the fairness of scheduling can be improved through the limitation of the constraint condition.
assignees: SUZHOU DERPIN MEDICAL SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Resource allocation method, device, storage medium and computer equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a resource allocation method, a resource allocation device, a storage medium and computer equipment. The method comprises the following steps: classifying the preset users according to the historical verification information to determine a first user and a second user; training a preset neural network model according to the first user, the second user and the historical verification information corresponding to the first user and the second user to obtain a resource verification probability model; determining a resource allocation strategy according to the resource verification probability model, wherein the resource allocation strategy comprises target resource characteristics and allocation scene characteristics; and updating the resources of the target user according to the resource allocation strategy. According to the method, the objectivity and fairness of resource allocation are guaranteed, meanwhile, the target user can obtain the resources which meet the requirements of the target user, the using effect of the resources is improved, and the loyalty of the user is enhanced.

title_en: Self-adaptive optimized hospital queuing and calling system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of resource and personnel data management, in particular to a self-adaptive optimized hospital queuing and calling system. The system acquires illness state information of a patient and queuing number of the patient through an information acquisition module; the priority of the queuing number of the patient is obtained through an information evaluation module and classified; the longest waiting number of the high-priority number is obtained through a data processing module; and dynamically calling numbers through the comprehensive processing module. The invention comprehensively considers the illness state information and fairness of patients and the current treatment condition of hospitals, so that the system can take precedence of emergency illness patients and consider fairness of other patients, the treatment result of the system is fairer and more reasonable, medical resources are more reasonably distributed, and the satisfaction degree of patients is improved.

title_en: Virtual power plant power dispatching method and device for multiplex commercial park
abstract_en: The invention provides a virtual power plant power dispatching method and device for a multiplex business park, which are used for carrying out hierarchical modeling on the multiplex business park, and constructing an optimization model of the single virtual power plant and a virtual power plant group comprising a plurality of single virtual power plants, solving a day-ahead output plan, reporting the day-ahead output plan, receiving a power grid dispatching instruction, and reasonably distributing the aggregate electric quantity, so that the stability and the reliability of power supply are ensured. Meanwhile, the real-time electricity price is determined according to the electricity quantity mismatch quantity, and the electricity quantity transaction among the virtual power plants is executed, so that the economic benefit of each virtual power plant is maximized, and the fair competition of the electricity market is promoted. Finally, according to the real-time electricity price and transaction data, the daily income is reasonably and equitably distributed to each virtual power plant, and win-win of the economic benefit and the social benefit of power dispatching is realized.

title_en: Virtual power plant bidding strategy optimization method based on chaotic game optimization algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to a virtual power plant bidding strategy optimization method based on a chaotic game optimization algorithm, which comprises the steps of generating an initial bidding strategy of a virtual power plant through chaotic mapping, enabling each virtual power plant to receive feedback information of a market, performing games in consideration of factors of cost and income, fluctuation of photovoltaic power generation, scheduling cost and attenuation of an energy storage battery and service life of equipment, adjusting the bidding strategy of the virtual power plant, applying punishment income to bidding behaviors which violate constraint of ethics or benefit distribution, calculating income of the power plant according to the adjusted strategies, updating the bidding strategy of each virtual power plant, repeating the game process until convergence conditions are reached, and outputting the virtual power plant bidding strategy. Compared with the prior art, the method utilizes the randomness and unpredictability of the chaotic system, so that the bidding strategy of the virtual power plant has higher flexibility and adaptability, and meanwhile, the fairness, the sustainability and the healthy market development of the system are ensured by introducing ethical constraint and equipment life management.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;JIANGSU DUODUAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Stochastic trading system with synthetic charting and real-time price anchoring for enhanced execution control
abstract_en: The invention relates to a trading platform that shifts focus from market prediction to disciplined execution, capital management, and trading psychology. By disclosing the general market trend in advance, users are empowered to train and operate within a known directional framework. The system generates synthetic charts using directional random walks anchored at algorithmically or randomly selected convergence points from historical data. This recreates real trends while introducing stochastic variability between anchors. A simulated order book models supply-demand dynamics using Poisson-distributed flows, capturing sentiment, liquidity shifts, and large trades. Features include Accelerated Time Compression for fast-forwarded trade simulation and a Rewind Trade mechanism allowing entry at the start of validated candlesticks. The rewind logic applies to both futures and spot markets, including staking actions. Safeguards such as rewind limits, volume caps, and LP prioritization preserve fairness. The platform supports multi-timeframe execution and bridges strategic training with interactive trading, enhancing decision quality and behavioral discipline.

title_en: Computer implemented blockchain-based system for agricultural products
abstract_en: A platform built on blockchain that is designed to help increase traceability, efficiency and fairness in agricultural supply chains, such as the coffee, cocoa, tea, sugar, grains and fruit supply chains. The platform includes a Self-Sovereign Identity solution, a new form of digital identity built on distributed ledger technology. Farmers, wholesalers, traders and retailers can interact more efficiently using comprehensive, near real-time access to this data, and consumers can have new insights about the origins of the products they consume. The platform includes a consumer-facing application that pulls information directly from the blockchain and connects the final consumer, e.g. a coffee drinker, to farmers, traders, roasters and brands. The information is presented on an interactive map, allowing each product to tell a story in a simple and scalable way. The app also presents sustainability projects in coffee communities and an opportunity for consumers to directly support them.

title_en: Storage facilities for emergency relief supplies
abstract_en: A method of community service including placing a storage structure at a strategic location for direct distribution of emergency relief supplies from the storage structure to a populace in the event of an actual disaster. In addition the method includes marketing advertising on the storage structure.

title_en: Data acquisition optimization method, device, equipment and storage medium of multi-parameter monitoring device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data acquisition optimization method, a data acquisition optimization device, data acquisition optimization equipment and a storage medium of a multi-parameter monitoring device, and belongs to the field of online monitoring of power transmission lines. The invention provides a calculation method for simultaneously ensuring the service life requirement of the monitoring device and the maximum interval requirement of data acquisition for the minimum battery capacity from the aspect of probability statistical distribution, and the calculation method has low complexity and strong practicability in the engineering field; a data acquisition interval optimization strategy is provided for the actual battery capacity, so that the real-time performance of data monitoring is further guaranteed, and time slot conflicts of different parameter acquisition can be reduced; in order to deal with the monitoring of abnormal parameters, the invention also provides a time slot allocation strategy of the processor, which respectively carries out different processing aiming at the conventional conditions and the abnormal data conditions, ensures the continuous tracking feedback of the abnormal parameters, and simultaneously provides a sensor priority setting method which gives consideration to fairness and improves the instantaneity of abnormal data monitoring, thereby being easy to be applied in engineering.

title_en: Medical facility accessibility evaluation method based on mobile phone signaling data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a medical facility reachability evaluation method based on mobile phone signaling data, aiming at the problem of medical facility space distribution fairness, and from the reachability perspective, considering supply-demand interaction, and evaluating the medical facility reachability by using an enhanced two-step mobile search method (E2 SFCA). The method comprehensively considers the influence of the travel time and the travel distance on the travel, defines the service range and the distance threshold of the medical facility according to the travel condition of the mobile phone user, and introduces a Gaussian attenuation function based on the time threshold to simulate the attenuation of travel attraction along with the travel time. The invention can simultaneously consider the accessibility of the medical facilities under different transportation modes and display the space distribution condition of the accessibility of the medical facilities under different transportation modes, thereby evaluating the space distribution equilibrium condition of the medical facilities and proposing suggestions for urban planning and equalization of the medical facilities.

title_en: Barrier-free VR teaching resource color optimization method for people with abnormal color vision
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of teaching application of information technology, and provides a barrier-free VR teaching resource color optimization method for people with abnormal color vision, which comprises the following steps: (1) constructing a color cognition factor system; (2) constructing a color evaluation model; (3) and generating a color scheme optimization model. The method comprehensively considers the requirements of people with abnormal color vision, designs various types of tasks and analyzes the color cognition difference; constructing a color evaluation model by using an ensemble learning method; and (4) firstly dividing color patches on the image and then screening the scheme to optimize the color scheme. The invention is beneficial to non-professional persons to design and optimize VR teaching resources, achieves the universality of the color scheme and meets the fairness requirement of education resources.

title_en: Method for selecting site and rescuing material reserve station in city
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for selecting a disaster relief material reserve station in a city, which comprises the steps of S1, inputting relevant data of the city of the disaster relief material reserve station to be selected, S2, acquiring data characteristics based on the relevant data of the city of the disaster relief material reserve station to be selected, wherein the data characteristics comprise population distribution characteristics, urban road network structure characteristics, urban infrastructure space position information characteristics, geographic information characteristics and urban POI data characteristics, and S3, screening an optimal area in the city based on the data characteristics, a preset site selection model and a preset rule to serve as the disaster relief material reserve station of the city.

title_en: Intelligent standard sample examination and distribution device
abstract_en: The intelligent standard sample examination and issuing device comprises a base station, wherein a face recognition module, a management system, a taking mechanism and a sample placing basket are arranged on the base station. The sample placing basket is used for placing a sample bottle, a two-dimensional code is attached to the sample bottle, and the two-dimensional code contains sample information of the sample. The face recognition module is used for recognizing the identity information of the checked person. The taking mechanism is used for taking the sample bottle from the sample placing basket, and a sample identification module for identifying the two-dimensional code is arranged on the taking mechanism. The management system is electrically connected with the face recognition module, the taking mechanism and the sample recognition module. Compared with the prior art, the utility model has the beneficial effects that through integrating the face recognition technology, the mechanical arm operation and the advanced sample management information system, the accurate distribution, effective tracking and intelligent management of the assessment sample are realized, and the efficiency and fairness of the sample assessment process are obviously improved.
assignees: NINGBO CITY BEILUN DISTRICT ENVIRONMENTAL PROT MONITORING STATION;ZHEJIANG PUBLIC INFORMATION IND CO LTD

title_en: A kind of sincere logistics alliance system and method based on block chain technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of sincere logistics alliance system and methods based on block chain technology, are related to Financial Management field.The present invention includes for safeguarding the host node of logistics alliance platform chain and being distributed in the child node of different places；Logistics alliance platform chain is deployed in inside block chain underlying services device, and investor and logistics alliance participant pass through page end or mobile terminal APP access logistics alliance platform chain progress information exchange；Block chain underlying services device includes service sub-system, equity subsystem and verifying subsystem；Child node includes multiple verifying nodes and multiple maintenance nodes.The present invention passes through block chain Floor layer Technology, unified and open interface platform is used in application layer, dock logistics alliance side equity system relevant with participant, Performance Management System, talent energization system etc., front end guarantees that respective relevant information is submitted by capital side and logistics alliance participant using page end and mobile terminal APP, promotes trust and common recognition between logistics alliance relationship side and participant.
assignees: HEFEI WEITIAN YUNTONG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Flight pre-flight plan optimization method based on airline flight reduction preference
abstract_en: The invention provides a flight pre-flight plan optimization method based on airline flight reduction preference, which comprises the following steps: determining a limited flight set, a limited flight total number and an unlimited flight set; calculating the residual available guarantee capacity of the airspace; determining the resource allocation priority order of all flights in the limited flight set; determining the number of flights to be subtracted by each airline under the scheme; determining specifically subtracted flights under the scheme; determining a flight pre-flight plan adjustment strategy adopted by flights, and distributing corresponding airspace resources; judging corresponding conditions, and calculating average flight delay of the scheme; and determining a final flight pre-flight plan optimization scheme. The invention realizes the advance deduction of delay levels of different optimization schemes and effectively enhances the rationality of decision results. The flight subtraction considers the fairness of the airlines and the preference degree of the airlines, and improves the participation enthusiasm of the airlines in collaborative decisions.
assignees: THE 28TH RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA ELECTRONICS TECH GROUP CORPORATION

title_en: Building carbon asset matching transaction method based on supply-demand ratio and fair benefit principle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building carbon asset matching transaction method based on supply-demand ratio and fairness benefit principles, which comprises the following steps: step 1: counting building electric equipment and energy consumption thereof; step 2: building carbon asset matching transaction double-layer frames based on supply-demand ratio and fairness benefit principles are established from the regional level; step 3: the regional carbon transaction platform issues initial transaction information according to the historical prediction data; step 4: acquiring real-time supply and demand of each building carbon asset and the expected price of a user; step 5: and obtaining an optimization strategy of the double-layer regional building carbon asset matching transaction based on the supply-demand ratio and the fairness benefit principle. The invention realizes scientific and reasonable accounting of building carbon assets, reflects the yield of building carbon assets, can be incorporated into a carbon transaction system, and promotes carbon reduction through economic means.

title_en: Medical resource dynamic scheduling method based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a medical resource dynamic scheduling method based on deep reinforcement learning, and relates to the technical field of medical resource scheduling. The method comprises the steps of constructing a medical demand state vector according to a multi-source heterogeneous data set, inputting the medical demand state vector into a first-stage reinforcement learning network, outputting an admission demand prediction vector through a prediction agent, combining the demand prediction vector with a resource scheduling environment state, constructing a joint state vector, inputting the joint state vector into a second-stage reinforcement learning network, and outputting resource allocation data indicating configuration actions of various medical resources through the resource scheduling agent, wherein the two networks adopt an asynchronous parallel training mechanism and share part of characteristic coding parameters. The method and the device can improve accuracy of hospital admission demand prediction, response flexibility and scheduling prospective of medical resource allocation, resource utilization rate and patient service fairness, and model training and updating period are shortened.
assignees: The 8th Medical Center Of Chinese Pla General Hospital

title_en: Event prediction method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: One or more embodiments of the present disclosure provide an event prediction method and apparatus, and an electronic device, which are applied to a block chain node; the method comprises the following steps: determining that a prediction result input by a participant for a specified event is issued to a blockchain, wherein the input time of the prediction result is earlier than the occurrence time of the actual result of the specified event; and calling an intelligent contract for evaluating a prediction condition, wherein the intelligent contract is used for reading the prediction result and the actual result and comparing the prediction result with the actual result so as to send an allocation instruction to the out-of-chain object according to the comparison result, and the allocation instruction is used for instructing the out-of-chain object to allocate a first out-of-chain equity certificate to the participant.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle three-dimensional track optimization method based on probability line-of-sight link
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle three-dimensional track optimization method based on a probability line-of-sight link, which comprises the steps of firstly constructing an optimization problem conforming to a scene, then decoupling the original optimization problem into sub-problems related to a user scheduling coefficient, unmanned aerial vehicle transmission power, unmanned aerial vehicle horizontal plane track and unmanned aerial vehicle vertical flight track based on a BCD method, converting the non-convex problem into a convex problem by introducing a relaxation variable and performing convex approximate fitting on the non-convex constraint aiming at the non-convex problem of variable decoupling, and finally solving by adopting an iterative algorithm. Compared with the scheme of considering an ideal line-of-sight link, the scheme provided by the invention is more accurate, and compared with the scheme of designing the fixed transmission power or simply considering the scheme to perform partial optimization, the scheme of combining the optimal user scheduling coefficient, the unmanned plane transmission power and the three-dimensional flight track has higher average system reachable rate on the premise of ensuring the fairness scheduling of each user.

title_en: Routing optimization method for truck-drone integrated rescue vehicles in forest firefighting
abstract_en: A routing optimization method for truck-drone integrated rescue vehicles in forest firefighting includes the following steps: collecting the data of the disaster sites caused by forest fires, calculating transportation time on road and flight time according to the data of the disaster sites, and getting the transportation time data of post-disaster relief; based on the disaster site data, transportation time data, and an amount of relief supplies that can be allocated to disaster relief sites, constructing a mathematical model of the truck-drone based vehicle routing problem; solving the mathematical model of the truck-drone based vehicle routing problem by the optimization algorithm, and specifying a post-disaster rescue route of the truck-drone integrated rescue vehicle according to the solution results. The model based on the truck-drone based vehicle routing problem method can reduce the impact of sudden natural disasters, and give full play to the advantages of truck-drone integrated rescue vehicles.
assignees: BEIJING EVERYONE SAFE TECH CO LTD;UNIV BEIJING CHEM TECH

title_en: An optimization method and device for humanitarian logistics through truck-drone integration
title_ko: 트럭-드론 연계를 통한 재난구호물자 전달 최적화 방법 및 장치
abstract_ko: 트럭-드론 연계를 통한 재난구호물자 전달 최적화 방법 및 장치가 개시된다.  본 발명의 일실시예에 따른, 트럭-드론 연계를 통한 재난구호물자 전달 최적화 방법은, 재난이 발생한 피해 지역 내에서, 복수의 노드에 관한 노드 데이터를 수집하는 단계; 상기 피해 지역으로 재난구호물자를 전달하기 위한 전달 수단으로, 하나의 트럭과, 상기 트럭에 장착되는 n개(상기 n은 자연수)의 드론에 관한 스펙 데이터를 수집하는 단계; 상기 노드 데이터와 상기 스펙 데이터를 고려하여, 상기 트럭과 상기 드론과의 연계에 의한 상기 재난구호물자의 전달이 이루어지도록, 상기 복수의 노드의 적어도 일부를 잇는 최적 경로를 채택하는 단계; 및 상기 채택된 최적 경로를 따라, 상기 트럭 또는 상기 드론을 이동시키는 단계를 포함 할 수 있다.

title_en: Alternate distributing system for intelligent pretreatment of scarce resources by discrete directional broadcasting
abstract_en: The invention relates to an alternate distributing system for the intelligent pretreatment of scarce resources by discrete directional broadcasting, which is used for distributing scarce resources according to a distributing rule of alternate distributing probability by adopting a mode of establishing an exclusive identification code and hand-shaking code data according to an advance requirement and informing a selected person of receiving and selecting the scarce resources by a convenient and rapid communication mode. According to the alternate distributing system for the intelligent pretreatment of the scarce resources by the discrete directional broadcasting, the social cost generated by man-made noise is avoided, and the aim of equitable distribution is realized. According to the alternate distributing system for the intelligent pretreatment of the scarce resources by the discrete directional broadcasting, the system can be greatly simplified; the system has higher safety and lower developing and running cost; and meanwhile, the system also has very extensive application range.

title_en: Water resource optimal allocation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water resource allocation, in particular to a water resource optimal allocation method. The method comprises the steps of establishing a relation model of water resource demand, water resource allocation quantity and water resource distribution parameters of each water resource allocation unit, calculating the value and the core value of each water resource allocation unit cooperation set based on Bayesian game, and determining the water resource demand and the water resource allocation quantity corresponding to the cooperation set as the optimal configuration of each water resource allocation unit according to the water resource distribution parameters when the value of the cooperation set is close to the core value. According to the invention, through accurately modeling the water resource demand and introducing the water resource distribution parameters, the diversity and the change of the water resource demand are better adapted, and meanwhile, the optimal water resource distribution strategy of each water resource distribution unit is determined by considering the water resource distribution behavior of each water resource distribution unit, so that the optimization of resource distribution is realized, and the fairness and the rationality of water resource distribution are ensured.

title_en: Dynamic load triggering-based seamless supply method for disaster relief materials of dog clusters of autonomous fire extinguishing machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic load triggering-based seamless replenishment method for disaster relief materials of an autonomous fire-extinguishing machine dog cluster, which comprises the steps of constructing a multi-resource health degree model, dividing the machine dog resources into core output resources, auxiliary output resources and action survival resources, calculating the health degree of each type of resources through weighting, adjusting resource weight coefficients in real time according to fire levels and wearing parts life, defining a multi-level threshold triggering mechanism, dynamically calculating thresholds according to core output resource triggering, action survival resource triggering and auxiliary output resource triggering, triggering replenishment demands in advance by combining fire change rates and environmental temperature, fusing resource health degree gaps and replenishment station distance penalty items to generate individual priorities of the machine dog, dynamically distributing replenishment tasks according to the priorities, and avoiding replenishment station congestion through a two-level load balancing strategy.
assignees: HANGZHOU DIANZI UNIVERSTIY INFORMATION ENG SCHOOL

title_en: Scientific and technological thesis introduced quality evaluation method based on introduced frequency
abstract_en: The invention relates to a guided frequency-based scientific and technological paper guided quality evaluation method, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of determining an induced quality influence factor index of a paper: a single introduced position factor M of the introduced paper A, a form factor f of the introduced paper B, a journal grade factor lambda of the introduced paper B, and an introduced rate Y of the paper A; secondly, parameterization schemes of influence degrees of the M, f and lambda influence factors are determined respectively; calculating an influence factor index; establishing a mathematical model of the guided quality assessment index of the scientific and technological paper: obtaining a quality evaluation index Q = Mf lambda of the scientific and technological paper introduced in a single time according to the influence factor index  k  Y, and further obtaining the introduced quality evaluation index of the introduced paper A introduced for N times Q     N    . The method can objectively and comprehensively calculate the introduced quality of the scientific and technological paper, eliminate the limitation that the influence of a single paper is evaluated only by the introduced frequency in a mainstream, and optimize the paper quality evaluation schemeThe fairness and the reliability of the quality evaluation result of the paper are effectively improved.
assignees: NORTHWEST INSTITUTE ECO ENVIRONMENT & RESOURCES CAS

title_en: Renewable resource recovery sheet dividing method for identifying aggregation unit and gravity center region
abstract_en: The invention relates to a k-piece dividing method for identifying an aggregation unit and a working gravity center area. According to the scheme, computer simulation division is adopted, related data in the project related range is set first, and a simulation matrix map is constructed through riding distance. In the operation process, dividing the original K clusters into K, rho aggregation subunits and H discrete patch units based on the set coefficient rho of the sub-patch units; and based on the gravity center unit, continuously absorbing and combining the non-gravity center units at the edges until the required quantity of the area of the integrated aggregation subunit is greater than or equal to the human effect of the area. And finally distributing the obtained partition division result K+H based on the scheme, wherein K is the number of aggregation subunits, and H is the number of discrete partition units. Therefore, the responsible areas of the collectors can be reasonably divided, on one hand, the workload of the collectors is basically consistent, and the fairness is ensured; on the other hand, each cell is covered as much as possible, and the minimum number of the rest discrete units is ensured.
assignees: ZHEJIANG THROUGH WISDOM OF SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD;ZHEJIANG YUNQI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Cross-regional pollution compensation method based on multidimensional ecological bearing capacity and game theory
