abstract_en: The invention discloses a cross-regional pollution compensation method based on multidimensional ecological bearing capacity and game theory, which relates to the technical field of intersection of environmental economics and ecological compensation, and comprises the following steps of firstly, constructing a dynamic ecological bearing index CEI (i, t), and quantifying the bearing level of an ecological environment of a region by fusing the service supply capacity, pollution absorption capacity and socioeconomic pressure of the ecological system of the region; and secondly, establishing a pollution compensation responsibility distribution model based on the CEI (i, t) and the game theory, and determining the pollution responsibility proportion and compensation amount of each area. Dynamic quantification of ecological bearing capacity is realized, the limitation of the traditional evaluation mode is broken through, the compensation mechanism is made to have fairness and scientificity, and the acceptance of the system is improved.
assignees: SHENZHEN SHANYUANCHENG TECH HOLDING GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Emergency material scheduling method considering retired equipment utilization
abstract_en: The invention relates to an emergency material scheduling method considering retired equipment utilization, and belongs to the technical field of emergency material scheduling. The method comprises five steps of constructing a fairness objective function, constructing a disaster recovery personnel loss objective function, constructing an emergency material cost objective function, constructing an emergency material scheduling model and solving the model. The invention improves the utilization rate and recovery rate of materials, improves the distribution rationality of the materials, reduces unnecessary energy loss and personnel scheduling, and is easy to popularize and apply.
assignees: YUXI POWER SUPPLY BUREAU OF YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Power grid production cost management method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The utility model provides a grid production cost management method and system based on artificial intelligence, which collects grid production data in real time, wherein the grid production data comprises power demand, power supply, power price, power quality and equipment operation state, and a data processing and analysis technology based on artificial intelligence is introduced at the rear end to carry out time sequence collaborative analysis on the grid production data, so as to predict short-time grid production cost values, thereby formulating a grid production cost management strategy and optimizing the equipment operation state. Therefore, the dynamic management and optimization of the production cost of the power grid can be realized, so that the operation efficiency and fairness of a power system are improved, more efficient and sustainable power production and supply are realized, and support is provided for the development of the power market and the application of sustainable energy sources.
assignees: NANYANG POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Systems and methods for managing physical assets across territorial boundaries
abstract_en: Systems and methods are provided for the transfer of legal control of a physical asset when the physical asset is transported across a territorial boundary. Such systems and methods facilitate the transfer of assets within a network between network participants associated with and having control over territories when an asset crosses a territorial boundary. Such a transfer allows for efficient and equitable distribution of costs, revenues, and other elements associated with movable assets among network participants in a region of control.

title_en: Ship brake passing scheduling method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ship pass gate scheduling method based on artificial intelligence, and relates to the technical field of ship pass gate scheduling. The method comprises the steps of obtaining ship information, multidimensional ship observation information and historical track data, estimating the ship state based on the multidimensional ship observation information, dividing the confidence level of the ship according to the ship information and marking the confidence level to generate a ship information set, obtaining a ship queue reorganization scheme and a corresponding prediction result based on the multi-node collaborative optimization model, and updating the multi-node collaborative optimization model according to the comparison result of the collected data and the prediction result. According to the invention, a plurality of scheduling targets covering lock room space utilization, safe passing constraint, ship priority, fairness balance and water level linkage are set, and a weight dynamic adjustment mechanism and a multi-target balance strategy are introduced in the optimization process, so that the scheduling method is flexibly balanced among various operation requirements.

title_en: Laminated woven cloth and flood control woven bag containerized rapid transportation unit
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a laminated woven fabric and flood control woven bag containerized quick dispatching unit. A laminated woven fabric containerized quick transfer unit is characterized in that laminated woven fabrics are stacked and fixed on a square nonstandard tray of 2.1 m, forklift holes are reserved between upper and lower plates of the nonstandard tray, the laminated woven fabrics are stacked in a regular mode according to a certain modulus in a groined mode, 4 bags are paved on each layer, a first layer is transverse, a second layer is longitudinal, 15 layers are stacked, and the height of a transfer unit with the tray is not more than 1.2 m. A fast transportation unit for the containerization of flood control woven bags is characterized in that the flood control woven bags are stacked in groups and fixed on rectangular nonstandard trays of which the size is 2.1 x 1.75 meters, forklift holes are reserved between upper and lower planks of the nonstandard trays, the flood control woven bags are stacked in order according to a certain modulus, 6 bags are paved on each layer, 5 layers are stacked, and the height of a transportation unit with the tray is not more than 1.35 meters. The utility model can comprehensively improve the rapid scheduling capability of emergency rescue and relief materials.
assignees: YELLOW RIVER FLOOD CONTROL AND DROUGHT RELIEF MAT RESERVE MANAGEMENT CENTER

title_en: Local area multi-microgrid power transaction pairing method based on block chain technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a local multi-microgrid power transaction pairing method based on a block chain technology, wherein a multi-microgrid is used as a novel distributed power generation system and is an important component of an energy internet. The selection of the power generation resources and the electric energy transaction have a series of problems of obvious centralization, low fairness and reliability and the like. Aiming at the defects of the micro-grid in real-time power transaction, a multi-micro-grid power transaction pairing method based on a block chain technology is provided, a competitive power spot market with a transaction part centralized in multi-seller-multi-buyer is constructed, and source-sale integration is realized. The settlement process is automatically achieved through transaction information uploading, matching, encryption and intelligent contracts, random quotation and random pairing of all main bodies are achieved through the ant colony algorithm, and multi-objective optimization is achieved. The whole process realizes the unification of the energy flow, the information flow and the currency flow of the electric power transaction, and ensures the reasonable distribution of electric energy resources and the open transparency of the electric power transaction.

title_en: Multi-express-item centralized sorting and scheduling method based on customer behavior evaluation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a centralized sorting and scheduling method for a plurality of express deliveries based on customer behavior evaluation, which is realized by the following steps: a) Building a sorting reservation scheduling system: setting up an online express sorting reservation system for an enterprise needing sorting express; b) Information recording and identification: uploading basic information of an express centralized sorting center, including express sorting speed, work time table and unit time cost; c) Processing the communication problem; d) Customer behavior scoring: grading according to the historical behaviors of the enterprises needing to sort the express, and judging the unit time deposit needing to be paid; e) Sorting and scheduling express; f) Feedback settlement and delivery. According to the centralized sorting and scheduling method for the multiple express deliveries, restriction can be formed on two parties through the customer behavior scoring and the feedback, the fairness and the rationality of sorting and scheduling are guaranteed while the cost is reduced and the efficiency is improved, and the overall cooperative effect of centralized sorting is exerted to the maximum extent.
assignees: ZHEJIANG MINGKE INTELLIGENT LOGISTICS EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Task allocation method based on ternary space-time crowdsourcing high fairness
abstract_en: The invention discloses a task allocation method based on ternary space-time crowdsourcing high fairness. The invention defines fairness space-time crowdsourcing first; secondly, as the invention aims at the problem of article distribution, a worker can receive a plurality of tasks at one time, and a distribution route with the least cost is searched for the worker by adopting a path planning algorithm; then determining a calculation formula of the rewards and the profit; the data is then preprocessed: screening candidate worker sets and site sets for the task by using constraint conditions; screening candidate task sets for workers; finally, a greedy algorithm is used for realizing task allocation, and a local optimal solution is obtained; further increasing the overall profit with an optimal threshold algorithm; the strategy set of workers is determined according to the data obtained through preprocessing, and a game algorithm is utilized, so that each worker selects the optimal strategy under the condition that strategy conflict does not occur with other workers.

title_en: Multi-objective decision-making technology for investment of equity of power grid management industry
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of multi-objective decision making, discloses a multi-objective decision making technology for investment equity in the power grid saving industry, which is used for constructing an incremental power distribution network investment risk assessment index system considering planning risks, management risks, market risks and economic risks, constructing an incremental power distribution network investment risk assessment model based on MGARA, constructing an investment capacity prediction model based on deep learning and optimization algorithms, deducing an equilibrium solution by setting proper constraint conditions and objective functions and combining benefit functions of multi-party subjects, adopting multi-subject game optimization of a genetic algorithm nested particle swarm algorithm to carry out model solving so as to obtain an optimal investment strategy, realizing optimal cooperation and benefit balance among the subjects and achieving the overall optimal investment decision of a system, and can realize cooperation and benefit maximization among different subjects and provide an innovative solution for power grid equity investment, resource allocation and risk management.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Railway emergency material scheduling optimization method based on distributed system architecture
abstract_en: The invention discloses a railway emergency material dispatching optimization method based on a distributed system architecture, which comprises the following steps of obtaining disaster condition multi-dimensional information, predicting emergency material demands, obtaining the demand quantity of emergency materials at each disaster point, using shortest path rules to draw out initial dispatching paths of the emergency materials at each disaster point, updating disaster condition evolution information collected according to big data to obtain final dispatching paths, constructing a multi-objective emergency material dispatching optimization model, respectively solving the perception of the disaster people on risks and the unevenness of the emergency material dispatching at each disaster point, carrying out directional distribution according to solving results, carrying out satisfaction evaluation, updating the demand quantity and the dispatching paths if a preset satisfaction value is not reached, and carrying out model solving until the preset satisfaction value is reached. The invention shortens the response time of resource scheduling, optimizes the fairness of material scheduling, and ensures that the scheduling process of emergency materials is more scientific and effective.
assignees: UNIV BEIHANG;CHINA STATE RAILWAY GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Virtual power plant double-layer optimal scheduling method and device based on differentiated quotation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a virtual power plant double-layer optimal scheduling method and device based on differentiated quotation, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing an upper-layer electricity-carbon combined market model and a lower-layer virtual power plant model; the method comprises the steps of obtaining quotation data of each virtual power plant in each period based on a lower-layer virtual power plant model, inputting the quotation data into an upper-layer electric-carbon combined market model for market clearing, obtaining clear data of each virtual power plant in each period, feeding the clear data back to each virtual power plant and updating the clear data to generate new quotation data, constructing a combined optimal judging index, carrying out multi-round iterative solution on the two models, and outputting optimal results of double-layer optimal scheduling when the two models are converged. According to the invention, the balance of supply and demand and the constraint of carbon of the system are met, meanwhile, the energy purchasing cost of the upper market, the economic benefit of the virtual power plant and the carbon emission reduction benefit are taken into account, the differentiated quotation and double-layer coordination optimization are realized, and the running efficiency and the benefit fairness of the participation of the virtual power plant in the electricity-carbon combined market are improved.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV SHANGHAI ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Emergency supply management system, emergency supply management method, and emergency supply management program
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To surely distribute emergency supplies by efficiently managing the inventory or delivery of emergency supplies across companies.  <P>SOLUTION: This system 100 is configured of an application acceptance part 110 for accepting use application information from a user terminal 300, and for storing it in a memory 103; a base point specification part 111 for collating the use application information with an inventory management database 125, and for specifying a base point including a use place in a service area with a spare capacity for dealing with emergency supplies whose attributes are designated by the use application information, and for storing the request quantity of emergency supplies, and for storing the information of the base point and the use application information in association with each other in a contract database 126; a storage instruction part 112 for notifying a base point terminal 200 of storage instruction, and for adding inventory quantity and reducing free space in the inventory management database 125; and a shipping instruction part 113 for specifying the corresponding base point based on shipping request information, and for notifying the base point terminal 200 of a shipping instruction based on the shipping request information.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Photovoltaic cluster batch control system and method for low-voltage transformer area
abstract_en: The invention relates to a low-voltage station photovoltaic cluster batch control system which comprises a dispatching master station, an edge side proxy substation and field controllable equipment, wherein the edge side proxy substation is communicated with the field controllable equipment in a downlink communication mode, acquires the running state and power of the field controllable equipment, sends a switching-off and switching-on instruction to the field controllable equipment, the switching-off instruction cuts off the field controllable equipment, and the switching-on instruction connects the field controllable equipment in a grid mode, and the edge side proxy substation is communicated with the dispatching master station in an uplink communication mode to send the total power of a station, the number of photovoltaic switches input in the station, the total power of the station photovoltaic power and the actual cut-off value of the photovoltaic power, and receives the cut-off target value of the photovoltaic power sent by the dispatching master station. The invention reduces the decision calculation amount of the dispatching master station, balances the cut-off times of each photovoltaic user and ensures the fairness of each photovoltaic user for receiving dispatching control.

title_en: Automatic driving vehicle dispatching system for signalless intersection based on game optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent dispatching method and system for an automatic driving vehicle without a signalized intersection, and belongs to the technical field of automatic driving and intelligent traffic control. Aiming at the problems of low traffic efficiency and unfair traffic of the existing signalless intersections, the invention provides a multi-vehicle cooperative scheduling method based on game theory optimization. According to the method, the state information of each vehicle is acquired through the communication of the Internet of vehicles, an optimization model which aims at minimizing the weighted maximum waiting time is constructed, and scheduling fairness and efficiency are comprehensively considered. And setting explicit safety constraint, fleet consistency constraint and global waiting time constraint, and ensuring that a scheduling result meets the requirements of safety and systematicness. Meanwhile, adjustable priority weights are given to different types of vehicles, so that differentiated dispatching control of emergency vehicles, public service vehicles and the like is realized. The method has the advantages of high interpretability, clear structure, strong adaptability and the like, and has good engineering realizability and popularization value.

title_en: Flow tobacco purchasing system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a flow tobacco purchasing system, which comprises a tobacco point server arranged in a computer network and a purchasing control center connected with the tobacco point server; the purchase control center is connected with at least one tobacco purchase line used for purchasing the field management system unit and a selected number arranging device; the tobacco leaf purchase line includes: the tobacco delivering and card swiping equipment is used for tobacco grower identity verification; tobacco leaf grading equipment for selling and confirming input tobacco leaf grade by basket; tobacco leaf weighing and stacking equipment for reading the weight of tobacco leaves basket by basket according to a grading sequence; the tobacco grower selling confirmation equipment is used for confirming selling of the tobacco grower on site. The utility model flexibly customizes the management control strategy according to the needs, and realizes the field flow management according to the role distribution function participated in the process; the sale confirmation function is added, so that errors and disputes are not easy to occur; the quality control process has clear vestige record and is convenient for tracing the product quality; the fairness and the objectivity are improved; the tobacco purchasing efficiency is improved, the operation is simple, and the applicability is strong.
assignees: CHENGDU HUINENG INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;SICHUAN TOBACCO CORP LIANGSHANZHOU CORP

title_en: A six rotor craft frames for disaster relief supplies are put in
abstract_en: The utility model provides a six rotor craft frames for disaster relief supplies are put in, the frame includes fuselage and six cantilevers, the fuselage includes mounting panel, lower mounting panel and is used for connecting the spliced pole of going up mounting panel and lower mounting panel, goes up and forms accommodation space between mounting panel and the lower mounting panel, goes up the first connecting seat that the mounting panel edge was equipped with six circumference evenly distributed, and lower mounting panel edge is equipped with six circumference evenly distributed's second connecting seat, and the setting is just presented down with second connecting seat one -to -one to first connecting seat, first mount pad forms the installation station rather than the second mount pad that corresponds, and cantilever one end is installed on the installation station, the other end of cantilever is equipped with the motor, and the output shaft and the screw of motor are connected. The utility model discloses the carrying capacity is big, can realize the input of goods and materials, and is reliable and stable. (U /)

title_en: Multi-stage time sequence dependent crowdsourcing system based on block chain and VCG auction mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-stage time sequence dependent crowdsourcing system based on a blockchain and VCG auction mechanism, which can be divided into a client, a contract layer and a blockchain layer three-layer structure; the client is used for interaction between the user and the intelligent contract; the contract layer is used for processing data and realizing corresponding functions; the blockchain layer is used to store contract-generated data. Aiming at a multi-stage complex space-time crowdsourcing task with time sequence dependence, the whole task can be divided into subtasks of a plurality of stages, and certain dependency relationship exists among the subtasks; the invention takes the time sequence dependency relationship of the subtasks as a key point of the problem, also considers the limit of the workload of the tasks, combines the task characteristics and the VCG mechanism, and provides a reverse auction mechanism for the task allocation and the commission settlement function, thereby fully considering the marginal benefit of the tasks, avoiding the waste cost and effectively reducing the task cost under the condition of ensuring the reality, fairness and credibility of the auction mechanism.

title_en: Electric automobile charging guiding method considering user satisfaction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric automobile charging, in particular to an electric automobile charging guiding method considering user satisfaction, which comprises the following steps: collecting relevant information of all charging stations in a dispatching area; collecting charging demand and position information of an electric automobile sending a charging application in a dispatching period; based on the nearby guiding strategy, the charging guiding sequence of the electric automobile is obtained, and the fairness of the charging process is ensured; taking the total charging time and the total charging cost of the electric automobile as clustering points, and constructing a user satisfaction evaluation model; and guiding the electric vehicles in sequence according to the charging guiding sequence, and solving a user satisfaction evaluation model with the highest user satisfaction as a target when any electric vehicle is guided, so as to obtain the optimal guiding result of the current electric vehicle. The invention can save the time cost and the cost of charging for the electric automobile user, improve the satisfaction degree of the user and effectively consider the utilization rate of the charging station.

title_en: Crowd-sourced competition task and worker intelligent matching method considering multi-subject requirements
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent matching method for crowd-sourced competition tasks and workers considering multi-subject requirements, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a crowdsourcing competition task set to be matched and an available worker set on a crowdsourcing platform; constructing a multi-objective crowdsourcing competition task and worker matching model taking the matching degree of the task and the worker, the knowledge diversity of the worker, the fairness of the worker group and the fairness of the worker individual as optimization targets; designing an improved genetic algorithm to solve a matching model of the multi-objective crowdsourcing competition task and the worker to obtain a matching scheme of the task and the worker; and distributing each crowdsourcing competition task to the corresponding worker based on a matching scheme of the task and the worker. According to the invention, the matching model is constructed by taking the matching degree of the task and the worker, the knowledge diversity of the worker, the fairness of the worker group and the fairness of the worker individual as optimization targets, so that the matching accuracy, fairness and matching efficiency of the crowdsourcing competition task and the worker are improved.

title_en: Virtual power plant low-carbon optimization method, system and equipment based on two-stage carbon transaction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of energy power, and discloses a virtual power plant low-carbon optimization method, system and equipment based on two-stage carbon transaction, which comprehensively consider the differences of equipment types and loads in each functional area and an electric automobile aggregator based on a frame model divided according to functions; the method comprises the steps of establishing a two-stage carbon transaction model, realizing optimal distribution of carbon quota through carbon quota transaction among all main bodies in the first stage, enabling all main bodies to participate in stepped carbon transaction in a carbon market in the second stage, taking carbon emission reduction capacity of an electric automobile as obtained carbon quota to enable the electric automobile to fully participate in the carbon transaction to sell the carbon quota to obtain benefits, and enabling VPP systems with larger contribution degree to obtain higher benefits due to different contribution degrees of each VPP system to the whole, so that benefit distribution is carried out by utilizing comprehensive contribution rate, the comprehensive contribution rate is applied to payment bargaining sub-problems, and fairness and rationality of benefit distribution are improved.

title_en: China electric power industry carbon quota allocation method considering inter-generation fairness and inter-province fairness
abstract_en: The invention discloses a carbon quota allocation method for the power industry of China, which takes the inter-generation and inter-provincial fairness into consideration, and comprises the steps of acquiring carbon emission data of the power industry of the past year and the national carbon emission data of the past year; based on the generation-based emission reduction model, predicting the carbon emission of the power industry in the t year according to the national carbon emission data of the past year and the carbon emission data of the power industry of the past year, multiplying the carbon emission of the power industry in the t year by the adjusted accumulated carbon intensity of the power industry in the set area, and obtaining the carbon quota of the power industry in the t year corresponding to the set area. The invention realizes cross-generation carbon quota upper limit setting, introduces a carbon transfer responsibility adjustment mechanism based on regional power dispatching, effectively relieves the problem of carbon responsibility imbalance caused by power cross-regional dispatching, and simultaneously quantifies the emission reduction economic cost of each period and each region, thereby providing a data basis for carbon regulation.

title_en: Fixed source multistage emission limit value determining method and system based on statistical characteristics
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for determining a fixed source multistage emission limit value based on statistical characteristics, and relates to the technical field of environmental monitoring and management. The method comprises the steps of obtaining and controlling the concentration of historical emission monitoring data of a point pollution source, calculating a long-term average value as a statistical base line, further calculating a variation coefficient, establishing a difference state coefficient across time scales, combining a statistical guarantee rate with log-normal distribution deviation correction on the basis, determining a daily maximum, weekly average and monthly average concentration limit value, further introducing a standardized fluctuation coefficient to realize unified expression of the limit value, multiplying the standardized fluctuation coefficient with average water discharge of a corresponding statistical period to obtain a multi-stage load limit value, and accordingly realizing concentration and total quantity cooperative control under a unified statistical framework, and considering short-term risk inhibition and long-term risk constraint, and has scientificity, fairness and management operability.

title_en: system
abstract_en: To utilize information on earthquake intensity to estimate the scale of disaster, number of victims, and types of damage, efficiently determine the allocation ratio of supplies to each municipality and optimize the quantity of supplies, transportation means and transportation routes to improve the efficiency of distribution and transportation of relief supplies in the event of a disaster.SOLUTION: A system comprises: means for estimating the scale of disaster, number of victims, and types of damage from earthquake intensity information, and determining the allocation ratio of supplies to each municipality; means for determining the quantity of supplies provided from non-affected areas that can provide supplies, transportation means, and transportation routes; and means for transporting the supplies using drones or the like.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Project declaration similarity detection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a similarity detection device is declared to project, comprises a workbench, scanning equipment has been placed to one side at workstation top, one side bolt joint at scanning equipment top has the warning light, the opposite side bolt joint at scanning equipment top has first camera, one side electric connection of scanning equipment has the detection display, the second camera is installed at the top that detects the display. The utility model discloses a workstation, scanning equipment, warning light, first camera, detect the display, the second camera, the standing groove, the hydraulic stem, a display screen, the spacing groove, the setting of slide bar and sliding sleeve, make project declaration similarity detection device, it is high to possess security and fairness, and prevent the advantage of camera bellows operation, optimize the environment of project declaration, solved current project declaration similarity detection device simultaneously and lacked certain security and fairness, and easy problem of being operated by the camera bellows.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG;CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO

title_en: Work order distribution method based on internet
abstract_en: This application discloses the work order distribution methods based on internet.One specific embodiment of the method includes：The work order allocation request message that work order promoter sends is received, wherein, the work order assignment request message includes：Work order content, working region range, ability to work requirement and priority；The information of all objects is obtained, the information of the object includes：Job site, ability to work, ongoing work order, scoring；Choose object of the job site in the range of the working region of work order；Selection ability to work meets the object of the ability to work requirement of work order as candidate allocation object from the object；The work order is sent to the candidate allocation object that the quantity of ongoing work order is zero.The embodiment realizes real-time work order and preengages the distribution of work order, not only ensure that distributional equity but also had improved the completion quality of work order and complete speed, be conducive to transfer the work incentive of object and improve work efficiency.
assignees: BEIJING SAGA CLOUD TECH CO LTD

title_en: Management method and system for activity-level inventory of equity mall
abstract_en: The invention discloses a management method and a system for activity-level inventory of a rights and interests mall, comprising the steps of creating an inventory table, a sub-inventory table and a coupon code table; purchasing a batch equity and an equity coupon code, automatically generating purchase records of the batch equity in the stock table, automatically generating general stock records of the batch equity in the sub-stock table, and automatically adding the equity coupon code to the coupon code table; creating active inventory in the sub-inventory table to distribute the batch rights and interests, and synchronously updating a general inventory record; setting an activity setting total equity quantity and an activity setting available equity quantity in the activity inventory to realize batch release and use of the batch equity; according to the method, through the design of the inventory table, the sub-inventory table and the coupon code table, the effective linkage management and control of the batch total inventory and the activity-level inventory are realized, the flexible allocation of the inventory among different activity inventories under the same total inventory is realized, and the inventory of the same activity inventory is released in batches according to activity requirements.

title_en: New energy automobile charging pile load balancing and scheduling method based on intelligent algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of new energy automobiles, in particular to a new energy automobile charging pile load balancing and scheduling method based on an intelligent algorithm, which comprises the following steps of S1, data acquisition, real-time acquisition of operation data of a charging pile; the method comprises the steps of S2, predicting charging demands of all charging piles in a preset time in the future through a graph rolling network model, S3, optimizing space dispatching of the charging piles, namely, optimizing the dispatching of the charging piles in space according to geographic distribution conditions of the charging piles, surrounding vehicle flow and charging demand prediction results, S4, carrying out load dispatching and resource allocation, namely, carrying out resource allocation according to the charging demand prediction and charging pile space dispatching optimization results and combining power grid load conditions. The invention improves the utilization efficiency of the charging pile resources, optimizes the layout of the whole charging network, and ensures the fairness of charging service and the balance of power grid load.

title_en: Intelligent evaluation system of cloud computing platform
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent evaluation system of a cloud computing platform, which belongs to the technical field of intelligent evaluation and comprises a four-dimensional heterogeneous topological network module, a dynamic load sensing neural network module, a privacy protection module, a disaster recovery and performance optimization module and a compliance and adaptation module. The intelligent evaluation system of the cloud computing platform provided by the invention solves the core defects of the existing intelligent evaluation system of cloud computing in the aspects of dynamic fairness, non-European resource association modeling and fault self-healing capacity. By introducing a time attenuation factor and multidimensional contribution quantification through a dynamic shape value evaluation model, the fairness barrier of traditional static evaluation is broken, and real-time accurate measurement of node contribution is realized.

title_en: Energy storage excitation value distribution measurement method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy storage incentive value distribution measurement method, system, equipment and medium, which relate to the technical field of power market and carbon transaction optimization and comprise the steps of collecting historical transaction data and system equipment parameter data of a power market and a carbon transaction market, constructing an electric carbon coupling quotation model according to electric carbon market data, defining constraint conditions in a dispatching optimization process, constructing a novel energy storage optimization dispatching model according to constraint conditions by adopting a double-layer optimization modeling method, optimizing a dispatching strategy through the novel energy storage optimization dispatching model, and outputting the electric carbon coupling quotation model to calculate the market value of a bidding subject by using a VCG mechanism. According to the method, competitive bidding payment is optimized through a VCG mechanism, equitable and reasonable market value distribution is ensured, and the double-layer optimized scheduling model is adopted, so that the benefits of the energy storage device in the electric energy market and the frequency modulation market are improved.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG;UNIV ZHEJIANG FINANCE & ECONOMICS;ZHEJIANG UNIV SHAOXING RESEARCH INSTITUTE

title_en: Power grid operation task optimization method considering change overhaul risk and waiting time
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid operation task optimization method considering change overhaul risks and waiting time, and belongs to the field of power grids. According to the method, the optimization of the execution sequence of the power grid operation tasks is realized by taking the reduction of the expected maintenance risk loss of the power grid and the waiting time cost of operators as the targets according to the equipment operation tasks and the real-time operation information of the power grid acquired from the automation system. The invention considers the constraint conditions of power grid safety, manpower, material resources and the like, can provide reasonable suggestions for the operation decision of a dispatcher, is beneficial to improving the operation reliability and the dispatching fairness of the power grid, and is suitable for various dispatching mechanisms.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle cooperative reconnaissance path planning method based on energy consumption fairness
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle cooperative reconnaissance path planning method based on energy consumption fairness, which utilizes an algorithm of a traveler problem to calculate a path covering all target points, so that the total energy consumption is minimum; distributing the N reconnaissance target points to K unmanned aerial vehicles by using a path decomposition algorithm and obtaining an initial path of each unmanned aerial vehicle; and (4) forming a closed path of the K unmanned aerial vehicles by adding the initial path of each unmanned aerial vehicle and the path from the starting point to the reconnaissance area. The invention effectively reduces the maximum energy consumption of the unmanned aerial vehicles, improves the energy consumption fairness among the unmanned aerial vehicles and ensures that the reconnaissance task is smoothly completed.

title_en: Heterogeneous type emergency resource scheduling optimization method considering fairness
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heterogeneous type emergency resource scheduling optimization method considering fairness, and belongs to the field of emergency resource scheduling optimization. Aiming at compact cooperative heterogeneous resources, adopting time and satisfaction rate dual dimension modeling, adopting a mixed coding and decoding mode according to problem characteristics, expressing an emergency resource scheduling scheme in a mathematical form, aiming at target and constraint conditions, adopting a random rule with priority to ensure the quality of an initial population, adopting a cross operator combining shuffling cross and partial matching cross to ensure the diversity and stability of the population in an iterative process, adopting self-adaptive cross variation probability to maintain the diversity of the population, improving the efficiency of the algorithm, adopting an elite retention strategy with a lowest crowdedness threshold to increase the diversity of the population and prevent the population from maturing prematurely. The method is suitable for dispatching optimization of the close-cooperation type heterogeneous resources under the condition of supply and demand in the early period of disasters, and provides a new thought for solving the problem of dispatching the heterogeneous resources in emergency resources.

title_en: Garbage clearance task scheduling and path optimizing method considering sanitation worker fairness
abstract_en: The invention provides a garbage clearance task scheduling and path optimizing method and system considering sanitation worker fairness, and relates to the technical field of path optimizing. Firstly, obtaining yard information, garbage collection point information, garbage collection vehicle information and garbage transfer center information; then, the information is used for constructing a garbage collection task scheduling and path optimizing model by taking the sum of the minimum carbon emission amount, the vehicle cost, the total vehicle fuel cost and the unbalanced workload punishment cost of sanitation workers as the target; and finally, solving a garbage clearance task scheduling and path optimizing model to obtain a garbage clearance task scheduling and path optimizing scheme. According to the invention, real factors such as sanitation equity consideration and the like are considered in garbage recycling and processing activities, a related mathematical programming model is constructed, the technical problem of poor applicability of a scheme obtained by the existing research is solved, the sanitation equity consideration is considered, and the garbage collection task scheduling and path optimization are enabled to have practical significance.

title_en: Position optimization method and system for UAV-RIS auxiliary wireless communication based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention provides a position optimization method and a system for UAV-RIS auxiliary wireless communication based on reinforcement learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: building a UAV-RIS auxiliary wireless communication model under a disaster scene; obtaining an optimal model of the optimal position with the highest throughput of multi-communication fairness under the disaster scene based on reinforcement learning in the wireless communication model; and training and learning by utilizing environmental data changing along with the position of the unmanned aerial vehicle, optimizing the track of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and optimizing the neural network parameters according to feedback to obtain the optimal position of the maximum throughput of the user side. The invention solves the deployment position relation of the RIS auxiliary mmWave communication system carried by the unmanned aerial vehicle, and simultaneously considers factors such as communication fairness, limitation of the flyable area, transmitting power and the like, can ensure the communication requirements of a plurality of trapped users, and proposes to maximize the throughput of the users.

title_en: Network constraint-free bilateral transaction optimization clearing method and system based on new energy consumption
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of power automation, and discloses a network constraint-free bilateral transaction optimization clearing method and system based on new energy consumption, the invention can better identify the supply and demand deviation of the market through the accurate comparison of the plan value and the predicted value, thereby optimizing the consumption of new energy and reducing the resource waste caused by the mismatch of the supply and the demand. By constructing a refined market bidding space curve and a price information matching mechanism, the transmission efficiency of market price signals is enhanced, the demand side can respond to price change more quickly and accurately, and the price elasticity of power demands is released. The established optimization clear model considers various market constraint conditions, so that an optimal trading pair can be found in a complex market environment, the high efficiency and fairness of a trading process are ensured, the market stability is improved, and the risk of market failure is reduced.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Urban industrial space intelligent distribution system based on persistent data learning
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent distribution system of urban industrial space based on continuous data learning, which relates to the technical field of planning and design, and comprises a data acquisition module, a data processing and analyzing module, an intelligent decision module, a user interface module and a continuous learning module, wherein the system can acquire and analyze multi-source data in real time through continuous data learning, the industrial space distribution scheme is dynamically adjusted, so that the change of traffic flow, industrial demand and environmental conditions can be quickly adapted in the urban development process, and the comprehensive and balanced decision-making is ensured by comprehensively considering multidimensional targets such as economic benefit, environmental influence, social fairness and the like through a multi-target optimizing engine when the system prepares the industrial distribution scheme.
assignees: SHENZHEN NATURAL RESOURCES AND REAL ESTATE EVALUATION DEVELOPMENT RES CENTER SHENZHEN GEOLOGICAL ENV

title_en: Irrigation area water and fertilizer coupling regulation and control method based on cross-scale collaborative optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water and fertilizer coupling regulation and control method for a irrigated area based on cross-scale collaborative optimization, which improves the agricultural water and fertilizer management efficiency through a systematic methodology. Firstly, collecting meteorological and agricultural basic data, fitting a water and fertilizer production function by using a least square method, and establishing a relation between crop yield and water and fertilizer input. And constructing a water balance model and a multi-objective optimization function on the farmland scale, and solving the optimal irrigation and nitrogen application scheme of each field by adopting NSGA-II and TOPSIS algorithms. And (3) optimizing a water supply scheme with the aim of subtracting the water and fertilizer cost from the total yield value of crops at the irrigation domain scale, forming a local water supply boundary, and realizing cooperative iteration of irrigation domain and farmland through a dynamic feedback mechanism. And finally, carrying out global optimization evaluation on the scale of the irrigation area through a fairness model, and providing decision support for reasonable allocation of water resources. Economic benefit, resource utilization rate and environmental influence are comprehensively considered, scientificity and sustainability of water and fertilizer management in irrigation areas are effectively improved, and a new idea is provided for intelligent development of modern agriculture.

title_en: Multi-agent reinforcement learning-based multi-mode intermodal route selection method
abstract_en: The application relates to a multi-agent reinforcement learning-based multi-mode intermodal route selection method. The method comprises the steps of constructing a multi-agent intermodal transportation network and a system environment, carrying out initial planning by adopting a self-adaptive large neighborhood search algorithm based on the multi-agent intermodal transportation network and the system environment, acquiring accident information when an accident occurs, optimizing the initial planning by adopting a multi-agent reinforcement learning algorithm based on the accident information and a cost objective function to obtain an accident action decision, and carrying out transportation tasks based on the accident action decision. By constructing a large neighborhood disturbance response mechanism fused with ALNS, when the node/path service time deviation is detected to exceed a threshold value, the intelligent trigger path reconstruction is performed, a new alternative path is generated, based on a MADDPG multi-Agent reinforcement learning framework, each carrier Agent can obtain global information in centralized training, independent decision is made in execution, and the utilization efficiency of transportation resources and the task allocation fairness are effectively improved.

title_en: Ship brake passing scheduling method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ship pass gate scheduling method based on artificial intelligence, and relates to the technical field of ship pass gate scheduling. The method comprises the steps of obtaining ship information, multidimensional ship observation information and historical track data, estimating the ship state based on the multidimensional ship observation information, dividing the confidence level of the ship according to the ship information and marking the confidence level to generate a ship information set, obtaining a ship queue reorganization scheme and a corresponding prediction result based on the multi-node collaborative optimization model, and updating the multi-node collaborative optimization model according to the comparison result of the collected data and the prediction result. According to the invention, a plurality of scheduling targets covering lock room space utilization, safe passing constraint, ship priority, fairness balance and water level linkage are set, and a weight dynamic adjustment mechanism and a multi-target balance strategy are introduced in the optimization process, so that the scheduling method is flexibly balanced among various operation requirements.
assignees: JIANGXI PORT GROUP TECH CO LTD

title_en: Index collection method and system based on multi-source heterogeneous index data fusion
abstract_en: The invention provides an index collection method and system based on multi-source heterogeneous index data fusion, and relates to the technical field of big data processing, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting a source end index factor data table of multi-source heterogeneous indexes from a source end system; the method comprises the steps of carrying out source layer pasting on source end index factor data in a source end index factor data table to obtain a source layer pasting index factor wide table, carrying out data integration association on the source layer pasting index factor wide table to obtain a shared layer index factor wide table, carrying out operation on the shared layer index factor wide table based on a data analysis algorithm, and generating an analysis layer index factor wide table according to an operation result. According to the invention, heterogeneous assessment index data with different formats and structures are integrated, meanwhile, a full-link closed loop is realized through a data center, and assessment indexes are optimized in an automatic mode to obtain accurate assessment indexes, so that fairness and effectiveness of performance assessment and decision analysis of organization are improved.
assignees: BEIJING GUODIANTONG NETWORK TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;STATE GRID INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Directional rights and interests distribution method, device, equipment and medium based on multidimensional contribution value
abstract_en: The invention discloses a directional rights and interests distribution method, device, equipment and medium based on multidimensional contribution values, the method collects actions of praise, sign-in, reporting, uploading content and the like of a user through an event monitoring mechanism, and converts the actions into two types of platform contribution values and civilized contribution values. At the end of the activity, the system selects a duty cycle mode, a ranking mode or a fixed value mode for benefit allocation calculation according to the configuration rules. The duty ratio mode distributes benefits according to the proportion of the contribution values of the users; and selecting a user with the contribution value ranked at the top by the ranking mode to issue the equity cards, and issuing the equity cards for the user reaching the threshold value by the fixed value mode. And the distribution result is asynchronously processed through the message queue, so that income warehouse entry or rights and interests card generation is realized. The invention supports a two-dimensional contribution value system and a plurality of flexible allocation strategies, adopts Redis cache and parallel computing technology to improve the processing efficiency, and can meet the accurate rights and interests allocation requirements under complex scenes such as government affair service, community management and the like.
assignees: QINGDAO BLUEPRINT THINK TANK INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: User participation auxiliary service sharing method, system, equipment and medium based on dynamic analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sharing and sharing method, a system, equipment and a medium for user participation auxiliary service based on dynamic analysis, which relate to the technical field of electric auxiliary service and comprise the steps of establishing an auxiliary service benefit quantization model of user participation, and quantizing the benefit degree obtained by each user due to participation in the auxiliary service; the method comprises the steps of determining corresponding cost sharing proportion based on the total benefit of users, calculating sharing amount of each user by combining supply cost, operation cost and risk cost of auxiliary service, setting step-type excitation coefficients and influence factors according to the sharing amount, participation frequency and response quality of each user, calculating final excitation amount of the user, establishing a dynamic adjustment and constraint model of mechanism operation, and periodically adjusting each parameter and factor. According to the invention, the user benefit is used as a calculation basis of cost sharing, the participation behavior quality is brought into incentive adjustment, the fairness of auxiliary service cost distribution is improved, and the enthusiasm of user participation and the flexibility of operation are enhanced.

title_en: Multi-agent asynchronous coordination method and system under centralized architecture
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-agent asynchronous coordination method and system under a centralized architecture, which are suitable for task scheduling and resource coordination of heterogeneous agents in an intelligent Internet of things environment. According to the method, a centralized control mechanism of a main dispatching node is adopted, a dispatching priority function is calculated according to real-time state information of a plurality of heterogeneous intelligent agents by combining a multi-intelligent-agent game model, and asynchronous allocation and feedback control of tasks are realized. Meanwhile, an asynchronous synchronous window mechanism is introduced, the scheduling continuity and the scheduling efficiency can be kept under the condition of incomplete information, and the fairness and the robustness of task allocation are realized through intelligent feedback delay modeling and revenue function design. The invention improves the throughput and response speed of the system, gives consideration to isomerism and expandability, and is suitable for multi-agent cooperation scenes such as disaster emergency, industrial manufacturing, intelligent home, intelligent traffic and the like.

title_en: Space domain allocation method and device based on block chain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a block chain-based airspace allocation method and device, relates to the technical field of airspace management, and mainly aims to improve the fairness and efficiency of airspace allocation and the utilization rate of airspace resources by using a block chain technology. The main technical scheme comprises: establishing a space domain allocation union block chain, and constructing a corresponding block structure; expressing the spatial domain usage plan by spatial domain rasterization coding; determining whether conflicts occur with the spatial positions and the use times of other spatial domains according to the spatial positions and the use times of the spatial domain use plans in the spatial domain scheme; if no conflict exists, reserving the space domain scheme; if the conflict exists, adjusting an airspace use plan according to a preset algorithm, and selecting an optimal airspace scheme by taking a preset airspace evaluation standard as a consensus algorithm; and issuing a final airspace scheme for executing approval in an intelligent contract mode, and finishing accounting and block packing on the determined final airspace scheme to finish chain growth. The method can be applied to the static and dynamic airspace allocation process.

title_en: Community material vehicle path optimization method based on improved lion group algorithm under epidemic situation
abstract_en: The invention provides a community material vehicle path optimization method under epidemic situation based on improved lion group algorithm, firstly establishing a path planning mathematical model and initializing algorithm parameters; a sequential encoding, ordering the individuals using a pareto non-dominant ordering mechanism and individual crowding distance; detecting whether an external enemy invades; using a lion group passage operator and the trial times to update the position of the lion group; optimizing a workload balancing goal by using a balancing operator; updating the best position, and re-determining the identity of the lion group individuals; and repeating until the iteration times are reached, and recording the historical optimal individual of the lion group. According to the method, a position updating strategy of an original lion group algorithm is improved, lion group position updating is achieved by using lion group passage operators and trial times, a balancing operator is used for optimizing a work load balancing target, and the problem that the existing vehicle path optimization method cannot meet the requirement of optimizing vehicle paths in community material transportation under epidemic conditions, so that the fairness of work load is guaranteed, and the high efficiency is guaranteed.

title_en: Air film emergency type refrigeration house
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of emergency rescue equipment and discloses an air film emergency type refrigeration house which comprises an air film main body, a refrigerating unit and an air compressor, wherein a heat preservation mechanism is arranged in the air film main body, a protection mechanism is arranged at the front end of the air film main body, two air inlets are formed in the front end of the refrigerating unit, a universal distribution box is arranged outside the refrigerating unit, an epidemic prevention mechanism is arranged outside the air inlets, the heat preservation mechanism comprises a protective layer, the outside of the protective layer is fixedly connected to the top side of the inside of the air film main body, and a heat insulation layer is fixedly connected to the bottom of the protective layer. According to the invention, the air film main body adopts an inflatable structure, so that the air film inflation construction can be completed in a short time, the double-layer door curtain and the sealing rubber strip combined with the bin opening are quickly opened and closed through the magic tape, and the sealing rubber strip is overlapped and extruded to block air flow during closing, thereby effectively reducing cold energy loss and meeting the quick refrigeration requirement of disaster relief materials.
assignees: SHENZHEN JUNJIA MECH AND ELECTRICAL EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic education resource distribution system and method based on multi-target game
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of education, and discloses a dynamic education resource distribution system and method based on multi-target game, wherein the system comprises a data acquisition module, a multi-target game model module, a dynamic weight adjustment module, a resource distribution decision engine and a real-time feedback and optimization module, the data acquisition module is used for acquiring real-time education demand data and user behavior data, the real-time education demand data covers education resource supply and demand dynamic change information, the user behavior data comprises resource use states and education effect feedback information, and the multi-target game model module is used for constructing a game model of a multi-party participant. By constructing the multi-objective game model and the dynamic weight adjustment mechanism, the inherent contradiction between fairness and efficiency in educational resource allocation is effectively solved. The multi-objective game model takes the minimum of the coefficient of the foundation, the maximum of the resource utilization rate and the minimum of financial investment as core objectives, and ensures the strategy stability by combining with Nash equilibrium theory.

title_en: blockchain-based open-type data processing system of electrical construction for electric vehicle charging equipments which enables privacy protection
title_ko: 개인정보 보호 가능한 블록체인 기반의 개방형 전기차 충전설비 전기공사 데이터 처리 시스템
abstract_en: A purpose of the present invention is to provide a system that openly processes data related to a series of electric vehicle charging facility installation electrical work processes based on blockchain. The open electric vehicle charging facility electrical work data processing system based on blockchain that can protect personal information is to openly process various data generated during a series of electric vehicle charging facility installation electrical work processes in a blockchain-based manner by cooperating with an electric supplier server (300) that operates an electric supplier portal, a distributed ID issuance server (410) that issues a digital ID, a distributed ID, and a distributed ID verification server (420) that verifies the distributed ID. The system includes a use application processing unit (100), a license company processing unit (210), a construction company processing unit (220), and a record analysis server (600). According to the present invention, transparency and fairness in the electrical work process can be guaranteed and responsibility can be clearly determined in the event of a failure after the completion of construction, and accordingly, there is an advantage of being able to induce proper construction of electric vehicle charging facilities.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 전기차 충전설비 전기공사 신청, 전기공사 접수, 시공사업자 선정, 전기공사 수행으로 이루어지는 일련의 전기차 충전설비 설치용 전기공사 과정에 관련된 데이터를 블록체인 기반으로 개방형으로 처리하는 시스템에 관한 것이다. 특히, 본 발명은 전기차 충전설비 설치용 전기공사 신청자들(예: 아파트 입주민들)에 대한 개인정보를 일련의 전기공사 과정에서 적절하게 보호할 수 있는 블록체인 기반의 개방형 전기공사 정보처리 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에 따르면 전기차 충전설비 전기공사의 관리 전반을 디지털 방식으로 전환하여 전기공사에 관련된 데이터를 개방형으로 처리하고 시공관련 데이터를 명확하게 보존할 수 있어 전기공사 과정에 대한 투명성과 공정성을 보장할 수 있고 공사완료 이후에 장애 발생시에 책임소재를 분명히 가릴 수 있으며, 그에 따라 전기차 충전설비의 적정 시공을 유인할 수 있는 장점이 있다. 또한, 본 발명에 따르면 전기차 충전설비 신청 과정에서 제출된 신청자들의 개인정보를 시공사업자들이 임의로 접근할 수 없도록 통제함으로써 개인정보의 철저한 보호를 보장할 수 있는 장점이 있다.
assignees: HANSHIN UNIV INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION;SUNGJIN MAT CO LTD

title_en: Method for transparent and fair resource distribution
abstract_en: A computer-implemented system for allocation of a series of picks amongst multiple selectors in a selection process is configured to use total picks data, number of selectors data, and picks per selector data to determine a series of benchmark pick slots for each selector in accordance with a benchmark, for each selector, calculating a pick cost for awarding a pick position to the selector, awarding said pick position to the selector for whom the pick cost would least deviate the system from the benchmark and storing said pick cost of awarding said pick, and then iterating through the remainder of the draft using pick cost to determine who picks next, ensuring maximum fairness in the pick order. The system also manages the draft itself once the pick order is determined. It can assign value to the items chosen. It awards, or deducts, points from participants based upon their receiving picks that are better or worse than they should have, and for the quality of the items they have chosen.

title_en: A kind of Intelligent examining evaluation management method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of Intelligent examining evaluation management method, comprise the following steps：S1, according to examination parameter user is examined in very first time region, and draw first result of appraisal；S2, second result of appraisal in the second time zone are drawn with reference to first result of appraisal；S3, with reference to second result of appraisal draw the 3rd result of appraisal in the 3rd time zone；S4, with reference to first result of appraisal, second result of appraisal, the 3rd result of appraisal formulate user's evaluation result.The present invention improves the specific aim of examination, it is to avoid the unfairness examined during special circumstances to user occur；The validity and fairness of the result of appraisal are improved by specification wire examination method, be conducive to improving the work incentive of user, drive the job enthusiasm of user, optimize the working attitude of user, so as to accelerate the benign Ordered and Healthy of enterprises and institutions to develop, the interests and rights of user have also further been ensured.
assignees: ANHUI QIAN TONG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium for dividing distribution area
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for dividing a distribution area, which can be applied to the technical field of logistics. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring an interest surface set in a target area; carrying out distribution area division on the interest surface set according to the preset division quantity, and generating an initial distribution division scheme; taking the initial distribution dividing scheme as a current dividing scheme, and carrying out local search based on the current dividing scheme to generate a candidate dividing scheme to obtain a candidate dividing scheme set; determining fairness coefficients corresponding to the candidate division schemes according to the distribution parameter information aiming at each candidate division scheme in the candidate division scheme set; determining a target distribution division scheme from the candidate division scheme set according to the fairness coefficient; the target distribution division scheme is used as a current division scheme to iteratively perform local search; and outputting a final distribution area dividing scheme when the local search is determined to meet the search ending condition.
assignees: BEIJING JINGDONG QIANSHI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Dispatching method and system for LNG liquid-state export vehicles
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of storage, loading or distribution, in particular to transportation. The method comprises the steps of obtaining and monitoring a tank car dispatching state of each flow node, obtaining a tank car dispatching stage statistics according to the tank car dispatching state and the operation state, calculating a low value coefficient of the number of waiting tank cars, building a dispatching model, and dispatching the tank cars according to the dispatching model. The system comprises a main control module, a data acquisition module, a supervision module, a communication module and a current device, wherein the main control module receives data and determines a scheduling instruction through a scheduling model, the data acquisition module acquires real-time data from the device and the communication module, the supervision module receives the scheduling instruction and confirms whether the scheduling instruction is fed back to the communication module, and the communication module receives and feeds back reservation information of an external tank car and sends the scheduling instruction to the current device. The scheduling method and the scheduling system for the LNG liquid state export vehicles solve the problems of low execution efficiency and difficulty in operation continuity in the prior art, and achieve the purposes of ensuring scheduling fairness, being strong in adaptability and keeping operation continuity.

title_en: Medical resource allocation fairness analysis method based on multi-source big data and regression model
abstract_en: The invention provides a medical resource allocation fairness analysis method based on multi-source big data and a regression model, which belongs to the field of medical resource allocation fairness analysis, and comprises the steps of 1, preprocessing map and medical data to obtain medical resource data related to the map data, 2, analyzing optimal grid segmentation granularity, determining optimal grid segmentation granularity by combining data statistics and actual requirements and application scenes, 3, constructing a regional population prediction model based on the multi-source data and an MLP-RF model, predicting population data of grids by the regional population prediction model, and 4, constructing a medical resource assessment model, and obtaining medical resource indexes of different grids by the assessment model.

title_en: Particle swarm optimization-based real-time load gap allocation optimization method
abstract_en: The invention provides an optimization method for real-time load gap distribution based on a particle swarm algorithm, which belongs to the technical field of power system operation and control, and specifically comprises the following steps of 1, constructing an adaptability function for fusing economic influence and environmental benefit; and step 2, setting constraint conditions comprising total load notch constraint and a single enterprise safety load interval, and step 3, adopting a particle swarm optimization algorithm to solve the minimum value of the fitness function and outputting an optimal load distribution scheme. According to the invention, the load gap is scientifically distributed through the quantitative index, so that the communication cost is reduced, and the efficiency, fairness and environmental benefit of load management are improved. The method is used for enterprise elastic load management in the power demand peak period, and scientific distribution and optimization of load gaps are realized.
assignees: CHENGDU BEITE DIGITAL ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: A system and method for budget-compliant, fair and efficient manpower management
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method and system for budget-compliant, fair and efficient manpower management primarily for service industries to improve customer service, save costs, improve employee morale and productivity. More particularly the present invention relates to a system and method enabling labour planners and schedulers to rapidly develop a budget-compliant, fair, effective, easy to use and manageable and deployable manpower schedule to optimize and increase effective manpower productivity. Further the system and method of the present invention generates manpower plans and schedules suitable for deployment, on the basis of two novel criteria's a) compliance of allocations to planned labour budgets while also being driven by business forecasts and b) using several fairness" criteria so that the desirable and undesirable features of the schedules are equitably dispersed. Further, the invention provides a system which can be deployed with several optional hardware and network architecture and configuration.
assignees: TATA CONSULTANCY SERVICES LTD;SENGUPTA SIDDHARTHA;SALSINGIKAR SHRIPAD;BOSE SOUMEN;GANESAN VISWANATH

title_en: Demand response method based on residential user clustering in smart power grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a demand response method based on residential user clustering in a smart power grid, which comprises the following steps: collecting historical electricity data of residential users; establishing an electric appliance model of the user through the collected data; establishing a characteristic model of the user through the collected data; classifying residential subscribers into several categories using a clustering algorithm through the collected data; the total cost is calculated giving different satisfaction, fairness and total cost coefficients for different types of users. The invention considers the important factors such as the electric appliance energy consumption mode, the electric power cost, the user satisfaction, the fairness, the energy consumption habit and the like of the residential users, extracts new characteristics from the electricity consumption history data of the residential users to describe the characteristics of the users, explores the electricity consumption habit of the users by applying a clustering method, further uses the information to schedule the electricity consumption behaviors of the residential users in a more flexible and effective way, and reduces the expenditure of a power grid system and the power peak-to-average ratio of the power grid.

title_en: Community material vehicle path optimization method under epidemic situation based on improved lion algorithm
abstract_en: The invention provides a community material vehicle path optimization method under epidemic situation based on improved lion algorithm, firstly establishing a path planning mathematical model and initializing algorithm parameters; sequential encoding, ordering individuals using a pareto non-dominant ordering mechanism and individual crowding distances; detecting whether an external enemy invades; realizing lion group position update by using a lion group passage operator and the number of attempts; optimizing a workload balancing target using a balancing operator; updating the optimal position and redefining the identity of the lion individuals; repeating until the iteration times are reached, and recording the historic optimal individuals of the lion group. According to the invention, the position updating strategy of the original lion group algorithm is improved, the lion group passage operator and the try times are used for realizing the position updating of the lion group, and the balancing operator is used for optimizing the work load balancing target, so that the problem that the existing vehicle path optimizing method cannot meet the requirement that the optimization of the vehicle path in the community material transportation under epidemic situation ensures the fairness of the workload and the high efficiency is solved.

title_en: Energy internet bidirectional auction optimization regulation and control method based on multi-time-slot network flow
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of energy Internet optimization, in particular to an energy Internet bidirectional auction optimization regulation method based on multi-time-slot network flow, which comprises the steps of obtaining market member declaration information and power distribution network related information, and establishing a target optimization function based on maximized social benefit; the method comprises the steps of converting an optimization problem into a minimum cost maximum flow problem, constructing a network flow model of the minimum cost maximum flow problem, solving the minimum cost maximum flow problem to carry out market clearing, obtaining one-to-one matched achievement of electricity purchasing and selling parties, dynamically describing a market balancing process more clearly and transparently, introducing a decrement transaction mechanism to ensure excitation compatibility of the mechanism, eliminating invalid achievement on the basis of market marginal price, and calculating to obtain full-cost electricity price on the basis of the market marginal price and the distribution cost between the achievement. And finally, the energy internet bidirectional auction optimization regulation method which takes benefit and fairness into consideration is formed.

title_en: Building site resource integration and distribution system
