abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of resource allocation, in particular to a building site resource integration and allocation system, which comprises: the resource contribution evaluation module collects equipment use time and material consumption of a plurality of contractors based on the equipment scheduling data and the material flow records, calculates current resource contribution degree by comparing historical data of the plurality of contractors, calculates a shape value according to the contribution degree of each contractor, and generates a resource allocation reference. According to the invention, the resource contribution is dynamically evaluated by using the equipment scheduling data and the material flow records, the transparency and the accuracy of resource allocation are improved, based on the analysis of real-time and historical data, the system can effectively identify and reward contractors for high-efficiency resource use, the allocation fairness is enhanced, the resource allocation responds to the project progress change by real-time monitoring and dynamic adjustment, the targeted adjustment suggestion is provided by collecting the resource use efficiency and the project progress data, the accuracy of decision support is enhanced, and the cost caused by resource mismatching is reduced.

title_en: Subway train running chart and demand management collaborative optimization method in reservation trip mode
abstract_en: The invention provides a subway train running chart and demand management collaborative optimization method under a reservation travel mode, which comprises the steps of obtaining subway line data and passenger flow data, establishing decision variables, constructing constraint conditions according to fairness between the number of passengers served by a train at each station and the number of waiting passengers and the coupling relationship between the capacity and the traffic volume of the train according to the coupling relationship between reserved passengers and unreserved passengers in a subway system, constructing an initial subway train running chart and demand management collaborative optimization nonlinear programming model by combining the subway line data, the passenger flow data, the decision variables and the constraint conditions, equivalently converting the nonlinear programming model into a linear form according to large M constraint to obtain a demand management collaborative optimization linear programming model, and solving by designing a solving algorithm according to mathematical characteristics of the linear programming model until a standard subway train running chart, a reservation name allocation scheme and a passenger flow control scheme are obtained. The method of the invention improves the service efficiency and reduces the operation cost.

title_en: Multi-main-body operator benefit distribution optimization strategy based on cooperative game
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-main-body operator benefit distribution optimization strategy based on cooperative game, and relates to the technical field of micro-energy network park energy distribution. The strategy comprises the steps of constructing IEO, EVA, ACA three-party main body cooperation models, defining objective functions and cooperation constraints of the main bodies, building an improved Shapley value double-weight distribution mechanism based on marginal cost and carbon emission reduction contribution degree, quantifying carbon emission reduction contribution weight through primary distribution and secondary distribution, providing an internal user side commitment-performance secondary distribution model of an aggregator, and realizing reasonable profit distribution by combining a power window, key time period weight and jitter penalty. The method solves the problems of multi-main-body game differentiation, difficulty in quantification of weight distribution and imperfect internal secondary distribution of the micro-energy network park, improves the renewable energy consumption rate and the system flexibility, realizes the unification of distribution fairness, alliance stability and scheduling feasibility, and is suitable for a multi-main-body energy collaborative cooperation scene of the park.

title_en: Multi-path multi-target emergency material distribution path selection method based on SHADE algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a differential evolution (SHADE) algorithm based on success history adaptive parameters, which is used for searching emergency rescue paths of emergency supplies and mainly comprises the following steps: by learning the cross rate and the variation rate of successful individuals in the differential evolution algorithm, the method can find a more superior path. In order to search more equivalent emergency material rescue scheduling paths, the fitness sharing mechanism is simultaneously used in a target space and a decision space to ensure the diversity of the paths, provide various feasible paths for a user to select, and avoid the condition that a single path cannot pass due to some sudden reason. The invention not only can search the optimal emergency goods and materials rescue scheduling path meeting the target condition, but also can provide a plurality of equivalent paths, thereby providing guarantee for sending emergency goods and materials to the destination for rescue at the first time.

title_en: New energy automobile charging station monitored control system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent charging network management and new energy automobile support systems, in particular to a new energy automobile charging station monitoring system. In the invention, the energy management module adopting the convolutional neural network and the long-term and short-term memory network improves the power demand and the power grid load prediction accuracy and improves the energy utilization rate. The safety early warning module combines a support vector machine, a decision tree and an isolated forest algorithm, so that the system safety is improved. In the aspect of pricing optimization, charging prices are adjusted according to power grid loads and user demands by using an ARIMA model and a Q learning algorithm, so that fairness and market response are improved. The charging scheduling module improves and adopts linear programming and genetic algorithm, and charging efficiency is improved. The data acquisition and processing analysis module is upgraded to provide comprehensive and accurate monitoring data.

title_en: A kind of ternary chain type enterprise increment assessment management platform based on block chain technology
abstract_en: The present invention relates to block chain technical fields, disclose a kind of ternary chain type enterprise increment assessment management platform based on block chain technology.It creates through the invention, it can provide a kind of distributed general ledger system record increment assessment related data by block chain, and the management platform of investor Yu business transaction equity are protected using its characteristic that can not be distorted, (member is on the one hand thrown by introducing enterprise's increment assessment ternary, enterprise's member and increasing member) chain method, tunable investor, the investment and assessment behavior of enterprise and third party appraisal agency during Venture Capital, rationally quantify value caused by each process, on the other hand by using the credible of block chain and characteristic can not be distorted, it can be in investor, believable enterprise valuation is provided in enterprise and this tripartite of third party appraisal agency, ensure that transaction record is safe and reliable.

title_en: A kind of boat-carrying UAV Communication Channel cut-in method
abstract_en: The invention proposes a kind of boat-carrying UAV Communication Channel cut-in methods, and this method comprises the following steps: (1) unmanned plane is synchronized by synchronous-reply-broadcast with boat-carrying base station and obtains full mesh topology；(2) by considering the self-adapting time slot allocation algorithm of network throughput, time delay and node fairness, guarantee the load balancing and real-time of data transfer phase network；(3) in such a way that node relays, increase the area coverage of network；(4) new node is arranged to enter network by random access time slot；The present invention takes full advantage of boat-carrying UAV Communication Channel and time resource, meets the communication requirement that the search and rescue of boat-carrying unmanned plane sea and scientific investigation etc. are observed on a large scale.

title_en: Method for realizing high bandwidth under condition of multi-tenant solid-state disk performance isolation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for realizing high bandwidth under the condition of multi-tenant solid-state disk performance isolation, which adopts a local garbage recovery mode in a multi-tenant solid-state disk, allocates bandwidth budget for each tenant, adopts a request scheduling method of polling scheduling, and periodically adjusts the bandwidth budget allocation according to the actual bandwidth ratio of the tenant to ensure the performance isolation so as to realize bandwidth fairness; the distribution of the reserved space resources is adjusted according to the demand degree of each tenant for the reserved space resources periodically to improve the bandwidth performance, and meanwhile, the damage of the dynamic adjustment of the reserved space to the performance isolation effect is avoided by controlling the garbage recovery rate and the write mapping rate of the adjusted blocks in the process of adjusting the reserved space. The invention can not only ensure the performance isolation effect among tenants, but also reduce the bandwidth loss caused by the performance isolation and realize high bandwidth performance in the multi-tenant solid-state disk.

title_en: Warehouse picking operation double-layer optimization method considering dynamic order constraints
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double-layer optimization method for warehouse picking operation considering dynamic order constraint, belonging to the field of logistics promotion, and the optimization method comprises the following steps: digitizing the warehouse layout, and performing the step two: establishing an order batch optimization model taking fairness passing through the least picking channel and the highest service desk as an upper-layer optimization target: step three, establishing an employee picking operation optimization model taking the shortest total picking time as a lower-layer optimization target; the method comprises the following steps: and optimizing the models in the second step and the third step. Aiming at the operation requirements of a certain logistics enterprise, the problems of order distribution and goods picking paths are researched, a double-layer optimization model with the minimum total goods shelf number, the maximum service counter fairness as an upper-layer optimization target and the shortest total goods picking time as a lower-layer optimization target is constructed, actual operation constraints including warehouse physical layout, personnel and auxiliary tool capacity constraints and the like are comprehensively considered, and the model has higher practicability compared with the model constructed in the traditional model.

title_en: Quality inspection plan scheduling method and tool
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quality inspection plan scheduling method and tool, and relates to the technical field of quality inspection management. In order to ensure the whole-course selective examination separation in the quality inspection process and the objective fairness in the inspection process, the plan scheduling method adopts the following technical scheme: classification and extraction of quality inspection personnel are realized through a resource pool, personnel scheduling is performed on a quality inspection plan, symmetric and asymmetric encryption based on generated samples is realized, and the scheduling, inspection, encryption and decryption processes of the whole quality inspection plan are realized by taking two-dimensional codes as carriers. The planning and scheduling tool executes the method through a marking module, a random sampling module, a grouping marking module, a sequence issuing module, a correlation making module, a grouping processing module, a two-dimension code generating module, a scanning decryption module, a decryption processing module, a cyclic execution module and a result output module. The invention can realize the physical and data dual isolation of sampling personnel and quality inspection personnel, reduce the possibility of falsification of quality and improve the quality inspection reliability.
assignees: SHANDONG INSPUR DIGITAL BUSINESS TECH CO LTD

title_en: Load shedding method based on Newton-Laportson optimization algorithm
abstract_en: The invention provides a load shedding method based on a Newton-Laportson optimization algorithm, which comprises the following steps of S1: based on load data of the load which can be cut in the power grid system, industry type cost parameters and compensation coefficients in a power grid user interruptible protocol, generating economic cost of each load which can be cut; s2: generating a fairness penalty function based on cut-off frequency data of the cut-off load in the power grid system, and adding the fairness penalty function into the economic cost to form an objective function; s3: respectively constructing a load shedding accuracy constraint condition, a load shedding amount constraint condition and a load importance degree constraint condition; s4: and solving an optimal load shedding strategy under the execution of the Newton-Laporton optimization algorithm according to the objective function of the economic cost and fairness and the constraint condition of the objective function. When the load shedding objective function is established, the fairness penalty function is generated based on the cut times data of the load which can be cut in the power grid system, and is added into the load shedding economic cost to form the objective function, so that the design of the load shedding method is more reasonable.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD INFORMATION & COMMUNICATION BRANCH

title_en: Rail saturation passenger flow control method based on multi-agent reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rail saturation passenger flow control method based on multi-agent reinforcement learning, which comprises the following steps: constructing a rail transit passenger flow control environment according to the dynamic characteristic description of three parts of a station hall, a station platform and a train; constructing a distributed multi-agent reinforcement learning passenger flow control framework considering global information and local information; acquiring station passenger flow data, inputting the station passenger flow data into the rail transit passenger flow control environment, interacting with the rail transit passenger flow control environment through multi-agent reinforcement learning, collecting data and training, and finally obtaining a multi-line collaborative passenger flow control model; and based on the multi-line cooperative passenger flow control model, making an optimal control decision according to the current passenger flow condition and state so as to realize the saturated passenger flow control of the rail transit system. The method is beneficial to improving the safety and fairness of the rail transit system while improving the operation efficiency.

title_en: Task allocation management method based on big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a task allocation management method based on big data, which relates to the technical field of enterprise management and comprises the following steps of automatically collecting and enqueuing tasks, automatically capturing and arranging inspection tasks to be allocated by a system, orderly putting the arranged tasks into a message queue, arranging departments and personnel information in real time and a system personnel database according to priority and types, calculating allocation ratio calculated by an allocation ratio system of each department according to the synchronous data, combining task characteristics, automatically allocating the tasks to staff of the corresponding department, optimally allocating the allocated tasks according to the current task quantity of the staff, and pushing the allocated tasks to the staff of the corresponding department through a system automation means. The invention can comprehensively consider multidimensional factors such as the number of departments, the work load of the departments and the like, automatically calculate and optimize the allocation of the inspection tasks, realize the maximization of the rationality and fairness of the allocation of the tasks, and simultaneously improve the overall work efficiency.
assignees: BEIJING ZHENGCHEN TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Demand management of material requirements planning
abstract_en: Systems and methods are directed toward managing demand, such as for manufacturing in complex supply and/or demand driven environments, including aerospace-industry products and systems, environments with a multitude of stakeholders, and other sophisticated organizations. A production request may be provided with a component identifier for a top-level module component to be produced. Data associated with the component identifier may be determined. The data may include one or more additional component identifiers for sub-components which are to be consumed to produce the top-level module component. Supply allocations for the top-level module component and the sub-components may be generated based at least in part on the data. One or more action signals may be provided to fulfill the production request for the top-level module component according to the supply allocations.

title_en: Connection plan design method for enhancing autonomous navigation capability of satellite system
abstract_en: A connection plan design method for enhancing autonomous navigation capacity of a satellite system obtains a visual matrix according to ephemeris calculation; each satellite node calculates to obtain a connection plan output by adopting a fairness connection plan algorithm according to the visual matrix; and on the basis of time synchronization, each node simultaneously executes link scheduling at the starting moment of the connection plan design period according to the connection plan design result. For each link scheduling period, the connection plan design process is done on-board and independent of the ground station: 1) Each satellite node in the satellite network acquires unified full-network latest ephemeris through information interaction with other satellite nodes, and obtains a visual matrix, namely input of a connection plan design, according to ephemeris calculation; 2) Each node pair in the satellite network adopts a deterministic connection plan design algorithm for input and calculates on the satellite to obtain the same connection plan design output; 3) And on the basis of time synchronization, each satellite node in the satellite network respectively executes link scheduling at the starting moment of the connection plan design period according to the connection plan design result.

title_en: A kind of fire fighting equipment has the unmanned plane of search and rescue function
abstract_en: There is the unmanned plane for searching and rescuing function the invention discloses a kind of fire fighting equipment, including fuselage, support rod has been bolted in the both ends outer wall of the fuselage two sides, and the first rotary electric machine has been bolted in the side outer wall that is located remotely from each other of four support rod bottoms, the output shaft of four first rotary electric machines is bolted the first rotation axis being vertically arranged, and the peripheral top outer wall of four the first rotation axis is bolted that there are four the flabellums of annular array distribution.A kind of fire fighting equipment proposed by the present invention has the unmanned plane for searching and rescuing function, by being provided with drawer, the relief supplies such as wet towel can be set in the inside of drawer, the inside for transporting flue gas to by unmanned plane, gives the personnel in smog, and the difficult member of end-on realizes rescue, simultaneously, the inner end of drawer is provided with second spring, effectively can avoid drawer in fuselage, realizes the effect of very convenient and fast pull drawer.

title_en: Multi-agent cooperative resource allocation method considering fairness principle
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-agent cooperative resource allocation method considering fairness principle, relating to the technical field of multi-agent cooperation, comprising the following steps: each agent takes the observed value and fairness reward of the unmanned aerial vehicle as the input of the Actor network; the Actor network takes the state and fairness reward at the time t as input, outputs the action at the current time, and utilizes the current state and action to estimate the Q value; calculating a strategy loss function according to the estimated Q value and the actual Q value to train the Critic network, and outputting a fair action set of the intelligent agent by using the maximum Q value as the feedback of the Actor network; judging whether the actions in the fair action set meet fairness or not by using the kini coefficient; and orderly charging is carried out by utilizing the training fairness strategy according to different states of the unmanned aerial vehicle. The invention ensures fair competition among the agents and improves the cooperative ability of the multi-agent system; strengthen unmanned aerial vehicle's duration, improve work efficiency.

title_en: Sampling investigation method and system considering member distribution balance of power market
abstract_en: The sampling investigation method and the system consider the distribution equilibrium of the members in the power market, and select the information reflecting the distribution of the members in the power market, including power consumption information, distribution coordinates and regional information; calculating a corresponding quantitative balance index based on the information to obtain a distance sum; and screening to obtain a sampling survey result considering the member distribution balance of the power market by adopting a mode of combining distance sum and a penalty function. The method has more stable effect on maintaining region fairness and transaction electricity quantity fairness, so that the obtained questionnaire has more typicality, can fully reflect the overall situation of the electric power market, and can modify the weight parameters according to the requirements to obtain more targeted results.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER TRADING CENTER CO LTD

title_en: Distributed carbon transaction market consensus method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a distributed carbon trade market consensus method, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps that a node is established, the node comprises a common node and a common node, the common node is used for processing a transaction proposal, checking enterprise qualification and data authenticity, and the common node is used for data submission and data synchronization; starting a consensus algorithm based on the nodes, wherein the consensus algorithm distributes identities for the consensus nodes, and comprises a transaction center, candidate nodes and common consensus nodes; the method comprises the steps that a transaction proposal is created by a common node and sent to a transaction center, the transaction center forwards the transaction proposal to all the consensus nodes, all the consensus nodes audit the transaction proposal, an audit result is generated and sent back to the transaction center, and if the audit is passed, the transaction proposal is broadcasted; and carrying out carbon transaction based on the transaction proposal after the verification, and completing carbon integral management of both transaction parties. The invention can effectively ensure the issuing of the carbon quota, the fairness of the transaction and the safety of the transaction data, and accurately identify and shield the nodes and the clients which try to tamper with the transaction information.

title_en: Steel management system and method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of storage information management and particularly relates to a steel management system and method. The steel management system comprises a steel management server, a label printer, a communication control module and a volume detection module, wherein the label printer is connected with the steel management server through a serial connecting line, and the communication control module is connected with the steel management server through a serial port connecting line. The volume detection module is connected with the communication control module through a serial port connecting line, and is used for performing scanning detection to acquire storage situations of steel in a storage yard and transmitting the storage information to the steel management server through the communication control module. Delivering and carrying of steel can be achieved accurately as required in a real-time mode, so that the system and method has significance in production efficiency improvement, cost reduction, optimization of supply allocation, displacement and storage, and guarantee of ship delivery.

title_en: State grid geographic information system (GIS) based emergency real-time monitor system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a state grid geographic information system (GIS) based emergency real-time monitor system and method. The system comprises a digital individual soldier device module, an emergency monitor module, a GIS emergency situation module and an Ethernet switch. The digital individual soldier device module is used for collecting live videos and is connected with the Ethernet switch through the network. The emergency monitor module is used for controlling a digital individual soldier device, controlling a monitor device, and displaying the videos collected by the digital individual soldier device and the monitor device. The GIS emergency situation module is used for enabling emergency resource data to realize display of an emergency resource situation graph on a GIS map through a GIS platform so as to display emergency resource distribution and detailed information. The Ethernet switch is used for data transmission. According to the system, the real-time picture of the emergency site and emergency supplies are distributed on the GIS map so as to be showed uniformly, and a decision basis is provided for resource allocation by leaders in emergency disposal.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY EMERGENCY MAN CT

title_en: Ecological compensation method for cross-regional water source supply service
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ecological compensation method for cross-regional water source supply service, which belongs to the field of comprehensive utilization of ecological water resources and comprises the following steps: determining a target river basin for water resource supply and demand, and dividing the target river basin into n different evaluation areas according to administrative areas; calculating an ecological compensation coefficient k (i) according to the water supply E (i) and the water demand F (i) in the evaluation area i; and (3) evaluating whether the water source in the target flow area can be self-sufficient or not by using the ecological compensation coefficients k (i) of all evaluation areas in the target flow area, and formulating a system for scheduling the water source in the target flow area and an ecological compensation standard according to the self-sufficient condition. The invention can rapidly serve the quantitative analysis and implementation of the ecological compensation of the upper, middle and lower streams of the watershed, comprehensively considers multiparty factors, reduces the uncertainty and subjectivity of the ecological compensation of the area, embodies fairness and fairness, reduces the cost of water resource scheduling and utilization, and improves the economic benefit.
assignees: UNIV CHONGQING;CHONGQING INST GEOLOGY & MINERAL RESOURCES

title_en: Emergency material distribution and vehicle scheduling method considering multiple rescue points and transportation capacity limitation
abstract_en: The invention provides an emergency material distribution and vehicle scheduling method considering multiple rescue points and capacity limitation, and relates to the technical field of intelligent optimal scheduling of logistics distribution. Firstly, constructing an emergency material distribution and vehicle scheduling model considering multiple rescue points and capacity limitation, and solving the emergency material distribution and vehicle scheduling model by using the total vehicle transportation cost, weighted arrival time of various rescue materials, total rescue time and deviation minimization of the demand and arrival quantity of various rescue materials as an optimization target; secondly, adopting an improved genetic algorithm to determine the quantity of various disaster relief materials; and taking the volume and weight of the loading materials and the capacity and load constraint of the transport vehicle into consideration, determining the loading scheme of each vehicle by adopting a heuristic method. The method can obtain a scheduling scheme with less total transportation cost, shortest arrival time and minimum deviation between the demand quantity and the arrival quantity of various rescue materials.

title_en: Roof greening fairness dynamic evaluation and composite risk identification method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of roof greening, in particular to a dynamic evaluation and composite risk identification method for fairness of roof greening. And constructing greening supply strength indexes of unit structures by combining high-resolution remote sensing images with building structure data, and introducing Gini coefficients to realize quantitative analysis of multi-scale space inequality. Meanwhile, the integration GeoDetector model identifies the driving effect of the space attribute factor, combines a static-dynamic two-dimensional modeling and a three-factor composite risk identification mechanism, realizes the accurate identification of the fairness evolution trend and the vulnerability area of roof greening, is suitable for urban green infrastructure optimization and policy intervention decision support under the condition of multi-temporal data, and has wide popularization value.

title_en: System and method for marketing mix optimization for brand equity management
abstract_en: A method of marketing optimization with respect to brand lifetime management formulates a problem of brand equity maximization utilizing Markov Decision Process (MDP) thereby casting brand equity management as a long term regard optimization problem in MDP, The marketing mix is optimized by formulating the mix as actions in MDP and, utilizing historical marketing and transaction data, aspects of the MDP are estimated.

title_en: Amphibious calibration package
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of amphibious calibration package, described system includes: an activity is loaded into the casing on transport facility; One docks at the amphibious ship in above-mentioned casing; The inwall of above-mentioned casing is provided with multiple shelf.Above-mentioned shelf is placed with emergency disaster relief goods and materials and equipment, anxious disaster relief supplies and equipment are including but not limited to fuel oil conservation tank, electrical generator, registration device, communication device, medical treatment device, potable water and grain.A kind of amphibious calibration package of the present invention, has the advantageous effect that scheduling is convenient, emergency ability is strong.

title_en: Method and system for generating college entrance examination football score based on neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of sports score evaluation, in particular to a method and a system for generating a football score of a middle school examination based on a neural network, which comprises the following steps: based on the athlete's basic data and game performance data, a data envelope analysis model is used to analyze various inputs of the athlete, a random front analysis model is used to process random fluctuations in the data, an efficiency front is constructed, and an efficiency analysis result is generated. According to the invention, through the technologies of fusion data envelope analysis, complex event processing, hypothesis testing, information theory analysis, gradient elevator algorithm, neural symbol learning, ensemble learning and the like, the objectivity, timeliness and accuracy of sports score evaluation are improved. The techniques enable key events in the game to be captured in real time and rapidly update the performance data of the athlete, ensure that the scoring system can instantly reflect the actual performance of the athlete, optimize the scoring criteria by applying hypothesis testing and confidence interval estimation, and enhance the fairness of the scoring process.

title_en: Unmanned vehicle-machine collaborative scheduling method and system under post-earthquake damaged road
abstract_en: The invention provides a collaborative scheduling method and system for unmanned vehicles and unmanned aerial vehicles under a post-earthquake damaged road, which belong to the technical field of earthquake disaster rescue scheduling. And constructing a comprehensive objective function by taking the shortest total rescue time, the highest rescue material distribution fairness and the highest wounded transferring efficiency as targets. And solving the comprehensive objective function based on the road condition change, the demand data and the carrier state to obtain the rescue material transportation and wounded transportation scheme after the unmanned aerial vehicle and the aircraft are cooperated to shake. Shortens the rescue and robs the time efficiency, realizes the multi-objective collaborative operation of unmanned vehicles and unmanned aerial vehicles, and improves the material delivery efficiency in the gold rescue period.

title_en: Real-time Sharing Method of Cargo Transportation Information through Cargo Information Sharing Community centered on Cloud Hub with the Enforced Dynamic Routing and State Change Adaptability
title_ko: 강화된 동적 라우팅 기능과 상태 변화 적응성을 구비한 클라우드 허브 중심의 화물정보 공유 커뮤니티를 통한 화물 운송 정보의 실시간 공유 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a real-time sharing method of cargo transportation information through a cargo information sharing community centered on a cloud hub. More specifically, by using a cargo information sharing community centered on a cloud hub, the members of a cargo transportation system such as shippers, brokers, transportation business operators, truck drivers, and the like share cargo information in the community in real time to increase the efficiency of dispatching cargo vehicles using a location-based service and increase adaptability to a real time state change while increasing dispatch fairness. The real-time sharing method includes: a step of providing cargo information to a plurality of cargo information sharing communities through a cloud hub; a step of transmitting the logistics information to the terminals of the members belonging to the cargo information sharing communities; and a step of establishing a transportation schedule in a logistics information management server.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 클라우드 허브 중심의 화물정보 공유 커뮤니티를 통한 화물 운송 정보의 실시간 공유 방법에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 클라우드 허브를 중심으로 구성되는 화물정보 공유 커뮤니티를 활용하여 커뮤니티 내의 화물 정보 등을 화물운송체계를 구성하는 구성원이 되는 화주, 주선사업자, 운송업자, 화물차 기사 등이 실시간으로 상호 공유하여 위치기반서비스를 이용한 화물 운송 차량의 배차 효율을 향상시키고 배차 공정성을 제고하면서 실시간으로 변화되는 상태 변화에 대한 적응성을 높이도록 하는 화물정보 공유 커뮤니티를 통한 화물 운송 정보의 실시간 공유 방법으로서 강화된 동적 라우팅 기능을 구비한 방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Multi-gas-channel inflation tent
abstract_en: The utility model provides a multi-gas-channel inflation tent. The multi-gas-channel inflation tent is characterized by mainly comprising a rain-proof fabric layer, a soft gas channel inner tire and a gas pressure distribution station, wherein the rain-proof fabric layer is arranged at the outmost side, and the soft gas channel inner tire is arranged at the inner side of the rain-proof fabric layer and is connected with the gas pressure distribution station. Due to the implement of the multi-gas-channel inflation tent, the tent avoids the problem of the increase of size and weight caused by an original framework supporting mode, and can provide more disaster relief materials under the condition of limited transport capacity in the process of disaster relief.

title_en: Micro-capacitance sensor group energy amount game dispatching method based on multi-agent system
abstract_en: Micro-capacitance sensor group energy amount game dispatching method based on multi-agent system, the following steps are included: step 1, establish the more proxy topologies of microgrid group, complete the modules agencyization to each subnet, dealing Proxy aggregates device SAA and BAA is set up on subnet upper layer, completes negotiation communication process by central processing unit EMO；Step 2, new microgrid energy pricing mechanism is used based on buyer MG, proposes that priority factors to the leading role of process of exchange, are found out based on best trading strategies in buyer's MG process of exchange；Step 3, new scheduling mechanism is introduced, central processing unit EMO is after receiving all buyer MG about the strategy of energy requirement, according to the superfluous energy demand of buyer MG and priority factors, by an appropriate number of energy EA i Distribute to single buyer MG；Shared weight is determined according to self-energy total surplus amount, and the strategy of buyer MG submission is verified using Energy distribution algorithm, reduces the burden of mass communication expense, improves energy is dispatched between each subnet in microgrid group fairness and stability.

title_en: Charging pile charging load balance scheduling method
abstract_en: The application provides a charging pile charging load balance scheduling method, which comprises the following steps: a charging pile terminal subsystem initiates a charging request; and the dispatching center subsystem judges whether the charging request of the new charging pile terminal can be born according to the current load power of the administered area, if so, the charging service is carried out according to the nominal voltage value and the current value of the new charging pile terminal, and if not, the charging configuration parameters of each charging pile terminal in the administered area are adjusted according to the load balancing principle, and then the charging service is carried out on the automobile. According to the method, the budget load power in the jurisdiction is taken as constraint, and the charging configuration parameters of the charging pile terminal are dynamically scheduled and updated based on event triggering through the scheduling strategy of the remaining time fairness principle, the new priority guarantee principle and the saturation yielding principle, so that the purpose of maximum intelligent use of the budget load power is achieved on the premise of not overloading electric energy.
assignees: DONGYING POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Hydropower station multi-target balanced scheduling method with minimum negative externality
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydropower station multi-objective balanced scheduling method with minimum negative externality, which comprises the steps of selecting a scheduling objective function according to actual scheduling requirements, and setting constraint conditions and optimization solving parameters to construct a multi-objective optimization scheduling model; solving each non-inferior solution on the pareto front of the multi-objective optimal scheduling model based on the selected solving algorithm to obtain a non-inferior solution set; and calculating the negative externality of each non-inferior solution on the pareto front by using a negative externality calculation method, and taking a scheduling scheme corresponding to the non-inferior solution with the minimum negative externality on the non-inferior solution set as an optimal balanced scheduling scheme. The advantages are that: the fairness and efficiency among the targets are effectively balanced, and other targets such as ecology and the like can be fairly considered while the running benefit of the hydropower station is improved. Compared with the prior art, the balanced scheduling method obviously improves the benefits and fairness of multi-objective scheduling.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Work order auditing method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a work order auditing method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, which relate to the technical field of computers, and the method comprises the steps of determining the work order types of a plurality of work orders to be audited; the method comprises the steps of determining the priority of each auditor for each to-be-audited worksheet based on the worksheet type, identifying audit materials in the to-be-audited worksheets for each to-be-audited worksheet, generating intelligent audit results according to identification results, and distributing the to-be-audited worksheets and associated intelligent audit results to corresponding auditors for worksheet audit according to the priority. According to the method and the system, the priorities of the work orders to be audited are determined by setting the priorities of auditors corresponding to the work orders of different work order types according to the different work order types, and in addition, the auditing materials in the work orders to be audited can be intelligently audited, so that the work orders to be audited and the intelligent auditing results are distributed to the corresponding auditors according to the priorities for the work order auditing, and the fairness and the efficiency of the auditing are ensured.

title_en: Two-stage collaborative peak shaving method and system for operator-virtual power plant
abstract_en: A two-stage collaborative peak shaving method and system for an operator-virtual power plant comprise the steps of collecting historical multi-source data and preprocessing, constructing a wind-light output fuzzy set based on the preprocessed historical multi-source data, training an LSTM (localized virtual machine) by using the historical multi-source data, performing super-parameter optimization on the LSTM by using an improved PSO (particle swarm optimization) algorithm, obtaining wind-light output predicted values by using the trained LSTM based on real-time multi-source data, constructing an operator bidding model, solving to obtain demand period quotations, report amounts and conditional risk values of each member in a VPP (virtual power plant), calculating Shapley values of each member in the VPP, calculating risk correction weights of each member in the VPP, distributing capacity of each member based on the risk correction weights, outputting collaborative decision instructions, and pushing the collaborative decision instructions to the operator and the virtual power plant execution system. The invention ensures fairness and rationality of profit allocation of operators under the condition of controllable risk under the condition of meeting optimization of objective functions of demand side response and auxiliary service bidding model.
assignees: NANJING POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Load prediction model establishment method, device, equipment and storage medium based on multi-gradient fair descent federal learning algorithm
abstract_en: The application relates to a load prediction model building method, device, equipment, storage medium and program product based on a multi-gradient fair descent federal learning algorithm, and relates to the technical field of power grids and artificial intelligence. The application can improve the accuracy, efficiency, fairness and robustness of the load prediction cooperative modeling while protecting the privacy of the load user and the ownership of data, and provides a mechanism capable of effectively regulating the balance among the fairness, the accuracy and the efficiency of the load prediction cooperative modeling. The method comprises the following steps: the central server initializes global model parameters, gradient fastest common descent direction vectors and learning rate, and in each iteration, each power distribution network operator calculates and feeds back gradient and loss values to the central server according to information sent by the central server and a local load data set, and the central server updates information such as gradient fastest common descent direction vectors and the like based on the fed-back gradient and loss values in combination with an equalization mechanism and sends the information to the power distribution network operators.

title_en: A kind of enterprise power generation completion rate harmony evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of enterprise power generation completion rate harmony evaluation method and system, the method includes：Determine that each power generation tagmeme corresponds to the power generation completion rate progression data of enterprise based on the power generation tagmeme of each enterprise, the power generation completion rate progression data for corresponding to enterprise according to each power generation tagmeme are fitted the power generation completion rate Lorentz curve of enterprise, the power generation completion rate Gini coefficient and regression criterion that enterprise is determined according to the power generation completion rate Lorentz curve of the enterprise evaluate the power generation completion rate harmony of enterprise using the power generation completion rate Gini coefficient and regression criterion of the enterprise；Technical solution provided by the invention can objective and accurately evaluation enterprise power generation completion rate it is harmonious, wherein regression criterion is introduced on the basis of traditional Gini coefficient Equity Assessment, more fully evaluation violates the degree of power generation tagmeme dispatching principle.
assignees: STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;BEIJING QU CREATIVE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-target method for efficiency and fairness in water resource distribution
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for treating multiple targets of efficiency and fairness in water resource allocation, which belongs to the field of water resource allocation, and comprises the steps of constructing fairness coefficients according to river basin information, and calculating to obtain water resource allocation fairness indexes based on the base-Ni non-purity of a classification regression tree; the method comprises the steps of calculating efficiency loss based on fairness cost to obtain a water resource allocation utilization efficiency index, setting necessary constraint conditions of water resource allocation, constructing a water resource allocation multi-objective model according to the water resource allocation fairness index and the water resource allocation utilization efficiency index and the constraint conditions of water resource allocation, converting the water resource allocation multi-objective model into a water resource allocation single-objective model according to decision maker preference information and solving the water resource allocation single-objective model to obtain an optimal water resource allocation scheme, and solving the problems that fairness and efficiency are easy to conflict, the multi-objective water resource allocation model is complex to solve and an accurate water resource allocation scheme cannot be provided in the existing water resource allocation process.

title_en: Emergency scene-oriented efficient dispatching and logistics optimization method for electric power materials
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency scene-oriented efficient dispatching and logistics optimization method for electric power materials, and belongs to the field of dispatching of electric network materials. Aiming at the material scheduling requirements of the power system under different disaster classes, a hierarchical response mechanism is provided, wherein the hierarchical response mechanism comprises three modes of single-bin quick response, multi-bin collaborative supplement and whole network centralized support. A mathematical optimization model comprising supply, transfer, demand nodes and transport paths is established, and improved optimization algorithms such as Sine mapping population initialization, differential variation disturbance, elite retention, dynamic reverse learning and the like are introduced to improve the solving efficiency and the solution diversity. The model enables full-flow optimization of supply allocation, transport paths and resource scheduling under the assumption that node locations and material demands, vehicle parameters, etc. are known. The method can effectively improve the emergency material dispatching efficiency, reduce the transportation cost and the material shortage risk, and has good practical application value.

title_en: Integrated optimization method based on urban rail transit operation ending period timetable and skip stop plan under abnormal state
abstract_en: The invention discloses an integrated optimization method based on an urban rail transit operation ending time period timetable and a skip stop plan under abnormal conditions, which comprises the steps of obtaining passenger demand data and train operation parameters in the operation ending time period; the method comprises the steps of constructing a mixed integer multi-target optimization model according to passenger demand data and train operation parameters, solving the mixed integer multi-target optimization model by adopting a multi-target whale optimization algorithm to obtain a pareto optimal solution set, and outputting the pareto optimal solution set to generate a timetable and a skip stop plan of an operation ending period. The method and the system have the advantages that the overall waiting time of passengers is obviously reduced in the operation ending period by integrating the optimized timetable and the skip stop plan, meanwhile, the number of the passengers which are not served due to skip stop is effectively reduced, the overall operation efficiency and the service fairness are improved, and multiple optimization schemes can be flexibly generated by the method, so that decision basis is provided for operation enterprises.

title_en: Order allocation method, device, medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides an order distribution method, an order distribution device, an order distribution medium and electronic equipment, wherein the order distribution method comprises the following steps: acquiring a target order of a service person to be distributed; determining historical service personnel allocated to the historical order of the user according to the information of the user contained in the target order; and distributing the target order to the history service personnel. The technical scheme of the embodiment of the invention can effectively avoid malicious competition among service personnel and is beneficial to ensuring the objectivity and fairness of order allocation.

title_en: New energy active instruction calculation method for guaranteeing spot transaction and medium and long-term electric quantity
abstract_en: The invention discloses a new energy active instruction calculation method for guaranteeing spot transactions and medium and long term electric quantity, and belongs to the technical field of operation and control of electric power systems. Aiming at the grid-connected active real-time control of a new energy station comprising complex electric quantity targets such as temporary spot transaction, basic guarantee electric quantity, medium and long term electric power transaction and the like, the invention provides that an active output instruction of the new energy station is decomposed into two stages for solving, the first stage considers comprehensive factors such as the power grid acceptance capacity, station performance indexes, sensitivity, temporary spot application quantity and the like and distributes optimal temporary spot application batch quantity for each station, when the final instruction of the station is solved in the second stage, the temporary spot transaction electric power calculated in the first stage is used as the lower limit constraint of the instruction, the medium and long term electric quantity is introduced into an objective function to complete the progress index, the temporary spot transaction electric quantity is stripped from the generated energy, the medium and long term electric quantity part is not influenced, and the fairness of market transaction is effectively guaranteed.

title_en: Fairness-oriented crowdsourcing tester recommendation method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fairness-oriented crowdsourcing tester recommendation method and device, comprising the steps of representing the requirement description of a crowdsourcing task as a descriptive term vector; predicting defect detection probability of each person to be recommended in crowdsourcing tasks according to the descriptive term vector and attribute information of the person to be recommended; setting a plurality of fairness targets including maximum defect discovery probability and minimum recommendation frequency difference, and performing multi-target optimization to obtain a crowdsourcing tester recommendation result. The method can alleviate the unfair problem and generate fairer recommendation, and the defect detection efficiency is not affected and the defect detection efficiency is improved on the basis of generating the fairer recommendation.

title_en: Equitable shift rotation and efficient assignment mechanisms for contact center agents
abstract_en: Systems and methods are provided for facilitating equitable assignment of rotating shifts to agents in a contact center. In one embodiment, points are allocated to agents indicating their frequency of receiving undesirable shift assignments. Based on the previously allocated points, future undesirable shifts are assigned to agents. The point allocation scheme accommodates various exceptions scheduling periodic rotating shifts, such as skipping assignment of an agent from an upcoming undesirable shift, agents leaving, swapping a shift, and agents being added. In another embodiments, agents are assigned to rotating shifts using constructs of a cycle and a rotation template, which facilitates assigning agents to a work schedule with a calendar in a repetitious manner, and where certain shifts are non-rotational in nature and other shifts are rotational in nature.

title_en: A kind of regional economy department water distribution equalization methods and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of regional economy department water distribution equalization methods and systems.The described method includes: obtaining each supply and demand analysis data with water main body；Region value goal function is constructed according to supply and demand analysis data；Regional water use equitable degree objective function is constructed according to supply and demand analysis data and region value goal function；Regional economy department water distribution balance optimizing model is constructed using region value goal function and regional water use equitable degree objective function；Regional economy department water distribution balance optimizing model is optimized using the non-dominated sorted genetic algorithm with elitism strategy, obtains optimal policy；The spatial of regional economy department Water Resources Allocation result is realized according to optimal policy.The present invention can water consumption between each industry of optimal coordination, realize that the use hydrologic(al) budget between every profession and trade, reasonable disposition water provide important support for water authority reasonable arrangement water plan.
assignees: YELLOW RIVER ENGINEERING CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Urban rail transit passenger flow management and control optimization method based on station entering proportion
abstract_en: The invention provides an urban rail transit passenger flow management and control optimization method based on an arrival proportion. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring urban rail transit network data, and designing a parallel linear train timetable according to the minimum departure interval of the train; according to a parallel linear train schedule and urban rail transit network data, establishing a passenger flow management and control strategy optimization model based on the station-entering proportion based on set constraint conditions and objective functions; and solving the passenger flow management and control strategy optimization model based on the station-entering proportion by adopting an approximate dynamic programming algorithm based on heuristic decomposition to obtain the station-entering amount of each train at each station under the optimal passenger flow control strategy. The invention provides an optimization method of the arrival traffic of the urban rail transit station under the condition of considering equal-proportion arrival from the perspective of fairness of passengers entering the station, and realizes the refined management and control of passenger flow under the condition of crowded peak at morning and evening.

title_en: On-line evaluation method and system for skill of practice exercises, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of computers, and particularly relates to an on-line evaluation method and system for skill of practice exercises, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring the arrangement information of the examination of an examinee; generating an electronic examination certificate and an examination certificate two-dimensional code according to the arrangement information; checking whether the identity information of the examinees is consistent or not by aligning the two-dimensional code scanning of the examination card and face recognition, and allowing the examinees to enter the examination card holding two-dimensional code if the identity information of the examinees is consistent; distributing examinee examination tasks according to the acquired attendance results of the examiners; scanning an examination admission card two-dimensional code of an examinee according to the examination task, checking the identity of the examinee and obtaining an examinee rating table; and receiving the encrypted transmission evaluation result containing the examinee key and the private key of the evaluator in real time, and generating a reduced examinee evaluation result after decryption. The invention only relies on the two-dimension code to verify the identity of the examinee in the whole examination process, ensures that nobody can tamper the data of the examinee, and avoids tampering or cheating behaviors so as to ensure the fairness and justice of the examination.

title_en: Coordinated current limiting method and system based on passenger accumulated travel cost analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coordinated current limiting method based on passenger accumulated travel cost analysis, which comprises the following steps of: passenger data and train data are collected, a passenger-train relation parameter is defined according to the passenger data and the train data, an accumulated travel cost calculation model is established according to the passenger-train relation parameter, an accumulated time index is obtained by combining the passenger-train relation parameter and the accumulated travel cost calculation model, and the accumulated travel cost of a passenger is analyzed according to the accumulated time index, so that the passenger-train travel cost analysis system has the advantages that: through the calculation of the accumulated travel cost, the influence degree of passengers is finely measured under the condition that the transport capacity is reduced or even the transport capacity is invalid, the transport capacity is inclined to a station with the really high waiting cost through the calculation of the travel cost in the rail transit system, and when the transport capacity is insufficient, the station is subjected to cooperative current limiting through the analysis of the accumulated cost of the passengers, so that the fairness of the transport capacity allocation is ensured.
assignees: NORTH CHINA INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECH NATIONAL SAFETY TRAINING CENTER OF COAL MINES

title_en: House transaction method, system, equipment and medium based on blockchain
abstract_en: The application discloses a house transaction method, a system, equipment and a medium based on a blockchain, which can be applied to the blockchain field or the financial field. The user node uploads the personal information of the user to the blockchain system; the auditing department node opens social security details according to the personal information of the user and uploads the social security details to the blockchain system; the bank node opens fund proving data according to the personal information of the user and uploads the fund proving data to the blockchain system; the intelligent contract carries out house purchasing qualification checking on the user according to the social security details and the fund proving data, and after the checking is passed, the intelligent contract distributes numbers for the user and uploads the numbers to the blockchain system; and the notarization node shakes the number through the number shaking system according to the number, and uploads the number shaking result to the blockchain system. The data are uploaded to the blockchain from each node, so that fairness of real estate transaction can be improved, the user does not need to go back to the line for processing, and convenience is brought to the user to conduct house purchase transaction.

title_en: Load prediction model establishment method, device, equipment and storage medium based on multi-gradient fair descent federal learning algorithm
abstract_en: The application relates to a load prediction model building method, device, equipment, storage medium and program product based on a multi-gradient fair descent federal learning algorithm, and relates to the technical field of power grids and artificial intelligence. The application can improve the accuracy, efficiency, fairness and robustness of the load prediction cooperative modeling while protecting the privacy of the load user and the ownership of data, and provides a mechanism capable of effectively regulating the balance among the fairness, the accuracy and the efficiency of the load prediction cooperative modeling. The method comprises the following steps: the central server initializes global model parameters, gradient fastest common descent direction vectors and learning rate, and in each iteration, each power distribution network operator calculates and feeds back gradient and loss values to the central server according to information sent by the central server and a local load data set, and the central server updates information such as gradient fastest common descent direction vectors and the like based on the fed-back gradient and loss values in combination with an equalization mechanism and sends the information to the power distribution network operators.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID ENERGY DEVELOPMENT RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: AI intelligent supervision online education system and education method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligent data analysis, in particular to an AI intelligent supervision online education system and an education method, comprising an education information acquisition module, a multi-class balance learning module, an education characteristic extraction module, an education index analysis module and an education evaluation management module; the education information acquisition module collects data in multiple channels, and acquires sample sets covering different population characteristics, so that sampling deviation is avoided, and the sample data is representative; the multi-class balance learning module divides class hierarchical relations to perform data balance processing, so that sample distribution balance is ensured; the educational feature extraction module performs feature extraction to improve the generalization capability and fairness of the system; the education index analysis module establishes a prediction model, and compares and analyzes the prediction results to improve the education quality and realize the education target. The invention is used for solving the technical problems of data analysis deviation of an online education system and intelligent supervision.

title_en: Omni-Channel Multi-Level Demand Prioritization and Allocation
abstract_en: A system and method are multi-level replenishment planning with independent channel demand prioritization that initiates production of a product by a first supply chain entity that receives orders for the product from a second supply chain entity and supplies the product to a third supply chain entity that receives orders for the product from a fourth supply chain entity. Embodiments further disclose calculating the supply of the product for the first supply chain entity for a supply allocation duration time period, receiving demand orders high priority demand orders from the fourth supply chain entity, allocating supplies within the supply allocation duration time period to firm plan arrivals based on a location priority and a demand date, and generating a shipment recommendation for each allocated supply that meets a firmed planned arrival.

title_en: Equitable resource access through adjudication of flight plan requests or other requests
abstract_en: A method includes obtaining information associated with requests to access at least one shared resource. The requests are associated with multiple requestors wishing to access or use the at least one shared resource. The method also includes generating at least one expected distribution of requests. The at least one expected distribution of requests defines one or more expected or desired characteristics of the requests. The method further includes granting one or more first ones of the requests in response to determining that the one or more first ones of the requests have the one or more expected or desired characteristics. In addition, the method includes denying or demoting one or more second ones of the requests in response to determining that the one or more second ones of the requests do not have the one or more expected or desired characteristics.

title_en: Relief Supplies Distribution System in Relief Station
title_ko: 구호소 물자 배분 시스템
abstract_en: One aspect of the present invention relates to a material distribution system of a relief center and, more specifically, to a material distribution system of a relief center, capable of properly distributing materials to each of a plurality of relief centers from a material storage center when a disaster situation occurs, and in some cases, properly distributing materials between the plurality of relief centers so that the materials are efficiently distributed. According to an embodiment of the present invention, provided is a material distribution system capable of properly distributing disaster materials from a material storage center to a relief center. In addition, according to another embodiment of the present invention, when a plurality of relief centers are installed, the system can effectively distribute the disaster materials between the relief centers. In particular, provided is a material distribution system which implements effective redistribution of victims and relief materials when a difference in risk level occurs between the relief centers depending on a disaster environment and a relief center with a high risk level is closed.
abstract_ko:
본 발명의 일 측면은 구호소의 물자 배분 시스템에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 재난 상황이 발생시 물자보관소에서 복수의 구호소 각각에 적절하게 물자 배분이 수행되고, 경우에 따라서 복수의 구호소 상호 간에 적절하게 물자 배분이 수행되어 물자의 효율적인 분배가 이루어지도록 하는 구호소의 물자 배분 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명의 일 실시예에 따르면 물자보관소에서 구호소로 재해물자 배분이 적절하게 이루어지도록 하는 물자 배분 시스템을 제공할 수 있다. 
또한, 본 발명의 다른 실시예에 따르면 복수의 구호소가 설치된 경우, 구호소 상호 간에 재해물자의 배분이 효과적으로 이루어지도록 하는 물자 배분 시스템을 제공할 수 있다. 특히, 재난환경에 따라서 분포된 구호소 간에 위험등급에 차이가 생기고, 위험등급이 높은 구호소가 폐쇄되는 경우, 이재민 및 구호물자의 효과적인 재분배를 구현하는 물자 배분 시스템을 제공할 수 있다.

title_en: Modeling distribution of emergency relief supplies for disaster response operations
abstract_en: A method and system to supply multiple items through a network of inventory staging areas and distribution points by determining inventory stocking levels for a staging area and distribution points, and inventory shipments from said staging area to distribution points and between the distribution points, using an optimization formulation whose objective is to cover maximum overall demand at the distribution points in a given period of time, and to minimize total cost of meeting demand.

title_en: Real-time frequency modulation control method and system considering frequency modulation resource balance
abstract_en: The invention provides a real-time frequency modulation control method and a system considering frequency modulation resource balance, comprising the following steps: counting the first frequency modulation response capacity difference among all the frequency modulation power supplies, and constructing a frequency modulation response balance index according to the frequency modulation response capacity difference; according to the frequency modulation response balance index, taking the frequency modulation response balance after the power generation output is maximally adjusted as an optimization target, and establishing a first frequency modulation instruction optimization model; the first frequency modulation instruction optimization scheme obtained by solving the first frequency modulation instruction optimization model is evaluated for effective frequency modulation response capacity, and the effective frequency modulation response capacity of the power grid is obtained; according to the effective frequency modulation response capacity of the power grid and the first frequency modulation requirement, when the frequency modulation safety is not met, correcting the first frequency modulation requirement; by adopting the method and the device, the fairness of the power grid frequency modulation power supply which needs to respond to the frequency modulation requirement can be improved, so that the real-time frequency modulation accuracy is improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Carbon emission quota allocation regulation and control method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of carbon emission management, in particular to a carbon emission quota allocation regulation and control method and system, comprising the following steps: first, data collection and processing: second, quota calculation benchmark setting: thirdly, quota preliminary allocation: fourth, dynamic regulation: 1) And (3) real-time monitoring: 2) Quota adjustment: fifth, quota transaction: and sixthly, feeding back and optimizing, wherein the data collection and processing module ensures the accuracy and comparability of data by collecting, cleaning and standardizing key data of each enterprise, provides a reliable basis for subsequent quota allocation, sets a quota calculation reference, considers policy targets and industry characteristics, ensures fairness and rationality of quota allocation, can perform differentiated quota allocation for different industries, and performs quota preliminary allocation based on historical data and set references, thereby avoiding blindness and subjectivity of quota allocation and facilitating fair competition among enterprises.
assignees: HUANENG SHANDONG POWER GENERATION CO LTD;SHANDONG RIZHAO POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: IT equipment time-sharing leasing service management system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of time-sharing leasing, in particular to an IT equipment time-sharing leasing business management system, the system comprises a user behavior analysis module, a market demand prediction module, a dynamic pricing module, a resource allocation optimization module, an energy efficiency management module, a danger early warning and response module, a fault diagnosis and tracing module and a flow recombination and optimization module. According to the invention, customer demands are understood through analysis, market trend is predicted through analysis, balance between resource supply and demands is guaranteed, matched sales promotion activities are formulated according to price sensitivity and market demands, flexible adjustment of realized price is realized, market change is adapted, competitive power of price strategies is enhanced, distribution of equipment in available time is adjusted, high efficiency and fairness of resource distribution are ensured, equipment energy consumption is optimized, operation cost is reduced, maximization of resource utilization is realized, diversified demands of users are met, management cost is reduced, and user satisfaction is improved.

title_en: Resource allocation method and system applied to customer management data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a resource allocation method and a system applied to customer management data, which relate to the technical field of customer management and comprise the steps of obtaining supply efficiency of various resources of all current resource supply sites to form a resource supply matrix A, calling historical demand data of each customer, predicting a resource demand predicted value of the customer based on the historical demand data of the customer, constructing a resource demand predicted matrix B of the customer, generating resource allocation conditions based on the resource supply matrix A, generating a plurality of resource allocation schemes based on the resource allocation conditions and the resource demand predicted matrix B, determining resource allocation C under each resource allocation scheme, and carrying out resource supply allocation planning of the various resources of the resource supply sites through an equilibrium allocation algorithm. The method has the advantages of remarkably improving the client data management capability and the resource utilization efficiency of enterprises, greatly optimizing the resource allocation of the enterprises and improving the operation efficiency.
assignees: NANJING YIZHUO MEIYU CULTURE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Peak shaving auxiliary service optimization decision method based on fairness index
abstract_en: The invention discloses a peak shaving auxiliary service optimization decision method based on fairness indexes, and aims to solve the problem of unfair cost allocation caused by supply and demand mismatch, insufficient flexibility, carbon emission and other multidimensional risks in a new energy power system. A new fairness index is provided for quantifying the deviation of the actual allocation amount and the theoretical allocation amount of the participants and comprehensively considering the difference of the system risk and the individual preference. And a combined weighting method is introduced, a risk weight is determined through an analytic hierarchy process and an anti-entropy weighting method, a risk weighted Shapley value cost allocation model is constructed, and dynamic adjustment of individual risk responsibility is realized. And further establishing a peak shaving auxiliary service dispatching optimization model, and optimizing a peak shaving scheme by comprehensively considering constraint conditions of system balance, standby and unit dispatching with the aim of minimizing the total cost of the system. The method effectively improves fairness and scientificity of cost allocation, and provides important technical support for efficient operation of the high-proportion access power system of new energy.
assignees: NANCHANG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH STATE GRID JIANGXI PROVINCE ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Securities fund net value trend prediction method based on time sequence deep neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a securities fund equity trend prediction method based on a time sequence deep neural network, which aims at a multi-asset history equity sequence, establishes a grouping collection, cleaning, archiving and time axis synchronization process, combines multi-dimensional dynamic feature extraction and standardization, fuses information such as morphology, periodicity, fluctuation rate, mutation points and the like into a high-dimensional feature vector, adopts unsupervised clustering to realize effective clustering of asset dynamic features, combines a local window controller and a hierarchical window coordination mechanism in the time sequence deep neural network to realize dynamic optimization of window parameters and trend signal synchronization, and outputs a multi-asset cooperative and high-timeliness trend prediction result.

title_en: Disaster control device for elevator
