abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a disaster control device for an elevator having a storage box for disaster control usable by many and unspecified passengers only in an emergency, without modifying the elevator.  <P>SOLUTION: This disaster control device for an elevator comprises: a monitoring center 4 remotely connected to a plurality of elevators through a communication line including the Internet 5 and performing communication with an interphone disposed in a car 1, notification of occurrence of abnormality of the elevator, and the monitoring of the state of the elevator; an accepting device 6 for transmitting and receiving signals to and from the monitoring center 4 through the communication line; and the storage box 2 for disaster control for storing emergency supplies used in an emergency in the car 1. The monitoring center 4 comprises: a determination means S10 for determining whether the storage box 2 for disaster control is present or not and whether an unlocking method can be notified or not according to elevator information S4, B received from the elevator side through the communication line; and a distribution means S11, C for distributing the unlocking method for the storage box 2 for disaster control to a source when the unlocking method can be notified by the determination means 10.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT
assignees: HITACHI BUILDING SYS CO LTD;KOKUYO KK

title_en: Method for constructing and verifying drainage basin water resource comprehensive simulation and configuration model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for constructing and verifying a watershed water resource comprehensive simulation and configuration model, and belongs to the technical field of water resource planning and configuration. Based on a natural-social binary water circulation structure, a flow production, confluence and allocation module are coupled, a calculation unit is divided, a topological relation is determined, a model is built by taking minimum water shortage rate and optimal water supply fairness as targets, a multi-source database containing meteorological, land utilization, reservoir and water consumption unit information is built, iteration calibration and verification are carried out on natural water circulation and social water circulation parameters by utilizing historical data, and a model with reliable verification is coupled with underlying surface and climate situation data of the planning year in the future, so that a water resource optimal allocation scheme is operated and output. The invention solves the problems of low coupling degree and poor precision of the existing model, and realizes high-precision simulation and scientific configuration of the water resource system of the flow field.

title_en: Electronic device, loan collection case division method and storage medium
abstract_en: The present invention proposes a kind of electronic device, loan collection case division method and storage medium, the described method includes: obtaining the case information to collection case, standard collection file is generated according to the case information, the standard collection file includes case essential information and overdue information；According to the case essential information, the overdue information and predefined case collection strategy execution rule, collection case, which carries out the distribution of collection queue, to be waited for this；The collection situation of the corresponding allocated collection case of each collection person in the collection queue that statistical is matched determines have collection should be to the collection person of the collection priority of collection case according to the collection situation of statistics；This is waited for that collection case is distributed to the determining collection person with collection priority.It can be improved case distributional equity, make it possible to more liberally according to the performance of the collection business evaluating collection person of each collection person.
assignees: PING AN TECH SHENZHEN CO LTD

title_en: Automatic scheduling method, device, equipment and computer storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides an automatic scheduling method, device and equipment and a computer storage medium. The automatic scheduling method comprises the following steps: receiving a shift scheduling request message; acquiring existing original data of a current shift scheduling period; generating a residual workload matrix according to the existing original data; acquiring scheduling historical data, wherein the scheduling historical data is scheduling record data in a preset time period before the moment of receiving the scheduling request message; generating a scheduling frequency transfer matrix according to the scheduling historical data; generating a scheduling weight matrix according to the residual workload matrix and the scheduling frequency transfer matrix; converting the scheduling weight matrix into a scheduling weight tree; and determining the optimal solution of the scheduling weight tree by using a backtracking algorithm, and separating out the scheduling result of the nurse in each operation room according to the optimal solution of the scheduling weight tree. The embodiment of the invention can improve the scheduling fairness and the working efficiency, and has better application effect.
assignees: QINGDAO HISENSE MEDICAL EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Power grid investment allocation decision method and system based on comprehensive evaluation of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid investment allocation decision method and a system based on comprehensive evaluation of a power distribution network, which comprises the following steps of: s1, constructing a county power distribution network comprehensive evaluation system, determining evaluation indexes, calculating the weights of the indexes, and calculating the scores of the evaluation indexes; s2, constructing a power grid investment distribution model for investment distribution; the method specifically comprises the steps of S2, under the premise that county scale, load increase, power supply capacity, economic benefits and social benefits of investment are considered, establishing a systematic power distribution network investment allocation decision model, distributing total capital of power distribution network construction and reconstruction to each county, and finally optimizing the generated power distribution network investment decision model by taking risk factors and allocation fairness as optimization targets to obtain an optimal decision model. According to the method, the investment area is evaluated, and the capital constraint condition is introduced through the optional factors of the comprehensive power grid construction level, so that the optimal combination of power grid investment projects is obtained, and decision support is provided for the investment capital allocation of the power distribution network construction.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Resource allocation method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a resource allocation method, a resource allocation device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, relates to the technical field of resource allocation, can be applied to an artificial intelligence service platform based on an artificial intelligence technology, and comprises the following steps: acquiring resource conversion data and user use data in a service platform; determining model parameters of a resource conversion distribution model according to the resource conversion data, and determining model parameters of a resource use distribution model according to the user use data; and performing target resource allocation on the content resource provider according to the resource conversion allocation model and the resource use allocation model. The method and the device can improve fairness and rationality of target resource allocation.
assignees: Baidu online network technology beijing co ltd

title_en: Driver queuing strategy method for order dispatching fairness in airport range
abstract_en: The invention provides a driver queuing strategy method for dispatching fairness in an airport range, which comprises the following steps: subscribing the track of a consumer driver, wherein the driver track information comprises the position of the driver and basic driver information; judging whether a driver queuing strategy is started in a driver service city, and if so, inquiring and starting a driver queuing city list; otherwise, the enqueue of the driver is finished; inquiring a driver list arranged in the fence according to the fence id, judging whether drivers are arranged in the fence or not, and if so, finishing the enqueue of the drivers; judging whether the driver service city opens a priority queue queuing strategy or not, if so, inquiring the order information of the pick-up machine completed by the driver within the last n minutes; and determining that the drivers queue and dequeue according to the driver enqueue record information and the order placing information. And a queuing mechanism is established according to the sequence of entering the airport fence to dispatch the order, so that the relative fairness of drivers can be guaranteed.

title_en: Distributed energy benefit automatic distribution method and system based on IOT
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic distribution method and system of distributed energy benefit based on IOT, which relates to the technical field of Internet of things and distributed energy management, comprising the steps of receiving energy data through an Internet of things communication gateway, dividing energy sub-networks according to geographic positions, unifying time references through a distributed clock synchronization protocol when executing energy transmission, and constructing an energy network topological graph, selecting an optimal mutual-aid transmission path based on the predicted energy matching degree of the long-term memory network, writing the path and the weight into an intelligent contract to automatically allocate benefits, and effectively improving the energy utilization rate and allocation fairness.
assignees: STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Material distribution method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a material distribution method and device and electronic equipment. The method comprises the steps of obtaining the types of materials to be distributed and the corresponding quantity of the materials to be distributed, determining the target step length of the materials to be distributed in the material distribution sequence based on the quantity of the materials to be distributed and the length of the material distribution sequence for any type of target materials to be distributed, distributing one target material to be distributed at the idle position of the material which is not distributed in each target step length interval from the beginning of the material distribution sequence, and carrying out material distribution in sequence based on the corresponding relation between the position in the material distribution sequence and the material after the materials to be distributed of all types are distributed in the material distribution sequence. By uniformly inserting and distributing the materials to be distributed of different types according to the length of the material distribution sequence, the centralized stacking of the materials of the same type is avoided, and the uniformity of overall distribution of the materials can be remarkably improved, so that the fairness of material distribution is improved.
assignees: WEIMENG CHUANGKE NETWORK TECH CHINA CO LTD

title_en: Printing order commission and resource allocation linkage method based on multi-channel data collaboration
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data collaborative analysis, in particular to a printing order commission and resource allocation linkage method based on multichannel data collaboration, which comprises the steps of integrating various key information of an order by constructing an order-resource map to reflect the association of the order and resources; the method comprises the steps of inputting an order-resource map into a map neural network model, extracting map embedded vectors, constructing subgraphs, excavating complex relations between orders and resources, achieving accurate initialization of bisection and resource nodes, sharing local subgraphs through distributed communication, generating a global commission resource map, achieving centralized overall planning of all channels and all resources, guaranteeing that commission and resource allocation decisions are based on the principle of overall optimization, generating a matrix and issuing instructions through linkage operation according to the global map, guaranteeing that orders of all channels obtain corresponding resources and commissions according to the principle of fairness and rationality, executing a node combination state execution algorithm, uploading data, and dynamically optimizing resource allocation paths in real time.
assignees: FUJIAN SHUNYIN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Management method and system for time-off schedule of delivery worker
abstract_en: The delivery timing of gas containers in LP gas delivery work depends on the state of use of gas by a customer, gas container volume, the number of placed containers, and the like; hence, it is not possible to limit delivery to a specific day. However, upon consideration of the fatigue of the delivery worker and maintaining worker motivation, creating a time-off schedule for a delivery worker in an equitable manner is necessary. This method involves assigning days off intermittently to delivery worker data having an identical delivery base and an identical coverage area, determining whether the number of total assigned days off meets or exceeds a prescribed number, and if the number of total days off is smaller than the prescribed number, assigning additional days off on the basis of a prescribed rule.

title_en: Method and system for implementing a cloud based email distribution fairness algorithm
abstract_en: Disclosed is an approach for implementing a system, method, and computer program product for a marketing automation tool that implements an advanced fairness scheme for resources. The order that work items are deployed is carefully managed to ensure that customers are treated fairly. This prevents and/or minimizes any customer from being adversely affected by other customers.

title_en: System and method for graph-based resource allocation using neural networks
abstract_en: A method for using a neural network to generate an improved graph model includes receiving, by the neural network, a graph model. The graph model is based on data relating to an environment for allocating resources to a first group and a second group. The method further includes receiving, by the neural network, a budget for editing the graph model based on a cost of corresponding modification to the environment, and determining, by the neural network, a fairness representation based on a fairness requirement between the first and second groups. It is determined by the neural network, a utility function for the graph model based on first and second group utilities representing resource allocation to the first and second groups respectively. Reinforcement learning is performed on the neural network to generate the improved graph model using the utility function and the fairness representation.

title_en: Electric automobile ordered charging guiding method and system based on blockchain intelligent contract
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of blockchain technology and electric vehicle charging scheduling, in particular to an electric vehicle ordered charging guiding method and system based on a blockchain intelligent contract. And the electric automobile user submits charging demand parameters to the charging platform, and the blockchain system acquires the distance between the user and each charging station through the commercial map interface to form a charging station set and a distance matrix which can be reached by the electric automobile user. And the charging station nodes call the orderly guide model constructed in the intelligent contract in turn to solve, so as to obtain a charging station recommendation set, and the calculation data is stored into the blockchain system through a consensus mechanism. According to the invention, the public flatness index is introduced by combining the blockchain technology, the fluctuation degree of the single pile benefits is limited, the charging station set is provided for the user through the user selection model and the ordered charging guide model, the fairness of the charging station operator benefits distribution is ensured, and the charging utility of the user is improved.

title_en: Block chain-based water resource management method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water resource management method based on a blockchain, which relates to the technical field of water resource management, and when a node initiates a transaction, each node suitable for the transaction is matched for the node according to the price, water quality and required water quantity of the node, so that the suitability of both transaction sides is ensured, the success probability of the transaction is improved, the formation of the transaction is effectively promoted, and the efficiency of the water right transaction on the blockchain is improved; according to the water consumption data, the water resource data, the transaction data and the industry data of each node in each period, analyzing the difference among the nodes, then analyzing whether the water resource allocation plan needs to be adjusted or not, simultaneously acquiring each node in a high consumption state, formulating a water saving scheme, improving the accuracy of water consumption evaluation of each area, providing reliable data reference for water resource allocation, improving the fairness of the water resource allocation, and reducing the waste of the water resource.

title_en: Multi-energy complementary micro-grid energy management method containing multiagent
abstract_en: The invention belongs to power system micro-capacitance sensor technical field, more particularly to a kind of multi-energy complementary micro-grid energy management method containing multiagent.To coordinate each decision-maker in energy internet, balance and optimization each side concerned interests, the present invention provides a kind of multi-energy complementary micro-grid energy management method containing multiagent.This method utilizes co-generation unit and heat-storing device, the response of electric demand response and heat demand and renewable energy power generation with reference to user side, consider the factors such as users'comfort, optimization cost, the cooperative game being made up of in micro-capacitance sensor each member is constructed, and income is allocated according to the contribution degree of each member using Shapley values method.The present invention is to maximize alliance's income as target, distributional equity is ensure that while maximum revenue is realized, the income of each member in alliance is effectively improved, the optimization method that a kind of cost is lower, fairness is higher is provided for the economical operation of multi-energy complementary micro-grid.

title_en: Big data driven urban green land demand measuring and calculating method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of urban ecological demand estimation methods, in particular to a big data driven urban green land demand measuring and calculating method. The method comprises the following steps: a) firstly, crawling motion data to obtain motion trail data of residents; b) analyzing the crawled data file; c) converting the coordinate system of the crawled data; d) cleaning the data; e) dividing the city space into grids, and calculating the motion attribute in the grids; f) and estimating the green space demand of each region through frequency and length, and visualizing the demand. The reasonability of the green land layout is evaluated through the distribution intensity index of the motion trail. The method adopts the big movement data of residents to obtain the actual movement range of most residents and reflects wider resident demands, thereby improving the fairness, scientificity and accuracy of research results and providing accurate data support for the construction of urban green lands.
assignees: TIN FREE DATA LAKE INFORMATION TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Work area division system and method for recycling renewable resources
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of garbage classification, in particular to a system and a method for dividing a working area for recycling renewable resources. According to the method, a matrix coordinate system is constructed through information of all cells in a project, then a local optimal path L connecting all the cells is obtained in the matrix coordinate system according to a GA genetic path planning algorithm, then all the cell points in the optimal path L are distributed into k regions by respectively calculating with the 1 st, 2 nd, 3 th, so, n as initial points in the optimal path L, and { S is formed respectively  1  ，S  2  ，...，S  n  }. And finally, calculating evaluation indexes for each group of division schemes to obtain the optimal division scheme. The scheme scientifically divides the working area of the renewable resource garbage recycler and ensuresThe labor cost balance of project operation and the labor distribution fairness among collectors are guaranteed.
assignees: ZHEJIANG YUNQI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Benefit distribution method and terminal for electric heating cooperative scheduling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a benefit distribution method and a terminal of electric heat cooperative scheduling, which are used for calculating electric heat cooperative scheduling benefits generated by an electric-thermal coupling system, constructing corresponding benefit functions, calculating contribution values of each energy main body to the electric heat cooperative scheduling, and carrying out benefit distribution based on the contribution values after integral solving. In this way, the benefits generated by the CHPD are fairly shared among multiple subjects, and the calculation burden can be greatly reduced on the premise of keeping higher precision through the way of integral solution. The method can be applied to the electric heating collaborative scheduling benefit allocation of multiple main bodies, ensures the fairness of the benefit allocation, and improves the calculation efficiency of the electric heating collaborative scheduling benefit allocation of the multiple main bodies.

title_en: Dynamic charging-sharing coupling scheduling method and system for new energy automobile
abstract_en: The invention relates to a dynamic charging-sharing coupling scheduling method and system for a new energy automobile, wherein the method comprises the steps of dividing a target area into a plurality of subareas, obtaining relevant parameters of each subarea and vehicle scheduling constraint, calculating travel benefits of a sharing platform, calculating regional fairness benefits of each subarea, calculating photovoltaic power generation utilization rates of all subareas in all time periods, taking the travel benefits of the sharing platform, the regional fairness benefits and the photovoltaic power generation utilization rates as target functions, calculating an evaluation value of each target function by using a pareto optimal solution method, and generating a vehicle charging scheduling strategy based on the evaluation values. Compared with the prior art, the photovoltaic power generation method has the advantages that photovoltaic power generation is brought into the consideration range of vehicle charging scheduling, and vehicle sharing charging scheduling is comprehensively optimized from the aspects of travel benefits, regional fairness benefits and photovoltaic power generation utilization rate of a sharing platform.

title_en: Load side power demand response scheduling method, system, electronic equipment and medium
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a load side power demand response scheduling method, a system, electronic equipment and a medium, and relates to the technical field of power. The specific implementation scheme is that when the dispatching mechanism node detects that the regional power grid has abnormal load, a demand response offer is issued to the aggregator node. And determining an objective function by the aggregator node according to the industrial load production curve of the regional power grid, the state information of the electric vehicle, the distributed energy storage information and the electricity price information, and solving to obtain the maximum adjustable capacity. And the dispatching mechanism node determines the subsidy power unit price and the winning capacity of the aggregator according to the edge clearing mode of price priority, time priority and capacity priority. And the aggregator node obtains the arrangement sequence of the adjustable load nodes according to the comprehensive scheduling index of the adjustable load nodes, and schedules the adjustable loads in the regional power grid by combining the load adjustment capacity of the adjustable load nodes. Thus, the accuracy and fairness of load scheduling of each node can be ensured.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION BRANCH;STATE GRID DIGITAL TECH HOLDINGS CO LTD;STATE GRID BLOCK CHAIN TECH BEIJING COMPANY

title_en: Intelligent port operation vehicle dispatching system and dispatching robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a scheduling system and a scheduling robot for an intelligent port operation vehicle, and relates to the technical field of intelligent port operation. The method aims at solving the problems that in the traditional port vehicle dispatching, the manual dispatching response is slow, the error rate is high, the resource allocation is uneven, the labor cost is too high, and the high-efficiency and intelligent requirements of modern ports are difficult to meet; according to the invention, the idle load distance of the vehicle is reduced by utilizing the bipartite graph matching strategy, the overload rate is improved, the predictive scheduling module is planned in advance, the backlog of the task and the idle of the vehicle are reduced, the operation efficiency is effectively improved, the constraint processing module optimizes the task distribution according to the task and the vehicle condition, the multi-objective optimizing module optimizes the task distribution and the dispatch fairness, so that the resource distribution is more reasonable, the scheduling robot integrated system function, the intelligent scheduling can be adapted to different operation environments through continuous optimization of the acquired data and the online learning technology, the scheduling accuracy and efficiency are improved, the labor cost is reduced, and the port overall competitiveness is improved.
assignees: Ningbo port information communication co ltd

title_en: Intelligent city carbon emission panorama management and planning system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent city management, in particular to an intelligent city carbon emission panoramic management and planning system, wherein a multi-mode behavior sensing unit collects multi-subject differentiated use behavior data of a central air conditioning system, a shared parking lot and a heating power pipe network in real time through a heterogeneous sensing network deployed on a shared facility, a dynamic emission tracing unit receives the data, a carbon flow tracing algorithm engine carries out space-time coupling calculation on total energy consumption of the shared facility to generate a multi-subject responsible carbon footprint, a responsible weight distribution unit dynamically calculates contribution degrees of all subjects by adopting a Xia Puli value-Bayesian game fusion model based on the carbon footprint, outputs a responsible allocation proportion to a block chain excitation execution unit, and the block chain excitation execution unit automatically triggers a differentiated reward and punishment mechanism according to the responsibility allocation proportion through an intelligent contract, further degrades facility use authority for a behavior abnormal subject, improves accuracy and fairness of carbon emission management and low-carbon development of a power-assisted city.
assignees: LIANHE TAIZE ENVIRONMENTAL TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent public health emergency event material scheduling method based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent scheduling method for public health emergency event materials with multi-source data fusion. The method comprises the steps of collecting a multi-source original data set from a health department database, a warehouse management system, a traffic management platform, a mobile communication operator platform and a meteorological environment monitoring station, carrying out data cleaning and standardization processing on the multi-source original data set, constructing an area diagram based on the preprocessed multi-source data set, carrying out multi-source data fusion by using a graphic neural network to generate a fusion feature vector, inputting the fusion feature vector into a combined model of a long-short-term memory network and a support vector regressor to carry out material demand prediction, adopting an improved particle swarm optimization algorithm combined with a simulated annealing mechanism to generate an optimal material scheduling scheme, and dynamically evaluating and adjusting the material scheduling scheme according to real-time data. According to the invention, through multi-source data depth fusion and intelligent optimization algorithm, accuracy, efficiency and fairness of public health emergency material scheduling are improved.
assignees: CHINESE CENTER FOR DISEASE CONTROL AND PREVENTION

title_en: Omni-Channel Multi-Level Demand Prioritization and Allocation
abstract_en: A system and method are multi-level replenishment planning with independent channel demand prioritization that initiates production of a product by a first supply chain entity that receives orders for the product from a second supply chain entity and supplies the product to a third supply chain entity that receives orders for the product from a fourth supply chain entity. Embodiments further disclose calculating the supply of the product for the first supply chain entity for a supply allocation duration time period, receiving demand orders high priority demand orders from the fourth supply chain entity, allocating supplies within the supply allocation duration time period to firm plan arrivals based on a location priority and a demand date, and generating a shipment recommendation for each allocated supply that meets a firmed planned arrival.

title_en: System and method for optimizing product development portfolios and aligning product, brand, and information technology strategies
abstract_en: Business and software methods are described for cost-effectively optimizing product development portfolios, services development portfolios, and IT (information technology) portfolios, accelerating market entry, and optimizing alignment between product strategy, IT strategy, and brand strategy. Product and service attributes are characterized, categorized, and prioritized with numerical values amenable to statistical analysis of each assessed product development/IT initiative in terms of alignment with ideal customer experience and potential competitive impact relative to the resources and risks required to bring each initiative to market. Methods further include prioritization in the form of applied decision intelligence tools to allow an organization to reach better-informed judgments concerning resource allocation to develop, maintain, or optimize a given product or service portfolio or IT portfolio to improve business performance, increase market impact, and build brand equity.

title_en: Annual water quantity scheduling plan compilation method considering water use fairness and importance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for compiling an annual water quantity scheduling plan considering fairness and importance of water use, which comprises the following steps: constructing a watershed water supply benefit function evaluation index system comprehensively considering water supply social benefits, water supply economic benefits and water supply ecological benefits; generating corresponding single-factor distribution standards for each evaluation index, constructing a first objective function with the minimum difference between each single-factor distribution standard and the target optimal scheme distribution standard, and solving the first objective function to obtain the normalized water supply benefit coefficient of each water unit; determining total watershed water supply benefit according to the normalized water supply benefit coefficients of all the water using units, and constructing a second objective function with the maximum total watershed water supply benefit as a target and a third objective function with the maximum sum of the current reservoir end water levels as the target; and solving the second objective function and the third objective function to obtain a basin annual water quantity scheduling scheme. The invention constructs a watershed water supply benefit function evaluation index system and provides theoretical support for the water quantity scheduling optimization distribution problem.

title_en: Regional source load coordination scheduling method considering carbon emission accumulated entropy
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regional source load coordination scheduling method considering carbon emission accumulated entropy, and relates to the field of power system scheduling and management. The regional source load coordination scheduling method considering the carbon emission accumulated entropy comprises a communication interface module, an energy management optimization module and an algorithm solving module, wherein the communication interface module transmits generator set information and load side information of a generator side, the energy management optimization module establishes a double-layer optimization scheduling model considering source load coordination of comprehensive cost and the carbon emission accumulated entropy, the double-layer optimization scheduling model comprises an upper layer model and a lower layer model, and the calculated scheduling scheme can consider fairness of carbon emission responsibility allocation of the load side on the basis of improving the running economy of a system by reducing carbon emission generated by the generator side to the load side. The scheduling scheme provided by the invention can consider the fairness of load side carbon emission responsibility allocation on the basis of improving the system operation economy.

title_en: Crowd sensing task scheduling method and system based on multi-space modeling and fairness reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the crossing field of crowd sensing technology and artificial intelligence technology, in particular to a crowd sensing task scheduling method and a system based on multi-space modeling and fairness reinforcement learning, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a ground and air collaborative multi-layer space task structure according to acquired tasks; the method comprises the steps of establishing a topological association model among tasks according to space region division results, defining a priority sequence of task scheduling through a critical path extraction mechanism, constructing a differentiated agent matching strategy, reasonably configuring critical path tasks based on the priority sequence, dynamically distributing non-critical path tasks by utilizing a fairness perception multi-objective scheduling algorithm, reducing search space through a space division and path screening mechanism, improving task completion rate and overall scheduling performance of a system, and being suitable for high-efficiency resource configuration requirements in a multi-space collaborative perception task scene.

title_en: Community education resource scheduling system based on multidimensional demand matching
abstract_en: The invention discloses a community education resource scheduling system based on multidimensional demand matching, which particularly relates to the field of education resource management, and comprises a disturbance construction module, an acquisition module, an extraction module, an evaluation module and a scheduling module; the disturbance construction module is used for constructing a disturbance task sequence of the target course, wherein the disturbance task sequence is composed of a plurality of disturbance tasks, and each disturbance task comprises task content, random excitation parameters and task trigger time of the target course. By constructing disturbance task induced behavior reaction, extracting behavior characteristics and combining with a motivation offset evaluation function, the recognition of pseudo learning behaviors and the dynamic adjustment of scheduling priority are realized, so that the long-term occupation of high-value education resources by non-real demand users is restrained, and the authenticity of the education resource allocation and the fairness of system operation are improved.

title_en: Two-dimensional code-based owner voting innovation mode
abstract_en: The invention discloses a two-dimensional code-based owner voting innovation mode, which comprises the following steps of S1: the invention relates to the technical field of owner vote, in particular to a system for verifying house property certificate information, which comprises a plurality of function modules, wherein an owner scans codes to download APP, clicks the corresponding function module, then obtains APP authorization, and after authorization confirmation, the owner selects different types of house property certificate information to verify, if verification fails, the house property certificate information can be checked, and the system can verify according to the real identity of a user, so that the house property of the user is ensured to be correct. This owner's innovation mode of voting based on two-dimensional code can solve traditional voting inefficiency, cycle length, human cost height, fairness are poor, the difficult scheduling problem of statistics of data, and the owner can vote on line through the procedure, and to some old man that can not use the procedure, we can pass through the automatic relevant off-line vote that generates of procedure, have reduced because of the work load of artifical preparation vote, can be fast with on-line, off-line data statistics together, greatly saved the time energy that the owner voted.
assignees: SHANGHAI JET THINK INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Comprehensive energy system operation optimization method considering multi-main body fraudulent conduct
abstract_en: The invention provides a comprehensive energy system operation optimization method considering multi-main body fraud. Firstly, constructing a comprehensive energy system collaborative optimization model under a multi-subject transaction mode; then, taking a multi-subject interaction model under the action of game fraud into consideration, and carrying out value evaluation on the multi-subject; finally, solving based on a virtual regretta minimization algorithm to obtain a final optimization result. The invention effectively solves the adverse effect of different main body fraud on the operation of the comprehensive energy system, and has the following beneficial effects: firstly, the fairness and transparency of the energy market are improved, and the benefit balance of each participating main body is ensured; secondly, the economic loss of the energy system caused by fraudulent conduct is reduced, and the economic benefit of the system is improved; and thirdly, the safety and stability of the energy system are improved, the mismatching of energy supply and demand and the unbalanced condition of power load are reduced, and reliable technical support and guarantee are provided for the efficient operation of the energy system.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ECONOMIC TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE;JIANGXI TENGDA ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN INST CO LTD;UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Carbon responsibility distribution and distributed scheduling method based on cross-electric power traffic system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of responsibility allocation, in particular to a carbon responsibility allocation and distributed scheduling method based on a cross-electric power traffic system. The technical scheme includes that electric power and traffic basic data are collected, node time-varying carbon intensity is calculated, a feasible path and a time window are screened, traffic flow time sequence constraint is constructed, an energy and battery charge state feasible domain is constructed, carbon responsibility density is updated, upper carbon excitation and lower carbon excitation are combined and optimized, and after convergence, attribution carbon responsibility and total CER of the system of each vehicle are output. The invention realizes continuous CER tracking and verifiable decomposition of the electric automobile in a bidirectional and space-time-crossing scene, improves accounting accuracy and fairness, eliminates confusion of carbon attributes of electric quantity of different sources through a responsibility density mechanism, avoids high-carbon responsibility pseudo-low-carbon reinjection, and ensures approaching of a CER target of a system under the condition of not disclosing a fine-granularity track through a distributed iteration signal. The method is suitable for carbon responsibility allocation and scheduling.

title_en: Urban group space toughness collaborative planning method, system, terminal equipment and medium based on collaborative game
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cooperative game-based urban mass space toughness collaborative planning method, a system, terminal equipment and a medium, and relates to the technical field of urban planning. The method comprises the steps of obtaining city group basic data, dividing the city group basic data into space unit sets with unified assignment according to attributes, constructing a multi-disaster scene set and quantifying risk loss parameters of each unit, defining candidate land utilization states and planning constraint condition sets for each unit, constructing a comprehensive benefit function of a corresponding city based on the candidate land utilization states of the units, constructing a cooperative game by taking the city as a participant, solving an optimal strategy in the planning configuration set meeting the constraint with the aim of maximizing the benefit of the city group, calculating marginal contributions of each city to the benefit of the city group under the optimal strategy, and distributing the cooperative benefit based on the marginal contributions. The invention provides an improved mechanism in the aspect of multi-disaster prevention and regional collaborative optimization, is beneficial to improving the toughness level of urban mass space planning and ensures the fairness and stability of regional collaboration.

title_en: Heuristic search method for monthly thermal power generating unit combination problem of power system
abstract_en: A heuristic search method for a monthly thermal power generating unit combination problem of an electric power system relates to the field of power generation scheduling of the electric power system. At present, when the unit scale is large, dimension disasters are easy to happen, the searching speed is slow, and the solving result is not unique possibly, so that the requirements of fast-developing power grid dispatching operation in China are difficult to meet. The technical scheme of the invention is as follows: and introducing a subsequent load rate index to describe 'three-fair' scheduling, and optimizing a unit starting combination mode by taking 'subsequent load rate equality' of a power station as a target. In the optimization process, the follow-up load rate of the power station and the spare capacity margin of the system are used as heuristic information, the starting mode of the power station is modified in an iterative mode, and a unit starting and stopping strategy of preferentially starting a large unit with low energy consumption or preferentially mediating and stopping a small unit with high energy consumption is adopted, so that energy-saving power generation of a power grid is realized. The technical scheme can effectively meet the 'three-public' principle of power dispatching, ensures the power generation fairness of each power plant, gives consideration to the energy-saving power generation requirement, and is a practical and feasible method.

title_en: Method for controlling two-stage flexible climbing capacity of heat pump virtual power plant day-day before day
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for controlling the dual-stage flexible climbing capacity of a heat pump virtual power plant in the day-ahead and day, which comprises the following steps: acquiring parameters required by the flexible climbing capability of the single heat pump based on a cloud-side-end heat pump virtual power plant architecture, and establishing a flexible climbing capability assessment model of the single heat pump by utilizing an affine mathematical theory and considering the uncertainty of outdoor temperature and illumination intensity; on the basis of a single heat pump flexible climbing capacity evaluation model, a heat pump cluster virtual power plant day-ahead flexible climbing capacity evaluation model is constructed, and a climbing capacity boundary is provided for the next day of issuing flexible climbing demands of the power system; and establishing a virtual power plant flexible climbing capacity correction model in the daily stage, correcting the daily flexible climbing capacity of the virtual power plant in a rolling manner, and distributing climbing demands among the heat pumps based on a maximum-minimum fairness algorithm.

title_en: Structured bidding document management method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of file management, in particular to a structured bidding file management method and system, which are used for solving the problems that the efficiency and accuracy of bidding process cannot be ensured because the conventional structured processing system of bidding files cannot reasonably classify the bidding files and allocate professionals for auditing; the structured bidding document management system comprises the following modules: the system comprises a bidding management module, a file acquisition module, a data analysis module, a file management platform and a file auditing module; according to the structured bidding document management method, by means of an automatic distribution method, errors caused by manual operation can be avoided, fairness of bidding process is guaranteed, in addition, special properties of each bidding document can be fully considered, each bidding document can be reasonably distributed to corresponding document auditors, and efficiency and accuracy of bidding process can be greatly improved.
assignees: MAT BRANCH OF STATE GRID SHANXI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;STATE GRID SHANXI TENDERING CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for preventing conflict in on-line examination time period
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a system for preventing conflict in an on-machine examination time period, comprising the following steps: acquiring real-time examination reservation requests of examinees, and recording time periods of each examination reservation request; based on the real-time examination reservation request and the mixed prediction model, predicting the flow of the examinee and the resource demand of the examination room during the examination to obtain a prediction result; dynamically adjusting the examination time period of the predicted result to generate a time period distribution result; optimizing a time period distribution result by utilizing a multi-objective optimization algorithm to generate a preliminary examination time period distribution scheme; and detecting whether the time conflict exists in the preliminary examination time period distribution scheme or not by using a real-time monitoring mechanism, and adjusting the preliminary examination time period distribution scheme based on the severity of the time conflict to obtain a conflict-free examination schedule, so that the efficiency and fairness of examination scheduling are improved.
assignees: QUANMEI ONLINE BEIJING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Electric power market force analysis and supervision method based on multidimensional index and machine learning algorithm
abstract_en: The invention provides an electric power market force analysis and supervision method based on a multi-dimensional index and a machine learning algorithm, which comprises the following steps of obtaining historical data of an electric power market and constructing a multi-dimensional index according to the historical data; the method comprises the steps of carrying out time sequence coding on multi-dimensional indexes which are calculated and normalized, capturing time correlation characteristics among the multi-dimensional indexes according to a double-flow machine learning algorithm, establishing a high-dimensional polyhedral model through high-dimensional joint distribution, deriving a dynamic threshold value according to probability volume density of the high-dimensional polyhedral model, setting a multi-index voting mechanism, setting a risk quantization model, dividing market force risk levels according to the multi-dimensional indexes and the dynamic threshold value, constructing a dynamic degradation mechanism, and generating a risk characteristic library according to the dynamic degradation mechanism. The invention can consider multidimensional factors, dynamically optimize the market force monitoring and supervising method, accurately grade the market force risk of each market participant, improve the supervising efficiency and ensure the fairness and stability of the electric power market.

title_en: Workflow Management System and Method
abstract_en: Systems and methods improve the equitable distribution the processing capacity of a computing device processing work items retrieved from multiple queues in a workflow system. A retrieval priority is determined for each of the plurality of queues and work items are retrieved from each of the multiple queues according to the retrieval priority. The retrieved work items are then stored in a central data structure. Multiple processing components process the work items stored in the central data structure. The number of processing components is selectively adjusted to maximize efficiency.

title_en: Resource reservation method, electronic device, storage medium, and computer program product
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a resource reservation method, electronic equipment, a storage medium and a computer program product, and relates to the field of data processing. The resource reservation method comprises the steps of responding to a demand portrait of an initiator of a resource reservation request, determining the reservation priority of the initiator, wherein the resource reservation request is a request for the use permission of a target resource, the reservation priority represents the order of the initiator to obtain the use permission of the target resource, comparing the reservation priority of the initiator with a first mapping table, determining the resource level of a resource unit which can be reserved in the target resource by the initiator, recording the corresponding relation between the reservation priority and the resource level in the first mapping table, and distributing the use permission of the resource unit corresponding to the resource level to the initiator. According to the technical scheme, the fairness of resource allocation is guaranteed while the differentiated requirements are met in the resource reservation process.

title_en: Big data-based emergency supplies data storage and circulation monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a big data-based emergency supplies data storage and circulation monitoring method. The method comprises the following steps: setting a task node, and forming a calculation ring by calculation nodes in a physical distribution network; extracting corresponding warehouse-in/out supplies record data from a database by the task node according to a received task request; separating warehouse objects serving as analysis objects in the corresponding warehouse-in/out supplies record data from a data set; performing Hash processing on the calculation nodes in the calculation ring through the task node, mapping the Hash-processed calculation nodes with the analysis objects, and assigning an analysis object split set to each calculation node; extracting analysis objects needing to be processed from the received analysis object split set by the calculation nodes, and acquiring other warehouse supplies record data having a supplies transfer relation in the analysis objects and the physical distribution network; and performing abnormity check on the warehouse supplies record data according to a received task object, and transmitting a check result to the task node. Through adoption of the big data-based emergency supplies data storage and circulation monitoring method, rapid analysis and monitoring can be performed on data.

title_en: A kind of patent information orderly management system based on big data processing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of patent information orderly management systems based on big data processing, comprising: organizational structure module, write staqtistical data base, reply staqtistical data base, patent document receiving module, information extraction modules, answer are in charge of module, patent document shift module and are replied and submit module.In the present invention, answer is in charge of module and retrieves preferential distribution object by retrieval organizational structure, and is determined according to search result and reply people, is conducive to guarantee that patent document replies the efficiency and quality of work to the greatest extent, protects applicant's equity.
assignees: HEFEI CHANGYUAN INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY MAN CO LTD

title_en: Urban raw water supply allocation path identification method and system and storable medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system and a storage medium for identifying urban raw water supply allocation paths, which relate to the technical field of water supply allocation and comprise the following steps: generalizing an urban raw water system, and dividing the urban raw water system into a supply community and a demand community based on a complex network theory; classifying the computing nodes in the supply community according to the water supply topological relation, and providing a containment control strategy; according to the category of the computing node, performing feasible path identification by combining engineering capacity; and judging according to the operation condition and the engineering capacity of the computing node to generate a water quantity allocation scheme. The method can calculate the feasible path of water allocation according to different water allocation targets and generate a water allocation scheme according to the operation conditions of a pump station and a gate project, so that reference is provided for forecasting and planning of urban water supply allocation and a foundation is laid for intelligent management of urban water supply.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Automatic driving vehicle dispatching system for signalless intersection based on game optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent dispatching method and system for an automatic driving vehicle without a signalized intersection, and belongs to the technical field of automatic driving and intelligent traffic control. Aiming at the problems of low traffic efficiency and unfair traffic of the existing signalless intersections, the invention provides a multi-vehicle cooperative scheduling method based on game theory optimization. According to the method, the state information of each vehicle is acquired through the communication of the Internet of vehicles, an optimization model which aims at minimizing the weighted maximum waiting time is constructed, and scheduling fairness and efficiency are comprehensively considered. And setting explicit safety constraint, fleet consistency constraint and global waiting time constraint, and ensuring that a scheduling result meets the requirements of safety and systematicness. Meanwhile, adjustable priority weights are given to different types of vehicles, so that differentiated dispatching control of emergency vehicles, public service vehicles and the like is realized. The method has the advantages of high interpretability, clear structure, strong adaptability and the like, and has good engineering realizability and popularization value.

title_en: Urban and rural passenger, cargo and mail integrated service management platform and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an urban and rural passenger-cargo mail integrated service management platform and method, which relate to the technical field of logistics management and information, and comprise a multi-source data collaborative center module, a dynamic benefit distribution engine module and a dynamic correction module, wherein the multi-source data collaborative center module is used for converging and fusing heterogeneous data from a passenger enterprise system, a postal express enterprise system, a village service point terminal, a vehicle-mounted terminal and a government supervision system to construct a unified passenger-cargo delivery by mail nutrient data model, and the dynamic benefit distribution engine module is used for integrating an initial benefit distribution model and a dynamic correction model based on a shape value method. According to the urban and rural passenger-cargo-mail integrated service management platform and method, heterogeneous data from multiple parties such as passenger transportation, postal express, village-level service points and the like are effectively converged and fused through the multi-source data collaborative center module, a unified passenger-cargo delivery by mail-nutrient data model is built, an information island is broken, comprehensive sharing and efficient utilization of data are achieved, and fairness and efficiency of benefit distribution in a collaborative alliance are ensured.

title_en: Robot scheduling and safety verification system for disaster relief material intelligent bin
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of disaster relief material dispatching, and particularly discloses a robot dispatching and safety checking system of an intelligent disaster relief material bin, which comprises a robot main body, a dispatching module and a safety checking module, wherein a plurality of rollers are arranged at the bottom of the robot main body, an electric rotating shaft is arranged on the robot main body, a rotating plate is fixedly connected to the electric rotating shaft, a two-stage vibration reduction structure of a pressing spring and a damping rod is adopted, when the robot main body moves to generate jolt, the clamping plate drives a lug to move in a chute, the pressing spring is firstly pushed by a swinging arm to push a driving piece to compress the pressing spring, most vibration energy is absorbed by utilizing the elastic deformation of the pressing spring, meanwhile, the damping rod generates damping force along with the downward movement of the lug to secondarily damp the disaster relief material, the vibration energy is prevented from being transmitted to clamped fragile materials, the fragile materials such as precision medical equipment are prevented from being damaged in the dispatching process, and the sound rate of the disaster relief material is remarkably improved.

title_en: Emission trading product and method
abstract_en: The present invention provides a system and method for determining equivalency factors for use in comparative performance analysis of industrial facilities by determining a target variable and a plurality of characteristics of the target variable. Each of the plurality of characteristics is ranked according to value. Based on ranking value, the characteristics are divided into categories. Based on the sorted and ranked characteristics, a data collection classification system is developed. Data is collected according to the data collection classification system. The data is validated, and based on the data, an analysis model is developed. The analysis model then calculates the equivalency factors for use in one embodiment in performance measurement and equitable benchmarking of green house gas (GHG) emissions from industrial facilities for the purposes of allocating GHG emission allowances for permits, licenses, etc. Furthermore, a system and method is described for quantifying, transferring, managing, underwriting, or insuring the risk associated with emissions from manufacturing, operating a facility, or engaging in an activity that emits, produces, or potentially emits or produces permitted or regulated emissions. In addition to insuring against emissions that exceed permitted or regulated amounts, a system for pooling, managing, and trading emission credits is also described herein.

title_en: Commodity purchase request distribution method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a commodity purchasing request distribution method, which relates to the technical field of electronic commerce, and aims to solve the problems of overstock and missales by dividing commodity inventory into a plurality of commodity single cases according to the SKU of commodities, respectively storing the commodity single cases in a key-value form, acquiring the number of servers and the inventory number of each commodity single case from a redis database, calculating the commodity purchasing request number processed by each server, and redistributing the servers for commodity purchasing requests according to the commodity purchasing request number and the server response thread weight, thereby avoiding the conditions of overstock and misuse, ensuring the fairness of commodity purchasing and improving user experience.

title_en: Online education management system for art creation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an online education management system for art creation, which belongs to the field of art education and comprises a user management module, a course management module, a real-time interaction module, a content management module, a learning planning module, a data management module, a work display module, a learning analysis module, an assessment feedback module and a security authority module; the invention improves the accurate recognition of the user learning behavior mode, can help the user to adjust the learning plan in time, enhances the learning motivation of the user, excites the learning interest and enthusiasm of the user, improves the learning effect and efficiency, provides data support for teaching improvement and decision making, helps to optimize the education strategy and the teaching method, improves the overall teaching quality, avoids the subjective deviation possibly existing in human evaluation, improves the fairness and consistency of evaluation, can quickly evaluate and feed back, provides instant improvement suggestion, helps the user to adjust and improve works in time, guides the user to continuously improve the artistic creation level, and improves the teaching efficiency.

title_en: Operation resource pool management system and method
abstract_en: The application discloses an operation resource pool management system and method, and relates to the technical field of resource management, wherein the system comprises an operation resource and expense management module, an equity management module and an equity management module, wherein the operation resource and expense management module is used for generating project standing budgets according to a special operation plan and associating with a resource pool, the equity management module is used for creating equity required by an operation activity and associating with the resource pool, the equity management module is used for associating an integral corresponding to the operation activity with the resource pool to obtain a data mart when the equity is triggered, and the resource pool allocation module is used for optimally allocating the data mart and equity using field Jing Guanlian according to the budge consumption condition of the operation activity. According to the application, the rights management module and the point management module are introduced to perform associated management on the resource pool and the rights and point issuing process, so that the condition of large difficulty in duplication caused by the fact that the traditional resource pool is not strictly controlled is avoided, the cost and fund consumption in the marketing field can be traceable and can be monitored, and the execution efficiency of the marketing process is improved.

title_en: Sport production selection method and platform based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of performance prediction, in particular to a sports production and pulling method and platform based on artificial intelligence, comprising the following steps: based on the game score, skill score and training data of the athlete, the athlete is arranged and summarized into structural information, the structural information is subjected to data cleaning and structural processing, information nodes are constructed, and an athlete capability knowledge graph is generated. According to the invention, the organization and visualization of data are enhanced by constructing the knowledge graph, so that the performance data and skill scores of athletes are intuitively displayed, the organization and visualization of the data are enhanced, a training team and a pulling person can conveniently and quickly grasp the comprehensive capacity and potential of the athletes, the efficiency and accuracy of data processing are improved through the structural processing of the athlete data, the improvement of decision logic is realized, a prediction model is optimized, the support is provided for pulling excellent athletes by a training team, and the fairness and the high efficiency of pulling are ensured.
assignees: GUAGNZHOU HUAXIA HUIHAI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic priority grouping and intelligent arrangement system for events
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of electronic athletic and data processing and discloses an event dynamic priority grouping and intelligent arrangement system which comprises an event twinning body construction module, a dynamic narrative potential field generation module, an intelligent arrangement decision module and a narrative intervention module, wherein the event twinning body construction module is used for aggregating multi-mode data in real time to construct an event panoramic digital mirror image, the dynamic narrative potential field generation module is used for quantifying and modeling multi-dimensional narrative values such as 'cold explosion', 'old enemy' of all potential pairs in the future based on the event twinning body data, the intelligent arrangement decision module takes event states and the narrative potential fields as inputs, takes the maximum athletic fairness, audience participation and the narrative values as targets through an enhanced learning algorithm, and the narrative intervention module is used for generating an executable operation strategy to actively promote the attractiveness of an event by analyzing potential field gradient identification. The invention enables the system to continuously self-optimize through the closed loop design of 'intervention-feedback-enhancement', and obviously improves the ornamental value and commercial value of the event.
assignees: XIAN JINGFA CHENGYUN CULTURE AND SPORTS IND CO LTD

title_en: Risk scheduling method for water resource system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water resource system risk scheduling method which comprises the steps of obtaining regional basic data, constructing a supply and demand pressure field, identifying causal relations, generating heterogeneous computing grids and a space-time causal network, dynamically determining a water-required tail cutting threshold value by adopting a cascade buffer pool mechanism based on historical supply and demand sequence data of the heterogeneous computing grids and influence factors identified by the space-time causal network, outputting a regulated water-required sequence, generating a water scene set by adopting an optimal transmission method of tail conformal by utilizing the regulated water-required sequence, simplifying the water scene set into a representative scene subset, constructing a distributed robust optimization model aiming at the representative scene subset, and generating a water resource scheduling scheme and a risk assessment report by fairness constraint projection and causal path analysis. The invention can finely describe the space-time pressure, adaptively regulate and control the extreme requirements, and generate a scheduling scheme which takes robustness and fairness into consideration under the condition of keeping the tail risk characteristics.

title_en: Electric-gas comprehensive energy system planning method based on cooperative game
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric-gas comprehensive energy system planning method based on collaborative games, which comprises the steps of S1, establishing a multi-main-body electric-gas comprehensive energy system model comprising a carbon capture power plant, renewable energy sources and a carbon utilization unit, S2, establishing a distributed optimization objective function and operation constraint of each main-body model, S3, establishing a collaborative game model through distributed optimization according to the distributed optimization objective function and operation constraint based on a collaborative game alliance, and S4, decomposing and collaborative solving the collaborative game model by adopting an alternate direction multiplier method to generate electric-carbon bilateral transaction amount and dynamic negotiation price. The invention can process the distributed decision behaviors among multiple subjects, truly characterize the physical interaction relationship among the multiple energy flows in the electric-gas-carbon system, improve the physical reliability and engineering applicability of the model, maximize the income of each subject, and give consideration to privacy protection requirements and cooperative residual value distribution, and improve the running efficiency and fairness of the system.

title_en: Government work order dispatching system based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence and government service, and discloses a government work order dispatching system based on deep reinforcement learning, which comprises an agent dispatching module, a control module and a control module, wherein the agent dispatching module is used for respectively configuring deep reinforcement learning dispatching agents for a plurality of government service areas and outputting execution work order allocation and priority ordering; the system comprises a fairness monitoring module, a bias analysis module, an agent optimizing module, a collaborative scheduling and auditing module, a collaborative scheduling system and a scheduling process recording module, wherein the fairness monitoring module is used for defining and monitoring fairness indexes, the bias analysis module is used for analyzing attention patterns in scheduling decisions, identifying potential bias characteristics related to changes of the fairness indexes and quantifying the influence of the potential bias characteristics on the fairness of the scheduling, the agent optimizing module is used for optimizing the scheduling agents, the collaborative scheduling and auditing module is used for constructing a collaborative scheduling system and recording scheduling processes to form auditable logs, and the original opaque deep reinforcement learning decision process is made understandable by integrating the interpretable artificial intelligent module, so that the transparency of the scheduling decisions is improved.

title_en: Apparatus and Method for managing performance of registering members
title_ko: 서비스 가입 유도에 따른 회원유치 실적 관리 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a member attraction performance management device and method which induces service subscription by sending a link to guide a membership registration process through an SMS or SNS. The member attraction performance management device comprises: a link transmission monitoring unit monitoring whether a seller terminal transmits the link to guide a membership registration process to a non-member customer terminal through an app or web page dedicated to attracting members; a database unit matching information on the non-member customer terminal to which the link to guide a membership registration process and the seller terminal after monitoring in the link transmission monitoring unit, and creating a database; a seller terminal detection unit detecting, when a request for membership registration is received from the non-member customer terminal, a seller terminal matching the non-member customer terminal which requests membership registration based on data stored in the database unit; and a performance calculating unit calculating a seller's performance in attracting new members according to seller terminal information detected by the seller terminal detection unit. In managing a member attraction performance through a member attraction performance management device based on service subscription induction, transparency and fairness in performance management can be ensured so that a performance is calculated to a seller who actually contributes to attracting members, and incentives based on the performance can be effectively distributed to the seller.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 SMS 또는 SNS를 통해 회원 가입 절차 안내 링크를 전송하여 서비스 가입 유도를 하는 회원 유치 실적 관리 장치 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 판매자 단말이 회원 유치 전용 앱 또는 웹페이지를 통해 비회원 고객 단말로 회원 가입 절차 안내 링크를 전송하는지 모니터링하는 링크 전송 모니터링부, 상기 링크 전송 모니터링부에서 모니터링결과 회원 가입 절차 안내 링크가 전송된 비회원 고객 단말과 판매자 단말 정보를 매칭시켜 데이터베이스화하는 데이터베이스부, 비회원 고객 단말로부터 회원 가입 요청이 수신되면, 상기 데이터베이스부에 저장된 데이터에 기반하여 회원 가입 요청한 비회원 고객 단말과 매칭되는 판매자 단말을 검출하는 판매자 단말 검출부 및 상기 판매자 단말 검출부에서 검출된 판매자 단말 정보에 따라 판매자의 신규 회원 유치 실적으로 집계하는 실적 집계부를 포함하는, 서비스 가입 유도에 따른 회원유치 실적관리장치에 의해 회원 유치 실적을 관리함에 있어 실제 회원 유치에 기여한 판매자에게 실적이 집계되도록 실적 관리의 투명성과 공정성을 보장하고 실적에 따른 인센티브를 판매자에게 효과적으로 분배할 수 있다.

title_en: Scheduling method, system, medium and electronic device for keeping long-term fairness
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a scheduling method, system, medium and electronic device for maintaining long-term fairness, the method comprising the steps of: acquiring the number information of the shifts of all employees in a preset time period; obtaining the accumulated deviation of the number of any employee for a certain shift and the total employee for the shift number according to the obtained shift number information; adding the sum of the accumulated deviation of each employee and the target shift value serving as the compensated target shift value into a constraint for describing the number of the employee shifts, and obtaining an optimal shift result according to a preset shift model; according to the scheduling optimization method, the accumulated workload of the staff is used as the offset and is included in the scheduling optimization model, and long-term scheduling fairness optimization is achieved through the optimization function.

title_en: School partitioning method considering maximum fairness and minimum objection number
abstract_en: The invention provides a school dividing method considering maximum fairness and minimum objection number, which comprises the steps of acquiring an information set of a school in a research area m and information sets of n residential communities; according to the information set of m schools and the information sets of n residential communities in the research area, under the goals of fairness maximization and objection minimization, constructing an entrance index distribution optimization model for distributing the entrance indexes of m schools to the entrance indexes of n residential communities, and setting constraint conditions of maximum school distance and school scale; and solving the entrance index distribution optimization model to obtain the distribution result of the entrance indexes of each school in each residential district, thereby determining the corresponding relation between each residential district and different schools nearby. The school index distribution scheme obtained by the invention not only improves the fairness of school index distribution, but also ensures the distance-to-school efficiency, reduces the resistance of introducing a random mechanism, and is convenient for implementing and managing the fairness reform of obligation education.
assignees: ZHONGGUIYUAN BEIJING PLANNING AND DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: Energy internet two-way auction optimization regulation and control method based on multi-period network flow
