abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of energy internet optimization, in particular to an energy internet two-way auction optimization regulation and control method based on multi-period network flow, which comprises the following steps: acquiring market member declaration information and power distribution network related information, and establishing a target optimization function based on maximized social welfare; converting the optimization problem into a minimum cost maximum flow problem, and constructing a network flow model of the optimization problem; solving the problem of minimum cost and maximum flow to clear the market, obtaining a deal pair matched with the electricity buying and selling parties one by one, and more clearly and transparently dynamically depicting the market equilibrium process; a decrement transaction mechanism is introduced to ensure the incentive compatibility of the mechanism; and eliminating invalid transaction pairs based on the market marginal price, and calculating to obtain the full-cost electricity price based on the market marginal price and the power distribution cost between the transaction pairs. Finally, an energy internet two-way auction optimization regulation and control method giving consideration to both benefits and fairness is formed.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;SICHUAN ENERGY INT RES INST TSINGHUA UNIV;UNIV TSINGHUA

title_en: Network security CTF competition multi-type cheating identification and traceability analysis method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for identifying and analyzing multi-class cheating in network security CTF competition, belonging to the technical field of network security. Firstly, monitoring the answering process of a player competition and recording a log; then analyzing players with abnormal logics in the answer step by using a finite state machine, judging abnormal players in the answer step based on normal distribution, proposing a player association degree calculation method according to flag submission time, finding suspicious high-similarity players, and analyzing and tracing cheating sources of the players; and finally, collecting and comprehensively judging the Writeup of the suspicious player and the answer logs in the new and old environments, and outputting cheating recognition results and analysis reports. The method effectively identifies cheating behaviors in the CTF competition instead of contests, one person with multiple numbers, flag copying other players or solution thinking, and locates suspicious similar players; meanwhile, multi-dimensional characteristic comprehensive comparative analysis of suspicious players can be collected, and judgment results with more persuasive force and cheating analysis reports are output, so that the fairness of the competition is guaranteed.

title_en: New energy station transaction method and device adapting to green electricity mechanism and camera adjustment access
abstract_en: The application provides a new energy station transaction method and device adapting to a green electricity mechanism and camera access, and relates to the technical field of new energy. The method comprises the steps of solving the constraint condition of the power generation constraint of the new energy station with the maximum capacity of the delivery channel as a target to generate a new energy station delivery channel capacity allocation strategy adapting to the access requirement of the camera, constructing a Nash bargained model which is incorporated into the market benefit contribution degree by taking the overall benefit optimal as a target and the individual rationality constraint as the constraint condition, solving the Nash bargained model to generate a benefit allocation strategy, and taking the new energy station delivery channel capacity allocation strategy and the benefit allocation strategy as transaction strategies. The application adopting the scheme effectively improves the capacity of the regional outgoing channel and ensures the fairness and rationality of the benefit distribution of market members participating in the electric power market.
assignees: STATE GRID JIBEI ZHANGJIAKOU SCENERY STORAGE AND TRANS NEW ENERGY CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Block chain-based virtual power plant optimal scheduling method in electric-carbon coupling market environment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a virtual power plant optimal scheduling method based on a blockchain in an electric carbon coupling market environment, which comprises the following steps of S1, establishing a committee based on all participating subjects in a virtual power plant, including a main representative node and a plurality of other member nodes, S2, establishing a virtual power plant optimal scheduling model, S3, solving the model outside the blockchain by the main representative node by applying a KKT condition, S4, encrypting and storing the obtained optimal solution by the main representative node to the blockchain, and then broadcasting the optimal solution to all other member nodes, S5, verifying received information by each other member node through a verification mechanism on the blockchain, judging whether the optimal solution is correct or not through a voting mechanism, if so, executing the optimal solution by the virtual power plant, and otherwise, determining a new main representative node and returning to the step S3. Compared with the prior art, the invention can realize high-efficiency resource optimization in peak shaving-carbon coupling markets, and ensure fairness of market participation and credibility of data.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV SHANGHAI JIAOTONG

title_en: A method and system for monitoring accountability and fairness for an enterprises
abstract_en: An automated system & method for real time monitoring and enhancing performance for an enterprise is disclosed herein. The present invention measures the performance objectively, instead of subjective measurement. The system comprises of plurality of electronic devices (1), a remote server (3), and an interface (2) providing link between the electronic devices (1) and the remote server (3), The system of the present invention facilitates time scheduling, parameter setting, progress updation, resource planning, task initiation, survey management and feedback, leave of absence and loss of pay management for the enterprise, day planning and management for the task executor, automated recovery in case of collapse of schedule and such.

title_en: Improved blocking cost distribution method based on Shapley value
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Shapley value-based improved blocking cost distribution method, which comprises the following steps: (1) calculating the running state of the power system considering network constraint and not considering network constraint to obtain the blocking cost at each moment; (2) forming alliances by taking the load as a participant according to a user revocation mode, taking the negative blocking cost as a characteristic function, obtaining the characteristic function of each alliance and forming a cooperative game model; (3) solving a Shapley value of the cooperative game model; (4) establishing a Shapley value-based improved cooperative game solving model, namely an equity minimum core solving model; (5) and carrying out blocking cost distribution according to the distribution strategy obtained by solving. The invention has higher stability.

title_en: Dynamic scheduling method for multi-runway flight getting in and out
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic scheduling method for multi-runway flight getting in and out. The method comprises the following steps that flight delay cost is analyzed, and a flight delay cost minimization objective function for multi-runway flight getting in and out scheduling is provided; theoretic delay time is calculated, and flight delay time of different aircraft types is converted into delay time of unit delay cost; fairness of multi-runway scheduling is analyzed, and the objective function considering the fair factor is built; ordinary constrain conditions of multi-runway flight dynamic scheduling are provided; the multi-runway flight scheduling constrain conditions considering flight delay are designed; the dynamic scheduling problem of multi-runway flight getting in and out is solved by adopting the genetic algorithm, dynamic scheduling of multi-runway flight getting in and out is achieved, and the purposes of improving the runway using rate and reducing the flight delay cost are achieved. According to the method, influence on multi-runway scheduling caused by flight delay is sufficiently considered, and the purposes of improving the runway using rate and reducing the flight delay cost are achieved.

title_en: Project review method, system, device and medium based on agile management
abstract_en: The application discloses a project review method, a project review system, a project review device and a project review medium based on agile management, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining project labels of projects to be reviewed and reviewer labels of each reviewer; selecting corresponding reviewers from the reviewers according to the corresponding relation between the preset project tags and the reviewer tags, and reviewing the project; and acquiring the evaluation information of the corresponding evaluation personnel respectively aiming at the project, and determining the evaluation result of the project according to the evaluation information. The online automatic distribution review mode is changed from the offline opposite review mode, so that the process is simplified, and manpower and material resources are saved. And the scope of the evaluation personnel is enlarged, the evaluation time is saved, and the evaluation efficiency is greatly improved. The project is classified, the evaluation personnel performs attribute division and grade division, and the special person is responsible, so that the evaluation quality and efficiency and the evaluation fairness are improved. The system can also record the evaluation key points, which is beneficial to the viewing of data and the accumulation and collection of technology.
assignees: SHANDONG AICHENGSHI NETWORK INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Scheduling method, device, equipment and medium based on customer service agents
abstract_en: The application discloses a scheduling method, device, equipment and medium based on customer service agents, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a manual gap every day in a scheduling period and a manual gap at each scheduling time point; acquiring a predicted date with the maximum manpower gap and a predicted shift time point with the maximum manpower gap in the predicted date according to the manpower gap per day and the manpower gap of each shift time point; calculating the manual work capable of being scheduled at the predicted scheduling time point of the predicted date, and acquiring the available shift of the manual work capable of being scheduled; and calculating residual square sum descending values of available shifts of all manual labor to be shifted and the manual labor to be shifted by using a least square method, and selecting the available shifts of the manual labor to be shifted with the largest residual square sum descending value for shifting. The problems that the conventional manual scheduling personnel are not timely enough to allocate, the call completing rate reaches the standard, the operation cost of a call center is high, fairness and efficiency are difficult to consider are solved, and compared with a traditional planning algorithm, a better solution can be found rapidly.
assignees: PING AN TECH SHENZHEN CO LTD

title_en: Bus turnover plan optimization method considering train number task allocation fairness
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bus turnover plan optimization method considering fairness of traffic task allocation, which comprises the steps of 1, constructing a turnover state space-time network capable of representing a bus to execute traffic tasks according to a given schedule, comprising a space-time node set and a space-time arc set in a space-time network diagram, 2, constructing a bus turnover plan network flow model aiming at minimizing the number of buses to execute service tasks based on the constructed space-time network, 3, solving the mathematical model by utilizing a Lagrange relaxation algorithm to obtain an initial bus turnover plan scheme, and 4, adjusting the obtained initial bus turnover plan scheme considering fairness to finally obtain an optimal bus turnover plan scheme. The invention considers fairness of the allocation of the bus number tasks, uses fewer buses as possible, ensures that all the bus number tasks are executed, improves the bus running efficiency, and balances the workload of bus service personnel.

title_en: Emergency rescue resource scheduling dynamic planning model for evacuation of wounded person after disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency rescue resource scheduling dynamic planning model for evacuation of wounded persons after disaster, which particularly relates to the technical field of emergency rescue, wherein the model is based on a preset disaster area rescue environment, and an objective function of the model is obtained by setting and serving constraint on a tent, keeping wounded circulation and conservation, ambulance scheduling constraint, processing of non-rescue wounded persons and hospitals and setting decision variable types, introducing deprivation cost to divide the wounded evacuation rescue process into multiple stages to calculate deprivation cost of each stage, wherein the deprivation cost comprises deprivation cost of a heavy wounded person, total deprivation cost of each wounded person and total deprivation cost of all wounded persons, and the total deprivation cost of all wounded persons is combined with the moving cost of a medical rescue tent, the transportation cost of an ambulance and the unreserved punishment cost of the wounded persons, namely the model minimizes the total emergency rescue cost.

title_en: Method and system for evaluating information value of collaborative scheduling excitation and sharing application
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for evaluating and sharing application of information value of collaborative scheduling excitation, which comprise the following steps: the household nodes collect multi-source information such as energy storage, distributed output, electricity consumption and the like, construct quality indexes according to credibility, timeliness and marginal contribution and combine the quality indexes into scheduling characteristics. The centralized control end quantifies the value of each information source based on marginal benefit and improved Shapley contribution metric (layered Monte Carlo sampling approximation), generates value weight and updates node reputation. And embedding the information value weight and the reputation factor into an optimized scheduling model, and adopting a main-auxiliary decoupling solving framework to perform layered iterative solving under the matched information contribution distribution and clearing framework to form and issue an executable control instruction. And converting the benefits into compensation or points according to the contribution degree of the information of each node according to the period to finish settlement. The method systematically excavates the data potential of the user side on the premise of not remarkably increasing hardware investment, and improves the economy, toughness and cooperative fairness of the micro-grid.
assignees: SHANGHAI QINGHUAN ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: System and method for marketing mix optimization for brand equity management
abstract_en: A method of marketing optimization with respect to brand lifetime management formulates a problem of brand equity maximization utilizing Markov Decision Process (MDP) thereby casting brand equity management as a long term regard optimization problem in MDP, The marketing mix is optimized by formulating the mix as actions in MDP and, utilizing historical marketing and transaction data, aspects of the MDP are estimated.
